Series.name: F**k Buddies
Series.description: F*ck Buddies, we see a middle-aged man on his couch drinking a glass of scotch, when his daughter walks in, sits next to him and takes a swig. "How's your sex life?," he asks her, matter-of-factly. They drone on about his date and her new friends and when the scene ends, she replies, "to answer your question, it's going pretty amazing." The effect the show is going for is cool and casual; just a father-daughter duo knocking back after a tough day at work. But then you watch it again and notice that there's nothing else in the scene. It doesn't lead to anything nor does it reveal something new about Jiah (Jikki Nair), the show's protagonist. And when you realize that the father doesn't get a second scene in the show, you sense a problem. The scene was written exclusively for its shock value. Which is ok if the show was trying to achieve something that was truly shocking. Even its central concept, about two friends "benefitting" with no strings attached, isn't exactly fresh. Other than the novelty of such a scenario being set in Chennai, it isn't rocket science for it to be explained. The contrived "Rules of F*ck Buddies" for instance. 'No going out', is one. 'No texting or calling' is another. Not only are these rules spelled out, but they are written up, framed and hung on Jay's (Jaytesh) bedroom wall. For people trying to keep things casual without labels, they seem extremely finicky about the rules. It's a show that tries too hard to be hip and progressive, but in the process, it reduces millennials to a bunch of alcoholic dimwits with nothing but sex on their minds. How about some texture while writing these characters? I know nothing about Jay, even after the whole show, other than he's a YouTuber (don't know what kind) and that he's a "wet dhummer"(someone who only smokes when he drinks). The same goes for Jiah. She's free and sexually liberated but does every single scene have to play out exactly the same way. It's hinted that she has some sort of a disease but it's neither serious enough to do some real damage nor is it used in such a way that it contributes to the screenplay. F*ck Buddies is a show so excited to be able to use the F word (and its many iterations) that it forgets that those words have to also make sense. And for all its progressive take on a modern relationship, one wishes they'd taken a ballsier stand. What's more to say about a show whose only intention is to make the audience go WTF.

Disney Plus Hotstar.description: Feeling unappreciated, Mustakim, a debt collector, decides to find a second wife. Chaos ensues when he's unable to consummate his marriage.

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Vidkill

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Faulad - Nerves of Steel

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Sab Cultures

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Hansika's Love Shaadi Drama
Disney Plus Hotstar.description: Actress Hansika Motwani as she prepares for her marriage to the love of her life, Sohael Khaturiya.

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: What Lies Within
Disney Plus Hotstar.description: Ayla, a 3rd year high school girl, is enjoying her teenage years and her love affair with Ando, the rock band vocalist. She is very surprised when a young pilot named Arsen, who claims to be her husband.

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Art in Motion

Disney Plus Hotstar.name: Gods of Gourmet

Witness the tales of nine (9) culinary maestros and the iconic restaurants that spotlight India's gastronomic prowess. From age-old traditions to avant-garde innovations, this series is a testament to India's position as a global gourmet superpower.

Jio Cinema.name: Game of Thrones
Jio Cinema.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.

Jio Cinema.name: Succession
Jio Cinema.description: The Roy family is known for controlling the biggest media and entertainment company in the world. However, their world changes when their father steps down from the company.

Jio Cinema.name: The Last of Us
Jio Cinema.description: After a global pandemic destroys civilization, a hardened survivor takes charge of a 14-year-old girl who may be humanity's last hope.

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
Jio Cinema.description: An orphaned boy enrolls in a school of wizardry, where he learns the truth about himself, his family and the terrible evil that haunts the magical world.

Jio Cinema.name: Dune: Prophecy
Jio Cinema.description: Two Harkonnen sisters combat forces that threaten the future of humankind and establish the fabled sect that will become known as the Bene Gesserit.

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
Jio Cinema.description: Harry Potter finds himself competing in a hazardous tournament between rival schools of magic, but he is distracted by recurring nightmares.

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
Jio Cinema.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione set out on a quest to eliminate the remaining horcruxes. On the other hand, the students and teachers must unite to defend Hogwarts against Lord Voldemort and his army.

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1

Jio Cinema.name: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Jio Cinema.name: Aquaman

Jio Cinema.name: Meg 2: The Trench

Jio Cinema.name: The Idol
Jio Cinema.description: Jocelyn is desperate to reclaim her rightful title as the greatest and sexiest pop diva in America after a nervous breakdown disrupted her most recent tour, and after Tedros, a notorious nightclub entrepreneur, reignites her passions.

Jio Cinema.name: Charlie
Jio Cinema.description: Dharma is stuck in a rut with his negative and lonely lifestyle and spends each day in the comfort of his loneliness. A pup named Charlie enters his life and gives him a new perspective towards it.

Jio Cinema.name: Drishyam
Jio Cinema.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

Jio Cinema.name: Asur: Welcome to Your Dark Side
Jio Cinema.description: Shubh returns for revenge and this season he takes the challenge to a whole new level. With the heroes fallen apart, will a desolate Dhananjay Rajpoot and a torn Nikhil Nair be able to stop him?

Jio Cinema.name: Bajirao Mastani

Jio Cinema.name: Jab We Met
Jio Cinema.description: A depressed wealthy businessman finds his life changing after he meets a spunky and care-free young woman.

Jio Cinema.name: Kahaani
Jio Cinema.description: A pregnant woman's search for her missing husband takes her from London to Kolkata, but everyone she questions denies having ever met him.

Jio Cinema.name: Welcome

Jio Cinema.name: Omkara

Jio Cinema.name: LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha

Jio Cinema.name: Iraivi

Jio Cinema.name: Vicky Donor

Jio Cinema.name: Thuppakki

Jio Cinema.name: Dasvi
Jio Cinema.description: Jailed under a tough cop, an uneducated politician decides to spend his time studying for high school, while his scheming wife has plans of her own.

Jio Cinema.name: The New Classmate
Jio Cinema.description: Follows a single woman (a Mom) and dreams on her Daughter.

Each week, housemates nominate two of their fellow housemates for eviction, and the housemates who receives the most nominations would face a public vote. Eventually, one housemate would leave after being "convicted" from the House. In the final week, there were five housemates remaining, and the public voted for who they wanted to win. Housemates are overseen by a mysterious person known as 'Bigg Boss', whose only presence in the house is through his voice.

Here, trust becomes strategy, confidence becomes ego, fear influences judgment, and ambition competes with integrity. IFI is not about predicting stock prices or giving investment advice. It is a cinematic exploration of human behavior under financial pressure, where immersive challenges, business survival scenarios, strategic negotiations, leadership conflicts and emotionally charged eliminations reveal who deserves to become India's next Money Superstar. Watching over this universe is BullVale(TM), the Eternal Guardian of The Financial Universe(TM) a silent symbol of wisdom, discipline and accountability. He does not interfere. He does not judge. He simply watches every decision, reminding contestants that true wealth is measured not by what they own, but by who they become. More than a television show, IFI is a technology-first entertainment franchise designed to expand beyond television through streaming, digital experiences, creators, community, live events, education, merchandise and future global adaptations. Because in The Financial Universe(TM). When Money Enters... Character Is Revealed.

Zee5.description: Jatt is a reluctant superhero who fights crime and protects people. He meets his match in the evil Raka, who he must vanquish to save the day.

Zee5.name: The Final Call
Zee5.description: When the pilot of Skyline flight 502, decides to end his life by committing suicide, he puts the lives of the 300 plus passengers in danger. Airline officer Kiran Mirza along with the ATS team, swings into action to save the passengers.

Zee5.name: Sanak
Zee5.description: Sanak is an action-thriller film, summarizing the emotion and journey of a lone hero, who fights overwhelming odds in a restricted environment, to save his wife and other unfortunates, helpless hostages, from the perils of evil.

Zee5.name: Helmet
Zee5.description: A quirky comedy from the heartland of India, it touches upon a topic that is considered embarrassing for most people in India and will showcase the same in a hilariously entertaining manner.

Zee5.name: Lost
Zee5.description: An emotional thriller that represents a higher quest, a search for lost values of empathy and integrity.

Zee5.name: Blurr
Zee5.description: With progressive blindness setting in, Gayatri has to find answers to her twin sister's unlikely death. As the lines of reality keep getting blurred, is she ready to look the truth in the eye?

Zee5.name: Srimanthudu
Zee5.description: Harsha, a multi-millionaire's heir who has everything, still feels that there is something missing in his life. In an attempt to fill the void, he adopts a village to bring change in the people.

Zee5.name: Kaalidas
Zee5.description: A cop, who suffers from family issues, takes up a peculiar suicide case. The plot thickens as similar cases get reported within a span of a few days.

Zee5.name: Crrush
Zee5.description: The plot revolves around the life of three youngsters. They dream to shift to America with a special desire.

Zee5.name: Footfairy
Zee5.description: When a serial killer with a foot fetish goes on the loose in Mumbai targetting young women, CBI officer Vivan Deshmukh is tasked with finding the murderer. Will he succeed?

Zee5.name: Max
Zee5.description: Inspector Arjun Mahakshay, law and order inspector reports to duty at a new police station after a 2 months suspension and faces an unexpected situation. Can Arjun save the day?

Zee5.name: Badnaam Gali
Zee5.description: It encompasses the journey of a surrogate mother, played by Patralekhaa, and her dynamic relationship with people around her.

Zee5.name: Jarann
Zee5.description: A family faces supernatural chaos when witchcraft and ancient beliefs invade their remote village. A woman must uncover the truth about dark rituals and herself as fear and madness grow.

Zee5.name: The Academy of Fine Arts
Zee5.description: A crew steals a valuable liquor bottle from a gang boss. Their clean escape turns chaotic as betrayal and hidden secrets surface, transforming their heist into a desperate fight to stay alive.

Zee5.name: Silence: Can You Hear It
Zee5.description: When everyone is hiding the truth, justice will thrive despite the silence. Prepare for a murder mystery that will keep you guessing till the end.

Zee5.name: Mask
Zee5.description: 440 crores stolen. Seven days to get it back. A game of greed, betrayal and intrigue culminates into an explosive climax in this story of a greedy man, a conniving woman and an uncanny guy with a bag full of tricks.

Zee5.name: Aravindha Sametha
Zee5.description: A young scion of a powerful family with a long history of violence decides to put an end to the bloodshed which leads him to a path of self discovery.

Zee5.name: Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak
Zee5.description: Despite knowing that their respective families are bitter enemies, Raj and Rashmi fall in love with each other and decide to elope.

Zee5.name: Raat
Zee5.description: When the Sharmas move into their new house in the city, they start experiencing strange incidents. The family seeks the help of a priest when their daughter, Mini, gets possessed.

Zee5.name: Nail Polish
Zee5.description: Nail Polish, written and directed by Bugs Bhargava Krishna, stars Arjun Rampal, Manav Kaul, Anand Tiwari and Rajit Kapur. It's a legal thriller that explores the uncertainty of the human mind.

Zee5.name: Deool Band
Zee5.description: NASA's youngest scientist Dr. Raghav Shastri returns to India and challenges his god-worshipping countrymen. He demands a local temple be shut down. In an unexpected turn, a deity appears to confront the atheist about his disbelief.

Zee5.name: Logout
Zee5.description: Set in Delhi, LOGOUT follows 26-year-old Pratyush, a social media influencer on the brink of reaching 10 million followers. However, his ambitions take a terrifying turn when an obsessive fan gains access to his all-important phone.

Zee5.name: Vimanam
Zee5.description: A father's endless pursuit to make his son's biggest dream of traveling in a flight come true.

Zee5.name: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
Zee5.description: This is the story of Sanjana, a girl of today's generation full of life and vibrant ecstasy. She lives life on her own terms and gets very upset when her mother Susheela, arranges for her to see a boy leading to a marriage prospect.

Zee5.name: United Kacche
Zee5.description: Tango's biggest dream in life is to shift abroad from his pind in Punjab. He finally manages, but as a kachcha, an illegal immigrant. Is life in the UK as rosy as Tango thought it would be?

Zee5.name: Yaara
Zee5.description: Story of 'Chaukdi Gang' and the two men who helped build this gang played by Vidyut Jammwal and Amit Sadh. This gang of four which includes Vijay Varma, is nabbed by the police and serve their time in jail. However, both men who once ruled the drug smuggling, gun-running and looting struggle in their own different ways to escape their past and start a new life after being released.

Zee5.name: Commando 3
Zee5.description: Karan goes to London to stop a terrorist attack on India.

Zee5.name: Saunkan Saunkanay 2
Zee5.description: A man with two quarreling wives faces chaos when his mother brings home an Italian woman as a potential third wife. His current wives, who are sisters, unite against this new threat while village onlookers watch the drama unfold.

Zee5.name: Kuttram 23
Zee5.description: ACP Vetrimaaran investigates a series of murders related to the medical industry.

Zee5.name: Kaamraj
Zee5.description: Kaamraj is gripping as it depicts the clash of prophecy, power, and love in a fantastical country.

Zee5.name: Dookudu
Zee5.description: Ajay, (Mahesh Babu) an undercover cop, is assigned to catch a dangerous mafia don with whom he has a personal score to settle.

Zee5.name: Vanvaas
Zee5.description: Delves into the dynamics between an elderly father grappling with dementia and his family.

Zee5.name: The Signature
Zee5.description: After 35 years of marriage, Madhu falls critically ill, leaving Arvind torn between hope and acceptance as she lies on life support.

Zee5.name: Solo Brathuke So Better
Zee5.description: 'Solo Brathuke So Better' is a love story between a young man who believes and preaches his philosophy of staying single in his college days, and a young woman who takes his ideology to next level agtr the man leaves the college. What happened when he realizes that his philosophy is wrong over a period of time with his real life experiences and decides to get married and meets the same woman who has idolised his over the years in the same college and who followed his philosophy to the next level forms the cruz of the story.

Zee5.name: Mr Perfect
Zee5.description: Vicky breaks his engagement with Priya, his childhood friend, after he learns that she is making many compromises for his sake. However, time makes him realize the need for compromises in life.

Zee5.name: Jab Khuli Kitaab
Zee5.description: Gopal and Anusuya's decades-long marriage faces upheaval when a revelation surfaces. As secrets emerge, the family navigates emotions both touching and comedic, exploring love, companionship, forgiveness, and rediscovering one another.

Zee5.name: Kahaani 2
Zee5.description: A woman with a mysterious past is charged with kidnapping and murder.

Zee5.name: Agnyathavasi
Zee5.description: In 1997, a rural police inspector leads a simple life until a crime occurs at his quiet village outpost after 25 years. His investigation uncovers long-buried secrets in the town.

Zee5.name: Behen Hogi Teri
Zee5.description: A jobless youngster has to fight with criminal rivals who come to snatch away his neighborhood lady love as a bride and also his family which seems not to take note of his feelings towards the girl next door.

Zee5.name: Taish
Zee5.description: A story of friendship and loss of innocence when two worlds clash amid a wedding when a secret exposes a betrayal, and innocent friends converge with dangerous criminals and intense violence.

Zee5.name: Mudhal Nee Mudivum Nee
Zee5.description: In the 1990s, a group of high school students in a strict Catholic school navigate their way through everyday teen pressures. Watch Mudhal Nee Mudivum Nee, a ZEE5 Exclusive film.

Zee5.name: Mazaka
Zee5.description: The path to true love does not run smoothly when a father and son seek marriage at the same time.

Zee5.name: Thiru.Manickam
Zee5.description: A man who is getting chased by everyone for doing good, yet he overcomes opposition. Among everyone who is trying to survive, this man wants to live. Shows how Manikkam becomes Thiru Manikkam

Zee5.name: Safia/Safdar
Zee5.description: When Salman falls ill, his saloon is at stake as the local moneylender wants it. The only person standing in the way is Salman's daughter, Safia. Will she be able to keep the salon running as Safdar?

Zee5.name: Bob Biswas
Zee5.description: Bob Biswas, an insurance agent, is released from hospital after eight years in a coma and is welcomed by his wife Mary and son Benny. He has lost his memory and does not remember the past.

Zee5.name: The Pet Detective
Zee5.description: Motivated to win the hand of his sweetheart, Kaikeyi, Tony Jose Alula joins his father's detective agency. Starting as a 'Pet Detective', Tony's cases quickly escalate into a dangerous kidnapping involving international smugglers.

Zee5.name: Veere Di Wedding
Zee5.description: Four girls on their way to find true love discover that their friendship must remain strong until the wedding of a friend named Veer.

Zee5.name: Bhaiyya Ji
Zee5.description: A man who stands up for his family and seeks revenge for the wrongs done towards his loved ones.

Zee5.name: Gupt: The Hidden Truth
Zee5.description: Governor Jaisingh Sinha is murdered and the needle of suspicion points towards his estranged son, Sahil Sinha who must prove his innocence.

Zee5.name: Bha. Bha. Ba.
Zee5.description: Three interconnected lives unfold, with one being a successful conman who continuously deceives others without facing consequences.

Zee5.name: Nunakuzhi
Zee5.description: A young man caught in a web of lies and mistaken identities.

Zee5.name: Kamali
Zee5.description: A kabaddi champion from rural Maharashtra rebels against family, pursues dreams in Mumbai, and promotes education to prevent child marriage while maintaining her cultural identity.

Zee5.name: Phere
Zee5.description: Sanjay, a Rajput from Jahanabad, is in love with Aditi, a Jat from Jaipur. They want to get married, but don't want to hurt their families. So they plan to get married by arranging a fake set of parents. Will they succeed?

Zee5.name: The Pink Shirt
Zee5.description: Sophia must decide between a new and a compatible partner and a mother-in-law making consistent efforts at reconciliation. The intense yet humorous nature of relationships, complexities, and redefining bonds in the most unprecedented way.

Zee5.name: The Broken News
Zee5.description: News channels Awaaz Bharati News and Josh 24/7 have opposing principles that lead to a fierce rivalry. The dynamic journalists attempt to balance their lives while facing an uncertain future.

Zee5.name: Indian
Zee5.description: Brave Indian policeman Raj beats up, then arrests Muslim terrorist Khan. This gets him promoted, and he is congratulated by none other than his father-in-law, who is also a very high ranking policeman. Suddenly, Raj finds out that many policemen would like to see Khan go free. He consults his father-in-law and surprisedly finds no support from him. Disagreements and arguments ensue, and his father-in-law gets killed as a result. The Police suspect Raj of killing him, they begin the process of arresting him, and he runs away--while Khan is all set to get freed to do whatever he likes.

Zee5.name: Miruthan
Zee5.description: A traffic police officer teams up with his friend and doctors in order to escape a deadly zombie apocalypse in the town and find out the possible antidote to stop it before time runs out.

Zee5.name: Kolamavu Kokila
Zee5.description: To save her mother from terminal cancer, a young girl gets herself involved with the drug trafficking mafia active in the small towns of Tamil Nadu.

Zee5.name: Crime Beat
Zee5.description: Small-town crime journalist Abhishek finds his life and career affected by a fugitive gangster. As he gets trapped in a web of lies and motives, what price will he pay- to become a renowned reporter?

Zee5.name: Bhanupriya Bhooter Hotel
Zee5.description: Lawyer Aranya and his partner visit Bhanupriya's luxurious North Bengal mountain hotel during winter opening. Ghost disturbances plague guests at the property built illegally over a colonial graveyard. Mischievous spirits and chaos ensue.

Zee5.name: Lakshmi Niwas
Zee5.description: Lakshmi, a resilient woman, navigates the complexities of a traditional joint family while supporting her husband Shriniwas' dream of building their own home.

Zee5.name: Bobby
Zee5.description: Raj, the son of strict, wealthy parents, falls in love with Bobby, the daughter of a poor Christian fisherman -- a romance his parents oppose.

Zee5.name: Vaalvi
Zee5.description: Aniket and Avani, a couple, decide to end their lives together. A foolproof plan is made, but by Aniket and his girlfriend Devika. So, is a suicide being executed or a murder being planned?

Zee5.name: Tigers
Zee5.description: Ayan, a pharmaceutical salesman in Pakistan, takes on the multinational health care corporation he works for after he realizes they knowingly marketed a baby formula that's responsible for the death of hundreds of babies everyday.

Zee5.name: Pareeksha
Zee5.description: The film revolves around the story of an ordinary rickshaw driver in Bihar who aspires and dreams of providing a maximum possible quality education to his son by making arrangements for him to study at a private English medium school.

Zee5.name: DD Returns
Zee5.description: The protagonist and his friends hides a bag full of money and jewels in a haunted bungalow to ditch the police. When he goes to retrieve the bag, a ghost makes him play a survival game in order to leave with the bag.

Zee5.name: Sarvgunn Sampann
Zee5.description: Follows a young woman whose striking resemblance to an internationally renowned adult film star leads society to judge her, complicating her prospects of marriage and acceptance.

Zee5.name: Bastar: The Naxal Story
Zee5.description: Based on the real-life incidents of Naxals in Chattisgarh - The Bastar rebellion broke out in 1910 in present day Chattisgarh.

Zee5.name: Detective Sherdil
Zee5.description: Follows an amateur detective. A simulated comedy set in a criminal investigation.

Zee5.name: Yaanai
Zee5.description: PRV's family who lives with his two wives and children in Ramnad district.. Also, there is a family who is convinced that PRV's family only caused the death of his brother. The movie narrates many incidents that happen in the two families.

Zee5.name: Bhaagamathie
Zee5.description: IAS officer Chanchala Reddy is imprisoned in a haunted house, while she is interrogated by law enforcers investigating a politician they suspect of corruption.

Zee5.name: Bhairavam
Zee5.description: The relationship between three childhood friends begins to crumble as their loyalty is tested.

Zee5.name: Kammattam
Zee5.description: Detective Antonio George suspects murder when Samuel Umman dies. His probe into Samuel's worker Francis reveals a bigger conspiracy.

Zee5.name: Costao
Zee5.description: The story of the civil servant who worked unafraid to fix the system's failures

Zee5.name: Aabhyanthara Kuttavaali
Zee5.description: A man in a troubled second marriage faces divorce complications when legal battles spiral with false domestic violence and dowry claims, turning the justice system itself into a form of punishment.

Zee5.name: Thaanaa Serndha Koottam
Zee5.description: Angered by the corruption that stopped him from becoming a CBI officer, a young man forms a gang who pose as CBI officers and raids the corrupt.

Zee5.name: Hey Balwanth
Zee5.description: A young man uncovers the secrets behind his father's peculiar business.

Zee5.name: Koose Munisamy Veerappan
Zee5.description: This six-episode docu series looks at what happened in the case of the legendary sandalwood smuggler, poacher and terrorist Veerappan. It uses footage archived by Nakkheeran Gopal, editor and publisher of the Tamil journal Nakkheeran.

Zee5.name: Kona
Zee5.description: Kolluru hasn't performed its yearly Kona (buffalo) sacrifice, leaving the village uneasy. Narayana, with his robot Jogi, is drawn into the village. As the ritual nears, secrets surface - will he dare to face the truth behind the sacrifice?

Zee5.name: Dashavatar
Zee5.description: When evil rises, divinity manifests to defeat it. An aging Dashavatar folk theater performer faces life's storms, guided by the wisdom of this traditional Konkan art form blending myth, music, and dance.

Zee5.name: Godday Godday Chaa 2
Zee5.description: In a lively Punjabi village, women seize control of traditional wedding ceremonies from men, sparking a playful battle of wits as both sides try to outmaneuver each other through increasingly elaborate schemes.

Zee5.name: Kaakee Circus
Zee5.description: A thief breaks into a jail not to escape, but to steal a temple donation box. As a book-loving Jailer and his exasperated Constable scramble to solve the absurd crime, a wannabe detective duo turns it into a viral mystery.

Zee5.name: D/O Prasad Rao: Kanabadutaledu
Zee5.description: A father desperately searches for his missing daughter, uncovering hidden secrets and betrayals along the way. The investigation tests family bonds while revealing dark truths beneath seemingly normal lives.

Zee5.name: Rautu Ka Raaz
Zee5.description: After the mysterious death of a warden of Sevadham school, it is up to inspector Negi who suffers from PTSD to solve the high-profile investigation which leads him to disturbing facts.

Zee5.name: Velaikkaran
Zee5.description: A youngster from the slums battles against food adulteration by the company that employs him.

Zee5.name: Zapatlela
Zee5.description: A man is presumed to have been haunted when a doll possessed by the spirit of a gangster comes along in his life.

Zee5.name: Dev DD
Zee5.description: Devdas gets hotter and bolder with more attitude, drama, and alcohol like never before in this modern-day avatar. Follow the adventures of Devika as she falls in and out of love, lust, and betrayal to get a taste of the wild side.

Zee5.name: J.S.K - Janaki V v/s State of Kerala
Zee5.description: Film tells the story of Janaki who becomes the victim of an inhuman activity, her unexpected encounter with Adv. David Abel Donovan and how she fights for her justice challenging the court and the judiciary system of India.

Zee5.name: Bruce Lee - The Fighter
Zee5.description: A stuntman is mistaken for a police officer by an idealistic woman and begins fighting crime on behalf of the police.

Zee5.name: Honeymoon Se Hatya
Zee5.description: Honeymoon Se Hatya is a gripping true-crime documentary series that explores Why Women Kill. This series unravels shocking stories of love.

Zee5.name: Besharam
Zee5.description: A car thief falls in love with a woman whose car he has stolen.

Zee5.name: Tirangaa
Zee5.description: Brigadier Suryadev Singh and Police Inspector Shivajirao Waghle are appointed to bring down Pralayanth, a terrorist who murdered officer Rudrapratap Chauhan and plans to invade India.

Zee5.name: Krantiveer
Zee5.description: Disowned by his parents at a young age, a man ends up in a small village controlled by underworld dons and powerful politicians. Lazy, alcoholic, and unemployed, he gets influenced by a journalist with a positive mission.

Zee5.name: My Dear Bootham
Zee5.description: When a kid named Pannu finds a lantern in a cave, he opens it when he gets home and it releases the King of all Genies named Karkimuki. The genie helps the little boy with his problems of everyday life.

Zee5.name: Dhadakebaaz
Zee5.description: Lakshya finds a bottle, which has Gangaram trapped in it who is his lookalike. He promises to make everything possible with the sand in the bottle, but once the sand is over he will be free to go.

Zee5.name: Saas Bahu Achaar Pvt. Ltd.
Zee5.description: Saas Bahu Aachar Pvt. Ltd. revolves around Suman who constantly struggles to set up an achaar business and kickstart her entrepreneurial journey with a pure-hearted intent to get her kids back from her ex-husband, Dilip.

Zee5.name: Nenu Local
Zee5.description: A happy-go-lucky man accidentally falls in love with a woman whose father despises him. To further complicate matters, his lover has another suitor, who is deemed more worthy of her.

Zee5.name: Ghost
Zee5.description: A Group of some people hijacked the jail in the city and demanding the release of ghost or elsewhere all the criminals will be set free.

Zee5.name: Elumale
Zee5.description: In 2004, a girl and cab driver near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border become unwitting participants in a night filled with crime and conspiracy while trying to find each other.

Zee5.name: A Long Night
Zee5.description: Based on the incidents from the Sri Lankan civil war

Zee5.name: Jai Lava Kusa
Zee5.description: Sidelined at a very young age due to stammering, the eldest of identical triplets develops hatred for his younger brothers and creates havoc in their lives as they all reunite as adults.

Zee5.name: Nerkonda Paarvai
Zee5.description: When three young women are implicated in a crime, a retired lawyer steps forward to help them clear their names.

Zee5.name: Republic
Zee5.description: An IIT gold medalist gets pulled into the Indian Administrative Services, where he confronts the newly elected political establishment.

Zee5.name: Prince and Family
Zee5.description: Introverted bridal boutique owner, Prince, the town's most eligible bachelor, marries his polar opposite. Chaos and comedy ensue as their contrasting personalities clash in rural Kerala.

Zee5.name: Main Atal Hoon
Zee5.description: Follows the extraordinary life and political journey of Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee, an iconic figure in Indian politics and delves into the multifaceted persona of Vajpayee Ji, capturing his essence as a poet, a gentleman, and a statesman.

Zee5.name: Bhram
Zee5.description: A car accident turns Alisha Khanna's life upside down. The bestselling romance writer moves to Shimla to her sister's place in order to start over.

Zee5.name: Dial 100
Zee5.description: One night, while working at the Mumbai Police Emergency Call Centre, police officer Nikhil Sood gets a call from a hysterical woman who wants to commit suicide. Even as he tries to save her, Nikhil has no idea that it will lead to him endangering his own family as dark truths that he has been hiding threaten to destroy all that he loves and stands for.

Zee5.name: Sarvam Shakthi Mayam
Zee5.description: The personal journey of an atheist writer and a dysfunctional family as they embark on a pilgrimage to visit all 18 Maha Shakti Peethas.

Zee5.name: Rubaab
Zee5.description: Suraj, charming and quietly confident, falls for bold, independent Vaishali. Their growing romance faces mounting challenges and tests. When destiny steps in, their story takes an unexpected direction.

Zee5.name: Chhal Kapat: The Deception
Zee5.description: When a famous influencer is found dead during a destination wedding in a remote village, a cynical yet brilliant cop unearths dark secrets, hidden betrayals, and shocking truths, as every guest becomes a suspect in a twisted web of love.

Zee5.name: London Confidential
Zee5.description: Amid a series of brutal killings of Indian agents in London, a RAW officer and India's Ambassador to Great Britain race against time to find the traitor within their own ranks.

Zee5.name: Fingertip
Zee5.description: An eerie reminder of the destructive power of apps in the cyber world.

Zee5.name: The Accidental Prime Minister
Zee5.description: Explores Manmohan Singh's tenure as the Prime Minister of India and the kind of control he had over the cabinet and the country.

Zee5.name: Natee
Zee5.description: An ambitious actress rises to fame in the film industry, but her success comes at a price. As she navigates the complexities of stardom, she becomes entangled in a web of emotions that ultimately leads to tragedy.

Zee5.name: Riwaj
Zee5.description: After marrying Hanif, Zainab faces abuse from her in-laws. When he tricks her with 'triple talaq', she must decide whether to fight for justice and rebuild her life.

Zee5.name: Jamai 2.0
Zee5.description: Jamai 2.0 is about Siddharth (Ravi Dubey) seeking revenge from Roshini's (Nia Sharma) mother Durga Devi (DD) (Achint Kaur) who owns a chain of night clubs in the city.

Zee5.name: Shikarpur
Zee5.description: Keshto, a small-time detective, is determined to solve murders that are spreading terror in the hill town of Shikarpur. Will he catch the killer in time?

Zee5.name: Akbar Birbal
Zee5.description: Emperor Akbar and his witty advisor Birbal solve problems through humor and wisdom in medieval India, blending historical folklore with comedy while imparting life lessons.

Zee5.name: Rashmi Rocket
Zee5.description: A small-town girl overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete, but her glory is hindered when she is asked to undergo a gender test.

Zee5.name: Paltan
Zee5.description: An action-war drama based on the 1967 Nathu La and Cho La clashes along the Sikkim border after 1962 Sino-Indian War.

Zee5.name: Raktabeej 2
Zee5.description: An elite counter-terrorism unit races against time to stop mysterious leader Munir Alam from orchestrating chaos between India and Bangladesh. Their investigation leads them through dangerous territory from New Delhi to Bangkok.

Zee5.name: Interrogation
Zee5.description: Retired judge found dead, police interrogate 4 associates who met him that fateful day. Unimaginable twists unfold in this gripping tale.

Zee5.name: Sattamum Needhiyum
Zee5.description: A courtroom drama set in the bustling world of justice, where power and privilege dominate, the series narrates the transformative journey of Sundaramoorthy.

Zee5.name: Maarigallu
Zee5.description: A 1990s tale inspired by the lost treasure of Karnataka's Kadamba dynasty. Their first king Mayura Sharma's legacy intertwines with Maari, a deity said to guard the hidden riches.

Zee5.name: Oka Chinna Family Story
Zee5.description: The story of a small middle class family and a big twist that awaits them. What's the twist? How do they sail through it? A hilarious ride awaits.

Zee5.name: Siya
Zee5.description: Siya, a 17-year-old rape survivor, decides to go against all odds and fight for justice after being held captive and repeatedly abused by a group of powerful men. Can she win against the perpetrators?

Zee5.name: Thalaimai Seyalagam
Zee5.description: The investigations of a CM's corruption trial, a murder in Jharkhand and killings on the outskirts of Chennai take an unexpected turn when they seem linked to each other. What connects them all?

Zee5.name: Kadak Singh
Zee5.description: AK Srivastava an officer of the Department of Financial Crimes is diagnosed with retrograde amnesia despite which he solves the case of a Chit Fund Scam by listening to different perspectives of who he was and how he came to the hospital.

Zee5.name: Manorathangal
Zee5.description: An anthology of nine featurettes based on a curated selection of short stories by the celebrated writer M. T. Vasudevan Nair.

Zee5.name: Phullwanti
Zee5.description: Famous dancer Phullwanti's performance at Peshwa's court faces interruption from scholar Venkat Shastri. Defending her art, she challenges him, igniting a contest between her artistic talent and his intellect.

Zee5.name: Recce
Zee5.description: In 1990, in Tadipatri village, a son hires people to kill his own father and ends up getting killed himself. S.I Lenin who investigates these murders, uncovers that when consumed by jealousy, lust and greed, even families can turn lethal.

Zee5.name: Tadka
Zee5.description: A middle-aged Tukaram is passionate about food and archaeology but a misplaced call from Madhura that adds the tadka to his life. While love simmers, Nicole and Sidharth's story spices up too.

Zee5.name: Farrey
Zee5.description: After gaining admission into an elite school on scholarship, an orphan genius Niyati gets entangled in a cheating racket when some of her rich friends lure her into helping them cheat in exams through elaborate methods.

Zee5.name: Thode Door Thode Paas
Zee5.description: A nostalgic series exploring how tech changed relationships, contrasting with simpler times of genuine talks and family moments without Wi-Fi. Celebrates authentic connections and shared home experiences.

Zee5.name: Mann Mayal
Zee5.description: The story revolves around two neighbors, Manahil (Maya Ali) and Salahuddin (Hamza Ali Abbasi). They live in a provincial town in Sindh. Manahil, nicknamed as Mannu is best friend of Salahuddin's younger sister Beeya (Aiman Khan). Mannu's family is joint and wealthy where as Salahuddin lives a simple life with his mother (Ismat Zaidi), father (Shehryar Zaidi) and sister.

Zee5.name: Mafia
Zee5.description: Six college friends reunite for Tanya's bachelorette in Madhupur. A dark past incident binds them. Playing Mafia game stirs old trauma, turning the party dangerous as hidden betrayals surface.

Zee5.name: Haseena Maan Jaayegi
Zee5.description: Separated from their wealthy father and each other, two brothers (Sanjay Dutt, Govinda) try to win the hearts of their dream girls.

Zee5.name: Zombivli
Zee5.description: In the suburban city of Mumbai ie Dombivli an outrage of deadly virus breaks up and our protagonist with the help of his friends or people he just met during the outrageous event try to survive.

Zee5.name: Nellikkampoyil Night Riders
Zee5.description: Nellikampoyil, a village wrapped in age-old myths, is now gripped by strange and unsettling nights. Shyam, an energetic charmer boy, joins forces with his close friends as the darkness grows more unpredictable,drawing them into a mystery

Zee5.name: Chintu Ka Birthday
Zee5.description: During US invasion of Iraq some illegal migrants are waiting to get back home to India. As one such family prepares to celebrate the 6th birthday of their youngest member Chintu, their kind-hearted Iraqi landlord lends them a helping hand.

Zee5.name: Poison
Zee5.description: Jaiveer is back as Aditya to take revenge from the JOSH team comprising Sara, Harsh and Oscar. Watch out for the mind games that follow.

Zee5.name: Savalyachi Janu Savali
Zee5.description: A dark-skinned singer Savali must let someone else claim her talent. Sarang, raised in a family focused on appearances, falls in love with her voice. Their marriage leads to consequences.

Zee5.name: Adanga Maru
Zee5.description: A sincere cop suspended from the department for locking horns with a few influential people in the society, starts taking revenge against those who finished off his dear ones.

Zee5.name: Captain
Zee5.description: A team of soldiers, led by a brave army captain, takes up a dangerous mission to go into a restricted forest area and uncover the mystery behind the unexplainable deaths of previous teams that had visited the site.

Zee5.name: Maurh
Zee5.description: Set against the backdrop of the untamed sandy badlands of Punjab between 1885 and 1893, Maurh unveils a tale of resilience, honor, and defiance against the oppressive dual rule of British colonizers and native kings. Jeona Maurh and his brother Kishna Maurh emerge as beacons of hope, challenging this unjust system and fighting for their rights, witness the unforgettable story of them with their unique dreams, aspirations and struggles.

Zee5.name: Gaami
Zee5.description: Shankar, an amnesiac Aghori who suffers from the fear of touch, goes on a dangerous Himalayan trail in search of a mythical cure for his condition. What happens when his past uncovers the way for him?

Zee5.name: Ateet
Zee5.description: A soldier lost in war and pronounced dead returns after decade to his wife and daughter, only to realize that they have moved on. As he forces his way into their life, questions are asked whether he is dead or alive.

Zee5.name: Dharmaveer
Zee5.description: A biopic on life of a Hindu nationalist leader Anand Dighe, through various incidents narrated by his close aides.

Zee5.name: Brother
Zee5.description: A young man struggles to find his place after moving in with his sister and her in-laws.

Zee5.name: Raat Baaki Hai
Zee5.description: It's a story of one night where estranged lovers Kartik and Vasuki end up meeting each other after 12 years under strange circumstances. Kartik is on a run for being a murder suspect. However, there is more than meets the eye.

Zee5.name: Checkmate
Zee5.description: In a tangled web of power and love, the lives of a pharmaceutical company CEO, a failed Don, a grieving widower, and a shrewd lawyer intersect when a mysterious woman is kidnapped, sparking a chain of events in New York City's underbelly.

Zee5.name: Poovan
Zee5.description: The day to day life of Hari, who suffers from sleeplessness, takes a turnaround with the arrival of a rooster next door.

Zee5.name: Detective Dhanajay: Rahasyajaal
Zee5.description: A private detective, Dhananjay, is reluctantly drawn into a murder investigation in the small town of Shirgaon to help an innocent man who has been framed.

Zee5.name: Net
Zee5.description: Small-town, mobile store owner Laxman's life turns upside down when he encounters an online subscription-based spying website and starts following a young girl Priya. His innocent obsession leads him to take immoral decisions.

Zee5.name: Thambi
Zee5.description: Parvathy is elated when she finds out that her brother, Saravanan, who has been missing for 15 years, is in Goa. However, somebody has already hatched a plan to kill him.

Zee5.name: Shakti
Zee5.description: An honest cop refuses kidnappers' demands, risking his son's life. The rescued son bears lasting scars from his father's choice. Years later, the son becomes a Mafia don, and his father must bring him to justice.

Zee5.name: Macherla Niyojakavargam
Zee5.description: Siddhartha Reddy gets a posting as a district collector for the Guntur district in Andhra Pradesh. There he goes against Rajappa, a local rowdy and politician.

Zee5.name: Taarkata
Zee5.description: A former police officer returns to his hometown to probe a puzzling death connected to his history.

Zee5.name: Parchhayee: Ghost Stories by Ruskin Bond
Zee5.description: This winter, there's no escaping the shivers as ZEE5 Original 'Parchhayee' is all set to bring to life the most bone-chilling horror tales of celebrated author Ruskin Bond.

Zee5.name: Woh
Zee5.description: The Hindi adaptation of the 1990 American TV miniseries "It".

Zee5.name: Timepass 3
Zee5.description: Dagdu passes exams, joins college, and works as a paperboy. He reforms his rough past to win back Prajakta. He befriends Palvi, a don's daughter who also reforms. They fall in love. Her father approves, unaware of Dagdu's past.

Zee5.name: The Shaukeens
Zee5.description: Three friends in their 60s try to do everything that they couldn't do in their younger days - before death arrives.

Zee5.name: Uttar
Zee5.description: A radio host mother in Pune and her engineer son grow apart until his tech project unexpectedly brings them together. Through this journey, they rediscover their bond, proving a mother's love transcends modern life's changes.

Zee5.name: Mera Gaon Mera Desh
Zee5.description: When Ajit, a former prisoner, learns of Jabbar who is terrorising the people of his village, he decides to stand up against him. However, things take a turn when Jabbar abducts Ajit's lover.

Zee5.name: Paper Rocket
Zee5.description: Six strangers go on a road trip across Tamil Nadu to get closure on their personal challenges. In the trip, each one wants to fulfil a major wish in their bucket list. But it's a bumpy ride. Will they be able to fulfil their wishes?

Zee5.name: Khichdi 2
Zee5.description: When an intelligence services agent discovers that Praful resembles the king of Paanthukistan, he enlists the help of the Parekh family to place Praful in the king's position and save his subjects. Will the Parekh family save the world?

Zee5.name: Woh Bhi Din The
Zee5.description: A renowned photojournalist returns to his alma mater as a guest speaker, reminiscing about his carefree school days and first love

Zee5.name: Jai
Zee5.description: It's a tale of Simhabetu village, where Satya, a local boy is politically influenced by the ruling party MLA and works for him. but, Satya ignores the unsolved conflict of the Simhabetu village, until it affects him personally.

Zee5.name: Churails
Zee5.description: Four women set up an undercover detective agency to expose philandering husbands.

Zee5.name: : Halla Ho
Zee5.description: Loosely based on a real incident, 200: Halla Ho is the story of women, terrorised by a mobster whose gang raped, robbed, terrorised and murdered 300 families for 15 years until he met his nemesis in a young Dalit girl.

Zee5.name: Amoz Alexander
Zee5.description: A determined crime reporter's routine prison interview turns into a life-altering encounter when an inmate's disturbing confession forces her to question everything she knows about justice and truth.

Zee5.name: Dikkiloona
Zee5.description: A man travels back in time to change his unpleasant past and face the consequences. Where will he finally land up ?

Zee5.name: Pathu Pathu
Zee5.description: Struggling filmmaker Subbu is mysteriously murdered at 10:10. His body is discovered in a suitcase under a bridge. A policeman investigates to find the killer.

Zee5.name: Qismat 2
Zee5.description: Fortune 2.

Zee5.name: Har Har Mahadev
Zee5.description: This is the inspirational story of a real battle in which only 300 soldiers, led by Baji Prabhu Deshpande, the commander of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, held back an enemy army of 15,000 while Shivaji reached the safety of Khera fort.

Zee5.name: Mufti
Zee5.description: An undercover cop goes into the big bad world (Ronapura), an place taken over by a don, where his safety may be compromised.

Zee5.name: Saru
Zee5.description: A Rajasthani kabaddi star relocates to Mumbai, overcoming challenges while pursuing her dreams and helping her mother gain recognition within their family.

Zee5.name: Prem Shots
Zee5.description: A bride escapes her own wedding day and encounters a stubborn entrepreneur. Two people determined to go it alone discover they're stronger together.

Zee5.name: The Villain
Zee5.description: An interesting adaption of the relationship and the analogy of the iconic characters Ram and Ravan set in the present day world.

Zee5.name: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
Zee5.description: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

Zee5.name: Saand Ki Aankh
Zee5.description: Both over the age of 60, Chandro Tomar and Prakashi Tomar inspire other women in India when they demonstrate their expert sharpshooting skills.

Zee5.name: Pooja Meri Jaan
Zee5.description: A girl named Pooja is being stalked by an unidentified admirer of her.

Zee5.name: Haddi
Zee5.description: In this ZEE5 Original film, a transgender, Haddi moves to Delhi and joins a gang of transgenders and cross-dressers headed by an influential man. But is this move aspirational or driven by revenge?

Zee5.name: Blank
Zee5.description: A suicide bomber loses his memory and has a bomb attached to his heart. It is up to the police officers to prevent this bomb from taking innocent lives.

Zee5.name: Black Widows
Zee5.description: Tired of their abusive husbands, three women plan and execute their murders. It is an almost-perfect plan until Pankaj Mishra, assigned to the case, realises there is more to it.

Zee5.name: Abbar Kanchanjangha
Zee5.description: A story about a family who visit to their ancestral home in Kanchanjangha and the characters reveal their true colors as everyone has their motives for the visit.

Zee5.name: Battala Ramaswami biopikku
Zee5.description: Ramaswamy is kind and a true gentleman with two ambitions one is to have only single wife just like lord Rama and the second is to setup a saree business.

Zee5.name: Mum Bhai
Zee5.description: Mum Bhai is the story of Bhaskar Shetty, a top encounter specialist. His passion to rule the city saw no limits, and he ended up becoming someone he never wished to become. But then someone changed all the rules of his game.

Zee5.name: Raghu Thatha
Zee5.description: This is the hilarious story of a rebellious young woman, Kayalvizhi, who is forced to choose between principle and patriarchy.

Zee5.name: Chirutha
Zee5.description: The consequences that follow after the love between hero and heroine, when they accidentally fall in love on an island.

Zee5.name: Memu Copulam
Zee5.description: A prized rooster goes missing, and bumbling cops Ravi and Mohan dive into the case—only to stumble upon a hidden conspiracy that could shake their entire village.

Zee5.name: Vaayai Moodi Pesavum
Zee5.description: The people of the Panimalai hill station are in trouble as the government has put a ban on speaking to control the spread of the "dumb-flu," which spreads only through talking.

Zee5.name: Naxalbari
Zee5.description: STF agent Raghav goes on a secret mission to curtail the revival of a naxal uprising in Gadchiroli. But the war becomes too personal as he digs deeper and tries to uncover the larger plan of the uprising.

Zee5.name: U Turn
Zee5.description: Motorists who take an illegal U-turn on a flyover die mysteriously. Radhika, who is interning to be a journalist, is investigating it. However, she becomes the prime suspect by a twist of fate. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Kasargod Embassy
Zee5.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

Zee5.name: The Terrorist
Zee5.description: When chaos becomes the order of the day and a series of hate-driven atrocities go unpunished, a woman decides to take on the perpetrators and serve justice to the wronged.

Zee5.name: Kaafir
Zee5.description: Web series that follows the journey of a journalist who is seeking justice for an alleged militant.

Zee5.name: Dakuaan Da Munda 3
Zee5.description: An orphaned boxer from a criminal family battles addiction after tragedy strikes. Now sober, he seeks redemption while confronting a corrupt officer in Uttarakhand's forests.

Zee5.name: Vinodhaya Sitham
Zee5.description: The smooth life of Thambi Ramiah undergoes drastic change, after his death and resurrection. At his request, "the time" gave him extension for 3 months, to mend his affairs. Whether he was able to do it?

Zee5.name: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting
Zee5.description: In the 90s, in a remote village named Viratapalem, several young brides died a mysterious death immediately after getting married, which led people to believe that the village is cursed.

Zee5.name: Virgin Bhanupriya
Zee5.description: Bhanupriya, a conservative girl decides to lose her virginity but fails in her every attempt. A soothsayer predicts that it is an impossible task and it will not happen to her. She decides to overcome this bad luck.

Zee5.name: Mrigaya: The Hunt
Zee5.description: In Kolkata, four cops unite to pursue a dangerous criminal. The chase evolves beyond police vs criminals as various characters engage in their own pursuits, often conflicting with others.

Zee5.name: Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya
Zee5.description: This drama is generally based on different love story around india that goes through 8 seasons have been aired yet

Zee5.name: Andha Pyaar 2.0
Zee5.description: One woman. 4 men. Zero visual bias. A panel of 4-5 comedians orchestrating chaos, wit, and unexpected connections. When you can't see, you're forced to actually listen. Personality trumps appearance.

Zee5.name: Keedam
Zee5.description: Radhika Balan, a smart cyber-security expert, advocates the use of the technology for the good but her life is turned upside down when she falls prey to a cyber-stalking incident and her privacy gets compromised.

Zee5.name: Bhabhiji Ghar Par Hain! 2.0
Zee5.description: To secure the haveli, Tiwari fakes marriage with Anita and Vibhuti joins in with Angoori, but their charade unravels when Gayatri Devi recovers and Vidya Bhabhi's ghost traps them in Ghungatganj.

Zee5.name: Shabad: Reet aur Riwaaz
Zee5.description: In a tight-knit Punjabi household, Ghuppi a stammering teen, secretly chases his dream of football while being forced by his revered Ragi singer father to uphold the family tradition. As tensions rise, both father and son must confront.

Zee5.name: Hum Paanch
Zee5.description: Anand Mathur, a middle-class businessman living in Bombay, gets no end of trouble from his five wild, troublesome daughters.

Zee5.name: Kaafir
Zee5.description: Follows Kainaaz Akhtar, a Pakistani woman falsely imprisoned as a militant. Journalist Vedant discovers her and her daughter, who was born in prison. Motivated by a strong sense of justice, he embarks on a mission to uncover the truth.

Zee5.name: Love, Sitara
Zee5.description: A love story between a Malayali girl and a Punjabi chef, complicated by the family members on each side.

Zee5.name: Goli Soda
Zee5.description: Four adolescent boys fall prey of a baddie and things turn ugly.

Zee5.name: Who's Your Daddy
Zee5.description: Soggy, the coolest dad of 'Dilli' has the 'hottest' tale to tell his son as they go down the comical memory lane laced with 'blue-films' and hilarious encounters to uncover who's the Daddy of Soggy's son.

Zee5.name: Middle Class Love
Zee5.description: A young college boy is frustrated being in middle-class family setup and finds love the ideal way to get out of it.

Zee5.name: Thamilarasan
Zee5.description: An honest police officer gets in to a conflict with Rana. Their enmity worsens when Tamilarasan refuses to obey Rana's order in a critical situation.

Zee5.name: Agilan
Zee5.description: When a crane operator starts controlling illegal trades at the harbor, he winds up clashing with another gangster.

Zee5.name: Joto Kando Kolkatatei
Zee5.description: A young detective enthusiast follows in the footsteps of legendary Bengali sleuth Feluda when a decades-old mystery resurfaces during Durga Puja, testing his skills against a puzzle that once stumped his hero.

Zee5.name: Ippudu Kaaka Inkeppudu
Zee5.description: Gautam and Anu grow up in traditional households, where they are barred from speaking with people of the opposite gender. How do the two handle their newfound freedom when they move to a city?

Zee5.name: Khudgarz
Zee5.description: Two childhood friends from different social classes grow close after a mother's intervention. As adults, their friendship faces challenges when a business dispute over land creates tension between their families.

Zee5.name: Barzakh
Zee5.description: Family drama unfolds as a reclusive resort owner invites his estranged children to his third and final wedding, but the locals believe his bride-to-be is a long-dead woman.

Zee5.name: Andhar Maya
Zee5.description: A family moves back to their ancestral home and faces supernatural occurrences as unresolved past events linger.

Zee5.name: Beyond the Clouds
Zee5.description: A hedonistic teenager in Mumbai is busted for dealing drugs and goes to his estranged sister for help, but complications land her in jail.

Zee5.name: Balupu
Zee5.description: Ravi, who works as a collection agent for a bank, realizes that a couple cheats gullible people of their money. He decides to give them a taste of their own medicine and falls in love along the way.

Zee5.name: Laadla
Zee5.description: The headstrong owner of a factory, Sheetal, marries Raju, the union leader of the factory, to quell his spirit and teach him a lesson. In the process, she ends up learning a few lessons herself.

Zee5.name: Shwetkali
Zee5.description: Families of Urvi and Palash's arrive at Kharapani Mansion to celebrate their engagement. As the house starts getting prepared for the upcoming engagement ceremony, a wall breaks and there emerges the eerie idol of a white kali ..Shwetkali.

Zee5.name: Expiry Date
Zee5.description: A married man discovers his wife cheating on him and accidentally kills her - what ensues is a series of unexpected plot twists.

Zee5.name: Bloody Brothers
Zee5.description: Driving home late one night, two brothers, Jaggi and Daljeet run over an old man. They put the body back in his house, but when people suspect, the brothers' lives fall apart. They realise they can trust no one. Not even each other.

Zee5.name: Vedha
Zee5.description: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

Zee5.name: Oru Kodai Murder Mystery
Zee5.description: Vyom, a nerdy teenager, has a crush on his senior and quiz partner, Tara. When Tara goes missing and is found dead, Vyom and his friends decide to investigate the case. What will they find?

Zee5.name: Lantrani
Zee5.description: The different segments of small towns and rural worlds where people take absurd measures to survive.

Zee5.name: Devi
Zee5.description: Krishna unwillingly marries a village girl and moves to a new house. After seeing an abrupt and drastic change in her personality, he realizes that a spirit has possessed her and tries to save her.

Zee5.name: The Great Father
Zee5.description: A businessman who is trying hard to be a good father to his daughter has a run-in with malevolent policeman.

Zee5.name: Mammattiyaan Stars
Zee5.description: Three die-hard cricket fans and a spirited young woman set out on an unforgettable journey to witness the final season of the legendary cricketer they have idolized for years.

Zee5.name: Nenjam Marappathillai
Zee5.description: A god-fearing young woman who takes up the job of a caretaker in a rich household tries to take revenge on her lustful employer.

Zee5.name: Puli Meka
Zee5.description: A serial killer is targeting police officers in Hyderabad. A female cop in charge of the Special Investigation Team and a forensic expert race against time to find the culprit.

Zee5.name: Cabaret
Zee5.description: The films follows the life of a cabaret dancer.

Zee5.name: Qubool Hai 2.0
Zee5.description: It is the story of Asad and Zoya -- two individuals who have surrendered to their ideals. One to the cause of his country, another to her duty towards her family.

Zee5.name: RejctX
Zee5.description: High school thriller drama set in an elite International school. It deals with teen millennial issues such as body shaming, gender fluidity, sexual orientation and love which inspires them to form their own band.

Zee5.name: Amrutham
Zee5.description: Two friends, Amrutham and Anjaneyulu, come up with different plans to boost their hotel business. In the process, they make silly mistakes and fail hysterically.

Zee5.name: Aakhree Raasta
Zee5.description: An ex-convict is bent on revenge against the people responsible for his wrongful imprisonment but is pit against his estranged son who is now a police officer.

Zee5.name: Endrendrum Punnagai
Zee5.description: Three best friends, Gautham, Baby and Sri, decide to stay single all their lives. But Baby and Sri get married and Gautham is left alone until Priya comes into his life.

Zee5.name: Eka Lagnachi Dusri Goshta
Zee5.description: Radha, a modern, independent girl, who lives alone with her father has so far rejected 71 boys for marriage. Ghanshyam, a fun loving foodie, living in a joint family, has rejected 63 girls for marriage. They meet and agree to get married.

Zee5.name: Date with Saie
Zee5.description: A famous actress finds herself stalked by an obsessed fan who secretly films her life with hidden cameras. She must deal with the threat when she discovers the surveillance.

Zee5.name: Anantham
Zee5.description: Estranged son Ananth returns to his family home Anantham and goes on a journey down memory lane to find the stories of the wonder, betrayal, success, love, laughter, horror and courage of the different families and people who lived there.

Zee5.name: Ayali
Zee5.description: Shunned by her family over false accusations against her mother, Ayali tolerates her stepmom's cruelty and teams up with Shiva to expose and prove her mother was innocent.

Zee5.name: Contract
Zee5.description: Bastard, a young man, accepts the contract to kill gangster Black Ranju, but things get complicated with the entry of gritty cop Begh.

Zee5.name: Writer Padmabhushan
Zee5.description: Padmabhushan, a 25-year-old aspiring writer based out of Vijayawada and his middle class family take us on a roller coaster ride packed with innocuous fun and soft emotions, with their heart in the right place.

Zee5.name: Annamayya
Zee5.description: A cinematic version of the life of famous Indian saint-poet, Annamayya.

Zee5.name: Ratris Khel Chale
Zee5.description: Anna Naik passes away on the day of his son's engagement.After his death several unnatural things happen in their house.The family believes that it's spirit of Shevanta who hanged herself outside their house as Anna had betrayed her.

Zee5.name: Tarla
Zee5.description: Explores Tarla Dalal's journey and legacy as an iconoclast during the early liberalisation period, empowering women through the art of cooking.

Zee5.name: Veetla Vishesham
Zee5.description: While Elango struggles to accept the news of his middle-aged mother's pregnancy, the situation jeopardises his relationship with his girlfriend, Sowmya, and his parents face social ridicule.

Zee5.name: The Great Pre-Wedding Show
Zee5.description: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected hurdles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before tying the knot.

Zee5.name: Naan Sirithaal
Zee5.description: Gandhi is an IT guy who suffers from Pseudobulbar, and he uncontrollably laughs during stressful moments. He is taken to a Shiva temple and tied with a holy ornament, which is very strong, but it would bring a threat to him if separated.

Zee5.name: Mugil Pete
Zee5.description: In a town divided by traditional and modern views on relationships, Raja and Apoorva's love story challenges their families' long-held beliefs about marriage.

Zee5.name: Madam Sengupta
Zee5.description: A famed cartoonist's search for her daughter's killer unravels a sinister trail of poetic murders-leading back to her estranged ex-husband, whose forbidden play threatens to expose Kolkata's darkest secrets.

Zee5.name: Rekka
Zee5.description: A lawyer kidnaps a young woman without meaning to.

Zee5.name: Yek Number
Zee5.description: Politically confused Pratap undertakes an unconventional task to win Pinky's affection. His subsequent experiences guide him toward self-discovery and finding a life's purpose.

Zee5.name: Khaali Peeli
Zee5.description: Follows a taxi driver who picks up a girl while he is on the run and ends up in a crazy roller-coaster of events.

Zee5.name: Inspection Bungalow
Zee5.description: In the village of Aravangad, Sub-Inspector Vishnu is forced to shift his police station to a haunted Forest Inspection Bungalow with a dark past.

Zee5.name: Legacy
Zee5.description: From every corner of the country, the finest rappers bring their original music, their stories, and everything they've got for one shot at earning their LEGACY.

Zee5.name: Kather Basha Endra Muthuramalingam
Zee5.description: In Ramanathapuram district, where Nana, the powerful gangster, tries to take control of the village. Kathar is not ready to listen to him and refuses to make peace with them. Will both survive the battle or not?

Zee5.name: Love Scandals & Doctors
Zee5.description: Love, Scandal and Doctors is a story of 5 medical interns who got embroiled in a scandal. They are the prime accused in a murder. The question lies - Are these students even capable of committing such a crime or are they just being framed?

Zee5.name: Chathur Mukham
Zee5.description: An ambitious young woman faces a supernatural force through technology. Will she be able to survive the onslaught and solve this unheard phenomenon?

Zee5.name: Kavan
Zee5.description: A TV journalist goes against his corrupt and dishonest boss's orders and helps a group of youngsters in their fight against a chemical plant.

Zee5.name: Baai Tujhyapayi
Zee5.description: Set in the early 90s in a remote village of Vesaich Vadgaon, Maharashtra. We follow a story of a young girl as she navigates 500-year-old oppressive customs in the village of Vesaich Vadgaon, in the hopes of one day becoming a doctor.

Zee5.name: Chatrapathi
Zee5.description: Shivaji and his family are uprooted from their community in Sri Lanka and wind up as bonded labourers in Visakhapatnam. The situation worsens when his jealous stepbrother enters his life.

Zee5.name: Water Bottle
Zee5.description: Water Bottle is a ZEE5 Original series starring Deepak Chakraborty and Rajatava Dutta. Directed by Tathagata Mukherjee, this psychological crime drama narrates the story of a serial killer. Get ready to know what goes inside the mind of a serial killer.

Zee5.name: Diya
Zee5.description: After abortion, a woman's life takes an unexpected turn when she is visited by the foetus, who is now grown up and is visible to her.

Zee5.name: Thothapuri: Chapter 1
Zee5.description: Gowda, a farmer and ladies' tailor with a twisted sense of humor. Shakila, who visits the local temple with a similar sense of humor, becomes his match. Will love triumph over religious prejudices?

Zee5.name: Mister
Zee5.description: Chai lives in Spain with his family where he meets and falls in love with Meera. Chai's fate takes a turn when he travels to India and meets Chandramukhi, who falls for him.

Zee5.name: Sengalam
Zee5.description: To take revenge, Rayar and his two brothers are on a ruthless killing spree. At the same time, a family ruling Virudhunagar corporation for 40 years is facing turmoil and their throne is being challenged.

Zee5.name: Saithan
Zee5.description: Dinesh, a software engineer, is brought to a psychiatrist by his boss after he seems mentally disturbed. His life turns worse when the voice in his head tells him to kill himself.

Zee5.name: Shivlok Ke Kundakka-Mandakka
Zee5.description: Shivlok Ke Kundakka-Mandakka is an animated fantasy-adventure series following the mischievous Asura twins Kundakka and Mandakka as they attend a magical Gurukul filled with ancient secrets, strange creatures and powerful teachers.

Zee5.name: Dono
Zee5.description: Dev travels to Thailand to attend his best friend and childhood crush's wedding. He meets Meghna and seems to have an instant connection with her. What does fate have in store for them?

Zee5.name: Maa Hai Na
Zee5.description: Six Gen Z celebrities team up with their mothers in cooking challenges that spark honest conversations between generations, exploring modern family dynamics through culinary tasks and heartfelt moments in the kitchen.

Zee5.name: Biskoth
Zee5.description: The story revolves around 3 generations where the three individuals played by Santhanam and they have no relation to each other. The mysteries and correction of mistakes in the past forms the story.

Zee5.name: Aranmanai 3
Zee5.description: The ghost of a wronged mother tries to take revenge on a Zamindar and his daughter, but one man stands in its way!

Zee5.name: Operation Parindey
Zee5.description: The film is a fictional story based on true events which depicts a groundbreaking jail break.

Zee5.name: Sex Drugs & Theatre
Zee5.description: Six medical students whose lives revolves around drugs and sex, unwillingly come together to stage a play and participate in a prestigious competition.

Zee5.name: Pandu
Zee5.description: Pandu and Mhadu are small time stand up comedians in small village of Maharashtra who catch the eye of powerful politician Babasaheb Pathare who has always been the target of rival parties.Babasaheb gets inspired by Pandu and Mhadu's performance as they are in need of job he offers them job in Mumbai police force after their parts as cops in the skit.The police force isn't happy with them joining the force directly but asks them to take proper training.They both clear their training and join the police force as Pandu Hawaldar and Mhadu Hawaldar where Mhadu becomes a corrupt cop taking bribes from people.But Pandu is an honest cop and gets famous after he arrests back to back criminals.Pandu meets Usha Keliwali a beautiful women and both get married with blessings of their family and Babasaheb.But things don't seem to be how it looks as whatever is happening in Pandu's life has been Pre planned by someone who wants to eliminate Babasaheb by making Pandu a scapegoat as he is his trusted aide.

Zee5.name: Jerax
Zee5.description: A xerox shop owner whose life changes after he discovers he has unusual powers.

Zee5.name: Kamali from Nadukkaveri
Zee5.description: Kamali From Nadukkaveri embraces the Power and the Importance of Education for Women. Born as a Girl Child in a village called Nadukkaveri, How Kamali becomes the identity of the same village is what this film is all about.

Zee5.name: Ladies & Gentlemen
Zee5.description: Follow the emotional journey of Sabila, an ordinary girl, who becomes the voice of every working woman in Bangladesh and beyond. The show highlights the complexity of male-female dynamics and hierarchical exploitations and misogyny.

Zee5.name: Mugilan
Zee5.description: The series depicts socio-political events that led to the rise of one of the most dreaded gangsters of Kanchipuram in the 1970s called Mugilan.

Zee5.name: The Great Indian Kitchen
Zee5.description: Post her marriage, a woman tries to fit into the conventional mould that society has prescribed for married women. But somewhere along the way, she starts feeling that this is not the life she wants.

Zee5.name: Hostel Hudugaru Bekagiddare
Zee5.description: When a boys' hostel warden commits suicide, he leaves behind a note blaming some students residing on the premises for his death. The suspects must now come up with a plan to hide the body.

Zee5.name: Break Point
Zee5.description: The series traces the incredible journey of Indian tennis legends Leander Paes and Mahesh Bhupathi. From their meteoric rise to their shocking split, watch their story of hard work, conflict, and hope.

Zee5.name: Itlu Maredumilli Prajaneekam
Zee5.description: A school teacher who is posted as an Election Officer in a rural mountainous village, makes sure that 100% voting happens there. However, he is forced to whisk away the voting machine to solve the societal issues prevailing in the village.

Zee5.name: A Match
Zee5.description: It explores the tradition of arranged marriage in rural India, where a girl's marriage overshadows the very sustenance of life. Narrated from the perspective of a young girl, Savita, it highlights the patriarchy rooted in society.

Zee5.name: Dark 7 White
Zee5.description: Yudi, a young politician, is murdered in broad daylight, which opens a can of worms. His closest friends become prime suspects, and as the mystery unfolds, many dark secrets unravel.

Zee5.name: The Casino
Zee5.description: A "reluctant Heir" to a billion dollar Casino is emotionally trapped by his father's 'Keep', who is extremely manipulative and deceptive. He must overcome and claim his throne before she destroys him completely and takes the casino away.

Zee5.name: Shodha
Zee5.description: After his wife vanishes following a deadly accident, Rohith reports her missing. When police find her, he insists the woman isn't really his wife.

Zee5.name: Dance India Dance
Zee5.description: A reality dance competition.

Zee5.name: Ghar Banduk Biryani
Zee5.description: A witty and thrilling events of one who is longing for a home, struggling for his right has a hunger for ambition.

Zee5.name: Kamala Nibas
Zee5.description: A Bengali joint family faces trials of love and sacrifice as Kamala and her principled husband Shrinibas strive to own a home and secure their daughters' futures, testing bonds and values across generations.

Zee5.name: Buddha in a Traffic Jam
Zee5.description: Vikram, a carefree management student, finds himself entangled in web of conspiracy, lies and deceit when he launches a successful social media campaign to highlight the plight of the poor in India.

Zee5.name: Vetrivel
Zee5.description: A brother attempts to get his younger brother married to the girl he loves by kidnapping her, but the plan goes so wrong and results in messy situations.

Zee5.name: Ghoomketu
Zee5.description: An aspiring writer from a small town in U.P. runs away to Mumbai. He gives himself 30 days to try and prove his worth.

Zee5.name: Heartiley Battery
Zee5.description: Sofia, a brilliant but emotionally guarded scientist, believes love is nothing more than biology. After witnessing her parents' relationship fall apart, she invents a device called the Love Meter to prove that true love can be measured.

Zee5.name: Bai Ji Kuttange
Zee5.description: Bai Ji, a highly feared businessman, gets tricked by Boota Singh, a street smart, into unknowingly hiring him and his entire family. What follows suit is a comedy of errors as Boota Singh and family try to hide their true identities from.

Zee5.name: Kaali
Zee5.description: A desperate mother enters the dangerous world of crime after her child's life hangs in the balance. With time running out, she must navigate the treacherous underworld while staying one step ahead of ruthless criminals.

Zee5.name: Farmhouse
Zee5.description: In this ZEE5 original film, a father and son duo enter a farmhouse with ulterior motives. However, they soon learn of a bigger plot brewing within the farmhouse orchestrated by their rich masters.

Zee5.name: Madha Yaanai Koottam
Zee5.description: Prithivi kill his uncle's son unfortunately. So his uncle and other family members take revenge on him.

Zee5.name: Khari Biscuit
Zee5.description: Khari Biscuit is a tender and moving tale of two siblings. A five year old blind girl Khari wishes to do something unachievable, its something that is beyond her brother, Biscuit's reach. A determined Biscuit goes on a series of adventures which leads him on to an unexpected journey to try and fulfill Khari's desire. What follows then is a story filled with compassion, determination and deep sibling love.

Zee5.name: Bibhishon
Zee5.description: Daily life at Bolagarh police station in Birbhum district is slow paced, uneventful. Until one day, a missing person and a theft case are reported. Mysteries unfold and murders come to the surface.

Zee5.name: Lakhat Ek Amcha Dada
Zee5.description: Devoted brother Surya's sole mission is securing respectable and affluent marriages for his four sisters, putting their happiness before his own.

Zee5.name: Rama Rama Re
Zee5.description: A renowned criminal plans his prison break and tries to run away from his death row as far as he could.

Zee5.name: Luv Ki Arrange Marriage
Zee5.description: Luv is in love with Ishika and wants to ask for her hand in marriage. A laughter riot follows when his widowed father falls in love with Ishika's mother. Which couple has a more successful love story?

Zee5.name: Comedy Couple
Zee5.description: A story about two comedian couples and the up and downs between their parternship.

Zee5.name: Operation Fryday
Zee5.description: A Muslim unwittingly gets involved in a terrorist bombing in Mumbai and decides to avenge the act.

Zee5.name: Paruvu
Zee5.description: A young couple from warring castes defies societal norms by eloping and marrying. Disowned, they're forced back to their town due to a death, only to face a sinister plan to eliminate them.

Zee5.name: Ek Hi Bhool
Zee5.description: Sadhana suspects her husband Ramkumar of having an affair. Her poor handling of the situation pushes him away. Despite her family's efforts to reconcile them, she refuses. What will reunite the couple and save their marriage?

Zee5.name: Darbaan
Zee5.description: Based on the 1891 short story by Rabindranath Tagore, follows life of a caretaker whose life is disturbed due to a single act of carelessness.

Zee5.name: Kavalthurai Ungal Nanban
Zee5.description: A terrible tournout of events when a common public employee enters unexpectedly into a police station

Zee5.name: Ek Mahanayak - Dr B R Ambedkar
Zee5.description: Ek Mahanayak is the story of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar, the founding father of the Constitution of India. For the first time, the story of Babasaheb will be shown on television through serial. The show will include inspiring parts of Babasaheb's life. The story of this show will begin from the childhood of Babasaheb. In which Bhimrao Ambedkar's role will be seen playing child artist Aayudh Bhanushali. Later Prasad Jawade will be seen in the role of young Baba Saheb.

Zee5.name: G.O.D - Gods of Dharmapuri
Zee5.description: Set in the year 1970s, a mining mafia bubble takes Pratap Reddy and his family from rags to riches, as he seeks control over Dharmapuri through sheer violence and ruthless acts.

Zee5.name: Short and Sweet
Zee5.description: Sanju is a 21-year-old boy raised by a single parent Tanvi. Tanvi is Sanju's weakness and he is proud of his & her looks & arrogant towards the less able people. Sanju's life turns upside down when he learns that all these years his mother was lying about his father's death. Sanju's battle becomes worst when he meets his father. Sanju, whilst battling this, learns the value of friendship and love. His attempt to face the situation helps him rediscover himself and reassert his value as a son.

Zee5.name: Ikroop
