Zee5.description: Wrongfully jailed, assault victim Ikroop bonds with unrepentant inmate Urmi. In a world harsher outside than within, a jasmine flower fuels their hope in this emotional tale of sisterhood and revenge.

Zee5.name: Aafat-e-Ishq
Zee5.description: This ZEE5 Original film revolves around Lallo, a 30-year-old recluse girl who yearns for love. She works as a caretaker, and her life changes when she inherits her employer's property.

Zee5.name: Maa Nanna Superhero
Zee5.description: Johnny embarks on a mission to help his adoptive father, inadvertently reuniting with his biological father Prakash, who was forced to abandon him years ago but now seeks reconciliation.

Zee5.name: Ghosty
Zee5.description: After following in her deceased father's footsteps and becoming a police officer, a young woman experiences strange phenomena while attempting to capture a criminal that escaped from her father's custody many years before.

Zee5.name: Ondu Sarala Prema Kathe
Zee5.description: Athishay dreams of becoming a music director. Anu is kind-hearted. Athishay wants a woman matching his musical heartbeat. Anu seeks a genuine, selfless man. In a twist, they marry but continue seeking true love.

Zee5.name: Veduvan
Zee5.description: Sooraj, a struggling Tamil actor, is approached by a director to star in a biopic about Encounter Specialist Arun. As he dives deeper, he discovers there is much more to Arun's story.

Zee5.name: Zero KMS
Zee5.description: After serving a sentence of ten years in prison for a murder he did not commit, Arjun is finally free. Little does he know that he's caught in the middle of a flesh-trafficking racket that threatens to upend his entire existence. A 12-Episode action thriller series to be released soon on Zee's online platform, ZEE5.

Zee5.name: Hawahawai
Zee5.description: Jyoti's world shatters when her husband has an accident. With guidance from her idol, she pursues her lifelong dream of entrepreneurship. Can she overcome the odds and build a new future for herself?

Zee5.name: Gaalivaana
Zee5.description: After childhood sweethearts Ajay and Geetha are murdered on their return from their honeymoon, the families suspect a badly-injured stranger Srinu, who turned up at their doorstep. But Srinu is found dead next morning. Who killed him?

Zee5.name: Boomerang
Zee5.description: A guy who gets a face transplant done, following a fire accident, realises many are after his life. He sets out to find the reason for the same.

Zee5.name: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala
Zee5.description: Tujhyat Jeev Rangala is the love story of Rana and Anjali. Rana is farmer and wrestler and while Anjali is a highly educated school teacher who has recently moved to the village. Their difference in mindset, upbringing and lifestyle makes their love story sweet and complicated at the same time.

Zee5.name: Kaun Banegi Shikharwati
Zee5.description: A former king, who has a dysfunctional family, devises an outlandish plan to unite his estranged daughters. Meanwhile, an income tax investigation looms over the palace's hidden treasure.

Zee5.name: His Story
Zee5.description: A rollercoaster tale of a power couple, Kunal-Sakshi who lead a perfect married life since 15 years and are the epitome of perfection that makes their friends red with envy.

Zee5.name: Tashan-E-Ishq
Zee5.description: The story revolves around the lives of Twinkle and Yuvraj, and their triangular relationship of love, hatred, betrayal and obsession.

Zee5.name: Gurram Paapi Reddy
Zee5.description: A mysterious fraudster hires three people to exchange a corpse from a grave. The team discovers the task isn't what they were told, leading to conflicts.

Zee5.name: Country Mafia
Zee5.description: Two siblings have a dream of becoming IAS officers. But life has other plans. Watch their tale of revenge as they confront Babban, the biggest liquor baron of Bihar, for murdering their father.

Zee5.name: Shukranu
Zee5.description: Set in Delhi/UP/Haryana, SHUKRANU is a comic take on the darkest phases of Indian democracy through the encounters of a would-be groom who is forcefully sterilized just days before his much-awaited marriage.

Zee5.name: Majha Hoshil Na
Zee5.description: Majha Hoshil Na is a Marathi television family series which stars Gautami Deshpande, who plays Sai and Virajas Kulkarni, who plays Aditya. Hailing from a rich family, Sai falls in love with the intelligent and righteous Aditya. After their wedding, Sai has to deal with her family members which further leads to hilarious situations. A unique take on how equations change after marriage and how loving relationships are formed will surely entertain and win the audiences' hearts over.

Zee5.name: Pakalum Paathiravum
Zee5.description: Michael, a wildlife photographer starts his journey from Kochi to Mysore with a hideous intent.

Zee5.name: Tiki Taka
Zee5.description: Revolves around Khelechi, an African national, who comes to India with a football laden with narcotics to deliver it to P.K, who runs a drug cartel. However, in a comedy of errors P.K's men pick up the wrong guy, and Khelechi ends up with Raju, a con man.

Zee5.name: Babe Bhangra Paunde Ne
Zee5.description: From selling underwear to adopting a father for insurance benefits, Diljit will stop at nothing for him and his friends to become the three richest men in the world.

Zee5.name: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa
Zee5.description: Indian music reality show.

Zee5.name: Murugesan +2
Zee5.description: Murugesan +2 is a darkly comic tale about Murugesan, a truck driver leading a secret double life with two families.

Zee5.name: Aamar Boss
Zee5.description: A heartwarming story about a man juggling work and family, until his mother's unexpected presence at the office quietly transforms the workplace. Inspired by real-life corporate daycare programs.

Zee5.name: Unlock- The Haunted App
Zee5.description: Obsessed with a man, a woman installs an app that will grant you wishes, but each wish comes at a deadly price.

Zee5.name: Ekam
Zee5.description: It explores different stories set in a place and see how each of their paths leads to 'Ekam'; defined not as one, but where everything comes together as one.

Zee5.name: Bahishkarana
Zee5.description: Two people who are in love. But gradually, their relationship starts to have issues. The couple's attempts to live together are met with ridicule and disgrace from society.

Zee5.name: Coffee with Kadhal
Zee5.description: A family consisting of three brothers and a sister. The eldest son is very responsible and lives by the likes of his father. The other two sons are out of bindings. The rest of the movie is about the twists and turns in their family.

Zee5.name: Atkan Chatkan
Zee5.description: It is the story of a gifted kid Guddu, who along with his street kid friends, forms a band to win a prestigious musical competition without using conventional instruments and unites his separated musician parents.

Zee5.name: Boyei Gelo
Zee5.description: Set in the modern day Kolkata, tells the story of two neighboring middle class families of a quintessential Bengali 'para' who are engaged in a constant mindless bickering as a part of a traditional rivalry.

Zee5.name: Bang Baang
Zee5.description: Raghu faces the biggest test of his life when he is a prime suspect in a high-profile murder case. Meera, his ex girlfriend is closing onto him at the same time. Will the truth prevail or will the case get more murkier?

Zee5.name: Jinne Jamme Saare Nikamme
Zee5.description: Niranjan Singh and Satwant Kaur live in a village on the outskirts of Mohali, Punjab. They are parents to four sons who don't have any time for them. So they decide to have another child. How will their shocked kids respond?

Zee5.name: Chhotolok
Zee5.description: While trying to get out of a failing marriage, Raja gets into a steamy affair with Rupsha, a woman with a criminal past. However, he becomes the prime suspect when Rupsha is found dead. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Taish
Zee5.description: A story of friendship and loss of innocence when two worlds clash amid a wedding when a secret exposes a betrayal, and innocent friends converge with dangerous criminals and intense violence.

Zee5.name: House of Lies
Zee5.description: After Albert's murder on his birthday, Officer Rajeev investigates numerous suspects, uncovering lies and seeking the mastermind behind the seemingly perfect Pinto House.

Zee5.name: Vadacurry
Zee5.description: Sathish, who is ashamed of his cheap phone, gives in to temptation when he finds one lying unattended in a shop and steals it. Unfortunately for him, the phone belongs to someone dangerous.

Zee5.name: Queen Elizabeth
Zee5.description: Elizabeth, an empowered lady who is committed to her professional goals. However, her steady emphasis on her job has ended up resulting in an attitude of arrogance, making her hated by people around her.

Zee5.name: Lockup
Zee5.description: Lock Up follows the lives of sub-inspector Moorthy and constable Vasanth . There is also Ilavarasi , a hard-nosed police inspector who is put in charge of the station the two men work at after the previous inspector, Sampath, is murdered.

Zee5.name: Mukti
Zee5.description: Will Ramkinkar break his own shackle and unite the political prisoners of different ideologies housed in Midnapore jail? Will they come together through a game of football against the onslaughts of tyrant jailor Petty?

Zee5.name: Atithi Bhooto Bhava
Zee5.description: Srikant's life turns upside down when he bumps into a middle-aged ghost who claims to be his grandson from his previous birth. Things take an even more comical turn when the ghost seeks Srikant's help to meet his long-lost love.

Zee5.name: Nisha
Zee5.description: The story revolves around Adhi, who kidnaps Nisha, Riya, and Kirthi, and holds them hostage in a hideout. While trying to escape their kidnapper, one of the girls succumbs to death. Will the other two manage to get out alive?

Zee5.name: Boudi Canteen
Zee5.description: An account of a young woman who aspires to convert her love of cooking into a business, the challenges grow in number as she makes the leap.

Zee5.name: Topless
Zee5.description: A bunch of con artists , a British archaeologist and a local politician find their lives intertwined by an antique painting that is believed to be cursed.

Zee5.name: /12 Binay Badal Dinesh
Zee5.description: The plot is based on the life and contribution of Binoy, Badal and Dinesh, revolutionary trio. On 8 December 1930 they entered into the Writers' Building and killed British officers.

Zee5.name: Once Upon Two Times
Zee5.description: On a family trip gone wrong, betrothed sweethearts Ahaan and Ruhi find out that their parents were once embittered lovers and attempt to mend their past, only to confront the problems of their own present.

Zee5.name: Kya Meri Sonam Gupta Bewafa Hai
Zee5.description: In this ZEE5 Original film, Sintoo, a dejected lover, pens down his feelings on a currency note which goes viral and triggers a chain of hilarious events. Will he overcome the heartbreak and find closure?

Zee5.name: Pariah Volume 1: Every Street Dog Has a Name
Zee5.description: Outcast native Indian dogs suffer continuous torture, their lives rendered worthless by the country's legal system.

Zee5.name: Nanhe Jaisalmer: A Dream Come True
Zee5.description: 10-year-old Nanhe from Jaisalmer guides tourists and organizes camel safaris. He dreams of meeting actor Bobby Deol. They meet on a film set and become friends. Nanhe writes to Bobby as he grows up. Bobby's visit changes his life forever.

Zee5.name: Mercury
Zee5.description: When five friends gather for a high school reunion, they find themselves around a man deformed by mercury poisoning.

Zee5.name: Gaalipata 2
Zee5.description: Three college friends meet teacher Kishore Kumar who offers them a place to stay. Years later, they reunite to assist their teacher during an illness and in turn find a chance to fix their love lives.

Zee5.name: Kaari
Zee5.description: Sethu, a champion jockey, SRK, a multimillionaire and Meena, a simple village girl cross paths in a village race, where a horse jockey is training a ferocious Jallikattu bull. Will fate take care of Meena's future and Sethu's life.

Zee5.name: Hutatma
Zee5.description: the series narrates the story of how the state of Maharashtra came into existence with Bombay as its capital. It is the story of the Samyukta Maharashtra Movement and the struggles of the Marathi manus.

Zee5.name: The Twisted Doll
Zee5.description: A young Indian woman embarks on a revenge mission in Los Angeles after her husband is scammed by two psychopathic real estate agents.

Zee5.name: Ananta (The Eternal)
Zee5.description: At a specific time of day every afternoon, the two cross each other fleetingly on a staircase but they do not exchange any words. A connection between two is suggested but the meetings do not translate into fully expressed relationship.

Zee5.name: Ardh
Zee5.description: Shiva struggles to become a mainstream actor in Mumbai despite being a theatre actor. With the help of his wife Madhu, he disguises himself as a transgender and begs for money to survive.

Zee5.name: De Dhakka 2
Zee5.description: Mr. Makarand Jadhav, and his funnily weird family land in London but they get embroiled in the financial scam and find themselves in the hands of the Pakistani mafia. To escape this ordeal they embark on a road trip adventure once again.

Zee5.name: Maayka: Saath Zindagi Bhar Ka
Zee5.description: The story concerns the Malhotra family's three daughters - Raji, Soni and Mahi and their younger brother Prince live in Jalandhar City of Punjab.

Zee5.name: Mrs. & Mr. Shameem
Zee5.description: Shameem marries his closest friend Umaina when she is betrayed by her ideal man. Fate deals a further blow to Shameem when he contracts an illness. Will the adversity bring the couple closer?

Zee5.name: Loser
Zee5.description: A sports drama revolving around 3 sports players separated by a decade and yet connected in unpredictable ways.

Zee5.name: Days: The Mystery Unfolds
Zee5.description: Satya, a Suspended Cop, who lost his wife in mysterious circumstances, unexpectedly gets hold of a case which relates to his wife's death. He's starts investigating which eventually hunts down his past and brings chaos in his life. How Satya solved the mystery surrounding him forms the rest of the story.

Zee5.name: Mentalhood
Zee5.description: The rules of parenting have changed. Every mother has her own strategy and some have their own game, with only one aim - to be the best of the best. Step into this #Mentalhood.

Zee5.name: Lockdown
Zee5.description: The lives of 6 individuals from different walks of life who are going through their personal challenges collide at the same hospital. On the same night, the Prime Minister declares a lockdown.

Zee5.name: Kirumi
Zee5.description: Kathir is a selfish youth in search of a job. Despite being married and having a child, he is waiting for a job offer that he feels meets his standards. Meanwhile, his wife Anitha is the breadwinner of the family. Prabhakar, a friendly neighbour who acts as his father figure, gets him a job as an informant with the less than honest local police inspector. Kathir uses this opportunity to take revenge against the violent bar owner who humiliated him in front of his friends, despite Prabhakar's advice. With his tip-off, the police raids the bar and arrests the owner for running an illegal gambling den as a side business. One night, Prabhakar is murdered by a group of thugs while a scared Kathir runs for his life. Suspecting that Prabhakar was murdered because he too was an informant, Kathir starts becoming paranoid. Eventually, he comes to realize that the inspector he is working for is now in cohorts with the bar owner after being promised a large sum of money as commission in return for permission to run their illegal businesses. Since Kathir is the only witness for most of the inspector's corrupt activities, the inspector has the bar owner send his thugs to kill Kathir too. However, the inspector eventually feels sorry for Kathir and allows him to live as long as he stays silent about all the underground operations being carried out by the local police station. In the end, Kathir takes up a low-paying but proper job at his wife's garment factory and earns an honest living.

Zee5.name: Dhrusti
Zee5.description: An injured home bound photographer watches a murder being committed, through his window and becomes the prime suspect in the case. How he unfolds the mystery forms the plot of the film.

Zee5.name: Be Dune Teen
Zee5.description: Abhay and Neha, an ordinary married couple, find their lives overturned when a routine checkup reveals they are expecting triplets.

Zee5.name: Main Viyah Nahi Karona Tere Naal
Zee5.description: A Canadian YouTuber visits Punjab for the first time and falls in love with a desi rooted girl from Punjab who eventually helps him discover his roots.

Zee5.name: S.I.T
Zee5.description: ACP Partha Saradhi leads a team investigating a murder case involving Navya, an NGO for rape victims, revealing connections between her work and her murder.

Zee5.name: NERD - Neither Either Really Dead
Zee5.description: Nerd is a ZEE5 Original web series which revolves around a lonely, dull, and orphaned techie who longs for companionship. What happens when six beautiful girls enter his life?

Zee5.name: Engineering Girls
Zee5.description: Three engineering students deal with dorm drama, date around, and do whatever it takes to make their dreams come true.

Zee5.name: Nayanam
Zee5.description: A conflicted ophthalmologist's illegal experiments let him see into private lives. His scientific curiosity becomes an obsession, leading to death and dark secrets.

Zee5.name: Shabash Feluda
Zee5.description: Feluda and Topshe are to solve a case in Gangtok assigned by Mr. Sasadhar Bose. They are to look into the accidental death of his business partner Selvankar. What role does the Yamantaka idol play?

Zee5.name: Jaanbaaz Hindustan Ke
Zee5.description: A single mother and celebrated IPS officer, Kavya Iyer's bravery and psychological strength are tested when she becomes the lead investigator in an ISIS-K bomb attack case.

Zee5.name: Kerala Underground
Zee5.description: Kerala Underground is a first-of-its-kind Malayalam hip-hop reality series that explores the voices, stories, and culture shaping Kerala's rapidly growing rap movement.

Zee5.name: Kalathil Sandhippom
Zee5.description: The story of two friends, Anand and Ashok, story revolving around them on their love, sports, family bondings.

Zee5.name: My Name Is Azhakan
Zee5.description: Azhakan thinks his father named him purposely so that the people will mock him till his death. One day due to pressure from his parents he went to see a girl who likes him because he was an artist.

Zee5.name: Fireflies: Parth Aur Jugnu
Zee5.description: A 14-year-old boy named Parth, who meets Jugnu, a mystical kid from the haunted forest of Bheem Mukteshwar.

Zee5.name: La Vaste
Zee5.description: A man who has done B.Tech, gets the job of lifting unclaimed dead bodies in the name of job.A unique tale depicting the untold tragedy of unclaimed dead bodies in our society.

Zee5.name: Blind Game
Zee5.description: A Cop, under suspension, is on the trail of Missing Cash.

Zee5.name: Bhavai
Zee5.description: The Film depicts us with path path for LOVE and LIFE as a SITA Character. But our mind lost power to choose between RAVANA and RAMA due to EVIL thoughts.

Zee5.name: Sigai
Zee5.description: A pimp in Chennai searches for one of his sex workers who has gone missing.

Zee5.name: Chuk Bhul Dyavi Ghyavi
Zee5.description: Chuk bhul dyavi ghyavi is a marathi comedy drama television series starring dilip prabhavalkar, sukanya kulkarni-mone and priyadarshan jadhav. The story revolves around the life of raja bhau, an 83-year-old man and his wife, malti and their imemense care and love for each other. The story centers on their funny encounters in day to day life.

Zee5.name: Kaantaye Kaantaye
Zee5.description: Advocate PK Basu races against time to unmask a killer lurking among guests at Darjeeling's Hotel Repose, ready to strike again, as his family's lives hang in the balance.

Zee5.name: Pyaar Ka Pehla Adhyaya Shiv Shakti
Zee5.description: Revolves around Shiv, a successful doctor with a crumbling personal life. Shakti, an orphan, has a nurturing nature. Will Shakti heal Shiv's broken self?

Zee5.name: Head Bush
Zee5.description: Political-crime drama on Bangalore Underworld based on Agni Sridhar's Autobiography "My Days in the Underworld".

Zee5.name: Blood Money
Zee5.description: 2 brothers from India working in Kuwait are sentenced to death penalty for killing an srilankan women. Day before there hanging the news breakout in an Indian news channel by a lady reporter. Then the plot evolves around the reporter, accused family and the family of the srilankan women got killed in Kuwait. The reporter tries to save the brothers by stopping the punishment. Did she succeed in her fight?

Zee5.name: Chimanee Pakhre
Zee5.description: Nandini is on last stage of cancer during this time tragedy strikes as her husband is killed by a village rival,Nandini now is forced to put all her four children for adoption to give them a better life.

Zee5.name: Specter: Black Out
Zee5.description: Desperate to win big, an ensemble of individuals from diverse walks of life are mysteriously invited to visit an escape room for an unconventional casting call audition.

Zee5.name: The Kashmir Files Unreported
Zee5.description: The real-life anecdotes, survivor testimonies, archived footage and geopolitical details about the events that led to the exodus and massacre of Kashmiri Pandits in the 1990s. Thus the circumstances that led to the abolition of Article 370.

Zee5.name: Mai Hero Boll Raha Hu
Zee5.description: Nawab rises as an underworld don from a small town boy to Bombay's most powerful don. He falls in love with actress Laila who isn't aware of who he is. His erstwhile mentor Lala turns against him. Will Nawab and Laila survive?

Zee5.name: Love Sleep Repeat
Zee5.description: Vishwas is a small-town boy from Panchgani(Maharashtra).He got to arrive Pune to join his new job at Technicult. Being new to the big city culture and its people, he is to go through an uncanny, fateful 7-days to find his love and himself.

Zee5.name: Shivaji Surathkal 2
Zee5.description: Five years have passed since Shivaji Surathkal cracked the infamous Ranagiri case. Haunted by the death of his wife, Shivaji investigates a new murder case and discovers a connection between the victim, the murderer and himself.

Zee5.name: Bommai Nayagi
Zee5.description: A touching emotional connection between a father and daughter and how politics and society impact their way of life.

Zee5.name: Hatyapuri
Zee5.description: Pradosh Chandra Mitter(Feluda) visits Puri for a vacation but gets involved in investigating a murder that took place in the coastal town during his stay.

Zee5.name: Mapla Singam
Zee5.description: Mapla Singam is a rural comedy about two families in a village that are in constant conflict with each other.

Zee5.name: Sharate Aaj
Zee5.description: This thriller drama revolves around a group of NRI Bengalis, both from India and Bangladesh, who come together to organise and celebrate Durga Puja. However, a terrorist group plans to disrupt the event.

Zee5.name: Jai Malhar
Zee5.description: This series is based on Lord Martanda Bhairava aka Khandoba, a reincarnation of Lord Shiva. The show is about Khandoba's courage, magnanimity and prowess. He is also fondly known as Malhar and worshiped across Maharashtra and beyond as the family deity of many. His devotees express their devotion by chanting aloud "Yelkot Yelkot Jai Malhar". The foremost center of Khandoba worship is Jejuri in Maharashtra and is thronged by huge devotees every year who visit to worship the Lord. Khandoba has been portrayed as a God of love, a Superpower and the symbol of excellence. He is portrayed as a super hero for the young generation.

Zee5.name: Minmini
Zee5.description: Follows two youngsters who carry survivors' guilt.

Zee5.name: Silvat
Zee5.description: A young, middle-class housewife, living in the crowded lanes of Bombay in 1997, struggles with her loneliness, and cannot stop herself from falling in love with her neighbourhood tailor even though her society and religion expressly forbid this.

Zee5.name: Karkat Rogue
Zee5.description: A first of its kind Bi-Lingual (Bengali and Hindi) web series in India, with an entire backdrop of the heinous world of Anti Cancer drug trial.

Zee5.name: Amrutham Dhvitheeyam
Zee5.description: Amrutham and Anjaneyulu return to their Hotel business and fail hilariously again while trying to be creative with their business ideas.

Zee5.name: Danny
Zee5.description: After the police inspector Kunthavai picks up a complex murder case for investigation, she takes the help of Danny, a smart police dog, to unearth a gang of dangerous criminals involved in serial killing.

Zee5.name: Khulata Kali Khulena
Zee5.description: Khulata Kali Khulena: Mansi's family asks her if she is willing to marry Vikrant. Mansi makes it clear to them that she needs to talk to Isha before making her final decision. Vikrant tells Mansi that Isha may disapprove of their marriage. Finally, Mansi decides to not marry Vikrant.

Zee5.name: Seven
Zee5.description: Five friends in their late 30s go on a holiday to a hill station. As they take the road, they soon come across an accident, two dead bodies, a bag full of cash and guns. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Chalti Rahe Zindagi
Zee5.description: Krishna explores Arjun's wife's infidelity with Aru's husband, Sushma's financial strain on Krishna, and generational clashes between Leela, Naina, and Siya during lockdown. Characters face adversities, testing their perseverance.

Zee5.name: Mee Raqsam
Zee5.description: It revolves around a young girl's aspiration to become a dancer, but coming from a small village like Mijwan, everyone questions her dreams and choices. It's only her father who trusts, supports and helps her in this journey of achieving her dream.

Zee5.name: Amanat
Zee5.description: The story is about a staunchly traditional Indian man, Lahori Ram, who holds a strong set of values and beliefs. His life revolves around his seven daughters: Santosh, Dinky, Bala, Guddi, Bunty, Munni, and Totey, each with her own peculiarities and problems. Lahori Ram, who is originally from Pakistan, moves to India after the partition between the countries. The world has progressed - or grown corrupt, depending on how you look at it - but his values and traditions have not changed with the advent of modern times. Having lost his wife early in life, he has been both father and mother to his girls. He has lavished all his love and affection on them and kept them in the constraints of a stern middle-class morality. The bond between the sisters is extremely close. Not having a mother in their formative years has forged among them a strong comradeship. Their shared moments of happiness and grief, their love and admiration for their father, and the desire never to hurt him are their common ground. It is only when they get married and go into different families, with varied backgrounds and cultural environments, some rich, some poor, that real conflicts start. For each, it is a struggle between fealty to the family of the husband and the love they have for their sisters. Lahori Ram is supportive like a rock and compassionate as a parent can be without hurting one for the sake of the other. But it is a tricky tightrope which he treads with skill. Like the tributaries of a mighty river, the life of each girl breaks free from the confines of family and flows to a distant place, while still being a part of the older stream. Lahori Ram, too, follows the happiness and heartaches of his daughters with fond indulgence and parental concern. They are his "amanat" (legacy), reared with love and bestowed one by one like a legacy on someone else. Each parent goes through these profound experiences, sooner or later, when daughters come of age, and depart as brides, leaving behind only sweet memories.

Zee5.name: Yaman
Zee5.description: After losing his father to a bunch of scheming politicians, a young man decides to wade into the corrupt and unscrupulous world of politics to avenge his death.

Zee5.name: Police Diary 2.0
Zee5.description: This action-packed series will witness 2 special task force teams who are on a job to identify and probe in to the heinous crimes that have crippled the state of Tamil Nadu.

Zee5.name: Agniphera
Zee5.description: The story of two brides and one groom.

Zee5.name: Vedikkettu
Zee5.description: Revolves around the lives of people belonging to two islands Manjapra and Karingotta. They frequently fight against each other but unite only for the yearly festival. What will happen when a love story blooms between the islands?

Zee5.name: Mitran Da Naa Chalda
Zee5.description: An underdog guy who is always bullied during his childhood days because of his stammering. He dropped out of school in his early years, but he learned a lot about legal and court cases while growing up with his maternal uncle, who works at a court. This guy helps a few girls coming out of a big case using his skills and brains. During this journey, he had to face a lot of challenges and pressure, but he still finds his way out and truth wins.

Zee5.name: Veekam
Zee5.description: Three forensic surgeons get involved in a murder case due to a small negligence at their end. What unfolds next is their attempt to prove their innocence.

Zee5.name: Mothevari Love Story
Zee5.description: Parshi and Anitha, two spirited youngsters from rural Telangana, are madly in love and decide to elope. Meanwhile, a shocking twist emerges.

Zee5.name: Five Six Seven Eight
Zee5.description: Semba and Vikram, two teenagers belonging to different strata of society, come together to help a friend in need. They courageously try to overcome many obstacles in their path with just one thing filling their hearts and souls - dance.

Zee5.name: India Pakistan
Zee5.description: Two lawyers battle it out in a case and in life.

Zee5.name: Shootout at Alair
Zee5.description: Akhtar kills a policeman every year on the day of the Mecca Masjid blasts. Soon, Akhtar is encountered. However, after several years, when a policeman gets killed on the same day, IG Praveen Chand suspects Akhtar's involvement. Is Akhtar still alive.

Zee5.name: Mathil
Zee5.description: A social drama where a common man stands for his rights against a corrupt politician. It is directed by Mithran Jawahar.

Zee5.name: Sohreyan Da Pind Aa Gaya
Zee5.description: Revolves around a newly wedded couple, their marriage, and the whole chaos around them

Zee5.name: Ko 2
Zee5.description: Ko 2 revolves around a man who kidnaps the chief minister of the state and the mystery over why he does so.

Zee5.name: Ramarjuna
Zee5.description: A smart insurance agent realises the value of life after losing his dear ones. How he transforms and seeks justice after the incident forms the rest of the story.

Zee5.name: Hum Chaar
Zee5.description: The story of the film revolves around four college friends went their own direction in life, but remained inseparable from each other.

Zee5.name: Vikkatakavi - The Movie
Zee5.description: The king of Amaragiri calls upon the detective Ramakrishna to find the cause behind the villager's sudden memory loss. His search leads Rama to a web of political schemes and historical conspiracies.

Zee5.name: Gharwali Pedwali
Zee5.description: Gharwali Pedwali is the story of Jeetu Pandey, a man cursed with a life of doubles: 2 mothers, 2 ideologies, and 2 wives. Set against the vibrant, mystical backdrop of Benaras.

Zee5.name: Ronny - The ruler
Zee5.description: A disillusioned actor turns into a feared mass rowdy, using his power to dismantle corrupt systems amid societal conflicts.

Zee5.name: Prakashan Parakkatte
Zee5.description: Das, who regularly bunks school, is unhappy with his family as they admire his brother for doing well at school. Tragedy strikes when an accident takes place, and at the same time, Das falls in love.

Zee5.name: Maa Neella Tank
Zee5.description: In Buchivolu village, Sarpanch Kodandam's son Gopal threatens to jump off a water tank for his crush Surekha. With his image and career at stake, Kodandam appoints SI Vamshi to find Surekha, who is missing.

Zee5.name: Gondya Ala Re
Zee5.description: This is a story of Chaphekar Brothers, who killed a tyrannical plague officer W.C. Rand, This is a story of those Braveheart's who chose to cross the line for the others to follow.

Zee5.name: Lockdown
Zee5.description: Bollywood artists and digital influencers collaborate intensively to produce music videos under a tight 24-hour deadline.

Zee5.name: Biye Bibhrat
Zee5.description: After a few failed relationships, star singer Shakya agrees to meet the girl of his mother's choice to court her for marriage. The courtship takes an unexpected turn when the girl's ex-lover shows up.

Zee5.name: Pattathu Yaanai
Zee5.description: Saravanan and his friends, with their new boss Gouravam, come to Trichy to set up a new restaurant. Their plans get messed up when Saravanan falls for Aishwarya, who is also pursued by a gangster.

Zee5.name: Issaq
Zee5.description: A contemporary adaptation of Romeo and Juliet set in the backdrop of Varanasi in the UP heartland, complete with naxalism, sand mining mafia and of course the timeless love story.

Zee5.name: Vyavastha
Zee5.description: Avinash Chakraborty is a ruthless lawyer who leaves no stone unturned to win a case. His authority is challenged by Vamsi Krishna, his employer's son and a newly graduated lawyer. What will he do next?

Zee5.name: Almost Sufal Sampoorna
Zee5.description: The story revolves around a NRI boy who falls in love with a Maharashtrian girl whose family is very particular about their language and culture. Can the NRI boy manage to impress the girl's family?

Zee5.name: Lahore Confidential
Zee5.description: The Story revolves around a humble, divorced Indian woman named Ananya and amidst her mundane-routine life, she finds herself on a secret intelligence duty in Pakistan. But her love for Urdu literature will have her falling in love that will eventually put them in a tug of war with each other.

Zee5.name: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
Zee5.description: A loyal dog refuses to leave his master's grave, keeping an endless vigil. Years later, a young boy forms a special connection with the faithful canine, leading to an extraordinary journey of friendship and destiny across two lifetimes.

Zee5.name: Idhu Kathirvelan Kadhal
Zee5.description: Kathir, who hates marriage, comes to Coimbatore to resolve a family dispute. There, he falls for Pavithra, a neighborhood girl. But, his dream shatters when he finds that she loves her friend.

Zee5.name: Kinnerasani
Zee5.description: Veda finds a book that holds the key to her past, present and future. Meanwhile, Venkat, a lawyer wants to avenge his lover's death. Venkat helps Veda to protect them both from an uncertain future.

Zee5.name: Bhanwar
Zee5.description: A couple moves into a new apartment and discovers that the place is already occupied by their own ghosts. They soon realise they have time travelled and can see the person who killed them

Zee5.name: Ennallo Vechina Hrudayam
Zee5.description: Tripura, a schoolteacher becomes the Saviour of a trauma-ridden businessman, Bala. Will Tripura be able to protect and nurture Bala while guiding him in rediscovering his identity?

Zee5.name: Ganoshotru
Zee5.description: A crime series that chronicles the lives and reigns of five of West Bengal's most feared public enemies - villains, whose terror once gripped different corners of the state.

Zee5.name: Meka Suri
Zee5.description: The story revolves around Meka Suri, a butcher, who gets married to his love, Rani. However, when Rani gets brutally murdered by a group of people, Meka Suri decides to avenge her death with the help of Naxalites.

Zee5.name: Chithirai Sevvaanam
Zee5.description: After Aishwarya, a teenager, goes missing after her sensual video gets leaked on social media, her father Muthupandi takes the help of the local police to find her. Will Muthupandi succeed?

Zee5.name: Ajob Premer Golpo
Zee5.description: A young boy, Dipto, falls in love with Sulagna who is much older than him. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Balloon
Zee5.description: Jeeva heads to a haunted house in Ooty where strange events start unfolding around him. The answer to which may lie in his past.

Zee5.name: Prem He
Zee5.description: The show is about defining love and relationships through impossible love stories and encourage youngsters to follow their heart and believe in true love.

Zee5.name: Thattassery Koottam
Zee5.description: Hailing from a traditional goldsmith family, Sanju falls in love with Athira. A series of unfortunate events lead to his unpredictable changes.

Zee5.name: Raakh: A Poem Masked in Blood
Zee5.description: After losing his love to the son of a gangster, a loyal gang-member must try and protect his family.

Zee5.name: Alarm
Zee5.description: This action thriller revolves around a cop who has 12 hours to save a kidnapped girl. The search leads to a massive crackdown on a prostitution ring in Chennai.

Zee5.name: Moondru Per Moondru Kaadhal
Zee5.description: Three couples and their love story.

Zee5.name: Raymo
Zee5.description: Revanth Deshpande is a rich kid but doesn't depend on his father's money. He is a rockstar who goes by the name Raymo. Soon, he meets Mohana and they fall in love. Will their love be successful?

Zee5.name: Chadarangam
Zee5.description: Various powerful politicians compete against a renowned celebrity to take control of the political affairs of their state

Zee5.name: Kandukonden Kandukonden
Zee5.description: The story revolves around a young couple who are brought together by the forces of fate and destiny. Whether the couple will overcome the challenges and continue to live happy or not forms the rest of the story.

Zee5.name: I Killed Bapu
Zee5.description: The assassination of Mahatma Gandhi made Nathuram Godse one of the most hated assassins in the history of India. The film depicts Godse's reason behind the extreme step.

Zee5.name: Kailasapuram
Zee5.description: In the small town of Kailasapuram, five college students aim for a brighter future but their lives get entangled in a series of unfortunate events when they get addicted to marijuana and get involved in drug peddling.

Zee5.name: Seruppugal Jaakirathai
Zee5.description: A pair of ordinary slippers becomes the center of chaos when a diamond smuggler uses them as a hiding spot, triggering a frantic search across town.

Zee5.name: Jigyaasa
Zee5.description: Determined to be a star, Jigyaasa offers her body to win the affections of influential producers and celebrities. But when showbiz success finally comes, is the price too great?

Zee5.name: Kuttram Kuttrame
Zee5.description: A family that hails from a village is struck by an unfortunate incident and gets into conflicts they never expected.

Zee5.name: Nirontor
Zee5.description: A story that started in the mountains among two colleagues in a regular office tour. And found its way down to the plains following a complex trail of relationships, love and empathy.

Zee5.name: High Priestess
Zee5.description: A tarot reading super natural lady swatireddy encounters the issue of several souls and sharing with her college friend who is also a soul.

Zee5.name: Bhoot Purva
Zee5.description: The series revolves around Aarav, a friendly ghost who comes back to win over his lady love Angelina, with help of his human friend Purva.

Zee5.name: Thanda
Zee5.description: The story involves people from different floors of a building handling different kinds of stories in every flat. Its the summer-time and everyone's suffering from the humid heat of Dhaka. Four bachelors living in a flat under the scorching sun decides to buy an AC, little did they know it was a disaster.

Zee5.name: Nikhonj the Search Begins
Zee5.description: Tanaya along with a local taxi driver, Sam, faces the horrors of the dark side of London after she goes there in search of her missing husband.

Zee5.name: Roktokorobi
Zee5.description: One of Satyaki's patients commits suicide while under treatment. It leaves him broken. He quits practicing as a psychologist as locals ransack his chamber. Satyaki goes to his aunt's house at Jonai where uncanny events start taking place.

Zee5.name: Akoori
Zee5.description: When Dara, a 55 year old bigot, in the midst of trying to protect his property from the hungry clutches of his cousin and hotel industry agent Zeus, finds out about his wife's comatose situation, he is forced to invite his children, who blatantly despise him and vice versa. What ensues is a drama wrapped in tragic hilarity when the dysfunctional Irani family realize that it will take a lot more than a common last name to survive under one roof.

Zee5.name: Indian Pro Music League
Zee5.description: Six teams comprising renowned playback singers and aspiring vocalists compete against each other to win the coveted title.

Zee5.name: Uyire.. Uyire..
Zee5.description: Uyire Uyire is the Tamil remake of the Nithin and Nithya Menen Telugu starrer - Ishq.

Zee5.name: Bin Kuch Kahe
Zee5.description: Three young sisters living in a dysfunctional family face several issues in their lives. However, with a sacrificing and supportive mother, they battle difficulties with aplomb.

Zee5.name: What a Kismat
Zee5.description: After facing marriage and career troubles, Chandu wins the lottery, but his fortune takes a twist when he's officially declared dead.

Zee5.name: Krishnankutty Pani Thudangi
Zee5.description: Unni, a male nurse, is known for reciting horror stories in a captivating manner. But one such recitation turns his life upside down.

Zee5.name: Beautiful Billo
Zee5.description: In this ZEE5 original film, a pregnant Billo is secretly staying at Navi's empty house in the UK. Hilarity and chaos ensue when the newly-wed Navi and Sonika shift there too.

Zee5.name: Ka Re Durava
Zee5.description: He story is about a young married couple, Jay and Aditi. Living in the city of dreams, Mumbai and harboring even bigger dreams, Jay and Aditi come from a modest middle class family

Zee5.name: Oru Pakka Kathai
Zee5.description: The marriage of Meera, a college student, and her boyfriend Saravanan has been approved by the family. But the condition is as after a job after graduation. But when Meera becomes pregnant, the whole story gets upside down

Zee5.name: Seasons Greeting
Zee5.description: A mother and daughter relationship, set in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. The 45 minute film is about Romita (Celina Jaitly Haag) who decides to introduce her live-in partner Usmaan "Azhar Khan" to her mother Suchitra "Lillette Dubey" who stays in a bungalow with her maid Chapala "Shree Ghatak". On a September noon, they visit Suchitra, a lady who lives alone after being separated from her husband. Ironically, she lives in a house 'Utsab' (meaning Festival) but she is lonely, often lost in her thoughts. Music is her only companion since her daughter travels due to work assignments and stays in a different city. Daughter's home coming is always celebrated in Bengal, just like Durga Puja. So after years Suchitra leaves no stone unturned to welcome her daughter and her fiancee Usmaan. Over a five course Bengali meal and few glasses of wine, they discover each other. While Romita thought that she was the one waiting to surprise her mother with Usmaan's presence in her life, she didn't know that her mother had bigger surprises stored for her.

Zee5.name: Malli Modalaindi
Zee5.description: Vikram, a self centred man who is set in his own ways, navigates life and love post divorce

Zee5.name: Mamakiki
Zee5.description: MaMaKiKi is a film about four friends who studied together in college. They meet at a reunion in college after 5 years of graduation. What has happened in everyone's lives in the 5 years forms the structure of the film.

Zee5.name: Kedara
Zee5.description: An old ventriloquist lives in his ancestral home, spending his time making up imaginary conversations with people from his past. His life takes a turn when a junk dealer presents him with an armchair.

Zee5.name: Cock Tail
Zee5.description: A story about a missing idol that was made by the Chola kings 450 years ago.

Zee5.name: Chhoriyan Chali Gaon
Zee5.description: Eleven urban female celebrities swap city life for rural challenges, testing their grit and adaptability as they navigate a world vastly different from their own.

Zee5.name: Roommates
Zee5.description: Follows four bachelors in Bengaluru balancing friendship and survival under a demanding landlord, whose relationships are tested when a cricket altercation turns into an ego war.

Zee5.name: Rocket Gang
Zee5.description: A roller-coaster ride of friendship, camaraderie, love and dance as the team of 5 children step into the biggest dance competition to accomplish their dream.

Zee5.name: Skyfire
Zee5.description: When a boy from the slum disappears, his search leads a historian and a journalist to strange and seemingly unrelated incidents, including warnings of natural calamities.

Zee5.name: Scammy Boys
Zee5.description: College students Pankaj and Piyush scam people to make money. Life takes a turn when they meet a corrupt cop Joshi, who connects them to an international drug cartel.

Zee5.name: Aha Na Pellanta
Zee5.description: Seenu vows never to flirt with a girl before marriage due to harrowing childhood instance. However, life seems to pull off a joke when his bride elopes with her boyfriend on their wedding day.

Zee5.name: Mini
Zee5.description: Titli is tasked with taking care of her teenage niece, Mini, when her sister is hospitalised. With time, the two of them become inseparable. What happens when Mini's mother returns?

Zee5.name: Guru Sishyaru
Zee5.description: Manohara who joins a school only for the sake of acquiring an experience certificate. But he is thrown into deeper conflicts when his connection gets stronger with students and the villagers.

Zee5.name: Seetha Raman
Zee5.description: Destiny forces Seetha to marry Ram, her sister's groom. But his stepmother refuses to accept Seetha as she does not meet her expectations. Seetha must now find a way to win over her in laws.

Zee5.name: Am I Next
Zee5.description: A sudden shock grabs the family of 14-year old Honey, when they get to know that their teenage daughter is pregnant. She was raped and now there is a long court battle to seek her right to terminate the pregnancy.

Zee5.name: Pubgoa
Zee5.description: A New Year's rave party in Goa turns deadly for a bunch of video game developers who get killed in a shootout. Only two survive. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Dobaara
Zee5.description: 22-year-old Parvathy is a free-spirited girl who loves to live life on her terms. However, when she is left with no option but to tie the knot with a man of her parents' choice, her life takes a 360 degree turn. Mohan and Parvathy migrate, and this marks the beginning of their new life together. But Mohan's priorities are clearly defined from the very start of their relationship. He invests all his time in his work. His intentions are pure; to build the perfect life for his family. But with a new addition to the family and as the years go by, Mohan gets further involved in his work. It is only after their son, Rohit, graduates that Parvathy decides to take a drastic step, shaking up her 20 years of marriage.

Zee5.name: Siddhi Vinayak
Zee5.description: Two childhood sweethearts, Siddhi and Vinayak, grow up to hate each other and become enemies until they begin to fall in love.

Zee5.name: Savings Account
Zee5.description: The backdrop of this film is a busy bank. On one fine morning, like any other day, usual works start at the bank. Suddenly a person enters the bank with a gun in his hand and takes control of everything creating panic. Soon police intervene and we see so many twists and turns in the story.

Zee5.name: Sutliyan
Zee5.description: A heart-warming tale of an estranged family struggling to deal with their troubled past and unresolved conflicts. What will happen when the siblings gather under one roof for Diwali?

Zee5.name: Sarojini - Ek Nayi Pehal
Zee5.description: The show followed the journey of Sarojini, a strong minded, well-educated girl who gets married into a family with a regressive patriarchal set up - a household governed, dominated and practically ruled by her over-bearing, chauvinistic father-in-law.

Zee5.name: Hello World
Zee5.description: These new IT interns are entering the grown-up world and the possibilities are endless.

Zee5.name: Archier Gallery
Zee5.description: When Archie, an old school romantic falls in love with his colleague, he tries to mix modern love ideas and old-school romance to win her heart

Zee5.name: PHD (Pyar Hai Drama)
Zee5.description: Follows three married couples who have established in the UK as they query what love is. Their relationships, which were once a bed of roses, have now reached a place where they are struggling to maintain them. Can love triumph?

Zee5.name: Tum Hi Ho Bandhu Sakha Tumhi
Zee5.description: The story revolves around the Pethewala family. Bhushan (Neil Bhatt), the second son of the family is in love with Shreya (Sreejita De). Before he can tell his family, they pretend to have fixed his marriage elsewhere but the girl turns out to be Shreya. The lovers are happily married. Ajay is the youngest son of the Pethewala family. His best friend Ajju is in love with Sanjana. Ajju gets a job in USA and he and Sanjana decide to marry in the court given Sanjana's father's objections. Being just under 21 years of age, Ajju cannot marry. To stop Sanjana's father from getting her married forcibly to someone else, Ajju requests Ajay to marry her till he returns from the US. Ajay marries Sanjana. Unknown to their families is that their marriage is a contract for a few months. The Pethewala family takes time to accept Sanjana. Meanwhile, Shreya, after getting brain washed by her mother, wants to divide the house and gain control over it. Sanjana comes to know of Shreya's true colours and tries to expose her. But Shreya exposes the truth behind Ajay's marriage. This creates huge problems in the family and Sanjana is thrown out of the house. Trilokchand asks Ajay to go for a divorce. But Sanjana's father, who has already accepted the marriage makes her realise her love for Ajay. Ajay likes Sanjana but hides his feelings as he does not want to hurt Ajju. Sanjana tries to win Ajay's love. Meanwhile, Dadi comes to know Shreya's true face. She brings back Sanjana to the house as a negative person. Sanjana tortures the family so the torn apart family will come together to fight against her. She finally succeeds in exposing Shreya who is thrown out by Bhushan. Shreya tries to commit suicide by jumping off from the cliff. Bhushan saves her but she loses her vision and becomes blind. Shreya regrets her mistakes and asks forgiveness from the family. Everyone forgives her except Bhushan. At the same time Ajju returns from USA. Ajju comes to know of Sanjana's love for Ajay. He tries to drag her out of the house but Ajay stops him and confesses his love for her. This creates a huge fight between the friends. Ajju tries to rape Sanjana, when Ajay's sister Mishri saves her by hitting Ajju on his head with a vase. Ajju dies and Mishri gets scared. Ajay and Sanjana hide Ajju's body. The cops come by and tell Trilokchand that they've discovered Ajju's body and that the entire Pethewala family are suspects in the murder, but Ajay and Sanjana are the main suspects. In college, Mishri notices that she is being followed. It is actually Ajju in disguise. Ajju's sister Shaina, Ajju and even Shreya try and manipulate Mishri into thinking she's going mad but Ajay and Sanjana protect her. In the meantime, Shreya has faked a pregnancy to stay in the family but Bhushan suspects her and finds out her lies. Ajay and Mishri catch another man, Anuj, who claims to have fallen in love with Mishri at first sight. Anuj's family asks for Mishri's hand in marriage. On the day of the wedding, Sanjana is arrested for Ajju's murder. Sanjana confesses and the only way Ajay can save her is to marry Shaina. Finally Bhushan enters and exposes all the villains and made Sanjana and Ajay Married. Shreya, Ajay and shaina are arrested.Sanjana requests Bhushan to bring Shreya home but he agrees. Shreya gets happy that Sanjana forgives her. The story ends with the whole family dancing.

Zee5.name: Kunjeldho
Zee5.description: Kunjeldho, an undergraduate student, falls in love with his classmate Nivedita. Problems arise when Nivedita gets pregnant.

Zee5.name: Ronkini Bhavan
Zee5.description: A young bride, Juthika enters her husband's ancestral home , she discovers a chilling legacy: every bride before her has died mysteriously. Now it's her journey juggling between faith and fear. To surrender or to suspect.

Zee5.name: Manampole Mangalyam
Zee5.description: The story revolves around Nila who decides to get her widowed mother-in-law remarried.

Zee5.name: One Stop for Love
Zee5.description: Sanjana virgin girl under peer pressure, instigated by her friends ends up booking a Gigolo, she sees some more guys till she meets the right match.

Zee5.name: Aranyar Prachin Probad
Zee5.description: Aranya, a medical student and detective by hobby, and also a cricket fan, starts helping his brother in law (CID officer) in the re-opened murder case of Dr Amit Roy in Panaghat. Investigations reveal a lot of underlying corruption there.

Zee5.name: Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti
Zee5.description: Lovers Priya and Lakshman who can't get married till Priya's elder sister Pallavi does. Lakshman devises an elaborate plan where they hire an NRI groom to woo Pallavi.

Zee5.name: Karuppankaatu Valasu
Zee5.description: A rural village is heading towards a drastic transformation and a sudden death of 4 persons triggers a case. will it be solved? what's behind this murder mystery?

Zee5.name: Angshuman MBA
Zee5.description: Angshuman, an MBA graduate, starts a break-up consultancy with his best friend, Gupi. When he falls in love with Labonyo, who believes in old-school romance, he must find a way to hide his profession.

Zee5.name: Pasant Aahe Mulgi
Zee5.description: The story is about the outgoing Urmi and mischievous but sweet, Vasu. How a match made in heaven faces turmoil on earth when their families come face to face. Vasu's father has strong religious beliefs and Urmi's family is a typical middle class family with contemporary thoughts.

Zee5.name: Babbar Ka Tabbar
Zee5.description: Babbar Ka Tabbar is a ZEE5 Original web series starring Manu Rishi, Ayesha Raza, Bhavin Bhanushali, Avneet Kaur and Anshuman Jha. The story revolves around the Babbar family, who struggle to bridge the generation gap with their millennial kids. The parents and kids try their best to cope up with each other's lifestyles which often gets them in hilarious situations.

Zee5.name: Alo Chhaya
Zee5.description: Two girls, Alo and Chhaya, are raised together and they care deeply for each other. However, growing up under Chhaya's shadow comes at a cost for Alo.

Zee5.name: Mei Hoom Moosa
Zee5.description: Moosa, a soldier returns home after 19 years in Jail. He finds he is presumed dead. How Moosa sets about to prove his identity while also trying to come to terms with everything that has happened around him during his time behind bars.

Zee5.name: Mafia - Game for Life
Zee5.description: Five years after college, six estranged friends gather for a bachelorette party in Madhupur. Soon, a game of Mafia reveals buried secrets that put their bond and lives in danger. Will they survive?

Zee5.name: Saari Raat
Zee5.description: A married couple takes refuge in a dilapidated house during a stormy night. An old man, who stays in the house, plays an uncanny host, and draws out their secrets and shares his life theories with them.

Zee5.name: Thandhu Vitten Ennai
Zee5.description: After Vinay falls in love with Amritha, his family looks for a girl of their choice. Will Vinay get married to Amritha, and will the girl who enters Vinay's house be able to tackle his family that comprises six women?

Zee5.name: Mainkar Chipay
Zee5.description: Three men are caught in a situation inside a car. One of them is a rich man who regularly sources cocaine from a fixed peddler at a fixed spot, another is a drug dealer who comes late and the third one is a stranger. What happens next?

Zee5.name: Jatugriha
Zee5.description: Upon taking up a new job, a hotel manager tries to unearth the mystery behind a seemingly haunted manor in the hills.

Zee5.name: Netaji
Zee5.description: Netaji is a Bengali television series based on the life and journey of Subhas Chandra Bose. This patriotic drama series narrates the incidents in the life of a young Subhash who joined the freedom struggle and went on to become one of the greatest leaders and freedom fighter India ever produced.

Zee5.name: Love Punch
Zee5.description: Follows college rivals Nandini and Preetham whose relationship slowly transforms into love amid misunderstandings, emotional conflicts, and family pressure.

Zee5.name: Lights, Camera, Achhan
Zee5.description: Sundar is on a quest to solve the puzzle of his father's life. His search leads him to his father's filmmaking dreams and a secret half-sister whose mother was the lead actress in B-grade films.

Zee5.name: Ek Love Ya
Zee5.description: Amar, a bright young boy, falls in love with Anitha, but when she rejects his advances, Amar turns into a different person with dim prospects. Produced by Rakshitha Prem, it is touted to be a musical love story.

Zee5.name: Loop 11:47
Zee5.description: Three friends escape mundane routines when they discover a mysterious lake trapping them in a time loop, facing new challenges that test their resilience.

Zee5.name: Amriki Dulha
Zee5.description: Ganesh returns home to Chennai for holidays where his father Mr Rangarajan pressurizes him to get married. Ganesh meets Michael and laments how he doesn't want to get married and relies on Michael to come up with a plan.

Zee5.name: Smart KidZ
Zee5.description: Smart KidZ is an Indian original digital animated edutainment series targeting children aged 7 to 13. The series uses short, highly relatable narratives to present practical tools for emotional intelligence, safety and honesty.

Zee5.name: Chote Tara Ka Bada Gadar
Zee5.description: Chote Tara ka Bada Gadar is an Indian animated children's action fantasy series set in the Punjabi village of Himmatpur.

Zee5.name: Mithijhora
Zee5.description: An unfortunate events forces Raipurna to sacrifice her love and happiness to give her sisters, Neelanjana and Tilottama, a secure future.

Zee5.name: Horn Ok Please
Zee5.description: What happens when a sanskari meets an atyachari? Advik and gayatri - both young and ambitious, but poles apart with each other's personalities. Destiny brings them together and now, with their new 'live-in arrangement', they decide not to come in each other's way. But as we know, life always has its own plans.

Zee5.name: Poove Poochudava
Zee5.description: Shiva and Shakthi meet in an automobile accident and instantly hate each other, but conspire to help Shiva's brother Sundhar who has fallen in love with Shakthi's sister Meenakshi.

Zee5.name: Endraavathu Oru Naal
Zee5.description: Thangamuthu, a farmer, loves his cattle the most, and leads a happy life with his wife Rasathi. But, an unfortunate incident turns their lives upside down.

Zee5.name: Ishtam
Zee5.description: The movie displays a feel of good romantic entertainer and describes the life of young married couple who make their life miserable with ego problems.

Zee5.name: Thappa
Zee5.description: A young journalist wants to become a successful ghostbuster. But unfortunately he is unable to encounter any ghost. So he decides to make a fake video of ghost experience which goes viral. Money and fame follows, but also follows is a ghost and that too in his own house. Will he be able to save his newly found reputation or will the ghost have his way with him?

Zee5.name: Phulki
Zee5.description: Phulki, a small-town girl, aims to break stereotypes by pursuing boxing professionally, a passion inherited from her father, to overcome life's obstacles.

Zee5.name: Chakradhari Ajay Krishna
Zee5.description: Chakradhari Ajay Krishna is a Hindi drama TV series. After the success of Baal Krishna (2016-2017), the makers have taken a leap forward with this show. The show captures the period after the death of Kansa and Chakradhari Ajay Krishna unfolds the untold story of Krishna's Mathura life, where a new challenge awaits him. The show is a captivating showcase of good v/s evil in each of the events that occur between Krishna and Jarasandh.

Zee5.name: The Scam: Leaked
Zee5.description: Follows students whose lives are affected when a medical exam paper is leaked, leading to the exam's cancellation and devastating consequences for those who prepared for it.

Zee5.name: Manja Pai
Zee5.description: An aged villager comes to the city and sets people right.

Zee5.name: BHK Bhalla@Halla.Kom
Zee5.description: Story of a common man who is struggling to have his own house in the city of dreams Mumbai, It's a light hearted situational comedy.

Zee5.name: Once Upon a Time in Kayamkulam
Colourrs of Love
Zee5.description: A terrible breakup and depression bring Avee, a young doctor, to Rajat, a renowned psychologist. Will Avee ever find his way back to love and happiness?

Zee5.name: Idak: The Goat
Zee5.description: Namya is on a journey with a goat to fulfil his mothers dreams. But the notorious goat won't make the journey easy. Set in beautiful landscapes of Western India, is a story about friendship, humanity, sacrifice and wisdom.

Zee5.name: Krishanu Krishanu
Zee5.description: A girl from Germany wants to make a work on Krishanu Dey's life.

Zee5.name: Malaysia to Amnesia
Zee5.description: Malaysia To Amnesia revolves around two childhood friends who plan to get married. However, they face complications as they are unable to cope with married life.

Zee5.name: Kahat Hanuman Jai Shri Ram
Zee5.description: With fascinating, interesting and adventurous tales from the life of Lord Hanuman (the divine devotee of Lord Ram and 11th avatar of Lord Shiva), this show teaches us many moral values of life

Zee5.name: Saajanaa
Zee5.description: A couple from different caste and class fall in love with each other. However, the villagers and the society refuse to accept their relationship and vow to teach them a lesson.

Zee5.name: Heads and Tales
Zee5.description: As three women deal with tough times in romantic relationships, they learn to take control of their personal lives and stand up for themselves.

Zee5.name: The Lovely Mrs. Mookherjee
Zee5.description: A makeup artist pressures her overseas-working love interest to marry her. He refuses, citing inability to provide her desired luxury lifestyle. Her reaction drives the narrative.

Zee5.name: Pratighat
Zee5.description: Chandu, a gangster, comes to the rescue of Puja, a distressed girl, and they eventually fall in love. However, things take an unexpected turn when Chandu's past comes back to haunt him.

Zee5.name: Kabani
Zee5.description: Kabali, from an underprivileged background, faces barriers due to her family's past. She secures a scholarship through Kabaddi, moves to the city where she meets Rambha, her half-sister.

Zee5.name: Mullum Malarum
Zee5.description: Dharmadurai is a hardworking man who takes care of his family and unexpectedly gets married to Mahalakshmi, who was initially engaged to his brother. The mismatched couple tries to lead a normal life.

Zee5.name: Maya Bazaar - For Sale
Zee5.description: The lives of families moving into a posh community named Maya Bazaar. Their hopes for a peaceful life are shattered when the government declares the construction illegal.

Zee5.name: Mera Vyah Kara Do
Zee5.description: Film narrates the story of a girl next door who edits her matrimonial profile with bold pics and comments. The bad girl image works in her favor but also creates chaos in her life.

Zee5.name: Ajker Shortcut
Zee5.description: The story takes off when Bishu, a slum dweller, and Abesh, a wanna-be poet, feel shaken after witnessing suicide of a homeless person on a busy road of Kolkata.

Zee5.name: Baba Jani
Zee5.description: A middle-aged, well off, family oriented man loses his love interest after his two sisters creates chaos. Story begins when he has to deal with his sisters after he marries a widow with a daughter of teenage and put up with the show his sisters create while his brother in law secretly harassed his step-daughter. How will he tackle each situation without hurting relationship with his sisters is all this show is about.

Zee5.name: Taana
Zee5.description: This is about a life struggle of a man who's trying to become a policeman as his family members wish and forced him to become police and save their village.

Zee5.name: Bitti Business Wali
Zee5.description: Bitti as a hardworking woman who aspires to gain financial independence, being aware that it might invite naysayers in her small town.

Zee5.name: Bhinna
Zee5.description: The Script of a Film, she is going to be a part of; begins to blur lines between reality and imagination, for an Aspiring Actress, obsessed about Method Acting.

Zee5.name: Room No. 54
Zee5.description: Four youngsters, coming from middle-class families, become roommates in engineering college in room number 54. Follow their journey full of learnings, challenges and fun in this light-hearted comedy mixed with vulnerability and innocence.

Zee5.name: AranyaDeb
Zee5.description: Two people try to find their calling in Kolkata.

Zee5.name: Meka Suri 2
Zee5.description: Meka Suri succeeds in taking revenge. But later he gets pulled deeper in the crime world and he becomes one of the most wanted criminals. The raw, rustic feel of the film is the USP.

Zee5.name: Mr. Nonsense
Zee5.description: Mr Nonsense comes as different characters of society to police station which creates humorous situation with the staff.

Zee5.name: Kolkatar Harry
Zee5.description: Kolkatar Harry is an upcoming Indian Bengali language comedy children film featuring Soham Chakraborty, Priyanka Sarkar, Laboni Sarkar, Arindam Ganguly, Dipankar Dey, Prosenjit Chatterjee and Oishika Guhathakurta in the lead role.

Zee5.name: Mitta
Zee5.description: Mitta revolves around two stoners who get themselves into different events of trouble.

Zee5.name: Jarowar Jhumko
Zee5.description: Everyone thinks Jhumko is dead except Kohinoor, Hirok and Panna Lal. One day Kohinoor sees Jhumko in Biju's house. However, Jhumko is hiding her identity from Ginni Roy. She wants to take revenge from Ginni Roy for trying to kill her. Ginni Roy goes to a jewelry store where she chooses the best necklace for Tikli. But someone snatches it from her and that person buys with. The price was 50 lakhs but that person doubles the amount to 75 lakhs. Ginni Roy is shocked by hearing the price. She does not know that it is Jhumko who brought the necklace. Kohinoor, Tridha, and Tikli Biju's wedding rituals are going on. Jhumko says she will come at the wedding day of Biju and Tikli to shock Ginni Roy. Finally, Jhumko gets to know her mother's killers: they are none other than Hirok, Ginni Roy, and Kohinoor's mother. Jhumko vows to take revenge from all her mother's killers. Also, everyone in the Roy mansion gets to know that Jhumko is alive by Ginni Roy's informer. Later Jhumko comes in front of everyone on the wedding occasion of Biju and Tikli and Trida is betrayed once again and she vows revenge on everyone. So Trida is using Biju to take revenge on Jhumko and everyone else and she is making Biju torture Tikli and asking them for demands. Can Jhumko ever find out that Trida is behind all the conspiracy and expose her in front of everyone?

Zee5.name: Annakodiyum Aindhu Pengalum
Zee5.description: It is an aspiring story of Annakodi and her four daughters. Gauri, the eldest daughter of Annakodi and Muthupandi is in search for an identity for her mother, herself and siblings as her mother being the second wife of Muthupandi is ill-treated by people around her, in spite of her step mother Pandiamma supporting them. How Gowri, a lawyer by profession tackles all the hurdles is captured as an interesting story. Gowri's role model in life is Uma Mahewari, the leading lawyer in the town. Destiny lands her as the daughter-in-law of Uma Maheshwari where she faces threat to practice her profession. How she takes over her role model and fights all injustice forms the rest of the story.

Zee5.name: Detective Didi
Zee5.description: Detective Didi is a crime thriller drama starring Manish Gopalalni and Sonia Balani in the lead. The story revolves around a street-smart ace private detective Bunty Sharma and special agent Bhim Singh Bhullar. Together they take on serial killers, crime lords, gangsters and all, both employing desperate measures in desperate situations. What follows is a chase akin to Tom and Jerry to solving the case first, and the bond between Bunty and Bhim who can't stand each other only to realize they cannot survive without each other.

Zee5.name: Fab 5
Zee5.description: FAB 5 is an action-animated series about Anand, a kind-hearted 10-year-old chosen to protect two connected worlds: Zeevan Amusement Park and the magical forest of Aranyavann.

Zee5.name: The Will
Zee5.description: Six youngsters gather at an old family-owned mansion in the hope of receiving a large inheritance. However, unknown to them, some dreadful and mysterious forces await at the mansion.

Zee5.name: Jaago Mohan Pyare
Zee5.description: Jaago Mohan Pyare is a Marathi television series starring Atul Parchure and Supriya Pathare in the lead. The story revolves around Mohan, a middle-class tailor, who is harassed by his dominating wife and mother-in-law. A fairy enters his life to help him with all the difficulties and soon his life takes a magical turn. Find out if his wife gets to know about this fairy or not.

Zee5.name: Taledanda
Zee5.description: The film throws light on current climatic condition of our planet. The protagonist Kunna, a member of Soliga tribe, despite battling mental health issues, takes it upon himself to fight for cause of preserving nature.

Zee5.name: Mukhomukhi
Zee5.description: Mukhomukhi is an Indian Bengali language film directed by Kamaleshwar Mukherjee. The film is based on a drama Abayab written by the director himself.

Zee5.name: Thiru Mangalyam
Zee5.description: The story centres around the journey and conflicts in the life of the lead protagonist Sandhya "Sreevani",the daughter of Asst. Commissioner of Police, Vijaykumar "Ajay Rathnam". She is very clear that she will not marry a cop in her life, as she herself has suffered as a result of being the daughter of a police officer. But destiny clearly has other plans for her, as she falls in love with an ordinary constable Murugan "Sridhar". Her troubled married life and the problems the two families face forms the crux of the story.

Zee5.name: Bandhan
Zee5.description: When Darpan's parents adopt a baby elephant, Ganesha, she starts treating him as her younger brother. As their bond develops, they learn that they are inseparable from each other.

Zee5.name: Nagaraja Cholan MA, MLA.
Zee5.description: A political satire, the movie chronicles the highs and lows of Nagaraja Cholan, a deputy Chief Minister's ambitious career.

Zee5.name: Hriday Haran B.A. Pass
Zee5.description: The story revolves around a young couple, Hridoy and Pekham. Hriday as he is referred to, is the black sheep of the family and unemployed and uneducated he is only interested in music. Hriday then makes the ultimate sacrifice, leaves his career as a lyricist and becomes a driver at Pekham's house.

Zee5.name: Singa Penne
Zee5.description: Arnav, Payal, Uday, and Kutti Padmini in the lead roles. The story revolves around Mahalakshmi, an independent village girl, who decides to break the stereotype and train herself for the Border Security Force. What's Mahalakshmi's motive behind joining the security force and can she find success in her breakthrough journey?

Zee5.name: Alliyambal
Zee5.description: Alli and Devan, whose views and aspects on life is completely poles apart each other, meets and falls in a tight bond of relationship.

Zee5.name: Trinayani
Zee5.description: Trinayani is a woman who can see the future. She decides to use her power to make other peoples lives better. Life changes upside down when people learn about her extraordinary abilities.

Zee5.name: Saara Kahi Tichyasathi
Zee5.description: Two sisters drift apart after a rift. Despite the distance, fate brings them back together.

Zee5.name: Ei Chheleta Bhelbheleta
Zee5.description: The show's unique name has been taken from common Bengali childhood rhyme. It truly captures the free-spirited love and chemistry between the protagonists - Abir and Shaluk. Life takes a turn when introvert city-bred boy 'Abir' meets the vivacious village girl 'Shaluk'. Their unusual friendship clicks in an instant and soon a sweet innocent chemistry develops between the two. Soon they realize their feelings towards each other. Thus, starts the story of their 'first love'. 'Eii Chhele Ta Bhelbhele Ta' is a tale of love, which follows the protagonists through myriad of situations and sees them unite against all odds. The story showcases a pure love story between two teenagers and how their love matures over time and rises above the different obstacles of life.

Zee5.name: Paashbalish
Zee5.description: Follows Chandu's life after separation from childhood love Anchol. Years later, he reenters her life under a different identity, keeping his past a secret.

Zee5.name: Ki Kore Bolbo Tomay
Zee5.description: Ki Kore Bolbo Tomay is a Bengali drama series produced by Shashi Sumeet Productions and directed by Ayan Sengupta. Starring Swastika Dutta , Krushal Ahuja and Ayan Nayak in pivotal roles, the story revolves around Radhika, who aspires to became a successful fashion designer. Koushik enters her life like a breath of fresh air, but she loses him. Then, Karna, a businessman, falls in love with Radhika. Witness how Radhika Finds her way in the maze of relationship band ethics.

Zee5.name: Sass Meri Ne Munda Jamya
Zee5.description: Keerat gets pregnant after marrying Harmeet. Things take a hilarious turn when Harmeet's mother faints, and the doctor informs everyone that she too is expecting.

Zee5.name: Vishwak
Zee5.description: Young graduate, who has inventive concepts, wants to launch a business and relocate to his hometown. He is advised to relocate abroad by his father and potential investors. What would his next step be?

Zee5.name: Kon Gopone Mon Bhesheche
Zee5.description: When Aniket, an entrepreneur, helps small-town resident Shyamali, their chance encounter develops into a deeper connection.

Zee5.name: Yeda
Zee5.description: Psychic Brahmin Appa harasses his wife Savitri and insists that his son Unmesh marry a rich girl to recover his education expenses. However, Unmesh loves Pradnya and flees with her fearing his father's wrath.

Zee5.name: Ayassh Dil
Zee5.description: Based on a novel, Ayassh Dil depicts the rise and fall of a man hailing from a humble background achieving the pinnacle of success in the field of investigative journalism.

Zee5.name: Shohorer Ushnotomo Din E
Zee5.description: Kolkata natives Ritoban and Anindita rekindle their college romance after years apart. Amidst the city's timeless essence, they grapple with sacrificing dreams for love or love for dreams.

Zee5.name: Accident
Zee5.description: After the death of his activist wife, in an unfortunate accident, Sawanth must cope up with his tremendous loss. At the same time, he must figure whether his wifes accident was no accident at all.

Zee5.name: Never Kiss Your Best Friend Lockdown Special
Zee5.description: The best-selling author and her first BFF (first kiss) land in the world of virtual dating amidst the global corona crisis, only to end up dealing with millennial complications of love and life.

Zee5.name: Daawat-e-Biryani
Zee5.description: Panchali travels from Kolkata to Lucknow and discovers her grandmother's secret biryani recipe. During this journey, she also discovers interesting aspects of her grandmother's life.

Zee5.name: The Last Coffee
Zee5.description: On the verge of a divorce, Rehaan and Iram meet for one last time over coffee. But they get stuck in a snowstorm and are left with no choice except to confront their pent-up feelings.

Zee5.name: Doll's House (Based on a play by Henrik Ibsen)
Zee5.description: A married woman, Keya struggles between protecting the secret that could shake her marriage and yearning for her husband's love rather than just being his prized doll. Can Keya avert the disaster that can put her marriage at stake?

Zee5.name: Ranu Pelo Lottery
Zee5.description: Ranu Pelo Lottery is a Zee Bangla show that revolves around Ranu who dreams of providing a comfortable living for her parents who are working as domestic helpers for the cruel Mitra family. She also wants to build a school for underprivileged children like herself so that they don't suffer the tyranny of the well-off over the underprivileged folk. Life takes a drastic turn when, Ranu wins a lottery od Rs 10 crores and gets married in the Mitra family.

Zee5.name: Chattaan
Zee5.description: 'Chattaan' revolves around Shamsher Raj, a stern father, who wants everybody in the family to be disciplined and follow his rules. However, his pride and honor are shattered when his family members join hands with Kamal Chopra, a rival.

Zee5.name: Indias Asli Championhai Dum
Zee5.description: India's Asli Champion-Hai Dum is an Indian reality stunt show hosted by Suniel Shetty. The unique show aims to find the fittest Indian who would survive the ultimate test of physical and mental endurance, to win the glorious title of India's Asli Champion.

Zee5.name: Godman
Zee5.description: After Godman, Anandhar, is jailed on murder charges, he gets acquitted with the help of Ayyanar, a platform dweller. Impressed, he promises Ayyanar to make him the next abbot for his godly empire.

Zee5.name: Phone-a-Friend
Zee5.description: Phone-a-Friend is a sci-fi romantic comedy series starring Akhlaque Khan, Mantra and Swati Kapoor. It's a humorous tale of romance and friendship between a guy, a girl and a cellphone.

Zee5.name: Palasher Biye
Zee5.description: In a North Kolkata family led by Sudhamoyi Devi, Palash loves Shalini, but her Bangladeshi background and East Bengal support clash with his family's Mohun Bagan loyalty and bias. Can Palash overcome these obstacles?

Zee5.name: Kambli
Zee5.description: A former Indian cricketer's journey from emerging as a promising young batting talent to facing personal and professional challenges that alter the course of his career.

Zee5.name: Jaalbandi
Zee5.description: After completing his graduation, Anish starts working as an insurance agent in a reputed firm. Due to his poor performance in office, his boss Gouranga da advises him to give an advertisement on the local newspaper.
