On the very next day, a renowned film producer, Adinath Mullick comes to Anish's place to make a policy of Rs 10crore. Adinath wants Bharat Seva Ashram as the nominee of his policy. Then in the course of events, he wants to replace his nominee by someone called Chitralekha Sen. In the meantime, Adinath's son, Amitabha and daughter, Gargi both get greedy and starts running after this money. They both want their names as the nominee and Anish falls into their trap. On the other hand, Gouranga da's daughter Champakali sets a trap for Anish. She wants to marry Anish in exchange of convincing his dad to make the deal done. In the course of events, Anish meets Riyanka, a famous TV star and coincidentally at that point of time, her husband Bobby takes his own life and Anish falls again into that trap again. On one hand a Rs. ten crore policy, which might change his life forever. On the other hand three women, Gargi, Champakali and Riyanka consumes his life. Bobby's death and Adinath's car accident make his life more miserable. Anish gets more and more entangled in all these humdrums. Would he ever set free or falls into an unending nadir?

Zee5.name: Table no. 5
Zee5.description: In this six-part series, interesting people from different walks of lives meet at a table and strike a conversation that turns bizarre and controversial.

Zee5.name: Streets the Final Chapter
Zee5.description: The story revolves around the rivalry of two brothers, but the tables turned when they both realized that there is another person behind the every misery they've faced in their lives.

Zee5.name: Kojagori
Zee5.description: While Phuljhuri (Aparajita Ghosh Das) is a city-bred, pampered young girl who lives life on her own terms, Saheb (Raja Goswami Om) is a well-read, upright yet grounded youth, who believes in simple living, with high ideals. But fate brings the two people together in wedlock.

Zee5.name: SaReGaMaPa Li'l Champs 2025
Zee5.description: A musical journey where India's finest young voices aged 4 to 14 grace the spotlight, blending raw talent with expert guidance in a celebration of childhood, music and dreams realised.

Zee5.name: Raja Manthiri
Zee5.description: Brothers Surya and Karthi always bicker over small issues from childhood. Things take an interesting turn when Surya's marriage is fixed with Subha, who is actually in love with Karthi.

Zee5.name: WTFry
Zee5.description: Shama, a suicidal film star, meets Bashar, a simple man and discovers the deeper meaning of life through chaos and calmness.

Zee5.name: Reunion
Zee5.description: A group of friends comes across their missing college senior while on a trip. They decide to bring him back to the city and reunite him with his college sweetheart.

Zee5.name: Lal Jose
Zee5.description: Nandu wishes to be a director like the renowned Malayalam film director, Lal Jose.

Zee5.name: Mella Thirandhathu Kadhavu
Zee5.description: The story about heart-warming love story between two visually challenged people- Santhosh and Selvi.

Zee5.name: Comedy Nights with Suraj
Zee5.description: Comedian Suraj Venjaramoodu along with Aswathy Sreekanth interacts with celebrity guests about their latest films while keeping the audience laughing with their wit, humor and assorted skits. The show also features various individuals from different walks of life come together to showcase a wide range of talents and impress the judges with their skills.

Zee5.name: Raja Magal
Zee5.description: Sivagami, a polite lady who has an elder brother Rajarajan. He has married an arrogant lady Bairavi, who refuses Sivagami and her husband due to her aunt Kanchana's plan. Sivagami and Bairavi were pregnant in same month. Bairavi wish to want a baby boy, but she gave birth to a girl baby. While Sivagami gave birth to a boy baby. As Bairavi wish to be fulfill, Sivagami swapped the babies.

Zee5.name: Nodi Swamy Ivanu Irode Heege
Zee5.description: A heartbroken and depressed Sai Kumar; after several failed suicide attempts is still adamant to die. Chaos unfolds after he finds a killer and a dead-body disposer for himself through a Euthanasia offering website.

Zee5.name: Varasdara
Zee5.description: An unforeseen circumstances a women faces when she gives birth to a girl child.

Zee5.name: Three Half Bottles
Zee5.description: An urban comedy about three young bachelors living in Hyderabad. The series follows their trials and tribulations with love, career and adulthood.

Zee5.name: Mrs.Subbalakshmi
Zee5.description: Revolves around a woman struggling to free herself from the daily doldrums of marriage. After her workaholic husband, who barely notices her, forgets their wedding anniversary, Subbu takes her friend's well-intentioned advice and decides to take a day off for herself. The series then follows her one-day escapade.

Zee5.name: The art room
Zee5.description: Hindi television series that engages and inspires children to experiment and turn their imagination into reality. Using a little dab of glue or a dash of colour, discover how to make your very own easy-to-make art and craft projects.

Zee5.name: Taut
Zee5.description: Shinda is a commission agent or a 'Taut' who works for an ill-reputed police officer, responsible for his father's death. On a mission to end corruption, the officer plots Shinda's murder too.

Zee5.name: The Legend King Lalityadiya
Zee5.description: Lalitaditya alias Muktapida was the most powerful ruler of the Karkota dynasty of Kashmir region in the Indian subcontinent. The 12th-century chronicler Kalhana characterizes Lalitaditya as a world conqueror, crediting him with extensive conquests and miraculous powers in his Rajatarangini.

Zee5.name: First Kapi
Zee5.description: Habitual crooks Taj and Laatu often carry out heists with the financial help of a local don. Things go south during their new con when they get double-crossed. What will they do?

Zee5.name: Aye Zindagi
Zee5.description: Find out what happens is, as the events unfold in the lives of a mother and her adopted son who she loves like her own blood.

Zee5.name: Jadu Kadai
Zee5.description: Bikram finds a wok endowed with special powers and as he begins to cook in it, his wishes start coming true. An excited Bikram must find the history of the wok and after some life threatening incidents, he also tries protect it from the greedy Maganlal.

Zee5.name: Bikele Bhorer Phool
Zee5.description: It is an unusual love story of a village girl and a city-bred doctor. The show focuses on a young Moina and a middle-aged Dr.Subhankar who get married in a turn of events. Life takes a turn when poor and naughty Moina is introduced to the luxurious lifestyle of Dr.Subhankar and his family members. Moina creates trouble and havoc in the lives of Subhankar's family members and she is disliked by them. However, Nupur, who loves Subhankar, decides to train Moina and make her eligible for Dr.Subhankar. 'Bikele Bhorer Phool' is a unique phrase which describes Moina and Dr.Subhankar's love story. The saying goes - "When two souls are meant for each other, they will find a way to meet, however different they are." Love is indeed the acceptance of difference not the search for similarities and more the difference, steadier the relationship. When Moyna, a high-spirited, fun-loving, mischievous, unruly, pampered village belle meets a city-bred, serious, no-nonsense, middle-aged, mellow Doctor, Subhankar, there is a war of words, thoughts and outlook towards life. Subhankar's disciplined character and thought process is obliterated right away by the simple facts of life as derived by Moyna. They say marriages are made in heaven. On earth, society's set rules of discrimination of age, caste, creed, background take a back seat in 'Bikele Bhorer Phool' where two diametrically opposite persons refuse to give up on each other and embark on a divine journey of marriage. Dr. Subhankar realizes that Moina needs to be educated to adjust with her family who have all completed their Masters. She gets her admission to a school on recommendations. Will Moina be able to prove her family her ability? Meanwhile, Konok Kakon plots a dangerous plot to get the ownership of Dr. Subhankar Banerjee Nursing Home from Subhankar. She puts public pressure on him and succeeds in her mission. Now what will happen? Marriage of Nupur or according to Moina Bhalo Didi's has been fixed. Shubhankar has decided to take the responsibility.

Zee5.name: Katti Batti
Zee5.description: Katti Batti is a Marathi romantic comedy television series starring Pushkar Sarad, Ashwini Kasar. In an unusual first meeting for an arranged marriage, Parag and Purva's parents have a major showdown and walk out on each other. However, this doesn't deter the young couple and they decide to meet again and eventually fall in love.

Zee5.name: Guldasta
Zee5.description: "Guldasta" traces the journey of three distinctive women named Srirupa, Renu and Dolly, Interwined in a web of make-believe emotions. Their interpersonal relationships, hardships, agonies, and ecstasies form the crux of the story.

Zee5.name: Shut up Sona
Zee5.description: SHUT UP SONA is a tongue-in-cheek take at a feisty female singer's unrelenting fight for an equal space in modern day India, a country deeply uncomfortable with her emancipation.

Zee5.name: America Ammayi
Zee5.description: It's a story of Samantha who sets out to reunite her mother with her family. They disown her when she disobeys them and gets married to an American. She is born and lived all her life in the US, but her family values are deeply rooted into the Indian System. Over the years, Samantha's mum falls ill and wishes to reunite with her family and thus, Samantha takes it upon herself to bring the family together. She enters her grandparents' house and convinces them to accept their daughter. In the process, she falls in love with her maternal uncle's son, Surya.

Zee5.name: Premer Phaande
Zee5.description: The story revolves around the lives of Mohor and Rishi. Rishi belongs to a joint family and works for a matrimonial company. Rishi's family is very supportive. He is a young lad and being the elder among two brothers, he is loved and pampered by everyone in the family. On the other hand, Mohor is a mature orphan girl. Mohor comes to Kolkata for her job. One fine day, much to his disgust, Mohor joins the matrimonial company as Rishi's boss. Mohor, who is new in the city, ends up becoming a tenant at Rishi's house. Rishi's family likes Mohor very much and his grandmother wants that Rishi should fall in love with Mohor. From here, starts the sweet fun chemistry of Rishi and Mohor, who being the boss troubles Rishi at work and Rishi, being the landlord irritates Mohor at home. This creates a hilarious ruckus due to the unconventional role reversal of Mohor and Rishi. Will this unique chemistry give rise to a sweet love story?

Zee5.name: Amrapali
Zee5.description: Honest teacher Banamali is respected in Raj Chandrapur, living with his daughter, Payel, who runs a nursery. Kabir, a politician's son, and Ayon, her friend, both love her. Amid political intrigue, who will win Payel's heart?

Zee5.name: Billa Pandi
Zee5.description: A die-hard Ajith fan, Billa Pandi works as a construction contractor and dedicates the rest of his time to helping others in his neighbourhood. He is in love with his aunt's daughter, Valli, but life drastically changes for him when Jayalakshmi, whose family's house he'd recently constructed, falls in love with him.

Zee5.name: Yaadhumagi Nindraai
Zee5.description: This is a story that needs to be told to the world. It's the story of several unknown faces hidden in the glamorous world of cinema. It's the voice that screams to be heard. Yaadhumagi Nindraal is the story of eternity and the woman who fights destiny to be a survivor. Directed by Gayathi Raghuram, this is based on several true stories that happen in the daily lives of background dancers. This is the first film in Tamil to give an insight into the lives of the background dancers and the dreams and aspirations they cherish. The film follows the story of a young school going girl, forced to take up dancing to make the ends meet for her family. Her dreams and aspirations are simple, but the realities of life is a lot more harsh than what one can imagine. This is a story that travels over 2 decades of the life of one such dancer Thamarai and the various people she meets and travels with. This is a story of hope, it's a story of a young girl, it's a story that has to be experienced to be cherished. It's a story that stays with you for a long time.

Zee5.name: Bhalobashar Shohor - Bus Stop
Zee5.description: During a bus journey, Neel falls in love with a beautiful girl whom he met for the first time. But he loses her once she gets down. How far will Neel go to find this girl whose name is even not known to him? Will they meet again?

Zee5.name: Thalayanai Pookal
Zee5.description: It is the story of Vedavalli, a brilliant and pragmatic middle class young girl who gets married into a wealthy joint family and fights to keep it united.

Zee5.name: Sumangali Bhava
Zee5.description: Vaidehi, an independent girl, dreams of being married to a man who adores her. After she marries Suryanarayana Varma, she struggles to deal with her husband's obsessive love

Zee5.name: Single Pasanga
Zee5.description: Ten clueless bachelors, paired with celebrity angels, embark on a transformative journey to overcome their fears of love and become the ultimate lover boy.

Zee5.name: Bowling-ah? Fielding-ah?
Zee5.description: A 15-20 minute casual cricket chat show that feels like Chennai friends pesra match talk raw, fun, opinionated, and full of emotion.

Zee5.name: Eesha
Zee5.description: Eesha meets widow Gowri while visiting his parents and falls in love. The village strongly opposes his intention to marry her.

Zee5.name: Nanbenda
Zee5.description: The show features three or four guests and two anchors, the core idea is to get them to share their nostalgic memories besides funny and interesting moments.

Zee5.name: Biye.Com
Zee5.description: The story revolves around a couple who meet through social media and fall in love. What happens further is what the film is all about.

Zee5.name: Baapu Bahar Bhejde
Zee5.description: In this ZEE5 Original, Gurnam, a habitual liar, dreams of moving to Canada but knows he can't clear the IELTS. He meets and woos Simran, as a ticket to reach Canada. But Simran learns about his plan.

Zee5.name: Dravya
Zee5.description: The thriller drama revolves around the life of a small-time scientist who claims to have invented a herbal fuel that can create a revolution in the petroleum industry.

Zee5.name: Pandiyum Sahakkalum
Zee5.description: Pandiyum Sahakkalum is an upcoming psychological satire film.

Zee5.name: Manathe Kottaram
Zee5.description: Madhavan and Chandrika, a middle-class couple, who devote their lives nurturing their children, dream of building a house and marrying off their daughters. Will their dreams come true?

Zee5.name: Naammatra
Zee5.description: Naammatra is a Marathi reality television show that showcases the efforts made by Naam Foundation, an initiative by actors Nana Patekar and Makarand Anaspure, that works for betterment of farmers in the drought-prone areas of Marathwada and Vidharbha. It is the inspiring journey of Naam Foundation and the significant contribution it has been making in the lives of Farmers and other Villagers.

Zee5.name: Forever
Zee5.description: Sanam and Shinara, unaware of impending events, walked hand in hand until a sudden lightning strike shattered their world.

Zee5.name: Uma Kaali - Aag Aur Paani
Zee5.description: Jagriti is a secret service officer but pretends to be timid with her family. When her cruel stepmother plans to get her elder daughter married, Jagriti discovers the groom's hidden reality.

Zee5.name: Liftman
Zee5.description: The story revolves around the misadventures of a Liftman who starts working in a new building.

Zee5.name: Mom Talks: Maa Ki Baat Maa Ke Jazbaat
Simply Kushboo
Zee5.description: It is a talk show where the actress will interact with celebrities from Kollywood every week. Unlike other shows with stars where they talk about their films and family, this one is totally different. The lesser-known personal side of the star will be brought out in front of the viewers across interesting segments of the show.

Zee5.name: Sudhamani Supera
Zee5.description: Sudhamani, a doting single mother, takes over the reins of her family after her fraudulent husband's death. Will she bend under societal pressure and compromise on her principles?

Zee5.name: Zee Kutumba Awards
Zee5.description: The event honours and applauds Zee Kannada TV artists as popular stars up the glamour quotient with their scintillating performances in 2021.

Zee5.name: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa LIL Champs 2021
Samayal Express
Zee5.description: The show explores Tamil Nadu's rich culinary heritage as celebrity couples recreate iconic dishes from each district, stirring up nostalgia and sharing cherished memories.

Zee5.name: Chutti Champions
Zee5.description: The show is loaded with cuteness and talent, and tests the compatibility between the kids and their parents.

Zee5.name: Naanga Vera Maari
Zee5.description: Zee Tamil celebrities entertain viewers with their amazing skits and electrifying performances and play loads of fun tasks on the occasion of the upcoming Independence Day.

Zee5.name: Bubble Baat
Zee5.description: Bubble Baat is world's first ever celebrity chat show hosted by Gunjan Utreja in a BATHROOM.

Zee5.name: Cricket Darbar
Zee5.description: Welcome to Cricket Darbar, a one-of-a-kind sports-comedy series where the world of T20 cricket meets the grandeur of a royal court. A Zee5 Original, this show transforms cricket analysis into a high-energy.

Zee5.name: Vishuphalam
Zee5.description: Vishuphalam, a show where astrologer Hari Pathanapuram predicts the year for the girls born under the twenty-seven birth nakshatras of astrology.

Sony Liv.name: Backrooms
Sony Liv.description: After a therapist's patient disappears into a dimension beyond reality, she must venture into the unknown to save him.

Sony Liv.name: Chennai Love Story
Sony Liv.description: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

Sony Liv.name: This City Is Ours: A Crime Family Saga
Sony Liv.description: Michael, a longtime member of organized crime, falls in love with Diana, prompting him to reevaluate his life and contemplate a future beyond his criminal activities. His newfound love becomes both a motivation and a potential liability.

Sony Liv.name: Gullak
Sony Liv.description: Set in quaint by-lanes in the heart of India, Gullak is a collection of disarming and relatable tales of the Mishra family.

Sony Liv.name: PK
Sony Liv.description: An alien on Earth loses the only device he can use to communicate with his spaceship. His innocent nature and child-like questions force the country to evaluate the impact of religious views on people.

Sony Liv.name: Bramayugam
Sony Liv.description: Thevan, a folk singer of the Paanan caste, has a fateful encounter when escaping slavery, leading to him discovering an ancient traditional mansion altering his destiny.

Sony Liv.name: Chapelwaite
Sony Liv.description: Captain Charles Boone relocates his family of three children to his ancestral home in Maine after his wife dies at sea.

Sony Liv.name: Kaithi
Sony Liv.description: Dilli, an ex-convict, endeavours to meet his daughter for the first time after leaving prison. However, his attempts are interrupted due to a drug raid planned by Inspector Bejoy.

Sony Liv.name: Rekhachithram
Sony Liv.description: Suspended cop Vivek Gopinath rejoins after gambling scandal. Tasked with solving 40-year-old murder case with faceless victim, he seeks redemption by cracking the long-unsolved mystery.

Sony Liv.name: Sitaare Zameen Par
Sony Liv.description: After a DUI, an arrogant basketball coach must train Neurodivergent adults for community service. His initial prejudice fades as his players show him a new perspective on life.
Two high school sweethearts meet at a reunion after 22 years and reminisce about their past.

Sony Liv.name: Por Thozhil
Sony Liv.description: A bright but faint-hearted rookie cop has to overcome his fears in order to succeed in his first case which sees him partnered with a reclusive senior officer to catch a serial killer on the loose.

Sony Liv.name: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
Sony Liv.description: When the poor Itsuki crosses paths with the rich but lazy heiress Hinako, he gets a job as her caretaker.

Sony Liv.name: Gargi
Sony Liv.description: The journey of a young school teacher to prove her father's innocence with the help of a juvenile advocate who's never even seen the interiors of a court hall.

Sony Liv.name: The Legend of Karna
Sony Liv.description: Follows Karna's journey from an abandoned child to a king who, despite knowing his side was wrong, chose to stand with them out of loyalty in this retelling of the Mahabharata.

Sony Liv.name: Gol Maal
Sony Liv.description: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates into more complex lies when his orthodox boss gets suspicious.

Sony Liv.name: Satya
Sony Liv.description: An innocent man is embroiled in the underworld after being falsely charged, and he sets out to punish the perpetrators who made his life miserable.

Sony Liv.name: Athiradi
Sony Liv.description: An energetic student, Samkutty, revives a banned college festival-unleashing a rivalry that turns celebration into chaos

Sony Liv.name: Leonardo
Sony Liv.description: The series recounts Leonardo da Vinci's extraordinary life through the works that made him famous, through the stories hidden within those works, revealing little by little the inner torment of a man obsessed with attaining perfection.

Sony Liv.name: Perfect Family
Sony Liv.description: A child's emotional crisis becomes the catalyst for the Karkaria family to confront their past, present, and the delicate threads that bind them together through family therapy.

Sony Liv.name: Bhoothakaalam
Sony Liv.description: Following the death of a family member, a mother and son experience mysterious events which distort their sense of reality and make them question their sanity.

Sony Liv.name: Vada Chennai
Sony Liv.description: A young carrom player in north Chennai becomes a reluctant participant in a war between two warring gangsters.

Sony Liv.name: Faadu: A Love Story
Sony Liv.description: In the ambitious journey of need and greed, Abhay, the poet falls in love with Manjiri, a poetess who has a different philosophy about life. Will Abhay choose love and simplicity or money and complexity?

Sony Liv.name: Freedom at Midnight
Sony Liv.description: Is the electrifying story of India's struggle for independence. Based on the bestselling book of the same name, it recounts the partition of India and Pakistan, and the religious and socio-political dynamics of the era.

Sony Liv.name: Marco
Sony Liv.description: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

Sony Liv.name: Piku
Sony Liv.description: A strong-willed, sharp-tongued daughter navigates her cranky, constipated father's hypochondria and quirky demands, while dealing with her own chaotic life and a reluctant road trip to Kolkata.

Sony Liv.name: Kadaisi Vivasayi
Sony Liv.description: The last active farmer in a remote village tries to hold out against a property developer.

Sony Liv.name: Welcome Home
Sony Liv.description: A census report leads two female government teachers to an isolated house, in which resides a family with twisted secrets they never imagined to recover.

Sony Liv.name: Haiwaan
Sony Liv.description: A blind martial artist protects a girl child from a psychopath killer.

Sony Liv.name: Kuttram Purindhavan: The Guilty One
Sony Liv.description: When a girl vanishes in a small town, a retiring pharmacist, the child's mother, and a local cop become entangled in a web of secrets and guilt as they search for answers and confront hidden truths.

Sony Liv.name: Thalavan
Sony Liv.description: Retired Dysp Udhayabhanu narrates events of his professional life in a TV program. He reveals the intriguing details of the 'Chepanamthota case', a milestone event in his career.

Sony Liv.name: KalamKaval
Sony Liv.description: A Kerala Police investigation in Kottayikonam escalates when small clues expose multiple disturbing cases and mysteries, while facing strategic obstacles throughout the probe.

Sony Liv.name: Pani
Sony Liv.description: When the peaceful married life of a couple is unexpectedly disrupted by two youngsters with criminal inclination, the trials and tribulations connect the mobster lives of Thrissur by becoming a part of vengeance.

Sony Liv.name: Lucifer
Sony Liv.description: A political Godfather dies and a lot of thieves dressed up as politicians took over the rule. Question arises regarding the successor of the God, unfolding few names, along with the God's most beloved angel, Lucifer.

Sony Liv.name: Scam 2003 - The Telgi Story
Sony Liv.description: Born in Khanapur in Karnataka, Telgi became the mastermind behind one of the most ingenious schemes in Indian history that spread across multiple states and shook the entire country.

Sony Liv.name: Churuli
Sony Liv.description: Two undercover cops who go in search of a fugitive enter another dimension occupied by uncivilized residents who are crass and rude. There, the two men get stuck in an apparent time loop as inexplicable events begin to occur.

Sony Liv.name: College Romance
Sony Liv.description: Three best friends look for love, laughs and some lifelong memories while attending college together.

Sony Liv.name: Tamil Rockerz
Sony Liv.description: Anonymous cyber pirates are threatening to release a highly anticipated film featuring a massively popular star. It's up to the cop Rudra to find the lawbreakers and bring them to justice.

Sony Liv.name: Dr. Arora
Sony Liv.description: The web series focuses on the travels of Dr. Vishesh Arora, a sex consultant from a small town. The latest creation by Imtiaz Ali focuses on the doctor and his variety of clients who all are connected to each other.

Sony Liv.name: Baby Girl
Sony Liv.description: A Child vanishes from a hospital. A hospital attendant becomes the prime suspect and goes on the run while others search for the missing girl.

Sony Liv.name: Laalo: Krishna Sada Sahaayate
Sony Liv.description: A rickshaw driver trapped in a farmhouse confronts his past demons while experiencing visions of Lord Krishna, who guides him through a transformative journey of self-discovery and healing.

Sony Liv.name: Pallichattambi
Sony Liv.description: Chattambi, a scheming man in a small town, survives by staying ahead of his neighbors through risky plans. When his schemes backfire, his survival depends on extricating himself from the mess he created.

Sony Liv.name: Jersey
Sony Liv.description: A cricketer who quits cricket decides to revive his career at the age of 36 for his sons dream and prove his ability.

Sony Liv.name: Josh
Sony Liv.description: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

Sony Liv.name: Purusha Pretham
Sony Liv.description: Purusha Pretham, Krishand's third feature, is a police procedural story that has never been seen before in Malayalam cinema; an investigative thriller with interesting twists and turns.

Sony Liv.name: Maanaadu
Sony Liv.description: On the day of a public conference by the state's Chief Minister, his bodyguard and a police officer are stuck in a time loop.

Sony Liv.name: Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah
Sony Liv.description: The day-to-day happenings of Gokuldham Society and its members, who live, celebrate and often face problems together.

Sony Liv.name: Agent
Sony Liv.description: A spy with a mysterious past, who is on a mission to uncover the truth about a dangerous terrorist organization.

Sony Liv.name: The Hunt: The Rajiv Gandhi Assassination Case
Sony Liv.description: In 1991, Rajiv Gandhi was killed by a suicide bomber at a campaign rally. A 90-day investigation revealed LTTE involvement, leading to arrests and convictions of conspirators.

Sony Liv.name: Bougainvillea
Sony Liv.description: A family entangled in a police investigation surrounding the mysterious disappearance of tourists in Kerala.

Sony Liv.name: Mayasabha: Rise of the Titans
Sony Liv.description: Two rival politicians from different backgrounds rise through Andhra Pradesh's power structure in the 1970s-80s. KKN and MSR navigate caste politics and personal ambition during a pivotal era in Indian history.

Sony Liv.name: Charlie Chopra & The Mystery of Solang Valley
Sony Liv.description: When her fiance gets implicated in a murder, Charlie arrives at his family home in pursuit of the truth. But as secrets tumble out that the murderer would rather have hidden, the next person to lose their life might be Charlie herself.

Sony Liv.name: Fatafati
Sony Liv.description: Phullora Bhaduri, a tailor from the suburbs with a gifted sense of designing, is ridiculed for being on the heavier side. Can she become a fashion influencer despite the odds?

Sony Liv.name: Adiyae
Sony Liv.description: When a depressed Jeeva gets into a freak accident, he wakes up to a bizarre utopian alternate reality, Living the most ideal life, Jeeva finds a purpose in life. But fate has other plans when he gets pulled back to the reality
Akhil and Athira, two youngsters who are deeply in love, and the implications their love has in the lives of their families and the society around them.

Sony Liv.name: Balti
Sony Liv.description: In a border town where kabaddi reigns supreme, four champion players dominate both the sport and the streets. When personal rivalries and dangerous feuds emerge, their unbreakable brotherhood faces its greatest test.

Sony Liv.name: The Kapil Sharma Show
Sony Liv.description: Comedian Kapil Sharma interacts with celebrity guests about their latest films while keeping the audience laughing with his wit, humour and assorted skits.

Sony Liv.name: Hastinapur Ke Veer
Sony Liv.description: Five noble brothers unite in courage and righteousness to battle the ruthless forces of ambition and injustice threatening their kingdom, testing their bonds through sacrifice and unwavering devotion to dharma.

Sony Liv.name: Maharani

This unique series brings forth distinguished Sikh guests from various walks of life, each with a remarkable story to tell. The series delves deep into the lives of these unsung heroes, offering audiences an intimate and revealing glimpse into the experiences, challenges, and triumphs that have defined their journeys. From trailblazing entrepreneurs to extraordinary athletes, from dedicated social activists to accomplished artists, each guest's narrative is a testament to the indomitable Sikh spirit. Hosted by the iconic Mahesh Bhatt, whose wisdom and insight act as the inner conscious of the show, "Sikh Spirit" goes beyond the surface. It explores the profound philosophies, faith, and cultural values that have shaped the lives of these remarkable individuals. With his signature style, Mahesh Bhatt connects with both guests and viewers on a deeply emotional and philosophical level. Through engaging conversations and heart-to-heart dialogues, Mahesh Bhatt unravels the hidden gems within the stories of these Sikh luminaries. He artfully weaves their experiences into the fabric of human existence, transcending boundaries of religion and culture. The series seeks to inspire and motivate, leaving the audience with profound life lessons and a renewed sense of purpose. With "Sikh Spirit," Mahesh Bhatt takes viewers on an unforgettable journey, celebrating the unsung heroes whose stories illuminate the human spirit's capacity for resilience, compassion, and greatness. Drawing from different philosophies, faiths, and cultures, the series is a powerful reminder of the boundless potential that resides within each of us, waiting to be unlocked. Prepare to be inspired, enlightened, and moved as "Sikh Spirit" unfolds the heroic journeys of these exceptional individuals, guided by the wisdom and warmth of the legendary Mahesh Bhatt. This is more than just a talk show; it's a transformations experience that transcends the screen and touches the heart.

Indian Movies.description: Yash Chopra's most cherished film with soul stirring music is a story of moments - moments of passion, of ecstasy and of life changing love.

Indian Movies.name: Aditya 369
Indian Movies.description: Children investigating a robbery discover a time machine. A couple trying to rescue them gets trapped, leading to adventures in 16th century India under Krishnadevaraya's reign and a distant future world.

Indian Movies.name: In Harihar Nagar
Indian Movies.description: Four young men are enamored by Maya, their next-door neighbor. However, she is in town to investigate the mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of her brother.

Indian Movies.name: Prahaar: The Final Attack
Indian Movies.description: Prahaar is the story of Major Chauhan, a tough and stern soldier, trained to destroy the enemy. He can see the enemy on our borders but is unaware of the invisible enemy within ourselves. When one of Major's Commandos - Peter D'Souza is killed, he is shown the harsh reality revolving around us, the enemy is within ourselves. The battlefield changes and Major Chavan makes his final attack on the enemy within this crumbling society.

Indian Movies.name: Dil
Indian Movies.description: A man pretends to be a rich industrialist to improve his son's chances of marrying in to wealth, but his plan backfires on him.

Indian Movies.name: Hum
Indian Movies.description: A dockworker overthrows the tyranny of a cruel gangster but has to run away to make a new life for himself and his brothers. Fifteen years later, his past catches up with him as his old enemy resurfaces.

Indian Movies.name: Phool Aur Kaante
Indian Movies.description: A young man who despises his father's criminal profession, wants to live a peaceful life away from him but fate has some other plans.

Indian Movies.name: Anjali
Indian Movies.description: After a few years, Chitra learns that her child, who was believed to be dead, is alive but is suffering from a mental illness. However, her family faces many challenges while looking after her child.

Indian Movies.name: Kilukkam
Indian Movies.description: A tourist guide in Ooty shelters a mentally unstable woman in return for the reward offered by her relatives. Later, he comes to know that she is in danger from her relatives.

Indian Movies.name: Saudagar
Indian Movies.description: Two clan chiefs who have maintained a blood feud for decades have to contend with the romance between their respective grandchildren.

Indian Movies.name: The Stranger
Indian Movies.description: A well-off family is paid an unexpected, and rather unwanted, visit by a man claiming to be the woman's long-lost uncle. The initial suspicion with which they greet the man slowly dissolves as he regales them with stories of his travels.

Indian Movies.name: Godfather
Indian Movies.description: Since Anjooran hates women, his sons remain unmarried. However, everything changes when his youngest son, Ramabhadran, falls in love with Malu, whose grandmother is their family's biggest enemy.

Indian Movies.name: Tum Mere Ho
Indian Movies.description: Shiva is blessed with magical powers of charming snakes. He falls head-over-heels in love with Paro.

Indian Movies.name: Sanam Bewafa
Indian Movies.description: Salman falls in love with Ruksar but their fathers, despite being neighbours, are sworn enemies. The couple end up marrying but they are shocked when they finally discover the reason why their fathers allow the marriage to take place.

Indian Movies.name: Love
Indian Movies.description: Prithvi and Maggie fall in love and decide to get married, but Maggie's mother objects looking at Prithvi's past.

Indian Movies.name: Days
Indian Movies.description: A young, clairvoyant woman has a vision of a murder and sets out to uncover the truth before the killer finds her.

Indian Movies.name: Guna
Indian Movies.description: A neurodivergent individual escapes the family he despises and the asylum he is kept in by creating fantasies.

Indian Movies.name: Baaghi: A Rebel for Love
Indian Movies.description: A saga of love as a man turns rebellious and goes against his family and society to protect his love, a prostitute from evil.

Indian Movies.name: Ek Doctor Ki Maut
Indian Movies.description: A medical breakthrough against leprosy catapults an unknown doctor to fame, igniting a firestorm of institutional betrayal. Powerful rivals manipulate the system to silence him and steal credit for his life's work.

Indian Movies.name: Swarg
Indian Movies.description: Krishna is very loyal to his master and treats him like God. Unfortunately, he gets thrown out of the house and the master becomes a pauper. But loyal Krishna returns to change things for the master.

Indian Movies.name: Jagadeka Veerudu Athiloka Sundari
Indian Movies.description: A man finds a ring that gives the bearer great power but the goddess to whom the ring belongs wants it back.

Indian Movies.name: Amaram
Indian Movies.description: An uneducated fisherman wants his daughter to be educated and become a doctor but his dreams get shattered when she falls in love with her childhood friend.

Indian Movies.name: Bharatham
Indian Movies.description: The tale of two classical musician brothers: while the elder squanders his life and talent away, the younger one fulfills their joint responsibilities towards their family.

Indian Movies.name: Saugandh
Indian Movies.description: A woman whose entire family was murdered by a cruel landowner, vows that she will get her son and his daughter married someday.

Indian Movies.name: Patthar Ke Phool
Indian Movies.description: A young police officer and the daughter of a gangster fall in love at first sight.

Indian Movies.name: His Highness Abdullah
Indian Movies.description: A qawwali singer passes as a Brahmin in order to infiltrate a palace and kill the king.

Indian Movies.name: Mathilukal
Indian Movies.description: Its a story of Basheer, an author who experiences his prison life. In it he finds friendship, loneliness, fear and finally love, but that remains questionable.

Indian Movies.name: Kshana Kshanam
Indian Movies.description: A high-profile bank robbery in the city wreaks havoc in the life of an unsuspecting regular young woman when she's caught in the line of fire between the villains and the police.

Indian Movies.name: First Rank
Indian Movies.description: The DGP of Police discovers a terrorist plot hatched by a sacked cricketer to blow up the stadium where an important cricket match is in progress.

Indian Movies.name: No: 20 Madras Mail
Indian Movies.description: Enroute Madras via train, when three friends get falsely accused of a mysterious homicide, they escape and desperately search for the real killer.

Indian Movies.name: Akkare Akkare Akkare
Indian Movies.description: Ramdas and Vijayan sent on a mission to the US to retrieve a priceless gold crown stolen from India. With pseudonym and a piece of torn shirt as clues, the comic duo end up with success.

Indian Movies.name: Deewana Mujh Sa Nahin
Indian Movies.description: An obsessive photographer (Aamir Khan) believes an engaged woman (Madhuri Dixit) is in love with him.

Indian Movies.name: Goopy Bagha Phire Elo
Indian Movies.description: The last and final sequal of Goopi-Bagha series as they invited at a palace of a king and their various attitudes as they are trapped by a astrologer cum imposter.

Indian Movies.name: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama
Indian Movies.description: An anime adaptation of the Hindu epic the Ramayana, where Lord Ram combats the wicked king Ravana.

Indian Movies.name: Darr
Indian Movies.description: Rahul is obsessed with Kiran and stalks her constantly. However, Rahul goes berserk when she gets engaged to Sunil, a navy officer, and he decides to forcefully claim Kiran for himself.

Indian Movies.name: Manichitrathazhu
Indian Movies.description: When a forbidden room in an old bungalow is unbolted, the spirit of a vengeful dancer is unleashed.

Indian Movies.name: Baazigar
Indian Movies.description: A young man with a vendetta against a business tycoon seduces the man's younger daughter, but she begins to suspect her new lover's connection with her elder sister and his ulterior motive.

Indian Movies.name: Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar
Indian Movies.description: A rich brat and a poor chap try to woo a girl, with their rivalry culminating in the most prestigious college event - the marathon cycle race.

Indian Movies.name: Roja
Indian Movies.description: A woman from a village in Tamil Nadu marries a sophisticated city dweller and moves with him to Kashmir, where all is rosy - until he gets kidnapped by militants.

Indian Movies.name: Yoddha
Indian Movies.description: Fate brings a young man from rural Kerala to be the protector of a young Lama in Nepal, who is being chased by a dangerous cult.

Indian Movies.name: Thevar Magan
Indian Movies.description: The urbane son of a village chieftain struggles between his personal aspirations and those of his family.

Indian Movies.name: Damini
Indian Movies.description: After witnessing a rape in her own household, Damini fights for justice for the deceased victim. However, she faces a bunch of challenges until she meets a disgraced lawyer who decides to fight the case and bring the culprits to justice.

Indian Movies.name: Chamatkar
Indian Movies.description: When Sunder loses everything, he seeks refuge in a graveyard, where he befriends a ghost.

Indian Movies.name: Deewana
Indian Movies.description: A singer (Rishi Kapoor) marries his biggest fan, but his uncle (Amrish Puri) plans to kill him in order to gain his money.

Indian Movies.name: Vishwatma
Indian Movies.description: A cop and a criminal, both on their respective missions of duty and revenge, go from India to Kenya in order to extradite a reclusive crime lord to India.

Indian Movies.name: Khalnayak
Indian Movies.description: A prison guard goes undercover as a dancer to try and recapture an escaped criminal and restore her police inspector boyfriend's reputation.

Indian Movies.name: Khiladi
Indian Movies.description: Two friends wage bets for money and fun. There comes a time where they race to win the biggest bet, for they know that their lives depend on it.

Indian Movies.name: Devasuram
Indian Movies.description: Neelakandan squanders away the inheritance left by his father. However, his life turns upside down when his mother reveals a terrible secret on her deathbed that changes the course of his life.

Indian Movies.name: Raat
Indian Movies.description: When the Sharmas move into their new house in the city, they start experiencing strange incidents. The family seeks the help of a priest when their daughter, Mini, gets possessed.

Indian Movies.name: Gumrah
Indian Movies.description: Roshni Chadha, a singer in Bombay, is imprisoned in Hong Kong facing death sentence. Her troubled past involving unknown father's abandonment drives her journey to unravel truth and escape this predicament.

Indian Movies.name: Aankhen
Indian Movies.description: Two good-for-nothing brothers are embroiled in a conspiracy involving a political assassination and try their best to save the country.

Indian Movies.name: Beta
Indian Movies.description: Raju, the only heir of a millionaire, is brainwashed by his stepmother for her greed of his entire property.

Indian Movies.name: Zapatlela
Indian Movies.description: A man is presumed to have been haunted when a doll possessed by the spirit of a gangster comes along in his life.

Indian Movies.name: Tirangaa
Indian Movies.description: Brigadier Suryadev Singh and Police Inspector Shivajirao Waghle are appointed to bring down Pralayanth, a terrorist who murdered officer Rudrapratap Chauhan and plans to invade India.

Indian Movies.name: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
Indian Movies.description: Rahul Malhotra (Aamir Khan) is the manager of the heavily-in-debt family business. He is also the guardian of his dead sister's mischievous kids. Rahul hires Vaijayanti (Juhi Chawla) as governess. Vaijayanti is a runaway who does not want to marry the man her orthodox family has chosen for her. Predictably, Rahul and Vaijayanti fall in love. Maya (Navneet Nishan), a rich girl in love with Rahul tries to ruin his family and his business.

Indian Movies.name: Naalaiya Theerpu
Indian Movies.description: Srividya is molested by her husband Radharavi. Radharavi has affairs with many other women. Srividya has a son, whom she raises on her own. However, things change when her son grows up.

Indian Movies.name: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
Indian Movies.description: Raju comes to Bombay chasing his dreams, but keeps losing out on opportunities. His love, Renu helps him find a job. Success goes to his head until one day a tragic accident destroys his reputation.

Indian Movies.name: Thiruda Thiruda
Indian Movies.description: An Inspector is assigned to track down a large sum of stolen money. His investigations lead him to a couple of small time crooks, a village belle, a murder, an absconding suspect, and an international drug dealer.

Indian Movies.name: Courage
Indian Movies.description: An engaging action-sport film, where a man avenges his sister's humiliation by participating in a deadly kung-fu tournament.

Indian Movies.name: Gentleman
Indian Movies.description: Due to a past tragedy , a small business owner by day becomes modern day Robin Hood by night takes from the rich to provide education for the poor.

Indian Movies.name: Annamalai
Indian Movies.description: A class-divided friendship goes through highs and lows through several decades.

Indian Movies.name: Khuda Gawah
Indian Movies.description: Baadshah Khan falls in love with Benazir, a member of a rival clan who has defeated him in a game of buzkashi.

Indian Movies.name: King Uncle
Indian Movies.description: When a runaway orphan ends up at the house of a cruel millionaire, she decides to alter his perception of the world.

Indian Movies.name: Shola Aur Shabnam
Indian Movies.description: The spoiled and arrogant brother, Bali, of notorious gangster, Kali Baba, enlists in the National Cadet Corps, and wants to have his way with his fellow-students and trainer, Inder Mohan Lahti, with comical results. When he meets Divya Thapa for the first time, he is smitten by her, and wants to marry her by hook or by crook. But Divya is in love with Karan, and both plan to marry each other. Circumstances act against them, and they flee together, with Kali Baba's men, and Divya's Police Commissioner dad, Yashpal Thapa, in hot pursuit, to an unknown destination, surrounded by a web of lies, deception, and no known resource to assist them.

Indian Movies.name: The Seventh Horse of the Sun
Indian Movies.description: On a lazy afternoon, a man shares his memories of a storyteller friend who once narrated a convoluted love story with intertwined plots. As these plots unravel, reality mixes with fiction.

Indian Movies.name: Ek Ladka Ek Ladki
Indian Movies.description: An arrogant heiress becomes amnesiac after her greedy uncle attempts to kill her. A hard-working farmer, who bears a grudge against her, impersonates her husband and brings her to his home as revenge.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Aashna Hai (...The Heart Knows)
Indian Movies.description: Laila, brought up in a brothel, is a cabaret dancer in Digvijay Singh's five star hotel. One day, her dying mother informs her that she is adopted. Laila is aided by Karan in her search for the mother.

Indian Movies.name: Sadayam
Indian Movies.description: Sadayam follows the final days of a condemned prisoner, for murdering two little girls.

Indian Movies.name: Waqt Hamara Hai
Indian Movies.description: Two prankster best friends gets unwittingly involved in a terrorist plot and tries their best to save the country.

Indian Movies.name: Sendhoorapandi
Indian Movies.description: Vijay falls in love with Meena. But Meena's brother opposes their marriage due to rivalry between both the families. Sendoorapandi returns from jail and tries to help his brother to win his love.

Indian Movies.name: Parampara
Indian Movies.description: The grandchildren of two sworn enemies want to put the bitterness between the families behind them, but will the bloodthirsty traditions compel them to do otherwise?

Indian Movies.name: Gardish
Indian Movies.description: A soon-to-be police officer takes a path of crime after his father gets attacked by hoodlums.

Indian Movies.name: Sainik
Indian Movies.description: Lieutenant Suraj Dutt successfully fails an arms dealing on the border.He soon comes on leave and goes to meet his sister Mini where he comes across Alka.Alka and Sooraj soon fall in love and get married life is going very cheerful to everyone in between Minnie's marriage gets arranged to Pankaj son of Gajraj Chaudhary.Suraj notices that Pankaj is the same person who was dealing with arms on the border and gets him and Gajraj arrested.Minnie is left broken heart but Vijay comes froward to accept her and their a marriage is arranged but before that Suraj has to leave for a mission.Few days later his father Yashpal Dutt ,Alka and Minnie get the news of Suraj's death from different people but all decide to keep it as a secret from everyone as his sudden death might shatter the family.

Indian Movies.name: Suryavanshi
Indian Movies.description: An archaeologist unearths an underground palace at Sangramgarh. The locals are afraid of what will happen if they start digging and would like to leave the past alone. It turns out their fears we confounded.

Indian Movies.name: Vatsalyam
Indian Movies.description: Raghavan, a farmer, devotes his life to ensure that his brother Vijayakumaran gets educated. But with time and under the influence of his rich wife, Vijayakumaran ends up destroying all relationships.

Indian Movies.name: Shhh!
Indian Movies.description: Follows Kashinath as he leads a film crew to Nagraj Rao's haunted house. Rao's daughter pranks the staff, while Kumar falls for her.

Indian Movies.name: Jaagruti
Indian Movies.description: Jugnu is a playful boy whose spending time with his friends doing nothing.He is in love with Shalu but their relationship is not approved by her father Sunderlal.Vishal,Jugnu's elder brother is a an honest custom officer who comes in bad books of corrupt minister Sevalal due to his honesty.Sunderlal is forced to marry Shalu to Mahesh.Jugnu and his friend manage to flee Shalu from Mahesh clutches where one of his friend Salim his shot who dies in hospital due to tainted glucose.Vishal finds Sevalal behind all this and goes to capture him where he is killed in front of Jugnu.Jugnu is also termed dead but gets saved by a tribal who trains him into a tough guy.When he returns home he plans his revenge against Sevalal and his man.

Indian Movies.name: Bol Radha Bol
Indian Movies.description: A man returning from a trip discovers that an impostor has taken over his life.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Tera Aashiq
Indian Movies.description: Vijay falls in love with Soniya in the dancing school where both are dance instructors. Thakur who is a confirmed bachelor is also drawn towards Savitri Devi; who is being impersonated by Soniya.

Indian Movies.name: Mannan
Indian Movies.description: Circumstances force the union leader of a factory to marry his own boss, a rich and arrogant lady who has ulterior motives. Krishnan is forced into a loveless marriage when he is really in love with Meena.

Indian Movies.name: Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja
Indian Movies.description: Custom Officer Verma red-handily catches Jagmohan Lal, alias Jugran, smuggling priceless diamonds through India's airport. Jugran kills Verma before Verma can arrest Jugran; Jugran goes on to murder his twin brother Manmohan Lal and Dr. Ashok Soni. Verma's son Ramesh and Ashok's daughter Seema are sent to an orphanage, where they befriend each other. They are separated when Seema is adopted by a kind-hearted couple while Ramesh runs away and is adopted by expert robber Girdharilal, who teaches him every robber's tricks. Years later Ramesh is an expert safe-breaker--much better at it than Girdharilal. Ramesh changes his name to Romeo, reunites with Seema, and together they work for Jugran, who now has two identities: well-respected Manmohan Lal, known to everyone; and gangster Jugran, known only to his men. Seema and Romeo must wake up, stop working for their dads' killer, and take swift action on him.

Indian Movies.name: Jamba Lakidi Pamba
Indian Movies.description: A woman living in Visakhapatnam hates male domination in society and reverses the characteristics of men and women with the help of a magical herb.

Indian Movies.name: Dhruvam
Indian Movies.description: Narasimha Mannadiar is a village lord famous for his thirst for justice and fearlessness. Hyder Marakkar, a notorious criminal awaiting capital punishment has means to prevent it. Mannadiar must battle to ensure that justice is prevailed.

Indian Movies.name: Chenkol
Indian Movies.description: The sequel to Kireedam (1989), Chenkol continues the story of Sethumadavan who hopes to regain his lost life after 8 years in prison.

Indian Movies.name: Midhunam
Indian Movies.description: An enterprising entrepreneur wants to start a biscuit factory but the bureaucratic corruption and the problems in his dysfunctional family constantly pose hurdles in his plans.

Indian Movies.name: Padma Nadir Majhi
Indian Movies.description: Hossain, a Bengali Muslim wants to establish a little Utopia on an island in the Padma delta. He doesn't care if the people who populate it are Hindu or Muslim.

Indian Movies.name: Daulat Ki Jung
Indian Movies.description: Two young lovers elope to get married and get caught between two gangs searching for buried treasure.

Indian Movies.name: Pappayude Swantham Appoos
Indian Movies.description: The movie explores the relationship between a father who is depressed after the death of his wife and his neglected son.

Indian Movies.name: Vietnam Colony
Indian Movies.description: Two men tries to persuade a bunch of colony residents to relocate to another location for the sake of a corporate project, while the residents including a number of goons, comes in their way.

Indian Movies.name: Ram Ke Naam
Indian Movies.description: Since gaining independence in 1947, India has been a secular state. But now, as religious fundamentalism grips much of India's population, the greatest danger to the nation's extremely strained social fabric may come not from Sikh or Muslim separatists, but from Hindu fundamentalists who are appealing to the 83% Hindu majority to redefine India as a Hindu nation.

Indian Movies.name: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
Indian Movies.description: When Raj meets Simran in Europe, it isn't love at first sight but when Simran moves to India for an arranged marriage, love makes its presence felt.

Indian Movies.name: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
Indian Movies.description: Prem and Nisha meet and fall in love at the wedding of their elder siblings, but their plans to be together are put in jeopardy when Nisha's sister dies, leaving behind a baby.

Indian Movies.name: : A Love Story
Indian Movies.description: A young Indian couple, both from wealthy backgrounds, find themselves caught up in the 1940's Indian revolutionary movement against their families whom are under the thumb a sadistic British general.

Indian Movies.name: Andaz Apna Apna
Indian Movies.description: Two slackers competing for the affections of an heiress inadvertently become her protectors from an evil criminal.

Indian Movies.name: Bombay
Indian Movies.description: A Hindu man and a Muslim woman fall in love in a small village and move to Mumbai, where they have two children. However, growing religious tensions and erupting riots threaten to tear the family apart.

Indian Movies.name: Anjaam
Indian Movies.description: Vijay falls in love Shivani and proposes her only to be rejected every time. However his love turns into an obsession and turns her life into a hell.

Indian Movies.name: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
Indian Movies.description: A dreamer falls for a girl who is in love with someone else and tries to create a rift between her and the man she loves.

Indian Movies.name: Pavithram
Indian Movies.description: A young man's relationship with his career, fiancee and brother is brought under stress by the birth of an unexpected sister.

Indian Movies.name: Bandit Queen
Indian Movies.description: The story of bandit queen Phoolan Devi, who was sent to prison in 1983 and released in 1994.

Indian Movies.name: Karan Arjun
Indian Movies.description: Karan and Arjun reincarnate in the different parts of the country. But the faith of their previous mother brings them together in order to avenge their death.

Indian Movies.name: Ram Jaane
Indian Movies.description: A social worker tries diligently to steer a group of wayward street urchins on the right path. But his childhood friend, now a fearless gangster, plans to bring the children into his fold.

Indian Movies.name: Mohra
Indian Movies.description: A journalist comes to the aid of a murderer with a life sentence when she makes an appeal in court and although he is given his freedom, they soon discover that there is a grim reason behind his release.

Indian Movies.name: Baasha
Indian Movies.description: An auto driver, Manikam, desperately tries to hide his dark underworld side to keep his promise to his father.

Indian Movies.name: Dilwale
Indian Movies.description: A police officer finds out the truth about a mental patient and helps him bring the perpetrators to justice.

Indian Movies.name: Yeh Dillagi
Indian Movies.description: A poor girl is rebuked by a rich boy. She leaves town to return successful and rich. He falls for her but his brother is already in love with the girl.

Indian Movies.name: Kuruthipunal
Indian Movies.description: Suave and scintillating, this fast-paced action thriller follows the adventures and investigations of a group of honest police officers, who go undercover to bring down a terror network.

Indian Movies.name: Rangeela
Indian Movies.description: A middle-class young woman who dreams of Bollywood fame is caught in a love triangle between her childhood friend and a famous actor.

Indian Movies.name: Mahanadi
Indian Movies.description: An innocent man is framed in a financial scam and imprisoned. After his release, he learns that his daughter was sold into prostitution and he struggles to free her.

Indian Movies.name: Sathi Leelavathi
Indian Movies.description: Arun (Ramesh Arvind), bored of his wife's (Leelavathi) looks and weighty appearance, meets Priya and develops an affair with her. But his wife has other plans.

Indian Movies.name: Om
Indian Movies.description: Satya, the son of a pious priest, turns into a rowdy and enters the underworld for the sake of love.

Indian Movies.name: Raja Babu
Indian Movies.description: A man tries to become a better son after his intended bride rejects him and he learns he was adopted from a poor family.

Indian Movies.name: Akele Hum Akele Tum
Indian Movies.description: An estranged couple battle for the custody of their only son.

Indian Movies.name: Krantiveer
Indian Movies.description: Disowned by his parents at a young age, a man ends up in a small village controlled by underworld dons and powerful politicians. Lazy, alcoholic, and unemployed, he gets influenced by a journalist with a positive mission.

Indian Movies.name: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
Indian Movies.description: A Bombay police officer seeks revenge when his brother is killed by a powerful underworld figure. Things get complicated when a matinee movie idol begins to shadow the policeman so he can research a movie role.

Indian Movies.name: Trimurti
Indian Movies.description: After being framed, a policewoman languishing in prison hopes that her three sons will deliver justice and restore her honor.

Indian Movies.name: Baazi
Indian Movies.description: A tough and honest police officer wages a one-man war against terrorists and a corrupt politician who have planned to assassinate the chief minister of the state.

Indian Movies.name: Kaadhalan
Indian Movies.description: Prabhu, a college student, falls in love with Shruthi, a governor's daughter. On knowing about their love affair, her father imprisons Prabhu and forbids him to meet Shruthi.

Indian Movies.name: Raja
Indian Movies.description: Raja and Madhu fall in love and decide to get married. However, her brothers are against the alliance and devise a plan to drive the two apart.

Indian Movies.name: Spadikam
Indian Movies.description: A small-town criminal constantly clashes with his strict school headmaster father at the expense of their family lives.

Indian Movies.name: Coolie No. 1
Indian Movies.description: In order to avenge his insult against wealthy Hoshiarchand Choudhary; Pandit Shaadiram Gharjodhe asks Raju; a coolie by profession to masquerade as a wealthy business tycoon so that he can get marry to Choudhary's daughter Malti.

Indian Movies.name: Rajavin Parvaiyile
Indian Movies.description: Gowri, daughter of a rich man, loves Raja. But, he keeps avoiding her. He stopped believing in love after his dear friend met with a tragic end due to a failed affair. Will Raja ever change his mind?

Indian Movies.name: Barsaat
Indian Movies.description: A naive young man and a rich city girl fall in love. Her stepfather, however, doesn't approve of the match and will stop at nothing to split the pair.

Indian Movies.name: Suhaag
Indian Movies.description: Collegian Ajay Sharma was born on 2 April 1968 and lives in Bombay with his widowed mom Asha. He is friendly with fellow-collegian Raj Sinha, from a wealthy family. Ajay often gets beaten up by goons and Raj gets beaten up by his girlfriend Madhu. After they graduate from college, Raj's maternal uncle asks Ajay to bring his birth certificate so he can make his passport and find work for him in a department store in Canada. Ajay goes home to look for his birth certificate, but is unable to locate it. His mother makes a show of helping him, but instead tears a document and throws it away. Ajay puts the document together and finds out that his real name is Ajay Malhotra and that his father, Dr. Ravi Malhotra, is still alive, serving a life sentence in prison for killing a patient and stealing the organs from the body. Ajay questions his mother and finds out that his dad was framed by the hospital owner, Rai Bahadur. He and Asha meet Ravi in prison and swear to avenge his humiliation. He and Raj then set out to collect evidence, unaware that Raj's dad, Dr. Sinha, was himself involved in Ravi's false conviction and will not hesitate in joining forces with Rai Bahadur to eliminate all possible evidence, and if necessary kill both Ajay and Asha.

Indian Movies.name: Aatish: Feel the Fire
Indian Movies.description: Baba turns to crime to support his brother, Avinash. However, Baba keeps him distant from the underworld nexus, but problems escalate when Avinash becomes a cop and is assigned to arrest his own brother.

Indian Movies.name: Zamaana Deewana
Indian Movies.description: A police commissioner enlists the aid of an eccentric inspector to end a gang war between bitter enemies.

Indian Movies.name: Muthu
Indian Movies.description: The movie is about a loyal servant, Muthu (Rajni), working for Zamindar Malayasimman (Sarath Babu) and the cunning plans by the uncle of Malasimman to capture the whole wealth which uncovers some mystery about Muthu.

Indian Movies.name: Oh Darling Yeh Hai India
Indian Movies.description: Miss India and an aspiring actor spend a night together roaming the streets of Mumbai and unwittingly clash paths with a megalomaniacal gangster planning to take over India.

Indian Movies.name: Vidheyan
Indian Movies.description: Thommy is a loyal servant of Bhaskar Patel. But Patel is a ruthless tyrant. Thommy struggles between his moral sense and his professional sense. He is finally redeemed without compromising his duty as Patel's servant.

Indian Movies.name: Sabse Bada Khiladi
Indian Movies.description: A police officer impersonates his murdered twin brother in order to bring his killers to justice.

Indian Movies.name: Laadla
Indian Movies.description: The headstrong owner of a factory, Sheetal, marries Raju, the union leader of the factory, to quell his spirit and teach him a lesson. In the process, she ends up learning a few lessons herself.

Indian Movies.name: Aasai
Indian Movies.description: A young woman's brother-in-law is infatuated with her and pulls out all the stops to destroy her love affair with another young man.

Indian Movies.name: Veergati
Indian Movies.description: A gangster and his flunkies abduct and kill a man's daughter. Soon, the man's adopted son sets out to avenge her death.

Indian Movies.name: Rasigan
Indian Movies.description: Vijay and Anitha secretly love each other but are unable to confess their love for each other. Her father realises this and tries to separate the two. However, fate has other plans in store.

Indian Movies.name: Gopi Kishan
Indian Movies.description: A struggling police officer's life changes when he mysteriously receives promotions and success at work. After his son's kidnapping, he discovers his doppelganger may be behind everything.

Indian Movies.name: Thenmavin Kombath
Indian Movies.description: Srikrishnan and his best friend, Manickam falls in love with the same girl, a village performer, Srikrishnan turns out more intent on having her for himself.

Indian Movies.name: Guddu
Indian Movies.description: When Guddu and Salina end up in a car accident, Salina loses her sight. Guddu soon finds out that he has a brain tumour, and decides to donate his eyes to Salina.

Indian Movies.name: Elaan
Indian Movies.description: When ACP Ramakant's elder son is killed, his attempts to find justice the legal way meet little success. His younger son, Vishal, decides to take the law into his own hands.

Indian Movies.name: Nammavar
Indian Movies.description: A new professor cleans up a crime-ridden college

Indian Movies.name: Mannar Mathai Speaking
Indian Movies.description: The hilarious trio from 'Ramji Rao Speaking' faces fresh trouble when the heroine of their drama group quits.

Indian Movies.name: Minnaram
Indian Movies.description: Bobby leads a carefree life until his former lover arrives at his place with a baby girl claiming she is his daughter. However, Bobby must find the truth behind her claims.

Indian Movies.name: Bhairava Dweepam
Indian Movies.description: A royal prince is raised by adoptive parents and experiences romance and adventure on his way to his destiny.

Indian Movies.name: The King
Indian Movies.description: On learning that an elected representative in the parliament is corrupted and involved in many crimes, Joseph Alex, an IAS officer, decides to expose his misdeeds in front of the public.

Indian Movies.name: Ponthan Mada
Indian Movies.description: Set in 1940s, the low-caste Ponthan Mada bonds with his colonial landlord Sheema Thampuran, who was expelled to British India from England during his youth for supporting the Irish Republican Army.

Indian Movies.name: Dil To Pagal Hai
Indian Movies.description: A grand musical about three passionate and dreamy characters: Rahul, Pooja and Nisha. Will their dreams come true? Will they find their true love?

Indian Movies.name: Ishq
Indian Movies.description: Two rich friends, hating the poor, were challenged by their children's love lives. Thus starts the war between love and money.

Indian Movies.name: Yes Boss
Indian Movies.description: Rahul Joshi wants to be a successful businessman so he works hard for his boss Siddharth. One day Rahul meets Seema, an up and coming model, and he feels like he's finally met his match. Will Seema fall for Rahul?

Indian Movies.name: Indian
Indian Movies.description: A veteran freedom fighter enraged with the rising crime and corruption in the society murders all the wrong doers one by one using an ancient martial arts technique.

Indian Movies.name: Iruvar
Indian Movies.description: A struggling actor and a writer-politician become friends as young men and rise to great heights in cinema and politics respectively. But when both become contenders for the top political post in the state, a rift develops between them.

Indian Movies.name: Koyla
Indian Movies.description: A village girl agrees to a marriage to a king she has never met after he sends her a photograph of himself. But the man in the photograph is not the king but his most loyal slave, the handsome but mute Shankar.

Indian Movies.name: Yeshwant
Indian Movies.description: A principled cop maintains his integrity despite pressure. He supports his wife's ambition to become a top government officer, tutoring her and sharing household duties. Through dedication, she achieves her goal.

Indian Movies.name: Border
Indian Movies.description: In 1971, along the border region of Longewala, a small battalion of Indian soldiers goes up against a large Pakistani strike force.

Indian Movies.name: Arunachalam
Indian Movies.description: The movie revolves around Arunachalam (Rajini), who is the son of the VIP of a village who finds out about his past but destiny has its own play.

Indian Movies.name: Ghatak
Indian Movies.description: Katya, a ruthless mobster, controls a Mumbai town through violence. Kashi, a newcomer, confronts Katya after witnessing his brutality, but faces severe backlash.

Indian Movies.name: Raja Hindustani
Indian Movies.description: Raja, a taxi driver, falls in love with Aarti, a rich girl, and marries her against her parents' wishes. Later, her parents try to create differences amongst the couple.

Indian Movies.name: Pardes
Indian Movies.description: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his westernised son. He gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter, and brings her to USA. But she shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

Indian Movies.name: Chaahat
Indian Movies.description: Roop and his father come to the city for medical treatment and Reshma falls in love with Roop. Roop loves Pooja, but when Reshma threatens to kill herself, Roop agrees to marry her.

Indian Movies.name: Maachis
Indian Movies.description: A realistic, hard-hitting portrayal of terrorism and youth in the Punjab after the 1984 riots.

Indian Movies.name: Gupt: The Hidden Truth
Indian Movies.description: Governor Jaisingh Sinha is murdered and the needle of suspicion points towards his estranged son, Sahil Sinha who must prove his innocence.

Indian Movies.name: Guru
Indian Movies.description: Situations turn a man who believes in secularism into an extremist. He plots to bomb a monastery where the survivors of a riot take refuge.

Indian Movies.name: English Babu Desi Mem
Indian Movies.description: After his brother dies, wealthy Vikram reluctantly goes back to India and forms a surprise bond with his orphaned nephew and the showgirl raising him.

Indian Movies.name: Chachi 420
Indian Movies.description: Desperation to be with his only child forces a divorced man to take the guise of the child's nanny. Situations get really messy when the child's grandfather (the man's ex-father-in-law) falls in love with his disguised ex-son-in-law.

Indian Movies.name: Poove Unakkaga
Indian Movies.description: When a man realizes that the Hindu woman he loves is in love with a Christian man, he decides to sacrifice his love and unite their families so as to make the love story a success.

Indian Movies.name: Diljale
Indian Movies.description: A patriotic young man turns into a terrorist to avenge his father's humiliation.

Indian Movies.name: Judwaa
Indian Movies.description: Twin brothers who are separated soon after birth, meet in adulthood and join forces to defeat their common enemy, a notorious criminal.

Indian Movies.name: Jeet
Indian Movies.description: A hitman working for a crime boss falls for a woman but she is married off to her childhood friend. Later, when the woman's and her husband's life comes under threat from the crime boss, the hitman becomes their protector.

Indian Movies.name: Hero No. 1
Indian Movies.description: Timid Rajesh Malhotra escapes his tyrant father and meets Meena in a foreign land. The two lovers decide to marry, but when Meena's parents object, Rajesh decides to win them over in the quirkiest way.

Indian Movies.name: Virasat
Indian Movies.description: Shakti returns to India with girlfriend Anita, facing family disapproval. His father's death and natural disasters force him to stay and manage the estate, where local belle Gehna awaits him. Anita must fight for his love.

Indian Movies.name: Kadhalukku Mariyadhai
Indian Movies.description: Jeeva loves Mini but her three brothers end up beating him every time he meets her. The couple decides to elope against their parents' wishes.

Indian Movies.name: Khamoshi the Musical
Indian Movies.description: The daughter of deaf-mute parents seeks their understanding when she discovers a love for music.

Indian Movies.name: Judaai
Indian Movies.description: In order to attain wealth and a luxurious life, a greedy wife sells her husband to a rich woman. However she realizes that with a luxurious life, she has to pay a heavy price for this decision.

Indian Movies.name: Nerukku Ner
Indian Movies.description: Shanti decides to divorce her husband, Raghu, when he confesses about his affair with another woman. This decision sparks a fight between Vijay, Raghu's brother, and Surya, Shanti's brother.

Indian Movies.name: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
Indian Movies.description: When an army man's brother goes missing in U.S., he goes looking for him and ingratiates himself with a lady gangster who is involved in illegal wrestling.

Indian Movies.name: Kaalapani
Indian Movies.description: Govardhan, a doctor by profession, is wrongly accused of bombing a train and is jailed by the British in Cellular Jail, also known as Kala Pani, in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. He witnesses the sufferings of hundreds of Indian prisoners there.

Indian Movies.name: Deewana Mastana
Indian Movies.description: Chaos ensues when a small time crook and a mental patient tries to win heart of a beautiful woman with comical outcomes.

Indian Movies.name: Mr. & Mrs. Khiladi
Indian Movies.description: A slacker (Akshay Kumar) must impress a wealthy man to marry her daughter (Juhi Chawla).

Indian Movies.name: Ziddi
Indian Movies.description: It is the story of a hot-tempered and stubborn man Deva, who is feared because of his ruthless ways and severe punishment to the local hoodlums. Later, Deva avenges the death of his brother and sister.

Indian Movies.name: Sapoot
Indian Movies.description: When a gangster is killed by his rivals, his two sons vow revenge.

Indian Movies.name: Daud: Fun on the Run
Indian Movies.description: Nandu, a small-time thief, is assigned to smuggle an unknown packet for a petty amount. With the police pursuing him, Nandu has to elude them and deliver the packet on time.

Indian Movies.name: Saajan Chale Sasural
Indian Movies.description: A village-based singer attempts to find love and fame in the big city.

Indian Movies.name: Ghulam-E-Musthafa
Indian Movies.description: A gangster shuns the path of crime after his lover is killed by his rivals but soon he is dragged by his boss once again in the criminal world to do one last job.

Indian Movies.name: Avvai Shanmugi
Indian Movies.description: A man disguises himself as a nanny to be with his daughter after his divorce.

Indian Movies.name: Love Today
Indian Movies.description: Ganesh is obsessively in love with Sandhya, but she is not interested in him. His relentless pursuit leads to a lot of problems. However, everything changes the day he loses his father in an accident.

Indian Movies.name: Auzaar
Indian Movies.description: Two college friends find themselves on the opposite side of the law when they reunite.

Indian Movies.name: Army
Indian Movies.description: Arjun, a newlywed Army man, is brutally killed by a gangster, Nagraj. His young widow, determined to avenge her husband's death, raises an army of dedicated young men to kill the gangster.

Indian Movies.name: Papi Gudia
Indian Movies.description: A child murderer and black magic practitioner transfers his soul to a doll before death and wreaks havoc in the lives of the doll's new owners: a boy and his elder sister.

Indian Movies.name: Annamayya
Indian Movies.description: A cinematic version of the life of famous Indian saint-poet, Annamayya.

Indian Movies.name: Once More
Indian Movies.description: Vijay, a guy with a careless attitude, gets Selvam, a senior home inmate, to act as his dad for an important business deal. Gradually, both help each other through their own experiences and problems.

Indian Movies.name: Aur Pyaar Ho Gaya
Indian Movies.description: Grandpa and Grandma Kapoor live a wealthy life-style with their only widower son, Kailashnath and his daughter Ashi who is of marriage-able age. Kailashnath arranges his daughter's marriage with his friend, the equally wealthy Mr. Malhotra's son, Rohit. Ashi approve of this match but would like to evaluate Rohit's personality before marrying him; she finds out that Rohit is in Switzerland and travels there to meet with him. At the airport she does meet with a male and takes him for Rohit and thus both started to get acquainted with each other only to find out that he is not the one she is looking for. Her efforts to locate Rohit are frustrated since every male she thinks is Rohit turns out to be someone else. Her first acquittance whose name turn out to be Bobby Oberoi continues to pursue her until both fall in love. Back in India; Bobby is introduce to the Kapoor family who approve of the couple's marriage. But calamity destructs them when some personal problems crop up between Ashi's dad, Kailashnath and Bobby's bank manager mother, Gayetri forcing Kailashnath to cancel the marriage which changes lives forever.

Indian Movies.name: Minsaara Kanavu
Indian Movies.description: Thomas loves Priya from their high school days but is afraid to confess. So he resorts to his friend Deva, to convince Priya. However, a tricky situation arises when Priya falls in love with Deva.

Indian Movies.name: Aflatoon
Indian Movies.description: Trouble ensues when Raja is framed for crimes that actually committed by his evil lookalike Rocky, and the former must prove his innocence and eliminate his nemesis.

Indian Movies.name: Yeh Majhdhaar
Indian Movies.description: Although Krishna and Radha are in love, their class differences prevent them from getting married; Radha eventually marries a man named Gopal, but leaves him soon after giving birth to her daughter without giving notice.

Indian Movies.name: Aaram Thamburan
Indian Movies.description: Jagannathan, a mafia don in Bombay moves to Kanimangalam village. He wins the love of the locals, but finds trouble with a feudal lord, Appan Thamburan, after he decided to resume a traditional festival banned by Appan.

Indian Movies.name: Kadhal Kottai
