Indian Movies.description: Kamali loses her bag in the railway station. Later, her bag is sent to her home, along with a letter from Surya, who found it. Kamali and Surya send letters to each other and soon fall in love.

Indian Movies.name: Vasantha Vaasal
Indian Movies.description: Vijay and Divya have different ambitions in life. While he aspires to become an actor, she hates acting career and wants to excel in academics. He also discovers that her uncle is forcing her to act.

Indian Movies.name: Tu Chor Main Sipahi
Indian Movies.description: A police officer and a master thief join forces in order to free a village from the clutches of an evil landowner.

Indian Movies.name: Chandralekha
Indian Movies.description: An unemployed man saves a rich woman and takes her to the hospital where her relatives mistake him as her husband. He plays along as he needs money to repay a loan.

Indian Movies.name: Hitler
Indian Movies.description: The story of a protective brother and his five sisters.

Indian Movies.name: Azhakiya Ravanan
Indian Movies.description: A millionaire (Mammootty) returns to his village without disclosing who he was in the village.

Indian Movies.name: Coimbatore Mappillai
Indian Movies.description: Balu comes to the city and stays with his friend. He falls in love with Sumithra, his landlord. But her evil cousin Mahesh, who has an eye on her, creates a rift between them.

Indian Movies.name: Satya
Indian Movies.description: An innocent man is embroiled in the underworld after being falsely charged, and he sets out to punish the perpetrators who made his life miserable.

Indian Movies.name: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
Indian Movies.description: During their college years, Anjali was in love with her best-friend Rahul, but he had eyes only for Tina. Years later, Rahul and the now-deceased Tina's eight-year-old daughter attempts to reunite her father and Anjali.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Se..
Indian Movies.description: A radio broadcaster's intense attraction to a mysterious woman opens the door to a tidal wave of powerful emotions and desires.

Indian Movies.name: Hum Saath-Saath Hain
Indian Movies.description: Ramkishen and Mamta have three sons Vivek , Prem and Vinod and a daughter Sangeeta. This family is part of a joint family whose close knit bond is challenged by a misunderstanding.

Indian Movies.name: Sangharsh
Indian Movies.description: A rookie CBI officer must enlist the help of an incarcerated criminal in order to catch a serial child killer, who has recently escaped police custody.

Indian Movies.name: Straight from the Heart
Indian Movies.description: Nandini has to choose between Sameer, the man who taught her to fall in love; and Vanraj, the man from whom she learnt how to abide and fulfill promises of love.

Indian Movies.name: Kaun?
Indian Movies.description: While alone in the house, a woman hears news of serial killer on the loose. And then a stranger rings the doorbell...

Indian Movies.name: Vaastav: The Reality
Indian Movies.description: Consequences force an innocent man to get involved in crime after making an error.

Indian Movies.name: Baadshah
Indian Movies.description: A small time detective is mistaken as a CBI agent and gets embroiled in a deadly mission to save the Chief Minister from an assassination attempt.

Indian Movies.name: Duplicate
Indian Movies.description: In order to evade the law, a ruthless don tries to kill his lookalike; a chef and tries to take his place.

Indian Movies.name: Sarfarosh
Indian Movies.description: After his brother is killed and father severely injured by terrorists, a young med student quits his studies to join the Indian Police Service to wipe out the terrorists.

Indian Movies.name: Padayappa
Indian Movies.description: The death of Padaiyappa's father destroys his family. But his luck changes, and he is able to lead a prosperous life, until his nemesis plots to ruin his happiness once more.

Indian Movies.name: Dushman
Indian Movies.description: A woman goes on a hunt to find her twin sister's rapist and murderer.

Indian Movies.name: Ghulam
Indian Movies.description: An amateur boxer runs errands for a local gangster but revolts against him after the gangster kills his friend and his conscience is awakened.

Indian Movies.name: Jaanwar
Indian Movies.description: A ruthless criminal mends his criminal ways after he meets an abandoned child and takes utmost care of him. However, the shadows of the past continues to haunt him.

Indian Movies.name: Sooryavansham
Indian Movies.description: Heera fails to live up to expectations of his father Thakur Bhanupratap Singh, a powerful and respected man of his community. Despite all odds Heera struggles to keep his father's pride.

Indian Movies.name: Taal
Indian Movies.description: Businessman Manav falls for aspiring singer Mansi, but their romance faces an uphill climb when Manav must depart and Mansi's suave manager moves in.

Indian Movies.name: Shool
Indian Movies.description: A tale of an honest cop set against the backdrop of the brutal, lawless system prevailing in the Indian state of Bihar, and the endless suffering he tolerates before all hell breaks loose.

Indian Movies.name: Gunda
Indian Movies.description: When a coolie's family is murdered by a group of gangsters and politicians, he swears revenge on them.

Indian Movies.name: Earth
Indian Movies.description: It's 1947 and the borderlines between India and Pakistan are being drawn. A young girl witnesses tragedy as her ayah (nanny) is caught between the love of two men and the rising tide of political and religious violence.

Indian Movies.name: Pyaar Kiya to Darna Kya
Indian Movies.description: When Vishal does not agree of Suraj and Muskaan's relationship, Suraj decides to win Vishal's heart for marrying Muskaan.

Indian Movies.name: Zakhm
Indian Movies.description: Amidst religious riots, a son deals with his mother's life-threatening injuries, and her last request.

Indian Movies.name: Upendra
Indian Movies.description: This is a psychological thriller movie about a man who calls himself as "Naanu" (Me). It explores the human needs and greeds in the form of a metaphorical comparison to the three female characters in the movie.

Indian Movies.name: Mudhalvan
Indian Movies.description: A man accepts a challenge to act as the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu for one day only, and makes such a success of it that soon he is embroiled in political intrigue.

Indian Movies.name: China Gate
Indian Movies.description: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

Indian Movies.name: Mann - Soul's Heart
Indian Movies.description: A young woman falls in love with a handsome playboy, while aboard a Singapore to India cruise. They make plans to meet again, but fate may have other plans...

Indian Movies.name: Arjun Pandit
Indian Movies.description: An unexpected betrayal transforms a meek college professor into a cold-blooded gangster who wants to marry a woman against her wishes.

Indian Movies.name: Hello Brother
Indian Movies.description: A police officer receives a heart transplant from a murdered man whose ghost then follows him around insisting that he solve and avenge his murder.

Indian Movies.name: Jeans
Indian Movies.description: The father of twin brothers wants to get them married to only twin sisters. But one of the brothers falls in love with a woman does not have a twin sister.

Indian Movies.name: Thulladha Manamum Thullum
Indian Movies.description: Kutty is a good-hearted soul, but unfortunate incidents tend to portray his ruffian side whenever he encounters the girl he loves. A bizarre incident brings them closer and yet keeps them apart.

Indian Movies.name: Only You
Indian Movies.description: Deepak returns Aarti's lost-in-transit luggage. The two start communicating via letter. They fall in love and rural/suburban Aarti comes to the city to look for Deepak, whom she had sent a handwoven pullover.

Indian Movies.name: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
Indian Movies.description: Rohan Khanna leaves India hoping for a better life in America.

Indian Movies.name: Soldier
Indian Movies.description: After Major Vijay Malhotra's colleagues betray him, he is branded as a traitor and subsequently killed. But his son, Vicky, vows to take revenge on his father's murderers and prove his innocence.

Indian Movies.name: Pyaar to Hona Hi Tha
Indian Movies.description: Set to reclaim her fiancé's heart, Sanjana (Kajol) decides to travel back to India, not knowing that fate has something else planned for her.

Indian Movies.name: Biwi No. 1
Indian Movies.description: A housewife learns that her husband is cheating on her. Thus, her quest to bring him back begins

Indian Movies.name: Tholi Prema
Indian Movies.description: While Balu falls in love with Anu at first sight, she is unaware of his emotions. The difficulties that he needs to face to win her heart, form the rest of the story.

Indian Movies.name: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
Indian Movies.description: Arjun and Pyare Mohan are honest policemen who work together. Trouble follows when thieves Bade Miyan and Chote Miyan, look-alikes of Arjun and Pyare, commit crimes and the hapless duo are blamed for it.

Indian Movies.name: Bandhan
Indian Movies.description: A united household is shaken to the core when Raju's (Salman Khan's) brother-in-law marries a prostitute.

Indian Movies.name: A: Film by Upendra
Indian Movies.description: An unusual love story between a film director and an actress narrated through multiple flashbacks within flashbacks and reverse screenplay. The film deals with the dark truths of cinema like the casting couch.

Indian Movies.name: When One Falls in Love
Indian Movies.description: A Playboy's past catches up with him, when he wants to get married

Indian Movies.name: Amarkalam
Indian Movies.description: A crook is asked by an ex-gang leader to hold the commissioner's daughter captive for two days to ruin the family's honor. The girl while captive falls in love with the crook, but he rejects her.

Indian Movies.name: Jaanam Samjha Karo
Indian Movies.description: Talented singer and dancer, Chandni's life is dominated by three aunts, and a soft-spoken maternal grandmother. She meets with a womanizer named Rahul, and falls in love with him. Rahul treats her just like any of his other girlfriends, and decides to have an affair with her. Rahul unexpectedly meets with his dadaji, who wants him to get married to Chandni. In order to fool him, Rahul asks Chandni to pretend to be his wife, which she does. After Dadaji leaves, will Rahul and Chandni go their separate ways, and will Rahul return to the waiting arms of his many girlfriends?

Indian Movies.name: Haseena Maan Jaayegi
Indian Movies.description: Separated from their wealthy father and each other, two brothers (Sanjay Dutt, Govinda) try to win the hearts of their dream girls.

Indian Movies.name: Kareeb
Indian Movies.description: Birju is a young man who lives with his mom, dad, elder brother, Bhabhi and nephew in an upper middle class home. His father would like him to work as well as accept some responsibility, but Birju does not heed him, but is instead interested in petty thievery, lies, and romancing a beautiful young woman named Neha. When he proposes marriage, his mom and dad hope that this will set him on the right path, and they approve of his marriage with Neha. When Neha finds out the truth about Birju, she refuses to marry him, and re-locates to another town. Birju is unable to get Neha out of his mind, and he runs away from home, hoping to locate Neha somewhere, and try to patch things with her. He does find Neha and her mom, who is hospitalized. When Birju makes inquiries he is told that Neha's mom is due for major surgery, and that this operation will cost a lot of money. Birju steals the money to pay for the surgery, and when he goes to deposit this money at the hospital, he finds out to his dismay that her operation has already taken place, and that Neha is to marry the doctor who performed this operation.

Indian Movies.name: Vaalee
Indian Movies.description: A young bride finds an unusual antagonist in her husband's twin brother.

Indian Movies.name: Dulhe Raja
Indian Movies.description: K. K. Singhania, a successful hotelier, is annoyed by Raja who starts a dhaba right next to his luxurious five-star hotel. His frustrations reach next level when his daughter falls in love with Raja and decides to marry him.

Indian Movies.name: Punjabi House
Indian Movies.description: A debt-ridden man tries to commit suicide by drowning in the sea but he is rescued by two fishermen and ultimately he ends up working for a Punjabi household.

Indian Movies.name: Sethu
Indian Movies.description: A violent youngster and a shy Brahmin girl fall in love but tragedy intervenes when the youngster is brain-damaged following a fight.

Indian Movies.name: Major Saab
Indian Movies.description: An Army Major decides to tame a persistent rule breaker who is bent on being discharged. However the trainee changes his plan when he falls in love and needs the Major's help in rescuing his beau.

Indian Movies.name: Raja Kumarudu
Indian Movies.description: While on a holiday, Raja meets and falls in love with Rani but breaks off the relationship due to family compulsions. Later, when he has all but given up hope of seeing her again, he gets a surprise.

Indian Movies.name: Rockford
Indian Movies.description: The movie chronicles the arrival of a (Hindu) student to a strict all-boys Christian boarding school in India and his assimilation into the school. The change is quite dramatic to the protagonist and there are a lot of events that would look extremely abusive to the viewer.

Indian Movies.name: Aarzoo
Indian Movies.description: After her fiance, Vijay, is killed in a crash, a pregnant Pooja agrees to marry Amar, her childhood friend who has always loved her. But her life takes yet another turn when Vijay returns to her life.

Indian Movies.name: International Khiladi
Indian Movies.description: A crime boss is accused by a reporter of murdering her brother and raping her. He investigates the frame-up.

Indian Movies.name: Dillagi
Indian Movies.description: When Ranvir, the responsible elder brother of a middle-class Indian family, realises that his reckless younger brother Rajvir is in love, he arranges for Rajvir's marriage, not realising that the girl is the same person he is in love with.

Indian Movies.name: Kachche Dhaage
Indian Movies.description: Two stepbrothers who loathe each other have to work together to avoid being framed for terrorist activities.

Indian Movies.name: Priyamudan
Indian Movies.description: Vasanth, a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Priya during his visit to Rajasthan. To woo Priya, he impersonates a man named Vasanth Kumar who had saved her life before.

Indian Movies.name: Ninaithen Vandhai
Indian Movies.description: Gokulan sees an attractive girl in his dream and is determined to find her. However, his father gets him engaged to another girl. Complications arise when he meets the woman of his dream soon after.

Indian Movies.name: Khiladi 420
Indian Movies.description: Dev, a conman, gets killed by his wife Ritu, after she learns that the former is a debt-ridden thug who married her only to repay his debts. Her life turns upside down when she meets Anand, Dev's identical twin brother.

Indian Movies.name: Mast
Indian Movies.description: Krishnakant Mathur (Aftab Shivdasani) alias "kittu", works in a restaurant, which is located right opposite the bunglow of famous movie actress, Mallika (Urmilla Matondkar). Kittu, simply put, is only a fan, but is smitten by Mallika, almost to the point of obsession. He does get to meet her at Mehboob Studios, and speak with Mallika herself. Before he could finish speaking with her, he is rudely interrupted by Tolluram, Manisha's uncle (Govind Namdeo), who insults and humiliates him and tells him to leave. Kittu is confused at this, and gets appalled and concerned about Mallika, when he learns that her life is being controlled by her uncle, aunt and cousin sister. One day he witnesses her uncle beating her up, he breaks into her house, assaults the uncle, and abducts Mallika. The next day, there is furore in the media when everyone learns that an actress has been abducted. The police get involved. Kittu decides to take Mallika to his home to his parents, and does so. He hides her in his house, but decides not to tell anyone in his family about Mallika. How long will Kittu succeed in doing this? Is this what Mallika wants, or is she being taken advantage of again? How long will a famous actress hide out without anyone else coming to know her?

Indian Movies.name: Thammudu
Indian Movies.description: An aimless student is banished from his home by his father. When his brother, a boxing champion, gets injured, the student must step up and take his brother's place.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Kya Kare
Indian Movies.description: An emotional saga of a mother who has lost her child and her love.

Indian Movies.name: Kaathala Kaathala
Indian Movies.description: Two friends, both with the name of Lingam, create a comedy of errors and consequent chaos with their girlfriends and their families.

Indian Movies.name: Summer in Bethlehem
Indian Movies.description: Ravishankar pretends to own the farmhouse of his friend Dennis when his relative, Col. Menon, pays a visit along with his granddaughters. Dennis and Ravishankar try to find Ravishankar's secret admirer among the girls.

Indian Movies.name: Minsara Kanna
Indian Movies.description: Indira hates men and only employs women in her company and personal staff. Kaasi enters her life as a driver and soon, one by one, his entire family is employed in her house, with a desired motive.

Indian Movies.name: The Terrorist
Indian Movies.description: A young female terrorist goes on a suicide assassination mission, but her resolve to complete it is put to the test.

Indian Movies.name: Hyderabad Blues
Indian Movies.description: The protagonist of Hyderabad Blues is Varun, played by the director, Nagesh Kukunoor. The movie revolves around his visit home after 12 years in the USA and his resulting culture shock.

Indian Movies.name: Hum Aapke Dil Mein Rehte Hain
Indian Movies.description: Not knowing what consequences she would face, a woman signs a 1-year marriage contract with a business tycoon to end her family's poverty.

Indian Movies.name: Friends
Indian Movies.description: The story of three friends from childhood and how their lives changes when one of them falls in love.

Indian Movies.name: Keemat: They Are Back
Indian Movies.description: After a man is killed when a mugging goes wrong, the two small-time crooks responsible try to make amends by pretending to be his best friends and helping his village.

Indian Movies.name: Harikrishnans
Indian Movies.description: Hari and Krishnan, a criminal lawyer duo, investigate the murder of Guptan.

Indian Movies.name: Chinthavishtayaya Shyamala
Indian Movies.description: Story of a wife who has to deal with her lazy, immature and irresponsible husband.

Indian Movies.name: Samarasimha Reddy
Indian Movies.description: Revenge story between Samarasimha Reddy and Veera Raghava Reddy.

Indian Movies.name: Kadhal Mannan
Indian Movies.description: Shiva, a mechanic, is dared to go to Delhi by a woman to deliver a letter to her soon-to-be-engaged sister, Thilothama. But Shiva ends up falling in love with the latter woman.

Indian Movies.name: Bade Dilwala
Indian Movies.description: A police officer Ram (Sunil Shetty), a man of his word. His wife Manthara (Archana Puran Singh) is obsessed with money and neglects her family in pursuit of getting rich quick. She forces Ram to buy a lottery ticket and he obliges. When he goes into a restaurant for a snack, he finds that he has no money to tip the waitress Piya (Priya Gill). He promises her half the money if he ever wins the lottery. And to his surprise, he does!! But Manthara is not about to give up half of this windfall so easily....and as Ram and Piya come closer to each other, they discover a growing attraction....

Indian Movies.name: Sudden Rain
Indian Movies.description: A man and a woman fall in love through exchanging letters but destiny keeps separating them.

Indian Movies.name: Hera Pheri
Indian Movies.description: Two tenants and a landlord look for answers to all their money problems - but when their opportunity arrives, will they know what to do with it?

Indian Movies.name: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
Indian Movies.description: After marrying a poor woman, rich Rahul is disowned by his father and moves to London to build a new life. Years later, his now-grown younger brother Rohan embarks on a mission to bring Rahul back home and reunite the family.

Indian Movies.name: Mohabbatein
Indian Movies.description: A film about the battle between love and fear, between two stubborn men and their opposing beliefs and the outcome of the love stories of 3 couples.

Indian Movies.name: Monsoon Wedding
Indian Movies.description: A stressed father, a bride-to-be with a secret, a smitten event planner, and relatives from around the world create much ado about the preparations for an arranged marriage in India.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Chahta Hai
Indian Movies.description: Three inseparable childhood friends are just out of college. Nothing comes between them - until they each fall in love, and their wildly different approaches to relationships creates tension.

Indian Movies.name: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
Indian Movies.description: The people of a small village in Victorian India stake their future on a game of cricket against their ruthless British rulers.

Indian Movies.name: Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai
Indian Movies.description: A young girl meets the doppelganger of her deceased boyfriend and now has a chance to find the people who have murdered him.

Indian Movies.name: Gadar: Ek Prem Katha
Indian Movies.description: During the Partition of India in 1947, a Sikh truck driver falls in love with a Muslim girl belonging to an aristocratic family.

Indian Movies.name: Josh
Indian Movies.description: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

Indian Movies.name: Asoka
Indian Movies.description: The epic tale of King Asoka's life is recounted.

Indian Movies.name: I Have Found It
Indian Movies.description: An Indian adaptation of Jane Austen's "Sense and Sensibility" focusing on two sisters of opposing temperaments.

Indian Movies.name: Nayak: The Real Hero
Indian Movies.description: TV cameraman Shivaji Rao is challenged by Maharashtra chief minister to run the state for a single day. His success exposes corruption, triggers backlash, and pulls him toward political conflict and personal sacrifice.

Indian Movies.name: Kasoor
Indian Movies.description: Shekhar appoints Simran, a lawyer with an impeccable record, to represent him as he was accused of murdering his wife and soon she starts falling in love with him. Little she knows that Shekhar has some darker intentions.

Indian Movies.name: Hey Ram
Indian Movies.description: Saketh Ram's wife is raped and killed during direct action day riots in Calcutta. He is convinced that Mahatma Gandhi is responsible for all the problems happening in the country and sets out to kill him.

Indian Movies.name: Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani
Indian Movies.description: In order to seek justice for a man who exacts vengeance on a politician, who was responsible for his daughter's death, two rival reporters teams up to help him to prove his innocence.

Indian Movies.name: Nuvvu Naaku Nachchav
Indian Movies.description: Venky and Nandini's relationship changes from mere friendship to something that is more romantic. However, love only blossoms between the two after Nandini's marriage is fixed elsewhere.

Indian Movies.name: Samsara
Indian Movies.description: A spiritual love-story set in the majestic landscape of Ladakh, Himalayas. Samsara is a quest; one man's struggle to find spiritual Enlightenment by renouncing the world. And one woman's struggle to keep her enlightened love and life in the world. But their destiny turns, twists and comes to a surprise ending...

Indian Movies.name: Alai Payuthey
Indian Movies.description: After a difficult romance in a class-divided society, the love birds find out marriage is not what they thought it would be.

Indian Movies.name: Ajnabee
Indian Movies.description: A newlywed couple, Raj and Priya, move to Switzerland and become friends with their new neighbors, Vicky and Sonia. But one day, Raj is accused of Sonia's murder and goes on the run in order to prove his innocence.

Indian Movies.name: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega...
Indian Movies.description: Raj is a struggling singer with big dreams who is still waiting for his big break. One night he witnesses an accident where a car spins out of control and lands on the tracks of an on-coming train. Raj runs over to the wreckage and rescues the occupant just in time. He takes her to the hospital and the girl's family are informed. The girl, Pooja Oberoi, survives but is in a vigil coma, a condition whereby she can hear and see everything but cannot speak nor move any part of her body. The Oberoi family is grateful to Raj and are led to believe that he is Pooja's groom, Romi. Raj is reluctant to accept this but then he changes his mind and accepts being the groom, as he has an agenda of his own and takes advantage of this accident to further his goals. But then he meets Pooja's best friend Jahnvi and falls in love with her. The situation is complicated even more when Pooja wakes up from the coma and begins to show feelings for Raj.

Indian Movies.name: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
Indian Movies.description: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the person his love interest, Reena, is about to marry and attempts to woo her. However, he is unprepared for the moment when the truth will be revealed.

Indian Movies.name: Mission Kashmir
Indian Movies.description: A police officer adopts the son and sole survivor of a family he has massacred while pursuing a terrorist. After some time the foster son finds out what the stepfather did.

Indian Movies.name: Dhadkan
Indian Movies.description: Anjali and Dev are in love and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, who has managed to fall in love with her husband.

Indian Movies.name: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
Indian Movies.description: A prostitute agrees to get impregnated and then give the baby to a couple (Raj and Priya) in exchange for a million rupees. Everything changes when she develops feelings for the baby and Raj.

Indian Movies.name: Tum Bin...: Love Will Find a Way
Indian Movies.description: Shekhar accidentally kills his associate Amar, and decides to watch over Amar's company and take care of his family and friends. However, he falls in love with Amar's fiancé Piya.

Indian Movies.name: Lajja
Indian Movies.description: The lives of four women from different places are the victims of male chauvinism and marital abuse. They decide to fight for their rights and dignity against the social norms and injustice.

Indian Movies.name: Aalavandhan
Indian Movies.description: Nandu and Vijay are brothers, who were abused by their stepmother during their younger days. Nandhu, who is mentally ill, decides to kill Vijay's fiancee as he visualizes her as his stepmother.

Indian Movies.name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar
Indian Movies.description: Biopic of B. R. Ambedkar, known mainly for his contributions in the emancipation of the downtrodden and oppressed classes in India and shaping the Constitution of India.

Indian Movies.name: Yaadein...
Indian Movies.description: Raj is against love marriages and when his daughter Isha falls in love with Ronit Malhotra, he opposes their relationship. Will Ronit and Isha sacrifice their love for the sake of their parents or will they manage to convince them?

Indian Movies.name: Indian
Indian Movies.description: Brave Indian policeman Raj beats up, then arrests Muslim terrorist Khan. This gets him promoted, and he is congratulated by none other than his father-in-law, who is also a very high ranking policeman. Suddenly, Raj finds out that many policemen would like to see Khan go free. He consults his father-in-law and surprisedly finds no support from him. Disagreements and arguments ensue, and his father-in-law gets killed as a result. The Police suspect Raj of killing him, they begin the process of arresting him, and he runs away--while Khan is all set to get freed to do whatever he likes.

Indian Movies.name: Pukar
Indian Movies.description: A notorious terrorist manipulates an Indian army major's jilted lover into helping him obtain a classified military code.

Indian Movies.name: One 2 Ka 4
Indian Movies.description: When a cop's partner is killed in the line of duty, he assumed guardianship of his orphaned children while investigating the murder.

Indian Movies.name: Mela
Indian Movies.description: When a village belle's brother is killed by a bandit, she vows revenge and enlists the help of two truckers-come-theatre artists in her mission.

Indian Movies.name: Aamdani Atthanni Kharcha Rupaiya
Indian Movies.description: In order to make ends meet, three women steps out from their houses for earning. However, this irks their jobless husbands who can go to extreme lengths to stop them.

Indian Movies.name: Fiza
Indian Movies.description: In 1993 Fiza's brother Aman disappears during the riots in Mumbai. In 1999 Fiza is tired of waiting and goes looking for him.

Indian Movies.name: Kushi
Indian Movies.description: College friends Jenny and Shiva part ways due to a misunderstanding. Although they are in love and realize they cannot live without each other, their egos prevent them from uniting.

Indian Movies.name: Shahjahan
Indian Movies.description: Ashok is the guy people turn to for love advice. He helps Raja succeed in wooing the girl he loves, only to realise later that the she is none other than Uma, the girl he himself is in love with.

Indian Movies.name: Minnale
Indian Movies.description: A young girl is torn between an obsessive lover and a mild-mannered suitor.

Indian Movies.name: Aks
Indian Movies.description: Raghavan Ghatge, a psychotic terrorist, and Manu Verma, the cop who tracks him down, shoot each other simultaneously, the result being that Raghavan's soul is transferred into Verma's body and vice versa.

Indian Movies.name: Murari
Indian Movies.description: A family is under a curse due to an old sin; due to which a male is bound to die every 48 years.

Indian Movies.name: Qayamat: City Under Threat
Indian Movies.description: CBI officer Akram seeks to nab three terrorists, Ali, Abbas and Laila, who have held 213 tourists as hostage in Elphinstone Jail. For this, he seeks help from Rachit, a former associate of the trio.

Indian Movies.name: Friends
Indian Movies.description: Three friends, who value friendship over everything else, begin to fall apart when one of them learns about a shocking incident that happened in their past.

Indian Movies.name: Kya Kehna
Indian Movies.description: A young college girl faces hardships and challenges after she becomes a mother without marriage

Indian Movies.name: Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge
Indian Movies.description: A young woman raised by three eccentric uncles escapes to Europe, where she meets a charming stranger after her purse is stolen. As they travel together, romance blooms—but he must win over her unconventional guardians back home.

Indian Movies.name: Badri
Indian Movies.description: When a kickboxer gets attacked by his enemies and ends up bedridden, his brother sets out to fulfil his dream of winning the kickboxing championship.

Indian Movies.name: Zubeidaa
Indian Movies.description: Zubeidaa, an aspiring Muslim actress, marries a Sikh prince to become his second wife. Her tumultuous relationship with her husband, and her inner demons lead her to a decision which has fatal consequences for them all.

Indian Movies.name: Chal Mere Bhai
Indian Movies.description: Vicky, a businessman, loves his younger brother Prem, who spends his time chasing women. The family feels that secretary Sapna will make a good wife for Vicky, but she is already in love with Prem.

Indian Movies.name: Rhythm
Indian Movies.description: A single mother changes her opinion about getting married again after meeting a single man and discovering that both of them have a similar past concerning their spouses.

Indian Movies.name: Style
Indian Movies.description: In an attempt to woo the rich women, two prankster-loving men becomes prime suspects of a murder of a woman.

Indian Movies.name: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
Indian Movies.description: Raj is a successful lawyer due to constant cheating and dishonesty. When his wife comes to know about this, she threatens to leave him. Fearful of his parents' divorce, Raj's son wishes that his father become unable to lie.

Indian Movies.name: Khushi
Indian Movies.description: While playing matchmaker to a pair of their friends, two young university students begin developing feelings for each other.

Indian Movies.name: Badal
Indian Movies.description: Having witnessed his family being massacred during a riot in his village, Badal is raised by a terrorist and sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

Indian Movies.name: Dheena
Indian Movies.description: Dheena works for his brother Adhikesavan, a gangster, and is very close to him. However, things turn sour between them after a misunderstanding leads to the death of their sister.

Indian Movies.name: Raju Chacha
Indian Movies.description: Raju is hired to pose as uncle to three orphaned kids in order to usurp their inheritance. But he changes his mind after falling in love with their governess and decides to fight the greedy relatives.

Indian Movies.name: Jungle
Indian Movies.description: A survival tale of two lovers, who tries their best to escape a jungle which is governed by a cold blooded dacoit.

Indian Movies.name: Thenali
Indian Movies.description: A neurotic Sri Lankan patient crashes his psychotherapist's family vacation in Kodaikanal.

Indian Movies.name: Hadh Kar Di Aapne
Indian Movies.description: Raj, a detective, goes on a Europe trip for his friend's case. During the trip, he falls in love with Anjali, who is impersonating her best friend. Their journey together ensues romance and comic confusion.

Indian Movies.name: Bichhoo
Indian Movies.description: A contract killer with a tragic past trains a teenage girl to avenge the murder of her family and falls for her in the process.

Indian Movies.name: Jodi No. 1
Indian Movies.description: Partners in crime Jai and Veeru set their next target on a rich businessman, Rai Bahadur. Things turn hilarious when both of them fall for his daughters.

Indian Movies.name: Hamara Dil Aapke Paas Hai
Indian Movies.description: Inspired by the Telugu film, "Pelli Chuskundam," the plot follows the life of a rape victim (Aishwarya Rai). Now, a disgrace to her family, she is turned away from her house after the sexual assault. But she finds shelter in the character played by Anil Kapoor.

Indian Movies.name: Kurukshetra
Indian Movies.description: ACP Prithviraj is an honest cop. When he arrests the Chief Minister's son for assaulting a girl, the minister tries his best to create havoc in Prithviraj's life.

Indian Movies.name: Badri
Indian Movies.description: Badri (Pawan Kalyan) is an ad agency director whose parents are settled in the USA. He has a love called Vennela (Renu Desai), who is a close family friend of Badri's family. Their parents want these two to tie the knot.

Indian Movies.name: Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai
Indian Movies.description: Karan, a small time musician, tries to win over a girl named Pooja.

Indian Movies.name: Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya...
Indian Movies.description: A obsessive woman determines to do what it takes to get her lover - at any cost.

Indian Movies.name: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
Indian Movies.description: Vijay Kapoor, a wealthy businessman and his family are deceived by Rajesh, Vijay Kapoor's employee and son in law. A struggle begins by both father-son duos to regain their business and position.

Indian Movies.name: Chandni Bar
Indian Movies.description: A displaced woman is forced to become a beer-bar dancer, and sire children of a gangster.

Indian Movies.name: Refugee
Indian Movies.description: A young man who smuggles illegal weapons and people back and forth over the borders between India and Pakistan falls in love with a young woman whose family he helped.

Indian Movies.name: Kahin Pyaar Na Ho Jaaye
Indian Movies.description: Musician Prem Kapoor lives with his sister, Neelu, brother-in-law Vinod, his niece and a nephew. He has plans of getting married to his fiancee, Nisha; unfortunately on the wedding day Nisha does not turn up. When a heart-broken Prem confronts Nisha for an explanation she confides to him that she is to get married to a multi-millionaire male from the U.S. who promises to aid her in maintaining the family and an ailing younger brother. Devastated Prem decides to take to alcohol; eventually time passes and Prem starts to fall in love with an acquaintance, Priya Sharma. But before Prem could express his feelings Priya announces her engagement to U.S. returned Rahul Puglia which forces Prem to take to alcohol once again but eventually there is a twist when Prem gets to find out Priya is romantically attracted to him.

Indian Movies.name: Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain
Indian Movies.description: Gangaram alias Ganga has been raised by his foster parents who reside in the village thus he gets accustom to village life. 24 years later his birth parents multi-millionaire Avinash and his wife Radha comes to ask him to move into their bungalow located in the city to which Ganga agrees and goes to bid farewell to his friends and girlfriend Saawni. While in the city Ganga is introduced to his elder brother, Milind, his wife, Supriya, and his younger brother; Ganga finds it very hard to adjust to the city life and is often scuffed at. Avinash arranges his marriage with equally wealthy Tina to which he agrees although he is not comfortable with this marriage as he is still in love with Saawni; meanwhile Ganga's honest policy gets him and his new found family into further problems.

Indian Movies.name: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
Indian Movies.description: Desperate for money, three men plot to kidnap a woman and hold her for ransom.

Indian Movies.name: Devadoothan
Indian Movies.description: Vishal Krishnamoorthy, a renowned music composer and singer, reminisces about his initial struggles and an unknown spirit that inspires him to compose songs.

Indian Movies.name: Citizen
Indian Movies.description: Antony assumes several identities and kidnaps three government officials in order to succeed in his secret mission. However, a CBI officer sets out to find the real identity of the kidnapper.

Indian Movies.name: Student No. 1
Indian Movies.description: Aditya joins a law college as per his father's wishes though he wanted to be an engineer. He faces many problems while trying to reform the unruly students along with dealing with his terrifying past.

Indian Movies.name: Ravanaprabhu
Indian Movies.description: A son becomes a liquor baron against his father's wishes. After losing their ancestral home to an enemy, he kidnaps the enemy's daughter for revenge but falls in love with her, leading to conflict between the families.

Indian Movies.name: Narasimham
Indian Movies.description: Induchoodan is wrongly implicated in a murder case. Later, his father is imprisoned for murdering his daughter and Induchoodan vows to prove his innocence.

Indian Movies.name: Dhaai Akshar Prem Ke
Indian Movies.description: Karan Khanna is an orphan and a captain in the Rajputana Armed Forces. He's madly in love with beautiful model Nisha, with whom he plans to tie the knot during his next leave. On the way to Nisha and their life together he bumps into Sahiba Grewal (Aishwarya Rai) who is an eye-witness to a murder and a girl on the run. Paranoid and panic-stricken, she finds an unexpected savior in Karan who rescues her from a group of criminals and stops her from taking her life. Slowly, Sahiba confides in Karan about her painful past and not-so-pretty future. Sahiba is the daughter of the stern and stony-faced patriach, industrialist Yagvendra Grewal who wants to see her settle down with the very suitable son of his friend, Rai Bahadur. Unwilling to get tied down too soon with a stranger, Sahiba lies to her family telling them she got married while studying in the city and is now terrified of returning to Palanpur without a husband. Karan chivalrously offers to make the trip home with her and tell her father that she was forced to lie to him to avoid an early marriage. Along the way, Sahiba falls in love with Karan but he is still starry-eyed about his model. They arrive in Palanpur and Karan soon endears himself to Sahiba's extended family that includes her father, his three younger brothers, their wives and Biji, Sahiba's doting grandmother. Only Yagvendra refuses to accept his son-in-law, who he is convinced is after Sahiba's crores. Karan, who's never had a family of his own, is easily drawn into the warmth surrounding him and life is fine till one of Sahiba's aunts mistakenly assumes that Sahiba's expecting and spreads the word around. Suddenly, even Sahiba's grim father is grinning and life's a bed of roses again for Sahiba, who begs Karan not to leave her ever. Karan on his part finds himself falling in love with his enchanting wife-who-isn't and scared of a future he hasn't planned for, slinks off into the night to meet Nisha. But Nisha is already married and convinces him that Sahiba is his true love and he should return to Palanpur. He does to find that Yagvendra Singh and his family now want to have nothing more to do with him. Sahiba's father wants her to start a new life with Rai Bahadur's son but at the engagement ceremony, Sahiba recognizes him as the murderer she had fled from in the city. She tries to warn her father about his friend and her fiancé but Yagvendra is deaf to all her pleas. However, his younger brother Raunak sides with Karan and tries to prevent the marriage from taking place. But Sahiba believing all is lost, consumes poison before her Romeo can reach her.

Indian Movies.name: Nandha
Indian Movies.description: Looking to put behind a past that haunts him, Nandha tries to reconcile with his mother and live life on his terms.

Indian Movies.name: Yeh Teraa Ghar Yeh Meraa Ghar
Indian Movies.description: Dayashankar Pandey, struggling with debt, tries to evict tenants from his Bombay house to pay loans. The tenants refuse to leave, complicating his situation as circumstances favor them.

Indian Movies.name: Mugavari
Indian Movies.description: An aspiring music director, trying to realize his dream for over eight years, sacrifices his love for his ambition, but faces a tricky situation when his brother's health deteriorates and his family is at risk financially.

Indian Movies.name: Poovellam Un Vaasam
Indian Movies.description: 40+ years of friendship between two intimate families is at stake, when a young woman from one of the families is indignant towards a young man from the other family, when he mistrusts her love towards him.

Indian Movies.name: Kunwara
Indian Movies.description: Raju meets Urmila in New Zealand. They have a fast romance and things are going well until Raju must make a trip back to India. While he is there, he meets Sharmila, pregnant and jilted by her boyfriend. He agrees to pretend to be her husband for her family, dump her in front of them so they will take her back after they see how unreasonable he is. The masquerade goes smoothly until Urmila appears and thinks she's been jilted. Which leads to conflict between the couple that may last for a lifetime.

Indian Movies.name: Kannukkul Nilavu
Indian Movies.description: Gautham, a man with special needs, comes to Pondicherry. Hema, a carefree woman, befriends him and with the help of her father, who is a psychologist, unravels his horrific past life.

Indian Movies.name: Joru Ka Ghulam
Indian Movies.description: A conman disguises himself as a groom in order to con a wealthy yet a troubled businessman, later reforms his criminal ways to win his ladylove.

Indian Movies.name: Ee Parakkum Thalika
Indian Movies.description: Unni, a bus owner, and his friend Sundareshan ply a bus service. The pathetic condition of his bus creates concerns for Unni. Things take a turn when a girl happens to come into their lives.

Indian Movies.name: Thenkasipattanam
Indian Movies.description: Kannan is in love with his childhood friend Meenakshi but keeps it a secret from his beloved friend Dasan. However, the friendship between them is ruined as Dasan falls in love with the same girl.

Indian Movies.name: Priyamanavale
Indian Movies.description: Vijay has no faith in marriage. However, on his father's insistence, he marries Priya but lays down a condition wherein at the end of the year he will decide whether to continue their marriage or not.

Indian Movies.name: Afsana Dilwalon Ka
Indian Movies.description: A young schoolteacher falls for her distant relative from a village but his singing talent catches the eye of a selfish mother-daughter duo who separate the budding lovers.

Indian Movies.name: Dhill
Indian Movies.description: A young police aspirant gets into an altercation with a corrupt cop, who then proceeds to ruin his life and career prospects.

Indian Movies.name: Narasimha Naidu
Indian Movies.description: Revenge story between two neighboring villages with one headed by a bad person and the other headed by a good person.

Indian Movies.name: Kal Ho Naa Ho
Indian Movies.description: Naina, an introverted, perpetually depressed girl's life changes when she meets Aman. But Aman has a secret of his own which changes their lives forever. Embroiled in all this is Rohit, Naina's best friend who conceals his love for her.

Indian Movies.name: Anbe Sivam
Indian Movies.description: Two men, one young and arrogant, the other damaged - physically but not spiritually - by life, are thrown together by circumstances, and find that they are in some ways bound together by fate.

Indian Movies.name: Devdas
Indian Movies.description: After his wealthy family prohibits him from marrying the woman he is in love with, Devdas Mukherjee's life spirals further and further out of control as he takes up alcohol and a life of vice to numb the pain.

Indian Movies.name: Maqbool
Indian Movies.description: The intrigue of the Shakespearean tragedy 'Macbeth' is transposed to the Mumbai underworld.

Indian Movies.name: Raaz
Indian Movies.description: Sanjana and Aditya decide to give their marriage one last chance. They plan a holiday in Ooty, but they don't know that a strange figure is waiting for them to come.

Indian Movies.name: Baghban
Indian Movies.description: An elderly couple wish their children to care for them in their old age. But their children see and treat them as a burden, and they must struggle to regain their worth and dignity to themselves and others.

Indian Movies.name: Company
Indian Movies.description: A small-time gangster named Chandu teams up with Malik, a low-level enforcer for a criminal syndicate. Together they eliminate all their enemies, becoming the most feared gangsters in Mumbai.

Indian Movies.name: Chalte Chalte
Indian Movies.description: A man pursues a woman who is already engaged and eventually gets married to her. Differences between the two lead to a bitter separation that threatens to destroy their relationship forever.

Indian Movies.name: Bhoot
Indian Movies.description: When a married couple moves into a flat that is haunted by a spirit, a series of inexplicable experiences drive the wife to near madness. Now, the husband must protect his wife to save their marriage.

Indian Movies.name: Kannathil Muthamittal
Indian Movies.description: A little girl is told by her parents that she is adopted. Determined to find her real mother, she begs to be taken to Sri Lanka, where her mother works with a militant group of activists.

Indian Movies.name: Paanch
Indian Movies.description: Kidnapping plot gone wrong when four friends plans to kidnap their own friend who accidentally got killed.

Indian Movies.name: Hungama
Indian Movies.description: The story of a bunch of misfits whose misconception about each others backgrounds end up in a series of chaotic, yet comic outcomes.

Indian Movies.name: Awara Paagal Deewana
Indian Movies.description: A dentist's life turns into a roller coaster ride when he is unknowingly embroiled in gang wars.

Indian Movies.name: Darna Mana Hai
Indian Movies.description: After their car breaks down in the middle of the night, seven friends find shelter and tell one another stories to kill time till dawn.

Indian Movies.name: Deewarein
Indian Movies.description: The story of a documentary movie-maker who films the reformation story of three hardened criminals within the prison walls - and in the process, finds redemption in her own life.

Indian Movies.name: Koi... Mil Gaya
Indian Movies.description: A developmentally disabled young man tries to continue the work his father did in communicating with extra-terrestrials from outer space, which leads to something miraculous and wonderful.

Indian Movies.name: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
Indian Movies.description: A gangster sets out to fulfill his father's dream of becoming a doctor.

Indian Movies.name: The Legend of Bhagat Singh
Indian Movies.description: The story of a young revolutionary who raised an armed resistance against the British rule in India.

Indian Movies.name: In Your Name
Indian Movies.description: A graduate jobless rowdy falls deeply in love with a simple, innocent girl. after their fiery clashes turn into fierce attraction. Just as she reciprocates his love, a savage attack leaves him mentally shattered.

Indian Movies.name: Saathiya
Indian Movies.description: A couple elopes to get married and set up home hoping that just love will do the trick - but that's just the beginning of their story.

Indian Movies.name: Deewangee
Indian Movies.description: A lawyer tried to defend a person accused of murder who is diagnosed with Split personality disorder.

Indian Movies.name: Okkadu
Indian Movies.description: A Kabbadi player rescues a young woman from an unwanted marriage and hides her in his home.

Indian Movies.name: Hum Tumhare Hain Sanam
Indian Movies.description: Gopal's blissful married life with Radha blemishes when Radha gets obsessed with the career of her friend, Suraj, who is a singer. Ripped apart by jealousy, Gopal deserts Radha.

Indian Movies.name: Mujhse Dosti Karoge!
Indian Movies.description: Meet Raj, Pooja and Tina - 3 best friends thrown into a situation that time, letters, love and separation have created for them.

Indian Movies.name: Footpath
Indian Movies.description: Two friends of a man help him avenge his father's death. Years later, he reunites with his friends who have now become criminals. What they don't know, is that he is now an undercover cop.

Indian Movies.name: LOC: Kargil
Indian Movies.description: Based on the real story during Kargil war fought between India and Pakistan in 1999.

Indian Movies.name: Gangaajal
Indian Movies.description: An IPS officer motivates and leads a dysfunctional, corrupt police force of Tezpur to fight against the corrupt politician.

Indian Movies.name: Indra
Indian Movies.description: A man attempts to resolve a water dispute between rival families by marrying a girl from the opposing clan, fostering peace through their union.

Indian Movies.name: Jism
Indian Movies.description: When an unemployed man falls for a wealthy woman and he is willing to do whatever he must to get her away from her abusive husband.

Indian Movies.name: Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai
Indian Movies.description: Sanjay wakes up to the truth that he loves his best friend Sanjana reluctantly but surely and sets off on a noble mission - to break her wedding.

Indian Movies.name: Kaakha Kaakha
Indian Movies.description: After a police team kills his brother, a drug-dealing gangster vows to kill the entire team and their respective families.

Indian Movies.name: Aankhen
Indian Movies.description: After a temperamental man is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank, for which he trains three blind men.

Indian Movies.name: Jaani Dushman: Ek Anokhi Kahani
Indian Movies.description: A shape-shifting snake exacts vengeance on a group of friends for a crime they did not even commit.

Indian Movies.name: Boom
Indian Movies.description: Three female models are unwittingly thrown into the Bombay underworld when they accidentally stop a diamond delivery to the Middle East.

Indian Movies.name: Choker Bali: A Passion Play
Indian Movies.description: Binodini is a young widow who lives with a woman and her son, Mahendra, who had once refused to marry her. Their lives are thrown into disarray when there is deceit and adultery between Binodini, Mahendra, his wife and his friend.

Indian Movies.name: Boys
Indian Movies.description: 'Boys' is the story of five boys and a girl from different families They are youthful, vibrant, careless violating all conventions and In the process, they discover their hidden talents.

Indian Movies.name: Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon
Indian Movies.description: This is the story of Sanjana, a girl of today's generation full of life and vibrant ecstasy. She lives life on her own terms and gets very upset when her mother Susheela, arranges for her to see a boy leading to a marriage prospect.

Indian Movies.name: Panchatanthiram
Indian Movies.description: Pilot Ram faces a crisis when a call girl his friends hired for him turns up dead. Can Ram and his friends navigate this dangerous predicament?

Indian Movies.name: Dil Hai Tumhara
Indian Movies.description: Raising her two daughters, Saritaji "Rekha" fears that history might repeat itself when both of them fall for the same guy.

Indian Movies.name: Makdee
Indian Movies.description: In a small North Indian village, Legend has it that a 100 years-old witch lives in an abandoned mansion on the village outskirts, and any person who goes inside is turned into an animal. In the same village a clever, naughty girl named Chunni (Shweta Prasad) lives with her widowed father, grandmother and her identical twin Munni, who is just the exact opposite of Chunni in mannerisms. But one day, Chunni's prank causes Munni enters the witch's mansion and the witch turns her into a hen. Chunni strikes a deal with Makdee (Shabana Azmi) that she will present Makdee with 100 hens in exchange for Munni in human form. How she manages this task forms the crux of the rest of this fun-filled children's movie.

Indian Movies.name: Baba
Indian Movies.description: Baba is an atheist who always questions the existence of a higher power. But when a turn of events bestows him with divine powers, he uses the opportunity to help other people.

Indian Movies.name: Nijam
Indian Movies.description: An innocent woman and her son face severe injustice at the hands of a villain. The woman also loses her husband in the bargain. Years later, she and her son avenge their losses in a planned manner.

Indian Movies.name: Hazaaron Khwaishein Aisi
Indian Movies.description: Set in the backdrop of Indian Emergency 1975, the story revolves around 3 friends whose lives changes drastically after the turn of events.

Indian Movies.name: Pinjar
Indian Movies.description: In the days leading up to Partition, a Hindu woman is abducted by a Muslim man. Soon, she finds herself not only forced into marriage, but living in a new country as the borders between India and Pakistan are drawn.

Indian Movies.name: Dil Ka Rishta
Indian Movies.description: A man faces a dilemma after he accidentally kills his lover's fiancee and hides this secret from her, not knowing that it may create a rift in their lives.

Indian Movies.name: Ishq Vishk
Indian Movies.description: To gain popularity in his college and get a girlfriend, Rajiv lies to Payal about being in love with her. After he tries to molest her and she leaves him, Rajiv pursues another woman.

Indian Movies.name: Saaya
Indian Movies.description: Akash and Maya, two doctors, are happily married and expecting a baby. However, things take a turn when Maya's bus crashes and she is believed to be dead.

Indian Movies.name: Kaante
Indian Movies.description: Six bank robbers trying to pull off the perfect heist discover one of them is an undercover cop.

Indian Movies.name: Haasil
Indian Movies.description: Aniruddh, a law-abiding college student, in love with Niharika, gets caught up in college politics and crime and must fight it out for himself when his friend becomes his foe.

Indian Movies.name: Yeh Hai Jalwa
Indian Movies.description: Raj Saxena (Salman Khan) goes to London, expecting his long-lost dad (Rishi Kapoor) to warmly greet him, but things do not go as planned.

Indian Movies.name: Pithamagan
Indian Movies.description: Chittan, a social outcast, has grown up in a cemetery. A drug dealer finds him a job in a cannabis farm. In prison, he meets a conman, Shakti. This friendship transforms him from his stony existence.

Indian Movies.name: Kaadhal Konden
Indian Movies.description: Exploring into the mind of a youth who is mentally and physically abused in his childhood, the film shows how he slowly turns into a psychopath who kills anyone who comes in the way of the girl for whom he has an obsessive love!

Indian Movies.name: Humraaz
Indian Movies.description: Karan plans to cheat Raj, a businessman, by getting his lover Priya married to Raj so that they can claim his wealth. However, when Priya falls in love with Raj and leaves Karan, he seeks revenge.

Indian Movies.name: Shakthi: The Power
Indian Movies.description: A couple visits the husband's family in India and finds itself in the middle of a fratricidal battle.

Indian Movies.name: Dum
Indian Movies.description: Uday, an aspiring police officer, beats up a man for misbehaving with his girlfriend. The man turns out to be a corrupt police officer who later starts harassing Uday and his family.

Indian Movies.name: Tumko Na Bhool Paayenge
Indian Movies.description: An amnesiac Hindu man remembers his past as a Muslim sharpshooter and an assassin.

Indian Movies.name: Andaaz
Indian Movies.description: Loyalty, Respect, commitment and love. What is Love? Loyalty, respect, commitment and friendship. Friendship and Love... Love and Friendship... So much in common, yet so different in emotion!

Indian Movies.name: Paap
Indian Movies.description: Kaya lives in a Buddhist village of Monks with her father who wants Kaya to devote her self to god and not live a normal like other females.The village head monk Lamha asks Kaya to travel to Delhi to bring a back a child named Llahmo who is believed to be re birth of their God.While in hotel Llahmo witness 's murder of a top cop where Kaya and Llahmo are asked by Inspector Shiven not to leave the city until they come to conclusion and shelters them safely in his sisters house.Llahmo identifies the killer whose none other then a top encounter cop ACP Raj Mehra,Shiven then decides to inform his senior DCP Mahtur but Maahtur and Mehra are partners in crime and plan to kill Shiven.A badly wounded Shiven picks up Kaya and Llahmo safely reaches them to their village but Shiven being in bad health cant return back an is nursed by Kaya where she starts having feelings for him.Kaya's father notices change in her behavior and reminds her about her devotion to got and feels that Shiven is come to make their holy lives impure.

Indian Movies.name: Mounam Pesiyadhe
Indian Movies.description: A man's attitude towards women and love starts to change after he develops feelings for a woman.

Indian Movies.name: Jhankaar Beats
Indian Movies.description: This is a story about love, friendship and music. Two copywriter brothers have lost in pop music contest called Jhankaar Beats for the last two years. They take the help of an apprentice to compete in a music contest.

Indian Movies.name: Manmadhudu
Indian Movies.description: A misogynist is forced by circumstances to work with a woman.

Indian Movies.name: Samay: When Time Strikes
Indian Movies.description: Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Malvika Chauhan battles time to obtain & solve the clues to solve the various murders occurring in the city.

Indian Movies.name: The Hero: Love Story of a Spy
Indian Movies.description: Arun is an Indian undercover agent enlisted to stop ISI chief Ishaq Khan. The village girl Reshma helps him but endangers her own life.

Indian Movies.name: Na Tum Jaano Na Hum
Indian Movies.description: A romantically inclined couple decide to get to know each other through letters without disclosing their identities.

Indian Movies.name: C.I.D. Moosa
Indian Movies.description: The adventures of a private detective, Moosa, whose luck and wit help him to solve the cases.

Indian Movies.name: December
Indian Movies.description: Indian intelligence agents race against time to stop a renegade Pakistani terrorist from detonating a nuclear weapon in Delhi.

Indian Movies.name: Kucch To Hai
Indian Movies.description: A group of friends accidentally throw professor Bakshi off a cliff after seeing a corpse in his house. Years later, during a reunion, they are stalked by a mysterious killer.

Indian Movies.name: Gangotri
Indian Movies.description: Neelakantha's daughter Gangotri faces water threat per horoscope. Simhadri protects her since childhood. They develop feelings, but Neelakantha opposes their union.

Indian Movies.name: Jajantaram Mamantaram
Indian Movies.description: A young man lands in the land of little people, who ask him to save them from their enemies.

Indian Movies.name: Rishtey
Indian Movies.description: Suraj Singh (Anil Kapoor) is in love with the beautiful and wealthy Komal (Karisma Kapoor). They dream of their perfect family together but her arrogant father Yashpal Chaudhary (Amrish Puri) detests Suraj because he is a middle-class youth, with no riches whatsoever. Komal cuts all ties with her father, marries Suraj, and is soon pregnant. Komal and her estranged father meet at a family wedding and her forgives her for leaving abruptly. Yashpal agrees to meet Suraj but when they reach home they see a seductress inside, wearing Komal's gown and drinking tea in the kitchen. Suraj walks in totally oblivious to the fact that a strange woman is in their home. Komal questions the seductress and she says she shares Komal's husband. Komal is furious and tries to commit suicide but Suraj stops her and repeatedly tries to prove his innocence. It turns out Yashpal set up the whole thing to break up their marriage. Komal leaves her husband with her father. She delivers a baby boy but Yashpal wants to make sure that the one thing that can bring his daughter and Suraj together be eliminated immediately. He hires hit men to kill the baby but Suraj manages to get away with his son. They move to a unknown place and he raises his son with help from the villagers. Suraj later meets Vaijanti (Shilpa Shetty), an eccentric fisher woman who his son sees as a mother and friend. Vaijanti begins to love Suraj and hopes that he feels the same way. Komal, depressed and lonely, spots her son with Suraj. Then begins a bitter custody battle between her and Suraj.

Indian Movies.name: Chameli
Indian Movies.description: On a rainy night, when an investment banker's car breaks down in the red light district, he takes shelter where he meets and later befriends a prostitute.

Indian Movies.name: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
Indian Movies.description: In order to win his love back, a rebellious youth accepts a deadly challenge from her father with several hurdles.

Indian Movies.name: Maa Tujhhe Salaam
Indian Movies.description: Major Pratab Singh works in the Indian army and he and his battalion has been assigned duty near the Indo-Pakistan border. There duty mainly consists of eliminating any terrorists trying to cross the Indian border. A Pakistan leader Gul Mustan and well known Lala is plotting to liberate Kashmir from India so that they can take control in there own way but things does not go accordingly as one loyalist of Lala; Albaksh begins to leak important information about there plans to the Indian army. And thus there begins a saga of combat between the army and the terrorists leaving many casualties on both sides.

Indian Movies.name: Khadgam
Indian Movies.description: Koti, an aspiring actor, rickshaw driver Amjad and Radha Krishna, a cop, have all been affected by terrorism. Circumstances bring them together and they decide to foil the plan of a dreaded terrorist.

Indian Movies.name: Aap Mujhe Achche Lagne Lage
Indian Movies.description: The daughter of a rich criminal industrial tycoon falls in love with a college boy. The tycoon, what a surprise, objects...

Indian Movies.name: Talaash: The Hunt Begins...
Indian Movies.description: -The Hunt Begins- For them it was revenge. For him it was a challenge. A timeless ride on a ferocious mission.

Indian Movies.name: Tagore
Indian Movies.description: Ravindranath Tagore, a physics professor, forms the ACF [Anti Corruption Force] along with his former students to take on corruption in society.

Indian Movies.name: Bagavathi
Indian Movies.description: Bhagvathi, a tea vendor, has big dreams for his younger brother, Guna. However, Guna gets killed by his girlfriend's father, who is unaware that his daughter is pregnant.

Indian Movies.name: Youth
Indian Movies.description: After getting rejected on his wedding day, Shiva moves to Chennai, where he falls in love with Sandhya. However, she does not love him and gets engaged to Pratap.

Indian Movies.name: Mr. and Mrs. Iyer
Indian Movies.description: During a bus journey, a devout Hindu Brahmin woman protects a Muslim man when communal rioting breaks out.

Indian Movies.name: Vaseegara
Indian Movies.description: A young educated unemployed youth comes to attend the marriage of his Father's close friend's daughter. He ultimately makes her to fall in love with him and Marries her at the end.

Indian Movies.name: Sathi
Indian Movies.description: A man sacrifices everything for his love, but his identity remains hidden from her for most of the movie.

Indian Movies.name: Simhadri
Indian Movies.description: Simhadri, a loyal servant in a landlord's house, also leads a secret life as Singamalai, a powerful leader in the state of Kerala.

Indian Movies.name: Meesha Madhavan
Indian Movies.description: Although forced into a criminal life from a young age, Madhavan is good at heart. However, as his enmity with Bhageerathan Pillai exacerbates, it forces the entrance of Sub-Inspector Eapen Pappachi.

Indian Movies.name: Ramana
Indian Movies.description: Ramana, a college professor, heads a secret force that eliminates corruption from society. They kidnap fifteen most corrupt employees from each government department and kill the most unscrupulous one.

Indian Movies.name: Road
Indian Movies.description: A couple decide to pick up a hitchhiker, but he ends up being a psychotic stalker who puts in them in danger.

Indian Movies.name: Saamy
Indian Movies.description: A cop takes bribes from politicians and goons. He rethinks his life choices after he meets a girl.

Indian Movies.name: Chor Machaaye Shor
Indian Movies.description: A thief pretends to be a cop in order to recover his diamond from a site that has been converted into the police headquarters. Although he becomes a favourite of the ACP, a colleague gets suspicious.

Indian Movies.name: Nuvve.. Nuvve...
Indian Movies.description: A rich Businessman is obsessed with his daughter who falls for a poor guy.

Indian Movies.name: Om Jai Jagadish
Indian Movies.description: The story of a mother and her three sons. Om has deep-rooted values, Jai is an ambitious car designer, and Jagdish is a carefree youngster.

Indian Movies.name: Pammal K. Sambandam
Indian Movies.description: A single movie stuntman attempts to save the marriage of his hen-pecked brother.

Indian Movies.name: Akhiyon Se Goli Maare
Indian Movies.description: Akendra alias Topichand Bhangare runs an antique store as a front for illegal activities. He lives near the notorious Chor Bazaar (thieves market) area with his wife, Sulekha, and only daughter, Kiran. He would like Kiran to get married to the mother of all gangsters, and picks gangster Shakti Dada, who is currently undergoing a lengthy prison sentence, to be his prospective son-in-law. But Kiran already loves Raj Oberoi, who belongs to a wealthy family, and has no links with any gangsters. Kiran convinces Raj in order to meet with her dad's requirements, he must first become a gangster. Raj reluctantly agrees, and is introduced to a gangster-trainer called Subramaniam. After a number of misadventures, Raj finally accomplishes his goal, and qualifies to be a suitable groom for Kiran. Then things change abruptly with the arrival of Topichand's dad, a wealthy man, Thakur Rana, who strongly opposes Kiran's marriage with any gangster. A hapless Raj now decides to cleanse himself of his gangster image, with hilarious and unpredictable results.

Indian Movies.name: Kuch Naa Kaho
Indian Movies.description: A man is coerced by his uncle to get married and assigns this task to his secretary. However the man falls for the secretary herself, who has a dark past.

Indian Movies.name: Haan Maine Bhi Pyaar Kiya
Indian Movies.description: Shiv (Abhishek Bachchan) and Pooja (Karisma Kapoor) are happily married to each other but sometimes can get into the most petty arguments coming from the way they approach life. Shiv takes each day as it comes whilst Pooja's imagination sometimes gets the best of her. Pooja falls in love with Shiv so much that she gives up her high rising career for him and settles as a housewife. Their in-difference gets worse and Pooja is soon convinced that Shiv has been unfaithful. Pooja asks for a divorce and leaves him. She carries on with life and meets Raj (Akshay Kumar). Raj has everything anyone could ask for: money, fame but not love something he has craved for some time. He falls for Pooja and she also begins to like him. They get engaged and as the wedding approaches, Shiv re-enters Pooja's life. Old feelings and emotions come rushing back and she finds herself torn between two men. Who does she choose...?

Indian Movies.name: Hum Kisi Se Kum Nahin
Indian Movies.description: Munna Bhai, a dreaded Mumbai gangster, falls in love with a young woman named Komal. Things go hilariously awry when Munna sets out to marry her and has to fight off Dr. Rastogi, her brother, and Raja, her vagabond boyfriend.

Indian Movies.name: Idiot
Indian Movies.description: Chanti who gets beaten up black and blue is rescued by a girl who takes care of him in the hospital, till he gets fine. He falls for this unknown girl. Will he ever find her and convey his feelings?

Indian Movies.name: Aithe
Indian Movies.description: Irfan Khan (Pavan Malhotra) is a key mafia affiliate in Mumbai. Khan is on the wanted list of criminals in Hyderabad with a bounty of 50 lakhs. Aiming to migrate to Dubai so that he could remotely control the operations in Mumbai, Khan devised a plan of hijacking a plane from Hyderabad to Kathmandu. His plan consisted of getting four of his own men to hijack a domestic flight from Hyderabad to Kathmandu(destined for Mumbai) in which he is a passenger. The home minister is also in the flight, and the four men are to release all the passengers and concentrate on the Home minister. From Kathmandu, he planned to go to Dubai. For the hijack operation, he organised a group of four intelligent men who were in dire need for money and who do not have a criminal record. The audience is made to believe in the beginning that the four central characters are these four men, but in fact they kidnap Khan before the flight takes off, aiming to get the prize money. They hide Khan in a forest and call the Assistant Commissioner of Police, who is a double agent for the mafia. When the ACP does not yield(as he wants them to release Khan), one of the four, Kumar, does a deal with the Mafia and obtains a bag with 2 crore. However, the bag in which the money is kept in has a bomb in it. When Kumar tells the others that he has done this, they back out, and he also joins with them, just in time. Meanwhile, Khan's assistant, Musharraf, comes and takes Khan from the forest, but is stopped by IB agent Zaheer Khan, who has been following the four men and Musharraf all throughout the movie. Finally, the four friends come back to their house and find a bag which they had lost with a note from Zaheer explaining everything. The bag also has, to their joy, their prize money.

Indian Movies.name: Unnai Ninaithu
Indian Movies.description: A young man tries to explain to his lover that her fiance is a crook. She refuses to believe him. Later, she realises her mistake and comes back to him. But the man now loves another woman.

Indian Movies.name: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah: By Hook or by Crook
Indian Movies.description: Two petty thieves get on the bad side of two wanted criminals. On the run, they end up at the home of a Major, who takes them in thinking they are good people.

Indian Movies.name: Takkari Donga
Indian Movies.description: Outlaw in the Indian (not Native American) wild west shoots it out with bad guys over a girl and a diamond mine.

Indian Movies.name: Dhool
Indian Movies.description: Arumugam lands in the city to protest to a minister about water pollution in his village. Here, he gets involved in a battle against corrupt politicians and rowdies, who leave him practically dead.

Indian Movies.name: Pudhiya Geethai
Indian Movies.description: Sarathy is a brilliant and carefree young man who is unaware that an astrologer has predicted his death at the age of 27. Eventually, he comes to loggerheads with Reddiar over a land deal gone bad.

Indian Movies.name: Dudes in the 10th Century
Indian Movies.description: Bombay City lives in fear of a notorious thief who calls himself Chindi Chor, and steals whenever and whatever he desires without any regard to security, and police protection. When Ghoshal announces the exhibition and subsequent auction of Emperor Babushah's crown, Chindi challenges him that he is going to steal this priceless crown, and Ghosal accepts the challenge, and hires private security guards. Chindi carries out the theft, and two of the security guards, Vikram and Ajay, and an accomplice, John D'Souza, become prime suspects, and are on the run. They must apprehend Chindi and recover the crown to absolve themselves of this crime. While being chased by security guards, the trio crash into a wall, and are transported back to the 10th century, straight into the palace of Emperor Babushah himself. The trio think they are on the sets of a Bollywood movie, and take nothing seriously, until they are imprisoned. It is then the hapless trio realize that they must not only escape, but must also take the crown, back with them to the 21st century to absolve themselves of this crime. They do realize that only an miracle can get them back to the 21st century.

Indian Movies.name: Amma Nanna O Tamila Ammayi
Indian Movies.description: A former kick-boxer, after death of his wife, trains his son who hates him for boxing match for revenge on his former student.

Indian Movies.name: Kalyanaraman
Indian Movies.description: An old man (Dileep) narrates his love story about the curse his family possesses to a bunch of teenagers.

Indian Movies.name: Manassinakkare
Indian Movies.description: Old Kochu Thresia's family is irked by her childlike behavior and does not comply with her bizarre demands. She finds an unusual friend in Reji, a down-to-earth young man, who fulfills her demands.

Indian Movies.name: Aadi
Indian Movies.description: Aadi Keshava Reddy, a youngster, returns to his homeland after 14 years to take revenge on Nagi Reddy who killed his family.

Indian Movies.name: Villain
Indian Movies.description: Shiva, a bus conductor, robs the corrupt in order to fund an organisation that aids those with disabilities. To avoid detection and trial, he pretends to be his twin, who has disabilities.

Indian Movies.name: Xcuse Me
Indian Movies.description: Chantu and Bantu are two meddling friends who join a hotel management program in Goa by deceit. During their training, they expose the illicit activities of many hotel personnel and guests.

Indian Movies.name: Khushi
Indian Movies.description: Karan and Khushi fall in love, but her conservative family balks at accepting Karan's modern ideas.

Indian Movies.name: Thirumalai
Indian Movies.description: Thirumalai, a mechanic, falls in love with Sweta. However, her father, the owner of a TV channel, is unhappy with their relationship. He takes Arasu help to create differences between the couple.

Indian Movies.name: Armaan
Indian Movies.description: Dr Aakash Sinha has to marry a spoiled brat Sonia.By sacrificing his love for Dr Neha to full the dream of his late father Dr Siddarth Sinha.

Indian Movies.name: Zameen
Indian Movies.description: Colonel Ranvir and ACP Jaideep joins forces to fight against Pakistani terrorists, who hijacks an Indian airplane and demands to free their militant leader in return.

Indian Movies.name: Chori Chori
Indian Movies.description: Khushi (Rani Mukerji) is a careless worker always conning her boss and making excuses to bunk her duty. She meets Ranbir Malhotra (Ajay Devgan) and comes to know that the home he plans to build for his love is now a dream unfulfilled. After being dispelled from her job, her devil brain works. She locates the bungalow and moves in, informing everyone that she is Ranbir's fiancée. There she meets Ranbir's family and Pooja (Sonali Bendre), Ranbir's love. When Ranbir returns, at first he is outraged at Khushi's intrusion in his life, but then decides to play along with Khushi to make Pooja jealous and fall in love with him. During all this fun and conning, Khushi and Ranbir end up really falling in love with each other. However, Khushi's close encounter with reality and Ranbir's old commitments hold them back for a long time before they finally listen to their hearts.

Indian Movies.name: Thamizhan
Indian Movies.description: A carefree young man who works as junior lawyer turns into an honest lawyer to avenge his sister and brother-in-law by punishing the villains without taking the law in his own hands.

Indian Movies.name: Nandanam
Indian Movies.description: A woman hires a fourth domestic helper despite having three of them already working in her house. The fourth helper, a devotee of Lord Guruvayoorappan has to look after the other three.

Indian Movies.name: Gemini
Indian Movies.description: A hoodlum faces challenges from a rival gangster and local police after falling in love and deciding to go straight.

Indian Movies.name: Chronic Bachelor
Indian Movies.description: Satyapratapan (Mammootty) and Kuruvila (Innocent) are chronic bachelors. Sp's sister Sandhya lives as a paying guest in their neighbourhood. Problems begin when Mukesh and Harishree Ashokan join Mammootty and Rambha joins Sandhya.

Indian Movies.name: Red
