Hindi Language.name: The Stoneman Murders
Hindi Language.description: In 1980s Bombay, a serial killer starts targeting homeless street dwellers, whilst a suspended police officer attempts to solve the case.

Hindi Language.name: Aladin
Hindi Language.description: Since he was a child, Aladin Chatterjee has been teased for his fairytale name. As a college student he follows his namesake's footsteps; unleashing genie Genius and wooing exchange student Jasmine. But the evil Ringmaster approaches.

Hindi Language.name: Ek: The Power of One
Hindi Language.description: A hitman, Nandu, is hired to stage the assassination of a politician. However, when the politician is actually killed and Nandu is framed for the murder, he assumes a dead man's identity to evade the law.

Hindi Language.name: Thoda Pyaar Thoda Magic
Hindi Language.description: An angel, a man and 4 orphans come together to bring you a story filled with fun, excitement, tears, love and magic.

Hindi Language.name: Tashan
Hindi Language.description: What happens when you throw 2 guys who hate each other together? Add for good measure a beauty and a gangster and the trouble is no one can be trusted.

Hindi Language.name: Bairi Piya
Hindi Language.description: Bairi Piya is a comment on how the poor and the needy are exploited by rich money lenders and how hundreds of poverty stricken girls fall prey to manipulative men seeing no respite in sight.

Hindi Language.name: Roadside Romeo
Hindi Language.description: A pampered pet dog gets abandoned in Mumbai's streets, where he befriends local strays and falls for the lovely Laila. But his new life faces danger when he crosses paths with Charlie Anna, the feared local gang leader.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Bole Hadippa
Hindi Language.description: In a village where girls don't play cricket, Veera puts on a turban and beard and becomes Veer to fulfill her dreams and meets Rohan. And fun begins.

Hindi Language.name: Singh Is King
Hindi Language.description: A comic caper about Happy Singh, a Punjabi villager who goes through a series of misadventures and eventually becomes the King of the Australian underworld.

Hindi Language.name: Paa
Hindi Language.description: A father tries to help his son cope with a rare condition that causes the young boy to age beyond his years.

Hindi Language.name: Kismat Konnection
Hindi Language.description: A luckless architect discovers a social activist to be his lucky charm. Unfortunately, she's protecting the community center he's aiming to win a contract to tear down.

Hindi Language.name: Desh Drohi
Hindi Language.description: Raja arrives in Mumbai looking for a job but ends up killing the brother of a local drug dealer. Realising the corrupt nature of politics, he goes on a killing spree and kills ten people in 24 hours.

Hindi Language.name: Sunday
Hindi Language.description: An amnesiac woman fears a missing day in her life may connect her to a crime, and tries to retrace her steps between Saturday evening and Monday morning.

Hindi Language.name: Mission Istaanbul: Darr Ke Aagey Jeet Hai!
Hindi Language.description: A news reporter must uncover the secret on the 13th floor of a News Station.

Hindi Language.name: Rock On!!
Hindi Language.description: Four friends reunite to relive their moments of glory as a rock band.

Hindi Language.name: All the Best: Fun Begins
Hindi Language.description: The unexpected arrival of his elder NRI brother and assorted characters complicates the life of a Goan male.

Hindi Language.name: Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya
Hindi Language.description: Story of a girl who is forced into a marriage to a goon.they fall for each other, However she soon realised her purpose and stands up for her rights and rights of other women in the family and her husband supports her.

Hindi Language.name: Golmaal Returns
Hindi Language.description: A man is sandwiched between his over possessive wife and a police inspector, where he is suspected for adultery and murder.

Hindi Language.name: Krazzy 4
Hindi Language.description: 4 mental patients formulate the plan to rescue their kidnapped doctor and teach the kidnappers a lesson.

Hindi Language.name: Ramayan
Hindi Language.description: Ramayan is the epic tale of prince Ram.

Hindi Language.name: Luck
Hindi Language.description: An underworld kingpin recruits people endowed with 'Luck' from across the globe to take part in a series of challenges designed to test their 'Luck' factor, as gamblers around the world bet on them.

Hindi Language.name: Yuvvraaj
Hindi Language.description: Two estranged brothers must learn to work together to claim their rightful share of an inheritance left solely to their eldest sibling.

Hindi Language.name: Uttaran
Hindi Language.description: The story of two friends with opposite backgrounds.

Hindi Language.name: Pavitra Rishta
Hindi Language.description: Story of Archana, whose sole objective is to fulfill the needs of her family and keep everyone happy. How she meets her soul mate Manav, gets married to him and how they deal with twists and turns of life.

Hindi Language.name: Agyaat
Hindi Language.description: A film crew shooting in a remote forested location begins losing members one by one to a mysterious entity that they cannot see or hear.

Hindi Language.name: Phoonk
Hindi Language.description: An atheist is compelled to confront his own belief system when his daughter begins exhibiting disturbing signs of possession.

Hindi Language.name: Firaaq
Hindi Language.description: Chronicles the devastating impact on vulnerable Muslims in Gujarat after riots.

Hindi Language.name: Lapataganj
Hindi Language.description: Story revolves around people lived in village called ' Lapataganj' and main character is head postmaster Mukundilal gupta.

Hindi Language.name: Gallit Gondhal, Dillit Mujra
Hindi Language.description: Kolsewadi has never seen any progress in the village, thanks to the bickering and fights between MLA Chandrakant Tope and Sarpanch Bajirao Dole. Narayan Wagh, a villager, makes the most of this to his advantage. He manages to coax the villagers and enters the electoral fray to fight the upcoming village elections. He gets help in the way of Rebecca who has come from America to study Maharashtra Folk Art and Dance. He convinces her to study the Lauvni and perform for him at his political rally.

Hindi Language.name: Well Done Abba!
Hindi Language.description: A mild mannered chauffeur finds that the government in his parched village is giving loans to dig one's own well. After fudged photographs and bribes, he has no loan amount left to build his well. Aggrieved, he protests by abjuring water.

Hindi Language.name: Hijack
Hindi Language.description: After the passing away of his wife, Pooja, Delhi-based Vikram Madan, enrolls his daughter, Priya, in a boarding school in Amritsar and re-locates to work as a Mechanic at Chandigarh Airport. His daughter informs him that she is on her way to Amritsar on a hostel-trip on Indian Airlines Flight IC147. Shortly thereafter, Vikram will be informed that the flight has been hijacked to Dubai by Islamic terrorists, who want the Indian government to release one of their comrades, Rashid Omar, or else they will start killing the passengers and crew one by one at half-hour intervals.

Hindi Language.name: Me and Mrs. Khanna
Hindi Language.description: An unhappily married couple find love in strange situations.

Hindi Language.name: God Tussi Great Ho
Hindi Language.description: A TV anchor keeps on blaming God for his unsuccessful life. God appears and he is given the God's Power for 10 days just to see how he manages to keep everyone happy.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Vivaah... Aisa Bhi
Hindi Language.description: A middle class girl, who lives with her family, falls in love with a rich boy. On the day of her engagement her father dies. In order to take care of her siblings, she must sacrifice her love.

Hindi Language.name: London Dreams
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around two childhood friends Arjun and Munnu who find a way to get from a small village in India to Wembley as Rock stars, having overcome their personalities.

Hindi Language.name: Road, Movie
Hindi Language.description: A young man's journey across the mythic Indian landscape becomes a life-changing odyssey.

Hindi Language.name: Daddy Cool: Join the Fun
Hindi Language.description: Wealthy Goa-based Income Tax Officer Douglas Lazarus passes away after exercising on his treadmill at a speed of 10.5. A funeral is arranged, relatives are notified and his eldest hen-pecked son, Steven, prepares a farewell speech while most attendees would have preferred the second son, Brian, a successful Mumbai-based writer, to do so. At the funeral, things hilariously spiral out of control when Michael, the fiancé of Douglas' gorgeous niece, Maria, notices movement within the coffin.

Hindi Language.name: Heroes
Hindi Language.description: Two boys travel a thousand miles to deliver three letters as a part of their film school assignment. However, little do they know that the journey they have embarked upon will give a new meaning to their life.

Hindi Language.name: Acid Factory
Hindi Language.description: Five people trapped in a factory where two hostages and three are kidnappers but they them self do not know who are kidnappers and hostages.As they all are suffering from temporary memory loss.

Hindi Language.name: Do Knot Disturb
Hindi Language.description: A man and a woman have to pretend to be a couple in order to salvage a CEO's marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Miley Jab Hum Tum
Hindi Language.description: The show is about falling in love during college and developing relations for a lifetime.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Veer Stree Ki Kahaani... Jhansi Ki Rani
Hindi Language.description: Ek Veer Stree ki Kahaani... Jhansi Ki Rani is the story of an ordinary girl who went on to become an extraordinary ruler. Her defiance against the British is exemplary even today. The fervor that she aroused gave birth to various leaders and revolutionaries who finally freed our nation from the British. The show attempts to bring forth the various facets of this remarkable woman which are yet unknown to people. The Rani is shown as a mother, as a wife, as a daughter, as a warrior and essays all the roles with equal aplomb. The show is a tribute to her bravery, gallantry and patriotism. Born as Manikarnika, Lakshmi Bai, also known as 'Manu' was the daughter of a Maharashtrian Brahmin Moropant Tambe from Varanasi. While other girls of her age chose to do household chores, she played and defeated the local boys in muddy matches of kabaddi. She married Gangadhar Rao, who was the Raja of Jhansi, at a very tender age. It was after her husband's untimely demise, while she was still an adolescent that the agile Rani became a true warrior and an epitome of women's power in the country. This historical tale attempts to portray how an ordinary woman became an extraordinary exponent of Indian freedom movement.

Hindi Language.name: Superstar
Hindi Language.description: Kunal Mehra lives a middle-classed lifestyle in Borivali, Mumbai, along with his disapproving dad, Purabi, and supportive mom, Kusum. He has a sweetheart in Mausam, an aspiring Journalist. Ever since he was 8 years of age, Kunal wanted to act in Bollywood movies much to his dad's displeasure. He did play the part of Bhagwan Shri Hanuman in a play in school, but has been not very successful in landing any major part in any movie. He gets a break when his look-alike, Karan Saxena, the leading man of his dad's production 'Super Star' has qualms about heights and is unable to act. Kunal steps into Karan's shoes, and even accompanies the unit to film in Bangkok, Thailand. Shortly thereafter the media explodes with the news that Karan has been injured, and Kunal has been killed in a car accident. Watch what impact this news has on the Mehra family, the Saxenas, Mausam, as well as on the outcome of the movie.

Hindi Language.name: Jail
Hindi Language.description: Remanded to policy custody, a man reviews his options in an overcrowded jail while awaiting trial.

Hindi Language.name: Halla Bol
Hindi Language.description: A popular Bollywood actor witnesses a murder but refuses to come forward to identify the killer(s).

Hindi Language.name: Kitani Mohabbat Hai
Hindi Language.description: It's a story about a guy (Arjun) who's in prison from last 2 years and is telling his lawyer his past of being a misogynist and his love story with an aspiring Singer (Arohi). How everything changed and later destroyed. How he ended in the jail.

Hindi Language.name: Bandini
Hindi Language.description: An invigorating tale of a young girl who is forced into a marriage of convenience with an elderly man twice her age.

Hindi Language.name: C Kkompany
Hindi Language.description: Three down on their luck men adapts a strategical idea of extortion, only to find themselves in deep trouble.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Life Mein Uski Wife

Hindi Language.name: Road to Sangam
Hindi Language.description: Amidst bomb explosions, fake arrests, police brutality and protests, a determined mechanic attempts to repair an antique truck to transport the last remains of Mahatma Gandhi in modern-day India.

Hindi Language.name: Kidnap

Hindi Language.name: Jai Shri Krishna
Hindi Language.description: The series focuses on the antics of an adolescent Krishna and includes charming stories about flirting with young girls, dancing on the head of the snake and his "Raas Leela" with Radha.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Mast Hai Life
Hindi Language.description: The show centers around a group of teens at Redfield Academy.

Hindi Language.name: Victory
Hindi Language.description: An over confident cricketer who ruins his career must prove his worth by starting all over again

Hindi Language.name: Fox
Hindi Language.description: A disgraced lawyer-turned-author is arrested for multiple homicides.

Hindi Language.name: Shree
Hindi Language.description: A love story with a paranormal element.

Hindi Language.name: Kisse Pyaar Karoon?
Hindi Language.description: Two men abduct a woman who wants to alienate them from their friend.

Hindi Language.name: Do Paise Ki Dhoop, Chaar Aane Ki Baarish
Hindi Language.description: When a sex worker hires a gay songwriter to care for her disabled son, the ensuing bonds that form offer a complex portrayal of love and family.

Hindi Language.name: Karzzzz
Hindi Language.description: A singer/dancer, while on tour, starts hallucinating and having visions of having been there before.

Hindi Language.name: Raja Ki Aayegi Baraat
Hindi Language.description: The journey of a Rani as she goes from a servant to the queen of the palace and how she manages the responsibilities of a queen and the elder daughter-in-law.

Hindi Language.name: Aloo Chaat
Hindi Language.description: Story focuses on a US return guy Nikhil who is in love with a Muslim girl Aamna (Aamna Shariff). To convince his orthodox Hindu family which a strictly against a Muslim girl Nikhil plots a drama with the help of his uncle Hakeem Tarachand and hires a girl Nikki to play his girlfriend from US while Aamna plays her friend. While both the girls stays at Nikhil's place Aamna tries to win the heart of Nikhil's family with of course Nikhil trying to highlight the misbehaviors of Nikki and cultured behavior of Aamna to change his family's perception. Nikhil, Aamna and Nikki have to face a lot of twist & turns, and with Nikhil's mama Chaddami at their back it won't be easy for the trio to accomplish their mission

Hindi Language.name: Hello
Hindi Language.description: Call-center workers receive a phone call from God.

Hindi Language.name: Bahubali
Hindi Language.description: Babhubali means a most powerful person, he can manage and control every situation and boss of the village.

Hindi Language.name: Teree Sang: A Kidult Love Story
Hindi Language.description: An under-aged couple fall in love, face opposition from the girl's wealthy parents, elope and go on the run from the police.

Hindi Language.name: Dashavatar
Hindi Language.description: Evil has been present during the evolution of mankind and the Dashavatar (ten incarnations of Hindu God Vishnu) have been constantly present to triumph over evil.

Hindi Language.name: Sarkar Raj
Hindi Language.description: An even more powerful gang emerges to wipe out Sarkar from the playground. A power plant proposal becomes a cause for greater political turmoil around him. What happens to the Family?

Hindi Language.name: Mr. White Mr. Black
Hindi Language.description: Hoshiarpur based Gopi's dying father asks him to locate Kishen and hand-over a piece of land to him, and subsequently passes away. Gopi heads out to Goa and this is where he will be taken for a ride not only by Kishen, but also by Kishen's look-alike hoodlum brother, Hari; and get involved, along with a group of assorted characters, in the location of diamonds that were stolen by three women.

Hindi Language.name: EMI: Liya Hai to Chukana Padega
Hindi Language.description: Sattar Bhai runs a collection agency called Good Luck Recovery in Mumbai's Bhindi Bazar area. Famous for his notoriety, he uses unconventional methods to make four defaulters repay their debts.

Hindi Language.name: Wafaa
Hindi Language.description: A recently widowed woman must deal with a male claiming to be her husband.

Hindi Language.name: What's Your Raashee?
Hindi Language.description: A young man has only ten days to locate his soulmate as dictated by the stars, otherwise he could lose a fortune. He thus embarks on a journey through love, looking through twelve girls to find the one who fits his horoscope.

Hindi Language.name: Naam
Hindi Language.description: A professional killer loses his memory after a near-fatal mishap. Piecing his life, he's ensnared in a perilous game with the CBI and implacable foes. Every revelation about his past uncovers deeper enigmas, that changes everything.

Hindi Language.name: Paying Guests
Hindi Language.description: Four friends' attempts to find employment and accommodation pits them against landlords and gangsters in Bangkok.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Pyar Na Hoga Kam
Hindi Language.description: Abeer who lives in Lucknow belongs to a Brahmin family. No sooner does he set eyes on Leher than he is undoubtedly smitten by her. They face numerous problems as they belong to different castes.

Hindi Language.name: India's Got Talent
Hindi Language.description: An Indian reality television series on Colors television network, and part of the global Got Talent variety acts reality series.

Hindi Language.name: Dance India Dance
Hindi Language.description: A reality dance competition.

Hindi Language.name: Bhootwala Serial
Hindi Language.description: Vicky inherits his grandfather's old bungalow. He starts a guest house business not realizing that a family of ghosts has made themselves quite at home.

Hindi Language.name: Jumbo
Hindi Language.description: Since childhood Jumbo (Jaidev) is taunted by other Elephants about his father being a coward. Jumbo decides leaves his house to find his father who was a war Elephant. But on the way he is captured by raiding party but escapes with help of prince. Years later in a village where Elephants and Humans live together villagers rebel against a tax collector and defeat him. The king of Elephants then calls the other Elephants to his palace where Jumbo's mother Devi recognizes him. The king also notices Jumbo from his childhood and keeps him as his personal war Elephant. Jumbo during a war comes across a giant and evil Elephant Bhaktawar and finds he was also responsible for his fathers death and wants to seeks revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Short Kut: The Con Is On
Hindi Language.description: After his script is plagiarized, and he is forced to marry, an unemployed movie writer self-destructs.

Hindi Language.name: Rehna Hai Teri Palkon Ki Chhaon Mein
Hindi Language.description: A heart- warming tale of an orphan girl Suman, whose dreams of finding family and love come true when she is accepted by a very lovable and traditional joint family. She finds both a loving family and the love of her life Karan, in this new home. But fate intrudes as she realizes that Karan's mother has ordained her for his elder brother Karthik. She eventually realizes that destiny has its own way of granting wishes and it ultimately gives you what you truly deserve. Set in the heart of India, the story of loving, losing and rediscovering love unfolds grandeur, magnificence and scenic beauty of Madhya Pradesh.

Hindi Language.name: The Legend of Drona
Hindi Language.description: A young man learns he is the latest in line of a dynasty of ancestral warriors dedicated to guarding a mystic source of cosmic energy, and the time has come for him to take the role.

Hindi Language.name: Kal Kissne Dekha
Hindi Language.description: Born with the ability to foretell the future, Chandigarh-based Nihaal Singh, re-locates to study in a Mumbai-based college. He meets with and falls in love with snobbish and rude Nisha Kapoor, who subsequently becomes a little humble after he rescues her and others by assisting ACP Pradhan to diffuse a bomb in a busy shopping mall. Nihaal will soon find his life changing after he becomes involved with his college's professor Siddharth Verma; is on the hit list of Don Kalicharan; and a terrorist group that wants to enlist his help in planting explosives in busy locales all over Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Jashnn: The Music Within
Hindi Language.description: A singer faces challenges after falling in love with a woman whose brother is having an affair with his sister.

Hindi Language.name: Kisaan
Hindi Language.description: A bitter family battle ensues between a father and his sons when a businessman makes a deal that entices farmers to sell off their properties.

Hindi Language.name: Sanam Teri Kasam
Hindi Language.description: A love triangle forms after a male finds his best friend has married his sweetheart.

Hindi Language.name: Cambala Investigation Agency
Hindi Language.description: Five friends form an organization to solve crimes in their town

Hindi Language.name: Ugly Aur Pagli
Hindi Language.description: An Engineering student's life changes drastically after the entry of an alcoholic and spunky woman.

Hindi Language.name: Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil
Hindi Language.description: Eternal and passionate love story of Prem and Heer who are destined to be together from their childhood.

Hindi Language.name: Mukhbiir
Hindi Language.description: A youth is compelled by police to infiltrate gangs and terrorist groups.

Hindi Language.name: Sajan Ghar Jana Hai
Hindi Language.description: After learning that her mother belongs to a lower caste, Ganga's father-in-law refuses to accept her into his family. After her mother's death, she goes to work as a maid in her husband's house.

Hindi Language.name: Maruti Mera Dosst
Hindi Language.description: A young woman narrates the story of her friendship with Maruti - none other than Rambhakt Bhagwan Shri Hanumanji.

Hindi Language.name: Indian Premier League
Hindi Language.description: The best cricket players on the planet converge for the epic battle that will transcend all barriers. For die hard cricket fans.

Hindi Language.name: Na Aana Iss Des Laado
Hindi Language.description: A powerful lady from a village 'Ammaji' who decrees that newly born girls would be killed by drowning them in milk, and many other such acts. Ammaji are very anti-women.

Hindi Language.name: U Me Aur Hum
Hindi Language.description: Ajay's life turns upside down when he learns that his wife Piya has Alzheimer and he has no option, but to leave his wife in a mental hospital.

Hindi Language.name: Sajan Re Jhoot Mat Bolo
Hindi Language.description: Apoorva needs job and he found it at Dhirubhai Jhaveri's Multinational company. He met Aarti (Dhirubhai Jhaveri's Niece) and falls in love with her. For her niece Dhirubhai wanted guy who has family. Apoorva didn't have. So Apoorva and his best friend Raju builds up a fake family. Dhirubhai hates lies. Now the show revolves around the efforts by Apoorva and the members of fake family, to hide the secret from Dhirubhai that the family is not real.

Hindi Language.name: Main Teri Parchhain Hoon
Hindi Language.description: The story of an emotional young woman, Aanchal, who follows her conscience and tries to set right the wrong she has unknowingly, unintentionally and inadvertently done to a family.

Hindi Language.name: Kahaani Hamaaray Mahaabhaarat Ki
Hindi Language.description: Modern adaptation of the epic Mahabharata.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbai Cutting
Hindi Language.description: Eleven directors tell eleven different stories about Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Black & White
Hindi Language.description: A spy living in the house in disguise, who has a heart transformation.

Hindi Language.name: Red Alert: The War Within
Hindi Language.description: An impoverished cook is forced to join a band of Naxalites.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Malegaon Ka Superman
Hindi Language.description: A thin, awkward superman brings hope to Malegaon in this comedic parody that blends social commentary with playful jabs at Bollywood superhero conventions.

Hindi Language.name: Pirate's Blood
Hindi Language.description: A group of pirates keeps their bounty in a cave, guarded by the captain. Getting bored by the same monotones life, The Captain decided to share the bounty among the pirates.

Hindi Language.name: Vaada Raha... I Promise
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Duke Chawla, a paralytic patient, awaits death as his fiancee leaves him, but then he befriends a terminally-ill boy who helps him to live life to the fullest.

Hindi Language.name: Straight
Hindi Language.description: After being rejected by women, a restaurant-owner attempts to deal with homosexuality.

Hindi Language.name: Shaurya Aur Suhani
Hindi Language.description: This is a tale of two lovers. A tale imbibed in magic, Suhani the princess of Kalpi kingdom falls for the brave and handsome Shaurya, a commoner. He is unaware of his royal heritage, that he is the rightful heir to the throne Suhani's father Maharaj Takshak sits on. Will their fate, their past, mistakes their family commited let them be together? Will this world of magic let their love survive?

Hindi Language.name: Jyoti
Hindi Language.description: The series revolves around the daily struggles of Jyoti who is the only earning member of her family. It captures the social atrocities prevailing in our society. The series has portrayed many serious issues beautifully through several story lines that run parallel and has depicted the social evils in a realistic form. The events that occur in the show are very relatable to the "middle class" culture and show how vulnerability causes destruction.

Hindi Language.name: Raat Gayi, Baat Gayi?
Hindi Language.description: Following a wild party, a married man meets with his friends in order to try and remember his indiscretions.

Hindi Language.name: Agle Janam Mohe Bitiya Hi Kijo
Hindi Language.description: Young Laali is optimistic about life; courage and compassion are her strengths when it comes to rescuing her family from hunger and poverty, as she shoulders this responsibility with her father.

Hindi Language.name: Chal Chala Chal
Hindi Language.description: After winning a lawsuit against his former employer, an ex-headmaster and his son inherit a rundown school bus. Their attempt to start fresh takes an unexpected turn.

Hindi Language.name: Barah Aana
Hindi Language.description: Three impoverished roommates kidnap middle-class men and demand small ransoms to improve their lifestyles.

Hindi Language.name: The New Adventures of Hanuman
Hindi Language.description: Maruti finds a divine mace locket that falls from the sky and gives him extraordinary powers. As Maruti picks up the locket, Lord Hanuman appears before him to inform him that he is chosen and destined to protect humanity from all evil.

Hindi Language.name: De Taali
Hindi Language.description: Paglu and Amu are childhood friends of Abhi and decide to save him from marrying the wrong girl. But then things go out of hand and it leads to chaotic and hilarious situations.

Hindi Language.name: Aapki Antara
Hindi Language.description: Aapki Antara is the story of a five-year-old girl named Antara. She is born to Anuradha who had a relationship out of wedlock with Aditya. When Anuradha dies in a car accident, Antara is orphaned. It is now the responsibility of Aditya to take her home to his wife Vidya and son Abhishek and accept her as a part of the family. With Antara in their life, things are not the same again in Aditya and Vidya's lives. Antara does not behave like a normal child. She cannot express emotions and lives in her own world. To the outside world she is a day dreamer and a slow child. During the course of time, Antara was lost and found Aditya discovers that she has autism. He is then faced with a challenge to bring up his special child and get her accepted by the society. Through the story, the show guides people to understand the needs of people suffering from this condition and to deal with them sensitively.

Hindi Language.name: Mehbooba
Hindi Language.description: After dreaming of a beautiful girl for over 8 years, Budapest-based but born in Rajasthan, Karan, finally gets to meet her in the shape and form of Varsha, who happens to be the foster daughter of his lawyer, Sahid. Karan is confident that Sahid will convince Varsha to marry him - little knowing that Varsha will not only refuse to marry but she also hates men, and had a parallel New York-based lifestyle as Payal Mehra.

Hindi Language.name: Summer 2007
Hindi Language.description: A group of medical students lead a carefree life. However, when they head to a village that witnesses many farmer suicide cases, they encounter local thugs and strive to survive.

Hindi Language.name: Fast Forward
Hindi Language.description: A dance group faces challenges and betrayal after competing against reigning champions in an underground dance competition.

Hindi Language.name: Sankat City
Hindi Language.description: A petty car thief and his garage-owner partner get in the bad books of a ruthless gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Ladies Special
Hindi Language.description: Three women living in the city of Mumbai become friends while commuting in a local train meant only for ladies. Eventually, they help each other face some of the biggest challenges in their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Mitwa - Phool Kamal Ke
Hindi Language.description: The drama is set in UP where rigid caste system and tradition prevail.

Hindi Language.name: Aa Dekhen Zara
Hindi Language.description: A photographer has nothing going for him, until he inherits a camera that has the ability to predict the future. In the process, he gains dangerous enemies who wants his camera for illicit goals.

Hindi Language.name: Money Hai Toh Honey Hai
Hindi Language.description: Six talented but luckless individuals, some wasting life in dreams of fast, easy life inherit a1000-crore empire 120% in debt, from an eccentric, senile billionaire, changing their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Morning Walk
Hindi Language.description: A retired professor experiences changes after going to visit his son.

Hindi Language.name: Baabarr
Hindi Language.description: A young lad from a crime-laden family grows up to be a much-feared gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Y.M.I. Yeh Mera India
Hindi Language.description: Lives of several people intertwine during an eventful day in Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Aseema: Beyond Boundaries
Hindi Language.description: A divorced mother faces a challenge after she receives a proposal of marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Aao Wish Karein
Hindi Language.description: Smitten by a 22-year old woman, a 12-year old boy's wish to be older comes true.

Hindi Language.name: Chamku
Hindi Language.description: A traumatized child becomes a Naxalite, and upon being captured must agree to become a police-assassin.

Hindi Language.name: Dharam Veer
Hindi Language.description: A fictional tale of two princes, named Dharam and Veer, and their adventures as they traverse the path of life.

Hindi Language.name: Anamika: The Untold Story
Hindi Language.description: Middle-classed, slender and petite Jia Rao meets Gajner's recently widowed Kunver Vikram Aditya Singh Sesodia, both fall in love, get married, and re-locate to live in his palace in Rajasthan. Jia finds out that everyone in the vicinity still believes that Vikram's first wife, Anamika, who allegedly met a sudden death, may still be alive, and actually witnesses an apparition in the palace grounds. She is not permitted to enter in to a certain section of the palace where Anamika had her residential quarters. However, she does manage to find her way there, and decides to follow in Anamika's lavish and sophisticated footsteps, invoking a sudden change in Vikram affections. Meanwhile local Police Inspector Pratap, none other than Vikram's brother-in-law, continues his investigation and collects evidence in order to arrest Vikram for Anamika's death.

Hindi Language.name: Black
Hindi Language.description: As two investigators Ranvir and Aaliya try to solve several mysterious deaths, they come upon a 12 year old boy who is the only common link between the deaths.

Hindi Language.name: Three: Love, Lies, Betrayal
Hindi Language.description: A lonely and neglected wife has an affair with her tenant.

Hindi Language.name: Iss Jungle Se Mujhe Bachao
Hindi Language.description: Two teams of celebrities must compete each other in order to survive in the jungle by completing different challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Ru-Ba-Ru
Hindi Language.description: Bangkok-based Tara Mishra and Nikhil Singh meet at a wedding ceremony and fall instantly in love with love with each. They move in together and continue to live a fairly blissful lifestyle until Tara is invited to India to attend a wedding. Nikhil not only refuses to accompany her but also refuses to introduce his widowed mother, Meera, who is now living with another male, Dilip, to her. Tara, a talented singer/dancer, feels neglected as he is always focused on his business, is not prepared to make any long-time commitment, and forgets important events. An encounter with a taxi-driver compels Nikhil to change his mind, but things do no work out, Tara leaves him and shortly thereafter passes away in an accident. A devastated and guilt-ridding Nikhil returns home, cradling her photo and falls asleep. He wakes up the next morning with Tara alive and well next to him. Was he hallucinating the events from the previous day or was he being warned by fate to change his ways?

Hindi Language.name: Jimmy
Hindi Language.description: A mechanical engineer moonlighting as a DJ is convicted of murder. While in prison, he discovers he's been framed in a complex conspiracy. Now he must race against time to prove his innocence.

Hindi Language.name: Haal-e-Dil
Hindi Language.description: While traveling by train Shekhar attempts to woo Sanjana Sharma, but finds out she had given her heart to a former boyfriend, Rohit, who is no more. Both share some misadventures en-route to Simla, and upon arrival Shekhar openly declares his love for her knowing fully that this decision will bring nothing but heartbreak for him.

Hindi Language.name: Khallballi: Fun Unlimited
Hindi Language.description: Chaos ensues when the residents of a hotel finds out that a bomb is planted.

Hindi Language.name: Babul Ka Aangann Chootey Na
Hindi Language.description: Aastha marries but her life is an act of balancing the responsibilities of a daughter-in-law and the duty of a daughter. Can she fulfill both the roles with equal panache?

Hindi Language.name: Saas Bahu Aur Sensex
Hindi Language.description: Upper middle-class women leave daytime soaps to invest in the stock market.

Hindi Language.name: Yaar Meri Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: A story of two friends, one is Thakur and the other a doctor. A journey how two friends egos clash and they turn foes.

Hindi Language.name: Gumnaam: The Mystery
Hindi Language.description: A male tries to locate his model-turned-actress girlfriend after she mysteriously disappears.

Hindi Language.name: Thanks Maa
Hindi Language.description: A homeless petty thief attempts to find the biological mother of an abandoned baby.

Hindi Language.name: Mahima Shani Dev Ki
Hindi Language.description: 'Mahima Shani Dev Ki' TV show breaks all the myths and misunderstandings about Lord Shani (Saturn), one of the nine heavenly objects known as Navagraha in Hindu astrology.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Aane Ko Hai
Hindi Language.description: The series revolves around the tales of alleged supernatural occurrences in the city that involves around various haunted houses, ghouls and the undead.

Hindi Language.name: When Kiran Met Karen
Hindi Language.description: A famous Bollywood actress, Kiran, meets a lesbian journalist, Karen - 3 days before the release of her international film - 'A Himalayan Love Story'.

Hindi Language.name: Children of the Pyre
Hindi Language.description: This documentary follows the life of Seven children who are working under extreme conditions at India's busiest cremation ground, Manikarnika in Banaras.

Hindi Language.name: Phir Tauba Tauba
Hindi Language.description: Three adolescent Indian guys staying in London have girlfriends there. They chance upon a hot married neighbour and try to woo her individually. Willl they succeed?

Hindi Language.name: Houseful
Hindi Language.description: Nikhil Banerjee's films are a disaster at the box office and at the festival circuit.

Hindi Language.name: Sunaina
Hindi Language.description: The show revolves around a 15-year-old girl Sunaina who has an ability to see the future in her dreams and follows the misadventures by those dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Veeru: Friends Forever
Hindi Language.description: Best friends Jai and Veeru teams up together to nab the dreaded don Tejpal. In the process their friendship is tested.

Hindi Language.name: Oh, My God!!
Hindi Language.description: An employee puts more time trying to get people to invest in a novel money-making scheme.

Hindi Language.name: Raaz Pichhle Janam Ka
Hindi Language.description: The host interacts with the participants and celebrities as they talk about a particular problem for which they wish to find a solution. They are then initiated into a past-life regression session.

Hindi Language.name: % De Dhana Dhan
Hindi Language.description: The kayfabe plot of the show involved the Indian wrestlers being trapped in South Africa and stumbling upon an underground fight league headed by Mark Beale and WWP.

Hindi Language.name: Woodstock Villa
Hindi Language.description: A businessman's wife approaches a cash-strapped man to kidnap her and test her husband's love for her, but was her unexpected death part of the plan?

Hindi Language.name: Raajkumar Aaryyan
Hindi Language.description: This is the journey of a young prince - Aaryyan and his mentor Bhootnath across ethereal worlds where they overcome sorcery, magical creatures and other demons to protect the prince's family, his countrymen and his love Bhairavi.

Hindi Language.name: Fatso!
Hindi Language.description: Killed too soon due to a clerical error in heaven, a man is sent back to earth with a new lease on life, this time in the body of his portly friend.

Hindi Language.name: Bachelor Party
Hindi Language.description: A man decides to have a wild bachelor party before his marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Aagey Se Right
Hindi Language.description: Spurred on by his pushy mother, Kanta, slacker Dinkar Waghmare, infatuated with TV Reporter, Soniya Bhatt, is compelled to join the Mumbai Police Force as a Sub-Inspector and follow in his late father's footsteps. On his way to Mumbai, his service revolver gets stolen by three youth. His hilarious attempts to recover it leads him to assorted characters and situations which include an underground den of organized criminal don Raghav Shetty; the suicidal daughter, Suhasi, of Police Commissioner Digvijay Mathur; an angry resident, Hasmukh Irani, who is threatening to kill the Mayor; a lovelorn terrorist, Balma Rashidul Khairi, who has been sent to plant an explosive in an 1800-plus gathering of Mumbai's police officers.

Hindi Language.name: Runway: Love Among Gun Shots...
Hindi Language.description: A man decides to become an assassin in order to save the life of his future wife.

Hindi Language.name: Jasuben Jayantilaal Joshi Ki Joint Family
Hindi Language.description: Jasuben along with her husband Jayantilaal Joshi looks after their joint family of around thirty members and overcome various challenges together.

Hindi Language.name: Bhram: An Illusion
Hindi Language.description: A substance-abusing model believes that her wealthy boyfriend's brother molested and killed her sister.

Hindi Language.name: Blue Oranges
Hindi Language.description: An alcoholic, love lost woman is murdered creating suspects out of a painter, a student and a pilot.

Hindi Language.name: Shadow
Hindi Language.description: A series of high-profile murders committed by a super-smart killer leave the police flummoxed. Who is he and how is he finally captured?

Hindi Language.name: Waaris
Hindi Language.description: The story is based on the life of an underworld mafia don, Rudra Pratap Singh, who is searching for a true or suitable "Waaris" (inherent, heir) for the position that he created in his criminal-world.

Hindi Language.name: Raakh: A Poem Masked in Blood
Hindi Language.description: After losing his love to the son of a gangster, a loyal gang-member must try and protect his family.

Hindi Language.name: Sikandar
Hindi Language.description: An orphaned teen in Kashmir finds a pistol and befriends a mysterious man who teaches him shooting. As political tensions rise in his town, the boy becomes unwittingly entangled in a dangerous conflict between militants and authorities.

Hindi Language.name: Aye Dil-E-Nadaan
Hindi Language.description: The series is based on a story of an innocent girl Simran who is forcefully married to a rich man Vikram for money.

Hindi Language.name: Hari Puttar: A Comedy of Terrors
Hindi Language.description: Inadvertently left at home by adults, young cousins face-off against burglars.

Hindi Language.name: Jo Jeeta Wohi Super Star
Hindi Language.description: This show aims to bring all the winners and runners-up of various singing reality shows completed previously to compete together for the 'Superstar' title.

Hindi Language.name: Bal Ganesh 2
Hindi Language.description: Lord Ganesha evolves from a mischievous boy, who is not only innocent but also intelligent, to an elephant-headed god, who embarks on a series of adventures with his friends to defeat evil forces.

Hindi Language.name: Sorry Bhai!
Hindi Language.description: While attending his brother's wedding, a Scientist falls for the bride.

Hindi Language.name: Jeevan Saathi: Humsafar Zindagi Ke
Hindi Language.description: About a girl face a lots of problems with her family to reach to her boyfriend which her family stopped in their way .

Hindi Language.name: Love Khichdi
Hindi Language.description: A talented Sous-Chef woos a variety of women with a view of using them to try and fulfill his dream.

Hindi Language.name: Horn 'OK' Pleassss
Hindi Language.description: Govinda, a truck driver and billionaire, helps Ajay get his love Sia, the twin sister of Govinda's wife Ria. Govinda, unaware about Ajay's love interest ends up planning Ajay's meeting with himself leading to a chain of incidents.

Hindi Language.name: Dhara
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Sagar is a London-based psychiatrist who works in a hospital. He is strongly opposed to shock therapy as a treatment for mentally ill patients, which is a source of conflict with his colleagues. One day he accidentally saves a girl who is being attacked by a group of men, and takes her home. The girl, Dhara, is behaving extremely childishly, and Sagar quickly finds out that she is mentally disturbed, but not retarded. He decides to keep her out of the hospital, and to take care of her at his own place. As a result of Dr. Sagar's careful treatment and a lot of domestic warmth, Dhara's condition gradually improves. Simultaneously, they slowly fall in love with each other, and Sagar even plans marrying her. When Sagan has to leave for India for a while, he friend Sahil comes to visit him, and decided to stay in his home until he returns. There he stumbles upon Dhara, almost healthy now, and the two fall in love quickly. When Sagar returns from India, he catches them in the act. Sagar, completely broken by this incident, loses his mind himself. Now it is Dhara's turn to take care of Sagar. However, once she succeeds, he loses it herself again.

Hindi Language.name: Saluun
Hindi Language.description: Asok, a small-town simpleton, gets entangled in a thick web of corrupt government machinery when his road side salon gets picked up by the local municipality. He is desperate to free his salon from the clutches of the corrupt officials. But before he realizes, the Salon is burnt in front of his very eyes on the eve of Holi, the festival of colors. Pushed to the wall, Asok, takes on the municipal officers. His weapon is deceit. He puts up an elaborate scheme to give it back to the officials.

Hindi Language.name: Bombay to Bangkok
Hindi Language.description: A chef, in possession of a stolen gangster's money, flees to Thailand where he poses as a doctor.

Hindi Language.name: Jo Kahunga Sach Kahunga
Hindi Language.description: A young Advocate, Ujjwala Rawat fights cases to bring the criminals to justice.

Hindi Language.name: Jugni Chali Jalandhar
Hindi Language.description: A girl from London (England) travels to small town Jagtaaria in Jalandhar, Punjab,India in order to change the conservative outlook of her boyfriend's family. But first she has to pretend to be an illiterate.

Hindi Language.name: Antardwand
Hindi Language.description: A young man is kidnapped by a local strongman with the intention of forcing him to marry his daughter to secure a family alliance.

Hindi Language.name: Kaash Mere Hote
Hindi Language.description: A man is caught between one woman's love and another's obsession.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Kya Hoga Johnny
Hindi Language.description: An abused boy who sells coffee on a bicycle gets involved in a robbery.

Hindi Language.name: Team: The Force
Hindi Language.description: Three aspiring music artistes endanger their lives after they get into the bad books of a gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Mere Sapne
Hindi Language.description: The story, focuses on the issue of migration when youths from rural North India come to the city of dreams, Mumbai, but are exploited. Sarju comes to Mumbai to make a living for his family, while his wife Radha stays home and tends to their family.She is more rooted and attached to her soil whereas Sarju desires and aspires to conquer the skies. He is restless and adventurous forever ready to take risks and explore newer shores in search of a new identity. The show depicts a cultural difference between rural India and the modern city and deals with various local issues such as illiteracy, caste system, gender exploitation, issues of infertility, status of women and the pain of displacement.

Hindi Language.name: Tujh Sang Preet Lagai Sajna
Hindi Language.description: Balwant and Vikramaditya used to be best friends despite the fact that the latter was a land owner and the former was a farmer. Their friendship was an example for everyone and they were inseparable until one horrible day. Balwant's daughter Simran was supposed to marry Vikramaditya's son Sumer. But it turned out that Sumer was already married (and had a son with his wife Bindya). Sumer hadn't told anyone. On the day of his proposed marriage to Simran, Sumer runs away to get Bindiya and tells Vikramaditya everything. Simran follows Sumer to tell him that she respects his decision and she doesn't want to marry him if he is already married. Simran is heartbroken as she has loved Sumer since her childhood but she swallows her pain in order to make him happy. Balwant and Vikramaditya reach the train station, where Simran and Sumer are standing. A car runs over Simran. In a fit of rage Balwant's son Kuldeep shoots Sumer. Kuldeep goes to jail and the families become sworn enemies. Kaliganj (the village where they live) gets divided into two parts (Pratapgarh - Kishanganj) and separated by a border which no one can cross. One either belongs to Kishanganj (Vikramaditya's village) or Pratapgarh (Balwant's village). Sumer's son Yug (one year old at the time) is sent to London to study and stay away from the enmity in the village. Kuldeep's daughter Vrinda (born on the day of the shoot-out) is considered unlucky in the family by everyone except Balwant, as her father (Kuldeep) went to jail and her aunt (Simran) died the day she was born.

Hindi Language.name: Maat Pitaah Ke Charnon Mein Swarg
Pati Patni Aur Woh
Hindi Language.description: Pati Patni Aur Woh was an Indian reality television show. It is the Indian version of The The Baby Borrowers (2008).

Hindi Language.name: Bhaskar Bharti
Hindi Language.description: Bhaskar turns into a woman as a result of being cursed by one of his love interests named Geeta.

Hindi Language.name: Chintu Ji
Hindi Language.description: Rishi, the son of legendary Raj Kapoor, decides to try his hand at politics, and to garner support, re-locates to his birth village, Hadbahedi. The village is located in an isolated area where most trains do not stop, and electricity is only available for about 6 hours a day. He also decides to shoot a film 'Khooni Khazana' with Producer/Director, Malkani. Once there, he secretly makes a deal to lend his name to an alcoholic beverage, in exchange for a plot of land in nearby Triphala, and one Crore Rupees, while pledging to the naive villagers that he has no intention to re-locating anywhere. Misled villagers believe Hadbahedi will get popular and modernized, and decide to assist him with all their might. Things escalate into chaos, and anger, when they find out that their valuables are being stolen, and the women being molested, by the film crew, while the police accuse them of harboring a terrorist who was responsible for the December 13, 2001, attack on the Indian Parliament.

Hindi Language.name: Rama Rama Kya Hai Dramaaa
Hindi Language.description: Two bank employees face problems after marrying very attractive women.

Hindi Language.name: Sacch Ka Saamna
Hindi Language.description: Indian version of the U.S. game show The Moment of Truth.

Hindi Language.name: Hulla
Hindi Language.description: A stockbroker who moves into a flat finds that he cannot sleep because of the loud whistle blown by the night-watchman. This leads him into conflict with the building's secretary who insists on the use of the whistle.

Hindi Language.name: Yahan Mein Ghar Ghar Kheli
Hindi Language.description: After getting married to Karan Prasad, Swarn Abha lives a life full of struggles and challenges. However, with the love and support of Karan, she manages to muddle through any difficult circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Shraddha
Hindi Language.description: A young girl named Shraddha, who lives in small town Ujjain. She devotes her whole life fulfilling her parent's wishes and serving them till death.

Hindi Language.name: Jugaad
Hindi Language.description: A man faces financial losses after authorities decide to demolish his business.

Hindi Language.name: Meera
Hindi Language.description: When Meera gets lord Krishna's statue, she falls in love with it. As she grows, her love deepens for the lord and she starts to consider herself as his wife. Will love for the lord alter Meera's life?

Hindi Language.name: Vighnaharta Shree Siddhivinayak
Hindi Language.description: Vighnaharta Shree Siddhivinayak is a film based on the real-life stories and of Shree Siddhivinayak experienced by devotees. Its a film about human values and beliefs.

Hindi Language.name: Kyunki Jeena Issi Ka Naam Hai
Hindi Language.description: Kyunki.Jeena Issi Ka Naam Hai focusses on the vital messages found in Facts for Life and aims at reaching mostly rural and unprivileged people with vital information in terms of short stories to improve the standards of women and children.

Hindi Language.name: Zor Lagaa Ke... Haiya!
Hindi Language.description: Children build a tree-house to spy on a beggar, than seek his help against a builder.

Hindi Language.name: Pranali: The Tradition
Hindi Language.description: Forced into traditional prostitution, a woman speaks out against tyranny, oppression and corruption in modern secular India.

Hindi Language.name: Marega Salaa
Hindi Language.description: A disgraced police officer investigates the homicide of a popular musician.

Hindi Language.name: Rafoo Chakkar: Fun on the Run
Hindi Language.description: Refusing to obey their widower father, Harbans Singh, and get married to the girls of his choice, two slacker brothers, Manjeet and Parmeet, run away from home with Five Lakh Rupees. After their cash is stolen, they take to crime, are arrested, but subsequently released. They end up getting arrested again - this time for Attempted Murder & Attempted Rape - and the only way they can escape conviction and a long prison term is by getting married to their victims - two elderly heiress' sisters, Kokila and Koena Chandnani.

Hindi Language.name: Ganesh Leela
Hindi Language.description: Story of Lord Ganesha

Hindi Language.name: Mere Khwabon Mein Jo Aaye
Hindi Language.description: Mere Khwabon Mein Jo Aaye is the story of Maya. Maya lives in New Delhi, is married to Vikram and has a daughter Priya. Maya's life is mundane and centres around her family. One evening she overhears a conversation between her husband and another woman and realises that he's having an affair. Her simple, family centric life around her breaks down and she realises how Vikram had slowly degenerated her confidence and self esteem in the past few years of their marriage. He stopped her from singing and abandoning all her dreams. During a conversation with her neighbour Mrs Mathur, who is looking for an ideal tenant, she conjures up her fantasy man, Jai. Through Jai, who keeps reoccurring in her dreams in different avtars, she regains her confidence. He inspires her to pursue her ultimate dream of singing. With the help of her neighbours, a young band, she embarks on realising her dreams. Will her fantasy turn into reality or will reality hinder her dreams?

Hindi Language.name: Sabki Laadli Bebo
Hindi Language.description: An Affluent, respectable, traditional Punjabi family of three brothers and their parents always yearned for a girl. Their happiness knew no bounds when, after years, God answered their prayers and a daughter was born.

Hindi Language.name: Lo Ho Gayi Pooja Iss Ghar Ki
Hindi Language.description: Pooja runs away from home on her wedding day to fulfill her dream of becoming a singer. She meets SRK and enters his house as a cook. The story revolves around how she wins the hearts of his family

Hindi Language.name: Madholal Keep Walking
Hindi Language.description: A man's life changes after he sustains an injury in a terrorist attack.

Hindi Language.name: Thodi Life Thoda Magic
Hindi Language.description: People in general, in order to secure the future ruin the present... They are always looking around for magic to happen someday in their lives.. Without realising that Magic exists in the present moment.. It is how make that moment magical. The story is about MK, the man from the streets, who brings smiles to the lives of people he meets. He comes in the lives of 5 people who are busy fighting for their dreams in this competitive world of media and television, he touches their lives and moves on... The crux of the story is cease the moment.. Happiness and Magic is not external but lies within you..

Hindi Language.name: Radio: Love on Air
Hindi Language.description: Still in love with his recently divorced wife, a RJ is asked to fake a romance with another woman to improve ratings.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Tho Chance
Hindi Language.description: This film is a colorful mural of the lives of individuals from Bombay city's diverse cultural, social and economic strata.

Hindi Language.name: Jo Ishq Ki Marzi Woh Rab Ki Marzi
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around the lives of two 'Zamindar' (rich landlords) families who turn from friends to enemies.

Hindi Language.name: Sirf
Hindi Language.description: An Assistant Director in Bollywood, Rahul Bajaj is in love with Shalu. He wants to marry her, so meets her parents and gets their conditional approval. However, he is given 3 months to find a flat or Shalu's marriage will be re-arranged to a Surat-based groom. Namita and Akash Ranade are caught up in their respective lives, but take time to resolve a neighbor's problem but delay in getting medical treatment for their daughter, Anushka. Amit and Suchita Soni are a newly married couple, very much in love until she discovers he is having an affair with his boss. Devika and her husband, Gaurav, contemplate divorce, as he suspects her of aborting a child, whose biological father is unknown. He has her movements spied upon. All four families are fated to meet each other in a variety of ways, changing their lives forever.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Se Bure Do
Hindi Language.description: Two petty thieves face-off against gangsters, bandits and police after forging a treasure map.

Hindi Language.name: Maan Gaye Mughall-E-Azam
Hindi Language.description: Shunned by local authorities for wanting to stage a political satire, a drama company joins forces with a RAW agent to save the country when an enemy swears to wipe out its existence.

Hindi Language.name: Fruit & Nut
Hindi Language.description: A madcap comedy film that revolves around Jolly Maker (Cyrus Broacha), a simple, hard-working bachelor in search of love, money, friends and success.

Hindi Language.name: Chanchal
Hindi Language.description: A young woman's story of being ordered around and having her life controlled by her dominant grandmother.

Hindi Language.name: Basera
Hindi Language.description: After sacrificing their dreams for the sake of their children, four middle-aged friends cope with disregard from their children and fight for their rights, self-respect and identity in society.

Hindi Language.name: Tulsi: Mathrudevobhava
Hindi Language.description: Tulsi and Suraj are blessed with four kids. But Tulsi is diagnosed with cancer and Suraj gets killed. Tulsi takes the decision to have her children adopted to good families before she passes away.

Hindi Language.name: Fauj Mein Mauj
Hindi Language.description: What happens when the first woman to join the infantry in India happens to be the incredibly gorgeous Mallika Sherawat?

Hindi Language.name: Victoria House
Hindi Language.description: A film crew experience horror when a dead crew-member is resurrected.

Hindi Language.name: Maniben Dot Com
Hindi Language.description: Random thought but what if you were in the middle and the person is the one that was the most annoying thing in my experience in life that you can never get rid off and then

Hindi Language.name: Contract
Hindi Language.description: After witnessing the brutal death of his family, an embittered ex-army officer agrees to infiltrate a gang of terrorists.

Hindi Language.name: Hamari Devrani
Hindi Language.description: A family drama about the Nanavati Parivaar, based in Ahmedabad. It strongly establishes the sweet yet, at times, sour relationship between the five elder bahu's of the family and their youngest devrani.

Hindi Language.name: Ishaara
Hindi Language.description: Professor Khurana develops an injection, "Project X", and administers it to his pregnant wife. She dies in childbirth, but their daughter, Simran Khurana (alias Nisha Oberoi), grows at an accelerated rate. By 10 years old, she is a beautifully developed woman, with an unnatural appetite for sex and murder. Simran overhears her father plot to kill her, and runs away to Goa. There, she stalks and murders several men, leaving behind an "X" in blood on the walls. The police discover her ability to "shape shift", making her apprehension difficult. When her father comes to town, will he be able to identify and nab her before more people are killed?

Hindi Language.name: Phir Kabhi
Hindi Language.description: Hari Singh has been married to Lakshmi for about 40 years, is the father of a male child, who is employed in America, while his wife, Divya, and daughter, Sonia, live with them in a very harmonious relationship. Then Lakshmi suddenly passes away, leaving Hari alone and vulnerable. He gets close to his grand-daughter, and starts visiting his school-mates. It is then Divya concludes that Hari may not be a good influence over her daughter, after she finds out that he has not only fallen in love, but is also visiting on the sly, as well as exchanging love letters with a woman named Ganga.

Hindi Language.name: Aadmi Ki Aurat Aur Anya Kahaniya
Hindi Language.description: Three different stories set in India of men struggling to understand their relationships with women.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Bandhan
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of four siblings Kajol, Sujoy, Deva, and Mishti who get separated in their childhood after their mother leaves them in an orphanage because she has cancer and is on the last stage.

Hindi Language.name: Kiran Bedi: Yes Madam, Sir
Hindi Language.description: A documentary about the first woman to join the Indian Police Service.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Ishq Mein
Hindi Language.description: Rajiv is betrayed by his wife Sonal by faking the death of their unborn child and escaping with the doctor whom she planned the whole conspiracy.

Hindi Language.name: Khargosh
Hindi Language.description: A ten-year-old boy, Bantu, enjoys flying kites more than talking to girls. But one night, when he follows his friend Avneesh and his girlfriend, down to the river, he transforms completely.

Hindi Language.name: Aasma: The Sky Is the Limit
Hindi Language.description: A theatre group containing talented, aspiring college actors sets out to have some fun.

Hindi Language.name: Mission: The Last War
Hindi Language.description: A student of Sacred Heart Medical College is found murdered in mysterious circumstances. Police begin the investigation but soon two more girls are found murdered in the college campus. Daisy Wilfred IPS (Vani Viswanath) takes charge of the investigation.

Hindi Language.name: The Taste of Relation
Hindi Language.description: Eastern values clash with Western culture when an Indian father uproots his Hindu family and moves to Canada, beginning an emotional journey that winds up tearing the clan's tight-knit relationships apart with greed and ambition.

Hindi Language.name: Kesariya Balam Aavo Hamare Des
Hindi Language.description: The story of a poor Rajput girl, Rukmini who struggles through life and fights with her destiny.

Hindi Language.name: Aamras: The Sweet Taste of Friendship
Hindi Language.description: The friendship of four friends turns sour after one of them gets a love letter.

Hindi Language.name: Dhoom Dadakka
Hindi Language.description: A gangster is asked to come up with a heir within 30 days.

Hindi Language.name: Jiya Jale
Hindi Language.description: The story is based on the life of an ordinary girl Sunaina, who was brought up in a close and caring family. The story takes off when Sunaina has just fallen in the love with the idea of love, when she meets Chandan. But they are also caught up in the trials and tribulations of hatred, deceit and betrayalwhich changes their lives drastically. The question remains that:::Will Sunaina and Chandan be able to hold their love for each other above all these problems?

Hindi Language.name: th July at Barista
Hindi Language.description: With no means of communication, transportation, or even electricity, an assorted group are stranded at Juhu's Barista Cafe during Mumbai's rain deluge (over 37 inches in just a few hours) on July 26, 2005, including: Delhi-based Shivam, who, after relocating to Mumbai, has placed an ad on Shaadi.com to find his soul-mate; Jabalpur-born Sanam meets with an agent to get her foot in the door in Bollywood; Simran and her husband are worried about their children who are at Esselworld; a desperate father, stranded in Four Bungalows, looking for his school-going daughter, Neetu; a grief-stricken and distraught grandmother is blaming herself for losing her grandchild in the floods; Mumbai-born Rashi is anxious to get in touch with her equally anxious mother; while two police officers arrive on the scene to question this group as they suspect one of them may be bank robbers who got away with a large sum of money.

Hindi Language.name: Mata Ki Chowki
Hindi Language.description: A girl called Vaishnavi who is a great devotee of Mata Vaishno Devi.

Hindi Language.name: Chand Ke Paar Chalo
Hindi Language.description: The show is about true love getting a second chance.

Hindi Language.name: Pancham Unmixed: Mujhe Chalte Jaana Hai ...
Hindi Language.description: Attempting to explore the legendary composer RD Burman's music, Pancham Unmixed: Mujhe Chalte Jaana Hai takes an incisive look into the composer's reflective artistry and buoyant-but-also-lonely inner being. Featuring a host of close friends, colleagues and admirers, the film evokes awe, admiration and nostalgia the way most of his music does, even today. Pancham Unmixed is the most comprehensive film made on the great composer and a film that no music and film buff anywhere in the world can afford to miss .

Hindi Language.name: Bolo Raam
Hindi Language.description: A youth accused of the murder of his mother refuses to speak to the police. Is he really the killer?

Hindi Language.name: Mohe Rang De
Hindi Language.description: 'Mohe Rang De' is a period drama set against the backdrop of the India's struggle for independence in 1942, when the Quit India Movement was in full momentum.

Hindi Language.name: Meerabai Not Out
Hindi Language.description: A cricket-loving school-teacher faces challenges after agreeing to marry a doctor.
A little girl gets trapped in a deserted bungalow with only her father's dead body for company and a psychopath out to kill her.

Hindi Language.name: Ahmedabad International Film Festival (AIFF)
Hindi Language.description: Founded in 2009 by Omguru under the banner of Omguru Films, Ahmedabad International Film Festival (AIFF) has been continuously running since 2009, promoting cinema, creativity, cultural exchange, and opportunities for filmmakers worldwide.

Hindi Language.name: Kartika
Hindi Language.description: Kartika is an ambitious girl from Goregaon who is passionate about singing.

Hindi Language.name: Aathvaan Vachan
Hindi Language.description: Based on the life of Manali, a young woman with a mentally challenged younger sister, Urmi. Manali marries Aadesh, who takes an eighth vow that he will take care of Urmi for life. The show traces the story of their lives as a family.

Hindi Language.name: Chehra
Hindi Language.description: A 24-year- old Handicapped Women Bandini is stunned when this most sought-after bachelor proposes marriage to her. Some think it's pure luck while others think it's her good karma. But there is more to it than meets the eye.

Hindi Language.name: Via Darjeeling
Hindi Language.description: A couple on their honeymoon is about to return to the city. On the last day, one of them disappears. The mystery returns to Calcutta one night...via Darjeeling. Faces are unmasked. New discoveries made.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Padosan
Hindi Language.description: In order to win a contest, a male decides to candidly film a married couple living next door.

Hindi Language.name: Paani Puri
Hindi Language.description: What happens when two diverse families are forced to come together, under one roof, for the sake of their children's love?

Hindi Language.name: My Name Is Anthony Gonsalves
Hindi Language.description: Riya lives a middle-classed lifestyle in Mumbai and works as an Assistant Director for a movie producer, Bharucha. After the passing of her mother, she is consoled by a young man, Anthony Gonsalves, in the church graveyard. He introduces himself as the son of Jeffrey, who passed away during 1986, and works as a waiter in Jimmy's Pub, Bandra and wants to be a Bollywood actor. Thereafter she meets him again in the studios when he comes to audition for the part of Mark Anthony in a re-make of Shakespeare's 'Julius Caesar'. Both are attracted to each other and continue to meet. Little does Riya know that Anthony has lied to her, as he never had a father by the name of Jeffrey, and the real person who brought him up is a gangster and killer, Sikander, who is now a suspect in the sudden disappearance of Police Inspector Gupta.

Hindi Language.name: Banaras
Hindi Language.description: Hari, a village boy, travels to Varanasi to pursue higher studies. However, he falls into trouble after he unintentionally cheats on his girlfriend, Devu, with his classmate, Amritha.

Hindi Language.name: Jaane Kya Baat Hui
Hindi Language.description: A beautiful young woman is leading an unhappy married life. Later, things take a turn for the worse after she finds out that her husband is having an extramarital affair.

Hindi Language.name: Saanncha
Hindi Language.description: "Sancha" is a conscious effort to present the naked truth of human emotions in today's progressive, cultured and civilized society. "Sancha" is a thought process that does not only symbolize an individualistic perception but relates to every human being who goes through hellish crisis. "Sancha" is homage to an age-old indestructible human values and relations... Every parent prays to God that they be blessed with an intelligent and physically powerful male child and if it is a female child she be sanctified with divine beauty... This very benevolence of God becomes an inconceivable curse for some parent. This is precisely what happens to a haggard woman, Chanda, who works at a rustic brick kiln to meet her daily needs. Like every dutiful mother would protect her young child, Chanda has religiously rubbed the kiln-ash every day over her daughter's ever-glowing skin for past sixteen years in order to protect her honor from the lustful eyes of this world. Chanda appears as a model of a sanctimonious motherhood and stands out as a self-respectful & strongest mother. Unfortunately due to sickness of her husband she borrows money from the brick-contractor, Shambhu, and unwillingly enrolls herself amongst those underprivileged & helpless women who undergo physical abuse in return of his monitory favor whenever he wishes so. As a hard luck would have it, one day Shambhu's eyes glimmer to see the mouth-watering attractiveness of Chanda's daughter, Chakori whose beauty was hidden under the layers of murky ash for years. Overwhelmed by this cruel situation and sensing his wicked intent, Chanda finds no other solution to safeguard her daughter's honor but to marry her to an aged 55 yrs old, Ramkhilavan who perceives his wife as nothing but a mere commodity to fulfill his sexual desires. By nature, Chakori's husband, Ramkhilavan is a pervert old man who seems overjoyed to trap a young virgin in his marital snare. To his dismay on his first night, he discovers that his young wife knows nothing about sexual act. As a wise old man he makes a prudent decision not to ravage her chastity with force but to prepare her slowly into physical submission. However in the process, the old man realizes his cardinal sin and surrenders before her sacred innocence that ultimately transforms him from a depraved demon to a holy saint.

Hindi Language.name: Mohandas
Hindi Language.description: Born in a poor family, young Mohandas lands an important job at the 'Oriental Coal Mines'. However, his success story is brutally disrupted when somebody steals his identity and takes his place in his name. A local journalist tapes the story which reaches Meghna, an Indian television star newsreader in Delhi. A Kafkaesque tale of identity theft that becomes a searing indictment of bureaucratic corruption and conspiracy.

Hindi Language.name: Siddharth: The Prisoner
Hindi Language.description: An ex-convict/aspiring writer's briefcase gets switched with that of a gangster.

Hindi Language.name: The White Elephant
Hindi Language.description: On the day of the sacred festival, as was the ritual, Nathan (The Holy Elephant) chooses Shabri (a worthless drunk) as its new keeper. For the chosen one it was a matter of fortune and honor for the rest it was a matter of envy.......Nathan was the holy elephant of the village and the fortunes of its keeper were sure to change. This "honor" (Nathan) for the poor Shabri, who finds it difficult to provide for his small family, is initially too much to take. Shabri's new-found resolve and the holy elephant's allure enable him to not only face adversity but also defeat the evil powers of the envious village tantric (practitioner of black magic) and the conniving lady (a timber merchant from the neighboring village) who are both trying to steal the holy elephant from the village for its godly status. Nathan's loss would have meant devastation for the village. The story of Shabri's resolve to safeguard the village's honor, changing fortunes, the envious eyes, the power of spells and conniving--above all a story of strength, faith, and the impact of believing.

Hindi Language.name: Coffee House
Hindi Language.description: A former editor decides to create awareness about political inefficiency and corruption.

Hindi Language.name: Seeta Aur Geeta
Hindi Language.description: The story traces the journey of Seeta brought up in luxurious trappings of life and is untimely orphaned. On the other hand Geeta grows up on the streets of Mumbai becoming a confident girl.

Hindi Language.name: Jhoome Jiya Re
Hindi Language.description: Jia has a passion for dance that she is prepared to go to any length to fulfill. Jia scores a place in a dance college, not as a student, but as a secretary.. She befriends Apoorva there.

Hindi Language.name: Bombay Summer
Hindi Language.description: "Bombay Summer" explores the fleeting, delicate friendship of three young people in Mumbai, India and its eventual disintegration in the face of betrayal and personal loss.

Hindi Language.name: Ocean of an Old Man
Hindi Language.description: After a devastating Tsunami, a school-teacher struggles with the loss of his family and students.

Hindi Language.name: World Cupp 2011
Hindi Language.description: This movie looks into a world of extortion, the underworld, gambling, bookies and match-fixing. It's based on the sport of cricket where players are forced to lose a match so that the underworld can benefit from it.

Hindi Language.name: The Hero - Abhimanyu
Hindi Language.description: A Police Officer's life is endangered after he is assigned to investigate the theft of antique statues.

Hindi Language.name: Khushboo: The Fragraance of Love
Hindi Language.description: A couple from diverse religions encounter challenges after they decide to get married without approval from their respective families.

Hindi Language.name: Kabhi Kabhii Pyaar Kabhi Kabhii Yaar
Radhaa Ki Betiyaan Kuch Kar Dikhayengi
Hindi Language.description: The Story of a mother, Radhaa, and her three daughters, Rohini, Ragini and Ruchi moving from small town to Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Delhi Bound for Work
Hindi Language.description: The film delves into the complex nature of the migration of young women from villages in Eastern India to cities, exploitation by recruitment agencies and employers and treatment by their families and communities.

Hindi Language.name: Gandhi's Children
Hindi Language.description: A shelter for children on the outskirts of Delhi provides food and accommodation for 350 boys. Some are orphans, others have been abandoned, still others have run away from home. About half are held under a court order, having been picked up from the streets for petty crimes. Living at the institution for several months, the filmmaker explores its routines and the varied experiences of several boys. Despite the harshness of their lives, many show remarkable strength of character, knowledge, and resilience. One day 181 child labourers arrived, placing additional strain on the building's deteriorating facilities. The institution does what it can, but is it enough?

Hindi Language.name: Kirkit
Hindi Language.description: Two squabbling groups are pitted against each other in cricket matches.

Hindi Language.name: Lux Kaun Jeetega Bollywood Ka Ticket
Saath Saath Banayenge Ek Aashiyaan
Hindi Language.description: The story where East meets West. Lajwanti, a village girl from Punjab and Leeza, a foreigner get married in the Singh family after a turmoil of emotions, sacrifices and drama.

Hindi Language.name: Jaane Pehchaane Se Yeh Ajnabi
Hindi Language.description: A story about a beautiful twenty-one year old girl Ayesha.her life is changed after a fatal car accident, she loses her family and now have only a six year old son Nihal of her sister.

Hindi Language.name: Pulsar MTV Stunt Mania Underground
Hindi Language.description: Pulsar MTV Stuntmania is India's first stunt biking reality show. The selected Stunters are provided with Bajaj Pulsar 220 DTS-i bikes to do the different stunts in order to advance to the next round. In the first episode the contestants are divided into teams or squads (usually Red, Blue, Yellow and Green) and the team members decide their respective team names. They are also given gear and bikes of their respective team colour. Each episode features Skill challenges and Survival Stunts. In Skill Challenges the squads have to perform different tasks while doing a Skill Stunt which are decided before hand. The team that performs the best stays immune and goes to the next round. The other teams have to face the Survival Stunt . Each team has to nominate one person for the Survival stunt. The person with the relatively worst performance in the survival stunt has to leave the show. This continues until the number of stunters reduce to a small number. Before the finale there is usually a 'Wild Card' challenge in which all the eliminated contestants get an opportunity to get another shot at getting back into the competition by competing against the other eliminated contests in a daunting challenge. At the end, the winner of the grand finale stunt wins the reality show with a cash prize, a custom Bajaj Pulsar and of course the title of India's best Stunt-rider.

Hindi Language.name: Lottery
Hindi Language.description: Attracted to two women, a male 'wins' considerable money, but must consider killing, in order to 'win' again.

Hindi Language.name: Sujata: Ek Stree Ka Samarpan
Hindi Language.description: The emotions of an urban married woman and her relationship with her husband and children.

Hindi Language.name: Toss: A Flip of Destiny
Hindi Language.description: The lives of five friends change after they find two bags full of cash.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Ghar Aayi Ek Nanhi Pari
Hastey Hastey Follow Your Heart
Hindi Language.description: A colorful, energetic and humorous depiction of how globalization and technology have made the world a really small place.
