Hindi Language.name: Chittod Ki Rani Padmini Ka Johur
Hindi Language.description: The series is a royal saga of beauty, loyalty, courage and sacrifice of one of the greatest Queens in the annals of Indian history- Rani Padmini.

Hindi Language.name: Detective Naani
Hindi Language.description: An elderly grandmother and others spy on a neighbor.

Hindi Language.name: Don Muthu Swami
Hindi Language.description: Don Muthu Swami is one of Bombay's most fearsome gangsters. On his deathbed, his father forces him to make a promise: that from now on he will lead a decent life. From that moment onwards, the don has a new purpose in life: to become Sir Muthu Swami instead. On of his new goals is to become fluent in Urdu, for which purpose he hires the young Jaikishan as a teacher. Don Muthu Swami has a beautiful daughter, Sanjana, whom he wants to get married to Pradhan, the son of his close friend. However, the don's right hand man, Preetam, asks for her hand as well. To impress Don Muthu Swami, he claims to be very rich by stealing millions from his employer. Sanjana herself, on the other hand, is desperate to get married to Jaikishan, and to scare off Pradhan, she fakes to be pregnant. The Don believe Preetam must be the culprit, but as it turns out, the girl Preetam loves is not Sanjana, but another girl who claims to be Don Muthu Swami's daughter, Ranjana.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Packet Umeed
Hindi Language.description: Ambika Dharamraj and 15 other members have all chosen to make a change. Despite having undergone so much misery, they now live a happy life in a home they can call their own, with a family of their choice.

Hindi Language.name: Ranbir Rano
Hindi Language.description: An epic love story based on class prejudice in Punjab. The story follows Ranbir and Rano's respective families who represent extremes of greed and purity and the impact it has on their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Bayttaab Dil Kee Tamanna Hai
Hindi Language.description: Three sisters, Kanchan, Shamoli and Kakoon arrive in Mumbai from their village in search of a livelihood. New to the city, they face several hardships whilst finding a job.

Hindi Language.name: Grihasti
Hindi Language.description: A family of seven women learn to survive in a man's world after the patriarch and sole bread winner of the family dies.

Hindi Language.name: Palampur Express
Hindi Language.description: Palampur Express is an inspirational story of Pavni, a young small town girl, who dreams of being an athlete and is ready to face all the trials and tribulations in her path to win an Olympic gold medal for India.

Hindi Language.name: Let's Dance
Hindi Language.description: A dance teacher struggles to bring fame to herself and her group of young dancers.

Hindi Language.name: Dekh Bhai Dekh: Laughter Behind Darkness
Hindi Language.description: A woman faces challenges after she and her associates steal a Murthy of Bhagwan Shri Kishan from her estranged in-laws.

Hindi Language.name: The Salt Stories
Hindi Language.description: In 1930, a group of Indians led by a frail, elderly man marched a distance of 241 miles. They marched for salt. Mahatma Gandhi was able to craft an anti-colonial, nationalist movement around the most basic issue of livelihood: the right of Indians to make and consume their own salt. 77 years later, the Wide Eye Film team followed the trail of the famous Dandi salt march, stopping at the same villages and towns, in search of Gandhi's legacy. Set against the backdrop of Gandhi's original journey, this is a road-movie about issues of livelihood in modern, globalizing India. It is a documentary about 'the salt stories' of our times.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Phirr Milein Na Milein
Hindi Language.description: A lover only has a few days to find a clue to his sweethearts' whereabouts.

Hindi Language.name: Pehli Nazar Ka Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Ajay saves Anju in a fall from a mountain height, it is love at first sight. He doesn't know that she is engaged, and they don't know they have a past together.

Hindi Language.name: Happy home
Hindi Language.description: A family comedy sitcom of old age home.

Hindi Language.name: Faujji... The Iron Man
Hindi Language.description: "Faujji - The Iron Man" was a show that aired on Doordarshan National in 2009. The show revolves around the Indian Army's fight against terrorism. The serial was ranked amongst the top 10 serials according to TAM ratings.

Hindi Language.name: Tales of Siva 2
Hindi Language.description: The movie revolves around a grandmother who sheds light on few stories of lord Shiva to her naughty grandchildren. The movie begins with the tale of the great grand wedding of Shiva and Parvati in the history of time. The movie moves ahead with the story of Hanuman (son of Vaayu Dev), his birth and his childhood incidents. One day, Vaayu Dev abandons the world as Indra hurts Hanuman, Lord Shiva then convinces Vaayu Dev and brings him back to the course and requests all the gods to bless the little Hanuman. The plot proceeds with the story of Shiva's son, Ganesha, who teaches the proud Kubera a lesson when he organises a grand feast and invites all the gods to show off his prosperity. To teach the grandchildren a lesson about bravery, the grandmother selects the story of Kartikeya, a great warrior, who leaves Kailash in search of his true identity. Watch how Kartikeya fights with a monster to free the villagers and earn the name, 'Murugan'. Lastly, the grandmother narrates the story of the famous fight between Lord Shiva and Brahma in the course of the creation of mankind which ends up with Shiva cutting off Brahma's fifth head.

Hindi Language.name: Kabhi Saas Kabhi Bahu
Hindi Language.description: Kabhi Saas Kabhi Bahu is a comedy series on the 3 generations of Awasthi family, whose head Mallu Awasthi (Abhijeet Lahiri) lives with wife Sujata Awasthi (Shama Deshpande) , son Virendra (Iqbal Azad) and his wife Hema (Sushmita Mukherjee) , grandson Mohit (Vijay Bhatia) and his wife Kajal (Sonica Handa). Hema never became a slave to her mother-in-law, Sujata, but she makes her daughter in law, Kajal slog. Both Sujata and Kajal team up against Hema and she must fight to maintain her position.

Hindi Language.name: Vijay - Desh Ki Aankhen
Hindi Language.description: The "Vijay" team is a privately-funded, parallel security agency which exists with the knowledge and consent of the Indian Government. Under the leadership of Colonel Ranjit Singh, this elite group of six officers, investigates and prosecutes those accused crime. The arch villain in the show is Dinaro, an ex army man and former colleague of the of Colonel. While the Colonel treads the righteous path, Dinaro is motivated by greed and money and has chosen to follow the path that glorifies anarchy and anti-nationalism. As Dinaro terrorizes the nation's peace through his nexus, the 'Vijay' team strives to overcome these threats and invariably thwart his plans. The team works together with a single mission: to safeguard the nation.

Hindi Language.name: Nachle Ve with Saroj Khan
Hindi Language.description: Get ready to be trained by the master of Bollywood dance - Saroj Khan. The program will also feature prominent television actors who will compete against each other.

Hindi Language.name: Love Kaa Taddka
Hindi Language.description: A newly married meat-eating couple encounter problems after moving into a purely vegetarian society.

Hindi Language.name: Main Kab Saas Banoongi
Hindi Language.description: The show is a saga around the aspirations of a "Bahu" (daughter-in-law) to occupy the power throne of the house by becoming "Saas" (mother-in-law). In a good-humored manner, the show throbs with her fond fantasy to progress to an upper level of the pedigree, the so-called "Saas", a title that automatically bestows the right and authority to rule over the hapless "Bahu".

Hindi Language.name: Hum Dono Hain Alag Alag
Hindi Language.description: The story of two odd couples, how they come together, their conflicts and how they work around the strange situation they find themselves in. Very simply, it is a reflection of how hilarious life can be.

Hindi Language.name: Nights 4 Days
Hindi Language.description: New summer anthem by independent Hip-Hop and R&B artist Mark Milez.

Hindi Language.name: Kms.
Hindi Language.description: Several people face challenges when they decide to compete in a 42 Kilometer long marathon.

Hindi Language.name: Burey Bhi Hum Bhale Bhi Hum
Hindi Language.description: A joint Family Drama - How can such a big joint family live in together.

Hindi Language.name: Muniya
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by a true story, a poor farmer finds out that his daughter has kidney failure. The operation needed to save her life will cost more than he could ever hope to pay. Will he be able to save his girl?

Hindi Language.name: Dvandva
Hindi Language.description: Dvandva is crime drama in which a tough police officer on the search for a mysterious contract killer takes us through the lives of some seemingly un-related people associated with the killings. However, they all form an inseparable part of this intricately woven crime story.

Hindi Language.name: Sukh by Chance
Hindi Language.description: A story of a Gujarati family who works hard and plays hard. Every rupee is spent properly due to money shortage. Suddenly 3-crores enters the bank account.

Hindi Language.name: Ci-Mi
Hindi Language.description: The film tells the story of two brothers, Ji and Mi, who were separated for many years and found each other after 20 years.

Hindi Language.name: Sabad Nirantar
Hindi Language.description: Elaborate lyrics infused with mysterious imagery: The cultural heritage of 15th-century mystical Bhakti poetry is strongly anchored in the collective memory of the Indian rural population.

Hindi Language.name: Last Chance
Hindi Language.description: The film is based on a woman's revenge who is now taking revenge on another character.

Hindi Language.name: Aashiq Biwi Ka
Hindi Language.description: Aashik Biwi ka brings comedy and romance together in a lovable and innovative manner. It tries to bridge the gap between different generations. It is a romantic comedy that is helped and disrupted by many forces like Neeta's (the main protagonist) mother from heaven, Yamraj and Chitragupta, and her father who has yet not reached heaven or hell.

Hindi Language.name: Namah Shivaya Shantaya
Hindi Language.description: Amidst the turbulent times of His day, Lord Sadashiva exhorts all warring groups of the land to unite under one banner: that of Shivagotra. Shiva is married to Parvatii. Her father Daksha is Shiva's mortal enemy. Parvatii herself is her father's most beloved daughter. She is the only thing that gives meaning to his life. Daksha tries to destroy Shiva's reputation by holding a sacrificial ceremony to which only he among the noted personages of the time is uninvited. Parvatii, distraught by her father's humiliation of her husband, kills herself in the sacrificial fire in protest. Her death, ironically of her father's own making, breaks his spirit once and for all. In trying to destroy Shiva he only destroyed himself.

Hindi Language.name: Bad Luck Govind
Hindi Language.description: Gangsters attempt to force a newly re-located male with 'bad luck' syndrome to work for them.

Hindi Language.name: Kabhi Kahin...
Hindi Language.description: Two best friends on a motorcycle road-trip. A road-trip where they encounter unforeseen incidents and circumstances that lead them to their destiny. The destiny that will challenge and test their friendship, the destiny that they cannot fight.

Hindi Language.name: The Killer
Hindi Language.description: Criminal lawyer Subhash takes the side of a serial offender, Bablu Naidu under the influence of strong political figure and Bablu's brother, P P Naidu. The same night he kills Bablu and then, a corrupt police officer. Is Subhash the flag bearer of justice wearing the mask of a corrupt advocate or is he seeking revenge for something else?

Hindi Language.name: Chhote Miyan Dhaakad
Hindi Language.description: Chhota bachcha jaan ke inko...don't underestimate. Chhote Miyan Dhaakad is ready to take over your world and we guarantee that this bachcha party is a laugh riot. Join judges as they look for the most entertaining kids from across the country. As the season progresses, the comedians get funnier and the gags get crazier until finally one chhota packet bada dhamaka emerges the winner of the season.

Hindi Language.name: One Crazy Ride
Hindi Language.description: A motorcycle expedition on uncharted roads across the Himalayan state of Arunachal Pradesh, situated in North-east India. But more than an expedition, it's a film on friendship, camaraderie and the "never say die" attitude of five motorcyclists in the face of unforgiving terrain. Shot in the same format as "Riding Solo To The Top Of The World" with no back-up vehicle or film crew, in parts of India hardly seen, filmed or explored, the documentary captures the interactions and experiences of the riders who are trying to chart a route, which according to everyone does not exist.

Hindi Language.name: Kahaani Gudiya Ki...: True Story of a Woman
Hindi Language.description: A tragic saga about a woman named Gudiya, whose husband goes missing after the Kargil war, gets married to another man. However, their happy lives are shattered when Gudiya's husband comes back and wants her again in his life.

Hindi Language.name: At My Doorstep
Hindi Language.description: A closer look at those who come to the filmmaker's door becomes a way of entering a parallel world of garbage collectors, domestic workers, delivery boys, watchmen-all those who labour long hours in difficult conditions to make middle and upper class lives in the city of Bombay more comfortable. These providers of services and goods often remain faceless and nameless. They are, like the people who enjoy their services, mainly migrants, but their presence here is more sharply defined by the lack of survival options back home. Nothing else explains why they should bear with such harsh living and unfair working conditions. The film will look at the crisscrossing of various lives in the filmmaker's housing colony, gleaning from this microcosm a sense of how millions work, interact and struggle for a firmer foothold in an indifferent, often hostile megacity.

Hindi Language.name: Memsahab
Hindi Language.description: The story is based on sikh riots victims of 1984.

Hindi Language.name: Khooni Ped
Hindi Language.description: A fat girl with big tits wants to prove that mummies exist in India sets out on a trip to do just that. According to legend there exists a tree under which a king was mummified and buried 3000 years ago. The mummified king returns from the grave and along with his tree friend starts killing people.Respite is at hand in the form of a black metal tantrik who loves talking to nothingness.

Hindi Language.name: % De Dana Dan
Hindi Language.description: The kayfabe plot of the show involved the Indian wrestlers being trapped in South Africa and stumbling upon an underground fight league headed by Mark Beale and WWP.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Ladkiyan
Hindi Language.description: The story is set in Benaras, the holy city of India, and depicts the lives of four young women; Sapna, Pooja, Ajju, and Alka.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Reporter
Hindi Language.description: The incidents of crime have always been the center of attraction for the viewers, and if these incidents are presented in the best way, then the audience becomes eager to see them. The specialty of Crime Reporter was that in its script, any event was presented in a very exciting way, this show, which was broadcast on Sahara Samay news channel, was very popular among the viewers.

Hindi Language.name: Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan
Hindi Language.description: The story of the great king who ruled a kingdom in northern India during the latter half of the 12th century.

Hindi Language.name: Cities on Speed: Mumbai Disconnected
Hindi Language.description: Three people share their views on transportation, congestion, over-population, and bureaucracy in Mumbai, India.

Hindi Language.name: Chal Chalein
Hindi Language.description: Collegians decide to sue their parents and the Government after one of them kills himself.

Hindi Language.name: Su-Swasth: How to Get Eternal Health
Raftaar - An Obsession
Hindi Language.description: A former lover returns to create havoc in the life of his now married ex-girlfriend and her family.

Hindi Language.name: Aapa Akka
Hindi Language.description: The film traces the journey of a young girl, Reshma and her search for her personal God. Although a Muslim, she is fascinated by the true story of a 12th century Hindu poetess saint Akka Mahadevi. Akka, intoxicated with her love for Lord Shiva had roamed unclothed singing verses in total abandon on the banks of the River Krishna where Reshma now lives with her little brother Noor. When a terrible tragedy befalls Reshma, she seeks solace from the river much like Akka.

Hindi Language.name: Waqt Batayega Kaun Apna Kaun Paraya
Hindi Language.description: The story is based on the life of an adopted girl named Rudra, who is searching for love from her stepmother and other family members. Rudra knows that she is adopted. She is very close to her father but not to other family members. She is aware of her limitations and keeping that in mind she takes care of her family members. She does not take it to heart when family members yell at her or curse her. In reality she is the heir of the family as she is her stepfather's older brother's daughter and Nanny is her real mother. However, Nanny hides this truth as her marriage with Rudra's real father was hidden from the family because she was poor.

Hindi Language.name: Suno Na.. Ek Nanhi Aawaz
Hindi Language.description: Abandoned by her boyfriend, an unwed expectant woman faces obstacles and challenges when she decides to give birth to the baby.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbai Chakachak
Hindi Language.description: The story of Koka, a BMC employee living in the BMC Colony at Colaba, who wants to his Mumbai to be as clean as Shanghai.

Hindi Language.name: Aap Ki Kachehri
Hindi Language.description: An Indian television reality-justice show about real-life state of affairs, hosted by Indian social activist and police officer - Kiran Bedi.

Hindi Language.name: Jeet Jayenge Hum
Hindi Language.description: The story focuses on child labour and the migration of people from villages to town in search of a good life but ends up becoming slaves to industries.

Hindi Language.name: Terminated Childhood
Hindi Language.description: The film narrates the fight of children of Bhopal gas victims against their bodies and the system.

Hindi Language.name: Mudhal Mudhal Mudhal Varai
Hindi Language.description: When was the last time you did/experienced something for the first time?? First time experiences are special. Set in contemporary India, this multi-layered movie is about an obsessive film maker, Huggy, desperately trying to make his first feature film. Time is running out for him because his girl friend Sindhu suffers from a life-threatening illness. He wants to marry her. But she will marry him only after he makes his first film. Does he make his first film and marry her is the sub-text of the film. Interestingly, through his journey Huggy encounters a plethora of characters, from a pregnant woman to an eighty year old man, who take the story forward with their first time experiences.

Hindi Language.name: Uttar Katha
Hindi Language.description: This TV show is an Indian Classic based on Jnan Pith Awarded Novelist Naresh Mehta's Acclaimed Novel "Uttar Katha". It is a family drama reflecting multiple colours of life including love, hate, sacrifice and selfishness amongst others.

Hindi Language.name: Dharm ki Baat
Hindi Language.description: Dharm Ki Baat is a Popular TV Show of 2009. It was released on Zee Jagran TV channel whose director is Dushyant Pratap Singh while the host of the program is Anjula Singh Mahore.

Hindi Language.name: Anubhav: An Actor's Tale
Hindi Language.description: A struggling film actor is compelled to become a male prostitute.

Hindi Language.name: The Firm Land
Hindi Language.description: A traveling salesman arrives in an unnamed Indian village. He tells of an incurable illness that a holy man blames on lust and six good-hearted men go to the city to seek a cure.

Hindi Language.name: Chalo Hamara Des
Hindi Language.description: A journey in search of the 'des' (country) invoked in the poetry of the fifteenth-century mystic poet of North India--Kabir--this film interweaves the stories of two people from two very different countries, Indian folk singer Prahlad Tipanya and North American scholar Linda Hess. Where is Kabir's country? The answer is elusive, as we journey through song and poem into these two lives, brought together in an unlikely friendship by the cross-cultural resonance of Kabir.

Hindi Language.name: Years! Of Love?
Hindi Language.description: Filmmakers Steven Bartlo and Karin Slater travel around the world to interview couples about their views on marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Maidan-e-Jung
Hindi Language.description: A man sets out to avenge his lover's murder. The planning and execution to avenge the killing of his beloved to coincide with her death anniversary, makes for gripping viewing.

Hindi Language.name: Biwi aur TV
Hindi Language.description: This was a very popular serial shown on the Sahara Samay news channel, in which the programs shown on the small screen were reviewed in a very comedy style. The show achieved its success the fastest among the programs aired in the afternoon.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Maa Sherawaali
Hindi Language.description: An ardent devotee of Devi Maa Sherawaali, Lakshmi lives a poor lifestyle in a small town along with her widowed mother. One day, while at the Devi Maa Mandir, she comes to the assistance of a wealthy male, Haribabu, who approves of her, and gets her married to his son, Prakash. The wedding takes place, and Lakshmi re-locates to live with Prakash in Mumbai. She will soon find out that Prakash was forced to marry her, and is in love with his sweetheart, Ratna Choudhary. Lakshmi decides to assert herself, and soon wins over Prakash. It is only when Haribabu travels to Mahabuleshwar for a business trip that she will find that Prakash still loves Ratna, had merely feigned to love her, and is now involved in a conspiracy to kill her.

Hindi Language.name: Ravana - The Great Warrior
Hindi Language.description: Dasahanan wants to be a king in Swarg, Dharti and Patal and he also want to everybody come worships him as a God, Man and Danav. Dashanan very intelligent, brave and also Devotee of Lord Shiva. After returning to Ayodhya from Mithila with his new bride Sita, Ram is banished to the forest for fourteen years by his stepmother so his half-brother can rule the kingdom. During their forest exile, Ram's wife is abducted by demon King of Lanka Ravan. The search then commences for Sitaji with Hanumanji leaping across the seas to Lanka, killing Ravan's son, Akshaye, and passing on Ramji's message to Sitaji, who is being held in the Ashok Vatica and refuses to give in to Ravan's demands as she is fully aware that he is cursed and will be torn in seven pieces if he dares to molest any woman against her wish. After being captured by Ravan's son, Meghnath, Hanuman does escape, but not before setting Lanka afire with his tail. Ramji, along with an army of apes and bears, descends upon Lanka, kills Ravan's brother, Khumbakaran; while Hanumanji resurrects Lakshman, who was fatally wounded by Meghnath. With the help of his brother Lakshman and an army of monkeys, Ram declares war on Lanka to win back his bride.

Hindi Language.name: Dhoop Mein Thandi Chaav... Maa
Hindi Language.description: The show is about Apara's tirade against society and her three children's suffering in the light of the fact that they are separated from her safety. Circumstances force Apara and her children to seek refuge in another house. The story shows how she overcomes the obstacles and tries to come out unscathed and unmarred, at the same time not letting go of her family's honor.

Hindi Language.name: Chilika Bank$
Hindi Language.description: Stories from India's largest coastal lake 1970 to 2007.

Hindi Language.name: Arjun V/S Destiny
Hindi Language.description: Arjuns believes, that he dictates his own destiny. Not some silly lines running on his palms. He faces the stigma of being different and absence of lines on his palms from an early childhood. As unfortunate events begin to shake his inner core. He fights his opponents in the ring while destiny is set dead against him outside the ring. His fathers dream of winning the championship become Arjuna's nightmare as his life slips like the sand that slips smoothly out of his blank hands.

Hindi Language.name: Encountered on Saffron Agenda?
Hindi Language.description: Film investigate four encounter killings happened in Indian state of Gujarat.

Hindi Language.name: Rahe tera ashirwad
Hindi Language.description: The story of this series is about a girl who is an orphan. She fights against evil along with the help of goddess. The name of this Goddess is Vaishno Devi.

Hindi Language.name: Devi Saraswati
Hindi Language.description: The mischevious Narad instigates Goddesses Laksmi, Parvati, and Saraswati into a conflict with each other by posing the question, which is the most important trait to a human? Is it wealth, knowledge or bravery? Each of the Goddesses selects an individual candidate and blesses them with the chosen trait to test who chose the right one. The story then follows Vidyapati, Senapati, and Aishwariyawati as they unknowingly compete on behalf of the goddesses in an effort to find out who was right.

Hindi Language.name: [v] Kidnap
Hindi Language.description: How many times has your love been put to test? To what extent will you go to rescue your partner? Channel[v] launches the biggest and the first ever romance - meets - adventure reality show - [v] Kidnap that will put the strength of your relationship to the test. We catch love struck couples put to test every moment that they have spent together. This thrilling show will test relationships while throwing a new twist at every corner.

Hindi Language.name: Gadh: When the Limit Is Reached
Yoga for You
Hindi Language.description: Yoga for You is a popular television series broadcast daily from India, which introduces ancient practices that help maintain a healthy lifestyle (including home remedies, marma, diet, Yoga, herbs, and other ancient healing secrets).

Hindi Language.name: Ek Safar Aisa Kabhi Socha Na Tha
Hindi Language.description: A sweet vulnerable girl gets embroiled in a journey because of emotional compulsions and battles the day to day onslaught from all quarters with only belief and values on her side is the theme. Saving the hero from the banks of the river will set her life in to such a roller coaster of emotional uncertainties is what she. - never thought of.

Hindi Language.name: Mahadev
Hindi Language.description: Laxmi and Vasu are true devotees of Lord Ayyappa. Since Swami has donned the sacred beaded necklace around him and decided to visit Sabarimala, the couple change their lifestyle and their eating habits.

Hindi Language.name: Chaapar Faad Ke
Hindi Language.description: What happens when HARRY, a carefree taxi driver with heart of gold from Patiala, runs into SUBU, a just landed Hydrabadi babu from Domalguda with no place to stay and brings him home to find out that his room mate JAY, a slick Bombaiya with agenda of his own, does not like this a single bit?

Hindi Language.name: Entertainment Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
Hindi Language.description: Every contestant gets a minute to entertain the judges and audiences alike. If the contestant can impress the judges and audiences with their act, they get a chance to win the cash prize.

Hindi Language.name: Snatch & Grab
Hindi Language.description: Tired of being treated poorly by men, four frustrated women devise a game of social conquest to reclaim their destinies. But each is soon challenged to face herself and her relationships while also battling a jealous psycho and sexist boss.

Hindi Language.name: I Wonder...
Hindi Language.description: From the vast coastlines of Tamil Nadu, to the arid lands of Rajasthan and the lush greenery of Sikkim, the camera joins local children on the journeys of their daily lives: to and from school, in their classes and after-school play, and doing chores.

Hindi Language.name: Shakti Leela
Hindi Language.description: Bhring Muni is adamant on destroying Goddesses Parvati, Saraswati and Lakshmi. But, Goddess Parvati saves everyone by killing the demon created by the Bhring Muni.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Thi Maa
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film is all about Anu's pursuit to find the truth and dealing with it. Soon she realizes that she is as helpless as the ones' she's trying to help. What happens to Anu, her grandparents and her mother.

Hindi Language.name: Framed with the stars of Kaminey
Solo un Giorno
Hindi Language.description: The daily life of three women who practices three different religions in as many regions of India: a nun in the older Indian Buddhist nunnery, a Muslim girl-student in Delhi and a Hindu worker in Varanasi.

Hindi Language.name: Seeds of Dissent
Hindi Language.description: 'Seeds of Dissent' documents Dr. Joshi's cycle yatra from Kanyakumari to Dehradun over a period of two months in Jan'08. During the journey Dr. Joshi meets and interacts with the farmers and raises relevant issues. We see farmers selling land to industries, coming up of SEZ's, farmers being coaxed to take nonviable loans for tractors, issue of farmer's suicide, preference being given to Industry (Coke) for water, and farmers resorting to distress sale. Dr. Joshi analyses situations and presents his own alternative in the form of a 'farmer's bank'.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
Hindi Language.description: Three friends decide to turn their fantasy vacation into reality after one of their friends gets engaged.

Hindi Language.name: Udaan
Hindi Language.description: Expelled from his school, a 16-year old boy returns home to his abusive and oppressive father.

Hindi Language.name: My Name Is Khan
Hindi Language.description: Rizwan Khan is a Muslim immigrant to the US with Asperger's syndrome. After his family falls apart in the aftermath of 9/11, he begins an epic quest across the country to speak to the President of the United States and clear his name.

Hindi Language.name: Rockstar
Hindi Language.description: Janardhan Jakhar chases his dreams of becoming a big Rock star, during which he falls in love with Heer.

Hindi Language.name: Ra.One
Hindi Language.description: When a gaming AI villain named Ra.One breaks into the real world, a timid boy teams up with his late father's heroic digital avatar to battle an unstoppable digital god bent on total destruction.

Hindi Language.name: Benny and Babloo
Hindi Language.description: Two room-mates experience major changes in their lives after acquiring new jobs.

Hindi Language.name: Badmaash Company
Hindi Language.description: Four youngsters grow rich together with a big idea in 90's middle-class Bombay. All is hunky dory till they are forced to shut shop until a plan comes up.

Hindi Language.name: Karthik Calling Karthik
Hindi Language.description: A much abused loner achieves success and even wins the heart of his gorgeous co-worker, after getting early morning mysterious phone calls from someone.

Hindi Language.name: Murder 2
Hindi Language.description: An ex-cop is hired by a pimp to find missing call girls and the man responsible behind their abduction.

Hindi Language.name: Bodyguard
Hindi Language.description: The daughter of a wealthy nobleman secretly falls in love with her bodyguard.

Hindi Language.name: Khatta Meetha
Hindi Language.description: An ambitious but seemingly corrupt petty contractor faces opposition from everyone, both at home and at work. But he continues to struggle while his family members continue to pocket ill-gained money.

Hindi Language.name: LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha
Hindi Language.description: A video camcorder, a store security camera and concealed cameras candidly expose lives in three loosely-linked tales.

Hindi Language.name: Housefull
Hindi Language.description: Believing himself to be jinxed, a man attempts to find true love, but instead gets caught in a web of lies.

Hindi Language.name: Desi Boyz
Hindi Language.description: Two friends lose their jobs, then part bitterly after they get exposed as male strippers.

Hindi Language.name: Band Baaja Baaraat
Hindi Language.description: Shruti and Bittoo become partners in their very own "Wedding planning ka bijness" in Delhi and in the process discover friendship, love and one another.

Hindi Language.name: Guzaarish
Hindi Language.description: Ethan, a magician rendered paralyzed in an accident, sets off a furor when he makes a petition to the court to end his own life.

Hindi Language.name: Don 2
Hindi Language.description: Don turns himself in and escapes with Vardhaan from prison, following which he recruits a team to steal currency printing plates from a bank in Berlin.

Hindi Language.name: Tanu Weds Manu
Hindi Language.description: Manu comes to India to find a bride and falls for Tanu at first sight, but free-spirited Tanu has no plan to marry him.

Hindi Language.name: Singham
Hindi Language.description: Honest inspector Bajirao Singham faces off against the powerful racketeer Jaykant Shikre. After a public humiliation in a rural village, the villain orchestrates a transfer to trap the lawman in a web of corruption and political vice.

Hindi Language.name: Phas Gaye Re Obama
Hindi Language.description: Om Shastri, a recession victim comes to India to sell his ancestors property to clear is debt. On reaching he comes to know that selling the property will make his family homeless in India. Later he is kidnapped by goons thinking a rich NRI.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Bin Laden
Hindi Language.description: A reporter casts a fake Bin Laden to act in his video message to America, so he can immigrate there.

Hindi Language.name: Ladies vs. Ricky Bahl
Hindi Language.description: A smooth and charming conman, Ricky Bahl, cons girls for a living but finally meets his match is this fun-filled "ROM-CON."

Hindi Language.name: Peepli Live
Hindi Language.description: An impoverished farmer's threat to end his life invites attention from politicians and media.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbai Diaries
Hindi Language.description: The lives of four people intersect in Mumbai: a washer-man who wants to become an actor, a banker-turned-photographer, a painter looking for inspiration, and a newly-married immigrant who journals her experiences on home video.

Hindi Language.name: : Error Not Found
Hindi Language.description: A brilliant student starts hallucinating after moving into a room that was occupied by another who committed suicide.

Hindi Language.name: No One Killed Jessica
Hindi Language.description: A journalist, who is more of an activist teams up with the sister of a murdered model, as she gets interested in the case and wants to bring justice to her case.

Hindi Language.name: Golmaal 3
Hindi Language.description: In Goa, Pritam meets his love Geeta after many years. They decide to get married but the feud between their respective children creates tension in their marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Children's Party
Hindi Language.description: A gang of innocent but feisty kids who lead carefree lives in Chandan Nagar colony takes on the big bad world of politics when one of their friend's life is endangered.

Hindi Language.name: The Dirty Picture
Hindi Language.description: The love story between an actress and a director, inspired by the life of the late South-Indian actress Silk Smitha.

Hindi Language.name: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
Hindi Language.description: As a smuggler rises to power in in 1970s Mumbai, a younger gangster seeks to overthrow him and a police officer is caught in the middle.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Punchnama
Hindi Language.description: Nishant starts dating Charu while his roommates Rajat and Vikrant already have girlfriends in Neha and Rhea respectively. Trouble starts when the guys feel that their girlfriends are dominating them.

Hindi Language.name: Dabangg
Hindi Language.description: A corrupt police officer faces challenges from his family, gangsters and politicians.

Hindi Language.name: I Hate Luv Storys
Hindi Language.description: Jay doesn't believe in love Stories, and Simran, is a girl who's in love with the idea of Love itself.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
Hindi Language.description: A quirky rom-com where Kush finds the ideal Indian bride Dimple for his brother Luv and a series of comical and unpredictable events follow.

Hindi Language.name: Mod
Hindi Language.description: A woman falls for a male she believes is her class-mate until she finds out that he is an unknown and unstable inmate from a mental institute.

Hindi Language.name: Ishqiya
Hindi Language.description: While on the run from goons, a man and his nephew fall for a kidnapper's seductive widow.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Saali Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Gangsters kidnap the prospective son-in-law of a politician in order to secure the release of an imprisoned gang-member.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Impossible
Hindi Language.description: Everybody loves beautiful Alisha and it's no surprise that nerdy Abhay loves her too but she doesn't know he exists until years later their paths cross.

Hindi Language.name: Luv Ka the End

Hindi Language.name: Sapnon Se Bhare Naina
Hindi Language.description: The story of a woman craving for a home that she can call her own and a man who can look beyond her beauty and love her unconditionally.

Hindi Language.name: Gattu
Hindi Language.description: A cheeky nine-year-old boy called Gattu lives in Roorkee. The small town along with Gattu shares an obsession with flying kites and defeating the ruler of the skies above Roorkee.

Hindi Language.name: Hitler Didi
Hindi Language.description: Indira Sharma is the only working member in a family of six. She is weighed down by the responsibility of providing for her whole family at a very young age.

Hindi Language.name: Kushti
Hindi Language.description: A small-framed postmaster must prove his one-sided love for a wrestler's daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Bheja Fry 2
Hindi Language.description: A tax-evading businessman and an income-tax officer get stranded on an isolated island.

Hindi Language.name: Ramaa: The Saviour
Hindi Language.description: While playing a video game on TV, school-children are mysteriously transported to a prehistoric island.

Hindi Language.name: Chatur Singh Two Star
Hindi Language.description: A bumbling police detective and his sidekick attempt to arrest an assassin.

Hindi Language.name: Pump Up the Mandali
Hindi Language.description: An emotional roller coaster ride of four friends from a poor village in Fiji to the glamor stage in Auckland.

Hindi Language.name: Humse Hai Liife
Hindi Language.description: A show revolves around a a small town girl who aspires to become a boxer and faces many difficulties to achieve her goal.

Hindi Language.name: The Film Emotional Atyachar
Hindi Language.description: A businessman runs into corrupt police officers and gangsters after procuring a bag full of cash

Hindi Language.name: Chala Mussaddi - Office Office
Hindi Language.description: A recently widowed and retired school-teacher must prove to corrupt government officers that he is alive, so he can receive his pension.

Hindi Language.name: Chase
Hindi Language.description: Police launch a manhunt for an escaped rehab-patient/terrorist responsible for the assassination of a politician

Hindi Language.name: Khotey Sikkey
Hindi Language.description: Five affluent youths find a new sense of purpose as they team up with a Mumbai police officer on crime-busting missions around the city.

Hindi Language.name: Chaloo Movie
Hindi Language.description: The police raid a theatre where movie tickets of a very successful film are being sold in black (illegally at a higher price). When Police Inspector Sher Khan interrogates Khoji, a man in his 20s, he claims that he is the director of the very film whose tickets he is selling in black. The cynical Sher Khan puts Khoji behind bars. Now Sher Khan receives two phone calls -- one from the Police Commissioner and another from the dreaded don "WC", both of whom support Khoji's detention. Who is Khoji? Is he really the film's director? Then why is he selling his film's tickets in black? What do the Police Commissioner and don "WC" want from Khoji? All this is revealed through a hilarious turn of events.

Hindi Language.name: F.A.Q.
Hindi Language.description: Frequently Asked Questions aka F.A.Q., India's first curiosity-based show and POGO's tenth original production, is filled with new discoveries and science experiments, aimed at inspiring learning in kids in a fun and entertaining way.

Hindi Language.name: Seven
Hindi Language.description: Awesome serial I have ever seen....

Hindi Language.name: City of Gold - Mumbai 1982: Ek Ankahee Kahani
Hindi Language.description: An impoverished family faces challenges and obstacles after strikes/shut-downs/arson shut down Mumbai's mills.

Hindi Language.name: Gandhi to Hitler
Hindi Language.description: Adolf Hitler assists India in its freedom struggle against the British, while Mohandas Gandhi writes to him to end the violence.

Hindi Language.name: Jo Dooba So Paar: It's Love in Bihar!
Hindi Language.description: A high-school drop-out is smitten with a visiting American Researcher.

Hindi Language.name: Chand Chupa Badal Mein
Hindi Language.description: Nivedita meets her childhood friend Siddharth Sood after many years and the two fall in love with each other. But unhesitatingly sacrifices her own love by pretending that she is indifferent to him.

Hindi Language.name: Gunahon Ka Devta
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by Shakespeare's Othello based in a gang war ridden rural India a young man named Avdesh Singh Thakur, raised by his widowed sister-in-law is the crime boss of the city. Despite all that his bravery and compassion is driven by the pure of his heart and that compelled the beautiful young Arpita to be enamoured by him. When they met love was inevitable. Surrounded by a whirlpool of obsession, madness and revenge their young love faced mayhem, agony and were tested to the limits of their devotion for each.

Hindi Language.name: Kucch Luv Jaisaa
Hindi Language.description: After getting bored with her love less marriage life, a wife decides to get a breathe of fresh air and meets a hit man.

Hindi Language.name: Alibaug
Hindi Language.description: A professor has re union of his students after ten years at the coastal heart of Alibagh.

Hindi Language.name: Emotional Atyachar
Hindi Language.description: Cheaters India style except they call it Loyalty test. This is way better then the show Cheaters

Hindi Language.name: Sawaare Sabke Sapne... Preeto
Hindi Language.description: The journey of Preeto, the third daughter who shoulders the responsibilities like the son of the family. She happily puts her own dreams on hold in order to realize the dreams of her sisters.

Hindi Language.name: Loot
Hindi Language.description: Four burglars end up stealing a vehicle from robbers as well as unknowingly breaking in the house of a notorious gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Sammaan Ek Adhikaar
Hindi Language.description: A girl who finds out that she is the illegitimate daughter of a rich man.On his deathbed he leaves all his property to her with the request that she join his disjointed joint family.

Hindi Language.name: Phulwa
Hindi Language.description: 'Phulwa' is a dramatic series that revolves around little 'Phulwa', an innocent village girl, who is as sweet and harmless as her name implies.

Hindi Language.name: Pankh
Hindi Language.description: After maturing, a Bollywood child artiste longs to act as an adult.

Hindi Language.name: Lahore
Hindi Language.description: A cricketer turns kick-boxer in order to avenge the death of his brother.

Hindi Language.name: Life Express
Hindi Language.description: A career-minded woman aborts her first child, then decides to have a baby through a surrogate.

Hindi Language.name: Soul of Sand
Hindi Language.description: Amid the epic landscape of the Mahabharata, the stage is set for an intimate yet eternal tussle between custom and commerce, tradition and modernity.

Hindi Language.name: My Friend Pinto
Hindi Language.description: Twenty-something Michael Pinto has grown up in a small Goan village, believing everyone in the world to be simple, kind and honest, just like him. His world revolves around a doting mother, a passion for music and the memories of a childhood friend, Sameer, who left Goa for Mumbai many years ago and hasn't replied to his frequent letters ever since. Pinto's talent for music is only matched by his knack for finding trouble in the unlikeliest of places often resulting in the most outlandish and hilarious situations. When Pinto's idyllic world is shattered by the sudden demise of his mother he decides to head to Mumbai in search of the only friend he knows. Will Pinto find Sameer or will trouble find him first? Will Pinto and his crazy antics survive the big bad city or more importantly, will Mumbai survive a phenomenon called Pinto?

Hindi Language.name: Patang
Hindi Language.description: In the old city of Ahmedabad, amid India's largest kite festival, a family duels, spins and soars like the countless kites in the skies above.

Hindi Language.name: Nooriee
Hindi Language.description: "Nooriee" is about thee sisters from Manali, who fight against the social barriers of class, gender and disability to rise up against elitist oppressors. The entire series aired on DD national prime-time and was shot in Manali, HP.

Hindi Language.name: Surya the Super Cop
Hindi Language.description: An investigative series with three separate investigative units working on different crimes headed by Surya, a blind suspended cop.

Hindi Language.name: A Flat
Hindi Language.description: A spate of unexpected events jolt Rahul as soon as he lands from U.S. He finds himself trapped in his own flat, completely cut off from the world. The only companion he has is a ghost that will not let go of him.

Hindi Language.name: Tell Me O Kkhuda
Hindi Language.description: After finding she was adopted as child, a young woman sets out to look for her biological parents.

Hindi Language.name: Admissions Open
Hindi Language.description: Unable to secure college admissions, students join a rebel professors' unaccredited institute.

Hindi Language.name: Mummy Punjabi: Superman Ki Bhi Maa!!
Hindi Language.description: An eccentric woman's life undergoes many changes as she prepares for the marriage of her children.

Hindi Language.name: Ring Wrong Ring
Hindi Language.description: Mansi Sharma gets Magical Ring which is invented by her late father in law. Because of manufacturing default magical ring fulfill the wish of person who wears it but magic happens with some side effects. Which adds some comical twist in each episodic story.

Hindi Language.name: Lanka
Hindi Language.description: A woman recounts her story of being confined to live as an unwed wife of an influential gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Mrs. & Mr. Sharma Allahabadwale
Hindi Language.description: This show celebrates the comic spirit and life of a small town. It is a story of the struggle of day-to-day incidents in the life of a middle-class family. It shows clash of values and ethics between people of small towns and large cities

Hindi Language.name: Ram Milaayi Jodi
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a shy, sweet Gujarati boy and a Punjabi girl who fall in love. However, will their families hailing from two different cultural backgrounds, get along with each other?

Hindi Language.name: Rishton Ke Bhanwar Mein Uljhi Niyati
Hindi Language.description: After her marriage, Niyati faces the dilemma of choosing between her responsibility to her husband and his family and her duty as a daughter to her father.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Singh
Hindi Language.description: Neo-Nazis and bigoted police oppress and target vulnerable Sikhs & Asians in post 9-11 America.

Hindi Language.name: Pappu Can't Dance Saala
Hindi Language.description: One time bickering neighbors are forced to share the same apartment.

Hindi Language.name: Prem Kaa Game
Hindi Language.description: After his wife and daughter go to visit relatives, a man decides to have an affair with his attractive neighbor.

Hindi Language.name: Main Lakshmi Tere Angaan Ki
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves a middle-class girl named Lakshmi, who believes in the importance of money and her unique love story where she is perplexed to choose between true love and wealth.

Hindi Language.name: Waiting for You
Hindi Language.description: This film is a gentle, warm and very human love story between an elderly, childless Indian couple who have lived in New Zealand for most of their life, far away from home, and what happens when the wife is admitted to the hospital with a heart problem, and her husband has to deal with the realisation that he is going to lose her soon.... The past and the present are interwoven into the narrative, as the husband has to cope with an increasing loneliness, as he deals with daily visits to the hospital and returning home to an empty house. In his remembrance of times past, he revisits his homeland of Rajasthan through books in the local library, and starts wandering through the empty, silent city streets, and into a large park in the rain, deep inside his troubled mind. He forms a friendship with a young New Zealand girl, who has a baby, and this simple uncomplicated relationship makes him happy for a time. Family friends try to intervene, but he gradually finds it more and more difficult as his wife's condition deteriorates, and he resents their intrusion into his personal life, and rejects any help from them. He now knows that he is going to lose his wife, and in their last time together in the hospital, she tells him not to worry about her, and that they will live forever..

Hindi Language.name: United Six
Hindi Language.description: Six women decide to break into a bank, withdraw at the 11th hour - but must go on the run after the bank gets robbed by unknown person(s).

Hindi Language.name: Kismat
Hindi Language.description: Born on the 15th of August 1947, Aditya Merchant and Kabir Khan mark the return of male protagonists on Indian Television in KISMAT an epic saga. A story of enmity between two powerful characters, set over 60 years the story is set in the immediate post independence era and spans to the present generation. The show revolves around the two central characters Aditya Merchant and Kabir Khan. Aditya Merchant is the heir to a rich industrialist family born with a golden spoon. Life is already charted out for Aditya as an heir to one of the richest industrialist families. He has access to all the privileges and was taught early in life that winning is all that matters, at any cost, and being a true Merchant, Aditya has made winning his habit in everything he does. While Kabir Khan, though born to Muslim parents is adopted by a Hindu family, is fated for a life full of struggles. Kabir has to face adversities early in life which moulds him to become an aggressive go getter who stops at nothing and nobody. Kabir's sole agenda is to get rich and be powerful. But KISMAT rules that both Aditya and Kabir's paths must cross & change their lives forever. In time, this immutable play of destiny brings Aditya and Kabir, face-to-face in a conflict that has far reaching implications. A twist of fate, an unfortunate turn of events, coincidence, Kismat - all conspire to make this conflict grow bigger with each passing year until this tug of war between Aditya Merchant and Kabir Khan, for Revenge, Power and Prestige eventually becomes the sole reason for their existence.

Hindi Language.name: Sanjog Se Bani Sangini
Hindi Language.description: Two incomplete people Rudra and Gauri who complete each other when they are tied in the relationship of holy matrimony.

Hindi Language.name: Dus Tola
Hindi Language.description: A Village goldsmith gets betrayed by the woman he loves.

Hindi Language.name: Tum Hi To Ho...
Hindi Language.description: A recently discharged mentally challenged male becomes sexually obsessed with a married woman.

Hindi Language.name: Saas Bina Sasural
Hindi Language.description: Taanya, a teacher, is married into a family consisting of seven men. However, she struggles to appease each of them and keep her family together by solving everybody's problems.

Hindi Language.name: Angel
Hindi Language.description: After serving time in jail for running over a man, an ex-convict is then arrested for sexually molesting the man's physically-challenged daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Tum Shabana
Hindi Language.description: Two colleagues, who woo the same woman, are abducted by her gangster uncle.

Hindi Language.name: Papad Pol - Shahabuddin Rathod Ki Rangeen Duniya
Kaccha Limboo
Hindi Language.description: A 13 year old fat boy feels vulnerable in handling pressure, taking responsibilities and having to make adjustments in his lifestyle.

Hindi Language.name: Monica
Hindi Language.description: An accused and three politically-connected suspects are prosecuted for their involvement in the homicide of a journalist.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Unplugged India
Hindi Language.description: MTV's acclaimed acoustic music series showcases the work of today's top artist and introduces the stars of tomorrow.

Hindi Language.name: Be-Careful
Hindi Language.description: In a bid to escape their domineering wives, two womanizing slackers get saddled with a corpse amongst other challenges in a foreign country.

Hindi Language.name: Mahi Way
Hindi Language.description: An overweight girl tries to find Mr.Right her way; Mahi's Way.

Hindi Language.name: Kahani Chandrakanta Ki
Hindi Language.description: The story focused on the twists and turns of Princess Chandrakanta's life, as well as on the love life of her eldest son, Yuvraj Inderjeet Singh with their enemy Maharaj Shiv Dutt's daughter Rajkumari Kishori.

Hindi Language.name: Krantiveer: The Revolution
Hindi Language.description: The daughter of an activist endangers her life by exposing corruption through the media.

Hindi Language.name: The Waiting Room
Hindi Language.description: People in a railway station waiting room suspect one of them is a serial killer.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Circus Ke Superstars
Hindi Language.description: One of the longest running comedy shows on television is back. This time, teams of veteran comedians will judge newcomers and select the best of them to join their ranks. These newly formed teams will then duke it out for the top spot.

Hindi Language.name: Turning 30!!!
Hindi Language.description: Naina grapples with heartbreak and a crisis in her advertising career, while facing her 30th birthday.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Nayi Chhoti Si Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: The story portrays the lives of two orphan girls, Isha and Ira who do not give up despite facing many hardships in life. Their mother died, their father abandoned them, and they are left to fend for themselves. Their father has to give them up because he is marrying someone else. They are sent to live in an orphanage with Devki and her brother Bhola.

Hindi Language.name: K-Five
Hindi Language.description: A woman's search for her home and shelter in the aftermath of a terror storm.

Hindi Language.name: Ada... A Way of Life
Hindi Language.description: A young man whose father is killed takes to violence.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Tum Aur Ghost
Hindi Language.description: An alcoholic and insomniac photographer is approached by deceased persons' souls in order to try and resolve their concerns.

Hindi Language.name: Sadiyaan: Boundaries Divide... Love Unites
Hindi Language.description: A Hindu/Sikh family face challenges when their adopted son falls in love with a Muslim girl.

Hindi Language.name: Anhoniyon Ka Andhera
Hindi Language.description: It is story of a family that has horrifying experiences with the dark world, of ghosts and spirits. And how they deal with them and help others .

Hindi Language.name: Bird Idol
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a bird called 'Hummi' who is not happy with the bird music and is greatly impressed by human music and how he introduces human music to the bird music by entering into a competition called Bird Idol and with his genuine effort he puts himself and his parents into trouble.

Hindi Language.name: Rokkk
Hindi Language.description: New Delhi-based Anushka Walia, who lives with her widowed mother, gets a phone from her frightened sister, Ahana Warda, from Goa. Shortly thereafter a male comes on the phone and informs her that Ahana is in the mental asylum after being arrested for killing her husband, Ravi, and sister-in-law, Nishita. Anushka's mother had not approved of her daughter marrying resort-owner, Ravi, and as a result they had not spoken to each other for many years. Anushka, however, departs for Goa and meets with the investigating CBI Officer, Ranvir, but is unable to see nor speak with Ahana who has apparently disappeared. Her investigations will pit her against an unknown entity from the Warda residence, and will entrap her in a horrific nightmarish world from which there is no escape.

Hindi Language.name: Love U... Mr. Kalakaar!
Hindi Language.description: The only daughter of a wealthy businessman falls in love with a middle-classed underemployed artist.

Hindi Language.name: Utt Pataang
Hindi Language.description: A man and his private-detective friend attempt to deal with a bitter ex-girlfriend and a missing bag full of cash.

Hindi Language.name: Do Saheliyaan... Kismat Ki Kathputaliyaan
Hindi Language.description: The friends grow up and eventually unite Roop and Badri. Because of this, Maithili's grandmother and Bhavri's father wish to get the girls, married to keep them out of further trouble. Kalindi takes this opportunity to disgrace Maithili and her family. Maithili's wedding has been arranged with an elite Rajput, Shaurya Singh Shekhawat, a military officer. Kalindi goes to Shaurya's border camp, switching Maithili's photograph with Bhavri's in the hope that Shaurya would believe that his future in-laws were trying to deceive him. Shaurya sees Bhavri's picture and falls in love with her. Bhavri's marriage is more difficult to arrange since Maithili's grandmother has spread rumors about her throughout the village. It is the talented and educated Rabari boy, Anadi, who stands up for Bhavri (after watching her from afar) and agrees to marry her. The girls have not seen the men whom they will wed. Maithili and Bhavri's weddings are on the same day. Maithili gifts her friend an identical wedding dress to her own. They are happy that both will be going to the same honeymoon destination, on the same train, finally free to be friends.

Hindi Language.name: Sahi Dhandhe Galat Bande
Hindi Language.description: The son of a politician is abducted. The kidnappers play a dangerous double game to support activists against land grabbing by the Government.

Hindi Language.name: Michael
Hindi Language.description: A dedicated cop's life spirals into chaos after a tragic accident during crowd control. Fired and haunted by threats against his son, he battles failing vision while taking questionable jobs to survive.

Hindi Language.name: Sonchidi
Hindi Language.description: Two travelers who are in search of a flying-craft, which they believe could possibly take them to the ultimate escape from the cycle of births. On their way they record their memories, dreams and fears in a sound-recorder and a notebook.

Hindi Language.name: Kashi: Ab Na Rahe Tera Kagaz Kora
Hindi Language.description: The show reflected the story of six-year-old Kashi who was born in a lower-caste family and her journey to fulfill her dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Chhajje Chhajje Ka Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Chhajje Chhajje Ka Pyaar is an Indian television series that aired on Sony TV February 28-26 July 2011.

Hindi Language.name: Saas Bahu Aur Saazish
Hindi Language.description: The latest news on whats going on in the Indian TV serial dramas with exclusive behind the scenes gossip with the small screen stars of Bollywood.

Hindi Language.name: London Calling
Hindi Language.description: An architect, who is tormented by nightmares, falls for the neglected wife of his employer.

Hindi Language.name: Golden Petal Awards
Hindi Language.description: Golden Petal Awards is an indian award function to honour characters and programs as a reward for their incomparable contribution to the Colors TV network.

Hindi Language.name: Damadamm!
Hindi Language.description: On a break from his pushy girlfriend, a male falls for the sister of his employer.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Faasley
Hindi Language.description: A daughter uncovers a dark secret from her wealthy father's past.

Hindi Language.name: Aarohan
Hindi Language.description: The patriarch, Suryashekhar Chattopadhyay is a deeply religious person and a man of firm principles. He treats the predictions of the horoscope like axiomatic truth, realizing little that such predictions, often interpreted in equivocal language, can be misleading. His obduracy distances him from his only son, Alok, who refuses to put up with his father's unbending attitude to the horoscope. Alok marries outside his caste, denounces his horoscope, and leaves home to settle abroad with his wife. Suryashekhar's wife; an accomplished and educated lady, is reduced to being a mute witness to all this and never protests against her husband's whims and harsh decisions. She bears everything with a quiet, resigned dignity. Their grandson, Arijit comes to stay with them through a strange turn of event, and they are overjoyed. But, by then, Suryashekhar has decided that he will die in Benaras (Kashi) to rid himself of the eternal cycle of rebirth. He decides to check in at Moksha Bhavan [lit. 'The House of Salvation'] , a house where people come to die. There Arijit meets Kasturi, a Bihari woman, whose mother-in-law awaits death. Her husband, Shyam cannot father a child, but blames her and abuses her which she refuses to accept. Kasturi takes it up as a challenge to prove that she is capable of carrying a child and as a result gets involved with Arijit. But by another turn of events, Arijit decides to marry Kasturi once he comes to know that he has sired the child she has conceived. As Arijit's parents come to Benaras, and come to know of their relationship, they refuse to accept their son's decision. While confronting Arijit, Alok has a massive heart attack and dies.Suryashekhar is shattered. As the embers of their son's pyre die out, Suryashekhar's wife confronts him for the first time and questions his unbending faith and the truthfulness of the predictions of the horoscope. Suryashekhar realizes how wrong he has been all through his life.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbai Mast Kallander
Hindi Language.description: A hair-stylist with money problems overhears a plot to kidnap her landlord's son.

Hindi Language.name: The Film Love.Com... The Ultimate Killing Site
Hindi Language.description: A contract killer accompanied by a bar dancer goes on the run from his employer and gangsters.

Hindi Language.name: Baba Aiso Varr Dhoondo
Hindi Language.description: Baba Aiso Varr Dhoondo is the story of a woman called Bharti and the hardships she has to face because of her short height.

Hindi Language.name: Aakhari Decision
Hindi Language.description: An assassin, who wants to quit, is asked to carry out a final assignment.

Hindi Language.name: Shobha Somnath Ki
Hindi Language.description: Shobha, a fearless princess, participates in a valiant battle against the Afghan invader, Mahmud of Ghazni. She fights tirelessly to save the temple of Somnath from getting destroyed.

Hindi Language.name: Payback
Hindi Language.description: A man decides to re-pay a good Samaritan but regrets doing so after he finds out that he is an assassin.

Hindi Language.name: Shahrukh Bola 'Khoobsurat Hai Tu'... And She Believed in It
Hindi Language.description: While dealing with personal issues, a woman hopes to meet and act with a famous actor.

Hindi Language.name: Jamunia
Hindi Language.description: Jamunia is the story of an 18 year old girl. Orphaned at an early age, she lives with her uncle and aunty at her maternal grandparent's house. Although she supports her family, she continues to be exploited by uncle and aunty.

Hindi Language.name: The Impossible Murder
Hindi Language.description: An old lady is killed in a locked room under impossible circumstances. Five witnesses hear her screaming while trying to break open the door to her room. When they enter, she is dead but there is no sign of the killer or the murder weapon. Why would someone kill an old lady in a remote village. And more importantly: How did he do it?

Hindi Language.name: Daayen Ya Baayen
Hindi Language.description: An impoverished village school-teacher's problems mount after winning a car.

Hindi Language.name: Khap
Hindi Language.description: Human rights workers encounter obstacles while investigating killings in modern secular India.

Hindi Language.name: Mrs. Tendulkar
Hindi Language.description: The Tendulkars are unlike any family in their neighbourhood as the wife is the bread earner and the husband is the homemaker.

Hindi Language.name: R. K. Laxman Ki Duniya
Hindi Language.description: This TV series is based on the books and works of R. K. Laxman. The episodes and incidents would involve happenings in the life of the common man as depicted by Laxman over the years. This series would focus on the character of the common man who is a silent spectator of marching time. Meek and silent , the common man is a witness to everything: scheming politicians, gossiping housewives and rapacious bureaucrats.

Hindi Language.name: Looteri Dulhan
Hindi Language.description: Billo, a girl adopted by a Haryanvi family, who position themselves as sari traders from Uttar Pradesh. Their real business is to con 70-plus men who want to marry young woman and then flee with their valuables.

Hindi Language.name: Shabri
Hindi Language.description: An impoverished woman faces off against gangsters as well as the police after her brother is killed.

Hindi Language.name: Bhopali
Hindi Language.description: In 1984, the world's worst industrial disaster devastated and contaminated Bhopal, India. Today the suffering continues, prompting victims to fight for justice and corporate responsibility, which has long been ignored.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Maa
Hindi Language.description: The story of Jhilmil, a street kid, who is on a mission to look for her real mother.

Hindi Language.name: Havai Dada
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around the affectionate relationship of a little girl and her grandfather. The grandfather lovingly called Havai Dada, has always had a dream of going on an airplane, a wish that his granddaughter Bela wants to fulfill.

Hindi Language.name: Teen Thay Bhai
Hindi Language.description: In order to inherit a mansion, three squabbling brothers must fulfill their late grandfather's wishes.

Hindi Language.name: Kumbh Karan
Hindi Language.description: Kumbh and Karan are twin boys who stay in the small colony of AJAB-GAJABPUR. Kumbh is perennially sleepy and hungry and has obvious love towards food (for some reason especially likes honey). He is big, strong with a real soft heart. Karan is an agile, sharp and better (looking) version of his twin.

Hindi Language.name: Pardes Mein Mila Koi Apna
Hindi Language.description: Pardes Mein Mila Koi Apna is a conflicting love story - a story of a romance and a bond between two contrasting individuals, who are forced to get married in the face of unavoidable circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Shakal Pe Mat Ja
Hindi Language.description: Airport security and the Anti-Terrorist Squad interrogate wise-cracking, suspicious-looking amateur film-makers.

Hindi Language.name: Toh Baat Pakki!
Hindi Language.description: A pushy busybody invites a young man to be her tenant, in hopes of arranging a marriage for her younger sister; but then has to get rid off him when she believes she has found an even better match.

Hindi Language.name: Dance India Dance: Li'l Masters
Hindi Language.description: This program offers a platform for young dancers, where they compete through various challenging rounds to win.

Hindi Language.name: Hi Padosi Kaun Hai Doshi
Hindi Language.description: Hansmukh Lal Mehta and Harvansh Lal Mehta are neighbours and have nameplates on their doors reading H. L. Mehta, due to which many funny situations are created

Hindi Language.name: Koel
Hindi Language.description: A young boy comes from the village to work as a domestic in prosperous Delhi (India). He is personal servant to an eccentric old lady who lives with her unemployed son and his beautiful wife. The daughter-in-law is the main earning member and therefore holds the family together. The old lady confides in the boy her fears of being abandoned by the family. When the daughter-in-law , who is unhappily married , acquires an admirer the household begins to worry about its financial future.

Hindi Language.name: Trump Card
Hindi Language.description: Three friends find their lives endangered after a huge inheritance.

Hindi Language.name: Delhi in a Day
Hindi Language.description: When the money of an idealistic British traveler disappears in a nouveau-riche Delhi household, the staff are given twenty-four hours to replace it or face the consequences. Delhi In A Day is a darkly comedic portrayal of upper-class Delhi society, examining how the haves and the have-nots coexist in the context of the contemporary nouveau-riche Delhi home.

Hindi Language.name: The Command Force
Hindi Language.description: The Command Force team investigates the difficult crimes committed in India. Different episodes have a different story.

Hindi Language.name: Ganga Kii Dheej
Hindi Language.description: The ordeals faced by young unmarried women in a fictional village called Kaliganj in West Bengal protected under strict surveillance before they are married.

Hindi Language.name: Channel V Dare 2 Date
Hindi Language.description: 'Dare 2 Date' is an anti-romance, anti-mush series where VJ Andy plays part Cupid (and part Devil) pairing people who are pretty much the complete opposite of each other's "ideal mate."

Hindi Language.name: Surya Puran
Hindi Language.description: Hindi-language Mythological show based on the Saura Purana which eulogizes the Surya, the Hindu Sun -God and his incarnations.

Hindi Language.name: U R My Jaan
Hindi Language.description: When Akash, a renowned tycoon, obsessed with wealth, meets Reena, a small town Indian girl with big starry dreams, he is confronted with perplexing choices and must make life altering decisions before it is too late. The film is a musical romantic love story shot in India.

Hindi Language.name: Kaho Na Kaho
Hindi Language.description: Kaho Na Kaho is a 2009 Romantic Drama movie directed and produced by Sanjay Niranjan. The film starred Tarun Khanna, Urvashi, Dinesh Hingoo, Rana Jung Bahadur, Shahbaz Khan in the lead role.

Hindi Language.name: Rishton Se Badi Pratha
Hindi Language.description: The story highlights the practice of "honour-killings"-meted out to young people in love who hail from different castes/family backgrounds. Abhay and Surabhi are in love, but their families are not agreeable to this and decide to kill them.They are spared because Surabhi is expecting and they feel she may bear a son.

Hindi Language.name: Aise Karo Naa Vidaa
Hindi Language.description: Reva is a young and innocent village woman who is about to get married. However, in a traumatic turn of events, she is raped by Prince Aryaman, who is smitten with her.

Hindi Language.name: Love Express
Hindi Language.description: A series of rumors and the incompatibility of the bride and groom threaten to derail a train-bound wedding party.

Hindi Language.name: Jo Hum Chahein
Hindi Language.description: In his bid to quickly boost his career, a male alienates himself from his family, friends, and true love.

Hindi Language.name: Mujhe Meri Family Se Bachao
Hindi Language.description: A 12-year-old boy constantly feels embarrassed by his eccentric family's outrageous antics. As he struggles to fit in at school and with friends, his family's hilarious behavior turns everyday life into a series of comic adventures.

Hindi Language.name: Piya Ka Ghar Pyaara Lage
Hindi Language.description: Centered around Sejal who has found a new meaning and dimension in her life after her marriage.She was a happy go lucky before her wedding, and now in her married avatar she has undergone a metamorphosis.

Hindi Language.name: Eleven
Hindi Language.description: The film portrays the life of 10 people who belong to different walks of life. Though each individual has achieved a measure of success in their individual lives, their darkest secrets come out in the open when all of them are given some time for introspection, when they meet each other in a bizarre twist of events.

Hindi Language.name: Corrode
Hindi Language.description: A woman's need for an unfinished sculpture blossoms into an obsession.

Hindi Language.name: Swaha: Life Beyond Superstition
Hindi Language.description: A Holy man has an unsettling experience after visiting the house of one of his devotees.

Hindi Language.name: Tum Jo Mile
Hindi Language.description: Raja (Daebu Banerji) an orphan and Kajol (Nivedita Tiwari) from a rich family background are students at Dudley College in Mumbai. The college is heading towards the summer break and the Principal Mr Bhatia (Jalees Sherwani) announcers the popular annual Dancing and singing competition by selecting male and female students through a number matching system. Incidentally Raja and Kajols numbers are paired for the performance but Kajol hesitates. Raja decides not to participate after Kajol's hassitation but Kajols sophisticated father Ranveer Singh (Shaheed Khan) who also participated during his college days is hyped up about Kajol winning the traditional college gold medal. Raja hasn't been to college for days leaving very little time for Kajol for preparation. Meantime Kajol becomes anxious to make her father happy and finally skips class to find Raja who is helping his adopted father (Moti Seth) in his restaurant. Kajol managers to find Raja and persuades him for the competition with tears. They head towards preparation. Raja and Kajol make the headlines at the 2oth annual dancing competition with a superb performance. College breaks and time comes for separation. Raja and Kajol begin to realise the emptiness in each other's life. Separation makes Raja and Kajol's heart fonder. Fate gives them many opportunities to meet without effort and every time they meet their love becomes stronger. Raja and Kajol's separation starts when Raja with constant health issues drops unconscious after the gold medal winner's dinner with Kajol. Kajol's family finds out that Kajol is in Love and is wondering who the Son in law will be, but fate has something else stored for Raja and Kajol. With both deeply in love and no family issues in relationship, find out why it is still so hard for Raja and Kajol to express their love for each other. Find out what turns fate has taken into their lives and what is their Destiny. Watch the full movie, Tum Jo Mile - A Sweet Love Story online, onl

Hindi Language.name: Idiot Box
Hindi Language.description: Unable to come with any ideas about a day-time soap, a writer decides to chronicle his own life.

Hindi Language.name: Hum
Hindi Language.description: Story of five women in a modern village who are on their independent and individual journey but their paths get interwoven due to the political, social and economical scenario in the village and like five fingers they join together to be a 'muthee'...to be HUM.

Hindi Language.name: I Am 24
Hindi Language.description: Subhendu, a middle-aged writer, falls in love with a much younger woman named Sheela. In order to woo her, he pretends to be a younger man.

Hindi Language.name: The X Factor India
Hindi Language.description: A Indian music competition to find new singing talent, contested by aspiring singers drawn from public auditions.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Ishq Nachaya
Hindi Language.description: Kamal is a spoiled, selfish young woman with a grandiose sense of entitlement and the maturity of a four-year-old. She lives with her father and uncles and has never heard the word no. During a family wedding she meets Gurjyot, who is immediately smitten. Their marriage is arranged, and they are promptly engaged. Kamal's father decides to take her to Bangkok to visit her invalid mother, and there she meets Jyoti and Karan. Despite her upcoming nuptials, she falls head over heels in love with Karan, and grows up immediately. She has already committed to someone else, and family honor is not a game she can win.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Sunday Kyun Aata hai
Hindi Language.description: The film is based on the 4 real shoe-polish boys of Goregaon Railway Station, Mumbai, who earn their daily bread and butter by polishing shoes at railway station. Their lives are full of struggle and hard work, where there is a limited scope for happiness, but even then they try to keep themselves happy. After dealing with their day-to-day problems, they still have to face a very big problem which goes by the name "Sunday", which in turn make their lives hell. That is the reason these shoe-polish boys often say, "Yeh Sunday Kyun Aata Hai".

Hindi Language.name: Hamara Shahar - Bombay, Our City
Hindi Language.description: The film story based on daily battle for survival of the 4 million slum dwellers of Bombay who make up half the city's population

Hindi Language.name: Golden Era with Annu Kpoor
Hindi Language.description: The show is a reminiscence of Indian cinema with veteran Anu Kapoor. The show is a walk through the melodious and heart touching era of Bollywood music. The show is divided into three harmonious segments followed by some memorable songs. Show starts with ins and outs of Bollywood and ends with a poetic feel which left you in the mood of nostalgia. It's a mesmerizing journey of an hour from 9 to10 only on Mastiii channel.

Hindi Language.name: On the other side
Hindi Language.description: Neha suspects Vikram of infidelity after having spent 5 years together. The suspicion grows every moment as she feels the presence of an unknown entity around her, which has been trying to convey her something through means other than known human senses.

Hindi Language.name: Maan Rahe Tera Pitaah
Hindi Language.description: Anmol battles against the common man to regain the revered outlook towards her apparent "mentally-challenged" father, Durgaprasad.

Hindi Language.name: Impatient Vivek
