Hindi Language.description: Rejected by the woman he loves, a slacker abducts her shortly before her marriage with another male.

Hindi Language.name: Padduram
Hindi Language.description: Debashish a.k,a Dabboo / Debu is quite harrowed and perplexed with the constant teasing and leg pulling that goes on in his school and colony alike. They call him names because he breaks wind at the drop of a hat. This is his story.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: A young woman's journey towards self realization.

Hindi Language.name: Mittal V/S Mittal
Hindi Language.description: Girls have dreams - dreams of a fairytale romance, of prince charming sweeping them off their feet, a dream wedding and living happily ever-after. Mitali, a successful model, also had dreams... Then one day she met Karan, the Mittal scion, the heir to one of the richest families in the country. Mitali 's simple, middle-class upbringing is in complete contrast to Karan's super-brat lifestyle. But Karan was smitten by Mitali. Accustomed to getting what he wants in life, Karan landed up at Mitali's home with his parents with a marriage proposal. Delighted at their daughter's luck, Mitali's family approved of the match. And Mitali entered Karan's home and life as his newly-wedded bride. It was not long before Mitali's dreams turned into her worst nightmare. Her mother-in-law detested her and created misunderstandings between Karan and her. Karan turned out to be a puppet in his mother's hands and her father-in-law is a helpless, mute spectator. Karan has a certain pattern of dealing with women and wanted to subdue Mitali's independent streak. He who appeared to be a loving husband was in fact a violent monster at night within the privacy of their bedroom.Unable to bear the humiliation and pain after she resisted his advances and is raped by him,Mitali decided to take charge of her life. She decided to fight back.Mitali walked out of her in-laws home, hired a lawyer and filed a case against her husband. Karan retaliated by hiring the best lawyer money can buy to fight on his behalf. Mittal Vs Mittal is about to he heard in court. It is a case on file that fights for the rights of women like Mitali who are subjugated to domestic violence and inhuman treatment at the hands of husband and in-laws. It is a case that will empower women to fight for their pride, respect and their very right to live with dignity. It is Mitali Mittal versus Karan Mittal...

Hindi Language.name: Ahinsa Parmo Dharma: Jeeo Aur Jeene Do
Baat Hamari Pakki Hai
Hindi Language.description: Set in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand, Baat Hamaari Pakkki Hai is the story of Sachi - an orphan who lives with her Mama and Mami - and Shravan, a businessman's youngest son. Sachi is an obedient and family oriented girl. She believes that whatever her elders decide is for her best. After being rejected by many boys and their families, Sachi's marriage becomes the only agenda in her Mami's life. Each time a prospective groom arrives, Sachi is displayed and goes through the humiliation of being displayed and rejection time and again, till one day Shravan walks into her life and fills it with joy. Due to a series of misunderstandings, Sachi's rishta is fixed with Shravan but this joy also proves to be short-lived as Sachi realizes that Shravan loves someone else. The story explores the journey of a rich spoilt brat, Shravan finding love in Sachi, and becoming a responsible and caring husband.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Do Anjaane
Hindi Language.description: After the homicide of his partner, a police officer assaults a male, is arrested, and after his discharge, must partner with him as a security guard.

Hindi Language.name: Beend Banoongaa Ghodi Chadhunga
Hindi Language.description: Beend Banoongaa Ghodi Chadhunga is an Indian television series which aired on Imagine TV. It is based on the story of two people who get caught up in the web of strong traditions. The show is set in Jaipur.

Hindi Language.name: Sanskaar Laxmi
Hindi Language.description: A less educated but worldly wise, mature and extremely talented Laxmi overcomes obstacles to settle down in her life.

Hindi Language.name: Mera Naam Karegi Roshan
Hindi Language.description: Reet obeys her father's every wish, including his last wish, for which the family disown her and she has to fend for herself. Will she survive this tough fight against her own?

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Circus Ka Naya Daur
Hindi Language.description: This edition of Comedy Circus sees veterans of the show team up with fresh faces as they work together to bring the house down with their unique blend of comedy.

Hindi Language.name: Cycle Kick
Hindi Language.description: Two students face-off against each other for the ownership of a bicycle.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Tera Ghar Yeh Mera Ghar
Asha Bhosle et Dubaï (Carnet Filmé: 7 décembre 2011 - 16 décembre 2011)
Ashoka the Hero
Hindi Language.description: A young boy finds ancient powers and must use them to save mankind while managing his life as a school going 8 year old boy.

Hindi Language.name: Bom
Hindi Language.description: Malana, a remote village in the Himalayas, isolated from outside civilization for thousands of years has been fostering a primitive existence in harmony with nature and a unique model of democracy of consensus. They have also been producing some of the best quality hashish in the world. A real life story of transition, this ancient civilization being invaded and obliterated by the modern democracy. Narrated in an epic structure, a visual essay from the edge of the world with a message of trust, peace and eternal unity.

Hindi Language.name: Vroom
Hindi Language.description: Gangsters try to locate a car that includes a special chip.

Hindi Language.name: Lava Kusa: The Warrior Twins
Hindi Language.description: Lava and Kusa were born to mother Sita at Sage Valmiki's hermitage. They grew up learning the essence of Ramayana and master the art of war by using divine weapons from the guidance of Sage Valmiki. The story is about their thrilling childhood experiences blended with action, comedy and enchanting magical powers. On invitation the twins set off to Ayodhya to recite Valmiki Ramayana in front of the King Rama. The twins learn that Mata Sita was sent to vanvas by Lord Rama. They return from Ayodhya with anger and rage towards lord Rama. Lord Rama performs Aswamedha yagna for the propriety of his kingdom. The twins happen to read the declaration of Lord Rama inscripted on a golden plate on the forehead on the horse, and arrests the horse. They hope that this would bring Lord Rama in front of them, so that they can question him regarding the ill treatment given to Mata Sita and to debate on Lord Rama's most acclaimed principle of dharma. They arrest the Aswamedha horse thus inviting the mighty Ayodhya Empire to a war against them.

Hindi Language.name: Havan
Hindi Language.description: A story about a devotee and the God..

Hindi Language.name: Do Hanson Ka Jodaa
Hindi Language.description: Preeti, an ambitious young girl, is married to Suryakamal, an ordinary man, much against her wishes. However, she gradually begins developing feelings for him after witnessing his caring nature.

Hindi Language.name: Malegaon Ka Chintu
Hindi Language.description: Chintu, from Malegaon, is a lively yet emotional young man with a heart of gold. He loves only three things in life: his coat, bicycle and Pinky

Hindi Language.name: SHUDRA: The Untouchables
Hindi Language.description: SHUDRA-the untouchables is the story of 250 million people subjugated in war and condemned to slavery and bestial existence for ages. these peace loving & imprudent people of ancient times were usurped by more aggressive and acquisitive group of men and societies. They were named differently across the globe like -Blacks,Red Indians,Dasya, Chandal,Black caste,out caste, Scheduled caste & SHUDRA-the untouchables.......... An out caste man SHUDRA dies for want of a gulp of water, a child is publicly violated for uttering holy mantras,a pregnant women is a forced in to physical submission, a wounded man dies in need of medicine, all for one crime only ........born in the caste of shudra- the untouchables

Hindi Language.name: Do Dilon Ke Khel Mein
Hindi Language.description: Pushy parents attempt to get their rebellious children married.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Mere Phere
Hindi Language.description: An irate groom-to-be abducts a recently married bickering couple and asks them to take him to his wedding.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Dooriyan
Hindi Language.description: A divorced businesswoman with two children falls in love with a much younger man.

Hindi Language.name: My Friend Ganesha 3
Hindi Language.description: Abused by his relatives, a young boy seeks the help of a truck-driver's wife, and Bhagwan Shri Ganeshji.

Hindi Language.name: Rakt Sambandh
Hindi Language.description: A blind girl who gets married to a rich family and disasters happen.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Yahi Sach Hai
Hindi Language.description: Corrupt police officers and politicians create obstacles and challenges for a new rookie.

Hindi Language.name: Just Dance
Hindi Language.description: Just Dance is an Indian television dance-reality series on Star Plus. The series is judged by well-known Bollywood film actor Hrithik Roshan along with choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant and film director Farah Khan.

Hindi Language.name: Pink Saris
Hindi Language.description: Now she follows Sampat Pal Devi, the leader of the 'Pink Gang' who brings her own brand of justice to the streets of Uttar Pradesh, India, combating violence against women.

Hindi Language.name: He - The Only One
Hindi Language.description: A carefree guy who lands himself and family in trouble when he comes across a goon Lallan Pandey.

Hindi Language.name: Madam Ki Paathshala
Hindi Language.description: A young and beautiful lady tutor tries to teach English and other communication skills to the villagers so that they can be at par with the residents of a city.

Hindi Language.name: Jaana Pehchana
Hindi Language.description: It's been 32 years since Lily died of cancer. Then Arun meets Lily's lookalike, who wants to publish his autobiography.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Ishq Haaye
Hindi Language.description: Story of Manjari, who realizes the hard way that first love or love at first sight is not necessarily true or ultimate love. What appears to her as her final destination turns out to be just a mirage.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Second... Jo Zindagi Badal De...
Hindi Language.description: A dual look at a woman's life - when she misses her train; and when she actually catches it.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Circus Ke Tansen
Hindi Language.description: This unique reality-based comedy show brings together noted singers, actors and comedians on the same platform for a never seen before presentation.

Hindi Language.name: Dhoondh Legi Manzil Humein
Hindi Language.description: The story leads to and revolves around Alka's life-altering moment that changes the course of her journey called life.

Hindi Language.name: Shrimati Swara Raje Deshmukh Sarvggun Sampanna
Hindi Language.description: Story of Swara a theater dancer married into a rich family but her in laws don't know the profession she comes from.

Hindi Language.name: Armanon Ka Balidaan-Aarakshan
Hindi Language.description: A love story between Sumedha, whose family lost a son to the agitation against reservation legislation for jobs and Aakash, who has benefited from it to become a District Magistrate.

Hindi Language.name: Shaktimaan the Greatest Cyber Yogic Hero
Hindi Language.description: Vehaan Arya who has trained with 7 guru masters in the Himalayas and gained amazing yogic super powers.

Hindi Language.name: Trapped in Tradition: Rivaaz
Hindi Language.description: A man falls in love with a village belle who is destined for traditional prostitution.

Hindi Language.name: Nakshatra
Hindi Language.description: An aspiring movie-writer gets involved in a diamond heist and goes on the run from the police.

Hindi Language.name: Bachao - Inside Bhoot Hai...
Hindi Language.description: Rumours say that a year back some body was murdered at Blue Roof Guest House. After that incident people believe that the guest House is haunted and spooky.

Hindi Language.name: A Strange Love Story
Hindi Language.description: There are things that science can't explain and also some events that can't be understood. This story is based on a young aspiring photographer named Kabeer. A dream that he cherishes to show the world that he has never seen before. In the midst he unleashes of being not of this world. All what he cares for is a girl named Jennifer. They start seeing things, and people around starts getting horribly murdered, and all the evidence directs to Kabeer and Jennifer's direction.

Hindi Language.name: B & W the Black and White Fact
Virgin Goat
Hindi Language.description: Farmer wakes up, rapes goat Climax:Goat no longer virgin.

Hindi Language.name: Meethi Choori No 1
Hindi Language.description: The hot new celebrity gossip show for celebrity women who are not afraid to speak their mind. 8 women will be put together in a chat room kind of setting to do what they love doing - talk.

Hindi Language.name: Saas Bahu Aur Betiyaan
Hindi Language.description: 24 hour updates of TV shows, serials twists, Reality shows, TV stars unplugged, Film Stars, Gossip and all doze of Entertainment

Hindi Language.name: Badmaash Company - Ek Shararat Hone Ko Hai
Stand By
Hindi Language.description: Corruption, favoritism and nepotism threaten and endanger the career and life of an aspiring football player.

Hindi Language.name: Neer Bhare Tere Naina Devi
Hindi Language.description: Story of an innocent girl, Laxmi, who gets branded as the reincarnation of a Goddess because she brings good luck to her religious family. Laxmi is born to an extremely poor family in a drought stricken village, craving for rain. Her father, who is in no position to feed her, decides to abandon her in the village temple. However, at that very moment, the rain gods smile on the village and a three-year-long drought is broken. Laxmi is proclaimed to be the bearer of this good fortune and is bestowed the status of a Goddess. While she receives special care and attention, she is also forced to lead an abnormal life, very different from a regular girl her age. The story traces Devi's exploitation at the hands of the village, entrenched in blind faith and superstition.

Hindi Language.name: Ammaji Ki Galli
Hindi Language.description: The show revolves around the lives of people living in a jam-packed street in Amritsar. Ammaji is the main protagonist and also the narrator of the show.

Hindi Language.name: Sankalp
Hindi Language.description: Three friends, Abhilasha, Vikrant and Meenakshi are fighting diabetes. Abhilasha and Vikrant have diabetes type 1 i.e. insulin dependent and Meenakshi sufers from type 2 diabetes.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Mothers
Hindi Language.description: "TO PRESERVE YOUR HONOUR TAKE UP ARMS YOURSLVES YE MOTHER'S" is an autograph given by Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose to the little revolutionary of this story Shanti Ghosh in 1931 at a student conference in Comilla. This story is based upon the life of world's youngest girl's revolutionaries, Shanti Ghosh & Suniti Chaudhary from Bengal...... On 15 December 1931 a news become the headlines of leading newspaper of India, London,Russia & Iorland ( The Statesmen, Amrit bajar patrika etc.) "TIEPRA (TRIPURA) DISTT MAGISTRATE & COLLECTOR SHOT DEAD BY A GIRL AT HIS BUNGALOW TWO YOUNG GIRL ARRESTED [It is reported that Distt Magistrate & Collector Mr. CGB Steven shot dead at his bungalow by two young girls. The incident was reported at about 10 AM in the morning. The two girls was arrested at spot and identified as SUNITI CHAUDHARY D/O UMACHARN CHAUDHARY, 13 yrs old the another is SHANTI GHOSH D/O PROF. DEBENDRA NATH GHOSE ,13 yrs old, both resident of Comilla and both are student of 8th class of Faizunisan Girl High school. "] In the Pre-Independence era the nation was burning with the desire of Independence and the British were struggling to control the rampaging non-violent movement on the one side and the revolutionary strikes on the other, two young girls Shanti Ghosh & Suniti Chaudhary echoed Indian sprit through their sacrifice. Shanti & Suniti two ordinary girls are studying in a local school. They don't even know the meaning of Ghulami & Ajadi. They gradually come to know about Jatin Das, Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, Sukhdev, Surjya Sen, Subhash Chandra Bose & others through their elders. By and by they also join the group of revolutionaries called JUGANTAR. Akhil Nandi is a senior leader of Comilla Jugantar group. Sishir Chaudhary elder brother of Suniti is a trusted & valued lieutenant of group and Biren Bhattacharji is a sharp shooter and a good trainer of arms. Prafulla Brahma is a school student she is a close associate of group. This group organizes a big demonstration after the death of Jatin Das in September 1929 and when they heard about the news of Chittogong uprising by Masterda on 18th April 1930 they planning to do it in comilla also. On 23rd March 1931 Bhagat Singh, Rajguru & Sukhdev hanged in Lahore jail. Very soon this news flashed all over India and at comilla. Akhil & group decide to take the revenge of the death of 3 martyrs and plan to kill three British officers they choose Collector Steven, Suptd of Police & Distt Intelligence Officer. Some members of the group reject this decision and given up the group. The group then divides but Akhil & Biren soon take decision to do it. When they are planning to kill, a boy of the separated group disclose it to Collector Steven by this the three officers stop to come out from their houses and start offices in their houses. This becomes a problem for the group. For this they choose Shanti & Suniti to do this action. They accept the decision cheerfully and are trained in secret in the hills nearby. Smilingly and bravely they tolerate all the hardship of the training and are finally ready to do their ultimate task. The two girls approached the collector Mr. Steven at his bungalow with a petition for permission for a swimming club. When face to face with him they fired at the collector and shot him dead. This heroic action of the two young girls thrilled the country from one end to other. Their unusual claim, serenity and cheerfulness seen all through their under trial days in the prison and in the court, struck one and all with wonder. All the time they song and laughed, they expected to die a martyr's death, but in view of their tender age, they were given the sentence of life imprisonment. Though a bit disappointed, they took the judgment cheerfully and bravely and entered the portals of the prison house, singing aloud Poet Nazurul's famous song "OH BREAK DOWN THOSE IRON BARS! BURN AWAY ALL THESE PRISON HOUSES!"

Hindi Language.name: Love U Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Geet lives life to the fullest; she comes across Aditya, who's mending his broken heart. They meet each other on a train journey and from there on, the memorable journey of love begins.

Hindi Language.name: Soch Lo
Hindi Language.description: An injured and amnesiac male who robs to survive in a desert, is rescued with people with an agenda of their own.

Hindi Language.name: My Barefoot Friend: The Story of Shallim and His Old Rickshaw
Hindi Language.description: Running barefoot between the wooden shafts for half a lifetime. What he wanted to carry in his rickshaw, actually, was his family.

Hindi Language.name: Bohlol Dana - A Sage of Baghdad
Aashiqui.In
Hindi Language.description: A dark complexioned waitress develops an online relationship with a hunk in her college.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Husbands
Hindi Language.description: Three married men seek counseling from a fourth in order to meet and date other women.

Hindi Language.name: Nirvana13
Hindi Language.description: A psychological, spiritual and philosophical take on the concept of life and death. A dialogue between a patient and a nurse both wishing the same. An unforgettable heart shaking journey of questions on human morality and helplessness.

Hindi Language.name: Satrangee Parachute
Hindi Language.description: Amidst terrorist alerts, five small-town children set out to procure a parachute from a city.

Hindi Language.name: Classic Legends
Hindi Language.description: This nostalgic documentary series takes a look back at Bollywood past paying tribute to the stars who paved the way and inspired millions.

Hindi Language.name: Thoda Hai Bas Thode Ki Zaroorat Hai
Guftagoo
Hindi Language.description: A heart to heart interview based show of Rajya Sabha TV. Guftagoo is an explorative-inquisitive and intimate conversation with celebrities and important people from various fields. Show's host is Syed Mohd Irfan.

Hindi Language.name: The Great Indian Marriage Bazaar
Hindi Language.description: In the middle of a family wedding, documentary filmmaker, Ruchika is put on the spot as her aunts poke at her about 'mission son-in-law'. As the pressure mounts, Ruchika narrates her story of going through with the arranged marriage process in modern-day India in this quirky and profoundly raw film. Since India is the home to 40 percent of the world's marriages, of which 90 percent of these are arranged, 'The Great Indian Marriage Bazaar' is a film told through the Directors' lens about issues of morality, sexuality, beauty and femininity and most identity of cosmopolitan Indian women today.

Hindi Language.name: Queens! Destiny of Dance
Hindi Language.description: Mukta is a transgender. He/she is the best dancer in a dedicated Indian palace community. Mukta is a natural leader whom all the other transgender dancers look up to. That is until Nandini, a beautiful young girl, enters their life and her amazing dancing skills enrage Mukta. If she a goddess why did she come here?

Hindi Language.name: Bitto
Hindi Language.description: Bitto is set against the backdrop of social discrimination in a village in Uttar Pradesh. It depicts the tyranny subjugated by the upper castes on the lower castes.

Hindi Language.name: Malik Ek
Hindi Language.description: A spiritual film based on Sai Baba of Shirdi. It's based on his biography.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbhai Connection
Hindi Language.description: An Indian salesman, Faisal, joins an Atlanta IT company only to learn that it is run by the Mumbai mafia. Worse, he is forced to sell IT services to the Atlanta mafia. Even worse, they are not buying! Now Faisal's life is on the line and the only way he can get out alive is by going boldly where no salesman has gone before.

Hindi Language.name: Hair Is Falling: A Serious Comedy Film
Hindi Language.description: A model experiences personal and career challenges after his hair starts to fall.

Hindi Language.name: The Camp
Hindi Language.description: A child is kidnapped and others in the group get stranded while on a camping trip.

Hindi Language.name: ters: Castle of Dark Master
Hindi Language.description: 5ters - Castle Of Dark Master is an expedition across the real and the imaginary world undertaken by five kids who are led by destiny to fulfill their responsibility to nature in the form of an adventure that is filled with mystery, fantasy and intrigue. The five children, get lost in the forest, while on a school trip and they come across various thrilling adventures, the solving of which leads them onto a deep insight into their role and responsibility as the future of the world...

Hindi Language.name: Na Jaane Kabse
Hindi Language.description: Karan Bajaj, a bartender turned resort developer, is the King of Tragedies. He is ditched at the altar by his fiance for the third time, and to save face he claims that she was not good enough for him. He is beaten by the family and thrown out, running down the road to save his life. There he hitches a ride with Anjali Premkar, a plain Jane runaway librarian and self proclaimed Drama Queen. Karan's new venture, the "Honey and Moon Resort", was to be inaugurated with him and his new bride. Now, without a bride, does he face public and financial failure, or will this very dull, crazy girl come to his rescue?

Hindi Language.name: Aagaah: The Warning
Hindi Language.description: The body of a young girl is eerily possessed by a recently deceased terrorist.

Hindi Language.name: Khuda Kushi
Hindi Language.description: A bloody act of self scarifies by innocents carried in the name of the all mighty, with a point of view of destruction of humanity (religious terrorism) is Khuda Kushi.

Hindi Language.name: Who Done It?
Hindi Language.description: The thriller is set against a Gujarati backdrop and revolves around three families and a murder takes place in one of the families and the protagonist tries to unmask the murderer.

Hindi Language.name: Pangaa Gang
Hindi Language.description: The movie is set in modern times, in a beautiful place called Shantivan. The story follows the adventures of four kids with extraordinary powers as they set out to defend their homeland from unwelcome intruders. 'Pangaa Gang' traces the action-packed journey of Seven friends as they battle evil forces to protect their beautiful homeland from deforestation and also save their animal friends from extinction. It is a moral led story, which eventually communicates the message of "Good wins over Evil".

Hindi Language.name: Hamari Saas Leela
Hindi Language.description: Leela Parikh (Apara Mehta), a well-off woman who wants a perfect daughter-in-law. Harsh (Malhar Pandya), Sameer (Raashul Tondon), Devang (Prateek Shukla) and Aayush (Ankit Bathla) are her four sons. She starts her quest for finding the best brides for his sons. Consequently Harsh, Sameer, Devang, and Aayush got married respectively to Koyal (Aditi Sajwan), Sejal (Ketkie Jayashree), Kreeti (Priyamvada Kant) and Jigna (Neha Prajapati). Then the trouble starts in the family and Leela tries to solve them to live happily with all family members.

Hindi Language.name: India Investigates
Hindi Language.description: A crime based docu-drama program that deals with some of the most heinous crimes committed India. The investigating officers of the cases have narrated the stories as a first person account. It was first telecast on Fox History and Entertainment in India in January 2011.

Hindi Language.name: It Happens only in India
Hindi Language.description: Malishka Mendonsa takes the viewers on a journey which explores India in a unique and captivating manner. She digs deep to unravel unusual and bizarre cultural practices followed in different parts of India. "It Happens Only In India" brings to life tales from history, sprinkled with Malishka's typical light dose of humor.

Hindi Language.name: ALIF
Hindi Language.description: The hero have to win the dance tournament to save the world from being destroyed

Hindi Language.name: Journey from Zanskar
Hindi Language.description: JOURNEY FROM ZANSKAR reveals the lengths to which a dedicated community will go to seek an education for its children--on foot, on horseback, by jeep or bus--whatever it takes.

Hindi Language.name: Letters from the Desert (Eulogy to Slowness)
Hindi Language.description: A postman walks through the desert, his life flows slowly as does the desert sand. He is the only link between the secluded villagers, however, this is about to change due to a small technological device.

Hindi Language.name: Pink Gang
Hindi Language.description: The documentary tells the story of the "Pink Gang", Gulabi Gang in the Hindi language and more specifically of Sampat Pal Devi, their aging founder and undisputed leader, a woman of around fifty, totally unschooled, who lives in a tin shack. The Gulabi Gang was first born in 1990, but only in 2006 it's leader Sampat Devi actually gave it a name and a precise identity. The gang operates in one of the poorest areas of India, just south of Delhi, the Banda District, on the border between Uttar and Madhya Pradesh. What distinguishes this gang is that it is made up entirely of women, all dressed in pink saris and wielding a lathi, a wooden stick. The gang fights for justice, as Sampat tends to reiterate, through specific actions that aim to establish the rights of women. At first the actions did not appear to be organized, but rather a series of sporadic and somewhat ineffectual forms of individual protest. The oral traditional, a fundamental element of Indian history and culture, has helped the fame of these actions to spread, and convinced an increasing number of women to join Sampat Devi's gang.

Hindi Language.name: Cartography of Loneliness
Hindi Language.description: The documentary, "Cartografía de la soledad" (Cartography of Loneliness), is akin to a map tracing the emotions and feelings of women who find themselves totally alone on losing their husbands in three countries, India, Nepal and Afghanistan. The choice of these three countries which are so near each other and have significant ethnic and religious differences is not by chance. India is the country with the most widows in the world, totaling over 45 million. In Nepal, half of the female population is widowed or have been abandoned by their husbands: they are called "child widows" or baikaylas. Afghanistan has the highest proportion of widows in the world after 30 years of war. Tradition, society and religion have determined the course of their lives following their husbands' deaths. Many widows are abandoned by their families, or victim of women trafficking, or condemned to social ostracism. War, AIDS and child marriages are the main factors behind these figures. After living with them for 4 months, there have been impressive stories in a very determined historical, social and religious context, and also the medicine, human rights and education are intertwined in their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Musaa: The Most Wanted
Hindi Language.description: Fearing media exposure, gangsters kidnap a TV Channel's CEO and his family.

Hindi Language.name: Mission 11 July
Hindi Language.description: People are not born terrorists, but wrong influences and circumstances may make them one, and good influences may be able to change people as they end terrorism and killing in the name of the religion.

Hindi Language.name: Ashok Chakra: Tribute to Real Heroes
Hindi Language.description: Police arrest and interrogate a suspect for arranging and carrying out multiple terrorist attacks in the city.

Hindi Language.name: Guru
Hindi Language.description: The syllable gu means shadows. The syllable ru, he who disperses them. Because of the power to disperse darkness the guru is thus named.

Hindi Language.name: Chintu Skool
Hindi Language.description: This is a story of two children from different backgrounds. Chintu a fortunate boy with well to do parents and Putti the daughter of a housemaid who cannot afford a formal education. Chintu detests the idea of learning, Putti yearns to be in his school-shoes. As the two children endeavour to cope with their conflicts, they encounter Balwan, a character from a different world; one where success is defined by honesty, hard work etc. The emphasis on these attributes is symbolically presented. Chintu understands the importance of education, ethics and veracity through Balwan and He shares his lessons with Putti. Then, the two children take it upon themselves to educate the underprivileged

Hindi Language.name: Magar Ke Nagar
Hindi Language.description: A children quiz game show consisting of different rounds like quiz round and game round.after finalizing quiz round contestant qualify for next round in magar ke Nagar where they have to show their capabilities to cross the hurdles to cross the dangerous magar ke Nagar.

Hindi Language.name: Opposites Attract
Hindi Language.description: Can a boy and a girl really just be good friends? A satirical look, as protagonist Honey Kapoor tries to find an answer to this perennial global Q.

Hindi Language.name: Eer: Stories in Stone
Hindi Language.description: A documentary film chronicling tribal history in India that never makes it way to the mainstream.

Hindi Language.name: Shuttlecock Boys
Hindi Language.description: Shuttlecock Boys - Story of Entrepreneurship Dream, is a heart warming tale of 4 boys from Delhi who play badminton in the night in their neighborhood. These boys who come from humble backgrounds decide to do SOMETHING ON THEIR OWN while playing badminton one such night.This attempt becomes their lifeline putting them on a litmus test of determination, courage, luck and spirit of friendship.

Hindi Language.name: The Holy Wives
Hindi Language.description: The film brings out the lives of three different communities who have been victimized in the name of caste based sexual exploitation in India through stories of their life,struggle and their dreams of a dignified life of their children.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Stupid Pyar
Hindi Language.description: Abhishek meets Neha while on vacation in Mumbai. Within two weeks, they get married. When they arrive at their new home in Singapore, she disappears.

Hindi Language.name: Buzz of the Week
Hindi Language.description: BUZZ OF THE WEEK is a one-stop shop for all that you wanted to know about the Friday release . A twelve minute anchor based, weekly show.The making of the film, the gossip, the tantrums, the delays, there views, views, the previews, We pack it all in this 12 minute capsule.

Hindi Language.name: Singhasan Battisi
Hindi Language.description: Imagine a world, when there was no Harry Potter, no world of Narnia. Yet there was magic as never seen before, Villians more powerful than ever. And to fight them all single handedly was the mightiest of them all. He was the King of the Kings. He was King VIKRAMADITYA. Get ready for an exhilarating journey of a lifetime. Come; enter the world of SINGHASAN BATTISI. A royal throne gifted by none other than Lord Indra himself. It was ornamented with 32 beautiful figurines who are the sole witness to the might and greatness of King VIKRAMADITYA, who was the proud owner of this extraordinary throne. Now these 32 figurines come alive to narrate the story of King VIKRAMADITYA episode after episode. Each story is filled with captivating incidents that not only entertains but also teaches us a lesson in life not to be forgotten; making these stories a treasure to be cherished for life and to be experienced again and again. So this season get set to witness the tale of one of the greatest mythological blockbuster ever told.

Hindi Language.name: Entertainment Express
Hindi Language.description: This famous show of news related to Hindi film industry was aired on Sahara Samay news channel, this show did not run for a very long time but due to its writing style it gained huge popularity in the working time. The promos of this show were very attractive due to which the audience used to wait for this show.

Hindi Language.name: Shorr
Hindi Language.description: The story of speech-impaired girl named Kanku.

Hindi Language.name: Flooding in the Time of Drought
Hindi Language.description: What if suddenly the water supply runs dry in Singapore? This fusion of documentary and fiction narrative depicts the lives of foreign migrants as an impending water crisis begins to seep into their lives. With water, or the lack of it, becoming the central motif, this two-part feature length film takes us on a journey across 8 interweaved stories and 10 languages, as the protagonists, consisting of non-professional actors, grapple with this hopefully temporary discomfort, amidst their dalliance with human foibles, and their fantasies of everlasting loves and broken romances. This aberration is a memento mori as the narratives grazed across the vague impressions of the racial tensions lingering past the 1997 riots in Indonesia, World War II, ritual beliefs, and ethnic discrimination in Southeast Asia which has been ingrained over generations and transported along with the migrant communities. Nonetheless, amidst the sporadic ventures into death and violence, sexual relations and sexualities, these are the lines of division that bind us to each other, in one way or another, as people survive through their crises.

Hindi Language.name: Channel V Campus Blog
Hindi Language.description: Channel [v] will select three of the best video bloggers and feature them on TV.

Hindi Language.name: Don't Worry Chachu
Hindi Language.description: Chintan Desai is a good-natured man fondly known as 'Chachu' in the household. Chachu has been sandwiched between his strict father, responsibilities of a joint family, and raising his brothers' kids. Somewhere his concern and love have turned into his hyper nature over the years.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Mein Twist
Hindi Language.description: A unique love story between a geek Amol and a hot girl called Rekha.

Hindi Language.name: Love Kiya Toh Darna Kya
Hindi Language.description: Coming from conservative families, the young couple decided to secretly marry in the Arya Samaj Mandir, knowing that their parents would be strictly against an inter-caste marriage. Three years since; they haven't mustered up the courage to tell their parents about this relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Adwait Sangeet
Hindi Language.description: This documentary is our humble tribute to the excellence of two brother's classical music. Last 40 years they have been the only singing duo from India who have been performing all over the world. This documentary traces their musical journey of 50 years.

Hindi Language.name: Still Standing
Hindi Language.description: An incredible journey of a man who defied all odds after being paralyzed neck downwards.

Hindi Language.name: Tum Ho Yaara
Hindi Language.description: Shvia is a software engineer who is in love with medical student Meera. Meera's Father Rajaraman is a don who taken law in his hands to provide justice. Rajaraman does not like Shiva who is in love with Meera so he challenge Shiva saying that he will forget Meera after 2 years if he is not having any contact with her. Shiva accept the challenge and fly is to USA for a job. In USA he meets with an accident and gets short term memory loss. Due to his memory loss he forgets Meera and Rajaraman and starts a life with his co-worker Maya. Once on a camping trip he drink a potion prepared by Shaman and get is to illusion. At the end of the illusion he gets back his memory and find out Meera is falling in love with Dr. Arun. Who is Psychiatrist. In order to get back Meera, Shiva acts as if he is mentally retarded. Dr. Arun explain Shiva's condition to Meera and Rajaraman and gets Shiva and Meera reunited.

Hindi Language.name: The Dancing God - Shiva
Hindi Language.description: A wonderful mythological movie depicting many popular tales of Lord Shiva. The movie also shows how Lord Shiva saved the Universe by drinking the Poison at the epic event of the Samudra Manthan.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Din... Achanak
Hindi Language.description: A killer tells a woman on her 10th wedding anniversary that her husband has hired him to kill her.

Hindi Language.name: Spirit of Moksha - Kumbh Mela
Hindi Language.description: Kumbh Mela is the biggest gathering of human beings on earth at a particular point of time, irrespective of race, religion, caste, gender and age.. The tradition of Kumbh Mela is very ancient. Spirit of Moksha is a journey through the belief, reason and myth. How the theory of Moksha evolved and why it still remains intact, rather it has been gaining more acceptance with time. 80 million people took the holy dip in Ganga during Maha KUMBH 2010 in Haridwar. The documentary is self explanatory from talks of the sages, pilgrims and scholars without any voiceover. The treatment and design of the film is simple to make you realize the beauty of faith, trust and power of belief which can be experienced.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Mujhse Hai Pehle Ka Naata Koi
Hindi Language.description: A bubbly and fun loving girl called Tashi meets Arjun, falls in love and gets married to him. Soon she discovers some murky truths and a curse that threatens to shatter her present and future.

Hindi Language.name: The Life Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: A jilted woman falls for the ailing son of her wealthy employer.

Hindi Language.name: Trade of a Eunuch
Hindi Language.description: The film depicts the true life events in the life of Neha, a eunuch living in India. It outlines the inhuman conditions that eunuchs are forced to live in India. They are tortured and traded like cattle, devoid of any dignity or respect, in stark violation of the UN Charter. This community is a highly secretive one and very little is known about them. They fall outside the purview of all government and other programs aimed at human development. The film hopes to provide information about this much maligned community, with a view to further understanding about them among society and provide them with a platform to live life with dignity.

Hindi Language.name: India inside Out
Hindi Language.description: INDIA INSIDE OUT is a sensitive journey throughout contemporary India, a country's portrait. This trip to the chore of the country's social, cultural and ritual diversity allows, through famillies' talks, to feel India from within. We are able to share their questioning confronted as they are to the many changings due to globalization and the issue of modernity and traditions. Through this deep immersion in intimate spaces, a specific window opens up onto contemporary Indian nation.

Hindi Language.name: Rang
Hindi Language.description: A tale of love and longing and loss, four intersecting stories on the road, on the night before the festival of colors - Holi.

Hindi Language.name: De Nova... The Road Less Trodden
Hindi Language.description: A grieving family seeks spiritual redemption after tragedy, embracing rituals, surreal visions, and inner transformation to heal beyond the surface, choosing the mystical path over conventional healing.

Hindi Language.name: Narsi ki purakar sun sanvara aaye
InkLab
Hindi Language.description: In the digital age, where megabyte is the new dynamite and power of ideas and connectivity cannot be ignored, this is an experiment in the Lab of thoughts - InkLab. The P.O.V. film made with a zero budget in Cinema-verite style is set in the sociopolitical scenario when India is fighting against corruption and a sizable mass movement has already built up all across the nation.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Tha Mafia
Hindi Language.description: Journalist Prakash uncovers a corruption racket which results in the sacking of a minister and a jailor. Soon after, his girlfriend is kidnapped. How will Prakash fight the unknown to rescue his love?

Hindi Language.name: Keshav Pandit
Hindi Language.description: Based on real life hero Keshav Pandit who fights for all odds and stands for truth and law.

Hindi Language.name: Samriddhi Ki Disha Mein
Hindi Language.description: This documentary is presented by the Vastramantralay.

Hindi Language.name: Flames of the Snow
Hindi Language.description: Film chronicles the rise of the pro-democracy movement from 19th century culminating in the abolition of monarchy in 2008 tracing the long and blood-drenched pro-democracy struggle and People's War by the Maoists in Nepal.

Hindi Language.name: My Own City
Hindi Language.description: The gendered looks of metropolitan Delhi become a camera eye, sketching the everyday life of a female driver exposed to the male gaze. The experience of women who live in this city is embodied in a mirage like images constructed by the director.

Hindi Language.name: Celebrity Cricket League
Hindi Language.description: The Celebrity Cricket League (CCL) is a non-professional men's cricket league in India and it is contested by nine teams consisting of film actors from nine major regional film industries of Indian cinema.

Hindi Language.name: Bhunsaara
Hindi Language.description: In India there is a tribe whose tradition states that the first daughter of a family has to become a prostitute. The story deals with an urban girl who finds out that her mother belonged to this tribe and starts her journey to find her. Her mother sent her to town with one of her lovers because she never wanted her daughter to follow the tradition of her village but wanted her daughter to be educated and get married. It is a story of a mother who scarified her motherhood to bring a new ray of light into her daughter's life.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Toh Ho Ardhnarishwar
Hindi Language.description: Koi To Ho...Ardhnarishwar is a mythological soap made under the banner of Paliwal Pictures for Doordarshan. It is based on Vishnu Prabhakar's novel.

Hindi Language.name: Murder of Mystic
Hindi Language.description: The fishermen of three fishing villages around Karachi have one common asset and so a common challenge to safeguard it. The mangrove forests are natural treasure for the fishermen, which are being clear- cut by the vested interests. This struggle against deforestation is now turning into a battle of their survival. The timber mafia, land-grabbers and heartless urban corporations are wreaking havoc on their centuries old settlements by logging mangrove trees. Those indigenous people who tried to resist the devastation were also killed by the vested interests. Mystic are not restricted to the human world. Mangroves are spiritual trees which are in service of mankind. They are refuge to birds, marine forms of life and a natural guard against disasters. Fishermen call them their lifeline.

Hindi Language.name: Hai Preet Yahan Ke Reet Sada
Hindi Language.description: Devraj Srivastava a businessman believed in indian tradition and culture.

Hindi Language.name: Apno Ke Liye Geeta Ka Dharmayudh
Maanas
Hindi Language.description: Lead Protagonist - Munna has a family of younger brother 'Chotu' and his mother 'Aai.' He has a (forgotten) past that he visualizes often but never understands it. Story rolls within span of three days of Diwali during which he makes his date with Destiny that leads him to circumstances that changes his mindset which in Hindi is called as Maanas.

Hindi Language.name: Cutting Chai
Hindi Language.description: Youth ambition brings problems.

Hindi Language.name: Job Time TV
Hindi Language.description: This was reality show based on jobs where Job seekers came in direct connect with the C.E.O of th companies and understood the etichs and codes of the company from the top boss.

Hindi Language.name: Laugh India Laugh
Hindi Language.description: Hosted by Gaurav Gera and Sunil Grover, "Laugh India Laugh" is a gag based show with re-packaging of Star One's biggest hit, "The Great Indian Laughter Challenge" which was the trend setter of stand up comedy shows.

Hindi Language.name: Cinema Review
Hindi Language.description: Cinema Review is the report card of the film that releases in the week. Hosted by very well known author and Columnist Bhawana Somaaya it talks about all the aspects of the film and helps you to decide.

Hindi Language.name: Shraddha: In the Name of God
Rukke Padge
Hindi Language.description: Rukke Padge is a 2010 Indian Comedy movie directed by Ashoak C. Tyagi. The movie's star cast includes Gaurav Prateek and Khushi in the lead roles and Rajendra Gupta and Khayali Saharan in alongside Monika Batra in the supporting roles.

Hindi Language.name: The Lunchbox
Hindi Language.description: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's famously efficient lunchbox delivery system connects a young housewife to an older man in the dusk of his life as they build a fantasy world together through notes in the lunchbox.

Hindi Language.name: Cocktail
Hindi Language.description: A love triangle between a guy and two girls, who are best friends but the complete opposite of one another.

Hindi Language.name: Gangs of Wasseypur
Hindi Language.description: A clash between Sultan and Shahid Khan leads to the expulsion of Khan from Wasseypur, and ignites a deadly blood feud spanning three generations.

Hindi Language.name: Aashiqui 2
Hindi Language.description: Once a popular singer, now a broken alcoholic, Rahul finds salvation in aspiring singer Aarohi. Their intense love ignites the stage, but his inner demons and jealousy slowly drag their dream into tragedy.

Hindi Language.name: Chennai Express
Hindi Language.description: A man travelling to Rameswaram via Chennai express for his late grandfather's ashes immersion finds himself in trouble after helping a don's daughter and her cousins board the train.

Hindi Language.name: Barfi!
Hindi Language.description: Three young people learn that love can neither be defined nor contained by society's definition of normal and abnormal.

Hindi Language.name: Mahabharat
Hindi Language.description: The mother of all wars, the epitome of all rivalries, the cauldron of emotions, insecurities, jealousies, and power play - Mahabharat.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani
Hindi Language.description: Kabir and Naina bond during a trekking trip. Before Naina can express herself, Kabir leaves India to pursue his career. They meet again years later, but he still cherishes his dreams more than bonds.

Hindi Language.name: Dhoom 3
Hindi Language.description: Detective Jai Dixit travels to Chicago to investigate a daring circus and pursue a charismatic thief who can seemingly vanish into thin air.

Hindi Language.name: Ugly
Hindi Language.description: The case of a missing girl takes us through a journey of human greed and brushes upon the egos and repressed emotions of the characters.

Hindi Language.name: Kahaani
Hindi Language.description: A pregnant woman's search for her missing husband takes her from London to Kolkata, but everyone she questions denies having ever met him.

Hindi Language.name: Paan Singh Tomar
Hindi Language.description: The story of Paan Singh Tomar, an Indian athlete and seven-time national steeplechase champion who becomes one of the most feared criminals in Chambal Valley after his retirement.

Hindi Language.name: Bhaag Milkha Bhaag
Hindi Language.description: The truth behind the ascension of Milkha Singh, who was scarred by of the India-Pakistan partition.

Hindi Language.name: Ramaiya Vastavaiya
Hindi Language.description: Ram falls in love with Sona, who lives on the fields of Punjab. He follows her to her farm, where her elder brother challenges him to produce more seed on their fields. If he wins, he will be allowed to marry her.

Hindi Language.name: Talaash: The Answer Lies Within
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Surjan Shekhawat, who is dealing with a depressing past, has to investigate a high profile murder case, deal with his crumbling marriage and use the help and solace of a prostitute by the name of Rosie.

Hindi Language.name: Chaalis Chauraasi
Hindi Language.description: Four friends, who have accidentally committed crimes, decide to loot Rs. 20 crore, posing as cops. But on the way, they encounter a real police inspector, who orders them to do an encounter. Do they have the guts to do so and will they be able to fulfil their dreams of becoming millionaires?

Hindi Language.name: Jab Tak Hai Jaan
Hindi Language.description: An uncompromising film on true love from the legendary and unforgettable director Yash Chopra which is fascinatingly distinctive and contemporary.

Hindi Language.name: Jannat 2
Hindi Language.description: A dealer of illegal guns is bullied into being an informer for a cop who wants to put an end to this racket.

Hindi Language.name: Shahid
Hindi Language.description: The account of Human Rights lawyer Shahid Azmi, an ordinary citizen with an extraordinary commitment to justice.

Hindi Language.name: Special 26
Hindi Language.description: A gang of con-men rob prominent rich businessmen and politicians by posing as C.B.I and income tax officers.

Hindi Language.name: Go Goa Gone
Hindi Language.description: A group of friends, just looking to have a good time in a rave party on a remote island in Goa, find out that the island is infested with Zombies.

Hindi Language.name: Raanjhanaa
Hindi Language.description: Kundan, the son of a Hindu pundit, discovers that his childhood sweetheart Zoya loves city-bred Akram and wants to marry him. However, he persistently seeks to win her heart.

Hindi Language.name: Shanghai
Hindi Language.description: Prime leader of a campaign against a big government project is killed in what appears to be a road accident. An IAS officer is ordered to probe the incident and the veils of falsehood begin to drop.

Hindi Language.name: Ishaqzaade
Hindi Language.description: A love story of a passion ignited by hatred. Of two people. Born to hate. Destined to love.

Hindi Language.name: Ankhon Dekhi
Hindi Language.description: After a distressing incident, a Delhi man vows to believe only what he can see, but his new ideals soon take his life in extreme directions.

Hindi Language.name: Student of the Year
Hindi Language.description: Several alumni reminisce about their final year at St. Theresa's College and the events that shaped their lives.

Hindi Language.name: A Pure Desi Romance
Hindi Language.description: A romantic comedy which tells the journey of three restless young people who junk society's syllabus for finding love and decide to follow their heart.

Hindi Language.name: Queen
Hindi Language.description: A Delhi girl from a traditional family sets out on a solo honeymoon after her marriage gets cancelled.

Hindi Language.name: English Vinglish
Hindi Language.description: A quiet, sweet tempered housewife endures small slights from her well-educated husband and daughter every day because of her inability to speak and understand English.

Hindi Language.name: Krrish 3
Hindi Language.description: Krrish and his scientist father must save the world and their own family from an evil man named Kaal and his gang of mutants, led by the ruthless Kaya.

Hindi Language.name: Fukrey
Hindi Language.description: The paths of four dream-chasing college friends cross with an array of colourful characters, from a tough-talking Punjabi female don to a Jugaad Baaz college watchman. Mayhem ensues.

Hindi Language.name: Table No. 21
Hindi Language.description: A couple is drawn into a game show with a whooping winning prize. However the game turns into more than a survival for them with no escape.

Hindi Language.name: Robber
Hindi Language.description: An aristocrat's daughter falls in love with a visiting archaeologist, but he holds a secret that could drive them apart.

Hindi Language.name: Rowdy Rathore
Hindi Language.description: A con man uncovers a deadly secret and must save his lady love, the small-town locals and the little girl who insists she's his daughter, from the mob.

Hindi Language.name: Chhota Bheem and the Throne of Bali
Hindi Language.description: On their visit to Bali for the coronation of the state's prince, Chhota Bheem and his friends learn that the state is captured by witch Rangda. Along with his friends, he sets out to save Bali.

Hindi Language.name: Vicky Donor
Hindi Language.description: A man is brought in by an infertility doctor to supply him with his sperm, where he becomes the biggest sperm donor for his clinic.

Hindi Language.name: Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram Leela
Hindi Language.description: A modern adaptation of William Shakespeare's "Romeo and Juliet" with an Indian twist, the film focuses on the story of Ram and Leela: their love, lust, and the drama afterwards.

Hindi Language.name: Housefull 2

Hindi Language.name: OMG: Oh My God!

Hindi Language.name: Ek Tha Tiger

Hindi Language.name: Horror Story
Hindi Language.description: Seven youngsters decide to spend a night in an abandoned haunted hotel. What they mistook as merely rumors, dawns on them to be the truth as they realize they are not alone inside.

Hindi Language.name: Mastram

Hindi Language.name: Kamasutra: The Revenge

Hindi Language.name: Heroine

Hindi Language.name: Agneepath

Hindi Language.name: Chhota Bheem in the Incan Adventure
Hindi Language.description: A huge bird swoops down and kidnaps Princess Indumati. The army's scoured the whole area and the neighboring kingdoms but there's no trace of Princess Indumati. The only thing Bheem finds was strange bird-feathers from the land of Incas. Bheem and team starts searching in the forests of Mexico where Dholu-Bholu fall off into a river. Bheem and others jump in to save them but are soon carried off by the rivers currents to the shores of a desolate valley. The valley is covered with heaps and heaps of ashes all around one such mound lie near the princess bangles. The sun rises and the mounds of ashes takes the shape of humans. The Incas where they meet Princess Indumati. The Inca chief Ixaba explains with the totem pole which was source of unlimited power, such as Rouran One day one of their own traded the totem to Rouran but as soon as Rouran touched the totem pole.... the monkeys attacked Rouran. Monkeys were angered for not having protected them and on the audacity of Rouran for trying to steal them. Th cast a spell on the Incas that they would never see sleep again and hence with each setting sun the villagers turned to dust. Will Bheem save the Incas villagers & Princess Indumati.

Hindi Language.name: Kai Po Che
Hindi Language.description: Three friends growing up in India at the turn of the millennium set out to open a training academy to produce the country's next cricket stars.

Hindi Language.name: Boss
Hindi Language.description: Disowned by his father as a boy, Surya is taken in by a crime boss. When his brother Shiv is wrongly imprisoned, his father pleads for Surya's help.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Thi Daayan
Hindi Language.description: When gifted magician Bobo finds himself assailed by hallucinations and seeks professional help, he learns he's being haunted by a sinister spirit.

Hindi Language.name: D-Day
Hindi Language.description: A team of experts dispatched to bring in The Most Wanted Man in India almost achieve the unthinkable ... until something goes horribly wrong.

Hindi Language.name: Jolly LLB
Hindi Language.description: Wanting to earn fame and fortune, a small time lawyer files a PIL for an infamous hit-and-run, and thus learns what it really is like to be a lawyer.

Hindi Language.name: Khiladi 786
Hindi Language.description: A father who runs a marriage bureau believes that his son is a failure in life. In order to prove him wrong, his son takes on the task of finding a match for a gangster's sister.

Hindi Language.name: Agent Vinod
Hindi Language.description: A series of seemingly unconnected events across the world leads to Agent Vinod undertaking a globe-trotting mission to discover why his colleague was murdered.

Hindi Language.name: Teri Meri Kahaani
Hindi Language.description: The true love between a couple in 1910, 1960 and 2012. Their love is so strong that even destiny wants to bring them together.

Hindi Language.name: Son of Sardaar
Hindi Language.description: Realizing he is the target of a vengeful family that welcomed him without knowing his identity, a young man must avoid exiting their house since they won't kill a guest unless he's outside.

Hindi Language.name: Dabangg 2
Hindi Language.description: Chulbul Pandey invites a fresh trouble when he kills the brother of a notorious politician and the former swears to wreak havoc in his life.

Hindi Language.name: Miss Lovely
Hindi Language.description: A Hindi feature film set in the lower depths of Bombay's "C" grade film industry. Miss Lovely follows the devastating story of two brothers who produce sleazy horror films in the mid-1980s.

Hindi Language.name: Gori Tere Pyaar Mein!
Hindi Language.description: Self-centered Sriram Venkat changes his outlook and actions when his girlfriend leaves him.

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu
Hindi Language.description: Motu and Patlu, two friends living in Fufuri Nagar, always get themselves into hilarious situations and later rescued merely by luck, using the help from Ghasita Ram, Inspector Chingam and Dr. Jhatka.

Hindi Language.description: After a breakup, Vikram dates Nisha, who moves into his mansion. Nisha notices strange activities, suspects haunting. Vikram's ex Roshini goes missing. Nisha and Vikram's life unravels as he's blamed.

Hindi Language.name: Madras Cafe

Hindi Language.name: B.A. Pass
Hindi Language.description: A young boy is seduced by a woman who later turns him into a gigolo (male prostitute).

Hindi Language.name: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
Hindi Language.description: Bheem and his friend should destroy damyaan along with (the book of magi) to free them from his prison and to save their city

Hindi Language.name: Joker
Hindi Language.description: A space scientist working on a project to communicate with aliens visits a village called Paglapur. To improve the plight of the inhabitants of Paglapur, he comes up with a novel idea.

Hindi Language.name: Nasha
Hindi Language.description: A teenage boy becomes smitten with his new drama teacher and pursues her, despite the perilous risks of being found out.

Hindi Language.name: Jodha Akbar
Hindi Language.description: A 16th century political marriage unites Mughal emperor Akbar and Rajput princess Jodha Bai. Despite opposition, their union blossoms into love, influencing the fate of India amidst court intrigues and wars between Mughals and Rajputs.

Hindi Language.name: Liar's Dice
Hindi Language.description: A mother and her daughter embarks on a desperate journey to find her missing husband. She met an guy who promised to help her for money. With limited money it become difficult to continue the search which leads to anxiety and despair.

Hindi Language.name: Jism 2
Hindi Language.description: Izna, a porn star, is tasked by an Indian Intelligence Agency to seduce her ex-boyfriend Kabir, a dreaded assassin, in order to steal vital information relating to his sleeper cell contacts.

Hindi Language.name: Players
Hindi Language.description: Learning of a fortune in gold being secretly shipped to Romania, master thieves Charlie and Riya assemble a crack team to steal it.

Hindi Language.name: Hate Story
Hindi Language.description: After a powerful businessman has her baby forcefully aborted, Kaavya Krishna uses her body as a sexual weapon to destroy his empire, brick by brick.

Hindi Language.name: Blood Money
Hindi Language.description: A young man elopes with the girl he loves and moves to South Africa, where he works in the diamond-exporting business. Slowly, he is pulled into the underworld.

Hindi Language.name: Chittagong
Hindi Language.description: School kids organize an armed revolt in the 1930s in British occupied Chittagong. There are casualties on both sides. Later, one of those kids successfully leads the peasants to regain their food-grains earlier commandeered by the British.

Hindi Language.name: Shootout at Wadala
Hindi Language.description: Based on the true story of the first-ever registered encounter by the Mumbai Police, which took place on January 11, 1982. Where gangster Manya Surve was shot by dead by Inspector Isaque Bagwan.

Hindi Language.description: Meet, Prem, and Amar look to have a blast at their college reunion, though they soon find themselves in another predicament.

Hindi Language.name: : Evil Returns

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Mohabbatein
Hindi Language.description: Doctor Ishita saves a life of a young girl named Ruhi in an accident. Neglected by her parents, Ruhi is allowed to stay for a while but Ruhi's father accuses Ishita of kidnapping her.

Hindi Language.name: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai Dobara
Hindi Language.description: After killing his mentor, a gangster comes into power to rule over Mumbai. In the process he falls for an aspiring actress, nevertheless he finds that his protege has fallen for her too which leads to enmity between them.

Hindi Language.name: Baal Veer
Hindi Language.description: Baal Veer is a SuperKid who fights for good and honest children.

Hindi Language.name: Phata Poster Nikhla Hero

Hindi Language.name: ABCD (Any Body Can Dance)

Hindi Language.name: Kamaal Dhamaal Malamaal
Hindi Language.description: Jhonny is often fooled by villagers as he is fit for nothing. He is in love with Maria but is often targeted by her brothers. Then enters Sam, who will be like a Samaritain to Jhonny's family.

Hindi Language.name: Filmistaan
Hindi Language.description: A Bollywood assistant director is kidnapped by terrorists who mistake him for an American. While held captive in Pakistan, he discovers his captor deals in pirated Hindi films, leading to unexpected cultural connections.

Hindi Language.name: Luv Shuv Tey Chicken Khurana
Hindi Language.description: A fugitive frantically looks for a much-coveted chicken curry recipe with which his family can reclaim their pride and wealth.

Hindi Language.name: Fear Files: Darr Ki Sachchi Tasveerein
Hindi Language.description: The series mainly focuses on the story of different paranormal and strange cases from different parts of India inspired from real life incidents. It also shows investigation and subsequent exorcism.

Tara is full of life who can do anything to save her family. Mritunjaya is in jail on charges of rape and murder of a girl. Tara marries Mritunjaya to save her family without even seeing his face. Will Rudrapratap ruin thier lives?

Jeannie falls in love with Vicky at the very first sight, tricks him and follows him back into his world. The well intentioned Jeannie only tries to make life better for Vicky while actually putting him into trouble at all situations. Its' only a matter of time before this very naughty yet lovable Jeannie will become the centre of Vicky's universe and the chase will turn into a sweet tale of romance, magic and fantasy.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara
Hindi Language.description: Rich Aditya doesn't believe in marriage while small town girl, Pankhuri thinks 'marriage is for keeps.' What will happen when these opposites meet?

Hindi Language.name: Ek Nanad Ki Khushiyon Ki Chaabi... Meri Bhabhi
Hindi Language.description: Ek Nanad Ki Khushiyon Ki Chaabi, Meri Bhabhi is a show about the lovely bond shared between a sister-in-law and daughter-in-law. Shraddha the nanad finds a friend in Kritika her bhabhi. Kritika is a loving person and a dutiful bahu of the Shergill family. She knows how to keep the family together. She is gentle, understanding and is very good at relieving tense moments with her humor. She is the most perfect house wife. Kritika plays a significant role in the life of Shraddha and shows her how to live with her head held high in difficult circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Nadaniyaan
Hindi Language.description: Nandu, a house husband, and his brother Pappu lead an idle life and show no inclination towards earning their livelihood. They live on Nandu's wife's money, who constantly mocks and criticises them.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Dost Picture Abhi Baaki Hai
Hindi Language.description: Amar Joshi (Sunil Shetty) sells his business in hope to become a film director. After meeting immoral producers and financers, he finds out that his journey won't be so easy.

Hindi Language.name: Singh Saab the Great
Hindi Language.description: A tax collector willing to reform the society with the thought of change instead of revenge tries to control himself while attempting to teach a lesson to the man responsible behind his wife's death.

Hindi Language.name: John Day
Hindi Language.description: A bank manager and his wife, still grieving over their daughter who died in a fire, become pawns in a bank heist with ties to corruption and fraud.

Hindi Language.name: Bani: Ishq Da Kalma
Hindi Language.description: A 40 year old Bride married for the past 20 years awaits her NRI Husband return at the very station she had last seen him.

Hindi Language.name: Wah! Wah! Kya Baat Hai!
Hindi Language.description: Shailesh Lodha and Neha Mehta host highly popular poets who recite their humorous poetry.

Hindi Language.name: London Paris New York
Hindi Language.description: Nikhil and Lalitha are two completely different individuals who are drawn to each other in spite of their differences -- or perhaps because of it. Follow their journey as they meet in London, Paris and New York for a night in each city.

Hindi Language.name: Login
Hindi Language.description: This movie is about three characters who are connected to the Internet and end up disconnecting their actual life.

Hindi Language.name: The Serial
Hindi Language.description: The show is about an aspiring 17-year-old actor Rohan Shah whose role model is Karan Kundra. He goes to the Balaji office for an audition of Gumrah and gets selected. In the meantime he gets to go in Kundra's party (organised by Soumya Seth to reunite Kundra and Kittoo) with a friend and not knowing about Kundar's and Kittoo's (Kritika Kamra) breakup plays a cd having their past memories to wish them anniversary which angers Kundra. In the same party Sara Khan turns out in a bikini to grab media attention and plays a large part in helping Rohan play that cd. The next day Sara is shocked to see the newspapers filled with the breakup news rather than her bikini pics. The story then covers the life and struggles of various celebrities from Rohan's point of view.

Hindi Language.name: Gustakh Dil
Hindi Language.description: Laajo, a simple girl from a village becomes the third wheel in her own marriage, when her husband Nikhil can't get over his lover Ishana.

Hindi Language.name: Rise of the Zombie
Hindi Language.description: A heartbroken wildlife photographer throws himself into his work, only to find himself experiencing strange transformations.

Hindi Language.name: Akaash Vani
Hindi Language.description: Two soul mates are separated by their families' fear of losing their social status. Moving on is hard for the woman as she finds herself in an abusive relationship. Her circumstances force her to follow her heart to be happy.

Hindi Language.name: Oass
Hindi Language.description: Eyes forward, Kiku hurtles down the street. A swish of glittering purple from the corner of her eye tells her that Madam is not far behind. Jhukki's grunts were getting louder. Kiku needed to quicken her pace. She shifts her focus back to her goal. The end of the street is a few meters away and beyond that lie her father's fields. She squints. Was that the silhouette of the Kanchenjunga she saw in the distance? A butterfly dances up ahead of her, its antennae pointing towards Kiku's finish line. Last few steps. She closes her eyes and stretches her hand forward. But, before she can step over the threshold, she is yanked back. Kiku lurches forward but Madam's fingernail is hooked into the collar of her shirt/blouse. The butterfly escapes. Kiku's hand drops to her side. OASS is inspired by a true story of Kiku who is taken away from her village at the age of 11 and sold to a brothel in Delhi. Drugged, beaten, raped and threatened, she surrenders to the atrocities in order to live, and one day escape. OASS brings to light the menace of girl-child trafficking and the perils faced by the million Kikus across the globe.

Hindi Language.name: Department
Hindi Language.description: A suspended cop joins hands with inspector Mahadev Bhonsle to free the city from underworld.

Hindi Language.name: Club 60
Hindi Language.description: A glance at 62 years old Manu bhai Shah (Raghubir Yadav) and how he appears peculiar in his outfit, crazy in his behavior, flamboyant in his style, loud and funny in his conversation and overbearing in his relations! With colored hair, trimmed French beard, colorful t-shirts with slogans (inappropriate for his age), GUCCI glares and i-pod plug-ins, he and his gang which includes Dhillon (sharat saxena), Mansukhani (satish shah), Zafar (tinu anand) and Sinha (Vineet Kumar) are a group of irrepressible 'five' whose lives revolves around a tennis court in a club called CLUB 60. They can drive anyone crazy by their antics. Story of Club 60 unfolds when Dr Tareek sheikh (Farookh sheikh), a neuro surgeon, suffering from acute depression after the death of his only son shifts to Mumbai from Pune with his wife Dr sayara (Sarika). A chance encounter of suave Dr sheikh with the flamboyant, talkative, funny and overbearing Manu bhai who stays in the same building, snowballs into Dr Sheiks forced and reluctant entry into the Club 60's gang of five. But is Manu bhai and his gang just a chunk of some well-to-do crazy and fun-loving 60 years young or is there something more to them under their colorful and playful facade? We explore it along with Dr sheikh as slowly and steadily his reluctant participation in Manu bhai's 'gang of five', makes him fall in love with life again.

Hindi Language.name: Beehad - The Ravine
Hindi Language.description: In Northern parts of India-Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan's territory, spreads the World famous Chambal valley,a home to many dacoits of their times like Man Singh, Putli Bai, Phoolan Devi, Malkhan Singh, Nirbhay Gujjar, Kusuma Nain and Mohar Singh. Many of them like Putli Bai, Phoolan Devi and Nirbhay Gujjar are already killed and some of them like Kusuma Nain, Sarla Jatav, Neelam Gupta and Maan Singh (Husband of Phoolan Devi) are still alive and kept in jails. 'BEEHAD' - The Ravine is based on the real lives of these dacoits. It exhibits the pathoes of these simple village people,who became victim to the social and political system in India, and revolted against the system. Their revolt turned them to be the most dreaded dacoits of Chambal Vally. The film experiments with incorporating the real dacoits like Maan Singh and Man gal Singh to portray their own characters in this film to bring reality of the situations in their lives.The story revolves around the biggest lady davit of India, Kusuma Nain, who became another name of fear in the Chambal valley. She was gang raped in front of her colleague and in the fire of her revenge she gave birth to Mai Asthma village,a true example of cruelty. 'BEEHAD' - The Ravine, is a cinematic tale of pain, pathos, cruelty, revenge and fear, written on the picturesque ravines of Chambal.

Hindi Language.name: Doli Armaano Ki
Hindi Language.description: A woman's struggle in this male dominated society that will leave her to embark on a quest of eternal marital bliss.

Hindi Language.name: Jodi Breakers
Hindi Language.description: A man (R. Madhavan) who helps wronged parties get out of bad relationships meets his match when he takes on a business partner (Bipasha Basu).

Hindi Language.name: Shudra the Rising
Hindi Language.description: Shudra - The Rising is the story of 250 million people subjugated in war and condemned to slavery and bestial existence for ages. These peace loving and imprudent people of ancient times were usurped by more aggressive and acquisitive group of men and societies.

Hindi Language.name: Pakdam Pakdai
Hindi Language.description: Doggy Don is a little pink dog, who is helped by his brother Colonel to fight against Motu , Chhotu, and Lambu.

Hindi Language.name: Dance India Dance Super Moms
Hindi Language.description: Talented mothers, who aspire to become phenomenal dancers, compete against each other in order to impress the judges and enthral the audience.

Hindi Language.name: ?: A Question Mark
Hindi Language.description: A group of friends went to shoot their film project, but never returned. A few days later, their camera was found.

Hindi Language.name: Policegiri
Hindi Language.description: DCP Rudra faces a bunch of challenges after he locks horns with a notorious criminal Nagori Subramanium.

Hindi Language.name: Bittoo Boss
Hindi Language.description: Bittoo Boss' is a young charming, ingenious and a fun filled wedding cameraman who takes pride in calling himself a "Sesky Video Shooter". He is the star of all wedding celebrations of Anandpur Sahib, a small town in Punjab. Bittoo believes in spreading happiness through the beautiful moments he captures, moments which you can rewind and keep watching for years and smile looking at them thus making them heartfelt experiences which last forever. He falls in love with an educated and strong-headed girl who makes him realize the importance of financial stability and monetary gains in order to gain respect and recognition. Smitten in love and bitten by the one he loves, the smart and righteous cameraman is lured to take a shortcut in order to earn a quick buck and get his life back on track. What follows is a madcap ride.

Hindi Language.name: Bhoot Returns
Hindi Language.description: A family moves into a possessed bungalow. A sudden turn of events in the house leaves them astonished. When things worsen, escape seems to be their last resort.

Hindi Language.name: Ghost
Hindi Language.description: A hospital finds itself the victim of a string of gruesome murders. Assigned to the case, Detective Vijay Singh enlists the help of a newly recruited female doctor to solve the seemingly supernatural case.

Hindi Language.name: Sadda Adda
Hindi Language.description: 'The only thing that will stop you from fulfilling your dreams is you" People have dreams, but not all of us have the guts to put faith in ourselves. Most of us lose focus and give up. We are most afraid to believe in our own dreams. Those who do are the true winners. This slice of life film is set in the backdrop of our capital city- Delhi. A city that brings in thousands of North Indians in search of opportunities that was never available in their own home towns. Like-wise, six boys from different states come together to share a two BHK apartment in a middle-class colony, which they lovingly call "Sadda Adda". This film is their story. It is about how six bachelors, with completely different backgrounds and personalities, live together. Their apartment "Sadda Adda" is a complete mess with empty beer bottles, cigarette butts, unwashed clothes, mattresses tossed all over the floor etc - yet together they cook food, clean, buy groceries, pay rent, laugh, cry, fight over insignificant issues and always stand up for each other - like a family. "Sadda Adda" which began as a transitional accommodation to help them work towards their dreams, becomes their home. The film takes us through a journey of their camaraderie and self-belief. The interwoven stories of these 6 characters takes us through a heart warming journey of the lives of these boys. This movie is about real characters from life who have fun, who fight the wave everyday and through very light heart moments inspire us in the most modest way. The crests and troughs that shape them into the men they will become in the future - because Boys will not always be boys.

Hindi Language.name: Krishna Aur Kans
Hindi Language.description: Hailed as India's first stereoscopic animated film, 'Krishna Aur Kans' is an exciting narrative full of action and drama. The movie chronicles Krishna's early years -- from his birth as the nemesis of his tyrannical uncle Kans.

Hindi Language.name: What the Fish
Hindi Language.description: A woman Sudha, before leaving for a month-long holiday, instructs Sumit to regularly feed her pet fish. But when she returns home, she is shocked to see her house in an utter mess. What could have happened?

Hindi Language.name: Amrit Manthan
Hindi Language.description: Two sisters, Amrit and Nimrit were raised in the royal palace at Amritgarh, where their family ruled for many generations.
