I Don't Luv U also lays emphasis on the potential role of media in a common man's life. It elucidates that if misuse of media can jeopardize a commoner's life, at the same time, if used judiciously, it can act as a savior.

Hindi Language.name: Amdavad Junction
Hindi Language.description: Amdavad Junction is a murder mystery. Two police officers, appointed to investigate a murder case, find it extremely difficult to make headway due to the lack of clues.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Ki Haqeeqat Se Aamna Saamna
The Bright Day
Hindi Language.description: This is a story of Shiv. Shiv, with a supportive family, a close group of friends and a normal life in all respects, sets out on a journey to discover what he seeks in the outside world, not knowing when, if at all, he will return. He is searching for something but isn't sure what exactly he seeks. Experiencing a whole new life is simultaneously frightening, exhilarating and intense as he ventures out, completely vulnerable, on a journey that takes him through diverse landscapes of life arid, vast, claustrophobic, open, abundant. He faces insecurity, enjoys adventure and freedom and learns about different philosophies. A trembling mind has set out on a journey into the unknown towards light. Its own light.

Hindi Language.name: Staying Alive
Hindi Language.description: After Aditya Roy, the Assistant Editor of a magazine, suffers a heart attack for a third time, his wife, Leela, has him taken by ambulance to Mumbai's Lilavati Hospital, where he is placed in the Intensive Cardiac Care Unit. While she anxiously awaits the prognosis, she meets with the wife, Shirin, and son, Altaf, of yet another patient, Shaukat Ali, an underworld gangster, who has suffered his first heart attack. Both women are drawn to each other in their sorrow and despair knowing fully well that their spouses may not live for long, and both may not be ready to accept the changes that are yet to come in their respective lives.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Jo Mohabbat Hai
Hindi Language.description: Will an old enmity between their respective Rajput families stop two lovers Karishma and Karan from eloping.

Hindi Language.name: A Silent Way
Hindi Language.description: This is life story of Paigam, an Assmese tribal, who faces a tough life from childhood to old age.

Hindi Language.name: The Tara Sharma Show
Hindi Language.description: The Tara Sharma Show Accomplished actor and devoted mother, Tara Sharma eagerly captures her adventures with her babies, Zen and Kai. Through a series of video diaries that were born out of a blog, Tara recountsthe day to day thrills of raising her children. Soon after the birth of her first son, Zen, Tara realized that as much as she loved being a hands-on mum, she wanted to get back to work and become an urban, contemporary, multi-tasking Indian mother. Hence, Tara started writing blog diaries that were turned into a TV showwhere she discovered a whole new world through her sons eyes. These video diaries have been edited to highlight four-year-old Zen and a new born Kais milestones, while showcasing Tara and Roopaks ups and downs as they raise their kids in becoming good, happy and healthy people! The show captures the language of love, the science behind baby care, advice from experts and tips from friends and Tara herself. As the show was centred on Taras blog, she was able to continue to drive online engagement with her audience. In addition, the show aims to bring awareness for various causes for kids. Tara also interacts with viewers, experts, paediatricians, and chats with celebrity friends and colleagues on their experiences as parents or grandparents and about their childhood. This show is also a way for Tara to reach out to mothers like herself who discover the joys and trials of motherhood. She admits to not being an expert,yet wanting to document her follies and adventures for mothers everywhere. One major way through which Tara is able to reach out to such a wide net of mothers is through the digital amplification of the show, which has already generated a great buzz. With extensive promotions on the FB fan page and Twitter platforms, Tara has managed to reach over 15lakh fans through the online medium. In addition, eminent twitter celebrity influencers such as Anand Mahindra, KonkonaSen Sharma, ArjunRampal, AbhishekBacchan, BomanIrani and GulPanang have given the show presence and have aided in spreading word through social media platforms. The second season of the show was launched at Funky Monkeys, Mumbai and was commemorated with the presence of Rahul Bose. On ground, the show was promoted through prominent dailies, with major coverage in Bombay Times, along with an extensive hoarding campaign all over the city that promoted the launch with a big bang. The Tara Sharma Show Season 2 was finally telecasted on the 17th February 2013 on Colors, Viacom18s flagship brand in the entertainment space in India and Nickelodeon, India's fastest growing kids channel that reaches over 34.2 million households in the country. The show is being extensively promoted on their online platforms through exciting content in various forms such as videos and images. Tara herself interacts with the fans on a personal level which results in a strong and genuine base of followership. The Tara Sharma Show met with Johnson Baby this season, a complete fit, as the core of the show perfectly represents the Johnson Baby brand attributes and both the show as well as the brand exemplifies the bond between a mother and a child.Moreover, Tara is a loyal user of their products which makes it aseamless sponsor for the show.

Hindi Language.name: Huff! It's Too Much
Hindi Language.description: A romantic-comedy. it revolves around a creative director, his quirky best friend and a woman that he is confused about. It is romantic-comedy set in London dealing with the tryst and tribulation of young 'Desis' staying abroad.

Hindi Language.name: In the Name of Tai
Hindi Language.description: The film is a female orientated story based on a dreadful tragedy of a dedicated and educated village woman (lawyer), respectfully known as Tai (meaning elder sister) who chooses a valiant but perilous avenue. She unfortunately suffers sexually as well as psychologically in her personal life, yet altruistically battles for a common cause of protecting acres of land owned by the village farmers and deprived poverty stricken village community from the clutches of the corridor of Power, Builders, (the land sharks) and of course not forgetting the voracious politicians.

Hindi Language.name: Love You to Death
Hindi Language.description: An outrageous comedy about love that doesn't exist, about therapy that doesn't work and murder that just might happen.

Hindi Language.name: Aasman Se Aage
Hindi Language.description: The show tells the story of Meenakshi, a talented but poor slum girl who gets the opportunity of a lifetime to be on a dance reality show on TV called Aasman Se Aage (Beyond The Sky).

Hindi Language.name: The Lost Tape
Hindi Language.description: Five youngsters went into the woods of Chail, Himachal Pradesh to explore an old urban legend's story. They were completely unaware of the fact that they were slowly becoming part of the story. The more they found out, the closer they got to the unexplained reality, of what they thought was merely a myth. After entering into the woods, they were never seen again. The search went on for 6 months and the case was closed. Until one day, police recovered a digital video recorder, which held the unexplained secret. This film unfolds the mystery of those 5 youngsters' mysterious disappearance. A tale of Love, friendship, betrayal and fear. Fear of the devil and fear of the Lord himself.

Hindi Language.name: Junior Masterchef Swaad Ke Ustaad
Hindi Language.description: Indian version of Junior MasterChef

Hindi Language.name: Ek Bura Aadmi
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by real life stories of some well-known criminal-turned-politicians from eastern Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, the film Ek Bura Aadmi is a realistic portrayal of the power politics of the Hindi belt wherein money and muscle power play very prominent roles. It narrates the story of Munna Siddiqi who starts as a disciple of a politician practising value-based politics but ends up being a consummate practitioner of manipulative politics. Through the story of Munna, whose intentions are noble to help the poor and downtrodden masses fight for the basic amenities but who employs questionable means to achieve these goals, the film Ek Bura Aadmi raises some serious questions about the working of the modern Indian society and the prevailing political culture.

Hindi Language.name: Dilli Gang
Hindi Language.description: Dilli Gang is the story of an old man targeted by a dangerous gang which preys on senior citizens living alone. The film is based on true incidents of increasing murders of aged men and women staying alone in metropolitan cities.

Hindi Language.name: The Artist Within
Hindi Language.description: The artist's psyche pushes the actor to the edge so that he loses his identity.

Hindi Language.name: Police Dial 100
Hindi Language.description: Get a glimpse into the actual process of crime solving as the police get cracking at various cases. Tag along with the cops while they solve cases at crime scenes, on patrol or during investigations.

Hindi Language.name: When Hari Got Married
Hindi Language.description: When Hari, a small-town taxi driver, has an arranged marriage to a girl he has never met, the result is an intimate and humorous look at the changes taking place in India as modernity and globalization meet age-old traditions and customs.

Hindi Language.name: The World of Goopi and Bagha
Hindi Language.description: The story of Goopi and Bagha, a pair of musicians gifted with magical powers by the King of Ghosts.

Hindi Language.name: Aalaap
Hindi Language.description: Artdirector Md asdulla khan

Hindi Language.name: Mokssh
Hindi Language.description: Parth,a young ambitious film director struggles with his career but in his struggles lies his confidence and belief that success will surely come his way.His search for a successful path breaking film makes him team up with Eric,a student of anthropology. Their subject ' Waari ' is a religious pilgrimage which is collectively made by millions every year in Maharashtra,India.It has kept pace with modern times but has retained its core values as it did many centuries ago. Through Parth the viewer is taken through a soul searching journey.His struggle with his conscience and his lover lead him eventually to a state of belief. 'Mokssh ' narrates a modern love story.Its not only spiritual it gives direction to the youth of the modern world who is lost in greed,lust,ambition.its a realization that everyone is connected to their roots ,culture. beauty of relationships,humanity,simplicity has been depicted & high lightedthroughout the film.

Hindi Language.name: The Saroj Khan Story
Hindi Language.description: The Film is a portrait of one of the greatest choreographers that the Hindi film industry has ever produced- Saroj Khan, and the inspiring story of her determination, passion, extraordinary skill and the sheer will to survive.

Hindi Language.name: Bhadaas
Hindi Language.description: A detective with training in criminal psychology aids the local police's hunt for a female serial killer who seduces unfaithful husbands before murdering them.

Hindi Language.name: Horse & Rider: A Journey Towards Freedom
Hindi Language.description: Horse & Rider is a non-conventional look into an increasingly conventional industry of trafficking minors for sex. Shot on location in India in 2011, this narrative documentary traces the tangled memories of two survivors of child prostitution, and the NGO that is working for their restoration back into society. Award-winning Director Ben Stamper draws heavily upon monumental cinematography and a lush musical score to explore the complexities of rescuing minors from brothels and their subsequent journey of healing and reintegration. Horse & Rider is a film that leaves commentary to the audience as it presents the tragic and the heroic dimensions of the human condition with an imaginative lyricism and beauty.

Hindi Language.name: Aakhri Deal
Hindi Language.description: A police officer (Karan) who infiltrates into a gang of criminals saves the Don's life, who then takes a liking to him.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome to the Jungle
Hindi Language.description: Anjali Naik a botany scientist gets disappeared while she is on a government project to search a plant in the jungle news of her disappearance pressures intelligence bureau.The chief of the intelligence bureau send his officer Ram for investigation even before he reaches the jungle few more people start to disappear.Anushka a reporter reaches with her team to cover the story and has differences with Ram but when her saves her from accident they decide to work together to unfold the mystery.

Hindi Language.name: Champ of the Camp
Hindi Language.description: A documentary filmed in the controversial labor camps of the United Arab Emirates. The film follows a massive Bollywood singing and trivia competition that searches across 70 labor camps throughout the country to find and crown the champ of all camps. The film alternates between music trivia competition and the gritty reality of a drab life lived by the laborers, while weaving in intimate scenes of their daily routines and emotional reflections on their life as laborers in Dubai. Narrated (and sung) often in the voices of the laborers, it paints a complete portrait of this vast and isolated population of men who come to build the dream cities of the Arab world while supporting their societies and economies back home in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh.

Hindi Language.name: The Nincompoops
Hindi Language.description: Three friends who have lost their money unintentionally display their stupidity in solving every situation which leads to even more silly situations which makes them getting back the money even more difficult.

Hindi Language.name: Belly of the Tantra
Hindi Language.description: Belly of the Tantra: A Mystical journey. Sometimes darkness tells a story too. A journey towards the left hand path of God.

Hindi Language.name: Pandavas 5
Hindi Language.description: Anime inspired Pandavas 5 (P5) Movie elaborates the adventures of five charming and uniquely talented Pandavas and their journey from rigorous training at Dronacharya's hermitage. With constant encouragement from Bhishma Pitamah, and the resentful competition from their cousins-The Kauravas- The Pandavas excel at the art of warfare."

Hindi Language.name: Myoho
Hindi Language.description: Myoho is based on the philosophy that what goes around comes around and explains that man charts his own destiny. One half of the film is based in 1934 in a small village of Bihar, the other half of the film is based in 2008, when city was attacked by terrorists. All the 14 characters of 1934 are reincarnated. They are chained to their fates created by their own past actions.

Hindi Language.name: Foresting Life
Hindi Language.description: In a world where uncaring Eco-terrorists undertake deforestation, this story is about one man's generous drive behind creating the world's first man-made forest on a sandbar. It is the biggest forest in the middle of the river Brahmaputra in Assam, India.

Hindi Language.name: Teesra shabd: The Shadow of a Woman
Jeet Lengey Jahaan
Hindi Language.description: Parents grow up their kids upto 18 years with a dream to make them Doctor/engineer and educate them accordingly with all their possible efforts and difficulties, but, Kids when grow young tell their decision in 18 days of college life that they want to become an actor/singer or whatever their friends suggest for them. After rebel against parents they choose careers for them of their own choice but after some time they find themselves unsatisfied with the same career. Subsequently they gets into depression and take serious step like committing suicide or addiction of drugs! Jeet Lengey Jahaan is story of such three youngesters who meet at a point of time when all three are frustrated with their career and life. But they decide to choose an alternate career for them rather getting into depression. When everything get settled in their life they found themselves helpless against our corrupt system and judiciary and decide to challenge system with their own way. Will they be succeed to change the system on their own ways? Will all those three 'Jeet Lengey Jahaan' ? !!!...The movie revolves around...!!!

Hindi Language.name: Ab Hoga Dharna Unlimited
Hindi Language.description: Opposition neta Gopinath wants Baba Lakshman Dev to do dharna - and bring the government down. Will these plans get limited?

Hindi Language.name: Chand Ke Pare
Hindi Language.description: Chand Ke Pare is an engaging, path breaking theme of unconventional and yet very warm and beautiful relationships.

Hindi Language.name: Delhi Eye
Hindi Language.description: College students in Delhi commit a crime and work to keep police from finding out.

Hindi Language.name: The Seventh Walk
Hindi Language.description: An experimental documentary on the charcoal drawings of Indian artist Paramjit Singh.

Hindi Language.name: Nights in Soul Valley
Hindi Language.description: A group of friends decide to go on a trek unaware of the deadly realities of the valley they chose to set their foot on. Harry, the protagonist is surrounded by an unknown aura but the positive energy is saving him from each fall. Shanky, Harry's girlfriend, tries to calm him down each time Harry tries explaining her mysterious happenings he experiences. Accompanying these two are Lucky, Lovely and Vicky. Though even the other friends do not believe Harry and consider these happening a telltale yet when they come across Himmat, the trekking guide with baffling aura, they realize that there are suspicious things surrounding them ever since they started their journey. Another character gets added to the story when the group is trekking the mountainous region of Pithoragarh. Jenny has come to Himalaya from England for research on ghost. But will this group surpass these supernatural powers that are pulling them to their death or will they disappear like most people did in the wild forests of Pithoragarh.

Hindi Language.name: Mutthi Bhar Sapne
Hindi Language.description: A musical film set in the heartlands of modern India. It traces the journey of a 10 year old blind boy 'Kesu' as he and his family work towards regaining his eyesight. Positive and inspiring in nature, the film will tug at the heartstrings of every viewer.

Hindi Language.name: Heart of a Murderer
Hindi Language.description: A Hindu fanatic kills a Christian missionary. Her family forgives him, obtains his release from jail, accepts him as a son and brother with a sacred Hindu ceremony. What happens in the heart of a human being who has received unconditioned forgiveness?

Hindi Language.name: The Unsound
Hindi Language.description: THE UNSOUND' is a story of Dev Oberoi, who suffers from multiple organic psychotic disorder-a condition that makes his behavior extremely unpredictable and at times even violent. A failed marriage and an impending divorce, a young beautiful girl Simran is charmed by Dev's flattering ways. But you don't always get what you see. So while those who are close to him desert him, there are others who enter his life not knowing what lies ahead. Ironically, amongst those who fall in the trap of Dev's seemingly normal attractive persona is his own psychiatrist-- a beautiful woman named Joena Their torrid one-night affair happens despite joena's committed relationship with Dev's close friend Dr.Kshitij Saxena. Will she expose the deep dark secrets of Dev's violent past and present to give him a better future? And can she rescue herself from the demons of Dev's unsound mind?

Hindi Language.name: Woh
Hindi Language.description: Little Poupe' comes to her Grandfather, a celebrated author, for the first time when her mother falls seriously ill. Her gloomy stay in the age old mansion with a grumpy faced Mary Aunty and a lonesome Grandfather slowly takes a turn with the arrival of a circus troupe, a talking fox, a nagging tiger, a magic tree and WOH, the anonymous commoner from the Grandfather's writing. With WOH intruding the ordinary day to day activities, Poupe' and her 'Daddu's' life takes a sudden leap and becomes adventurous...WOH is inspired by Rabindranath Tangore's novel "Shey" (That Fellow) written in Shantiniketan, 1937 about his own relationship with Grand Daughter Nandini.

Hindi Language.name: Bhobhar - The Live Ash
Hindi Language.description: Bhobhar explores the life and relationships of a small farmer Rewat in rural Rajasthan, India.

Hindi Language.name: It's Rocking: Dard-E-Disco
Hindi Language.description: During a visit to his doctor, DK sings a new song he has written. He is overheard by a newborn (Rocky)in the next room - destined to live his life for Disco. Rambo and Rocky Singh, (crazy, spoiled brothers), wish to open their own disco and spend every night partying. They are excited to visit the new DK discotheque "Dard-E-Disco", and thrilled to meet the famous Disco King. Meanwhile, Powder Bhai wants to infiltrate the new club with his product - drugs - the one thing DK does not allow. He sees Rocky and Rambo's closeness to DK as a way in, which eventually splits the close brothers apart.

Hindi Language.name: Cook It Up with Tarla Dalal
Hindi Language.description: Catch the culinary stylings of the vegetarian genius Tarla Dalal, with co-host Sudhanshu Pandey.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Jalebi
Hindi Language.description: Zindgi Jalebi is a comedy based on idle minds is devils' workshop. It also symbolises an innate need and tendency of every human to do a heroic deed and a desire to be remembered for it for times to come. If their ordinary lives and circumstances do not have a place for a heroic deed, then how they want to manipulate and create one. The comedy is that those who set out for the task end up creating a hero out of somebody else and somehow come out of the series of events unscathed[3]. Zindagi jalebi is a story where everyone's life is jumbling up in a mess and then how they come out of this mess

Hindi Language.name: Meri Shadi Karao
Hindi Language.description: A young, music lover and obedient boy Gurdeep of Singh family which is settled in UAE for past 20 years,wants to be married and his uncle is very much over protective because of his own heart breaking incident in his youth.

Hindi Language.name: Dekha Jo Pehli Baar
Hindi Language.description: The film Dekha Jo Pehli Baar is a unique love story rotates around the three college mates Rahul, Anupama and Nilofar in a love triangle. It defines the philosophy of love that love is the gift of deity. Love has no boundary. It unites the two souls. In the very story of the film Dekha Jo Pehli Baar Rahul is a rogue student in the college, who has no aim in his life. He always indulges in criminal activities, in lieu of attending classes. Once an incidence takes place in the college premises, wherein one fresher student Anupama slaps him. Rahul turns to slap her but after seeing Anupama, a beautiful girl; he is fascinated by her and falls in love at the first sight. But on the contrary, Anupama hates him due to his vicious unlawful act. Another girl, a college mate Nilofer comes in his life. She loves him, but when she comes to know that Rahul loves Anupama, she sacrifices her love and tries her best to unite Rahul and Anupama. She becomes the bridge between the two. Will Rahul be able to get his love? Will Nilofer be succeeded to unite Rahul with Anupama? Could Anupama feel the sentiments of Rahul? These are the questions to be solved only after witnessing the film Dekha Jo Pehli Baar. Dekha Jo Pehli Baar carries the message that sport plays a pivotal role in our love life, as the hero of this film turns into a tennis player from a rogue boy and becomes a lover. Love gives strength as well as confidence. Love is peace, love is victory.

Hindi Language.name: Footprints in the desert
Hindi Language.description: A human story of the Indo-Pak border through the footprints in the desert. . Abdul with an ancient mysterious knowledge reads the footprints which cross the border. Alhadeen is a Muslim Aulia who travels along the border. He finds the people, their pain, joy and longing for the other side. The footprints lead to the real people, real feeling & story is woven on 60 years of pain, longing & love-which rarely comes out in the projected relationship of the 2 countries.

Hindi Language.name: Kaand Black Scandal
Hindi Language.description: Kaand is the story of brothers who return to their village and find themselves pulled into a feudal intrigue.[3] Beera is a sports coach in the college in which his younger brother Rajveer (Suraj K Shah) is a student. Beera falls for the new girl in college, seema, but she turns down his marrage proposal. Rajveer falls in love with another college student, rekha, but she too rejects him. Beera and Rajveer go to their village during college holidays. Seema, too, lands up in the same village, to visit her uncle, Viraj. Beera and seema meet often and soom fall in love. However, when beera tells his father, Dharamdas, that he want to marry seema, he refuses him. Dharamdas tells Beera about the incident that had happened decades ago. Dharamdas wife, Rukmani, consider Viraj her brother. She had gone to his house on Raksha Bandhan to tie him a rakhi but never returned. Viraj claimed that Rukmani din't come to his house, but Dharamdas suspected him of lying and of having killed or kidnapped her. The relationship between Dharamdas and Viraj had soured, and now Dharamdas din't want to have anything to do with Viraj. Rekha come to visit Seema and meets Rajveer again. They also soon fall in love. Meanwhile, Gujri, wife of Ajit singh, who is Viraj's brother, hatches a plan to get their son, Umed, marrried to Seema, who is the niece of Viraj's wife, Gujri realizes that seema love Beera, so she kills her husband Ajit, to frame Beera for his murder. Beera is arrested by the police. But the police soon learn that Gujri has kidnapped Seema to force her to marry Umed. Will Seema be Freed? Will Seema and Beera find Love? Will rajveer and Rekha find love? and is Rajveer's mother still alive?

Hindi Language.name: Amphigori
Hindi Language.description: This movie is a motley collection of 12 short films varying from action, drama, comedy to romance and connected together with the help of a book and a conversation of two guys who are planning to make a movie.

Hindi Language.name: Kalavu
Hindi Language.description: Film begins with the theft of Ran-gamma's buffalo. Story primarily visits the incidents in a village over one day, also lays bare many forms of theft occurring in the lives of the villagers. Story explores the theft of Ran-gamma's desires and ambitions, shattering of Rani's dreams of marriage, loss of Ran-gamma's husband's masculinity, loss of the landlord's daughter's love for a man, theft of the family jewels, loss of land, spiritual values and relationships among many other instances that reveal the all-pervasive nature of theft in daily life. In a patriarchal society, we see how even in a tradition-bound village Ran-gamma defies the rules and courageously dons the traditional role of the man in the family.

Hindi Language.name: Ghatothkach 2
Hindi Language.description: Ghatothkach, the son of demigod Bheema is blessed with extra-ordinary powers. The film captures the magical and adventurous journey of this cute prince and his elephant friend 'Gajju' to thwart the demon, Lankasoor's evil plans.

Hindi Language.name: Bhagaude
Hindi Language.description: 'Bhagaude' in English mean a person who runs away from facing difficulties. Frustrated with their life 2 men facing mid life crisis and global slowdown run away from regular life in search of 'Nowhere'. They bike to unknown places with the determination of finding 'Nowhere'. The unplanned journey is filled with passion, danger, excitement, emotion, anger, friendship and shows different characters of a human being. The search leads them to an unknown place away from urban world where they find a beautiful temple with a lonely Priest. Will they be able to find the 'Nowhere'? According to Priest 'Moksha' can be achieved by following this words and advices But life is unpredictable, what happens to these 3 men? Will they get to 'Nowhere'?

Hindi Language.name: Classic Incantations
Hindi Language.description: Classic Incantations: The German Film Orchestra Babelsberg performs A.R. Rahman.

Hindi Language.name: Hind Desh Ke Niwasi
Hindi Language.description: A film about social exclusion on the basis of caste based on interviews and evidence collected in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh. Film made with the help of Indian Institute of Dalit Studies.

Hindi Language.name: Greater Elephant
Hindi Language.description: Greater Elephant is a wicked assembly of those who still haven't found what they're looking for: a purpose.

Hindi Language.name: Tutiya Dil
Hindi Language.description: Tutiya Dil (UA) is the story of Rhea Kapoor (Suzanna Mukherjee) who falls in love with her new boss, Karan Oberoi (Nikhil Sabharwal). However, she soon realises that Karan is two-timing her. She walks out on him but is unable to forget him. She is even ready to forgive him when he makes the first move after the breakup, but he once again lets her down rather badly. After walking out on Karan, Rhea begins to stay in the house of Vishal Khanna (Sidhant Kapur), a colleague, who understands her predicament and sympathises with her. Vishal is living in with his girlfriend but still makes place for Rhea in his house because he cares for her. After her bad experience in love, Rhea likens men to turkeys, a species of birds which are always on the hunt for new hens to mate with. She is convinced, men can never be faithful and always have sex on their minds. Rhea also has to consult a shrink, Dr. Prayag (Naveen Kaushik), such is her condition after the heartbreak.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Haule Dost
Hindi Language.description: This is a comedy drama about 5 college kids who want to go on a bike rally in the Himalayas but do not have the resources. The film is about how these kids deal with the threat of responsibility and impending adulthood, find love and make money in a fast growing and rapidly changing urban India.

Hindi Language.name: One More...
Hindi Language.description: The story of a little known ice hockey team from Ladakh, India which struggles against all odds to keep the game alive in India. They get a lucky break to represent India at a tournament in Russia after a team pulls out at the last minute. Will they be able to redeem themselves?

Hindi Language.name: Le Gaya Saddam
Hindi Language.description: Munni loves Sher Khan. Sher Khan loves Munni, and so does every other man in town. They get married, but her notorious flirting causes a quick divorce. In order to remarry each other, they must follow the law - she has to marry someone else for 24 hours, then divorce him. She chooses to remarry - Sher's 70 year old grandfather......who decides not to divorce.....

Hindi Language.name: The Bhai
Hindi Language.description: THE BHAI is the origin story of India's most powerful criminal syndicate. The film is a contemporary re-telling based on the lives of the dons who ruled the Mumbai Underworld.

Hindi Language.name: Star Verdict
Hindi Language.description: Anupama Chopra interviews your favourite Bollywood celebrities, and shares her candid, qualitative reviews of latest Hindi films on Star Verdict.

Hindi Language.name: The House That Made Me
Hindi Language.description: Host Vinay Pathak journeys back home with such celebrities as cricketer Irfan Pathan and actors Govinda, Waheeda Rehman, Sakshi Tanwar and Ila Arun.

Hindi Language.name: Keymon and Nani in Space Adventure
Hindi Language.description: One day Nani takes Keymon and Rohan camping where an explosion takes place and after returning Nani starts behaving very different than usual. Will Keymon and Rohan be able to find out what happened to Nani? Watch Keymon, Rohan and Nani in their fun-filled escapade.

Hindi Language.name: Lovebirds: Rebel Lovers in India
Hindi Language.description: India - Lovebirds are young rebel lovers that risk their life just to stay together. They escape their families and persecution from India's ancient tradition of prohibiting marriage outside one's caste or religion. Different stories of lovebirds on the run interweave in a poor shelter in New Delhi. There to help them is Mr. Sachdev who leads the Love Commandos, a group of Indian activist supporting their rebel choices.

Hindi Language.name: Nirankush
Hindi Language.description: A dominant family history carved Arjun Shandilya as an extreme sociopath. As a grown-up psychology enthusiast, he decides to quit the job and move to a remote isolated cottage to propagate his research on self-regulated personality alteration. The experiment successfully alters his personality but towards the other extreme of human thought that recognizes no authority at all.

Hindi Language.name: August 2
Hindi Language.description: This movie is about three different people who are having their own plans for the day, On August 2, Naveen who had a recent rift with his girlfriend plans to apologize her to bury the hatred between them. The other characters Jay and his wife Anvitha who were on their way to a marriage will get in trouble with their car in a midway. It is too late by the time they realize that the day had its own plans for them.

Hindi Language.name: Calapor
Hindi Language.description: The film is a taut thriller, set in the backdrop of a jail. It is a modern story of reformation. The film provokes thoughts about the nature of human being while infusing hope that there is good in every human being. When a reluctant Jyotsna, an artiste with her assistant Ragini arrive in Calapor Central Jail to conduct an art program for prison inmates, initiated by a very sincere and committed reformist Jail Superintendent, Karunakar, the agonizing past of a criminal husband who cheated her and a delinquent son who ran away, returns to torment her. With adversity comes an opportunity; a second chance that Jyotsna as a mother cannot afford to lose or fail to succeed.

Hindi Language.name: Bole UP
Hindi Language.description: Bole UP is a flagship infotainment program produced by Doordarshan Kendra Lucknow for the DD Uttar Pradesh network. The show blends interviews with audience participation and cultural showcases, featuring spotlights from regional talents.

Hindi Language.name: With Stars on Fingertips
Hindi Language.description: In some remote tribal villages of India, the first light bulbs are starting to glow over the heads of the natives. For some, it is a great revolution. But many others would like to have the darkness back.

Hindi Language.name: Gandhi Ki Zameen Par
Hindi Language.description: A family, a TV reporter & his cameraman coping with communal riots and their attempt to disseminate the message of humanity being supreme religion. A message for peace & non-violence. If we blind-follow religion & consider it above humanity then are we not self-destroying?

Hindi Language.name: Bhagwan... tera Bhala ho!
Hindi Language.description: There are nearly 31 million Gods and Goddess in Hindu religion who people turn to for Happiness, Peace, Prosperity, Health and many other Man made needs. There are also fanatics who would do anything to stop people of lower caste from even entering the Temples. This is a story of one such boy from a lower caste who is identified by these same fanatics as a God (adding one more to the list of Millions). The satire, based on real life event and people takes a shot at the natives of a poor village, Bakheda in India.

Hindi Language.name: Science with Braincafe
Hindi Language.description: The hosts share valuable insights on basic scientific concepts by conducting fun experiments in front of a young audience. It makes it easier for them to grasp theories, which are otherwise tough.

Hindi Language.name: The International Problem
Hindi Language.description: The film centres round one Avinash, a computer engineer. To rejoice his accomplishment, he throws a party. where, he contracts acquaintance with a girl and has sex with her. After the sex, he becomes a prey to HIV syndrome. He rushes to a doctor for treatment. Disgraced with his syndrome, he decides to commit suicide. The meeting and the treatment from Dr Asha leads to a turning point in his life. Asha makes it aptly clear to family that there is nothing to concern and HIV syndrome is nothing to panic as it is normal. To eradicate this syndrome, both Asha and Avinash embark on a mission and hold a press conference. Various questions on this syndrome of HIV are posed.

Hindi Language.name: Luv Kushh and the Ghost Army Global
Hindi Language.description: Luv Kush is the story of the amazing twins of Ram and Sita. This animated movie made for kids depicts their birth, adolescence, their love for the Vedas, their skills in archery and the final confrontation with Ram.

Hindi Language.name: Sama: Muslim Mystic Music of India
Hindi Language.description: Exploring the Muslim Mystic Music of India

Hindi Language.name: Webbed
Hindi Language.description: Faceless predators on the Internet pose a great risk to unsuspecting users. Webbed, in its second season, showcases such scary and compelling stories of people who have become victims of Internet fraud and heinous crimes.

Hindi Language.name: Missing Persons Report
Hindi Language.description: Everything is going wrong for Neil and his diploma film. His lead actress attempts suicide. Hand-written notes begin to appear. As he puts together the notes, he realizes the chilling story of the house. But it may be too late.

Hindi Language.name: Balakka
Hindi Language.description: 'Balakka - Loved Women' combines the two ends of feelings of love and authority together. It's the comic story on the classic theme. The film portrays the colors of both the phenomena of Chhaya (Shadow) and Maya (Illusion) in women.

Hindi Language.name: Decision
Hindi Language.description: The Film is Pushpa's journey as she tries to make sense of her own life and those of her women friends. Set in a lower middle class colony in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, it explores the lives of women, who are young, educated and bright, but feel bound and helpless when it comes to taking any major decision regarding their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Dancing Pandavs
Hindi Language.description: 'Dancing Pandavs' is a first time record of folk-practices and beliefs of people living in the Himalayan states of Garhwal Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh in India, relating to the famous Indian epic, the 'Mahabharata'. Traveling and shooting in difficult Himalayan terrain, often without roads in the six winter months of 2011-12 this film attempts to tell the singular story of the Himalayan people. A story that brings together the inner meanings of their possessed dancing, their folk-theater, their ancient form of enchanting music on drums and song, their agnostic war-games and their ancient architectural ruins and heritage, spread almost over a 1000 kms. The film tell its story in the words of the participating people speaking in many the Himalayan languages, with subtitles in English.

Hindi Language.name: Een olifant is in het dorp gekomen
Hindi Language.description: 'Education is about understanding the skills and knowledge, which have been generated over the years in society. And about how to use these for the development of the society.' Despite changing attitudes, there are still many children who don't have access to proper education. Indian ngo's are trying to improve the educational system and to reach all layers of society, with a special focus on the poorest living in the city-slums and the disadvantaged in rural and remote tribal area's. This documentary offers an perspective of India, different than described in travel guides. It's about daily realities for many Indian people and a connected mixture of colorfulness and serious problems. About a country which is moving forward rapidly, but where development starts which awareness and education.

Hindi Language.name: The One and the Many
Hindi Language.description: This anthropological documentary film offers an in-depth look at the Tantrik, Aghori, holy seekers of Northern India who are the living disciples of the great Guru Gorakh Nath. In their search for the One amongst the many, the Naths believe only a true guru can guide them through the paradoxes of human life in their search for a centre where nothing must exist.

Hindi Language.name: Inka Safar Shuru: Raghupati Raghav Raja Ram
At the Crossroads Nondon Bagchi Life and Living
Hindi Language.description: A biographical documentary on eminent Indian rock and jazz musician and percussionist Nondon Bagchi and a generation of 60's musicians playing English rock music in India. The glorious journey was brought to a halt by the untimely passing away of key band members and left the remaining stranded at the crossroads grappling for survival and recognition in the face of state indifference and lack of support. Undaunted by personal and professional setbacks Nondon continues to rock his brand of 60's rock with cover band Hip Pocket and as a member of the internationally acclaimed Carlton Kitto Jazz Ensemble. The film is a homage to the maverick musician on the occasion of his 60th birthday, June 21 which is now celebrated as World Music Day.

Hindi Language.name: Heroes - Moments and Memories
Hindi Language.description: Children interview cricketers about their life and career, and also receive cricket tips and lessons.

Hindi Language.name: The Serpent King
Hindi Language.description: The film features Serpent King who is in search of a special mantra to gain powers. He must first defeat the King of Vanar Rajya who knows about the mantra and its powers.

Hindi Language.name: The Plotter
Hindi Language.description: Guptraj , a mystery writer refuses to grant a divorce to his wife Neelam. Detective Andaz returns from America to his wealthy father's estate and meets Neelam. They fell in love and devised a perfect murder plot to kill Guptraj. The plot gets complicated when the true identity of Neelam is revealed. A serial killer is set out to kill both as the horror and the mystery begins to unravel.

Hindi Language.name: Tied in a Knot: Narratives from Bride Seeking Regions of India
Hindi Language.description: Parts of North India are facing an acute shortage of brides! Years of girl dis-preference is forcing men to travel to far-off poorer regions of India to find wives. Who are these men seeking wives from elsewhere? Are the women trafficked for forced marriage or not? Why cannot these women get married locally? How are they treated by the families and the communities into which they are married? This film provides a unique look into the everyday harsh reality of such brides: the stigmatization, racism, rejection and abuse they face from conjugal families and communities and how they try to resist it. It bares the everyday suffering endured by lonely brides when they find themselves married into totally alien cultures and environments.

Hindi Language.name: Vyakaran
Hindi Language.description: A boy studying for his entrance exams becomes alienated from his family. Although the boy stays in the same house as his family the gap between the boy and family widens so much they start forgetting about the existence of this boy. One day their neighborhood is attacked by terrorists, the family mistake their own son for a terrorist and get him killed by the police. This story connects the story of two journalists, an anti-establishment girl and a pro-establishment man, who go through existentialist crisis in their parallel stories. The film is about social justice and land acquisition and existence.

Hindi Language.name: Don't Waste People
Hindi Language.description: An exploration of the lives and livelihoods of people who work as waste pickers in Delhi, India and their current struggle with private waste management companies for rights to recyclable waste.

Hindi Language.name: Prem Mayee
Hindi Language.description: Prem Mayee is a story of people in love and the circumstances that push them only to realise the inevitable... that love brings out the BEST and the WORST in us.Its about love that can give abundance of joy, reassurance, positivity, success, fulfilment and yet it can go on to cause unhappiness, hurt, negativity. Prem Mayee further throws light on women's place in society, marraige, relationships and work-place.

Hindi Language.name: Tuhi Mera Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Vijay is an irresponsible brat who, despite his disbelief in marriage, is forced by his father to tie the knot. Having decided to marry Radha, a girl of his father's choice, Vijay's decision comes with a list of his bizarre conditions.

Hindi Language.name: Reality Stars
Hindi Language.description: Four crazy friends - Krish, Kuldeep, Tania and Zameer - are trapped in the mad, mad world of reality TV.

Hindi Language.name: The Life Kung-Fu
Hindi Language.description: THE PLOT OF THIS FILM IS SET AROUND A GIRL WHO IS TAUGHT BY A TEACHER FROM SHAOLIN KUNG-FU TEMPLE AND HOW SHE FIGHTS AGAINST THE INJUSTICE OF THE SOCIETY

Hindi Language.name: Monophobia
Hindi Language.description: A man suffering from monophobia - the fear of being alone - finds himself lost in a forest.

Hindi Language.name: The Alphabet of the River
Hindi Language.description: Once upon a time, there was a school with two oars in place of desks, and a river for a blackboard, to learn how to write.

Hindi Language.name: Manaswini
Hindi Language.description: The female protagonist is a very quiet, simple girl having v.high moral values, and has younger sis and d whole family is looking fwd to d marriage of elder sis to a young industrialist. But d young handsome man falls for d young sis.

Hindi Language.name: Naya Chand
Hindi Language.description: A story of boundless love between Sahil and Ruhi. He has love at first sight and wants to walk to a different and deeper meaning called marriage. Soon he discover that she has a hole in heart, his world collapse but he doent give up hope. Doctor advices Sahil no physical intimacy else he would lose her forever. it makes Ruhi uncomfortable as she feels that Sahil does not love her but she gets shocked when she learns the fact. Time passes and Sahil go to another workstation. one fine day Sahil sees an accident where in his close friend has got killed. He disconnects from the world, Ruhi. Ruhi lands up there and eventually gets him to normal life with her affection and warmth.

Hindi Language.name: Ab to Jagoo
Hindi Language.description: Ab to Jagoo is a political and socially driven movie which throws light on the atrocities done on the common man by the people in power. The film stars Ishaan Tandon and Sheena Das in the lead roles. The music score is by Jalalludin Khan.

Hindi Language.name: Tathagata
Hindi Language.description: Questioning the ultimate? Who are you? Where have you come from? And where are you heading Tathagata?

Hindi Language.name: My Street, My Life
Hindi Language.description: A highly experimental fictional film accompanied by a powerful film score. It is set in the middle of New Delhi, where street children live amidst the hustle and bustle of a typical market street. The children acting in this film are the real street children from the area - this is their street. They hope, they try, and they fail. The film is heavily based upon reality, subtle yet strong, and full of colours and life so vivid that one can almost smell the odours of India. In addition to offering an authentic insight into the lives of street children in India, this film also gives an accurate impression of daily life in a busy bazaar with continuous movement and an abundance of life.

Hindi Language.name: The Human Horses
Hindi Language.description: Ibrahim, Ram and Raju are three rickshaw pullers in Kolkata - a city held together by its agony, which has the spasmodic vitality of something that is nearing its end. These men are called Human Horses because of the work they do. Actually, they are the last of the lasts, a stubborn proof of the true essence of human dignity.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Tha Sardaar
Hindi Language.description: The film is a story of a rickshaw driver who rises to the position of Sardar Bhai who soon turns out to becomes a rowdy fugitive.

Hindi Language.name: Hockey India League
Hindi Language.description: Hockey India League (HIL) is a professional field hockey league in India. The league is organized by Hockey India, the governing body for the sport in India.

Hindi Language.name: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
Hindi Language.description: An Indian man with a magnanimous heart takes a young mute Pakistani girl back to her homeland to reunite her with her family.

Hindi Language.name: PK
Hindi Language.description: An alien on Earth loses the only device he can use to communicate with his spaceship. His innocent nature and child-like questions force the country to evaluate the impact of religious views on people.

Hindi Language.name: TVF Pitchers
Hindi Language.description: A story of trials and tribulations of four young entrepreneurs who quit their day jobs in order to pursue their start up venture.

Hindi Language.name: Drishyam
Hindi Language.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

Hindi Language.name: Bajirao Mastani
Hindi Language.description: An account of the romance between the Maratha general, Baji Rao I and Mastani, princess of Bundelkhand.

Hindi Language.name: Dilwale
Hindi Language.description: The younger siblings of two estranged lovers fall for each other, unaware of the violent past that drove the elder ones apart.

Hindi Language.name: Talvar
Hindi Language.description: An experienced investigator confronts several conflicting theories about the perpetrators of a violent double homicide.

Hindi Language.name: Shackle
Hindi Language.description: The grim journey of the protagonists viz. Abeera (26 yrs) and Kesar (11 yrs) in under shade of this malpractice has been named SAANKAL (Shackle).

Hindi Language.name: Tamasha
Hindi Language.description: A boy meets a girl, in Corsica. They decide not to reveal their real name or personality.

Hindi Language.name: Masaan
Hindi Language.description: Along India's Ganges River, four people face prejudice, a strict moral code and a punishing caste system as they confront personal tragedies.

Hindi Language.name: Happy New Year
Hindi Language.description: A gang of amateur dancers takes part in a dancing competition to avenge their personal vendetta.

Hindi Language.name: Haider
Hindi Language.description: A young man returns to Kashmir after his father's disappearance to confront his uncle, whom he suspects of playing a role in his father's fate.

Hindi Language.name: Kick
Hindi Language.description: An adrenaline junkie walks away from a whirlwind romance and embraces a new life as a thief, though he soon finds himself pursued by veteran police officer and engaged in a turf war with a local gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Dhadakne Do
Hindi Language.description: The Mehra family must contemplate over their way of living and their love lives while on a cruise celebrating their 30th wedding anniversary.

Hindi Language.name: Rahasya
Hindi Language.description: A Doctor stands accused of killing his own eighteen-year old daughter. While this aggrieved father protests his innocence, all evidence points towards him irrefutably.

Hindi Language.name: Piku
Hindi Language.description: A strong-willed, sharp-tongued daughter navigates her cranky, constipated father's hypochondria and quirky demands, while dealing with her own chaotic life and a reluctant road trip to Kolkata.

Hindi Language.name: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
Hindi Language.description: A single mother finds solace with a wealthy, but lonely hotel magnate, together they find love until her past comes back to confront her.

Hindi Language.name: Bang Bang
Hindi Language.description: A young bank receptionist gets mixed up with Rajveer Nanda, a man who has a mysterious background.

Hindi Language.name: Manjhi: The Mountain Man
Hindi Language.description: Using only a hammer and a chisel, a man spends twenty-two years carving a road through a treacherous mountain.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome Back
Hindi Language.description: A pair of reformed gangsters try to find a husband for their newly discovered sister, but complications arise due to mistaken identities.

Hindi Language.name: Permanent Roommates
Hindi Language.description: A couple, who were in a long distance relationship for 3 years, face the prospect of getting married.

Hindi Language.name: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
Hindi Language.description: While recovering from an assassination attempt four days before his coronation, a stern prince is replaced by a romantic lookalike.

Hindi Language.name: Highway
Hindi Language.description: Right before her wedding, a young woman finds herself abducted and held for ransom. As the initial days pass, she begins to develop a strange bond with her kidnapper.

Hindi Language.name: The Villain
Hindi Language.description: Raghu, a gangster falls madly in love with a terminally ill girl named Aisha. But when she's brutally murdered, his dark past returns as he unleashes hell to hunt the killer - only to discover the shocking truth.

Hindi Language.name: Badlapur
Hindi Language.description: Raghu begins walking a fine line between good and evil as he exacts violent revenge on two criminals who killed his family 15 years ago.

Hindi Language.name: Gunday
Hindi Language.description: The lives of Calcutta's most powerful Gunday, Bikram and Bala, changes when Nandita enters it. Then a counter-force takes charge and a thriller unfolds.

Hindi Language.name: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
Hindi Language.description: A girl from Ambala, Kavya Pratap Singh, is about to be married. When she visits Delhi to shop for her 'dhai lakh ka Ghagra, she meets Humpty Sharma, a carefree Delhiite, and falls in love with him.

Hindi Language.name: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
Hindi Language.description: Amidst the chaos of World War II, eager and idealistic Byomkesh Bakshy is determined to uncover a murder mystery that soon turns into a battle against time to save Calcutta from Japanese invasion.

Hindi Language.name: Mardaani
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Shivani Shivaji Roy, who works at a Mumbai Crime Branch, sets out to confront the mastermind behind a child-trafficking mafia.

Hindi Language.name: Mary Kom
Hindi Language.description: A chronicle of the life of Indian boxer Mary Kom, who went through several hardships before audaciously accomplishing her ultimate dream.

Hindi Language.name: Hunterrr
Hindi Language.description: Mandar, an ordinary guy is obsessed with sex and chases girls until he meets Tripti and decides to settle down with her.

Hindi Language.name: Earthquake
Hindi Language.description: Los Angeles is about to be hit by a devastating earthquake, and time is running out to save the city from imminent danger.

Hindi Language.name: States
Hindi Language.description: Coming from two very different cultural backgrounds, Krish and Ananya try to convince their parents to bless their relationship before they get married.

Hindi Language.name: Rainbow
Hindi Language.description: Believing actor and goodwill ambassador Shah Rukh Khan can help her brother get an operation to restore his sight, a 10-year old girl takes her blind 8-year old brother on a trek across Rajasthan in search of the superstar.

Hindi Language.name: Hasee Toh Phasee
Hindi Language.description: Nikhil is re-introduced to Meeta nearly ten years after their first meeting. Now, as Nikhil has one week to prove himself worth enough to marry Meeta's sister Karishma, the old acquaintances become quite close to each other.

Hindi Language.name: Singham Returns
Hindi Language.description: Mumbai DCP Bajirao Singham targets a fraudulent godman whose criminal empire, backed by political muscle, reaches deep enough to endanger Singham's team and force a personal reckoning.

Hindi Language.name: Aligarh
Hindi Language.description: A gay, linguistic professor living in a small orthodox city must deal with the aftermath of a sting operation that puts his sexual orientation in front of the entire nation.

Hindi Language.name: Tanu Weds Manu Returns
Hindi Language.description: Tanu and Manu's marriage collapses. What happens when Manu meets Tanu's lookalike Kusum - and when Tanu returns?

Hindi Language.name: Parched
Hindi Language.description: In the arid landscape of Rajasthan, four women navigate their way through personal and cultural difficulties.

Hindi Language.name: Baby
Hindi Language.description: An elite counter-intelligence unit learns of a plot, masterminded by a maniacal madman. With the clock ticking, it's up to them to track the terrorists' international tentacles and prevent them from striking at the heart of India.

Hindi Language.name: Dum Laga Ke Haisha
Hindi Language.description: Prem and his oversized wife Sandhya are supposed to spend a lifetime together. Will a regular arranged marriage turn out to be a perfect mismatch?

Hindi Language.name: Holiday
Hindi Language.description: A military officer attempts to hunt down a terrorist, destroy a terrorist gang and deactivate the sleeper cells under its command.

Hindi Language.name: Brothers
Hindi Language.description: After living many years together, two brothers discover that they are not blood related so square off in a mixed martial arts tournament to determine whose blood is stronger.

Hindi Language.name: Shaandaar
Hindi Language.description: In the backdrop of a destination wedding in London, two families try to save their respective empires, unbeknownst to each other.

Hindi Language.name: NH 10
Hindi Language.description: On their way to a weekend retreat, a married couple find their dream vacation turn into a nightmare when they cross paths with a dangerous gang.

Hindi Language.name: Main Tera Hero
Hindi Language.description: Seenu and Sunaina fall in love with each other when he saves her from a corrupt policeman who wishes to marry her. Meanwhile, Ayesha, a girl Seenu meets on a train journey, wants to marry him.

Hindi Language.name: Mr. X
Hindi Language.description: After gaining the power of invisibility; a man becomes a vigilante, in order to take revenge on those who have wronged him.

Hindi Language.name: The New Classmate
Hindi Language.description: Follows a single woman (a Mom) and dreams on her Daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Margarita with a Straw
Hindi Language.description: A rebellious young woman with cerebral palsy leaves her home in India to study in New York, unexpectedly falls in love, and embarks on an exhilarating journey of self-discovery.

Hindi Language.name: Khoobsurat
Hindi Language.description: A hopelessly romantic physiotherapist meets a handsome young Rajput prince who is the complete opposite of her and engaged to someone else.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Ending
Hindi Language.description: A confused writer goes on the search of inspiration for his next story and falls in love with a best seller author who doesn't believe in love.

Hindi Language.name: It's Entertainment
Hindi Language.description: Akhil, an underdog and a failure, comes to know that his real father is a rich diamond merchant who has just passed away. When he goes to retrieve his wealth, he learns that a dog has inherited it.

Hindi Language.name: Bombay Velvet
Hindi Language.description: An ordinary man goes against all odds and forges his destiny to become a 'Big Shot'.

Hindi Language.name: Kill Dil
Hindi Language.description: Abandoned when young, Bhaiyaji gives shelter to Dev and Tutu. A game of defiance, deception and love follows when free-spirited Disha enters their life.

Hindi Language.name: Dedh Ishqiya
Hindi Language.description: Two lousy crooks find paradise in the seven stages of love.

Hindi Language.name: Kaisi Yeh Yaariyan
Hindi Language.description: Manik and Nandini's fairy tale love faces shadows that threaten their promised world of light. Can their bond prevail or will it crumble under darkness?

Hindi Language.name: Naagin
Hindi Language.description: A miraculous shape-shifting serpent has the power to become a human. She can be anybody she wants: a wife, a seductress, a mistress, a damsel in distress--all for the sake of revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Haraamkhor
Hindi Language.description: A selfish, manipulative schoolteacher takes advantage of a schoolgirl's vulnerability to gratify his dark, narcissistic desires.

Hindi Language.name: Shiva
Hindi Language.description: Shiva is a young boy who lives with his grandparents in a fictional city named Vedas. He is a child superhero with supernatural powers, he faces a lot of villains who try to harm or try to damage any people and property of his city.

Hindi Language.name: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hai
Hindi Language.description: Loveless marriages and jealousy characterize two neighboring households as they try to cope with each other and themselves.

Hindi Language.name: Gabbar Is Back
Hindi Language.description: After a vengeful college professor targets corruption in the government, he adopts the name "Gabbar" and becomes a hero to a weary public.

Hindi Language.name: Kumkum Bhagya
Hindi Language.description: Kumkum Bhagya is a love story of Pragya and Abhi who are destined to be together against all odds.

Hindi Language.name: Raja Natwarlal
Hindi Language.description: A small-time con man seeks assistance from his mentor with the intention of settling scores with a gangster.

Hindi Language.name: Chakravartin Ashoka Samrat
Hindi Language.description: The serial is about Indian Emperor, Ashoka, grandson of Chandragupta Maurya. The story starts with young Ashoka (Siddharth Nigam) who is getting guidance from Chanakya(Manoj Joshi) .

Hindi Language.name: Titli
Hindi Language.description: Titli, the youngest member of a car-jacking brotherhood wants to escape the family business. He and his wife form a pact to set free from their family roots. But is escape possible?

Hindi Language.name: Roy
Hindi Language.description: Successful film-maker Kabir meets with Ayesha and falls in love. He suffers a heartbreak when she leaves him. Meanwhile, a thief named Roy undergoes a change of heart when he experiences love.

Hindi Language.name: Hate Story 3
Hindi Language.description: Siya appears to be the bone of contention between warring businessmen Aditya and Saurav. But this one runs deeper than your average love triangle.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Ho
Hindi Language.description: An upright ex-army man, Jai fights a solitary war against corruption and injustice. With a simple mantra to pay forward, he starts off by helping one person and forms an ever growing circle of people helping each other.

Hindi Language.name: Heropanti
Hindi Language.description: Two young people find love despite the violent landscape in which they live.

Hindi Language.name: Khamoshiyan
Hindi Language.description: An erotic love triangle revolving around a writer adrift in the icy slopes of Kashmir where he discovers a woman with a strange, silent past.

Hindi Language.name: Hate Story 2
Hindi Language.description: A woman takes revenge on a powerful corrupt politician who forcefully abused her and left her for dead.

Hindi Language.name: Hero
Hindi Language.description: A boy and a girl find themselves stuck in a whirlpool of such intense love that they would do anything, go to any extent and face all odds for the one they love.

Hindi Language.name: Phantom
Hindi Language.description: A disgraced Indian soldier carries out a series of assassinations in the hope of restoring his honour.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2
Hindi Language.description: After falling in love, three roommates experience changes in their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Alone
Hindi Language.description: A supernatural mystery about a young woman whose dead sister relentlessly haunts her.

Hindi Language.name: Humshakals
Hindi Language.description: A comedy centered around three people who each have a lookalike of a lookalike, all with the same name.

Hindi Language.name: Bhoothnath Returns
Hindi Language.description: A ghost returns back from his world to prove something. But on earth, he has something more to do for his country.

Hindi Language.name: The Lovers
Hindi Language.description: An epic, sweeping and riveting tale of an impossible love set across two time periods and continents.

Hindi Language.name: Suryaputra Karn
Hindi Language.description: Karna, son of Surya and Kunti and the doyen of archers, endures a challenging journey on his way to becoming one of the greatest warriors of the Mahabharata.

Hindi Language.name: Singh Is Bliing
Hindi Language.description: A lazy youth failing to take up any responsibility is sent to work with his father's friend in Goa where he meets a woman who has problems of her own.

Hindi Language.name: Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon
Hindi Language.description: A comedy or errors, wherein a married man attempts to juggle his three wives along with his current girlfriend.

Hindi Language.name: Yaariyan
Hindi Language.description: A college student must win an inter college competition to save his college from being demolished by property builders.

Hindi Language.name: Angry Indian Goddesses
Hindi Language.description: A photographer invites her closest friends to vacation at her family's home in Goa in celebration of her upcoming marriage.

Hindi Language.name: CityLights
Hindi Language.description: Deepak Singh is a farmer in Rajasthan. After a tragedy, he migrates to Mumbai with his wife and child to lead a better life. However, upon arriving, he soon discovers the challenges of life in a big city.

Hindi Language.name: Stories by Rabindranath Tagore
Hindi Language.description: The writings of Nobel Prize winner Rabindranath Tagore come to life in this collection of tales set in early-20th-century Bengal.

Hindi Language.name: BB Ki Vines
Hindi Language.description: BB Ki Vines is a Video series. Bhuvan Bam is the person who has started BB Ki Vines and all the characters are played by him.

Hindi Language.name: Tigers
Hindi Language.description: Ayan, a pharmaceutical salesman in Pakistan, takes on the multinational health care corporation he works for after he realizes they knowingly marketed a baby formula that's responsible for the death of hundreds of babies everyday.

Hindi Language.name: Action Jackson
Hindi Language.description: In order to escape crime and clutches of a ruthless mafia, a Bangkok based hit man seeks the help of his lookalike, a Mumbai based goon.

Hindi Language.name: Roar: Tigers of the Sundarbans
Hindi Language.description: After his photojournalist brother gets killed by a white tigress in the jungles of the Sundarbans, Pandit and his team of commandos enter the prohibited core area of the forest to avenge his death.

Hindi Language.name: Siya Ke Ram
Hindi Language.description: Traces the story of ramayan character Sita from a very different perspective. For the first time the story is televised in this detail.

Hindi Language.name: Any Body Can Dance 2
Hindi Language.description: Based on the true story of the Fictitious Dance group; their rise to fame, sudden downfall, and their heroic attempt to seek vindication by regaining their lost pride and glory.

Hindi Language.name: Creature
Hindi Language.description: A newly-opened forest lodge finds itself under attack from a recently awakened creature.

Hindi Language.name: Daawat-e-Ishq
Hindi Language.description: A story of Gullu, a Hyderabadi girl frustrated with dowry-seeking men and Taru (a charming Lucknawi cook), who crush old-fashioned world-view.

Hindi Language.name: Shaadi Ke Side Effects
Hindi Language.description: A complicated relationship develops between a man and woman after getting married and having a baby.

Hindi Language.name: Lakshmi
Hindi Language.description: 13-year-old Lakshmi is trafficked into prostitution. After enduring abuse and violence, she's rescued in a police raid. Despite threats and bribes, she testifies in court, leading to her traffickers' imprisonment in a landmark Indian case.

Hindi Language.name: Dance Plus
Hindi Language.description: Discover solo, couple and group performances starting a movement in revolutionary styles. Transforming dance culture, to find the next big dance trend.

Hindi Language.name: Mohalla Assi
Hindi Language.description: A Sanskrit priest decides to take matters in n his hand when the locals of holy town Banaras stars to lure foreign tourists with fake spiritual gurus.

Hindi Language.name: Badi Door Se Aaye Hain
Hindi Language.description: A family of aliens set off on an adventurous journey as they pose to be humans and come down to Earth in search of their son.

Hindi Language.name: Fugly
Hindi Language.description: Four friends fight against a corrupt police officer who extorts money from them for not framing them in a murder which the officer committed himself.

Hindi Language.name: Pizza
Hindi Language.description: A Pizza delivery boy's mundane life takes a horrifying turn when he is sent to make a delivery to the home of a family who have a dark secret. Will he be able to overcome the evil that lurks in the shadows and live to tell his tale?

Hindi Language.name: Zid
Hindi Language.description: A journalist, who is still in love with his ex-girlfriend, becomes the obsession of his landlord's daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Jazbaa
Hindi Language.description: Tensions arise when the daughter of nation's best lawyer is kidnapped. Now she'll have to save a rapist from death sentence, as ransom, within 4 days.

Hindi Language.name: Ungli
Hindi Language.description: A gang of friends decide to take justice into their own hands.

Hindi Language.name: Swaragini: Jodein Rishton Ke Sur
Hindi Language.description: Two half sisters are caught in a web of love,deceit and revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Patrol Dial 100
Hindi Language.description: Fictional representation of real life crime cases in India

Hindi Language.name: Akbar Birbal
Hindi Language.description: Emperor Akbar and his witty advisor Birbal solve problems through humor and wisdom in medieval India, blending historical folklore with comedy while imparting life lessons.

Hindi Language.name: Kaanchi
Hindi Language.description: The inner power of a woman who represents over one million suppressed youth against injustice in the country.

Hindi Language.name: Sumit Sambhal Lega
Hindi Language.description: Sumit, a reckless young man, runs away from responsibilities, and without understanding the seriousness of the situation, he ends up making a mockery of it.

Hindi Language.name: Baankey Ki Crazy Baraat
Hindi Language.description: It's a quirky situational comedy that tickles your funny bone, unexpectedly. The ensemble cast of actors that creates a laugh riot, that escalates in to a hangama ~ that will leave you chuckling, gurgling and laughing out aloud. So, leave your scowls, jowls and frown lines at home, and laugh like you've not done, in a long long time.

Hindi Language.name: Main Aur Charles
Hindi Language.description: After escaping from prison, a notorious serial killer and conman becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt led by an honest police officer determined to catch him.

Hindi Language.name: Jamai Raja
Hindi Language.description: Siddharth, a hotelier, takes up the responsibility of repairing the relationship between his independent wife, Roshni, and his enterprising mother-in-law, Durga Devi.

Hindi Language.name: Dharmakshetra
Hindi Language.description: After the Mahabharata war, Pandavas and Kauravas face Chitragupta's court to answer for their actions. Each episode features a character answering questions on behalf of others.

Hindi Language.name: Dolly Ki Doli
Hindi Language.description: Dolly is a con woman who marries unsuspecting men and on the wedding night runs away with their money. On the case is a police officer and two disgruntled grooms.

Hindi Language.name: Calendar Girls
Hindi Language.description: The story of five aspiring models who are selected to appear in a photoshoot for a prestigious calendar and what happens to them later.

Hindi Language.name: Loev
Hindi Language.description: A weekend trip between friends takes a sudden turn, making them each question what love is and what it means to them.

Hindi Language.name: Bewakoofiyaan
Hindi Language.description: Bewakoofiyaan is a slice-of life comedy when recession strikes and the lack of money tests love. Is living on love and fresh air really possible?

Hindi Language.name: Monsoon
Hindi Language.description: The movie revolves around the story of a 15 year old guy who falls in love with a 28 year old lady. The lady is now a widow as her husband who was a forest officer died while he was on duty. How the 15 year old boy falls for this lady and how he protects her from the society forms the rest of the story.

Hindi Language.name: Thapki Pyar Ki
Hindi Language.description: Take a look at the past episodes of 'Thapki Pyar Ki', the story of a woman who faces several problems with a positive perspective and moves to a city in order to find a job and live independently.

Hindi Language.name: Time Out
Hindi Language.description: Years of friendship, laughter and love shared between two brothers faces the music when a 14 year old boy is confronted with the complexities of a simple relationship.

Hindi Language.name: The Shaukeens
Hindi Language.description: Three friends in their 60s try to do everything that they couldn't do in their younger days - before death arrives.

Hindi Language.name: Bandbudh Aur Budbak
Hindi Language.description: Two dim-witted 10-year-old boys, Budhdeb and Badrinath, struggle academically but excel at pranks and trouble-making. Through luck or odd logic, they escape their messes in this school comedy series.

Hindi Language.name: Baked
Hindi Language.description: Three former college friends re-unite for a road trip to the hills and each of them has a secret agenda. From getting lost in rural India to being mistaken for drug smugglers and getting arrested nothing goes according to plan for the boys

Hindi Language.name: Ek Paheli Leela
Hindi Language.description: Two lovers, having been denied true love 300 years ago, are reincarnated in order to correct that wrong.

Hindi Language.name: Shamitabh
Hindi Language.description: An aspiring actor with the inability to speak, joins forces with a man who has a powerful voice. Together they take the film industry by storm, but will their egos get in the way?

Hindi Language.name: Ek Hasina Thi
Hindi Language.description: Durga is out to avenge the crimes committed by Shaurya, a playboy and the scion of the powerful Goenka family of Kolkata.

Hindi Language.name: Bhaag Johnny
Hindi Language.description: Blackmailed into murdering, a casanova is presented with the opportunity of living two lives. One in which he commits the crime and the other in which he refuses and goes on the run.

Hindi Language.name: Samrat & Co.
Hindi Language.description: A small town tycoon gets murdered. The daughter hires a private investigator to catch the real culprit.

Hindi Language.name: Guddu Ki Gun
Hindi Language.description: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

Hindi Language.name: Mrs. Scooter
Hindi Language.description: There is a woman who gets married, her husband buys a scooter on the same day, and later, he abandons both. The story is woven around the parallel lives of the scooter and the woman, who go through the same situation.

Hindi Language.name: Sonali Cable
Hindi Language.description: Sonali, a spunky self-made internet operator, proudly runs a small outfit along with her band of ghetto boys catering to a sprawling Mumbai suburb. Complications arise when Sonali's childhood sweetheart, Raghu returns from the United States and helps bring her small enterprise into the twenty first century. But not all forces of modernization are as kind and as loving as Raghu. SHINING INC, a huge corporation wants her out to complete their monopoly of Shining Broadband in the city. Sonali refuses... and it's war! This is a character driven, edgy survival drama of an ordinary girl, a sizzling love interest and her rag-tag family of internet cable technicians for whom Sonali Cable Centre is more than a livelihood... it's their home.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Ka Rang Safed
Hindi Language.description: Set amidst the color and custom of the ancient city of Banaras, Ishq Ka Rang Safed is the tale of the impossible love of Viplav for Dhaani. The carefree, spoilt grandson of Mahant Dashrath Tripathi, Viplav is slated to go abroad for his law studies and intends to never return to the religiosity, traditionalism and ritualism of Benares and his family. Life takes an abrupt turn as Viplav encounters Dhaani - a lady in white. An innocent prank played in retribution of a bruised ego draws Viplav into an unseen world and the realization of the harsh realities of life. A reality epitomized by Dhaani. A young widow leading a life of quiet dignity abiding by her Dharma in a society that condemns women to living death even in the 21st Century. Swathed in white and devout to her cause, Dhaani is a conformist yet no weak willow as evident by her determined stance and sense of pride held against Viplav from the time she saw him as a "rakshas" till his profession of love towards her.

Hindi Language.name: Sankatmochan Mahabali Hanuman
Hindi Language.description: The Show focuses on different and unknown stories of Lord Hanuman, apart from his well-known history as a Ram Bhakt. The a show also covers stories about role of Hanuman in the Mahabharatha.

Hindi Language.name: Hawaizaada
Hindi Language.description: The film which is based on the life on an Indian scientist Shivkar Bapuji Talpade, who is credited to have constructed India's first unmanned plane is the tale of the hardships that he went through on the journey to discover. Also the film is set in the pre-independence era of Bombay of 1895.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Warrior High
Hindi Language.description: MTV Warrior High is an Indian television show aimed at a young audience, which is broadcast on MTV India. The story revolves around a group of students at Warrior High, a boarding school in Dehradun, India.

Hindi Language.name: Gangaa
Hindi Language.description: Ganga, a child widow, undergoes many difficulties as she lives in a locality consisting of ultraconservative people. But, in an endearing yet courageous way, she questions obsolete traditions.

Hindi Language.name: Hawaa Hawaai
Hindi Language.description: Arjun dreams of skating. Can Arjun follow his dream and be a champion?

Hindi Language.name: All Is Well
Hindi Language.description: A musician finds himself on the run from a group of thugs with his friend and his estranged parents.
