With the heavy heart he goes to take a glance of the truck, "shockingly" he realizes that there is not even a single kaanda in the truck.On further exploring the truck kidnapper realizes that his shock isn't a shock any more its trouble now, when he puts his hand on asla barood. In his shell shocked situation he listens to the important radio announcement which is related to a terrorist who deals into taskari of arms and amination from last 10 years. Now the situation gets more terrible when the kidnapper predicts the near future that the terrorist will arrive like a hungry dog sniffing for his bone, the kidnapper hilariously plays smart and informs police about the actual nightmare of his life and the story goes on.

Hindi Language.name: Charlie Kay Chakkar Mein
Hindi Language.description: ACP Sanket Pujari and the rookie officer, Sameera sit across the television screen to decipher a rare case of multiple homicides caught on camera and this case is going to test their fundamental perception of truth.

Hindi Language.name: Friends: Conditions Apply
Hindi Language.description: Friends: Conditions Apply revolves around Shakti Rai who witnesses her parents' murder at a very young age. The only person left standing by her is Rajneil Purohit, her guardian. Shakti is suffering from an anxiety disorder for which she takes medications. She has a childhood friend named Murli whom she regards as her elder brother. Years later, Shakti finds her guardian chained in a prison cell. Shakti believes he is innocent and vows to get him released. Shakti and Murli devise a plan to get some high-profile rich kids kidnapped and then pressurize the government to have Rajneil released in exchange for the kids. Shakti plans to have her own friends involved in this. Shakti's plan eventually works but she finds herself in an unexpected turn of events.

Hindi Language.name: Mid Wicket Tales with Naseeruddin Shah
Hindi Language.description: Actor Naseeruddin Shah reminisces some of the most interesting moments from the world of cricket and interacts with former cricketers who share their experiences.

Hindi Language.name: Chal Guru Ho Jaa Shuru
Hindi Language.description: They are gurus and they are out to cheat everyone. The movie tells the story of out-of-work theatre artistes, who find another way to earn some quick bucks. They turn into gurus/babas/godmen to con innocent victims. How long can they put up this act?

Hindi Language.name: Four Pillars of Basement
Hindi Language.description: FBI comes at the end to do investigation. ..... Another big tycoon intervenes to secure his position

Hindi Language.name: Lal Bhi Udhaas Ho Sakta Hai
Hindi Language.description: An experimental documentary about a contemporary Indian painter, shown in his workshop.

Hindi Language.name: Three Atrangi Jai-Veeru-Gabbar
Hindi Language.description: Three Atrangi Jai-Veeru-Gabbar is a comedy drama film based on real life struggle in comedy genre plot.

Hindi Language.name: Under the Sky
Hindi Language.description: Does the boy shift in to his father's show,or does he succeed in convincing his father to pursue his foot mark ?

Hindi Language.name: Prithipal Singh
Hindi Language.description: It's the story of an Olympic champion; of a player who won three Olympic medals, gold (1964 Tokyo), silver (1960 Rome) and a bronze (1968 Mexico). It's the story of a man who crossed the border in 1947, who was witness to the partition carnage. It's a story about his struggles of making a new home, and with his skills becoming a legend in Indian sport. It's also the story of a man who took on authority for what he felt was right. It's the story of a man who was gunned down in front of the Vice-Chancellor's office with more than 45 eye-witnesses. None of them testified. It's also the story of a man we have forgotten. It's time the story was told. It's time his story was HEARD.

Hindi Language.name: Na Bhuto Na Bhavishyati
Hindi Language.description: A small-town boy in search of a job gets inspired by the glamorous lifestyle of the so-called spiritual gurus and comes up with a plan.

Hindi Language.name: Mighty Khiladi Raju
Hindi Language.description: Aryanagar is hosting an inter-school sports competition. Raju and gang prepare as their rival school has a new super champion. Raju decides to participate sincerely, without the use of any powers. He realises it is indeed difficult to be a normal boy and loses a race to Sid. However, seeing that Raju is not in Mighty mode, Karaati decides to attack him. Karaati replaces Sid with a robot who tries various means to harm Raju. Charlie escapes from Robot Sid's hideout and warns Commissioner Khanna. With his new superhero outfit hidden under his regular clothes, Raju appears as Mighty and fights the Robot. He wins the swimming contest, freeing the real Sid. Karaati is defeated yet again.

Hindi Language.name: Chamki Ki Duniya
Hindi Language.description: Chamki ki Duniya Chamki's World is an animated series based on popular animated TV series Galli Galli Sim Sim, the Indian Sesame Street co-production. It was premiered in May 2015 and airs weekdays on POGO. The TV series focuses on Chamki, a 6 years old adventurous and inquisitive schoolgirl. Chamki ki Duniya follows Chamki, who is quite adventurous and curious schoolgirl anxious to know more about the world. The series addresses topics such as early literacy, creative thinking and reasoning, family and community life, healthy habits, appreciating cultural plurality and many more via compelling and humorous stories, music and art.

Hindi Language.name: Jaane Kya Hoga Rama Re
Hindi Language.description: Jaane Kya Hoga Rama Re is a drama series. Follow the story of Nandini and Rambhateri, who struggle to restore Mo more.

Hindi Language.name: Folk Stars: Maati Ke Laal
Hindi Language.description: Folk Stars: Maati Ke Laal is the first of its kind tv series on indian television. for the first time singers of different dialect and languages came to compete each other on one realty show.

Hindi Language.name: Angoori Bani Angaara
Hindi Language.description: Angoori Bani Angara is a female oriented Hindi Feature film based on Tribal backdrop, The film features basic social problems faced by women in India and her Struggle for Justice.

Hindi Language.name: Mujahid-e-Azadi Ashfaqulla Khan
Hindi Language.description: TV Series On Freedom Fighter Ashfaqulla Khan (22 October 1900 - 19 December 1927)

Hindi Language.name: Wounds of Change
Hindi Language.description: The documentary gives a glimpse into the complex sociopolitical situation of India as the nation takes on the path of development. It discusses the uneven nature of development in India and its political ramifications.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Mother's Day
Hindi Language.description: In the serene hilly town of Pragpur, Vicky and Kaku, siblings in a close-knit family, lead a humble life. Their father Pradeep dreams of obtaining a license as a tourist guide to improve their financial situation while their mother Karuna supplements the family's income by offering tuition. The family, including their grandfather Dadu, a retired teacher who offers free homeopathic treatment, values education and community. When Vicky's classmate Sachin introduces the siblings to the concept of Mother's Day, they embark on a heartfelt journey to celebrate their mother. This newfound adventure leads them to explore the evolving culture from the city, testing their innocence and determination. Will Vicky and Kaku's love and ingenuity help them create the perfect Mother's Day celebration midst life's challenges?

Hindi Language.name: Virgin House
Hindi Language.description: It is about five friends staying together in a house, when suddenly one day the house owner comes and asks them to vacate on immediate basis. Since nobody has another place to live, the owner puts a condition that only virgins can stay in the house.

Hindi Language.name: Beyond the 3rd kind
Hindi Language.description: A story of a ladyboy , a boy gets converted to a ladyboy and the trauma he faces after becoming a ladyboy . Transgenders , transexuals being looked as sex slaves by some perverts.

Hindi Language.name: Anjaan Parindey
Hindi Language.description: Five teenage street kids struggle to make ends meet in a big city. Intelligent young man, Munna, works as a guide; Pakkiya juggles school and odd jobs like shoe-polishing; Tillu dreams of Bollywood; Harish survives abuse to earn the little he can by begging, and Ganga hopes one day she'll be free. With little to live for, stuck fending for themselves, will our five Anjaan Parindey fall prey to drugs and crime? Or does tomorrow hold a better future?

Hindi Language.name: House of Knowledge
Hindi Language.description: This movie is based on those wonderful discussions between Basavanna and other eminent personalities during that reign. Basavanna who was a 12th century Indian philosopher, statesman, Kannada poet in Shiva-focussed bhakti movement and a social reformer. He spread social awareness through his poetry, popularly known as Vachanaas.

Hindi Language.name: Bhaage Re Mann
Hindi Language.description: Padmini has run away from conforming to her duties all her life. What happens when she comes home to her brother's house and tragedy strikes? Something for which she feels guilty? Will be rise up and grow to take responsibility? Set against a serious background, what works in her favor is her non conforming attitude of taking life by the horns. - meeting crisis head-on, without ever letting anyone on to her feelings. Will she lose her heart to the man she always loved? Or will she run away again.

Hindi Language.name: In Their Shoes
Hindi Language.description: The filmmaker tries to find out why was he always pushed away by his father from joining the family business of shoe material trading. In his quest he unravels the odyssey of the footwear industry in Agra, India and the journey of some of the men behind it.

Hindi Language.name: The Spirit of Mumbai
Hindi Language.description: Ex-Con, Arjun Dutta, just wants his life back, but when Bollywood actress, Rani Deol, is kidnapped from the limo he is driving, he must go all out against impossible odds to save her and restore his name.

Hindi Language.name: Pappu Ki Pugdandi
Hindi Language.description: When young Pappu meets a genie,he thinks all his problems will be taken care of but the genie had had other plans for him which make Pappu realize that there are no shortcuts to happiness and he identifies his own strength

Hindi Language.name: Dreadlocks Story
Hindi Language.description: The hidden spiritual links between Jamaican Rastas and Indian Sadhus.

Hindi Language.name: Supercops V/S Supervillains - Koko Robo Special
Saavi: A Bonded Bride
Hindi Language.description: The Gaddis & some labourer families follows the Batta-Satta system of marriage in which the bride's brother has to marry the groom's sister or vice versa. Batta-Satta is a Barter marriages system for sons to find brides. But every family does not have a girl of marriageable age to exchange; some marry off minors to keep their end of the bargain. Generally in such arrangements two families are involved, that is, a sister of a person is married to another person in lieu of his sister. Sometimes 3 families are involved in this relation.

Hindi Language.name: Guy in the blue
Hindi Language.description: A lonely girl finds the muse of her life and while exploring the road of love, she discovers the biggest truth of her as a loner.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Mera Tedha Medha
Hindi Language.description: Tera Mera Tedha Medha (TMTM) is a quirky-topsy-turvy romantic comedy influenced by Planetary Disposition. It is a love story of two young struggling painters Rajan and Kamini, intertwined with the affect of two powerful planets Shani and Mangal. Hilarious events erupt when jilted lover, young and vivacious Swati enters Rajan's life. What would Shani-Mangal do next?

Hindi Language.name: Kuch Alag Sa
Hindi Language.description: Kuch Alag Sa is a film starring Samiksha Bhatt. It is the story of a female who physically and mentally tortures her husband for her greed for money.

Hindi Language.name: Gurudakshina
Hindi Language.description: An orphaned boy Dev is adopted by Guruji and brought to his dance academy in Kolkata, owing to his dancing skills. Impressed by his talent, guruji takes him under his wings. However, Dev's one-sided love for Guruji's daughter Sanjukta changes their lives forever. Sanjukta finds herself seduced by Chhau dancer Gambhira instead, who seems like a man of dubious intent. Turns out he is a Naxalite, on a secret mission. Dev suspects Gambhira's motives and warns Sanjukta but she doesn't pay heed. Dev is heartbroken and guruji devastated, when Sanjukta secretly marries Gambhira. Post marriage, Gambhira shows his true colours, thus ruining the life of his wife and Guruji. Meanwhile, an accident takes Dev to Himachal. Will he come back to avenge the torture Gamhira inflicts on his guruji? Watch the full movie, Ek Adbhut Dakshina - Guru Dakshina online, only on Eros Now.

Hindi Language.name: Laakhon Hain Yahan Dilwaley
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a young man Arsh (Vije Bhatia) whose passion is singing and whose love are the songs from the era of 60s. To fulfill his dreams, he comes to Mumbai. While singing on streets of Mumbai, he meets a beautiful girl Swara (Krutika Gaekwad). Fate with the help of an organizer (Arun Bakshi) entangles them into a beautiful musical journey filled with the songs of 60s. But as they say Karma is a bitch. Swara's past ruins the budding love of Arsh and their career too. Vithal Dada (Aditya Pancholi) enters into their life and creates havoc. Arsh desperately tries to get back Swara with the support of Hasmukh and Mrs. Narang (Anju Mahendru). Come ! Join us in this musical and see how Arsh gets back both of his love; how Swara fights back her past, see Aditya Pancholi's never seen avatar and enjoy the music of 60s.

Hindi Language.name: Kartooz
Hindi Language.description: 'Kartooz' is the story of wandering musician, Rocky (Mel Datta), who gets caught in the crossfire of a fight to death between the sinister drug lord Habul Ghosh (Faruque Azam), and Kabir (Pasha), a rising young gangster whose fiance was killed by Habul Ghosh. The two are hunting each other down and unwittingly Rocky gets caught in this deadly game. Good is pitched against evil but the difference between the two is blurred.Inspired by Roberto Rodriguez's 1992 film 'El Mariachi', 1980s Bollywood and Chinese Kung-Fu movies, 'Kartooz' mixes comedy, songs, lush green Himalayan scenery, lots of gunshots and fistfights with a tightly woven plot that unwaveringly moves forward at every frame. Do not miss this thoroughly entertaining movie.

Hindi Language.name: An Ordinary Election
Hindi Language.description: A new politics of hope and change flickers in the world's largest democracy, as a rank outsider makes an audacious bid for political power. A tiny new political party prepares to take on the mighty political establishment in the capital city: the Aam Aadmi Party, the party of the Common Man. Like its counterparts from Greece to Spain, this anti-establishment party promises to vanquish political corruption and bring power back to ordinary people. An Ordinary Election tells the extra-ordinary story of the Aam Aadmi Party's debut election campaign in the constituency of RK Puram, Delhi. From the campaign war room to the streets, from the narrow lanes of urban slums to the manicured parks of upper-class neighbourhoods, the crew follows the charismatic candidate Shazia Ilmi and the ordinary men and women of the AAP fighting to change the terms of Indian democracy in an election campaign where victory seems impossible.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Aae Na..
Hindi Language.description: A smuggler sets a trap to acquire a rare and valuable dagger.

Hindi Language.name: Luv... Phir Kabhi
Hindi Language.description: Luv - Phir Kabhi talks about a young couple who can go to any lengths to spend a lavish life and end up sabotaging their own relationship in the process.

Hindi Language.name: Obsessed
Hindi Language.description: A back-end CBI officer is sent to an unknown city to prepare reports on a murder case of a young woman. His world starts falling apart when he starts mixing his personal life with the case discoveries he makes.

Hindi Language.name: Picture Perfect
Hindi Language.description: Vaani, a small town girl, proves that with sheer determination and will power, the world can be at her feet. Watch her life change as she trains with her style mentor.

Hindi Language.name: Aakhri Pal
Hindi Language.description: Social media creates havoc in the lives of 3 high school teenagers. Years later, one of them dies mysteriously at a birthday party.

Hindi Language.name: Krup Literature Festival
Hindi Language.description: Krup Literature Festival is the longest literature festival in the world. It is a 12-day-long celebration of seven essential languages, literature, music, films, art, and heritage. It also pays tribute to completing 10 years of the Valentine's Parv. The festival is organized by the Give Vacha Foundation and Krup Music in collaboration with Krup Productions, Krup Publishing, Krup Films, and Esy ID. This festival has evolved into an international hub of creativity, bringing together ideas, innovations, and revolutions in the field of literature. Kutchi, Gujarati, Hindi, Sanskrit, English, Awadhi, and Music (the universal language) are the core languages that will be honored during the festival, which additionally includes extravagant celebrations in various cities of Kutch. Krup Music Festival will also be a part of this biggest literature festival. Dr. Krupesh Thacker and Dr. Pooja Thacker, the festival's passionate directors, have creatively designed the whole concept and crafted the pathways for emerging poets, authors, artists, and their creations to approach global identification. This longest-running literature festival will be executed by the Global Literature and Cultural Club.

Hindi Language.name: Chota Birbal
Hindi Language.description: The two week- long series has been conceptualized as an extension to the Historical Comedy 'HAR MUSHKIL KA HAL - AKBAR BIRBAL'.

Hindi Language.name: Mr. Lieutenant Radio
Hindi Language.description: Lt. Sudhir, a junior officer of the Indian Army is wounded and forced to retreat with nothing but a Wireless Radio set, after his Platoon is heavily defeated is a skirmish with the Chinese Army during the 1962 Indo-China War. Unable to proceed further and stuck behind enemy lines, he tries to operate the radio, only to end up conversing with a Chinese girl, who is a radio operator for the P.L.A. Relief Force. Without understanding each other, their conversation escalates through the night. As Sudhir succumbs to his wounds, he manages to complete the last couplet of his unfinished poem, which eventually transcends the barriers of language, shedding light on the true essence of religion and humanity.

Hindi Language.name: Shades of Life
Hindi Language.description: A counterfeit bill links four tales of love, loss and regret, following different characters facing life's difficulties. Their stories ultimately converge in a tragic car crash.

Hindi Language.name: Biscoot TV
Hindi Language.description: Biscoot TV your daily dose of latest #bollywood news and gossips, bollywood box office, movie trailer and many more. We cater to every aspect of your entertainment palette. Be it catchy visuals, celeb interviews, latest film trailers, bollywood box office collection, feature stories predicting and analyzing industry trends.

Hindi Language.name: A Frustrated Software Engineer
Hindi Language.description: A Frustrated Software Engineer is a series which brings to light, the lives of millions of software engineers in India, through the character of Parth and his manager Dassu.

Hindi Language.name: Long Dark Road
Hindi Language.description: The fate of 4 kids will change forever, in a way they would have never imagined. A chance meeting of strangers trying to forget the past, little do they know, it would come back and haunt them. Their lives spiral down a series of unexpected events.

Hindi Language.name: Bulbule
Hindi Language.description: A group of people find it difficult to stand each other than deciding the fate of a young boy.

Hindi Language.name: Aaj Ki Raat Hai Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: The Show celebrates uncommon people's kindness towards society and showcase the journeys of people, who went against all odds to help the society improve and worked as an inspiration for others to change their outlook.

Hindi Language.name: Mission Sapne
Hindi Language.description: Prominent celebrities use their popularity as a pedestal to do odd jobs. The money they earn is used for noble purposes.

Hindi Language.name: Sanrachna
Hindi Language.description: Explore ancient India's feats of architecture and engineering, from mighty fortresses to ingenious methods of harnessing the power of sound and water.

Hindi Language.name: Out of a Jam
Hindi Language.description: Poor village women of rural India, work towards shaping their common future by making jams, becoming self sufficient, getting their children educated, and defying their patriarchal society

Hindi Language.name: Mumbiker Nikhil Vlog
Hindi Language.description: Nikhil Sharma Started filming his bike rides then became youtube vlogger.

Hindi Language.name: Sabki Bajegi Band
Hindi Language.description: The film is based on true events - when the controversial RJ Anirudh recorded candid conversations between his celebrity/Bollywood pals at a farmhouse party: their intimate sexual desires, kinks, rivalries, affairs and bitching about Bollywood. The sensational uncensored footage has become India's First Reality Film.

Hindi Language.name: Bhaage re mann
Hindi Language.description: It's the story of a woman Padmini(Karuna Pandey) who had kept herself from getting tied down to societal norms and stereotypes for 39 years. She has to now rise to the occasion and don a role she has kept away from.

Hindi Language.name: Pocket Gangsters
Hindi Language.description: how real you can fake yourself?

Hindi Language.name: Hinsa Par Vijay
Hindi Language.description: Hinsa par Vijay is a film that depicts a journalist finding out that the holy book Gita is being misinterpreted by criminals supporting their acts of revenge as Dharm Yudh. And how a Brahmakumari Didi busts their myths and transforms them.

Hindi Language.name: Teri Dilli Meri Dili
Hindi Language.description: A woman rises above post-rape trauma, encourages women to face life's challenges with determination, affirming that womanhood is not a curse but something to celebrate.

Hindi Language.name: Kings of The Wind & Electric Queens
Hindi Language.description: The Sonepur fair in India, with its whirlwinds of dust rising from the ground, is the opportunity for a gigantic carnival where each is going to give itself in representation for the pleasure of day spectators, pilgrims in ecstasy, in search of shivers and signs of good fortune. As in a western, men with gleaming black mustaches lead nervous horses, adorned for the demonstration, others drive wild motorcycles, while some organize outrageous parades. Each has its rituals, prayers, its methods to accumulate and master the energy of the party, both mechanical and organic, magic and electric.

Hindi Language.name: Black Sheep
Hindi Language.description: Black Sheep follows a group of Transgender women in Mumbai through the filmmaker's eye, Reshel, through empowering events; break the barriers of popular myth and prejudice. The cinematic journey will move beyond the gritty slums of Mumbai to celebrate the real-life joys and multi-faceted personalities of this unique community of trans genders in India. From empathetic glimpses into their everyday lives, the narrative encapsulates a series of emotions these women go through and the ever-lasting bond made between Reshel and the girls. The film will shine a light on these inspiring Hijras who have demonstrated the courage to go up against society's strictures to fulfill their true destiny.

Hindi Language.name: A Far Afternoon: a Painted Saga by Krishen Khanna
Hindi Language.description: In a career spanning over fifty years, Krishen Khanna has established himself as one of the most prolific and influential painters in the Indian art landscape.' A Far Afternoon' is a filmmaker's attempt to memorialize the artistic process involved in the creation of the eponymous art work, and trace some of the influences of the artist.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Dil Ramta Jogi
Hindi Language.description: When you step into the world of Kalidas, you enter the life of a dreamer. He is a taxi driver, and like the many drivers in the city who cruise the streets ferrying passengers to and fro, Kalidas lives his mundane life by enjoying the air of an alternate universe of his dreams, where love, wealth and acceptance are within reach, and joy is just around the corner. But what will he do when reality grows more grim and new problems that will rock his world strike?

Hindi Language.name: Chunar ABCD 2 Cover by Vivek Verma
Ek tha Bhujang
Hindi Language.description: 'Ek tha Bhujang' is a story of a 10 years old boy wanting to play the role of Lord Krishna... the hindu GOD, in the school drama. There's only one thing that stops him from getting this role. He is a muslim boy. The teacher who is directing the drama believes that a muslim boy should not play the role of Hindu GOD. Since the drama is about Lord Krishna's battle with a large snake, Kabir invents a lie in form of Bhujang which means a large snake in hindi. How that lie gets bigger than him and how he faces his fears to get the role is what "Ek tha Bhujang" is all about.

Hindi Language.name: Akela the Alone
Hindi Language.description: A loner, whose parents died years ago, lives all alone doing petty jobs for survival. He meets Nadeem and Dawood and his whole life takes a turn to insanity.

Hindi Language.name: HRX Heroes
Hindi Language.description: HRX Heroes is a TV show about real life heroes of India.

Hindi Language.name: A Daughter's Dream
Hindi Language.description: Story of a 7 year old girl from a very poor family who wants to pursue her dream but is opposed by her family and society as she is a girl. Finally she becomes a role model for every person in her village when she becomes a real life hero .

Hindi Language.name: Vah Chaudhary
Hindi Language.description: The serial VAH CHOUDHARY Gaon Kushal Desh Kushal is based on a story that refers to agrarian India. We have plotted the story with a backdrop of Haryana, showcasing actual life and culture of Haryana. Each episode will take the viewer in the direction of alleviating the problems of rural masses.

Hindi Language.name: India Poochega Sabse Shaana Kaun
Hindi Language.description: The show features two couples who must answer questions asked by common people, and the team that performs better wins the prize.

Hindi Language.name: Satrangi
Hindi Language.description: The show provides a platform to the young folk musicians from 13 states in India to showcase their lineage, their traditions and their vast musical knowledge. A journey of untold stories of artists who have nurtured various forms of music and have learned to play traditional musical instruments that have added to India's musical heritage.

Hindi Language.name: Roll Sound Camera Action: RSCA
Hindi Language.description: Roll Sound Camera Action (RSCA) is part fact, part fiction, based on the lives of movie aspirants, popularly known as 'strugglers' in Bollywood. Since movie actors are known to recount their days of struggle in becoming a star from impoverished days, lives of strugglers are very exciting for the audiences and media alike. But then the lives of these strugglers is not as exciting for they themselves. The grass always seems green, on the other side.

Hindi Language.name: Paisa Ho Paisa
Hindi Language.description: Ashwin, an engineering college student meets a beautiful girl Bhoomika in the campus. After a few playful encounters, they fall in love. Ashwin hails from a lower middle class family and all the time he thinks of making big money in a very short time. When Bhoomika stumbles upon something big, she consults Ashwin and his friends and together they strike it rich in a very big way using an invisible chemical (A chemical when it is sprayed on anything or anyone the object or the person becomes invisible). However they are forced to be on the run after being chased by the cops. Now starts the wild goose chase with ruthless & buffoonery gangsters, comic cops, bungling CBI officer and the hero and his friends playing all kinds of pranks.

Hindi Language.name: Kuchh Baatein Kucch Yaadein with Annu Kapoor
The Man Who Dwarfed the Mountains
Hindi Language.description: Seldom do a man's deeds loom so large that they dwarf the very mountains from where they emanate. One such person is Chandi Prasad Bhatt, who has strong claims to being the first modern Indian environmentalist, and arguably also its greatest. Bhatt was one of the pioneers of the Chipko movement, not just a fight for protecting forests and environment, but a struggle for protecting and renewing livelihoods. The Film seeks to decipher the life, the motivation and work of a man who silently changed the paradigm of environment activism in India and has been described by Ramchandra Guha as one of the finest Indians alive today.

Hindi Language.name: Jhand Hogi Sabki
Hindi Language.description: A bunch of the most instinctive pranksters you have met are on the prowl to target some of the biggest Bollywood stars. Aided by the friends and family of the Stars themselves this show catches the best of them off guard.

Hindi Language.name: Free Bird
Hindi Language.description: "Baanaadi" means a bird flying in open Sky. Each child is like a bird and hence he/she should stay and learn where his heart belong . Hence this name was kept for the movie. Our well-wishers endorsed the name too.

Hindi Language.name: Vignan Shashvat Sukh Ka - A film on Dada Bhagwan (Hindi)
Palayan Ab Aur Nahi
Hindi Language.description: The film is the story of poor people who leave their village in search of livelihood and are treated badly in the cities. The honor of the sisters and daughters of their house is robbed. Even after this they do not get employment.

Hindi Language.name: Aastha - Atoot Vishwas ki Kahani
Hindi Language.description: This is a TV series which depicts the story of indestructible faith and devotion. In Bhagvad Geeta, Lord Shri Krishna had assured the human kind that whenever the evil forces take over the earth, he will incarnate himself in a human form and take birth to destroy the evil forces and establish the rule of law. He will always protect the good from the evil. In today's era of Kalyug, the evil forces have become so rampant that the Lord manifests himself and descends upon Earth to help the pure and pious people from the evil forces. It is rightly said, there is delay in God's house but not darkness or denial. It is this absolute faith in the Almighty that keeps the world going. The show premise is social with embedded with instances of divine interventions. Yashodha is a firm believer and follower of Santoshi Mata. She believes that Mata has bestowed blessings on her in form of her little daughter, Aastha. Aastha's life is destined by spiritual and divine powers to fight the evil and spread eternal bliss in the nowhere going era of Kalyug. The evil force in this story is symbolized by our main antagonist, Rajaji who is the self proclaimed God of Devipur and believes that he should be worshiped by everyone. He manipulates the innocent villagers of Devipur in several ways for his own benefits. He has seized their lands and is involved in heinous activities such as child labor. He forced the children of Devipur to work in his factory in inhuman conditions. It is the journey of Yashodha and Aastha, who with their faith and devotion are determined to stand-up against the evil atrocities and the evil doings of Rajaji and restore peace in Devipur.

Hindi Language.name: North Bank
Hindi Language.description: A sociological thriller depicting the miserable plight of the rural people, ignored by governments. The subject is universal and is inspired by real happenings and events in a village located in the northeastern India.

Hindi Language.name: Naseman
Hindi Language.description: A boy from India. A girl from Pakistan. 26/11 Mumbai Attack. A love story.

Hindi Language.name: Amul The Taste Of India
Hindi Language.description: Chef's Sanjeev Kapoor and Ranveer Brar share some mouthwatering recipes in this summer special programme

Hindi Language.name: Iraade Maum Ke
Hindi Language.description: This movie is a story of the difficulty in fulfillment of ambition. Achieving difficult dreams requires continued persistence and perseverance. The ambitious will fail if they give up too soon. The film revolves around two characters. One is Shobhana, who is ambitious. She wants to start a restaurant. The second is Parth, who wants to enjoy life. He wants to make the most of the moments that pass him by. In Parth's company, Shobhana finds happiness. They fall in love and decide to marry. This film is about their life after marriage. What happens to Shobhana's dreams? Does she achieve them?

Hindi Language.name: Epic Ke Dus
Hindi Language.description: Epic Ke Dus is a half-hour collated list of the top ten people, places, or events of a chosen topic, examples of which include rivalries, thinkers, and warriors. Each story has been carefully selected to be part of the list.

Hindi Language.name: Tuhi Mera Pehla Pyar
Hindi Language.description: The Story Is About 3 Friends Rahul, Seema and Salman. Where Rahul's First Love Is Money And Seemas First Love Is Rahul And Salman First Love Is USA. Vicky's First love is Power, Who Is Genius But Criminal At Mind. Studied at The Same Campus, After Graduating They All Start Exploring Their Careers Using Their Talent, Vicky Get A Job With Underworld Don. Rahul Exploits The Rich And Gets Trapped Into A Dons Daughter Rajni 's Affair, Who Goes After To Marry Him At A Gun Point. Seema, An Homely Girl Who Loves Rahul. Salman Works Towards Fulfilling His Dream To Migrate USA And Seeks Financial Help From Rahul. Hyderabadi Comedy By Detectives.*Beautiful Music And A Clean Family Film. A must watch movie...

Hindi Language.name: Ummeede: Everyone Has One Special Thing
Anandvan
Hindi Language.description: Embark on a captivating cinematic journey, "Anandvan," where filmmaker and narrator Samar K Mukherjee becomes your guide through the enchanting realm of Kashi, also known as Varanasi. Immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of this ancient city as you explore the mystical ghats of the Ganga, visit sacred temples, stroll through Sarnath, delve into the vibrant life of BHU, wander bustling markets, and discover the art and culture that define Varanasi. Witness an intimate darshan of the revered Baba Vishwanath of Varanasi. "Anandvan" is a truly unique documentary, offering a profound experience of this timeless city.

Hindi Language.name: Hind Desh Ke Nivasi- We, the people of India
The Superstars of Koti
Hindi Language.description: "...for as long as the moon will shine ,Koti's name will live in time.."

Hindi Language.name: Anubhuti: Taking the Legacy Forward
Hindi Language.description: The 45-Minute film showcases the stories, unique traditions and unifying principles of the Indian Army through a feel good fiction drama highlighting the invaluable contribution, sacrifices and responsibility of army officer's wives as unsung soldiers of Indian Army. The film serves as a source of learning for the wives of newly married army officers about the culture of the army and the responsibility of an army officer's wife.

Hindi Language.name: Behind the Glass Wall
Hindi Language.description: The film is an attempt to understand the world of the autistic - to become aware of their inability to socialise and communicate with the world followed by their own frustration and the frustration of the people that live with them. The film showcases the situation in Maharashtra which is very much a representation of the lack of awareness in India.

Hindi Language.name: Lights camera kissey
Hindi Language.description: Shekhar suman unfolds some of the most interesting stories of hindi cinema in lights camera kissey.

Hindi Language.name: Chintu Aur Pintu
Hindi Language.description: Chintu and Pintu is a silent comedy show which captures the eventful life of our hero. The hero is lively young man who lives in a small town in India. Chintu is emotionally attached to few things in his life that is his coat, bicycle, his wife pinky and son called pintu. Pinky is the most beautiful girl in the town. Pintu is the replica of chintu, as chintu is very emotional and cannot see anybody in trouble.

Hindi Language.name: Phulbasan Bai
Hindi Language.description: Life and achievements of Padma Shri awardee social worker who rose from poverty and illiteracy to become a crusader of women empowerment in Chhattisgadh, India.

Hindi Language.name: Hard to Change the World
Hindi Language.description: TOSHI CHAUHAAN with the hope and dream to help the weaker section of the society, whom he think the soul of India. He struggled allot to open an NGO with a dream to help the poor people with his business tactics and will make a prosperous tactics and will make a prosperous and secured life for them. His good deeds caught the eye of his competitors NGO and finally for the sake of profile, they destroyed Toshi's empire.

Hindi Language.name: Kaise maare iss zombie ko?
Hindi Language.description: Kaise Maare Iss Zombie Ko deals with the corpse of Rana Mongia, a notorious criminal, who turns into a Zombie after an experiment goes wrong. To prevent a zombie infection from spreading, he should be captured and terminated. A small team of young men go on this adventurous and hilarious Zombie hunt through jungles and the city of Hyderabad racing against time and battling unexpected obstacles.

Hindi Language.name: Savdhaan India - Ek Kissa Paanch Hisse
Boom Boom Wale
Hindi Language.description: The crazy adventures on the road trip of 2 normal kids, who go from a small village in Goa through a jungle to score some prime quality Weed from the dealer. Armed with false bravado and eyes clouded with smoky dreams they meet an array of exotic characters on their epic journey. Some who are helpful in their quest, but mostly not.. The boys bump into a philosophical Sadhu, Tricky Locals, Rogue Drug Dealers, Bad Ass Cops. a bunch of lost girls, Forest officials and finally the two faced Dealer and her sexy daughter, who turns out be a firecracker on legs who throws our hero into an emotional roller coaster.

Hindi Language.name: Taous Chaman Ki Maina
Hindi Language.description: Taous Chaman Ki Maina A beautiful story belonging of lucknawi culture and showcasing the culture, brotherhood and human relations of the period of wajidali shah.

Hindi Language.name: Rising of Sarpanch
Hindi Language.description: A film about sarpanch raaj in villages very good film. Director akash chaturvedi showed his amazing talent.

Hindi Language.name: Friendship Parv - God is in True Friend
Khwabon Ka Safar with Mahesh Bhatt
Hindi Language.description: The show is based on the history of prominent Indian film studios; the journey of iconic personalities behind these studios and how they turned their dreams into reality.

Hindi Language.name: Dhamal India Dance
Hindi Language.description: Dhamal India Dance is a Reality Tv-series presented by PFC (Pramod Films Creation) Films. Director/Producer/Writer/DOP of Dhamal India Dance is Pramod Gupta. Episodic Director of this series is Asim Jafri.Professional and amateur Indian dancers showcase their talent in a series of rounds and are assessed by a panel of judges. The audience decides who stays and who is eliminated. First season was premiered on 28 June 2014. Every season of the series is judged by 3 Indian choreographer.

Hindi Language.name: Case of Bisarpani
Hindi Language.description: Three youngsters went for camping at 'Bisarpani' area near Mainpat , Chhattisgarh , and they never returned from that trip. A week later their cellphones , bag packs & a camcorder was found by a local cattleman in the forest. This video is a rough edit of the footage from the found camcorder.

Hindi Language.name: Wow weekends
Hindi Language.description: Vj aparshakti brings some exciting updates on bollywood and latest tunes in wow weekends. So don't miss 6 in 60, junta express, star with apar and weekend moves with vj aparshakti.

Hindi Language.name: Nidhivan: God and the Darkness
Hindi Language.description: Set in the backdrop of Mumbai and a road trip from Mumbai to Ndihivan,this is an edge-of-the-seat an entertaining Para-Psyche thriller about four young Media Professionals who are tragically trap in chain of mysterious incidents on their way to explore NIdhivan Little do they realize that one fine day a Handsome money offer to document NIDHIVAN would have the power to change their lives forever Roll the camera and find out.

Hindi Language.name: Utho Aur Laro
Hindi Language.description: The Movie is shown In Past present future events happening at the same time and is shot in Mockumentary style.

Hindi Language.name: Mujhe Jeene Do
Hindi Language.description: This is a true story based on killing of an unborn child who becomes the food of street dogs. The incomplete story of a complete love

Hindi Language.name: The Bankrupts
Hindi Language.description: When two filmmakers meet after fifteen years, and one of them narrates a script to the other, they find the past catches up with them...

Hindi Language.name: First Cry
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a remarkable hospital in the mining township of Dalli-Rajhara Chattisgarh known as Shahid (Martyrs) Hospital. The hospital was paid for and built by the voluntary labour of daily-wage contract miners and successfully provides modern health care to workers, adivasis and the poor. The Film reveals the history of its making, key turning points of the hospital and the experiences of the doctors and worker- paramedics who manage this oasis of hope.

Hindi Language.name: Naad Bhed
Hindi Language.description: A National level Classical music Reality Show that aims at promoting and popularising Indian Classical music and rewarding the best young practitioners of Classical music. To make it more attractive, the show has taken on board some of great maestros of Indian Classical music as Judges.

Hindi Language.name: Confused @16
Hindi Language.description: Homosexuality and exploring one's own identity.

Hindi Language.name: Gopala
Hindi Language.description: A heart felt story of a village simpleton, whose only aim in life is to save and shelter cows, rather than being slaughtered once they stop giving milk. He believes that not only the cow which gives us milk but also the urine and cow dung which is used for medicine purpose and organic farming. After being thrown away from his home for his thoughts and actions, how he convinces everybody from villages, far and near, including his father about his noble goal forms the crux of the film.

Hindi Language.name: Sangam: Where Two Rivers Meet
Hindi Language.description: A Canadian filmmaker documents the act of putting his mother's ashes into India's holy Ganges River, resulting in a subsequent quest to understand the Hindu concept of an 'Ideal Wife'.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Hai Chota Sa Choti Si Asha
Hindi Language.description: The show starts with four women from different backgrounds who have emotional and inspiring stories. They are invited to play through different rounds and collect virtual money. At the end of the show, Sony Pal converts the winning sum into cash, which can help empower the women going forward.

Hindi Language.name: Jhamela
Hindi Language.description: This is a movie about the difference between rural folk musician who it trying to make his dream successful in modern urban world

Hindi Language.name: Dreams Hopes and Bollywood
Hindi Language.description: There is a famous saying 'All that glitters is not gold' which goes appropriate for Bollywood. DREAMS HOPES and BOLLYWOOD is an untold story of boys and girls who come to the dreamland better known as Bollywood. Inspired by some true incidents,this story takes a realistic take on different phases of their life during their struggle in Bollywood. This film gives you a roller coaster ride of their agony,happiness,achievements,anger,failures,loss,exploitation while they try to achieve their dreams in this cut throat competitive field. Hope is the only fuel which keeps them driving but there are unexpected surprises waiting for them during their labyrinth journey in Bollywood.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Ki Kalam Se
Hindi Language.description: A docudrama on the life of Mahakavi Gopaldas Neeraj, presented by the Films Division.

Hindi Language.name: Hi Jack
Hindi Language.description: Ajay Chachu is visiting and Raju is happy. But a fighter plane with escaped terrorists lands on the air strip of Aryanagar and plan to hijack a plane. Raju appears as Mighty and is shocked to see Ajay Chachu unconscious. The co-pilot is a terrorist who tells Might that he will let the plane nosedive into the sea if they do not get the military secrets. As the terrorists attack with full force, Mighty retaliates to defeat them but the plane is already about to hit the sea. Gopi tells Raju that it was not just turbulence but also an attack by terrorists in the sky and they all were saved by Mighty Raju and Ajay Chachu.

Hindi Language.name: Maal Kiska Kamal Kiska
Hindi Language.description: Maal Kiska Kamal Kiska is a satirical comedy movie on the lives of married men and their respective wives.

Hindi Language.name: In the perpetual presence of death
Hindustan ka BIG Star
Hindi Language.description: Talented artists from North, East, South and West India particularly from Bihar, Jharkhand participate in a series of rounds to showcase their talents in various fields, including singing, dancing, stand-up comedy, mimicry and art.

Hindi Language.name: Kitchen Politics
Hindi Language.description: Yuki and Paru are best friends with some spicy differences. Watch them cook in each other's kitchen.

Hindi Language.name: Adibhumi: Home Land
Hindi Language.description: This is the Story of Millions of Indians those who are suffering from the aftermath of Forced Displacement for Industrial Development. This is the story of the poor people of the Eastern Indian States like Bihar,Chhatishgarh,Jhharkhand and Bihar where there is a absolute stock of Coal mines, major deposit of Iron ores and Bauxites 95% Manganese of the country is unfortunately available in this poorest States of India.The biggest paradox revolving around them is, though Globalization and Industrialization was meant to make them rich, the outcome is, it made the common people poor. This experiment is the one line of this Story. The Story is based on few real issues.

Hindi Language.name: Dangal
Hindi Language.description: Mahavir Singh Phogat, a former wrestler, decides to fulfill his dream of winning a gold medal for his country by training his daughters for the Commonwealth Games despite the existing social stigmas.

Hindi Language.name: Sultan
Hindi Language.description: A small-town wrestler chases Olympic glory, falls for a fierce female champion, builds a life around her dreams as much as his own, then watches it collapse; years later, he fights his way back from ruin.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Gangaajal
Hindi Language.description: A newly appointed Senior Inspector finds herself against very powerful goons and having people from her own department against her.

Hindi Language.name: Secret Superstar
Hindi Language.description: A talented teenage singer/songwriter living amid domestic abuse becomes a YouTube sensation after a video in which she hides her identity goes viral.

Hindi Language.name: Pink
Hindi Language.description: When three young women are implicated in a crime, a retired lawyer steps forward to help them clear their names.

Hindi Language.name: TVF Tripling
Hindi Language.description: Divorced, jobless, hopeless. Three siblings plan a road trip together. Chandan, Chanchal & Chitvan. Together they start a hilarious journey, to find themselves and their relations..

Hindi Language.name: Jab Harry Met Sejal
Hindi Language.description: A depressed middle-aged tour guide who lives in his own bubble gets another chance to experience and face reality through a chirpy girl.

Hindi Language.name: Qarib Qarib Single
Hindi Language.description: Yogi and Jaya, who have polar opposite personalities and sensibilities, meet via an online-dating app. This encounter turns into so much more when the two travel to Rishikesh.

Hindi Language.name: Psycho Raman
Hindi Language.description: Ramanna, a maniac murderer, finds a soulmate in Raghavan, a policeman, who inspects his murder cases. He tries to make Raghavan realize how they both are similar.

Hindi Language.name: Tiger Zinda Hai
Hindi Language.description: RAW Agent Tiger joins forces with Zoya in order to rescue a group of nurses who are held hostage by a terrorist organisation.

Hindi Language.name: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
Hindi Language.description: A passionate singer falls deeply in love with Alizeh, who only sees him as a friend. When she marries another man, he finds solace with Saba, but his heart remains torn between both women.

Hindi Language.name: You Are My Sunday
Hindi Language.description: When their Sunday soccer game on the beach is canceled, five friends set out to find another place to play in the noisy, crowded city of Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Kaira is a budding cinematographer in search of a perfect life. Her encounter with Jug, an unconventional thinker, helps her gain a new perspective on life. She discovers that happiness is all about finding comfort in life's imperfections.

Hindi Language.name: Trapped
Hindi Language.description: A man struggles to survive after he unintentionally locks himself up in a high rise devoid of food, water and electricity.

Hindi Language.name: Sanam Teri Kasam
Hindi Language.description: After being disowned by her family, an awkward librarian relies on the help of her brooding neighbour.

Hindi Language.name: Bhouri
Hindi Language.description: A tragic love story of Bhouri, a 23-year old who is married to a 55-year old, the film highlights the exploitation of women in male dominated society.

Hindi Language.name: Raees
Hindi Language.description: A bootlegger sets out to improve his community as a promising leader but falls in a political trap.

Hindi Language.name: Fan
Hindi Language.description: A man named Gaurav is obsessed with Bollywood superstar Aryan Khanna, who he bears a striking resemblance to. However, when his hero rejects him, he decides to seek revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Ittefaq
Hindi Language.description: A detective seeks out the truth between two different stories of a crime scene.

Hindi Language.name: Hindi Medium
Hindi Language.description: A couple from Chandni Chowk aspire to give their daughter the best education and thus be a part of and accepted by the elite of Delhi.

Hindi Language.name: Udta Punjab
Hindi Language.description: A story that revolves around drug abuse in the affluent north Indian State of Punjab and how the youth there have succumbed to it en-masse resulting in a socio-economic decline.

Hindi Language.name: The Bride of Badrinath
Hindi Language.description: Badrinath is looking for a typical bride; Vaidehi is looking for an independent life. Together they must break with tradition and redefine their role.

Hindi Language.name: The Ghazi Attack
Hindi Language.description: A Pakistani submarine, Ghazi plans to secretly attack Vizag port. For doing so, it has to get past Indian submarine S21.

Hindi Language.name: Inside Edge
Hindi Language.description: Inside Edge is the story of the Mumbai Mavericks, a T20 cricket franchise playing in the Powerplay League. Set in a landscape of conflicting interests, where selfishness is almost a virtue, where sex, money, and power are mere means to an end, Inside Edge is a story that pulls no punches, minces no words, and takes no prisoners. Come witness the game behind the game.

Hindi Language.name: Airlift
Hindi Language.description: When Iraq invades Kuwait in August 1990, a callous Indian businessman becomes the spokesperson for more than 170,000 stranded countrymen.

Hindi Language.name: Kapoor & Sons
Hindi Language.description: The story about two brothers who visit their dysfunctional family for their grandfather's birthday party.

Hindi Language.name: Kaabil
Hindi Language.description: A blind dubbing artist seeks revenge against a corrupt politician and his brother, after his wife is raped and killed.

Hindi Language.name: Toilet: A Love Story
Hindi Language.description: A woman threatens to leave her husband unless he installs a toilet in their home. To win back her love and respect, he heads out on a journey to fight against the backward society.

Hindi Language.name: Shivaay
Hindi Language.description: A skilled mountaineer races against time to rescue his mute daughter from the clutches of human traffickers in Bulgaria.

Hindi Language.name: The Brawler
Hindi Language.description: A boxer struggles to make his mark in the boxing world.

Hindi Language.name: Befikre
Hindi Language.description: It is a carefree love story of Dharam and Shyra, who find love in an engaging series of experiences. Doused in the spirit of Paris, it celebrates a sensual and free-spirited love.

Hindi Language.name: Housefull 3
Hindi Language.description: A father doesn't want his three daughters to get married. Now, it's up to three men to try to and convince the father that they're a good fit for his daughters.

Hindi Language.name: Half Girlfriend
Hindi Language.description: Madhav meets a girl named Riya and falls in love. After stuggling to convince her to be his girlfriend, she half heartedly agrees to be his "Half Girlfriend"

Hindi Language.name: Ek Shringaar-Swabhiman
Hindi Language.description: A new age saga that addresses the most significant challenge faced by every Indian woman who aspires to have a thriving career and a successful marriage - Can I really have it all?

Hindi Language.name: Phillauri
Hindi Language.description: A man must marry a tree to ward off threats to his love-life, but the tree turns out to have more spirit than the man bargained for.

Hindi Language.name: Mom
Hindi Language.description: After her daughter is sexually assaulted at a party, a furious mother sets out to destroy the lives of the four perpetrators who walked away free.

Hindi Language.name: M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story
Hindi Language.description: The untold story of Mahendra Singh Dhoni's journey from ticket collector to trophy collector - the world-cup-winning captain of the Indian Cricket Team.

Hindi Language.name: Seeking True Love
Hindi Language.description: Set in the small-town of Bareilly, Bitti is a free-spirited young girl who lives life on her own terms and refuses to be pressured into getting married. Her life takes a shift when she meets Chirag Dubey and Pritam Vidrohi.

Hindi Language.name: Te3n
Hindi Language.description: A grandfather, a priest and a police officer investigate the case of a kidnapped child.

Hindi Language.name: The Aam Aadmi Family
Hindi Language.description: This show revolves around a middle-class Sharma family. There's a gossip-loving grandmother, a hardworking father, a sanskaari mom, and two grown up kids who are dealing with their middle-classness in the best way possible.

Hindi Language.name: Rustom
Hindi Language.description: A naval officer returns home to find out about his wife's affair. Soon, he surrenders after murdering the lover but as the case unfolds, it starts to reveal his hidden intention.

Hindi Language.name: Madaari
Hindi Language.description: When Nirmal loses his family in a disaster caused by government corruption, he embarks on a journey seeking accountability and revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Mohenjo Daro
Hindi Language.description: In 2016 BC, a kind farmer leads an uprising in the city of Mohenjo Daro.

Hindi Language.name: Golmaal Again
Hindi Language.description: The gang encounters with some spiritual bodies and finds out the truth about the Jamnadas Orphanage where they were brought up.

Hindi Language.name: Fukrey Returns
Hindi Language.description: Just out of jail, a don is ready to get back at the four friends who conned her.

Hindi Language.name: Jagga Jasoos
Hindi Language.description: Join Jagga, a gifted teenage detective, who along with a female companion, is on a quest to find his missing father.

Hindi Language.name: Raabta
Hindi Language.description: An inseparable couple Saira and Shiva find themselves in a complicated situation when a stranger claims to be her reincarnated lover from their previous lifetime, hellbent on destroying their relationship and winning her back.

Hindi Language.name: Chef
Hindi Language.description: Chef Roshan Kalra sets out to find the true source of happiness and reignite his passion for food while being more present in his son's life.

Hindi Language.description: Paranoia and mayhem at once strikes Maya when she moves into her new apartment. The film entails the developments in her life as she starts growing more delusional.

Hindi Language.name: Dobaara: See Your Evil
Hindi Language.description: Siblings Natasha and Kabir Merchant investigate an allegedly haunted mirror in their parents' home in this official adaption of 'Oculus'.

Hindi Language.name: Pehredaar Piya Ki
Hindi Language.description: The story of an unusual marriage between a 9 year old boy, Ratan Harshvardhan Singh and an 18-year old girl, Diya.

Hindi Language.name: Dev
Hindi Language.description: Showcasing stories inspired from real life events, this fictionalized investigative thriller plunges viewers into the world of Dev Burman - a detective who is an enigma in himself.

Hindi Language.name: Chidiya
Hindi Language.description: Two boys in a Mumbai chawl chase dreams despite tight spaces and tough odds. Their mother's complex love shapes their path as they face reality's challenges with only curiosity and courage to guide them.

Hindi Language.name: Laado 2: Veerpur Ki Mardani
Hindi Language.description: Ammaji is back. Living a retired life, she is now a changed person and her only aim in life is to protect her 2 granddaughters, Anushka and Jahnvi. But what happens when one wrong move by her granddaughters takes Ammaji back to where it all began - Veerpur.

Hindi Language.name: The Legend of Michael Mishra
Hindi Language.description: After a life of crime, a notorious kidnapper tries to change his ways and turn over a new leaf to win the heart of the woman he loves.

Hindi Language.name: Junooniyat
Hindi Language.description: Captain Jahan Bakshi rescues a Punjabi girl, Suhani. This starts a friendship that evolves into a passionate love affair.

Hindi Language.name: Badman
Hindi Language.description: A mad, comic caper where the legendary Bad Man of Bollywood, Gulshan Grover relaunches himself in the film industry, but this time as a hero! With celebrity cameos, hilarious delusional situations with the 'young hero' Gulshan Grover, Bad Man explores the dark yet funny side of Bollywood. A first in the history of Indian cinema, Bad Man is a mockumentary of epic proportions. Premiered on Voot, Viacom18's Digital Platform.

Hindi Language.name: Indu Sarkar
Hindi Language.description: Indu Sarkar is set during the emergency period between 1975 to 1977 declared by Prime Minister Indra Gandhi.

Hindi Language.name: Aa Gaya Hero
Hindi Language.description: ACP Ravindra Varma, a fearless and sincere police officer, is called to nab terrorist Milind Shinde, who has political backing.

Hindi Language.name: Paramavatar Shri Krishna
Hindi Language.description: Reminisce the naughtiness and enchanting ways of Krishna.

Hindi Language.name: Veeram
Hindi Language.description: Veeram is based on the ballads of North Malabar and narrates the tale of the brave and ambitious Kalarippayattu warrior, Chandu, whose story resembles that of William Shakespeare's Macbeth.

Hindi Language.name: Warrior Savitri
Hindi Language.description: A modern day adaptation of the legendary fable of Savitri, Satyavaan and Yamaraj from Mahabharata, one of the major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. The modern day Savitri is adept in martial arts and will do anything to save her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Bin Laden: Dead or Alive
Hindi Language.description: A Bollywood director is hired by an American talent agent to make a film on Osama bin Laden. The plan to use an Osama doppelganger in order to prove his death boomerangs when a Taliban arms dealer hijacks their idea to prove he's alive.

Hindi Language.name: Simran
Hindi Language.description: A socially-criticized, financially-cornered girl becomes an outlaw to dodge the situation.

Hindi Language.name: Rock on 2
Hindi Language.description: The band, Magik reunites with some new members.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Maya
Hindi Language.description: Anna and Ira prank a local woman by writing her letters from a secret admirer. The prank takes a more serious turn when the local women goes missing,

Hindi Language.name: Bioscopewala
Hindi Language.description: A woman meets her dead father's old friend, who was the operator of a Bioscope show that she loved in her childhood. Connecting India and Afghanistan, a story of love and cinema unfolds.

Hindi Language.name: Romil and Jugal
Hindi Language.description: What happens when two men fall madly in love? Watch this fun and fresh take on Romeo and Juliet with a never-seen-before twist.

Hindi Language.name: CLASS of 2017
Hindi Language.description: Peer pressure, anxiety, drugs, sex, and raging hormones. Life is tough when you are 16, can these eight teens attain adulthood unharmed?

Hindi Language.name: Buddha in a Traffic Jam
Hindi Language.description: Vikram, a carefree management student, finds himself entangled in web of conspiracy, lies and deceit when he launches a successful social media campaign to highlight the plight of the poor in India.

Hindi Language.name: Savitri Devi College & Hospital
Hindi Language.description: A young medical student who aspires to become a successful doctor joins the prestigious Savitri Devi College and Hospital in pursuit of her dream.

Hindi Language.name: Rishta Likhenge Hum Naya
Hindi Language.description: Rishta likhenge hum naya follows the life of Diya who sacrifices the 12 years of her life by fulfilling a dying man's last wish on his death bed by becoming a caretaker of his son Ratan.

Hindi Language.name: Aadat Se Majboor
Hindi Language.description: Set in the city of dreams Mumbai, 'Aadat Se Majboor' is a fun filled caper of what happens when five young people with totally different personalities come to work under one space.

Hindi Language.name: Brahmarakshas: Jaag Utha Shaitaan
Hindi Language.description: Set in Kamalpura, a remote village in India where the newly wed brides live under constant fear of becoming a prey to unknown monster. Since this unknown beast or demon attacks the newly wed brides, the brides of Kamalpura have started wearing white vermilion, white bangles and anklets without the tiny bells attached to it. Is it a human or a demon or a myth, the reality is unknown.

Hindi Language.name: Noor
Hindi Language.description: The jumbled up, crazy and happening life of journalist Noor takes a dramatic turn when she comes across a news breaking cover story.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Haal, Mr. Paanchal?
Hindi Language.description: Kunti Devi is looking for a perfect bride for her son. When God finally grants her wish, it's five daughters-in-law she has to deal with.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Durga
Hindi Language.description: Yashpal is illiterate and works as a peon in a school. Despite no social encouragement for female education, Yashpal aspires to educate his daughter, Durga, But Durga's calling lies elsewhere.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Boley Oberoi
Hindi Language.description: Dil Boley Oberoi is a spin off of the 2016 show Ishqbaaaz (2016). The show will mainly focus on the love stories of the brothers Omkara and Rudra.

Hindi Language.name: Jaana Na Dil Se Door
Hindi Language.description: In spite of having contrasting personalities, Vividha and Atharv end up falling in love with each other. However, the differences in their social background cause trouble in their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Dance Champions
Hindi Language.description: This dance show places the contestants into few teams which are mentored by a professional dancer. Dance Champions features champion dancers who won or were runners-up in different shows. New challengers will also join them and can beat them by displaying their further level dance moves.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Dad
Hindi Language.description: Dear Dad is a bittersweet coming of age story; involving a father-son duo 14 year old Shivam, and his 45 year old dad Nitin Swaminathan. The father-son duo embarks on an impromptu road trip from their home, in Delhi, to Mussorie (Uttarakhand), where Shivam attends boarding school. Unexpected confessions, weird strangers, accidental meetings, a drunken escapade and singing in the rain all these add up to a complicated and sweet tale releasing on 13th May.

Hindi Language.name: Global Baba
Hindi Language.description: A conman finds refuge in becoming a baba and carries out his various criminal activities under the guise. A policeman, a journalist and politicians get entangled in his Web of deceit.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Saasu Maa
Hindi Language.description: A story of Pari and her pursuit to find a mother in her mother-in-law.

Hindi Language.name: Ballavpur Ki Roopkatha
Hindi Language.description: Bhupati, the King of a sleepy town called Ballavpur, owns a huge but dilapidated royal palace and 7 acres of land. But Bhupati, crippled by a huge debt, dreams of moving to Calcutta after selling his palace- once he gets rid of the ghost that haunts it.

Hindi Language.name: Sajan Re Phir Jhoot Mat Bolo
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around one of the richest families of south Mumbai, The Chopras.

Hindi Language.name: Ichhapyaari Naagin
Hindi Language.description: The life of Iccha, a shape-shifting snake, dramatically changes and becomes complicated when she falls in love with Babbal Pratap, a human.

Hindi Language.name: Sameer
Hindi Language.description: A young engineering student is forced to help authorities find his roommate after the latter is suspected of masterminding a series of bombings.

Hindi Language.name: Maatr
Hindi Language.description: Vidya, who's left shattered after her daughter Tia's murder, seeks vengeance by fighting the broken justice and criminal system.

Hindi Language.name: Days of Tafree
Hindi Language.description: The movie revolves around the lives of eight friends and their journey of growing up while they face the highs and lows of their relationships, love and romance, the end of their college days and the beginning of a new life.

Hindi Language.name: Partners
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Manav Anang Desai, a happy go lucky, bumbling Police Officer, and Inspector Aditya by-the-book Police Officer, as they are forced into forming an unlikely partnership.

Hindi Language.name: Fuddu
Hindi Language.description: Unable to consumate his marriage, Mohan becomes a social pariah in Mumbai's cramped living conditions, where privacy is a luxury not everyone can afford.

Hindi Language.name: Chalk N Duster
Hindi Language.description: CHALK N DUSTER is an emotional journey of two teachers Vidya ( Shabana Azmi) & Jyoti ( Juhi Chawla) , serving at a Mumbai - based High School. Their passion and love for teaching, bonds them in a special relationship with their students. Their gratification is good grades, moral values they strive to impart to students.However, in an evil turn of events, a wicked lady, Kamini Gupta ( Divya Dutta) gets appointed as the School Principal, who earlier worked in the capacity of a Supervisor. She is extremely cunning by nature and monopolizes on every opportunity she can find her hands on. In a bid to make profits for the school, she decides to fire experienced teachers to replace them with fresher teachers. The saved funds of which she can boastfully present to the school trustees, at the cost of quality education. Vidya suffers a sudden heart attack due to her dismissal from school. The school management threatens the staff to cut ties with Vidya. At such a time, Jyoti stands up for her friend and colleague, Vidya. Together they fight to earn their respect and credibility as teachers and unite against prejudices set by the management.

Hindi Language.name: Krish Trish and Baltiboy: Face Your Fears
Hindi Language.description: In three tales about fear, a baby elephant gets captured by a circus, two boys enter a haunted house and a parrot faces his fear of flying.

Hindi Language.name: Grade
Hindi Language.description: Grade is first ever film made in India to address Films classification Subject. Grade is a story of girl Sapna and her struggle to get work and act in films. Film gives message- Films should be classified on age, not on Grade. Arts/Entertainment should not be divided into Grade.

Hindi Language.name: Gattu Battu
Hindi Language.description: Two friends own a security agency in Vishrampur. While one thinks he's the brains, his patient friend is the real hero, saving them from comical misadventures. Their silly mishaps and brilliant cover-ups form the show's heart.

Hindi Language.name: Firangi
Hindi Language.description: When there are disputes in life, love overcomes all challenges and truth prevails. Set in the colonial era, Firangi is the story of a mutiny staged by the villagers against the Britishers.

Hindi Language.name: Pardes Mein Hai Mera Dil
Hindi Language.description: Pardes Mein Hai Mera Dil tells the story of Raghav and Naina, two individuals with a golden heart, who are fated to meet and fall in love in a foreign land, but destined to face challenges before their union.

Hindi Language.name: Tanhaiyan
Hindi Language.description: Set against a wedding backdrop, London-returned Haider Ali Khan meets Meera Kapoor, a fashion designer and is instantly drawn to her but unknown to them life has other plans. The web show promises passion, romance and heartbreak.

Hindi Language.name: Daddy's Daughter
Hindi Language.description: In this movie a school going girl falls prey to a boy who's only intention was using her to satisfy his ulterior motives. The protagonist has no one to talk to and the girl keeps falling prey to his sweet ways.

Hindi Language.name: Krishnadasi
Hindi Language.description: Aradhya falls in love with Aryan but is unable to keep herself away from the mysterious history of her family. Her mother Tulsi has not told her that they are descendants of devadasis.

Hindi Language.name: Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh Piyaji
Hindi Language.description: After her parents' death, Kanak stays with her grandmother, Bhabho. Although Bhabho hates her, Kanak secretly wishes to win her love one day.

Hindi Language.name: Rebellious Flower
Hindi Language.description: The film on the life of guru Osho Rajneesh and his spiritual journey to enlightenment.

Hindi Language.name: Dehleez
Hindi Language.description: Set in the political and legal world of Delhi; this is the love story of Adarsh (Harshad Arora) and Swadheenta (Tridha Choudhury) whose goals are same, but paths are different

Hindi Language.name: Land of the Gods
Hindi Language.description: After a long exile, Rahul returns to his village in the Himalayas. It causes commotion amongst the villagers, who have never forgiven him for his sins in the past.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Duje Ke Vaaste
Hindi Language.description: A love story of two childhood best friends, Shravan and Sumo, who are unable to confess their love for one another.

Hindi Language.name: Banjo
Hindi Language.description: A banjo player seeks fame, success and respect.

Hindi Language.name: Piyaa Albela
Hindi Language.description: Naren, a spiritually inclined boy, spends his time admiring nature and doing humanitarian work. His friendship with Pooja, a pretty college student, changes his life in the most unexpected way.

Hindi Language.name: Ram Ratan
Hindi Language.description: A notorious playboy continues his womanizing ways after marrying the beautiful Ratan. When she discovers his infidelity, she orchestrates an elaborate plan to teach him a lesson about loyalty and love.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Girls on Top
Hindi Language.description: MTV Girls on Top showcase about the issues, women face in the country. The three girls in the show will try to deal with job issues, love issues and also domestic issues.

Hindi Language.name: Karrle Tu Bhi Mohabbat
Hindi Language.description: An alcoholic reluctant to recover, a head strong counsellor who won't quit, and a life changing trip to the hills.

Hindi Language.name: Super Dancer
Hindi Language.description: Talented children in the age groups of four and thirteen compete against each other to win the title and entertain everyone through their performances.

Hindi Language.name: Hanuman Da Damdaar
Hindi Language.description: A sheltered boy, disappointed by his warrior father's disapproval, prays to become the bravest child alive. His wish granted, he embarks on jungle adventures that transform him from a timid youngster into the mighty Hanuman.

Hindi Language.name: Saansein: The Last Breath
Hindi Language.description: Shirin, a singer mysteriously disappears. Abhay looks for Shirin and tries to solve this mysterious incident.

Hindi Language.name: Raag Desh
Hindi Language.description: A period film based on the historic 1945 Indian National Army Red Fort Trials.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Tune Kya Kia Season9
Hindi Language.description: This drama is generally based on different love story around India that goes through 9 seasons have been aired yet.

Hindi Language.name: ISIS: Enemies of Humanity
Hindi Language.description: "A must watch film to know about the life of terrorists,their ideology and a solution which challenges this violent ideology".

Hindi Language.name: Yaro Ka Tashan
Hindi Language.description: Professor Govardhan Aggarwal is a genius scientist who creates Y A R O, a humanoid. He programs him to act like a 22-year-old and also gives him an artificial heart to enable him to feel emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Game Over
Hindi Language.description: GAME OVER - Story of a Con Girl - Bold and Beautiful, Smart and Intelligent; but that's not enough to play the Game of Life - Game of Gamble.

Hindi Language.name: School Teacher
Hindi Language.description: A beautiful teacher is interested in a poor, young man named Shyam who irons clothes for a living. She wants to provide him with a good education, but they are attracted to each other. Her self-absorbed husband becomes jealous.

Hindi Language.name: Mr. Kabaadi
Hindi Language.description: Mr. Kabaadi is a romantic comedy that revolves around caste struggle. It is based on the life of Mr.Kallu Kabaadiwala a.k.a KK who used to be a Kabaadiwala. When he becomes rich, he starts his own family business of Public Toilets.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Sambhal Jaa Zara
Hindi Language.description: Ahana, a young girl navigating her life in urban India, gets caught in a web of relationships when she meets Anant, a middle-aged man.

Hindi Language.name: Baal Krishna
Hindi Language.description: The series explores lesser known and Widely popular stories about Lord Krishna, who is set to kill Kans, a cruel king.

Hindi Language.name: Muzaffarnagar 2013
Hindi Language.description: Range shooter Dev Malik, a resident of Muzzafarnagar gets into trouble with Jodha Singh, a land mafia who tortures villagers.

Hindi Language.name: Super Bheem
Hindi Language.description: Chhota Bheem, along with his friends, sets out on numerous adventures battling various demons and protecting the locals living in the town of Dholakpur.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Intezaar
Hindi Language.description: A woman sets out to uncover how her lover went missing.

Hindi Language.name: Haasil
Hindi Language.description: Haasil focuses on the lives of two brothers; Kabir Raichand and Ranveer Raichand and how their lives evolve when they both fall in love with Aanchal Srivastav, who comes from a world which is very different from their reality.

Hindi Language.name: Tom, Dick and Harry 2
Hindi Language.description: Three struggling friends hit upon new means to live a happy life, by imposing as COPS. v Wearing the uniform makes them an overnight neighborhood sensation. v Life changes when these Fake Heroes get tangled with Mafia, Goons and Real Cops. THREE SPECIAL FRIENDS DEAF DUMB & BLIND

Hindi Language.name: Prem Ya Paheli: Chandrakanta
Hindi Language.description: The twisted love tale of Prince Virendra and Princess Chandrakanta, who are reborn to fight the evil forces of Maricha.

Hindi Language.name: Ghulaam
Hindi Language.description: Veer Pratap rules over the deadly village Berahampur with brute force with the help of his trusted lieutenant and loyal slave - Rangeela.

Hindi Language.name: Sher-E-Punjab: Maharaja Ranjit Singh
Hindi Language.description: Biography of a Sikh Emperor who united all punjab and who came to rule most of North India.

Hindi Language.name: Maid in India
Hindi Language.description: This show follows Priyanka - a hilariously smart maid who is always a step ahead of her employer. She is witty, she is innocent, she is straight-forward and she is a flirtatious.

Hindi Language.name: Patel Ki Punjabi Shaadi
Hindi Language.description: Comedy movie is about a Punjabi and Gujarati family. and their cultural clash. Gujarati is played by Paresh Rawal and Punjabi Played by Rishi Kapoor.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Laut Ke Aaya Hai
Hindi Language.description: Newlyweds Gitanjali and Abhimanyu's happiness is short-lived. Abhimanyu's death takes Gitanjali on a mysterious journey.

Hindi Language.name: A Scandall
Hindi Language.description: A film school graduate is interested in making a movie about his girlfriend's uncle, who claims that he can see his long-dead daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Rudra Ke Rakshak
Hindi Language.description: Rudra Ke Rakshak is a Hindi adventure fantasy television series starring Yash Sehgal, Mohammad Saud and Mahi Milan. The story revolves around three kids blessed with superpowers, who fight evil forces and protect the good and weak in the mythical world of Surajpur.

Hindi Language.name: Saam Daam Dand Bhed
Hindi Language.description: Vijay, a youngster, is forced to mend his carefree ways and take care of his family. He becomes a political leader and is seen as an inspiration for the youth.

Hindi Language.name: GST - Galti Sirf Tumhari
Hindi Language.description: All goes well for a group of friends and their respective romantic partners when they fall in love. However, things start taking a dark turn when love gives way to deceit and revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Sargoshiyan
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film is weaved around Kashmir and Kashmiri people's simplicity, pride and Kashmiriyat.
