However, when he finally succeeds in his mission to find the fish, and is in the final decisive moment, he himself is surprised by the what he encounters as his greatest desire.

Hindi Language.name: Murari the Mad Gentleman
Hindi Language.description: The film hits hard on the superstitions present in the society through the comical situations in the life of a mental patient, based on things going on in Bihar rural areas. India's rural states like Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and some rural states beliefs blindly without any research on superstitions are passed down from generation to generation. These faiths have sprung with an objective to protect from evil spirit, but in this story a character in village accepted mad by villagers and not allow visiting his regions and in fact no communication with him . And the mad gentleman will be coming out with pleasant gentleman for those who put crown of mad on his head. The villager tried every method to get rid of the problem which Murari is facing and even villagers are facing because of murari as he has an image and behavior which is destroying the mental level of the whole village. After every attempt villagers are tiered and finally they tried a superstitious way to get rid of Murari, But in actual murari had his own hidden story which will be revealed later during pre-climax. The movie as following the culture of Madhubani, Phulpras and Bihar.The story also belongs to an American girl who came to India and coincidentally met with the mad gentleman as she got a different culture and a free thinking she in spite of going away fall in love with him and she will become the narrator of the story.

Hindi Language.name: Rifle Ganj
Hindi Language.description: A young talented Engineer and Civil Services topper, Chandar turns into a Naxal commander when the abuse of power and politics result in his sister's kidnapping and death of his much respected grandfather.

Hindi Language.name: The Drama Company
Hindi Language.description: An eclectic mix of the finest comedians in a theatrical plot portraying different characters each week.

Hindi Language.name: Do Sau Karod Ki Bottle
Hindi Language.description: "Do Sau Karod Ki Botal" is a tv serial based on Ek Karod Ki Botal" ,a novel by Krishan Chander. The story revolves around Indu, a girl from a Mumbai slum One day, accompanied by her lover, she finds a will in a bottle floating in the sea, declaring her the heir to a wealthy merchant. After this she enters the world of wealth, Due to which she faces the dilemma of being separated from her lover Ranjit(Vikrant Rai), being cut off from her roots and being stuck between both social strata.

Hindi Language.name: Threads of Fate
Hindi Language.description: A young woman living a dry, barren life with her old husband in a small town of Rajasthan begins to bloom on arrival of her stepson, who is almost her age. The film takes a rare peek of undercurrent human chemistry when the subtle strings of situation play its role and how the characters behave in the complexity of their family/social relation and their inner tussle.

Hindi Language.name: Dr. Madhumati on Duty
Hindi Language.description: Dr Madhumati, is a strict doctor, who cures patients in stereotypical doctor way when Dr Mohan, a die hard romantic, is hired, their personalities clashes as He tries to cure patients with laughter, fun and emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Love Ke Funday
Hindi Language.description: Love Ke Funday is a romantic comedy that deals with youngsters and their relationships. It deals with their commitment issues and fundays.

Hindi Language.name: A Ballad of Maladies
Hindi Language.description: Rhythm and blues of resistance in Kashmir negotiating the questions of survival and expressions through art and music.

Hindi Language.name: Rishton Ka Chakravyuh
Hindi Language.description: Set amidst the royal backdrop, the show focuses on a rich industrial family residing at the majestic Lal Mahal, which is home to many conspiracies. It depicts the story of Satrupa, an authoritative woman and her daughter Anami.

Hindi Language.name: Woh
Hindi Language.description: A heartbroken girl (Costina) gets involved with a mentally unstable man who is accused of murder.

Hindi Language.name: Elixir of Immortality
Hindi Language.description: The legend of immortality is embodied in the painting of the artist as it comes to life in the character of the dancer-thanks to the guidance of the wandering sage.

Hindi Language.name: Detective Didi
Hindi Language.description: Detective Didi is a crime thriller drama starring Manish Gopalalni and Sonia Balani in the lead. The story revolves around a street-smart ace private detective Bunty Sharma and special agent Bhim Singh Bhullar. Together they take on serial killers, crime lords, gangsters and all, both employing desperate measures in desperate situations. What follows is a chase akin to Tom and Jerry to solving the case first, and the bond between Bunty and Bhim who can't stand each other only to realize they cannot survive without each other.

Hindi Language.name: Phir bhi tumko chahungi
Hindi Language.description: This is a Romentic Hindi Song. Beautifully acted by Rahmat Ali and Rima Yadav.

Hindi Language.name: Khataara
Hindi Language.description: Satyaveer works in a NGO in remote area. He goes to pickup a girl from the stand by a khatara van. who's coming from the city to come to work with him. They have a lot of trouble on the way due to bad carriage.

Hindi Language.name: Angels of Rock
Hindi Language.description: Four fearless and fabulous rockstars. Ten awe-inspiring stories. One epic road trip. Join Shalmali, Jasmine, Anusha and Akasa as they rev up for a musical adventure like never before. Watch the Angels of Rock inspire and get inspired by women from all across the nation, and join them as they salute womanhood through their amazing original compositions.

Hindi Language.name: Bittu Bak Bak
Hindi Language.description: Watch Krushna and Bharti's hilarious acts in Bittu Bak Bak online on Sony LIV.

Hindi Language.name: Tilli
Hindi Language.description: A young boy's desperate fight to save his debt-ridden father.

Hindi Language.name: Chinese Bhasad
Hindi Language.description: This show is about Indian boy with a Chinese girl who he wants to marry and the problems that situation creates. There's no other way of putting it except - Bhasad mach jaati hai.

Hindi Language.name: Ram-Path
Hindi Language.description: A narrative on the RAMLEELA art form performed in JASWANT NAGAR, India. It is not performed on a stage but on the roads of the town. Recognized by UNESCO as the world's best field Ramleela and categorized as an UNESCO intangible heritage.

Hindi Language.name: Mission Tiger
Hindi Language.description: Mission Tiger is the first film featuring the root cause of tiger poaching in India and intends to impart a message- Save the tiger.

Hindi Language.name: Rahenge Sadaa Gardish Mein Taare
Hindi Language.description: A relationship drama based on the lives of two creative people and their work. A tribute to 1950s Hindi cinema, it is heavily inspired by the life of filmmaker Guru Dutt, his singer-wife Geeta Dutt and their tumultuous marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Pustak
Hindi Language.description: Director's Note: Cinema is a big influence in our lives. Movies like Taare Zameen Par and 3 idiots teach us that every individual is different and we should embrace our uniqueness. I want to use this medium to convey the message of education and how many children are deprived of basic or equal education. My heart goes out to this issue and want to help our society tackle this problem. The cast, the crew and I have put in a lot of effort, to make Pustak. I hope that we can convey this message to as many people as possible.

Hindi Language.name: Paradiso
Hindi Language.description: Paradiso is my second feature film, the first being 'Umformung-The Transformation'. This movie is part of my trilogy 'Search' series, the third film is yet to be made. In Paradiso, I was more of a Psychologist and less of a Director. It was exhilarating and at the same time terrifying to make Paradiso, to delve deep into other human mind is no less adventurous then diving deep into the ocean. The untold diversions of the common man, I tried to unfold in the movie. The movie is less of a Drama and more of a Narrative. Also the Protagonist has no name and no dialogue in the movie. I wanted everyone to identify himself and herself with the Protagonist.

Hindi Language.name: Mangal Ho
Hindi Language.description: An Indian couple who become the first, to set up the first human civilization on the planet Mars.

Hindi Language.name: Soadies
Hindi Language.description: An obsession that haunts a family...A dying man's last wish...A girl on a mission to shatter her family's delusions...Who are these people and what is their mission?Welcome to the mad mad world of the Soadies - The most magnificent fans of Roadies!13 years ago, Banto Sodhi passed away and left for his wife Santo, the task of finding a Roadie in the family....and so, the Sodhis became the Soadies. With a son who raps in anger, a grandson who is a complete blonde and granddaughter who hates Roadies, will Santo ever be able to complete her husband's dying wish?

Hindi Language.name: Samadhan Ki Samasya
Hindi Language.description: Samadhan Dagdu Nagargoje is no ordinary man. He is an idiot of first order. He mans a desk of helpline service where people call to seek help in emergency situation but is this Nagargoje guy any good to help them out or will he make their situations more troublesome.

Hindi Language.name: Hi Tea
Hindi Language.description: Taking time to relax and unwind shouldn't be something you only do on weekends. Hi Tea is a brand new series that focuses on effortless, foolproof recipes that are guaranteed to enrich your evenings.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Hours
Hindi Language.description: The show will showcase talented artist donning different avatar and entertaining audience with their gags. There is no definite plot as the show takes a topic(which is usually circled around social media) and presents a series of acts each day but always consists of social media jokes, funny videos sent to Happy Hours, The Social Baba Act and audience interaction along with one or more acts including The Rangana Kanaut Show, Useless Argument(Debate) and Court Cases.

Hindi Language.name: Azaab
Hindi Language.description: A story of three friends who caught in a situation which leads them to kidnap a kid.

Hindi Language.name: Love Alive
Hindi Language.description: Bhaarat wakes up in an empty world. Void of any companion, Bhaarat reminisces the story of his life. Living a freewheeling life with his best friend Champak, Bhaarat is the heir and grandson of industrialist Mrs. Desai. Bhaarat meets Kisha, both then become each other's first love. But Bhaarat struggles to prove his love to Kisha, who has a strong faith in the kingdom of stars.

Hindi Language.name: Pirates 1.0
Hindi Language.description: The story follows the lives of four unemployed engineers who turn criminals to avenge an anonymous, yet dangerous cyber-criminal.

Hindi Language.name: Meeradha
Hindi Language.description: Meeradha is a romantic love triangle between the three pivotal characters, Krishna, Radha and Meera. The plot revolves around the central character Krishna, a modern chap who does not care of his life. He wastes his time in having fun with his friends. Meera and Radha are his childhood friends. They unite during college days and enjoys until a love triangle develops between them. But Krishna's irresponsibility towards life pays him and his life changes after few drastic moments.

Hindi Language.name: Livfit : Yoga
Hindi Language.description: You can burn the fat on mat. Yoga is a 5000-year-old Indian body of knowledge. Practice Yoga with some of the best of the certified National and International Yoga experts and achieve spiritual strength, discipline and flexibility.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Andekha Sach
Hindi Language.description: Exploring depression and suicide among today's youth, offering seven reasons why, 11 symptoms to watch for, and 14 solutions to help parents take preventive action to protect their children's lives.

Hindi Language.name: Bumbai Bird
Hindi Language.description: A soul is visiting unconscious bodies in the city and looking back in time with them to understand what happened to them. A compassionate, poetic and realistic look at different lives in Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Ordinary World
Hindi Language.description: Ordinary days and ordinary life of an ordinary couple in Mumbai, India.

Hindi Language.name: Narayan
Hindi Language.description: NARAYAN is a simple man and a father, living a simple life, and like all fathers, his son KABIR is his pride and joy. KABIR, is surrounded by friends and peers who seem to have it all, the great bikes, latest phones, fast cars and lots of spending money. All this and more given to them by their rich fathers. On the other hand Kabir's father, Narayan, cannot afford anything beyond a DTC bus ticket for his son. Seeing all his friends living this indulgent lifestyle, Kabir often feels short changed by his father, a traditional man, working as a simple Security Supervisor. One day Kabir's friends, who seem to be making a lot of money themselves, offer him an opportunity to make a quick buck. Egged on by desperation and greed for a similar lifestyle, an unsuspecting Kabir, takes a shortcut to making money, and soon finds himself in big trouble. Narayan fight to win back his son and also his dignity, honour and respect.

Hindi Language.name: :13:7 Ek Tera Saath
Hindi Language.description: This story is about paranormal activities happening around us in our daily life which sometimes gets noticed and at times not.

Hindi Language.name: Gandhigiri
Hindi Language.description: Rai, a staunch follower of Mahatma Gandhi, inspires various people who diverted from the path of righteousness and teaches them the importance of Gandhi's principles.

Hindi Language.name: Chacha Bhatija
Hindi Language.description: Chacha Bhatija is a wholesome family entertainer that features an uncle-nephew duo, popularly known as Chacha Bhatija. The duo is 'world-famous' in Fantooshnagar for their uncanny knack to solve all the problems of the town.

Hindi Language.name: Rekka
Hindi Language.description: The unforeseen circumstances he is pushed into which ultimately leads him to kidnapping a girl.

Hindi Language.name: Bhangarh: The Last Episode
Hindi Language.description: In March 2012, five crew members of a news channel disappeared in Rajasthan while shooting an episode of a paranormal TV show in the world's most haunted location, Bhangarh. After two years their footage was found.

Hindi Language.name: Dare You
Hindi Language.description: Rani Dewan comes from Kashmir to study in Pune University. Her talent and her charisma makes her the blue eyed girl of the campus. The college band absorbs her with open arms and soon their band becomes a group to reckon with. The journey of Rani undergoes a roller coaster ride and the revelations get shocking. Rani DARES YOU to witness her challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Pinky Beauty Parlour
Hindi Language.description: Two sisters named Pinky and Bulbul own and operate a beauty salon in Banaras. One morning, a dead body is discovered in their parlour, sparking an investigation. As the case develops, the vibrant world of beauty salons and our society's deep-seated obsession with fair skin begin to come to light.

Hindi Language.name: Union Leader
Hindi Language.description: Resigned to his fate as a worker in a notoriously shoddy chemical plant, Jay realizes that he must not only find a way to support his family, but also overcome grave social and legal injustice in the system.

Hindi Language.name: Office #thebrightesthorrorfilm
Hindi Language.description: Things get scary in an office when the employees start seeing the ghost of a girl, who is not even dead, what if the person sitting on workstation next to you, is a ghost. A psychological horror exploring the basic idea of ghosts.

Hindi Language.name: Love You Family
Hindi Language.description: Love u familly is a movie acted by salman yusuf khan in 2017

Hindi Language.name: Love in Melbourne
Hindi Language.description: Director: Vinny Pal Production House: Hollybolly Movies Pty Ltd Cast: TBA

Hindi Language.name: Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule
Hindi Language.description: Savitribai Jyotirao Phule (3 January 1831 - 10 March 1897) was an Indian social reformer and poet. Along with her husband, Jyotirao Phule she played an important role in improving women's rights in India during British rule. The couple founded the first women's school at Bhide Wada in pune in 1848.. She also worked to abolish discrimination and unfair treatment of people based on caste and gender. She is regarded as an important figure of the Social Reform Movement in Maharashtra and is regarded as "Rashtramata" (The Mother of The Nation). But unfortunately majority of many Indians especially young generation is not aware of Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule and Mahatma Jyotiba Phule. The story starts with a terrifying incident of a girl burnt alive in a village in Maharashtra and while covering this news ace reporter Kavya Banerjee meets social reformer Bhaskar manjule for his review and opinion regarding the incident. Bhaskar while giving his interview gives example of Savitribai Phule and to his shock Kavya questions him about Savitribai Phule as she is completely unaware of this iconic lady. Bhaskar scolds Kavya and tells her that its very shameful being a female journalist she doesn't know about this great lady. Kavya feels guilty and she decides to find out more information on Savitribai Phule. Kavya on suggestion of Bhaskar manjule leaves for kudaal village near satara to meet retired professor Namdev patil who is a true follower of Savitribai Phule... Kavya meets Namdev in his village but he refuses to give information about Savitribai Phule but later on seeing her dedication and sincerity about her work he agrees to narrate the story of Krantijyoti Savitribai Phule'.

Hindi Language.name: Brina
Hindi Language.description: In a community where women marry multiple brothers, a young woman falls in love and fights against the tradition when her parents arrange her marriage to four siblings. Her stand challenges deep-rooted customs and gender bias.

Hindi Language.name: Anna
Hindi Language.description: Indian biographical film based on the life of social activist, Kisan Baburao "Anna" Hazare.

Hindi Language.name: Dhhai Kilo Prem
Hindi Language.description: Set in Agra, this is an unusual love story of Deepika and Piyush. Deepika doesn't care about her looks while weight issues bother Piyush.

Hindi Language.name: Autohead
Hindi Language.description: A documentary crew starts to make a documentary about an Auto Rickshaw driver in Mumbai. As they dig deeper into his life they discover angst, sexual frustration and paranoia that leads to a terrible end.

Hindi Language.name: Naga the Eternal Yogi
Hindi Language.description: A journey that will bring a young ascetic, belonging to the oldest Indian monastic order, to the most important religious festival for Hindu: The Kumbh Mela.

Hindi Language.name: Typecaste
Hindi Language.description: Mahipat Babruvahan becomes the first from his caste and village to complete his M.A. degree. Being fired from his current job after expecting a raise, he takes up a new job as a professor where his patience is put to the test by his students and his love interest.

Hindi Language.name: The Zero Line
Hindi Language.description: The Zero Line is a film starring Samiksha Bhatt and Manjot Singh. The film is based on Indo-Pak relationships. It depicts cricket as a mediator to bridge difference between the two nations.

Hindi Language.name: Turup (Checkmate)
Hindi Language.description: In the neighbourhood, chess is a popular pastime with men being the most visible players. In this backdrop a domestic worker, a young woman in love and a former journalist make their moves with care.

Hindi Language.name: Teen Taal
Hindi Language.description: A classical musician in Delhi struggles to take his music forward and his son attempts to revive his unfinished dream.

Hindi Language.name: Shaurya Veer Eklavya Ki Gatha
Hindi Language.description: The show was launched on 24th March 2017 and was to have a schedule of being a show from Monday to Friday at 7:30 pm. The CEO of Reliance Broadcast Network Limited, Tarun Katyal remarked that they have decided to keep the early prime time kids heavy, hence showing the kids friendly show like Eklavya and Bal Krishna. The story of Eklavya is shown in particular as the writer said that many people are unaware of his journey. Eklavya was a compassionate personality in the Mahabharata, and the kids' need to know about the decisions he made in his life.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Bin
Hindi Language.description: The show is about Dr. Akshay Sinha who lost his love to help his friend's wife, Vijaya because she was pregnant. Eight years later, his love, Nandini comes to him in a turn of events. He has a hard time explaining to her about what happened, meanwhile his confused wife tries to figure out the reason behind his weird behavior.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Deke Dekho
Hindi Language.description: Members of the Shastri and Chopra family, residing in the same locality, fall for each other, despite differences in their lifestyles.

Hindi Language.name: The Rally
Hindi Language.description: Kamlapati Dogra sets on a journey to compete in the Himalayan Rally competition.

Hindi Language.name: Jaat Ki Jugni: Ek Visphotak Prem Kahaani
Hindi Language.description: A rebellious but good-hearted Bittu falls for romantic Munni, who lives sheltered from men by her brothers in an artificial world - leaving questions about their mysterious motives.

Hindi Language.name: Gumrah 5 End of innocene. #Reality check. India
Ishq Click
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of Aditya a struggling photographer holidaying in the beautiful valleys of Himachal Pradesh, where he meets a pretty girl Sophie and happens to click her while sight seeing. Post which he tries to befriend her but has many failed attempts. He also loses focus from his own career as he can see no one beyond Sophie in his life. On befriending Sophie he persuades her to try modelling in the City of dreams Mumbai. As luck would have it her stunningly perfect looks work well for her career making her one of the topmost models. However Aditya is yet to find his ground as his parents are pushy and career oriented pressuring Aditya to become serious with his career. He also hugely depends on Sophie for money, networking and personal gains. One fine day Aditya meets Ira daughter of a successful photographer Mr Mehta at a family event and soon turns to her for his personal benefits. Realizing the struggle that goes into becoming a successful photographer Aditya takes a shortcut by using his connect with Ira to climb up the career ladder. They get married and Aditya now achieves a decent career status. Ira the smart young woman of today, soon gets to know all about Adityas past. She also throws in a legal charge of infidelity against Aditya in support of Sophie. Meanwhile Adityas past haunts him and his guilt eats into his peace and he imagines that Sophie has committed suicide due to him. While in reality it is just Adityas guilty conscience that makes him hallucinate. What happens to Aditya when ex lovers team up together is something this love saga shall reveal in theatres soon.

Hindi Language.name: Love Ka Hai Intezaar
Hindi Language.description: Actress Kamini Mathur is an ordinary girl at heart, looking for true love and then she meets Madhav Singh Ranawat, a Rajasthani prince. Will these star-crossed lovers find a way to be together?

Hindi Language.name: Akbar Rakht Se Takht Ka Safar
Hindi Language.description: Akbar Rakht Se Takht Ka Safar is a Hindi historical drama television series starring Bhavesh, Ankur Nayyar and Rishina Kandhari. The story revolves around the prodigious journey of the Mughal.

Hindi Language.name: Gutrun Gutargun
Hindi Language.description: THIS STORY RELATES TO SUCH A VILLAGE WHERE THE HOUSES HAVE NO FACILITY OF TOILETS AND THERE ARE TWO DIFFERENT LAWS FOR MEN AND WOMEN RELATING TO FIXATION OF TIME TO GO TO VILLAGE TOILET. IN SUCH A SITUATION UGANTI (MAIN CHARACTER HAS TO FACE MANY PROBLEMS AND HER HUSBAND SHAMBHU ALTHOUGH WANTS TO HELP HER YET CANNOT BE HELPFUL TO HER.HE CAN NOT CROSS THE BOUNDRIES OF VILLAGE LAW. AT LAST UGANTI HERSELF FIND SOLUTION OF HER PROBLEMS AND FOR THAT SHE HAS TO FACE INSULT AND HUMILIATION MANY A TIMES.HER HUSBAND THEN FEELS HER GRIEVANCE AND TAKE STEP TO HELP HER IGNORING THE RULES OF VILLAGE SOCIETY.THIS STORY ATTACKS THOSE POLICIES OF SOCIETY WHERE THERE ARE DOUBLE STANDARDS AND WHERE WOMEN ARE NOT TREATED AS HUMAN BEINGS.

Hindi Language.name: Daak Ghar
Hindi Language.description: Set in the early 20th century rural Bengal , Daak Ghar tells the poignant story of a childless man who has adopted Amal, a young boy with an incurable illness. The boy, innocently oblivious of what the loss of life means, is caught in the flurry of life outside the window of his room.

Hindi Language.name: Gang of Littles
Hindi Language.description: The Story of 4 Innocent kids who are common but there thinking is different from other's. They have aspiring dream to become scientist but ignorance of their parents guidance they commit something which is unthinkable by any one .

Hindi Language.name: Thodi Thodi Si Manmaaniyan
Hindi Language.description: Siddharth, a young boy is brought up by his single mother with dreams of settling abroad. Being a part of a rock band "Antriksha"; Siddharth participates in a contest which changes his life completely. Not only that, he meets Neha - a folk singer and a social activist and gets smitten by her ideologies. In the midst of all this, he comes face to face with his father's death. Will Siddharth be able to come across the truth? Will he realize his passion, discover himself or will his mother convince him to let go off his past?

Hindi Language.name: Jhappi Jet
Hindi Language.description: A premise in the cockpit of an airplane revolving around four characters Captain Chadda,co captain Pingle,Airhostess Rosy and flight purser Nawab.

Hindi Language.name: Woh Teri Bhabhi Hai Pagle
Hindi Language.description: Woh teri bhabhi hai pagle" is an out-n-out Romcom show based on a love triangle story. The show revolves around three primary characters. The show is setup in a hospital of Agra (Uttar-Pradesh). The concept is supported by chirpy, unusual, whacky, funny and crazy comedy. The story revolves around Dr Diya Dushyant (Physiatrists), Dr Ranbeer (Fake Heart Surgeon) and Nathu Nakabandi (Fake Patient). Ranbeer, a rich brat finds out Diya's profession and joins the same hospital where she works and thus befriends her. The trouble begins when Nathu, a "tapori"comes to Diya to get his phobia for water, height, fire etc cured. However, he too falls for her and sees his rival in Ranbeer. Ranbeer and Nathu share tom and jerry relationship where their only aim is to gain Diya's attention. They try several ways to woo her which create hilarious comic situations. Each episode will have new and funny characters coming to the hospital and the staff dealing with their unique problems.

Hindi Language.name: Om Shanti Om
Hindi Language.description: Baba Ramdev, actress Sonakshi Sinha, music director Shekhar Ravjiani and singer Kanika Kapoor judge a devotional music competition, wherein fourteen participants compete against each other.

Hindi Language.name: Indias Asli Championhai Dum
Hindi Language.description: India's Asli Champion-Hai Dum is an Indian reality stunt show hosted by Suniel Shetty. The unique show aims to find the fittest Indian who would survive the ultimate test of physical and mental endurance, to win the glorious title of India's Asli Champion.

Hindi Language.name: Kis Kiss Ka Kissa
Hindi Language.description: Seven friends in their forties - three couples and a bachelor, are surprised by a blackout during a party. The silence is broken by the sound of a kiss and a slap. In the confusion and commotion that ensues, dark secrets are revealed.

Hindi Language.name: Flying Colors
Hindi Language.description: A 15 year old mute village girl runs away from home due to problems, lands in Mumbai city. Initially she struggles to cope up with the big city, but fights her way forward to survive and achieve freedom overcoming obstacles.

Hindi Language.name: Prakash Electronic
Hindi Language.description: Story of a middle aged Electrician having a shop by name "Prakash Electronics" and how his life changes when one girls come to live in that society. His dreams, Imaginations and interactions all changes.

Hindi Language.name: Palki
Hindi Language.description: Palki movie depicts a Punjabi farmer named Balbir Singh, and his only daughter Palki, she is in the lead role of this film, Palki's life difficulties help her father Balbir Singh learn about women empowerment.

Hindi Language.name: Lip Sing Battle
Hindi Language.description: Renowned celebrities compete against each other as they lip-sync famous songs with the help of props and costumes.

Hindi Language.name: The Power of Vardi
Hindi Language.description: The Power Of Vardi is a Hindi movie released on 15 Dec, 2017. it is a story about police force of the Indian government.

Hindi Language.name: The List
Hindi Language.description: Stand Up Comedian Varun Thakur picks one typically Indian habit or practice every week and tears it apart. Be it annoying guys at night clubs or the premise of our ever so popular daily soaps. With video clips to support it, a laugh riot is assured.

Hindi Language.name: The Unreserved
Hindi Language.description: The Unreserved is an inquiry into the lives of passengers who use the Unreserved Compartment, the cheapest way to travel across India on the Indian Railways system. The film portrays the passengers' aspirations, efforts and opinions through conversations and personal stories.

Hindi Language.name: Going Viral Pvt. Ltd.
Hindi Language.description: Going Viral Pvt. Ltd is a company where hopeful Indians come with their dreams and money - to do the one thing everyone aspires to - become famous by going viral. Can this firm win over social media? Or will it all end in disaster?

Hindi Language.name: Raja, Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
Hindi Language.description: Hosted by chef Ranveer Brar, the show takes you to his retreat - an old world bungalow basking in the laid back vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery; both personal and culinary.

Hindi Language.name: Bhanwarey
Hindi Language.description: Set in the late 90s in Delhi, Bhanwarey revolves around three friends and how they accidentally get involved in wrong doings while trying to cure their sexual problem of premature ejaculation, and to solve them and eventually get trapped between the law and a couple of gangster groups.

Hindi Language.name: Bharatvarsh
Hindi Language.description: Bharatvarsh is an Indian television historical documentary series, hosted by actor-director Anupam Kher on Hindi news channel ABP News. It started on 20 August 2016. show presents thoughts and ideologies of personalities in the 5000-year old history of India and showcases journey from ancient India to the 19th century. E01 A Journey From Siddhartha To Gautama Buddha E02 Story of Chanakya, The Author Of Arthashastra E03 Story of Mauryan Emperor Ashoka Samrat E04 Story of Adi Shankaracharya E05 Story of Prithviraj Chauhan E06 Story of Kabir E07 Story of Akbar E08 Story of Maharana Pratap E09 Story of Dara Sikhoh E10 Story of Shivaji

Hindi Language.name: Dil Toh Deewana Hai
Hindi Language.description: Raja(Haider Khan) is a guy who has always remained a 'good friend' to most of the girls, that is if they have not already beaten him up! He has always been shy, never to open his heart out. Raja meets the girl of his dreams Anamika(Sada) in tube in Malaysia. She is a spoilt, arrogant daughter of a billionaire in Malaysia. As days pass, Raja gets more and more hooked on to her and expresses his feelings to her. This is when his life takes a different turn and he is left on the thresholds of life

Hindi Language.name: Wrong Way: A Way to Death
Hindi Language.description: Dada thakur and heera thakur are the drugs traffickers who always looking for the new young and innocent kids to help them in their business . But a girl stop them to go on this wrong way and police catch them but still dada thakur and heera thakur is far from the catch of police and still searching for new kids.

Hindi Language.name: Awesome Mausam
Hindi Language.description: This love story between a Hindu boy, Rahul Sharma (Rahul Romy Sharma) and Muslim girl, Ghazal Siddiqui (Ambalika Sarkar) invokes the 'Laila-Majnu' track to drive home it's legendary leanings. Unfortunately there's really nothing much to recommend here save for a few lines of stinging thought-provoking dialogue. Rahul and Ghazal perform the Laila-Majnu play in their college and eventually fall in love. But the girl's uneducated, successful land shark, father, Siddiqui (Mukesh Tiwari) is livid about the pairing and puts up hurdles in their way. An NGO, basically a website tiled 'Love Guard,' started by Arjun - a love-loss survivor, hopes to help and protect such couples achieve happily ever after. Rahul and Ghazal seek out his help but will that be enough to withstand the entire onslaught that Siddiqui has in store for them?

Hindi Language.name: POV: Point of View
Hindi Language.description: Ghost is the fear of a self-fabricated cage in the subconscious, in which people lock themselves up consciously. Everything which exists on this earth is as correct as well as incorrect. Point of view defines them, period.

Hindi Language.name: The Circle
Hindi Language.description: Film on yoga transforming lives of street children caught in web of drug addiction.

Hindi Language.name: Two Desires and a Dream
Hindi Language.description: "TWO DESIRES AND A DREAM" (The First Ever Quadriplegic ACTOR in the Cine World) The film "TWO DESIRES AND A DREAM" is an honest attempt to unravel the innate, unseen, unknown feelings and emotional aspects of a person with a serious disability. The message of the film is... people with disability are just like any other able-bodied/ normal human being. They also have Feelings, Emotions and DESIREs... and, it's time our society recognizes and respects this reality. The USP of the film is.... The protagonist, a severely disabled person himself bringing into lights the innate unseen, unknown feelings and emotional aspects of persons with disability.... which is first-of-its-kind anywhere in the world...film. LOVE, TRUST, COMMITMENT and LOYALTY are the four primary pillars of any strong and stable relationship. And a differently-abled person is capable of having/ expressing these virtues.... as much as or as effectively as any other able-bodied person out there... he believes. While there's no dearth of sympathy in our society for people with disabilities.... when it comes to empathy or some kind of understanding/ genuine feeling for such people, it's something very hard to find. Lastly, why should someone choose a person with disability as his or her soul mate in life... our story is all about it. The story unwinds through a real life quadriplegic Jitendra who is also playing the role of the main protagonist in the film. After months of online interaction a chance encounter with Swapna, a celebrity socialite, Jitendra develops unexplained feelings for her. And through their subsequent conversations reveals the loneliness, the agony, the frustration as well as the hope, the desire, the passion... people with disabilities have in their lives. As the story progresses, Jitendra starts developing weakness for the girl... leading to an interesting sequence of events that take the film towards a pulsating end. The film tries to encapsulate the fact that as far as the core components of a relationship goes... like Love, Care, Commitment & Loyalty... a person with disability can certainly express/ exercise them as effectively as any of their able-bodied counterparts, if not better. The USP of the film is.... The protagonist, a severely disabled person himself, is the central character and acting in the movie, which is first-of-its-kind anywhere in the world.

Hindi Language.name: Arre Ho Ja Re-Gender
Hindi Language.description: India's first ever, digital reality series based on a social experiment that explores the relationship between the sexes. The men will become women and women, men. 6 participants will discover not so obvious truths about the opposite sex. India's first ever digital reality series based on a social experiment that explores the relationship between the sexes. The men will become women and women, men. 6 participants will discover not so obvious truths about the opposite sex.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Sala Sanki
Hindi Language.description: A young ne'er-do-well becomes a man in the process of standing up to his disreputable childhood idol for the love of a woman who must learn, in her turn, to love him. On their journey, the couple makes some serious enemies.

Hindi Language.name: Weather Report
Hindi Language.description: Weather Report is a chronicle of the times. It questions the directions in which the civilization is headed and the faces of familiar institutions like marriage, family, home and occupations.The three characters, Ira, Arjun and Amol, bring the fore the choices we have and choices we make. Each of them is both a product and progenitor of specific value-systems. For one, the process proves to be liberating. For the other, it's crippling. As global recession sets in three friends lose their corporate jobs. Ira, Arjun and Amol grapple with their personal demons as they come to terms with their realities. Dormant fears come to surface. Latent desires open up new opportunities. Each makes a set of choices which determines the trajectory their live take. Representative of the times, Weather Report, Foregrounds a certain unease a about notion of respectability, comfort and security.

Hindi Language.name: Karmbhoomi
Hindi Language.description: In the first episode of Karmbhoomi, you meet the three leaders - Anukriti Singh, Kartik Kapoor and Kiara Oberoi,

Hindi Language.name: Jab Tum Kaho
Hindi Language.description: Jab Tum Kaho Is A Romantic Hindi Movie, Directed And Produced By Vikram Shankar. A Man, Who Was Once Jovial, Leads A Lonely And Mechanical Life. His Life Changes When He Falls In Love.

Hindi Language.name: In Search of Life
Hindi Language.description: In Search of Life is a philosophical and poetic journey that explores what it means to truly live, rather than merely exist. Through reflective passages and thought-provoking insights, conventional ideas about purpose, identity, and happiness are challenged.

Hindi Language.name: Sethji
Hindi Language.description: The plot show is based on the life of a young boy, Bajirao who belongs to a village in Maharashtra, ruled by Sethji, a strong-headed traditional lady. However, when he falls in love with modern Pragati, it creates ripples across the village.

Hindi Language.name: Who Is the First Wife of My Father
Hindi Language.description: The story of this film revolves around a young girl, Amba, 16 years who lived happily with her father & mother, Swati. Amba is studying in 12th standard while her mother, Swati is a school teacher & father is not doing any work due to loss in business. In depression father becomes alcoholic & doubts his wife's extra marital affair with a colleague of hers. Things go out of way when Amba's father dies. A family friend & neighbor take charge for all family responsibility of Amba. Incidentally Amba builds up a relation with this neighbor's husband & one day Amba marries a NRI & settles in U.K. The life of Amba changes when she comes back to India to visit her mother & witnesses an unexpected turn in all their lives to find the new relations & its complications.

Hindi Language.name: Atin Ella and Charadhaya
Hindi Language.description: A love bird got trapped in today's political and economical structure; adapted from Rabindra Naths Tagore's Novel Char Adhyay.

Hindi Language.name: Unlimited Tamaashaa
Hindi Language.description: Billionaire HK is in trouble. He's invented a cosmetic cream with secret ingredients from Fiji. Many groups converge in Fiji to kidnap HK as the product nears it's launch date, including his estranged wife. All is not as normal as it seems..

Hindi Language.name: Short & Scary
Hindi Language.description: Eros Now And Radhika Apte present Short And Scary - a special series of horror shorts. The three separate stories which are all under two minutes range from the eerie to the downright scary.

Hindi Language.name: Shreelancer
Hindi Language.description: Shree, a Bangalore-based freelance copywriter who is in his mid-20's struggles to cope with the self-doubts about his artistic abilities. Whilst, he continues to work for small-time ad agencies, he is quite frustrated about the fact that the world doesn't understand and give respect to freelancers that they deserve. Unable to concentrate at home, he visits various cafes to find his peace and works from there. Addicted to his cell phone and the social media, Shree's worldview is shaped by what he reads online, not having traveled much in the"real"world. As fate would have it, Shree gets an invitation to attend an all-expenses paid trip to a college friend's wedding, which changes his life forever. Shreelancer is a contemporary take on the life of a freelancer in today's time.

Hindi Language.name: Bhangover
Hindi Language.description: About a group of youngsters who accidentally catch a terrorist.

Hindi Language.name: Le Lotta
Hindi Language.description: If we win we will make fun of you, if not, you'd be killed.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Ka Manjan
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a plot line wherein he crime syndicate involved with human trafficking is depicted in detail. A the core there is a love story between a girl and boy who is the protagonist. The story also comprises of several sociopolitical angles attached to he functioning of human trafficking syndicate across the country. The moment of anagnorisis for the protagonist is when his lover's sister is kidnapped by mafia henchmen. The unfortunate series of events unfold resulting in the murder of the lead female character. His lover's death pushes the protagonist towards a commited cause of countering he crime menace all around.

Hindi Language.name: Bal Ganesh and the PomZom Planet
Hindi Language.description: Bal Ganesh's friend Mooshak plans to go to a planet named Zeba with his friends, but his spaceship crashes and they land on a planet named Pomzom where his group is held captive, until Bal Ganesh saves the day.

Hindi Language.name: Desi Wrestler: The Power of Bull
Hindi Language.description: After completing his schooling, Abhay goes University for further education. As Abhay belongs to Wrestler father, he participated in University wrestling championship and beat Sanjay, the son of Thakur Durjan Singh. Thakur couldn't to bear it and he implicated Abhay in drugs case. At last Abhay vindicated him.

Hindi Language.name: Befikar Besahare
Hindi Language.description: The film name is - Befikar Besahare. its a light hearted romantic situatiuonal comedy film with a strong message to Society. The film talks of the lives of 6 MBA students - during and after MBA.

Hindi Language.name: Rajuben
Hindi Language.description: Rajuben, a passionate journey of a girl into the underworld and back.

Hindi Language.name: What the Goat
Hindi Language.description: A witty take on the Startup Circus happening in India. An unusual journey of four small towners trying to make a mark in the Startup Ecosystem.

Hindi Language.name: City of Dark
Hindi Language.description: Two separate journeys get tied together when a man and a woman are attracted to a stranger. Kabir is a small time stage show actor who earns his livelihood as a part time car thief. Even while he has been trying his hand at various auditions, one day Kabir's luck seems to change when Saima spots him and gives him a role. Except Kabir must finish a story he has started, his last steal before he disappears into his new life. Niloy is new to the city. A lonely and friendless Niloy is looking for something that marriage and family could not fulfill. One day he meets Kabir on the streets of Delhi. Is it a coincidence? Or is there is a plan? City of Dark is about meetings, attractions, deception, loss and a trip across town. A journey where men meet with their secret desires and part with longing. Where days have love and intimacy for the two men but the night threatens a different ending for women who wander in the city. Set over two car journeys in a void, the story unfolds in a city hopeful in the day and unkind after dark.

Hindi Language.name: TED Talks India Nayi Soch
Hindi Language.description: The host interacts with inspiring people and discusses issues that are relevant in today's world, from the future of technology to women empowerment.

Hindi Language.name: The Golden Years with Javed Akhtar
Hindi Language.description: Writer, poet and lyricist Javed Akhtar hosts this musical trip down memory lane, revealing untold stories behind India's best songs of 1950-75.

Hindi Language.name: Super Bheem Fire and Ice
Hindi Language.description: At the coronation ceremony of the Fire Prince, an evil queen turns out to be Snow Queen, the arch enemy of Fire Nation. She snatches the special firestone from the king and unleashes her wrath on Fire Nation, freezing everything. Bheem and the kids try to save the prince but the Snow Queen ends up freezing Sky Dragon instead. The Prince tells the kids that he now needs to acquire the Fire-Sword to fight her. Together, they travel to retrieve the Fire-Sword, but are attacked by the Snow-Queen's minions, who manage to capture the Prince in an ice-bubble. The prince cannot escape, but trains Bheem to retrieve the Fire Sword. Bheem and the kids use their new skills to navigate rough terrains and recover the Fire-Sword. A fight against the Snow Queen ensues, and Bheem and the kids defeat her. The ice thaws, and the Sky Dragon and the Prince unfreeze. Everything is warm in Fire Nation once again.

Hindi Language.name: Sabrang
Hindi Language.description: The story starts with a character name Akaash who is working as a civil engineer in America. One day he decided to come back to take a nostalgic feel. In India he meets with a guy name Sahil on road and he takes him to his own college. Seeing his college and their life, Akaash starts remembering his college days. The moment he enters the college where he was in love with a girl name Samaira. Suddenly he looks at a girl who is a professor in their college none other then Samaira. Seeing her as a professor Akaash fallen in love with her but the suspense opens when Akaash tells Samaira that he is married and working a civil engineer in America. Samaira tells him that whatever the reason he has but he should work in India for the growth and development for the country. Initially Akaash takes it lightly and did not listen to her but his wife Suzy who is working in San Francisco tells him that he should work for his country not for America. Suddenly on television, Akaash comes to know that few of the meteorites are coming towards earth which will hit northern India. From there he takes the big step to work for for his own country and saves the country from meteorites

Hindi Language.name: My Life My Story
Hindi Language.description: My Life My Story is a Hindi chat show hosted by RJ Anmol. The host interviews celebrities who share the stories of their success and failure. The celebrities open up about their personal life and share interesting anecdotes.

Hindi Language.name: Sai V/S I
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film revolves around love, revenge, mercy & destiny.

Hindi Language.name: Aye Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Find out what happens is, as the events unfold in the lives of a mother and her adopted son who she loves like her own blood.

Hindi Language.name: Lovechakra
Hindi Language.description: Mohini comes mumbai from a middle class family, having high ambitions. She comes in touch with a contract killer, named Raghu, and falls in love with him. Raghu refuses Mohini as he is a professional killer and has no emotions, but Mohini finally succeed in convincing him, as to leave his current profession and get indulge in good business. Sonia, a Bar Dancer, is in live-in relationship with Raghu and extremely loves him, but Raghu only feels as she is a necessity and friend, he finds only love in Mohini . finally Sonia comes to know that raghu is in love with Mohini and tries to help him in getting settle with Mohini. After some period, Raghu comes to know that Mohini is already married to a person named Mr. Mukesh Agarwal, a businessman, and her actual name is Maya, also she had married to Mr.Tilakraj from whom she was separated after getting a ransom amount and playing games with him. Maria, younger sister of Sonia, is working as a secretary with Mukesh Agarwal, with whom she wants to settle down but as he is already married to Maya.

Hindi Language.name: Tezaab
Hindi Language.description: A well educated renowned Doctor is on a self-exile paying for the unpardonable sin he had committed years ago. The more he struggles to right the wrong, the more he is haunted by the Sins of his past.

Hindi Language.name: Amal
Hindi Language.description: Explore the journey of a man battling erectile dysfunction. Seeking mystical aid, he delves into Sifli magic but faces unforeseen consequences.

Hindi Language.name: V 4 Viraat
Hindi Language.description: Follow the action-packed adventures of 11-year-old Viraat and his 'grandmothers', the four eccentric, hyper-active sisters who have taken him under their wing.

Hindi Language.name: A Day in the Life Of
Pragaash
Hindi Language.description: Three young Indian Kashmiri Muslim girls,full of hopes and ambitions,embark on a journey of music and discover the harsh reality of the world they live in.

Hindi Language.name: Gol Gattam
Hindi Language.description: A small town cricket crazed poor boy and his struggle to prove himself and play in the ground of and among the privileged.

Hindi Language.name: Chakallaspur
Hindi Language.description: Chakallaspur story narrates how an uneducated Billu get recognition from government for his village and changes lives of villagers from facing difficulties.

Hindi Language.name: Nitibha knows
Hindi Language.description: Are you and your maid not made for each other? Do you have a problem dealing with her? than this episode is just "maid for you" watch Nitibha Knows how to deal with the maids only on The Comic Wallah.

Hindi Language.name: Appu the Yogic Elephant
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a baby elephant called Appu, with Yogic powers that enable him to defeat evil forces.

Hindi Language.name: Sabse Bada Kalakar
Hindi Language.description: Sabse Bada Kalakar is a fun filled kids acting reality show with a fresh and distinct format airing on Sony Entertainment Television. Judged by Raveena Tandon, Arshad Warsi and Boman Irani, the show scouts for child proteges between the age of 4-13 year who have the ability to entertain the nation with their acting talent. The uniqueness of this show is in its format, for the first time on Indian television, contestants will be seen performing not only in solo acts, but also in duos and group.

Hindi Language.name: Salt Bridge
Hindi Language.description: When a family man, in a bid to revive childhood bondage, befriends a married woman from within the migrant society which resists, he must come clean without affecting the relationships.

Hindi Language.name: Batallas Intimas
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of five women from different countries who have survived or are trying to survive domestic violence.

Hindi Language.name: Chapekar Brothers
Hindi Language.description: The Hindi film will present the glorious journey of Chapekar Brothers who contributed to the freedom struggle in 1897.

Hindi Language.name: Cryptic Road
Hindi Language.description: A struggling writer, with mind reading ability, finds a subject whose story can bring him the fame and money he always craved for. The thrill begins when his mind clashes with one of his kind.

Hindi Language.name: Bewajah
Hindi Language.description: The film encapsulates three lives; a school kid, an Intelligence agent and a terrorist. Things start to turn around when the kid meets with an unfortunate or rather a fortunate accident.

Hindi Language.name: Days and Nights on Earth
Hindi Language.description: a man, a woman on the road, through life, sex, society, and shocking turn.

Hindi Language.name: Chauhar
Hindi Language.description: A true love story from Bihar, Chauhar explores the never seen facts about the Indian society. The story is based on a popular love saga remembered as 'Reshma-Chauharmal Ka Khela'. The story is about an upper caste girl Reshma who falls in love with Chauhar, a Dalit boy. Infact, Chauhar is known for his fight against the injustice and inequality which is still prevalent in today's age & time. And because of this, Chauhar outrightly rejects Reshma's love proposal. There are several twists and turns in this love story however will it succeed?

Hindi Language.name: Ye Kaisa Pal Do Pal Ka Pyar
Hindi Language.description: The film is a love story about a dalit boy and a high caste girl who fall in love and are forced to elope as the girls father does not approve.

Hindi Language.name: CarryisLive
Hindi Language.description: CarryMinati do Livestreams while playing video games and chilling with his audience.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Dropout Pvt Ltd
Hindi Language.description: Dropout Pvt. Ltd. turns the spotlight on a bunch of under-qualified underdogs, or shall we say the square pegs who just don't fit in the round holes?. What happens when these so-called 'rejects' face the biggest real-world business challenges? Can their dreams survive the harshest reality check ever?

Hindi Language.name: + Jobseekers
Hindi Language.description: Vicky, Shailu, and Sana are at crossroads. Don't really know what to peruse in life. Life hits all of them hard. Would they be able to find, they really desire or they will collapse?

Hindi Language.name: Kapat
Hindi Language.description: Three friends...One love story...and a betrayal. Kapat revolves around 3 close friends - Gayatri, Kunal and Siddhant. The love story between Kunal and Gayatri. However life turns upside down for all them when Kunal meets with a fatal accident. What's the mystery behind this accident and how does Gayatri cope up with this tragedy? Siddhant ensures to be a true friend by becoming a pillar of support to Gayatri. So where's the deceit? And who turns out to be guilty of it? Kapat has all the answers.

Hindi Language.name: Junoon: Once Upon a Time in Calcutta
Hindi Language.description: This a political thriller based on the life of a communist leader and a journalist Nandini.

Hindi Language.name: Rhythm
Hindi Language.description: Avantika, scarred by past love, guards her heart while pursuing her songwriting dreams. When Rohan enters her life, their musical connection inspires her unknowingly, teaching her to trust in love again.

Hindi Language.name: Hungama on Honeymoon Hills
Hindi Language.description: Hungama on Honeymoon Hills is a Hindi movie which deals with narrow mind of rural Indian society on gay relationship It is a comedy romantic drama.

Hindi Language.name: Kunwar Sahab
Hindi Language.description: A married women meet evidently with a man who is returning to his home. the women is pregnant and his boyfriend left her and she going to do suicide sudden he meet a young man.

Hindi Language.name: Mazaak mazaak mein
Hindi Language.description: In a bid to win the trophy, five teams of stand-up comedians compete with each other to display their hilarious and comical talent, which are assessed by esteemed judges.

Hindi Language.name: Crazy Screen Production
Hindi Language.description: Crazy Screen Productions is an Indian Hindi-language action, comedy, romance production company since 2017, written and directed by Naveen Singh.

Hindi Language.name: Iraade
Hindi Language.description: A love story of intentions that never get across the right way causing the heroes to suffer and almost end in tragedy. Highlighting the importance of being truthful about desires and intentions, the importance of never giving up.

Hindi Language.name: Ranthambhor: The Untold Saga
Hindi Language.description: (World Premiere) This is the story of Ranthambhor: of the invincible fort that, for centuries, remained unconquered by war. The story of the valiant Maharaja Hammir Dev Chauhan who put down everything at stake to protect and uphold the glory of his motherland. The film conducts, for the first time, pioneering frontline research on the archaeology and history of one of the most ancient forts of India, also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, thus revealing the untold saga of India's most impregnable fort which is a real, living representative of the glorious Indian history, culture and those dauntless warriors who laid down their lives for their country.

Hindi Language.name: Lost & Found
Hindi Language.description: What happens when a Super-Geek helps a run-away bride in a nerve-wracking chase from her eccentric to-be Dulha? Watch 'Lost and Found' to find out more of this love story only on Sony LIV.

Hindi Language.name: A Million Rivers
Hindi Language.description: A Million Rivers is a surrealist, quasi-narrative fiction film set in South Asia. Themes of fragmentation and fantasy are explored in this black and white contemporary classic: a man with a mirror reflects all that is around him, never turning the mirror to reveal himself.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Ke Rang
Hindi Language.description: It is a horror thrill drama where spirits of a couple keep on haunting in a bungalow and punish those who come to stay over there and are cheaters or liars. Finally a Tantrik make their spirits relieve and they come to peace ..

Hindi Language.name: Psychedelhi
Hindi Language.description: 'If Godard and Tarkovsky had conceived an illegitimate child, with an anarchist bohemian capturing the surrealist copulation on camera round the back of a Chowk in the Indian capital, the offspring might look something like PsycheDelhi.' New Delhi. History. Politics. Poetry. A detective. A killer. A mother. A rebel. A poet. An outlaw. A bigot. A daydreamer. A nurse. And a Prime Minister.

Hindi Language.name: Main Tumhare Bachche ki Maa Banne Waali Hoon
Hindi Language.description: Two years into marriage and just like most couples, love is lost between the old love birds, Saaya and Sarthak. Saaya's naughty but caring neighbour Rukmini gives her some tips, those "Dadima ke nuskhe" i.e. "Grandma's prescriptions". What happens next will surprise you as well as touch you.

Hindi Language.name: My Friend's Dulhania
Hindi Language.description: Aryan and Mahira, a young couple are merged into singularity by the ubiquity of Love. Geographical distance notwithstanding, with Aryan having settled in Mumbai and Mahira studying at a college in Delhi; their love blossoms with each passing day. Aryan having found his heart's true calling and a soulmate in Mahira decides to propose her and permanently seal their union through the bond of marriage. Aryan reaches Delhi with great expectations and anticipation, for he had full faith in his love. But all his aspirations were drastically shattered when found that Mahira had unexpectedly abandoned him. Like a whiff of smoke she disappeared into thin air, cutting all her ties and contacts with Aryan. This incident changed Aryan and leaves him with a bruised soul, which constantly seeks to regather the shattered fragments of his broken heart albeit unsuccessfully. 2 years later... The regularity of Aryans existence is stirred when he along with two of his old college friends Harsh- a Casanova who proclaims so otherwise and the astute Sneha, receives an unexpected phone call. The call which manifests in form of an wedding invitation is from their fourth comrade Sajad, who summons his friends to his marriage which is to be held in Bhaderwah; a beautiful town in Jammu and Kashmir. The three friends are overwhelmed with joy and surprise at this news. They board the same train from their respective cites to become a part of this exhilarating celebration and as well as reaffirm their old friendship. After reaching their destination and indulging in a joyful reunion, the trio engages themselves at their friend's pre wedding celebrations where they insists the groom to show the picture of his would-be bride. Sajad sheepishly passes the photo to his friends. They admire her beauty one by one. But when it reaches Aryan he receives a bolt from the blue. For the picture is none other than that of Mahira - the only person in Aryans life who was the cause of his happiness as well the reason of his tears.

Hindi Language.name: The Great Leader Kanshiram
Hindi Language.description: The Great Leader Kanshiram is a 2017 Indian Hindi-language Biopic film directed and produced by Arjun Singh based on life of DS4, BAMCEF and Bahujan Samaj Party founder, Kanshi Ram.

Hindi Language.name: Raktdhar
Hindi Language.description: Death of a eunuch who is brutally raped. One of her friends, a fellow eunuch, (Shakti Kapoor) avenges her death in a meticulous way by entering politics and changing the system and eventually becoming the Chief Minister of the state.

Hindi Language.name: Super Bheem Hawa Mein Halla
Hindi Language.description: Bheem and his friends are attacked by humanoid vulture villains after the sky dragon arrives. He defeats the evil leader and frees the citizens from his atrocities.

Hindi Language.name: Sharanam - Safar Vishwas Ka
Hindi Language.description: A poignant journey to the most revered pilgrimage sites in India. It showcases testimonies of incidents that are the bedrock of belief, and follows the strong thread of faith binding the pilgrims to their Gods, and the nation with itself.

Hindi Language.name: B for Bundelkhand
Hindi Language.description: A father and son relationship drama taking place in worst land for farming, Bundelkhand, India. Bundelkhand situations aggravate the conflicts and it only gets worse in time.

Hindi Language.name: Foser Villy
Hindi Language.description: A young man had a kind of psychological problem, which mainly included detest from dirtiness. He had been in search of a girl, who must be neat and clean, but every time he found some filthiness which resulted failure in doing complete sex. After divorce he came in relationship with a girl who insulted badly just because of his psychic problems. He was always found in search of a good girl. There were two more persons, whom with he lived, and one day after observing some uncommon things they sent him to a psychologist, who treated him very well. Finally he could achieve success in doing sex with the same girl who insulted him. At the end he adopted the world of spiritualism.

Hindi Language.name: Uhi Milte Rahenge
Hindi Language.description: An extramarital affair, 30 years of unconventional romance.

Hindi Language.name: Vadiyan
Hindi Language.description: A Suspense Thriller, Story based in Mumbai. Story is based on mistaken identity. Centralized on Milind Gunaji and Sudesh Berry.

Hindi Language.name: Jango
Hindi Language.description: A contract killer comes face-to-face with his karma. How can he redeem himself?

Hindi Language.name: A Call from the Past
Hindi Language.description: (World Premiere) This is the story of every artist: of a disconcerted mind on a quest to find his very existence in his own art. The film traces the journey of art which suddenly comes alive, descending down the artist's studio and the deepest corners of his mind in search of its meaning and reflections. His studio houses relics of the past- full of emotions- which stir the very conscience of both the art and artist who find the shadows of the past lurking everywhere. The film explores inseparable relationship between the artist and his art. Today, when the past is often neglected, the film reveals how both the present and the future will soon become past, but only the past will remain unchanged, Eternal. With the artist's dilemma answered, the film asks us to introspect: what happens when the past calls.

Hindi Language.name: Dp Guru
Hindi Language.description: We live in a word where selfies have taken over self - love, where people say 'we click together' but all they are interested is in perfect clicks, where we have an active social life over fb, insta and twitter, but deep down, we are lonely. We make plans and meet rather than meet and make plans. What looks good on me is replaced with what will make me look good on the social media. We have more friends on fb than in real life. Where fb says - what's on your mind...but there is no one to ask what's in your heart. It's a sad situation to be in as technology has taken over human connections but India is a country where people make a career out of nothing, they do their jugad, and one such story is that of Arjun, Arjun Kapoor, who calls himself AK47 'I can never miss the target'.

Hindi Language.name: Pick-A-Trick (H)
Hindi Language.description: Hosted by a super cool magician, Mandy, this is a one of a kind show which focuses on teaching simple and easy-to-learn magic tricks in a fun and entertaining way.

Hindi Language.name: Khardoo 2
Hindi Language.description: A boy takes a rental house and landlord girl falls in love with him.

Hindi Language.name: Naga Sadhus Unravelled
Hindi Language.description: Conversations and more with the revered Naga Sadhus at the Ujjain Simhastha Kumbh Mela, 2016.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Hai Gaddar Dil
Hindi Language.description: This is a love story and a thriller based on love and revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Working Women Kitchen
Hindi Language.description: Considering the hectic schedule of today's working women, Chef Pallavi introduce some easy and quick recipes that can be prepared with minimum efforts and with delicious results.

Hindi Language.name: Taxi 24/7
Hindi Language.description: A struggling actor attempts method acting to bag the role of Taxi Driver in a big banner film. He drives the real Taxi for a night and explores the colourful side of people.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy dangal
Hindi Language.description: Comedy dangal is a hindi comedy show hosted by bharati singh wherein, she also judges the competition, along with anu malik. The show is about a competition between two types of comedy; skit performances and stand up comedy. Join the laughter fight, as the performers from both the teams give their best shot to make the viewers laugh.

Hindi Language.name: Jeeney Bhi Do Yaaron
Hindi Language.description: A Family Drama. How a Old man tries to save his family from being divided. A light hearted comedy.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Kaisa Pesha
Hindi Language.description: Sadhye Maa is a respected god woman with a difference. She wears glamorous clothes, dance with her followers and behind close doors, She indulges in land dealing and even fulfils sexual desires. These activities land her in trouble ..

Hindi Language.name: Yusuf
Hindi Language.description: This is a story of an auto rickshaw driver Yusuf, who loves this parents and he is equally loved in return, until on terrorist attack changes his life forever.

Hindi Language.name: U, Me Aur Ghar
Hindi Language.description: The film revolves around a live-in couple, Chitti and Mittu, who begin their journey by looking to buy a house in Mumbai and the tides and turbulences faced by them during this house hunt.

Hindi Language.name: Masala Chai
Hindi Language.description: The documentary film "Masala Chai" is about the working situation of tea cooks, the so called "chai wallahs" and their importance for the indian society.

Hindi Language.name: Ramad
Hindi Language.description: Anzar and Pandey are childhood friends, whose quest for a better life and prosperous future had brought them to Delhi. Pandey has a job at a bottling plant. It just about pays the bills. Anzar is still struggling to find work. An accident becomes a threat to their dreams. How they deal with it changes lives.

Hindi Language.name: My Father Iqbal
Hindi Language.description: Father is based on a real life incident of an engineer from J&K's PwD Department who fulfils multiple responsibilities in his life. He is a husband, father and above all - a sincere and honest citizen. The film captures the struggle of a father who'd go to any length to achieve the dreams of his child while maintaining his duty towards the country. Father depicts the patriotism of a common man who fights for his country. There are also some light elements in the film portraying a typical middle class husband-wife relationship, their love and their tiffs. A father is not just protective towards his family but also towards the entire society that he lives in. Some terrorists use the Father to create havoc in the atmosphere that the family hails from. Father always sacrifice his dreams and how his honesty is disturbing the corrupt people and how they trapped the father. However, he stands like a protective rock and saves everyone from the evil intentions. The Father in true essence .

Hindi Language.name: Aa Jao Please
Hindi Language.description: A Powerful Social Hindi film against witchcraft, superstition, fraudulent tantrik babas jadu tona and black magic in India

Hindi Language.name: Lagori
Hindi Language.description: 'Angel' an architects don't believes in 'A Political party's Government and its Law and Order" accordingly he joins with "Mond" in order to create " THE NEW ORDER "

Hindi Language.name: Yaaron Ki Baraat
Hindi Language.description: Yaaron Ki Baraat is a Hindi chat show hosted by Riteish Deshmukh and Sajid Khan. In this light-hearted comedy chat show, Bollywood celebrities who share a strong bond, are invited for a candid chat. The celebrities make some funny revelations and confession about their life and friendship. With their quirky one-liners and impeccable comic timing, Riteish and Sajid add their own touch of fun, frolic, spice and quirky humour to the show.

Hindi Language.name: The Witch hour: Curse of the ring
Hindi Language.description: Sameer along with his girlfriend Natasha and business partner Vikrant land up in a house during a field trip. A strange women visit their house and gifts Natasha a cursed ring,which leads to a horrible chain of events in the house !!.

Hindi Language.name: Let's Talk About 'It'
Hindi Language.description: While trying to help a paranoid patient who claims to be tormented by an unknown entity, Doctor Kavita Mukherjee soon discovers that there is no wonderland at the end of this rabbit hole as she delves into the dark depths of his mind.

Hindi Language.name: The Guilty Misfits
Hindi Language.description: Characters explore themselves through the dilemma of sex and ethics.

Hindi Language.name: Rajdarshan
Hindi Language.description: When Lambodar Bhatt is given the opportunity to have his soul transported into King Nand's body, he thinks of it as a way to become rich. However once Lambodar becomes the King, he finds himself turning into the same corrupt and frivolous king that Nand was.

Hindi Language.name: O'Clock
Hindi Language.description: What happens when someone bangs your door in the middle of the night? When evil forces are enough to gives you an eerie feeling. A man peaceful sleeping gets a big bang on the door not once or twice but thrice. And when he responded, he was in a shock to know something creepy is there inside his room.

Hindi Language.name: Veergatha
Hindi Language.description: The audiovisual depicts the glorifying valour, selfless service and heart-wrenching tales of 12 Paramveer Chakra Recipients - Indian Army soldiers of Western Command, the oldest command of Indian Army.

Hindi Language.name: Pehel Ek Nayi Subah
Hindi Language.description: Fiery Poorvi a takes on GanpatRao Bhonsle. Shrestha, a media baron sees this fearless girl. When Poorvi loses a lot to Ganpat Rao, they strike a deal. Bhonsle is the man who left his first born, a daughter, to die. That is Poorvi.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Gunaah
Hindi Language.description: "Mere Gunaah" an emotional drama, where the story gives a moral and reality...its about young generation, who are running to get fame, money and all materialistic things but forget to spend time with the family .At the end of this life ,the truth is only that, relations are our real bank balance, these are our property and our happiness...Life is beautiful when soul get relax. Why we are running so fast? Why we are following something, which is invisible? Proximity only comes when we know truth of this life, which is relation, once we lost, we shall never get back again....

Hindi Language.name: India Unlimited
Hindi Language.description: Food Food's Chef Shantanu takes you through the varied tastes of India, its traditions, its color and brings it all together in his kitchen. His cooking tips and tricks, food secrets of recipes that are simple will make you wonder how the complex layers of taste and flavors may have been arrived at. So if you want to explore the rich Malabar Meal, or the traditional Tamil Tiffins, Kashmir's Kabargah or Goa's love for vinegar, meat or spices then just head over to Chef Shantanu laying a delectable spread of the state of food affairs in INDIA UNLIMITED.

Hindi Language.name: Woh Din
Hindi Language.description: The series follows the journey of a 9 year old boy named Babu and his best friend Shreedhar, growing up in a small township of India in the magical decade of 90s. The series will surely take you on a joyous trip down the memory lane.

Hindi Language.name: Godknows
Hindi Language.description: While he falls in love with her,she keeps slipping away from him.Their separation seems to be destined.Is there a force above that controls our lives?A mesmerising love story which depicts we are puppets in the hands of God.

Hindi Language.name: Chand Pe Chai
Hindi Language.description: Chand Pe Chai is a Series where you can listen to actor and poet Rajesh Tailang's poems and poems of guest poets.

Hindi Language.name: He Ticket
Hindi Language.description: A trail-blazing adventure show that thrills, exhilarates, challenges and tests the limits of the madcap adventurer in you. Discover yourself while treading the road less travelled by and exploring the hidden wonders of India.

Hindi Language.name: Be in Touch
Hindi Language.description: Cricketer Virender Sehwag, who played great cricket innings for team India, recalls memory lanes of his cricket life..., 'on-ground' and 'off-ground' pressures. He explains that how he handled the pressure and reactions of the people in various situations and how important it is to 'be in touch' with your doctor to keep a check on your hypertension, so one can lead a healthy life despite having 'under pressure' situations. This was issued in public interest by M/s Cipla Pharmaceuticals Limited.

Hindi Language.name: Love vs Gangster
Hindi Language.description: Atithi Devo Bhava means 'The guest is equivalent to God' or 'Be one for whom the guest is God". Every year there are thousands of people flying down to India either as tourists or as residents. As per ancient Hindu scripture, it is our "dharam" to treat them equivalent to God. But most of the times, these people are pushed to see the dark side of the Indian society. The plot of the film revolves around a pre-planned MMS scandal of innocent girls. A foreigner comes to India and she is lured to make her MMS tape. It films speaks about how she deals and survives the MMS scandal and her revenge. The film enlightens the society about such mishaps and provokes a sense of responsibility amongst the citizen.

Hindi Language.name: All About Sec-377
Hindi Language.description: The journey of a homophobic man ducking & dodging through the days & sleeping with one eye open in the night because of his gay cousin & his boyfriend in the same house, his journey of sweet revelation & funny incidents form the crux of the story that brings to the forefront the transparent thread that binds two people irrespective of their gender.

Hindi Language.name: Arranged
Hindi Language.description: Abhinav and Manali meet for an arranged marriage date. They try to explore each other through the socio political environment around them. They discuss about films, society and much more.

Hindi Language.name: Summer of '99
Hindi Language.description: A nostalgic trip back into to the late 90's... A never before seen innocent and youthful saga about friendship, compassion,enmity,love,crush,ambitions,aspirations,success and failure.

Hindi Language.name: Sunny Side Up
Hindi Language.description: Chef Shilarna Vaze, traveler, blogger and eco-food connoisseur, brings the sunshine into your day, with fusion brunch recipes that break all the rules of the kitchen, push all the boundaries of flavor and stimulate your senses like never before. What's more, she invites her celeb friends (Anushka Manchanda, Esha Deol), chef buddies and other creative pals to her food haven for an afternoon of good food and great conversation.. With a bit of music, art and humor thrown in, this show is be the perfect formula to start your day Sunny Side Up.

Hindi Language.name: Mtv He Ticket
Hindi Language.description: A trail-blazing adventure show that thrills, exhilarates, challenges and tests the limits of the madcap adventurer in you. Discover yourself while treading the road less travelled by and exploring the hidden wonders of India.

Hindi Language.name: The Ride
Hindi Language.description: Host Rishu Singh is passionate about two things and two things alone - Indie Music and Indie Films. Watch him in conversation with his favourite independent artists like Kailash Kher, Papon, Vishal Dadlani, Raghu Dixit and many more.

Hindi Language.name: Muqaddar: You Will Never Outrun Destiny
Hindi Language.description: A crime Saga. No matter how hard you try to take destiny in your hands, fates have already been written in blood.

Hindi Language.name: Stupid man, smart phone
Hindi Language.description: An unplanned, unscripted expedition.An incredible mission in the most difficult terrains in India using nothing but a smartphone and the power of social media. Join Sumeet Vyas on this ultimate survival game, only on Voot.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Fark Padta Hai
Hindi Language.description: A young boy in a village, constantly discouraged from pursuing his talents due to belonging to a lower caste. He moves to Austria where he meets a woman who shows him unconditional love, and yet, leaves her.

Hindi Language.name: Dad, I am Watching you
Hindi Language.description: Let me tell you how I came up with this story. My daughter was 8 years old when we moved to India. She started using the word "look," as soon as we landed in India.
