"Daddy look at this, look at that, look, how can he do that? It had never been like that there, why, why here?" so on and so forth. I need to tell her etiquette is different here. But how? Surveys, blogs, news papers, TV, Media conclude the rudeness is in every part of Indian life even in professional jobs. Everybody thinks that we are rude people. We behave like early man even after learning about behavioral science, social science, general science, civic science and what not, all basics of society rules for 15 to 16 years at school. The Times of India article suggested the survey is not in need, the news paper concluded "Indians are rude, uncivil and thoughtless". The Hindu article dated May 15, 2012 says "junior doctors see their seniors - their so-called role models - being rude". I wonder how we adopted this rudeness when our prayers "Om Sarve Bhavantu Sukhinah" praying for everyone's happiness. As we all know, Parents serve as role models not only through direct interactions with their children, but through the examples they set with their attitude and behavior within the family and in the outside world. If we don't, our kids won't, their kids won't, behave well. We achieved sovereignty; dignity should be our new frontier for a better society, in fact for a better nation.

Hindi Language.name: House Connection
Hindi Language.description: We meet interesting people in our day-to-day life, be it through friends or at parties and events, but it's only that one person, who happens to conquer our heart. But, what if getting an access to their heart meant a competition, then love would be a race, having only one winner. 'House of Connections 1' is the first season in the series that aims to connect two people on a romantic level. Led by our handsome host, Manu Punjabi, the show will have three contestants, a handsome hunk, and two beautiful ladies, trapped in a house for a span of 24 hours. Manu will put them through some interesting tasks to test their spirit. In the course of the series, the boy will choose the girl, with whom he feels a connection.

Hindi Language.name: Bhumi
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film begins with the murder of a new born baby girl from Mangala Seheriya(Kallu Majumdaar's Wife) by the Parvati Seheriya(Kallu's mother) of the family supported by the villagers and the (Kallu) Father of the baby girl in the name of Goddess i.e. Devi mata. In the urge of getting a male child, Kallu tried again with Mangala and they had twins - a boy (Raghu) and a Girl (Bhumi). Because of birth of Raghu, Parvati didn't give much importance to kill Bhumi as she is happy to get a male child. Everything is going fine till the day when Raghu died and from that day the sufferings of Bhumi started. As the time passes, Parvati died at her old age and Kallu became physiologically ill. The village started suffers from the drought. Now Kallu become a big problem for the Mangala and Bhumi. He beat them and drinks allot and also he didn't work anymore. When they have nothing to eat, Mangala and Bhumi started working at a distance school and earn their living. Bhumi got chance to study at that school and Mangala supported her allot. One day, Kallu wants to sell Bhumi in the hand of few people for money but Mangala saved her and helped her to run away somewhere far and study allot, live her life. This action results into the death of Mangala been killed by Kallu. Kallu sells the field for money to his neighbor and then died drinking poisonous liquor. Bhumi gets success in her life. She struggled allot and got a good job in the bank. One day she is coming back to the village to meet her mother and she kept knocking the door. But no one answers.

Hindi Language.name: G: A Dark Tale of Desires
Hindi Language.description: Three women and the collision of their "G" (Desire-choice-the sexual instinct) with outdated yet very widely prevalent, violent feudal notions of relationships, sexuality and freedom of choice.

Hindi Language.name: Baiyko
Hindi Language.description: An unknown writer has struggled for more than 15years, trying to sell his script.He has reached to the breaking point when he gets a call from a producer duo at their farmhouse to narrate his script of a budding film maker who turns into a psycho killer. When he reaches there for narration he finds out that the producers have this habit to call budding writers over their farmhouse and laugh on their scripts.Just for fun and entertainment.This gets so much into his head that he ends up killing both of them.But he gets an awesome idea then and there to make his film at zero cost.He starts to pretend like the character of the psychic writer/director from his script who believes the camera to be his wife. He goes on a killing spree, where he shoots the same and makes a film out of it.

Hindi Language.name: The Junkyard Project
Hindi Language.description: Fed up of all the junk that lies around you? It's time you dunk that junk where it belongs. Aiming to support the Swachch Bharat mission, The Junkyard Project identifies junkyards, shares ideas to clean them up and put it into action - all with an MTV dash of fun, music and art. What's more? Your favorite celebrities have all extended support to the campaign. So, don't be a punk, dunk that junk. Care to join in?

Hindi Language.name: You Are Right Mr Positive +
Hindi Language.description: In the today's modern era ,when we look to the post independent decades it looks that whether we got Independence in true sense or we just Got only freedom from Britisher's rule . All around us we find of Economic, Social ,Religion, Political, discrepancies and corruption on every walk of life, which are affecting a life of the people who wants to do something for society .In the beginning he start with high moral enthusiasm ,honesty with real work but slowly he find himself entangled with all these problems and there is no other way left , either become a part of this or lost a war against the utmost blemished Govt. system. we are making a small effort to eradicate above said discrepancies through our organization"VISION INTERNATIONAL",we are making a film"Mr Positive +" under the banner of "VISION INTERNATIONAL" this film is based on a life of a young boy who wants to do something for his country enthusiastically .He is having strong feeling that if every youth of his country is well educated then his country is having the bright future without all discrepancies .while making such efforts of eduction the every youth he got severely affected with blemished system and slowly while fighting his enthusiasm is broken down.

Hindi Language.name: Narmada Seva Yatra - Civilization of Narmada
Hindi Language.description: The primary component of the campaign is a yatra or pilgrimage. The yatra ran for 148 days from December 11, 2016, to May 15, 2017, and began and ended at Amarkantak, the origin of the Narmada river in Anuppur district after traveling around Madhya Pradesh. Smaller "sub-yatras" covered areas not in the main route. The total length of the yatra was 2,930 kilometres 1,820 mile, with 1,077 kilometres 669 mileP being along the Narmada itself. The campaign covered 962 villages in 16 districts.

Hindi Language.name: Purab Ki Awaaz
Hindi Language.description: One of the country's youngest and most influential freedom fighters ever, Kanaklata became a martyr of Indian freedom struggle at the tender age of just 14 years, on 20 September 1942.

Hindi Language.name: The Desi Kardashians
Hindi Language.description: Enter the world of madness, make-up, glamour, paparazzi, scandals, heartbreaks, and controversies. This is the age of social media; the age of instant money, instant fame. But is it worth the price we have to pay? This September, GGA brings to you, four ordinary youngsters with an extraordinary idea. In their race to become The Desi Kardashians, they may find fame, but will they still be sane? Which one will win? Real life or Reality TV?

Hindi Language.name: Gandhiji My Mentor
Hindi Language.description: Critically acclaimed high voltage intense drama, power packed performance, will take you on a roller coaster ride. A fictional story of Chandrabhan Upadhyay, who trespassed into Gandhiji's Bungalow, with only one intention of killing him. And then the drama unfolds, when Untruth challenges Truth, Non-Violence is pitted against Violence. An amazing drama unfolds between the two before it's dawn.

Hindi Language.name: Ajab Singh Ki Gajab Kahani
Hindi Language.description: Ajab Singh ki Gazab Kahani is an Hindi movie, starring Ajay K. Singh and Yashpal Sharma in prominent roles. The movie also stars Govind Namdev, Manoj Mishra and Rajesh Jais. The biopic is directed by Rishi Prakash Mishra.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Ka Formula
Hindi Language.description: "Zindagi Ka Formula" India's First Psychological Talk Show That Will Reveal All The Psychological Formulas to Help You Live The Life of Your Dreams and Achieve Your Life Goals.

Hindi Language.name: Take 3
Hindi Language.description: A writer, editor and sound engineer, that's what these 3 hope to become if they eventually pass out of Modern Institute of Film and Technology.

Hindi Language.name: Mridang
Hindi Language.description: When headline goes as 'Naked man arrested' a chaos is originated among the common men while the man was running in the streets with no clothes. He fights his own case and end up in the legal heated debates to prove himself infront of a crowd of thousands.

Hindi Language.name: Rupa's Boutique
Hindi Language.description: Rupa's Boutique profiles the bravery and perseverance of six young acid attack survivors who are defying their trauma to pursue their dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Dead Morning
Hindi Language.description: A guy wakes up every morning and finds a dead body in his apartment.

Hindi Language.name: Mumal: A Prophecy
Hindi Language.description: A satire on how the patriarchal society of Northern India evolved both in a positive manner and vice-versa between the period of early nineties to the present times.

Hindi Language.name: Wish We Were Kids...
Hindi Language.description: We human being try our best to be an adult. Where as the child inside us never dies. The child with in provokes us to take those steps which creates havoc in our life.

Hindi Language.name: Matsar
Hindi Language.description: Human mind is obscure. It has different virtues and vices within. There's saying in Vedas (The earliest body of Indian scripture) that we should eliminates three flaws that lies within us. They are 'Madd' which means arrogance, 'Moh' which means desire and 'Matsar' which means jealousy. The amplitude may vary from person to person but they all do exist together in every human kind. The journey of eliminating these vices is the background on which film is narrated. The film is about a journalist on her way to take an interview of a 'Booker's prize' winning author for his fiction - 'Matsar'. Matsar is a fiction on the reality of discriminations & casteism that exists in India since centuries. The fiction deals with three different characters having these vices within them and how they converge and come to the stage of elimination of these vices. The names & deeds of characters are metaphorical representation of Lord Krishna & his friend Sudama as per Indian Mythology. The journalist while going through the interview and discussion of the fiction, simultaneously undergoes the process of transformation and experiences the change within. "Change one person and the world will be changed" is the concept portrayed in the timeline of the film.

Hindi Language.name: The Workplace: Love Is War
Hindi Language.description: Throw a piece of cheese in the middle of a group of hungry mice, and watch the fun. That's exactly what happens when a beautiful girl joins an office full of FOSLAs (Frustrated One Sided Lovers and Assholes).Watch this,and you might just have a deja-vu.

Hindi Language.name: Chipku
Hindi Language.description: A renowned actor of Mumbai, got stack in a traffic while on way for shooting. He started to read a story. Story " The journey ". The story begins with a flashback. Bijoy and Renu, newly married couple board a local train for their honeymoon. Biru ,Muslim by religion is also a passenger of the same train. He lost his job while his factory Lock-out due to some political reason. His sister attempts suicide as their family was unable to provide dowry for her marriage. Krishna from a poor family, failed to search a job after completed MA. He even doesn't have a political source. His brother manage to earn money for their family by doing coaching classes . Sonia Christian by religion is only daughter of her rich parent. She already has completed her graduation. Her parent went her to get married. Sonia not agreed and left the house. Nadu, a Bengali guy , grown up in a orphanage. He doesn't have any body in relation. Very realistic person. He always wants to spend his life in happiness. All of them are in the same train. All of them are confused about their life and future. Nadu told them to be happy always and spent life with full of enjoyment. Bijoy and other decide to go Duarse. Everybody agreed thinking that at least for a couple of days they will remain tension free. Suddenly Nadu become ill. Nobody knows that Nadu is a cancer patient. They try to survive Nadu at their level best but they failed. Nadu died. Krishna and all went home as they promised to Nadu. The story comes to its end. The actor closes the book. Are this kind of people really exists in the world who inspired other to live their life after knowing the end of his own life as the Incense-stick sprayed its fragrances after burning. Tears comes out from his eyes, he begins to cry after holding the book in his heart.

Hindi Language.name: Bablu hai na
Hindi Language.description: Bablu is a happy-go-lucky man who gets involved in solving issues between his friends who are in a relationship. Will he be able to solve their problem?.

Hindi Language.name: Asli Sardarji
Hindi Language.description: Asli Sardarji is a series of films that chooses to remember and invoke a self-reflecting thought through its films. "Almost as if staring at ourselves in the mirror".

Hindi Language.name: Nirjhar: Life and Work of Dr. Tushar Guha
Hindi Language.description: Life and Work of Dr. Tushar Guha

Hindi Language.name: Film Woh
Hindi Language.description: 'Torn Between Hatred and Love'

Hindi Language.name: The Loop
Hindi Language.description: A trivial argument with a neighbor turns into something sinister.

Hindi Language.name: Yarri Dosti Shaadi
Hindi Language.description: It is a wedding reality show that captures real weddings and unbreakable bonds of friendship. The show travels across India. The couples' best friends play story tellers giving an insider's perspective on the affair.

Hindi Language.name: Tycoons
Hindi Language.description: Porbandar Mines and Minerals scam. An untold story of the era. Dramatic graph of the film connects film to the true story.

Hindi Language.name: Producer Champaklal
Hindi Language.description: An all new series of vignettes which will showcase the antics of an out of luck Bhojpuri Producer - 'Producer Champaklal' and his quirky secretary - 'Suzie' as they wrestle their way through various funny situations, will have audience in splits. Champaklal and Suzie share a unique rapport where they constantly try to out-smart one another each time landing into awkward circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Once Upon a Time with Vikram Bhatt
Hindi Language.description: Filmmaker, Vikram Bhatt, narrates some of his most popular short stories.

Hindi Language.name: Purane Panne
Hindi Language.description: Purane Panne (old pages) is a short film series, by Ashima Pictures, in which old masterpiece stories of famous writers will be adapted to an Indian setting, culture and context.

Hindi Language.name: Saturday Night, Alright!
Hindi Language.description: Zam, Ajax, Sahana and Venky are four friends who like most other 20 some-things are caught up in the rigmarole of work and living in the big city. They catch up every Saturday Night to discuss love, sex, bosses, politics, cricket and so much more.

Hindi Language.name: Umeed India
Hindi Language.description: Umeed India showcases groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day with one aim in mind bringing home that Gold.

Hindi Language.name: Saubhaghyalakshmi
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around three sisters, Kuhu, Kavya and Muskaan, who live with their grandmother. The grandmother is fond of Kuhu and Muskaan but doesn't quite like Kavya, a free-spirited girl. The story is about Kavya's struggle in personal and professional life.

Hindi Language.name: Black Is Beautiful
Hindi Language.description: Eleven visually impaired children were living in a darkness created by certain section of society in India. One day, these children accidentally meet an improv theatre artist and start learning theatre. This documentary film captures this journey from darkness to the light of life through improvisational theatre.

Hindi Language.name: Box
Hindi Language.description: He thought of terror, terror got him.

Hindi Language.name: Sanjeev Kapoor Khazana
Hindi Language.description: A destination for tried and tested recipe videos from India and around the world.

Hindi Language.name: The Image
Hindi Language.description: PRATHIMAA SYNOPSIS Prathimaa,a young girl, is living with her mother, brother (Prakash) and grandfather. Grandfather is a traditional Sculptor, and he wants Prakash to learn this art / craft by working with him. But Prakash's mother is against this hard struggle with stones for her son. She wants Prakash to go thro' formal education and become a big officer. Prakash does not show any interest in either of them. Prathimaa has a natural flair for this art / craft, and is very keen to be trained as a Sculptor. But the age-old custom that girls should not be trained in this art / craft comes in the way. That does not deter her. She starts honing her natural skill by keenly observing the grandfather at work, and assimilating as much as she can........ Grandfather passes away........ Years pass.......... Her burning desire, dedication, hard work, and full support of her husband propel her to rise against all odds to become a Sculptor of international recognition.

Hindi Language.name: Of Love and Artistry
Hindi Language.description: A film that explores the lifestyle and life stories of different folk artists from Rajasthan while talking about memories and anecdotes associated with John Da, the man and who helped these artists explore the world of music on various national and international platforms and go beyond the boundaries of their regional performing space.

Hindi Language.name: This Week in Food
Hindi Language.description: Introducing This Week In Food, a show that serves up the news in tasty morsels. Watch Damian D'souza mix, mash, and muddle the hottest happenings with some yummy bites and a whole lotta attitude.

Hindi Language.name: Kahan Ka Raasta
Hindi Language.description: Nestled in the Himalayan range of Uttarakhand in India, Kalap may soon have a motor-able road. Till then the village continues to be 10 kilometers uphill on foot from the nearest road. The film delves into the lives of the people of Kalap, who for generations have been negotiating their own path for sustainable living. With increasingly easy access to the world beyond, will there be a gradual shift in social and cultural values across generations? Kahan Ka Raasta is an immersive journey, in time and space, into the everyday reality of Kalap. It transpires at the pace of the village life, to unveil it's many facets.

Hindi Language.name: Get Access with Anuj
Hindi Language.description: Get Access is a free pass to peek into the life of your favorite celebrity and watch them unfold secrets close to their heart with the suave Anuj Sachdeva. The light hearted show will surely tickle your funny bone.

Hindi Language.name: Father: Tale of Love
Hindi Language.description: Father is based on a real life incident of an engineer from J&K's PwD Department who fulfils multiple responsibilities in his life. He is a husband, father and above all - a sincere and honest citizen. The film captures the struggle of a father who'd go to any length to achieve the dreams of his child while maintaining his duty towards the country. Father depicts the patriotism of a common man who fights for his country. There are also some light elements in the film portraying a typical middle class husband-wife relationship, their love and their tiffs. A father is not just protective towards his family but also towards the entire society that he lives in. Some terrorists use the Father to create havoc in the atmosphere that the family hails from. Father always sacrifice his dreams and how his honesty is disturbing the corrupt people and how they trapped the father. However, he stands like a protective rock and saves everyone from the evil intentions. The Father in true essence becomes a saviour.

Hindi Language.name: In Two Worlds
Hindi Language.description: In Two Worlds explores the life of a Transgender. Living two different lives with a wall in between. Can it be broken? Life is hard enough as it is. Imagine how much harder it would be if you had to hide your true identity on a daily basis. There are people in this society who live in incomprehensible fear of damnation from society if they merely express who they are. This film explores how unwritten social norms can be so painfully tangible. It explores why "live and let live" is so hard to do.

Hindi Language.name: Mahwari
Hindi Language.description: Mahwari is a Hindi feature film against 21 superstitious beliefs from all the religions from across the globe a girl faces at the time of menstruation.

Hindi Language.name: Last Days Last Shot
Hindi Language.description: The everyday lives of a poet-artist and a street photographer, reveal contrasting ideas on death, unmasked with playful lightheartedness.

Hindi Language.name: Urban Wanderers
Hindi Language.description: Not all who wander are lost. Meet the Urban Wanderers, whose sole purpose in life is exploring uncharted territories. Join the six teams on their soul searching quest as they travel through cities, far and wide.

Hindi Language.name: Sand - The Love Without Trust
Hindi Language.description: Have you ever thought about any relationship where there is no space of trust? Is it possible to keep a relationship without trust? NO. The answer is very simple but quite critical. Jay and Diya is in love but she breakup the relation when she misunderstand him because of trust issue she has. She moves to Delhi and Jay stays here in Guwahati. Finally Diya realizes her mistake but it's too late to get him back.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Ka Do Aur Dhoka Ek
Hindi Language.description: Magua and Mahua a schizophrenic personality after 25 years is seeking revenge. Subjected to brutal physical atrocities in the past by Bobby Khan a bully and now an established criminal, Magua & Mahua plan to execute their revenge by seeking employment in one of Bobby's businesses, which is used as a front, a cover-up for his criminal activities. Magua plans to destroy Bobby by slowly eating away from within, the very foundations upon which his business is standing. Taking everything that is dear to the criminal Bobby Khan. Does he succeed masterminding his revenge? Can he really bring back peace between his oppressed self-Mahua and the aggressive Magua? Ek Ka Do Aur Dhoka Ek is a gut wrenching fast paced thriller with many twists and turns, a story that will bend your capacity to comprehend the dark side of revenge.

Hindi Language.name: A Twist of Date
Hindi Language.description: A horror comedy about wrong place at the wrong time can lead to the scariest phenomenon. How a spirit captures a human being making it impossible for her to leave its lurches. Will good win over evil?

Hindi Language.name: Food Memoirs with Chef Hemant Oberoi
Ekaant Sarhad Paar
Hindi Language.description: Akul Tripathi ventures to Sri Lanka to discover the Ekaant of Sigiriya, the ruins of a rock-palace. While there, he explores the myths and cultural links between India and Sri Lanka since the time of the Ramayana.

Hindi Language.name: Tu lage Jaan se Pyara
Hindi Language.description: Rohan a young business man falls in love with his employee Neha a beautiful women with a mysterious past but Rohan's life turns upside down when Neha suddenly disappears"

Hindi Language.name: Undefeated - Soldiers of Courage
Hindi Language.description: Undefeated - Soldiers of Courage is a Web-Series bringing out the life that a soldier and their families live. What makes them stand out and what gives them the courage to keep living even after whatever they go through during their service for the country.

Hindi Language.name: Fameistan
Hindi Language.description: Every story needs a storyteller, and every storyteller needs a stage. Make way for India's first collaborative filmmaking platform - Fameistan, where young filmmakers can make their dreams into a reality. Fameistan is not only a platform for budding artists to showcase their talent but also a golden opportunity to learn from the best filmmakers in the country.

Hindi Language.name: I can you can
Hindi Language.description: I Can You Can is a six-episode adventure reality series that blends extreme physical challenge with personal transformation, set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Himalayas. The show follows six participants three active smokers trying to quit and three individuals who have successfully given up smoking paired together on a life-changing journey. Under Milind Soman's mentor ship, they embark on a demanding trek to Everest Base Camp, a goal that becomes both a literal and symbolic "personal Everest."

Hindi Language.name: Bold & Beautiful Sherni
Hindi Language.description: Wat happens next on the bold and the beautiful with quin and ridge

Hindi Language.name: Bastard
Hindi Language.description: Vikki, an unemployed dreamer aspiring to be an IPS officer, is falsely framed by a corrupt cop and jailed. Inside prison, he transforms under the influence of criminals and emerges as a ruthless don, determined to rule Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Balls
Hindi Language.description: 13 people from india talk openly about sex, love and marriage for the first time in indian film history- and discuss the most controversial issues of homosexuality, marital infidelity, aids, anal sex, kinks, domestic violence, incest, rape, arranged marriage, women rights, open relationships, masturbation and other issues of sexuality in a film that is so uninhibited, brave, explicit and uncensored that it has been rejected by indian censors! This film is the first documentation of indian sexuality ever-and the 13 people represent all the view points of indian society-gay, straight, old, young, liberal, conservative, married, single! All the characters in the film have made the most shocking and brave revelations about their real lives whether it is their homosexuality or the fact that they were raped as a child or assaulted by their spouse !the anchor/director of the film anirudh chawla has attempted to expose the hypocricies and sexual repression of indian society and wants to begin a nationwide and international conversation about sex, which is considered a dirty word in india; hrough this film!!

Hindi Language.name: Simple Vegetarian Cooking
Hindi Language.description: Simple Vegetarian Cooking With Chef Saurabh.

Hindi Language.name: Tennis Buddies
Hindi Language.description: Parents really have no business to envision their unfulfilled dream through their kids

Hindi Language.name: In Our Country Cinema Is the Most Popular & Most Corrupt Art Form
Hindi Language.description: This film is about the most popular & mass consumed art form - Cinema. Presently, in our country cinema is far away from truth and reality...If art is the mirror of the society...then what sort of truth our people are sharing through this most popular art form of CINEMA.

Hindi Language.name: Staaron Ka Yaar Suren
Hindi Language.description: Which star hates getting shoes as gifts? Who is a massive video game addict? Who needs crazy EDM to wake up in the morning? Who hasn't had a sip of cold drinks since he was 18 years old? The only person who knows the answer to all these and much more is now going to meet you every weekend on Sony MIX and Sony ROX HD. But who is he? Is he also an actor? Is he a journalist? Or, is he a fan? No, he is the one and only Suren and he is coming with his brand new show, Staron Ka Yaar Suren.

Hindi Language.name: Stupid Cupid
Hindi Language.description: Dating is a stage of romantic relationships where two or more people meet socially, possibly as friends or with the aim of assessing the other's suitability as a prospective partner in a more committed intimate relationship or marriage. Now add the concept of a blind date to that mix. Fireworks are bound to blow. in the course of this series, Karishma will set up many such individuals on blind dates and make them go through some spicy and exciting questions and activities that will give the contestants an opportunity to get to know each other better and maybe find their ideal partner.

Hindi Language.name: The Shift
Hindi Language.description: A Mirror to social changes taken place in last two decades, how this was made impact on some of Indian Villages.

Hindi Language.name: Shaher
Hindi Language.description: Four holy men under go a crisis of faith when they confront the forces of modernity in the form of a crippled beggar.

Hindi Language.name: Tea Time
Hindi Language.description: Across India, the evening snack time or "nashta" is an important one - it's more a 'refreshing break', a time to relax, and enjoy a good cup of tea with snacks and more. Chef Rakesh shares his experiences and experiments in the kitchen with his viewers by bringing simple, yet delicious and lip smacking International and Indian recipes that can be served during 'Tea Time' or any snack time. His innovative dishes help every cook elevate tea-time to a much awaited time of day for kids and family.

Hindi Language.name: Kaaya
Hindi Language.description: Sahil moves in to an old home with his family only to be tangled between the horrifying mysteries of the house and everything is about to change forever.

Hindi Language.name: Three Rhythms
Hindi Language.description: A classical musician in Delhi struggles to take his music forward and his son attempts to revive his unfinished dream.

Hindi Language.name: Homecoming
Hindi Language.description: A Kannada film Marali Manege (homecoming) is based on a novel by the same name written by Yogesh Master. Love is greater than adamant and relationship is superior to clashes. Vishwa works in a hotel after turned back to his home. He falls in love with Padma and tries to attract her. Later he knows that she's waiting for her love, a childhood buddy, Anand's return. Vishwa respects her feelings and subsided his own. Anand's mother Lalitamma and father Shamanna, Padma's mother Parvati bai and father Mannoji rao too known people to Vishwa now. All they have regards to his helping nature. The young Anand and Manohar stole a metal lamp-stand to get sweet, which was most liked by Padma. The fathers consider this theft is serious and kids run away to escape from punishment and they never turned back. Thus Lalitamma and Parvati Bai remain waiting for their sons to return and worship Mother Earth for the welfare of their children living somewhere. There is an unknown youth who fallows Padma creates panic in the family. Later they come to know that he is Manohar who ran away long back. He says that Anand was not with him since they got separated. Meanwhile, Lalitamma finds Anand, and he is afraid of his father. She tries both father and son to reunite. Her deep love for her son presents out. Later she accepts reality and live peacefully their after. Witnessing all these Vishwa documents in his novel, Marali Manege.

Hindi Language.name: The real high
Hindi Language.description: The Real High is an adventure reality show based on a journey set in Arunachal Pradesh for 10-12 days in which 6 city slickers (Challengers) are put to test under harsh conditions, to bring out the challenger spirit in them so as to experience 'The Real High' that can be found only in nature. Rannvijay mentors and guides them all the way through the entire journey while challenging them to push themselves beyond their known limits.

Hindi Language.name: Clubfoot Awareness Month
Hindi Language.description: "Clubfoot Awareness Month" is a show based on the event by the Give Vacha Foundation and Krup Music from 7th May - 7th June each year including the World Clubfoot Day event to spread awareness around newborn birth deformity Clubfoot.

Hindi Language.name: Door
Hindi Language.description: North East India - A feeling of neglect and alienation has crept into the minds of people and this has given rise to militancy in this region. The militant organizations have become so powerful that they run a parallel government in the rural areas. The Government unable to curb their activities calls in the Central Forces. Abhimanyu Singh, a no non-sense D.I.G in CRPF is chosen to lead the operation. From day one he hits them hard, cutting down their supply routes and eliminating their informers. But unfortunately one day during a crack operation he falls into their trap and they takes him into their custody. In this period he meets their local commander JP or Jayprakash. The two men had many heated arguments both ideological and personal but it resulted in both having a better understanding on each others problems. JP releases Abhimanyu - unharmed. Abhimanyu now got a different perspective of looking at things, he realized that these educated youths who have taken the path of violence could have been stopped had the government taken steps to resolve their basic problems of unemployment, lack of development and corruption which has eroded every social institution. Abhimanyu urges the government to initiate a peace dialogue to bring about a concrete and permanent solution to this problem. He personally tries to build bridges between the government and the militants, but the stakes are very high and no one is ready to budge from their already held positions. Abhimanyu has now entered a 'Chackraview' and he doesn't know the way out.

Hindi Language.name: Ocean in a Drop
Hindi Language.description: India's internet pioneers are archiving dying cultures, diluting caste traditions and empowering women.

Hindi Language.name: Crunch
Hindi Language.description: Crunch unites strangers and tests their ability to survive in a room, which is crunched and diminished each day. The show brings together a mix of people from different walks of life. Their survival on the show depends on how they cope.

Hindi Language.name: Beauty of Life
Hindi Language.description: 'Beauty of Life' is a documentary film revolving around four acid attack survivors highlighting the problems they face in the society, about family compensation, the aspect of law and order, gender discrimination and many more. All the three ladies and one gentleman are now married and leading a happier life.

Hindi Language.name: Chhutkan Ki Mahabharat
Hindi Language.description: Chutkan lives with the family of his uncle who makes him do all their work. His only escape is his imagination. Things go wrong when Chutkan begins altering reality through his dreams. He changes the Mahabharata and the warring Kauravas and Pandavas now become friends. The drama folks bound by the spell of his dreams are unable to recite their original lines. Chutkan then changes his bullying cousin into a donkey and a few aggressive villagers into geese. When an exorcist is called to cure him, he dreams up the Pandavas to rescue him. They declare that the only Mahabharat that will be performed henceforth would be Chutkan's Mahabharat in this Best Children's Film National Award-winning film that will delight everyone.

Hindi Language.name: The Touch
Hindi Language.description: After losing his family and his eyesight in a brutal incident, a determined blind man sells everything he owns to raise fifteen million rupees to hire a contract killer and take revenge on the man responsible. Anticipating the threat, his powerful enemy assigns a relentless private detective to gather evidence and put him behind bars for good. For eight months, the detective bugs his home, taps his phone, and shadows his every move - yet finds nothing incriminating. Frustrated and ready to quit, the detective's routine surveillance takes a shocking turn when an unexpected incident shatters the case and changes all their fates forever.

Hindi Language.name: Qurbat
Hindi Language.description: Qurbat is a story of a middle class person Ajay Patil stuck in a legal matter though he is innocent.

Hindi Language.name: Taxi 24/7
Hindi Language.description: A struggling actor attempts method acting to bag the role of Taxi Driver in a big banner film. He drives the real Taxi for a night and explores the colourful side of people.

Hindi Language.name: Rehne De
Hindi Language.description: The playful and hilarious life of a stand up comedian Varun who sucks at it until he meets his three goofy tenants - Abhinav, Rajveer and Gurukirath.

Hindi Language.name: The Mother
Hindi Language.description: It is an ethnographic film on Gonds of Bastar, one of the largest indigenous groups of South Asia, whose ancestry maybe traced to early African humans through various anthropological elements.

Hindi Language.name: Nahth Bhajj
Hindi Language.description: Plot The story revolves around the main leads. Heroine's Father is an Army Officer so Hero makes many traps to impress him. The movie's story revolves two rich families. Scions of both families fall in love with each other. One belongs to a reputable family with many tea gardens and coffee who have lived their life full of rituals and traditions. The other family is headed by a retired Brigadier who believes in discipline and wants his entire village to be disciplined and rule abiding. Landowner's son falls in love with the Brigadier's daughter setting up an interesting clash between the two families. They both want to get married to each other but are frightened to tell their respective families. To make matter complicated both families start searching for life partners for the lead couple. Brigadier wants his daughter to be in a family of an army officer or to be in a Sikh family. Meanwhile, the boy in a bid to impress his future father-in-law impersonates as a Sikh and succeeds in impressing him to agree to the marriage. Nahth Bhajj is the First time Himachali (Himollywood) Movie released in Multiplex Cinema at Himachali Cinema.

Hindi Language.name: Art of Murder
Hindi Language.description: Kabir convinces Atul to kill their best friend and hide his body in Atul's office. They throw a birthday party to check out whether they get caught and if their crime is perfect or not.

Hindi Language.name: Lootere Bandits of British India
Hindi Language.description: Bandits of British India between the 18th to the early 20th century.

Hindi Language.name: India's Best Jobs
Hindi Language.description: India's Best Jobs is an inspirational non fiction series that explores the shifting landscape of the Indian professional world. Hosted by Meiyang Chang the show moves away from traditional safe career paths such as engineering medicine or corporate management to spotlight individuals who have turned their unique passions into successful high impact careers. The series serves as a guide for the modern Indian youth emphasizing that success is no longer defined by a desk job. Each episode is structured as an immersive journey where Chang meets professionals in their natural environments whether it is a professional kitchen a high altitude military base or a comedy club to understand the grit training and mental fortitude required to reach the top of these niche fields. Beyond just explaining the job the show focuses on the personal hurdles each guest faced including societal pressure and the risks of choosing an unstable path. Viewers get an insider look at specialized industries. For example it explores the technical precision required for aerial yoga the creative discipline of stand up comedy and the high stakes environment of professional sports and specialized military roles. Maintaining the signature style of Discovery Channel the cinematography is high quality and informative providing a documentary style feel that balances entertainment with educational value. Featured Professionals The series features a diverse lineup of trailblazers, including: Zakir Khan: Detailing the rise of stand-up comedy as a viable profession. Ranveer Brar: Showcasing the evolution of a chef into a global culinary brand. Anshuka Parwani: Highlighting the fusion of wellness and entrepreneurship through aerial yoga. Siddharth Chakravarty: Exploring the life of a sea shepherd and marine conservationist.

Hindi Language.name: Palki (Palanquin)
Hindi Language.description: Palki is the story of Balbir Singh, a Punjabi village farmer an his learnings about woman empowerment through the suffering of his daughter, Palki

Hindi Language.name: The Family Man
Hindi Language.description: A working man from the National Investigation Agency tries to protect the nation from terrorism, but he also needs to keep his family safe from his secret job.

Hindi Language.name: Mirzapur
Hindi Language.description: A shocking incident at a wedding procession ignites a series of events entangling the lives of two families in the lawless city of Mirzapur.

Hindi Language.name: Tumbbad
Hindi Language.description: A mythological story about a goddess who created the entire universe. The plot revolves around the consequences when humans build a temple for her first-born.

Hindi Language.name: Hotel Mumbai
Hindi Language.description: The true story of the Taj Hotel terrorist attack in Mumbai. Hotel staff risk their lives to keep everyone safe as people make unthinkable sacrifices to protect themselves and their families.

Hindi Language.name: Gullak
Hindi Language.description: Set in quaint by-lanes in the heart of India, Gullak is a collection of disarming and relatable tales of the Mishra family.

Hindi Language.name: Delhi Crime
Hindi Language.description: Based on the Nirbhaya case, Delhi Crime follows the Delhi Police investigation into the finding of the men who perpetrated this crime.

Hindi Language.name: Sacred Games
Hindi Language.description: A link in their pasts leads an honest cop to a fugitive gang boss, whose cryptic warning spurs the officer on a quest to save Mumbai from cataclysm.

Hindi Language.name: Section 375
Hindi Language.description: A celebrated Bollywood director Rohan Khurana stands accused by a female member of his crew, Anjali Dangle of having raped her at his residence.

Hindi Language.name: Kota Factory
Hindi Language.description: In a city of coaching centers known to train India’s finest collegiate minds, an earnest but unexceptional student and his friends navigate campus life.

Hindi Language.name: Sir
Hindi Language.description: A prosperous young Indian man falls in love with his servant, a widow with the dream of becoming a fashion designer.

Hindi Language.name: Criminal Justice
Hindi Language.description: Sex, drugs and a gruesome murder. An edgy one night stand turns into a nightmare for Aditya, when he wakes up with blood on his hands. The evidence is stacked against him, but he doesn't remember the grisly crime. Is he guilty or not ?

Hindi Language.name: Andhadhun
Hindi Language.description: A series of mysterious events change the life of a blind pianist, who must now report a crime that he should technically know nothing of.

Hindi Language.name: Abhay
Hindi Language.description: Abhay Pratap Singh, the gutsy cop who can outwit any criminal, is back. Only this time, he is up against some sharper and hardened evil masterminds. Join him as he sets out on the road to justice with a darker and edgier.

Hindi Language.name: Uri: The Surgical Strike
Hindi Language.description: Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads an elite Para Special Forces unit to execute a high stakes retaliatory strike across the border. He navigates personal grief and military bureaucracy to dismantle the infrastructure of a militant cell.

Hindi Language.name: Charmsukh
Hindi Language.description: Mixed with emotions like Sexual Desire, Betrayal, Love and many more, this series consists of multiple episodes. Each episode has a different plot and cast.

Hindi Language.name: Chhichhore
Hindi Language.description: A tragic incident forces Anirudh, a middle-aged man, to take a trip down memory lane and reminisce his college days along with his friends, who were labelled as losers.

Hindi Language.name: Lust Stories
Hindi Language.description: Four short films by four of India's biggest directors exploring love, sex and relationships in modern India.

Hindi Language.name: Made in Heaven
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of two wedding planners in Delhi, where tradition jostles with modern aspirations against the backdrop of big fat Indian weddings revealing many secrets and lies.

Hindi Language.name: Blackmail
Hindi Language.description: When Dev finds out his wife is cheating on him, he secretly blackmails his wife and her lover as a form of revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Karwaan
Hindi Language.description: Two friends and a chirpy teenager take a road trip from Bangalore to Kochi.

Hindi Language.name: Hichki
Hindi Language.description: Naina, who lives with Tourette Syndrome, gets assigned a class of defiant students and must ensure that her students realize their potential.

Hindi Language.name: Raazi
Hindi Language.description: A Kashmiri woman agrees to marry a Pakistani army officer in order to spy on Pakistan during the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971.

Hindi Language.name: Kaalakaandi
Hindi Language.description: Focusing on life, death and karma, this dark comedy follows three parallel tracks - a man who discovers that he is a terminally ill, a woman seeking redemption and two goons with major trust issues.

Hindi Language.name: Stree
Hindi Language.description: In the small town of Chanderi, the menfolk live in fear of an evil spirit named "Stree" who abducts men in the night. Based on the urban legend of "Nale Ba" that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s.

Hindi Language.name: Apharan
Hindi Language.description: Rudra, a senior police inspector is set on a mission to catch a wanted criminal with his personal life on stake.

Hindi Language.name: Gully Boy
Hindi Language.description: A coming-of-age story based on the lives of street rappers in Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Flames
Hindi Language.description: A teenage romance from The Timeliners that aims straight from the heart. This web-series is the story of a young romance unfolding as a chemical reaction.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Meri Family

Hindi Language.name: Out of Love
Hindi Language.description: Meera begins to suspect every female associate of her husband after she found a stray hair which is not hers. After discussing with her friend, she thought she might be over reacting but does not stop digging up for finding the evidence.

Hindi Language.name: The Journey of Karma
Hindi Language.description: Its a story of a slum girl who is brilliant in studies and tries to chase her dreams to work in America. She travels through her journey full of twist n turns, surprises, lust with a mysterious old man.

Hindi Language.name: Chandragupta Maurya
Hindi Language.description: This is a historical saga of the first king of united India, Chandragupta Maurya. And How Chankya helps him throughout his journey.

Hindi Language.name: Little Singham
Hindi Language.description: This animated series showcases the fun and thrilling adventures of Little Singham, a brave kid super-cop with lion powers, as he defends his town and the world from evil villains, scary mutants and even aliens .

Hindi Language.name: Vodka Diaries
Hindi Language.description: In the misty town of Manali, ACP Ashwini Dixit attempts to solve a series of mysterious murders happening in a single night, which might be connected to the night club, Vodka Diaries.

Hindi Language.name: Chhota Bheem Kung Fu Dhamaka
Hindi Language.description: Chhota Bheem and his friends decide to participate in the annual martial arts competition held at China, where the country's princess gets kidnapped by an evil demon Zuhu.

Hindi Language.name: Pataakha
Hindi Language.description: Based on Charan Singh Pathik's short story Do Behnein, Pataakha narrates the story of two feuding sisters who realize the true nature of their relationship only after marriage "separates" them.

Hindi Language.name: Silsila Badalte Rishton Ka
Hindi Language.description: Two best friends, one broken marriage, and a dangerously addictive affair.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga
Hindi Language.description: The film tells the story of closeted lesbian Sweety Chaudhary and her attempts to come out to her conservative, traditional family.

Hindi Language.name: Music Teacher
Hindi Language.description: A dejected small-town music teacher grapples with guilt and regret when his ex-pupil who once loved him returns home as the star he always wanted to be.

Hindi Language.name: Genius
Hindi Language.description: An orphan, with a brilliant mind, joins RAW and is burdened by the killing of his entire team. Until he doesn't avenge their death, he can't live in peace with his love. So, he hatches a genius plan.

Hindi Language.name: Marudhar Express
Hindi Language.description: Marudhar is the son of his tyrant father, Ashok Pandey. Straight as an arrow and boring as an oyster, Marudhar trudges along in his life, one hopeless day after the other. But Ashok has marriage plans for him and he won't have no for an answer. What follows is a comedy of ridiculous proportions as Marudhar marries the sweet and pretty Chitra from Lucknow. With no experience in dealing with women, let alone a wife, Marudhar embarks on an emotional and equally hilarious journey as he tries to find his feet amidst love, life and family.

Hindi Language.name: Roop - Mard Ka Naya Swaroop
Hindi Language.description: It is a story of an eight year old boy named Roop, who deals with the patriarchal norms of society.

Hindi Language.name: Nazar
Hindi Language.description: An evil Daayan, who worship the mother goddesses Kali and Durga. But as a devil, she was cursed by gods and captured into the human world.

Hindi Language.name: Kadakh
Hindi Language.description: Sunil is home alone when the doorbell rings. The stranger at the door is the husband of Chhaya, a woman that Sunil is having an affair with. The man asks many uncomfortable questions about their affair, becoming more and more intrusive.

Hindi Language.name: Sare Jaha Se Achha: Web-Series
Hindi Language.description: While Mumbai's city authority makes excuses for unfixed potholes, 46-year-old Dadarao Bilhore takes it upon himself to fill them wherever he can.

Hindi Language.name: Mitron
Hindi Language.description: In order to bring stability in Jai's life, his father decides to get him married. However, fate has other plans.

Hindi Language.name: Bhram
Hindi Language.description: A car accident turns Alisha Khanna's life upside down. The bestselling romance writer moves to Shimla to her sister's place in order to start over.

Hindi Language.name: Chopsticks
Hindi Language.description: A gifted but insecure woman is in for a transformative experience when she enlists an enigmatic con to help recover her stolen car from a Mumbai thug.

Hindi Language.name: Soni
Hindi Language.description: While fighting crimes against women in Delhi, a short-fused policewoman and her level-headed female boss grapple with gender issues in their own lives.

A decade after 1920. When Ayush arrives in England to learn music, he is shocked and scared when the manor he is living in becomes haunted by spirits. To exorcise them, he seeks the help of Rose, a woman who can see and speak with them.

Hindi Language.name: Wanna Have Good Time 2
Hindi Language.description: A charming young businessman dates a spoiled woman. They plan a memorable night, but an unexpected event leaves the loud, chatty woman astonished.

Hindi Language.name: Line of Descent
Hindi Language.description: Three brothers in a Delhi crime family fight over the future of their enterprise. Meanwhile, an undercover police officer attempts to end the family's legacy, and an arms dealer conspires with the brothers.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Chahatein
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Preesha, a single mother who raises her elder sister's child, Saransh after her elder sister's death. Then she meets Rudraksh who is a rockstar.

Hindi Language.name: Regiment Diaries
Hindi Language.description: The Indian army is a family of several regiments, each of whom have their own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army - a living chronicle of events - told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors.

Hindi Language.name: Hate Story IV
Hindi Language.description: Aryan and Rajveer, sons of a wealthy businessman, Vikram Khurana, fall in love with the same woman, Tasha. Not only do they commit a deed they cannot undo but also end up as targets in a revenge plan.

Hindi Language.name: The Accidental Prime Minister
Hindi Language.description: Explores Manmohan Singh's tenure as the Prime Minister of India and the kind of control he had over the cabinet and the country.

Hindi Language.name: Baarish
Hindi Language.description: A self-made businessman and an educated middle-class woman find their lives intertwined through an arranged marriage. As monsoon clouds gather, their practical arrangement takes an unexpected turn.

Hindi Language.name: Beer Boys and Vodka Girls
Hindi Language.description: Three boys having different personalities are staying together in a flat.Similarly three girls having different personalities are staying together in some other flat.BBVG is the story of their goof-ups that turn hilarious.

Hindi Language.name: Cheesecake
Hindi Language.description: Neel and Sameera's routine existence changes course when a golden retriever mistakenly enters and alters their home life.

Hindi Language.name: Jamai 2.0
Hindi Language.description: Jamai 2.0 is about Siddharth (Ravi Dubey) seeking revenge from Roshini's (Nia Sharma) mother Durga Devi (DD) (Achint Kaur) who owns a chain of night clubs in the city.

Hindi Language.name: Jijaji Chhat Par Hai
Hindi Language.description: Two men live as fake husband and wife only to find a shelter and work, meanwhile focusing on their music career. While the teenage daughter of their landlord and boss becomes attracted to one of them.

Hindi Language.name: Laal Ishq
Hindi Language.description: Laal Ishq is a Hindi romantic series of passionate love stories set in different backdrops, each episode showcase an offbeat love story with a supernatural twist.

Hindi Language.name: Paltan
Hindi Language.description: An action-war drama based on the 1967 Nathu La and Cho La clashes along the Sikkim border after 1962 Sino-Indian War.

Hindi Language.name: Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka
Hindi Language.description: He lives under the dark shadow of a Jinn while she is blessed with angelic qualities. What turn will Aman and Roshni's lives take when the two entangle in a 'magical' love story?

Hindi Language.name: Soorma
Hindi Language.description: Soorma is the story of the triumph of the human spirit, about a player, who made headlines for his miraculous comeback after facing a near death experience through sheer determination, hard work and unrelenting passion for the sport.

Hindi Language.name: The Khatra Show
Hindi Language.description: The five popular television faces will feature in a rib-tickling show based on the concept of embarrassing dares and one-up man-ship.

Hindi Language.name: Prassthanam
Hindi Language.description: A rural politician marries a widow with kids and gains a respectable position. He trusts his stepson more than his own in political matters; thus upsetting his son beyond limits.

Hindi Language.name: FryDay
Hindi Language.description: A desperate salesman Rajiv (Varun Sharma) is on the brink of losing his job at a water purifying company and asked to leave if he fails to sell at least one purifier by Friday. But, Rajiv finds himself in the middle of a marital mess when a seasoned ex-salesman Manchanda (Sanjay Mishra) puts him in touch with a quirky couple.

Hindi Language.name: The Past
Hindi Language.description: Two sisters Simran and Alia go on a vacation to Lonavala, where they experience paranormal activity at the bungalow that they're put up in, as an evil spirit takes over the place.

Hindi Language.name: Poison
Hindi Language.description: Jaiveer is back as Aditya to take revenge from the JOSH team comprising Sara, Harsh and Oscar. Watch out for the mind games that follow.

Hindi Language.name: Motichoor Chaknachoor
Hindi Language.description: A hilarious story of a 36-year-old jobless man Pushpender, trying to find a wife and Anita who's also looking for a husband. But there's a catch - Anita wants to settle abroad after marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Jabariya Jodi
Hindi Language.description: A thug helps kidnap grooms in order to avoid paying out dowries for their upcoming marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Divya Drishti
Hindi Language.description: Separated in childhood, Divya and Drishti attain super powers: they can not only see the future but also manipulate it. But their own futures lie in the hands of evil Pishachini.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny Ka Jholmaal
Hindi Language.description: A pair of cats join forces with a dog and parrot to defend their neighborhood from trouble, all while having playful adventures under Miss Katkar's roof.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Tum and Them
Hindi Language.description: Hum Tum And Them is the story of two single parents Shiva and Yudi, who have a second chance at love. Their teenage children try to deal with their past and their new lives, while Shiva and Yudi struggle to maintain their relationships.

Hindi Language.name: Dolly Kitty and Those Twinkling Stars
Hindi Language.description: A disillusioned Delhi wife and her new-in-town cousin navigate damning secrets, dreams and their thorny dynamic on their respective roads to freedom.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke
Hindi Language.description: Mishti, a young woman, is expected to settle for an arranged married by her family. However, she feels that she must get a chance to know her life partner well before tying the knot with him.

Hindi Language.name: Shubhratri
Hindi Language.description: A newlywed couple's contrasting desires create marital tensions that are eventually resolved through understanding and compromise.

Hindi Language.name: Ujda Chaman
Hindi Language.description: Chaman Kohli is 30 -year-old bachelor with Premature Balding and in quest of a beautiful wife. Chaman hits rock bottom when an astrologer gives him a deadline to find himself a wife or remain a celibate forever.

Hindi Language.name: The Typewriter
Hindi Language.description: Maya an award-winning Writer. Caught in the imagination of her Writing. But what you imagine every time can get u killed. Welcome to the World of Maya..

Hindi Language.name: Thinkistan
Hindi Language.description: The lives of people working for an advertising agency become entangled while they look out for ambition and power.

Hindi Language.name: Bar Code
Hindi Language.description: A friendship shattered by egos. Two close friends pulled apart by arrogance, destroying anyone who comes in their orbit.

Hindi Language.name: Ghode ko jalebi khilane le ja riya hoon
Hindi Language.description: A testament of time written in Old Delhi, past and present plotted in its lanes. The narrative moves like a homeless migrant, changing space and structure with each unfolding event, living in the twilight between the real and the dream.

Hindi Language.name: Bypass Road
Hindi Language.description: The Story revolves around a young man Vikram (Neil Nitin Mukesh) who is a fashion prodigy. The story is layered with a murder in town.

Hindi Language.name: Parchhayee: Ghost Stories by Ruskin Bond
Hindi Language.description: This winter, there's no escaping the shivers as ZEE5 Original 'Parchhayee' is all set to bring to life the most bone-chilling horror tales of celebrated author Ruskin Bond.

Hindi Language.name: Cargo
Hindi Language.description: A young female astronaut, who joins a reclusive astronaut aboard a spaceship, struggles with her job as she interacts with mysterious Cargos that appear on the ship.

Hindi Language.name: Hoorain
Hindi Language.description: These Fidayeens, bound by an unyielding faith, embark on a harrowing journey leading them to the celestial realms. Their ultimate goal is to meet the legendary 72 Virgins, known as the Hoorain.

Hindi Language.name: Fixerr
Hindi Language.description: One mistake and an ATS officer from Delhi becomes a fixer for the Mumbai film mafia and industrialists. Soon he finds himself trapped in a dangerous cycle. To end this crime game, he decides to play them all.

Hindi Language.name: Red Panty
Hindi Language.description: Red Panty is thriller web series featuring story of Indian housewife taking revenge from her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali
Hindi Language.description: Salim, a young Mughal prince falls for a courtesan named Anarkali but things become complicated after he faces opposition from Emperor Akbar, his father.

Hindi Language.name: Fareb
Hindi Language.description: Sanya's extramarital affair with a pizza delivery boy gets complicated when her sister-in-law arrives for an extended stay, leading to a series of close calls and risky maneuvers as she attempts to continue the forbidden liaison.

Hindi Language.name: Shaitaan Haveli
Hindi Language.description: When B-grade filmmaker Hariman shows up to shoot his horror film at an old haveli, freak occurrences make the crew suspect that instead of shooting a horror film, they will soon be living one.

Hindi Language.name: Yamla Pagla Deewana Phir Se
Hindi Language.description: An upright Ayurveda practitioner is hounded by big pharmacy giants for his age-old formula that cures everything.

Hindi Language.name: Black Coffee
Hindi Language.description: A young intern serves black coffee to his boss Riya and falls in love at first sight, she is also intrigued by Arjun and her own kinky imagination. Watch to know what all can happen over a black cup of coffee.

Hindi Language.name: Saand Ki Aankh
Hindi Language.description: Both over the age of 60, Chandro Tomar and Prakashi Tomar inspire other women in India when they demonstrate their expert sharpshooting skills.

Hindi Language.name: Nirvana Inn
Hindi Language.description: Nirvana Inn. A cycle of birth and death and reincarnation. This is the story of a boatman who becomes the caretaker of a Himalayan resort after an attempted suicide.

Hindi Language.name: Blank
Hindi Language.description: A suicide bomber loses his memory and has a bomb attached to his heart. It is up to the police officers to prevent this bomb from taking innocent lives.

Hindi Language.name: Choti Sarrdaarni
Hindi Language.description: Meher is coerced by her mother into marrying Sarabjeet, a widower with a 5 year-old child. But, much to her mother's dislike, Meher is pregnant with her lover, Manav's child. Can she stand up for her love and fight her own?

Hindi Language.name: Kissebaaz
Hindi Language.description: Set in Varanasi, the movie narrates a story of a man (played by Rahul Bagga), who is victim of a plot of a wily narrator.

Hindi Language.name: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
Hindi Language.description: When video blogger Saher Sethi embarks on a tedious trek with mountaineer Karan Sehgal, sparks are bound to fly. But will their love story blossom despite the odds?

Hindi Language.name: Damaged
Hindi Language.description: A psychological crime drama, the show follows seductress - Lovina, a remorseless serial killer, and a ruthless, angry and trigger-happy cop.

Hindi Language.name: Aurat
Hindi Language.description: Aurat is story of indian housewife from indian village taking revenge from her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Arjun Patiala
Hindi Language.description: Determined to make his town crime-free, Cop Arjun Pataila teams up with his quirky sidekick, Onnida Singh. However, his mission takes an unexpected turn when he falls for Ritu, a news reporter.

Hindi Language.name: Thackeray
Hindi Language.description: From controversial cartoonist to powerful Mumbai politician, this biopic maps the meteoric rise of far-right Shiv Sena party founder, Bal Thackeray.

Hindi Language.name: Happu Ki Ultan Paltan
Hindi Language.description: Daroga Happu Singh lands in trouble by having his own battalion of naughty children.

Hindi Language.name: Love Lust and Confusion
Hindi Language.description: A young woman navigates modern relationships, exploring polyamory and personal growth while facing romantic misadventures with a new connection she meets at a crossroads in her life.

Hindi Language.name: Used
Hindi Language.description: Relationship of two sisters entangled them in a dangerous game.

Hindi Language.name: Har Kisse Ke Hisse: Kaamyaab
Hindi Language.description: Sudheer is an actor from the heyday of Bollywood. Years after his retirement, he realizes that he 'retired' on the verge of accomplishing a unique record. He decides to come out of his retirement to complete the round figure of 500.

Hindi Language.name: Kaafir
Hindi Language.description: Web series that follows the journey of a journalist who is seeking justice for an alleged militant.

Hindi Language.name: Phamous
Hindi Language.description: India's highlands descend into bullet-riddled mayhem as the longtime rivalries and ruthless revenge missions among four men come to a head.

Hindi Language.name: The Insiders
Hindi Language.description: What would you do if you were locked in a room with a bunch of people every Saturday? On nights when the wifi was slow, they used their imagination to survive. A bunch of millennial's created a self proclaimed club called the INSIDERS.

Hindi Language.name: Haseena
Hindi Language.description: Three boys swooned by the beauty of Haseena, who they meet in Goa, find themselves in trouble when she loots them and runs away.

Hindi Language.name: Minus One: New Chapter
Hindi Language.description: Varun and Ria realise that they still might have feelings for each other, when Varun decides to take the big step of marriage with Anisha. As they deal with their repressed feelings, we also see how they fell in love and why they broke up.

Hindi Language.name: Rangeela Raja
Hindi Language.description: A strong career woman changes the life of a business tycoon and upsets his family. His brother attempts to set everything back to normal. Will he succeed?

Hindi Language.name: Tony: My Mentor the Serial Killer
Hindi Language.description: Four psychology students plant a camera in a church's confession box and come across a serial killer confessing to murder to the priest. Life takes a bizarre turn when they meet TONY, the serial killer and go on a murdering spree with him.

Hindi Language.name: Upstarts
Hindi Language.description: Hoping to do good while making millions, three graduates create a startup. But as business begins to flourish, their own bond starts to fray.

Hindi Language.name: Rajma Chawal
Hindi Language.description: An internet-rookie father attempts to use social media to enhance his faltering relationship with his millennial son.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome to New York
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to New York is a comedy film, in which Hero (Diljit Dosanjh), a sloppy recovery agent, and Jeenal Patel (Sonakshi Sinha), a fashion designer, become part of a big Bollywood event in New York - and chaos ensues.

Hindi Language.name: Amavas
Hindi Language.description: The lives of a couple turn into a nightmare, as dark forces lie in wait beneath the shadows of the haunted bungalow in which they have decided to stay.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Pyaar Nahi Toh Kya Hai
Hindi Language.description: Two childhood friends whose fate were intertwined reunite after years, but time has changed them.

Hindi Language.name: Mr. & Mrs.
Hindi Language.description: Here is Madhu and Sanju's hilarious conversation on daily life issues and how they deal with it together in their marriage with their fun rapport.

Hindi Language.name: Songs
Hindi Language.description: Challenged to compose 100 songs before he can marry the girl he loves, a tortured but passionate singer-songwriter embarks on a poignant musical journey.

Hindi Language.name: Khandaani Shafakhana
Hindi Language.description: A feisty girl from Punjab tries to continue her family traditions by opening a sex clinic to help and aware others in her hometown.

Hindi Language.name: G Gaali Galoch Girls
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around a group of girls and the relationship with their partners. The thrill, fun, excitement and romance makes it interesting.

Hindi Language.name: Junoon-E-Ishq
Hindi Language.description: A passionate romance between Ekta and Sheetal takes an obsessive turn when love and desire become dangerously intertwined, leading to unforeseen consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Home
Hindi Language.description: A middle-class family fights eviction, determined to keep their beloved home. Putting their values and unity to the test, they battle the authorities' decision. Will their efforts succeed or will they lose their most prized possession?

Hindi Language.name: Namaste England
Hindi Language.description: An Indian couple go to great lengths to move to London, England.

Hindi Language.name: Aap Ke Aa Jane Se
Hindi Language.description: A love story between a 42 year old middle class, conservative single mother, Vedika and a 24 year old irresponsible, maverick, Sahil, from a traditional, super rich business family.

Hindi Language.name: Haq Se
Hindi Language.description: Four blood-bound sisters with four passionate dreams, all yearning for one thing: fulfilment. This is a modern-day story of dreams, desires, love, war and the eternal pursuit of happiness, set against the breathtaking beauty and unsettling unrest of Kashmir.

Hindi Language.name: The Night
Hindi Language.description: A couple's car breaks down during a stormy night, leading them to seek shelter in a mysterious mansion owned by an alluring woman who may have sinister intentions.

Hindi Language.name: Eeb Allay Ooo!
Hindi Language.description: A young migrant battles hordes of monkeys in the heart of New Delhi as a contractual monkey repeller.

Hindi Language.name: Kullfi Kumarr Bajewala
Hindi Language.description: The story follows the journey of a young singing prodigy Kullfi, who sets out to find her father, Sikandar Singh Gill.

Hindi Language.name: Vish Ya Amrit - Sitara
Hindi Language.description: Bishakha is born to a Vishkanya but her father fought a pitched battle to keep her away from the evil forces. But what happens when fate brings her back to the doorstep of where it all started? Good or evil, what will Bishakha choose?

Hindi Language.name: Auction
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around a group of girls being trafficked and sold on auction and how the illegal business gets exposed.

Hindi Language.name: Medically Yourrs
Hindi Language.description: Childhood friends now medical students Abir and Nibedita take different paths, as he struggles with his father's renown while she excels, causing tensions at Kolkata's KIMS. They and their friends fight personal battles to pass finals.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Circus
Hindi Language.description: Contestants presents their acts and takes you in laughter town with their presence, talent and timing.

Hindi Language.name: Bahu Begum
Hindi Language.description: Azaan finds his soulmate in Shayra, but his mother, Begum Razia wants him to get married to her best friend's daughter, Noor. However, love triumphs against all odds in this battle - but not for too long.

Hindi Language.name: Halkaa
Hindi Language.description: Halkaa (Relief) is a unique take on a slum child's heroism, aspirations and dreams. The child protagonist, Pichku fights for the basic problem that he faces everyday; defecating in the open among others.

Hindi Language.name: Bepanah Pyarr
Hindi Language.description: Raghbir's first wife is dead, he is about to marry his childhood friend but even before the ceremony begins another woman is already claiming he's her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi
Hindi Language.description: Harpreet Kaur, a woman who travels to China to find her fiance, gets mistakenly kidnapped by some thugs whose assignment was to abduct another woman of the same name travelling by the same flight.

Hindi Language.name: Moksh To Maya
Hindi Language.description: Moksh to Maya is a sinful journey of the character 'Maya' who is in love with four men at the same time. The movie depicts her life and her choices, some good and some bad. Is she a criminal or a revenge seeker?

Hindi Language.name: Cabaret
Hindi Language.description: The films follows the life of a cabaret dancer.

Hindi Language.name: Hey Prabhu!
Hindi Language.description: The show revolves around the millennial's and what they go through in their everyday lives. "Hey Prabhu" is the story of a common man Tarun Prabhu and his unbelievable journey.

Hindi Language.name: Sanjivani
Hindi Language.description: Under Dr Shashank's tutelage, Dr Sid loves to bend the rules while Dr Ishani prefers to play by them. In the new-age medical system, will they manage to be the 'dream docs' for every patient?

Hindi Language.name: RejctX
Hindi Language.description: High school thriller drama set in an elite International school. It deals with teen millennial issues such as body shaming, gender fluidity, sexual orientation and love which inspires them to form their own band.

Hindi Language.name: House Arrest
Hindi Language.description: A world-weary man's self-imposed home confinement becomes a comedy of errors with the simultaneous arrivals of a peculiar package and a curious journalist.

Hindi Language.name: Sarfarosh - Saragarhi 1897
Hindi Language.description: A chronicle of the lives and events that led to the brave and epic last stand of the 21 soldiers of the 36th Sikh regiment of the British Indian Army against thousands of Afghani invaders in the September of 1897.

Hindi Language.name: Enaaya
Hindi Language.description: A college student with father-estrangement issues and a passion for music finds herself being roped into the college band. The lead singer's girlfriend takes an instant dislike to Enaaya and there is friction on stage.

Hindi Language.name: Megalopolis
Hindi Language.description: An 18 year boy from a small town in Maharashtra comes to a big city to take revenge from a man called Kamal who killed his parents. He encounters many mysterious characters who help him to get Kamal. And a group of young nihilist radicals who want to blow up the city. this group is also lead by a man called Kamal. And the post apocalyptic nature of the city. these get intertwined with each other as the boy goes through a surreal journey through hell.

Hindi Language.name: Albert Pinto Ko Gussa Kyun Aata Hai?
Hindi Language.description: Albert Pinto goes missing one day and his girlfriend and family start making rounds at the police station to track him down. Unknown to them, he is on his way to Goa to carry out his first assignment as a hitman.

Hindi Language.name: Puncch Beat
Hindi Language.description: Things change when there is a murder of a student in the school and everyone becomes a suspect. And during the investigation, so many secrets will be revealed that might break or make friends and relationships.

Hindi Language.name: Dance Bar
Hindi Language.description: Dhanraj Shikhawat, a well established business tycoon, expresses his love for a bar dancer, Ayesha. Soon he finds himself in a strange situation when Ayesha pops up three conditions to be fulfilled, before she gets laid.

Hindi Language.name: My Name Ijj Lakhan
Hindi Language.description: Lakhan, a kind-hearted hooligan, balances his tough persona while trying to commit good deeds for the people as he often finds himself in comical situations.

Hindi Language.name: Shubharambh
Hindi Language.description: Shubharambh is a story of Rani who is a hardworking girl and she does everything she can to make ends meet. Destiny will bring her to Raja, who changes her life completely. But leading to some misunderstandings...........

Hindi Language.name: Bhonsle
Hindi Language.description: Bhonsle is a retired policeman and is living a non-interfering life in a colony dominated by locals, diagnosed with stage 4 brain tumor. When the migrant resident politics take a nasty turn, he chooses to take a stance and deal with it.

Hindi Language.name: Size Matters
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around a boy planning for marriage and falls in love with a girl.

Hindi Language.name: Anjaan: Special Crimes Unit
Hindi Language.description: Two police officers, ASP Aditi Sharma the believer and ACP Vikrant Singhal the skeptic, investigate strange unsolved cases, while unnatural forces impede their efforts.

Hindi Language.name: Court Room: Sachchai Hazir Ho
Hindi Language.description: Inspired from the real cases put forward to the court. It deals the problems in name changing, cold murder and gives a logical moral to the case.

Hindi Language.name: Kahaan Hum Kahaan Tum
Hindi Language.description: A chance encounter brings together Dr. Rohit, a heart surgeon and Sonakshi, a TV actress. Starting off on a wrong foot, they are amazed at the differences in their worlds, and what begins then is a bond that alters their lives forever.

Hindi Language.name: High Jack
Hindi Language.description: Four angry employees hijack a Goa to Delhi plane to settle their dues and take revenge against their employer. Things take a turn when the passengers accidentally consume drinks laced with drugs.

Hindi Language.name: Battalion 609
Hindi Language.description: The story of Battalion 609 revolves around a cricket match between the Indian Army and the Pakistan army gone wrong and narrates the tale of the brave soldiers of Battalion 609 putting up a fight with the mighty Taliban.

Hindi Language.name: Guddan Tumse Na Ho Payega
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around Guddan, a 20-year-old girl, who makes a mess of every opportunity that comes her way and therefore people have lost all hopes on her. Life takes an unexpected turn when she marries an old man and becomes India's youngest mother-in-law. Can Guddan handle her three daughters-in-law, who are older to her, and prove her critics wrong by overcoming all her challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Water Bottle
