Hindi Language.description: It's a story of a really innocent guy from Allahabad, Somehow, he becomes doubtful about his sexuality and does many things suggested by his so-called well-wishers without thinking anything and gets stuck in more and more problems.

Hindi Language.name: Family Time with Kapil Sharma
Hindi Language.description: Family Time With Kapil Sharma is an Indian Hindi stand-up comedy and game show which premiered on 25 March 2018. The show is broadcast on Sony TV. Neha Pendse is the co-host of this show while Kiku Sharda and Chandan Prabhakar appear at regular intervals to crack jokes and participate in the games that are being played. Family members selected from all over India participate in the show and play games to win prizes.

Hindi Language.name: The Star Gazers of India
Hindi Language.description: The Star Gazers Of India is an Indian television show. It is broadcast every Saturday and Sunday on India News. Direction and concept of the show is given by Dushyant Pratap Singh under the banner of Dushyant Corporation. While the show was hosted by Ritu Singh, Pratima Totala, Raju Kher, Pankaj Berry. In this show, well-known personalities like Sunil Pal, Mustaq Khan, have been interviewed.

Hindi Language.name: The Himalayan Diaries
Hindi Language.description: A beautiful romantic- comedy, love story based in town of Shimla. The Himalayan Diaries is a contemporary love story of Abhimanyu and Diva, which revolves around the beautiful town of Shimla. Directed by Anjanikumar and produced by Diginox studios.

Hindi Language.name: Kutte Ki Dum
Hindi Language.description: Five youngsters who follow the trouble or trouble follows them every time they try to show their smartness. As in reality, everyone is struggling to fulfil his/her own dreams any cost. It's a big satire on humans, humanity who follows the right path will achieve, and the rest will remain KUTTE KI DUM.

Hindi Language.name: Ilaaka Kishorganj
Hindi Language.description: Rooma comes to Ranchi from Sri Lanka, She stays in Kishoreganj at Raja's apartment. Raja is gangster who works for Tony. Tony too likes Roma but because of Raja he can not have her. But Later Toneys opponent Michel is killed in a confrontation by Tony. Tony force Raja to Take responsibility for the murder. Raja does it for his mentor after getting married to Roma, Raja goes to jail and Tony tries to get roma. when raja returns from jail on parole he is attacked. but his friend peter is killed in it. when raja meets Tony. he finds that tony has joined hands with rao who was his opponent.

Hindi Language.name: Chai Coffee
Hindi Language.description: An upset musician comes to an unidentified place for isolation but his life changes as he meets a girl with extremely spontaneous yet thoughtful nature.

Hindi Language.name: Band Radio
Hindi Language.description: That first Radio in the village which changed everyone's life..

Hindi Language.name: Upeksha
Hindi Language.description: The film revolves around the struggle of eunuchs in our society. This is a true story of a family who face the trauma and agony when they come to know that a handsome boy who born in their house is actually a eunuch when he attended age of 12 year.

Hindi Language.name: Dhumkkudiya
Hindi Language.description: The backdrop of the movie is a tribal setting in Jharkhand A girl named Rishu is promised a chance of living out her dreams of playing hockey and is sent to the capital of the country for supposedly better training facilities. However, instead of the hockey training institution, she is sent to a household to work as a domestic maid/helper. She is totally unaware that she will not be playing hockey at all but instead will have to accept her fate of being a domestic helper. The man of this house repeatedly rapes her and stuns her into silence. She gets pregnant with the rapist's child and is unable to do anything about it and has almost but given up on her life. Since the woman of the house doesn't want pregnant Rishu around anymore, she is sent away to another job where inspite being very visibly pregnant she is again raped by the overseer. She gives birth to the baby and decides to get away from everything and return to her hometown but on the way back she along with the baby are killed. The movie is very hard hitting and a wake-up call for all.

Hindi Language.name: KHATA-Kaash Humse Na Hoti
Hindi Language.description: Raj Malhotra is a Business Tycoon in Mumbai He have two Children Raj and Mili, and Raj Have a Wife named Khushi Malhotra, Raj wants a House Keeper so Comes a Beautiful teenager Syla (Main Lead) in Raj's House. Raj and His wife have no understanding which benefit pic to Syla and He closed to Raj and done a Physical Relation with Raj Khushi knows it and She is in Comma To be continued..

Hindi Language.name: Chal Jaa Bapu
Hindi Language.description: This movie is about a phony, irresponsible and idle man who finds a 500 rupee note which teaches him how to work hard and live a dignified life with self-respect.

Hindi Language.name: Hum to Huye Hain Tumhare
Hindi Language.description: Love story of a RJ and boxing champion start with full of romance and how end with a tragedy.

Hindi Language.name: Bajra Vs Burger
Hindi Language.description: A small town guy decides to leave his simple life behind and move to the city to pursue his dream. However, events take a hilarious turn when he faced with struggles of city life. Will be able to survive in the city or will he return to his organic life?.

Hindi Language.name: Byomkesh 2.0
Hindi Language.description: What circumstances forces an aspiring Engineer to become a Detective? All we know that nothing can stop him from hunting the criminals. Byomkesh 2.0

Hindi Language.name: Bhavar
Hindi Language.description: This thriller drama revolves around a group of NRI Bengalis, both from India and Bangladesh, who come together to organise and celebrate Durga Puja. However, a terrorist group plans to disrupt the event. Who will win in this battle of the good vs evil?

Hindi Language.name: Dravya
Hindi Language.description: The thriller drama revolves around the life of a small-time scientist who claims to have invented a herbal fuel that can create a revolution in the petroleum industry.

Hindi Language.name: Pinch by Arbaaz Khan
Hindi Language.description: A tell all show about how the stars deal with their Social Media lives with everyday abuse which is just to amuse the trollers.

Hindi Language.name: Couple of More Mistakes
Hindi Language.description: The series revolves around the hilarious incidents that place in the life of young couples.

Hindi Language.name: Lakhmipur ke Lukkhe
Hindi Language.description: The Unemployed Youth of Today is trying to find the cure of is mental depression in drunkenness due to which his social statusis declining. When declining social stauts and imbalance of gender ratio put obstacles in the way of his marriage,either he commits an unsocial act such as making a girl elope with him in the name of marriage or he resorts to immoral means of sex. Consequently, the society ostracizes him reluctantly , Daksh of village Lakhmipur is such youth who is now grown up but owing to his such activities, he was treated as an outcaste. Therefore, he could not get married. One day ,Daksh goes to Dholagarh, a distant village , to meet his companion named Jagga. Jagga has already been murdered.when Daksh makes enquiries about jagga here and there ,the illiterate villagers think him a man of C.B.I. thinking him a Government servant , Jagga's widow wants to marry her adult daughter Geeta to Daksh.Geeta too is Infatuated with him wholeheartedly. Therefor, Daksh's desire to setup a household by getting married becomes stronger, but then it comes to his mind that he is treated as an outcaste in his village ,so getting married is difficult. At night Daksh Dreams that on the Instigation of a friend he brings Geeta as a wife to his village;but Geeta's mother also reaches there in pursuance of them and gets him arrested with the help of villagers. On waking up he becomes Unhappy. In the morning the Ex-serpanch of the village ,who had got him ostracized, reaches to him .Daksh begs pardon form the Ex-Serpanch for his previous deeds on the advice of his friend. Having given him some Instructions the surpanch pardons him and gets him married with Geeta in a Proper way.

Hindi Language.name: Bagpat Ka Dulha
Hindi Language.description: Bagpat ka dulha is a film where no one wants Shiv Shukla and Anjali's marriage, even Shiv and Anjali too, comedy of errors , based in Bagpat Uttar Pradesh .

Hindi Language.name: Adventures of Ali Baba
Hindi Language.description: A completely new take on the famous old Ali Baba story: Ali and Bab are two orphaned children blessed with supernatural powers. Their mission is to spread love, protect the secrets of the dungeons, and conquer evil forces.

Hindi Language.name: Parsi Bawa Kare Dhamaal
Hindi Language.description: The web series revolves around the main character "Parsi Bawa' who is a nice guy with great sense of humor. He is very simple person who always gets stuck in some issue created by his own or his friends mistakes.

Hindi Language.name: The Colour of My Home
Hindi Language.description: What happens to people when they are violently displaced? Forced out of their home and ancestral village, buffeted by winds of hate, running for their lives, scattered like human debris in relief camps. Never able to return. How do they rebuild new homes and new lives, with hearts unable to leave the old one behind? This film is about survivors of Muzaffarnagar, a town in north India, where targetted violence in 2013 forced over 60,000 people to flee their homes in fear. Many could never return. An estimated 60 people were killed, and 40 more died later in the relief camps - mostly children who perished from cold and sickness in a bitter winter. The Colour of My Home is about rebuilding broken lives. It is about the scars that hate and violence leave on the human soul. It is about memory and loss. It is also about the spirit to survive.

Hindi Language.name: Agarzari
Hindi Language.description: Living in the shadows of fear, anger and helplessness for years is Agarzari, a man-animal conflict hit village in the Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve, India. The livelihood of the villagers is a question and their survival an even bigger one.

Hindi Language.name: Main Shaheed aur Shahjahanpur
Hindi Language.description: This short documentary is a tribute to the filmmaker's hometown, Shahjahanpur, Through stunning cinematography and personal memories connecting the town to theater, it captures the beauty and nostalgia of the place they once called home.

Hindi Language.name: Slumdog Karodpati
Hindi Language.description: Slumdog Karodpati is a heart touching story of an orphan, a waste picker. 27-year-old boy Municipality (Govindrao) is an impoverished orphan boy who unfortunately rescues the kidnapped girl Himani Singhania (Madhura) from Jaggu Dada gang and gets a chance to marriage with Himani Singhania (Madhura) who Millionaire by birth. In the flashback, the movie reveals the story of his life in the slums, the struggles, kidnapping, his love, his near-friend death experience, and how he gets married to Millionaire girl and become a Millionaire / Karodpati.

Hindi Language.name: Ghulaami
Hindi Language.description: India is Male Dominating society but there are some males who like dominating females.Comedy on slave husbands and Male where women is the boss.

Hindi Language.name: Unto an Evil Counsellor
Hindi Language.description: Six months after a near-fatal accident, Detective Sarvesh Sinha returns to duty to investigate the murder of a drug peddler. He partners with rookie officer Vijay Vinayak after a cryptic riddle is discovered at the crime scene.

Hindi Language.name: Akbar and Birbal
Hindi Language.description: Lively Stories About Emperor Akbar And His Favorite Courtier Birbal. Birbal Is The Wittiest And Most Intelligent Minister In The Kingdom Of Akbar. He Solves Several Problems Of The King And the People Of His Kingdom.

Hindi Language.name: Opposites Attract
Hindi Language.description: A fading superstar, Honey Kapoor, tries to regain his superstardom by rebooting his cult films as "69 Opposites Attract" that tries to find an answer to the perennial global question - can a boy and a girl really just be good friends?

Hindi Language.name: Parinda
Hindi Language.description: Parul and Govinda met on social media, later they find out that their name initials and finals make the world Parinda. they started getting fame with the name of Parinda. But Family had other bigger plans about them.

Hindi Language.name: Compromise
Hindi Language.description: A small town girl with a dream to become a Bollywood heroine comes to Mumbai only to find out that it is a dangerous place for an outsider. Will she be able to make it big or will she lose herself in this dreamy world?

Hindi Language.name: Sarkaar Haazir Ho
Hindi Language.description: This whodunit double murder mystery follows the story of a feisty young woman named Juhi Sarkar who is suddenly found murdered on her eighteenth birthday along with the servant of her house Hemu Kaka. Her parents are held responsible for the deaths. What follows are nail-biting courtroom confrontations that reveal dark, chilling secrets of everyone associated with the victims.

Hindi Language.name: High Feverdance Ka Naya Tevar
Hindi Language.description: With no bar for age, it provides a platform for the dancers to put their best foot forward.

Hindi Language.name: Gurudakshina
Hindi Language.description: Gurudakshing is story of english teaching professor giving english lessons to mature aged male having difficulty in doing his job without english knowledge.

Hindi Language.name: Laughter Ke Chapter
Hindi Language.description: Think what will happen when the robber Gabbar Singh meets smuggler Veerappan with his gang Kalia and Sambha ?. There is also a love story between these two gangsters, which has more of a comedy twist than romance, In the movie Laughter Ke Chapter you will get double dose of comedy.

Hindi Language.name: Ghoonghat Wali Chudail
Hindi Language.description: Anokhi a clever girl with her brother, traps people to loot their property

Hindi Language.name: Trending Talents
Hindi Language.description: Trending Talents is a show by Digital Commentary focused on covering life stories of talents (actor and actress) in the digital/OTT space.

Hindi Language.name: Cant Stay Down
Hindi Language.description: Profiling the community clubs around the world where combat sports are practiced as a way to engage youth and improve people's lives.

Hindi Language.name: College ke Din Char
Hindi Language.description: A bunch of college students are living their lives - having fun, finding love until the ghost appears.

Hindi Language.name: Nescafe Basement
Hindi Language.description: Nescafé Basement is a Pakistani/Indian music television series which features live studio-recorded music performances by underground artists. The show is produced by Nescafé.

Hindi Language.name: Toughest Men in India
Hindi Language.description: An 8-part documentary series bringing to light unsung heroes, men with professions that push their bodies and minds to the limit. The series is a portrayal of their inner lives, motivations and daily struggles.

Hindi Language.name: Strawberry Blues
Hindi Language.description: A retired gangster returns to his old job unwilling to find money to treat his ill wife. He has to eliminate a secret cult group as the vengeance of a movie actress. the journey of revenge into big realisation for the gangster and the actress.

Hindi Language.name: Unfolding Stardom
Hindi Language.description: Unfolding Stardom is a casual chat show that takes you inside the homes of India's top digital celebrities and gives the audience the glimpse of their reel and real lives. It's live on the YouTube channel called "Digital Commentary"

Hindi Language.name: Jaadui Bunayi
Hindi Language.description: A model from Mumbai travels across the various parts of India to discover the fabrics that the places offer. We meet the various weavers who showcase their art that has been passed on from generations. The first season is on Benarasi, Bhagalpuri, Kanjeevaram, Paithani, Chanderi, Kunbi, Ikkat and Jamdani.

Hindi Language.name: Maaraq
Hindi Language.description: In an effort to establish direct communication with the god, an anonymous person calling himself 'maaraq' gives up food and water till he dies. A struggling documentary film maker 'Pratishtha Singh' decides to shoot Maaraq's journey till his demise to earn a few bucks along with some attention from the market, due to the desperate and chaotic measures they encounter a series of events and characters that shape their lives eventually granting 'Maaraq's ultimate wish.

Hindi Language.name: Weekend
Hindi Language.description: Weekend is story of girl cheating many men and doing fraud but she has some other intentions.

Hindi Language.name: Lynchistan
Hindi Language.description: A 24 year old singer is accused of raping an upper caste woman and a set of angry mob wants him to get the maximum punishment. An Inspector and a Constable who handles the case plot to make their future with the case. They decide to shoot the convict in a fake encounter to get immediate fame and glory.

Hindi Language.name: Tu to Hai Bas Ek Kirdaar
Hindi Language.description: A Girl in a small town of Allahabad wants to be an actor. She is not a very great actor. Then she joins a theater acting institute of a very strict teacher "Ashok Panch". It's the story of a girl learning the art of acting through the hardships of life.

Hindi Language.name: DEV!LL
Hindi Language.description: While recovering from breakup with Paaro, Dev faces the tragic death of his mother which turns his life upside down. But somehow, at last, he manages to overcome every wrong situation and stand himself.

Hindi Language.name: Kuch Der Aur
Hindi Language.description: The film follows the heartfelt journey of a young boy trying to find a moment of bliss in his life filled with impassiveness and eternal wait, to which thousands of lives in Chandni Chowk are already accustomed.

Hindi Language.name: Billu Ustaad
Hindi Language.description: An extraordinary story of a small boy and his journey from orphanage to being a son of an IAS officer and his fight against terrorism to save his dear friends.

Hindi Language.name: Fokatiye
Hindi Language.description: 'Fokatiye', is a story of 4 guys out of which 3 (Jaan, Dinesh, Suraj) are good for nothing and always rely on money of Jeetu who is in love with Shreya. All the four guys encounter with Surya Bhau and a clever dancer baba named Bangdu Baba... a mad comedy with hilarious twists.

Hindi Language.name: Bedhab
Hindi Language.description: A rich ill mannered Jingle Composer is left by his love of life Anya and is visited by a modern age God Of Death (Yamraaj) , who offers to take his life in a unique way via a special deal, will he find a way out or will he give up and succumb to God of Death's plan? Will Anya come back in his life?

Hindi Language.name: Suno Parth
Hindi Language.description: Suno Parth is a religious talk show revolves around Ritu Singh , Pooja Mathur and Pradeep Chandiramani

Hindi Language.name: Mudda hai Bhookh: The War
Hindi Language.description: The film revolves around the fact that the mid-day meal facility provided by the Government for the primary schools are being misused by the officials and used for their personal benefit. The word 'Bhookh' is a symbol of the hunger for rights and betterment of the society.

Hindi Language.name: Eat Right India Series: Agra & Mathura
Hindi Language.description: After a journey of more than 2700kms, Swasth Bharat Yatra, on South Central Track has reached Agra from Puducherry. Yatra has covered Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. Learn more about ancient food traditions and age old healthy eating practices. This episode highlights importance of balanced diet, maintaining personal and workplace hygiene and usage of right food serving mediums.

Hindi Language.name: Heritage of Thrall
Hindi Language.description: "Heritage of Thrall" is first full length documentary film on Hand pulled narrate the life of these hand rickshaw puller replacing animal since British time in Kolkata. This documentary film covers the story of Hand rickshaw-pullers who normally come to Kolkata from either Bihar or Jharkhand. Many rickshaw puller have lasted their life due to tuberculosis, Asthma, Malnutrition Heritage of Thrall explain the inhuman practice which ruin the principal of a democratic nation. This documentary hints the aspect of humanity which is preserved as heritage. This documentary raise issue that any Heritage must be for the proud, if anything which is defilement on democracy must not be treated as heritage. A pulled rickshaw is a mode of human-powered transport by which a runner draws a two-wheeled cart which seats one or two people which is treated as inhuman and have been banned across the world but not in Kolkata.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny As Police Petrol
Hindi Language.description: The fun-tastic Honey Bunny will kickstart the day at 9 AM with the movie, Honey Bunny as Police Patrol where they will save the day against dangerous criminals.

Hindi Language.name: Touttay
Hindi Language.description: This times it is not about Freedom of Speech but Freedom of Thought.

Hindi Language.name: Cashless India
Hindi Language.description: This story is based on Note ban demonetisation. It affects the common people as well as the goons. It depicts the hostility of two factions those who bet that the 500000 currency will change that person will rule the city. Meanwhile there is complete entertainment which Comedy is full of action romance.

Hindi Language.name: Shehjar
Hindi Language.description: A young Kashmiri Couple with their two teenage sons travel from Kashmir to Mumbai for a brief stay. Slowly the families interaction in the new surroundings put their relations to test leading to unexpected consequences and revelations.

Hindi Language.name: Moti Bagh
Hindi Language.description: Against the forces of migration, Vidyadutt Sharma - farmer, activist and poet, chronicles the changing landscape in verses of resistance. As he and Ram Singh, his Nepali farmhand, plough the fields to keep a dream called Moti Bagh alive, we wonder if it will ever return to its old glory.

Hindi Language.name: Baatein Ankahee with Dr. Krupesh
Hindi Language.description: In this 1st Series of the show Dr. Krupesh will narrate his emotional poetry on different relations, festivals and romance. The audience will feel the connection with the words, music and emotions that flows through the poems.

Hindi Language.name: Wo Jo Tha EK Messiah Maulana Azad
Hindi Language.description: The film is based on the life of Maulana Azad, the first education minister of independent India, who fought valiantly, devoting his whole life for the Hindu-Muslim unity.

Hindi Language.name: Prarabdh
Hindi Language.description: Understanding life through Bhagvaad Gita Saar.

Hindi Language.name: Maa Purnagiri
Hindi Language.description: This movie is based on mythological place "Maa Purnagiri" situated at Tanakpur, Uttarakhand, India. Maa Purnagiri is well known a spiritual shaktipith one of 51. Maa Purnagiri is a symbol and aw tar of ma ta parvati. More then one lake disciple go to take ashirvad of ma ta purnagiri.

Hindi Language.name: An Excursion: From the Archives of Kaagaz Ki Kashti
Hindi Language.description: An Excursion is a priceless collection of over 3 hours of captivating interviews on Jagjit Singh's life, music and magic. Much more and beyond what you came across in the film, Kaagaz Ki Kashti, which traces the life journey of a down-to-earth, small-town boy, who made it big by breaking through the norms and revolutionizing the Ghazal scenario, by texturing traditional Ghazal singing with western instruments and making it simple and can be hummed, enticing new listeners into becoming Gazal fans. The collection is broadly divided into seven broad categories, which are The Musician, Lyrical World of Ghazals, Song Memoirs, Persona, Formative Years, You and I, Wistful Memories by Chitra Singh.

Hindi Language.name: What the Duck Season 4
Hindi Language.description: What the Duck is a chat show where stand up comedian and self proclaimed cricket pundit Vikram Sathaye has a chat with cricketing greats about cricket...and also everything else. They discuss stories about their career highs, lows, laughs and most importantly, their ducks. Watch your favourite cricketers in a candid, hilarious avatar you've never seen before.

Hindi Language.name: Sirf 5 Din
Hindi Language.description: A supernatural horror film in which a woman attempts to help a man named Shanti an abuse victim, who he found chained up in a Lonavala bungalow .

Hindi Language.name: Mere Ghar Bhi Aaja Na Maa
Tragedy of a Thought (Trasdi Ek Soch Ki)
Hindi Language.description: 'Tragedy of a Thought' (Trasdi Ek Soch Ki) is a Tragic saga of four Generations of Dev Dutt's Family, caught up in hate-filled, unending violent Communal conflict. The Epic time-scale of the Story, Chronicles the majority of tragic political events of Indian history, simultaneously peeking into conflicts, fears, emotions of Dutt's family.

Hindi Language.name: Vishwas Se Upar Aastha
Hindi Language.description: Vishwas Se Upar Aastha is a drama series in Hindi language showcasing stories of miracles that will make you believe in existence of the Almighty, to be above all the human beings.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Brave Series
Hindi Language.description: Blood, gore, guts, glory- welcome to the Brave Combat, the largest mixed martial arts championship across 5 continents. Watch as the best MMA artists from 28 nations engage in the ultimate no-hold-barred battle for the world champion title.

Hindi Language.name: The Joyous Nights of a Ridiculous Man
Hindi Language.description: A story of three dispossessed people in the times rising communalism and right wing forces. It is an adaptation of Dostoevesky's and Premchand's short stories. The film is a minimalist and sparse look at the alienation of a small town photo studio owner. The protagonist, Gulmohar finds himself completely out of sync with changing times and has dug himself deep into an abyss of mass media and pornography. In order to escape from his mundane existence, he takes a flight into the world of dreams and ironically experiences emotions and idealism in this world of dreams. It explores his relationship with a sex professional, his betrayal, his guilt, and his redemption but not before he falls in love. The film is the meeting of the political with the poetic. The film follows a back n forth movement in time and concentrates on specific episodes in the life of the protagonist. These episodes have an extremely abstract representation and therefore extremely stylised. A voiceover in the form of dialogue with its immediate environment and the audience.

Hindi Language.name: Rituals of Bheel tribes - Gatla Parampara
Speak Out with Nafisa
Hindi Language.description: We, humans, have opinions on various topics, yet very few dare to speak out. But our Mumbaikars never step back when it comes to making their opinions known, you just need to ask them. 'Speak Out With Nafisa' aims at knowing Mumbaikars opinions on various trending topics.

Hindi Language.name: A Biopic from the Film Industry
Yours Cupidly
Hindi Language.description: After ending her toxic relationship, a girl meets a boy on a dating app. Will he be the one for her?

Hindi Language.name: My India My Bike
Hindi Language.description: The 2 hour 17 minute film "My India My Bike" endeavor to show the journey almost India from the perspective of a bike rider. The film shows the journey from Mumbai to Kanyakumari, Kanyakumari to Kashmir and finally from Kashmir to Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Vaña Vaasiyon
Hindi Language.description: The voices of the adivasis and indigenous peoples expressing their joy and pain and various other in-between emotions of being Vaña Vaasiyon "or forest dwellers" will actively engage you in this film.

Hindi Language.name: Ganit
Hindi Language.description: Movie is inspired by a true incident which is surrounded by a social message that can change the world to become a better place. It has a tagline of "Karmon Ka Lekha Ya Hathon Ki Rekha hai Ganit."

Hindi Language.name: People's Restaurant
Hindi Language.description: The show has 3 participants and 2 Celebrity Guests in each episode consisting of local well-known personalities belonging to different walks of life such as a food connoisseurs, radio jockey, actors, socialites and one will be a user of the Ticket Restaurant Meal Vouchers. These selected participants and guests experience the gourmet delights and cuisines served by the restaurants in their city. The restaurants are rated by them and the highest scoring restaurant is declared as the 'People's Restaurant of that particular city.

Hindi Language.name: Yoga Vibes ft. Mansi Gulati
Hindi Language.description: Mansi Gulati, a Yoga expert, give a quick fix to improve your well-being through the ancient practice of Yoga.

Hindi Language.name: Inspector Chingum
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Chingum, the in-charge of Sandalwood Police Station is a duty-bound, exceedingly self-confident yet supremely clumsy cop. Known by his characteristic heavy South Indian accent, Chingum wish to make Shantiwood a 'zero crime city'.

Hindi Language.name: Crossing the river of life
Hindi Language.description: Social Justice is dear to me. Freedom of speech is a luxury and many don't have that privilege. This film is a humble attempt to voice the concerns of domestic workers from India who are often victims of Human trafficking.

Hindi Language.name: The Unseen Sikkim
Hindi Language.description: The Unseen Sikkim depicts the beautiful and unknown views of Sikkim. It is the most watched documentary film based on Sikkim. After watching this film, tourism of bike riders has increased in Sikkim.

Hindi Language.name: Midnight Delhi
Hindi Language.description: There are always three versions of the story Your version My version & The Truth & each version looks real. You choose yours.

Hindi Language.name: Cut-Copy-Paste, An Indian Startup Story
Hindi Language.description: Startups are the new magic wand. They will solve all our problems as IT did in 90s and 2000s or manufacturing was to solve in 70s and 80s or PSUs were to solve in 50s and 60s. It's already falling apart. The most successful Indian startups are making losses. In fact, all of them are making losses. Will venture capital sustain it? For how long.

Hindi Language.name: Duck Se Dude
Hindi Language.description: The show tells the story of Manjit, an introvert, whose life turns upside down when his childhood love falls for the cricket team's captain. Desperate to win back the girl, he seeks the help of a local RJ.

Hindi Language.name: Kumbh A Celebration of Spirituality
Hindi Language.description: From millions of devotees taking a dip in the holy river to Aghoris and Naga Sadhus adorned with dreadlocks on their faces, Kumbh A Celebration of Spirituality is a unique example of spirituality.

Hindi Language.name: Express Yourself
Hindi Language.description: Four individuals, empowered by their creativity and self-expression are championing change this #Elections2019. Join Sonu Nigam, Monica Dogra, Papon and Swanand Kirkire on #ExpressYourself. All episodes out on MX Player on 27th April.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Alert II independence Special Salma Aur Kashmir
India Ke Mast Kalandar
Hindi Language.description: India Ke Mast Kalandar is a reality show judged by Geeta Kapoor and Mika Singh which gives people a chance to showcase their unique talent.

Hindi Language.name: Lul Bate Lul
Hindi Language.description: Lul Bate Lul is a Hindi comedy feature film about three carefree friends whose mischievous actions unexpectedly turn them into heroes when they save a troubled woman and inspire her to live with hope.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny and Doggy's Day Out
MTV Beats - Secret Side with Akasa
Hindi Language.description: The Show reveals the secret side of Bollywood Musicians that you cannot find over the internet as well.

Hindi Language.name: Mungerilal B Tech
Hindi Language.description: This film portrays the story of two college friends - Mungerilal and Pintu. Their college life throws various challenges and problems at them forcing them to walk on a very risky journey.

Hindi Language.name: Lasafot
Hindi Language.description: LASAFOT is a story of a family of a mother, a handicap elder son, a rebel rowdy younger son that splits in one day and gets destroyed in trying to keep to save themselves and get their goals.

Hindi Language.name: Vatsyayana
Hindi Language.description: The one sport that's played across the globe and enjoyed the most is "SEX". What happens when the man who wrote the rules of engagement comes back to life and demands that sex be given its rightful respect and dignity. The return of Vatsyayana.

Hindi Language.description: Falling in love is one of the most awesome phases of our lives, but the problem starts when we move in together and a live-in relationship happens. So, here is a series that captures some light-hearted love and hate moments in a live-in couple.

Hindi Language.name: Shaadi Fit
Hindi Language.description: The series revolves around the life of four couples that are put over an intensive journey that are required to turn things into the right shape along with getting the physical, mental and emotion life in the right shape so as to prepare the best for their wedding day.

Hindi Language.name: Stop or I Will Shoot
Hindi Language.description: Stop and shoot is story of two couples.

Hindi Language.description: About a life in a Village where basic amenities still lacks even after 65 years of independence. But Village people have desire and hope to walk with the pace of the country. They try every possible way despite various obstacles.

Hindi Language.name: DD Science
Hindi Language.description: DD Science is a Hindi-language show that aims to spread scientific awareness among people in India.

Hindi Language.name: Mazak Tha Bhai
Hindi Language.description: Kashif Ali is an Indian TV artist and film actor. Who has mainly worked in TV serials and Bollywood films. background Kashif Ali was born on 11 July 1983 in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. career She started her career with the small screen serial Santoshi Maa. After this he worked in many TV shows which made him known from house to house. Apart from television shows, he has played the lead actor in many Hindi films. The main ones are Wrong Love, Joke Tha Bhai, etc. television work * Santoshi Maa - Police Officer * Amma - Ravi *Kundali Bhagya - Policeman * Qayamat Ki Raat - Sardarji * Siddhivinayak - Police Officer * Lado- Pani Poori Wala * Prithvi Vallabh - Commander * Crime Patrol - Policeman Apart from working in Indian television series, Kashif Ali has also done a few minor roles in Bollywood films. Also has done web series as well. movies * Joke Tha Bhai (2018) * Wrong Love (2017) *Gangs of Uttar Pradesh (2021) Season 1 *Gangs of Uttar Pradesh (2022) Season 2 Written by SKA Films Production

Hindi Language.name: Stand Up Diaries
Hindi Language.description: In our daily life, we come across people who do things those are a bit exaggerated or funny but anyone hardly notices it. In our brand new series 'Stand Up Diaries', we bring for you the real side of people that goes unnoticed in daily life.

Hindi Language.name: Ladakh & Me
Hindi Language.description: Ladakh and Me is the most watched documentary film on Ladakh. This film has been watched by 4 million people on the official channel. , After watching this film, more than 10 lakh tourists from India and abroad have come to visit Ladakh.

Hindi Language.name: Itihaas Ki Thaali Se
Hindi Language.description: We love our food in India - from Idlis to Jalebis, Patrani Macchi to Rasgulla – but have you ever wondered how these recipes came to be? Come join us on a delicious journey – tracing the recipes and their ingredients across the years.

Hindi Language.name: Behind the stumps
Hindi Language.description: Catch all the scoop on the royal challenges. On and off pitch here.

Hindi Language.name: Legends of the wild: Kahani beehad ki
Hindi Language.description: A documentary based on the rise and fall of the feared dacoits of the Chambal and Yamuna ravines. The main character that is in focus here, who recounts her personal experiences is the renowned public figure and a notorious former female dacoit, Seema Parihar.

Hindi Language.name: F5 Storytellers
Hindi Language.description: F5 Storytellers' is a platform that features the inspiring stories of successful individuals, from diverse backgrounds, who have broken barriers and made a difference. This is a project by 'F5 Multimedia Studio Pvt. Ltd.

Hindi Language.name: Bubble Baat
Hindi Language.description: Bubble Baat is world's first ever celebrity chat show hosted by Gunjan Utreja in a BATHROOM.

Hindi Language.name: Bharta
Hindi Language.description: Ronit and Sukhleen are in love and are facing a common problem, how to convince their staunch parents. They come up with a solution to reveal this by taking their parents on a holiday, to Jaisalmer. Bharta is an emotional mash-up of what transpires during their journey to Jaisalmer and back; little do they that there is an even bigger shocker coming their way.

Hindi Language.name: Fair in Love
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a woman ALPANA, daughter to a Minister of Women Welfare of U.P. living in Kanpur to whom respect and honor was her pride. ALPANA falls in love with an Engineer" DEV" the son of Mahuvadi Head In India, whose family lived in Jarkhand. ALPANA and Dev get married against the wish of their families and settle in Goa. Yash the closest friend to Dev is an CBI officer, who has always been there for Dev and ALPANA at their good times and bad. Although happily married with her love partner she was always cursed with the choicest of abuses such as inauspicious witch, infertile bitch etc for not having a child. It was her husband who had a low sperm count, due to which she was unable to conceive. She never revealed about it before anyone as it would have meant demeaning her husband in front of everyone, especially his own parents. So, she took the entire blame upon herself quite willingly. ALPANA was harassed by almost everyone ranging from her mother, in-laws to her neighbors. Since ALPANA and Dev were in love and respected each other a lot they would never think about leaving each other although forced by their parents and in laws. Her husband was quite supportive of her and loved her to the core, no matter what. ALPANA was a poet and children were her poetry, very fond of children she involved herself into a NGO to pass her time and help the kids. On a dark night in absence of her husband, ALPANA gets raped and gets to know that she is pregnant. Although it was the happiest moment which she longed for, the same time her emotions were in turmoil. The circumstances were such, that she unwillingly had to accept the child or else her marriage could have been in danger since her in laws were against it, but she was still bent upon to find out the culprit. Will she be able to know the culprit? Will she succeed in getting justice? What will happen to the child?

Hindi Language.name: Ranjan Mistry: The Power of Entrepreneurial Mindset in Rural Communities

What happen next is the story. Will Aditya be able to clear the misunderstanding and get his love back ?

Hindi Language.name: Crime alert Nau Mahine Nau Din
Hindi Language.description: This episode of India Alert depicts the story of the widowed woman, Shanti Devi who lived with her son named Vikram. She got her son married to a woman named Manisha but after the marriage Manisha's behaviour towards Shant Devi was very bad and humiliating. Manisha always tried to put her down and ensured to portray the bad side of mother-in-law to Vikram. Shanti Devi realised the reason behind Manisha's such behaviour was her greed for their property and wealth.

Hindi Language.name: Kohkana
Hindi Language.description: An unsuccessful but talented, deranged Novelist hires an ardent and alluring Call Girl in order to interview her in a hotel room, for his research regarding his next novel but both remain unaware of the relation between them.

Hindi Language.name: Seventh
Hindi Language.description: On a gloomy night on the 1st of May Sufi comes back to his building only to get stuck in the lift and he has friend along- a cockroach. Beneath the surface of his life Sufi is hiding a secret either from himself or from someone else. Could his fight for survival become a night of reckoning or this night will be the end of him.

Hindi Language.name: Nagaland & The Hornbill Festival
Hindi Language.description: The Hornbill Festival of Nagaland has evolved from being just a celebration of the heritage and tradition of the Nagas into one big cultural event. This EPIC Special takes you to the exotic state of Nagaland to experience the festival

Hindi Language.name: JamToast

In this show, we feature the artist through interview, candid discussions, and fun banter with the show anchor and musician, Vidyaa Prakash. Each episode of the show includes live musical performance, journey of the musician, their influences, ambitions and aspirations.

Hindi Language.name: DC's ThoughtCast

Hindi Language.name: Talk Show on Punch Mark Coin
Rituals of Bheel tribes - Birth to Death
The Village Project
Hindi Language.description: Synopsis for The Village Project - "Does death ends your life? does birth starts your life? - of course not. Then where does life starts? Is it the day when you were conceived or even before that? Are you really dead when your heart stops beating or you stop inhaling oxygen? Is Death so simple and life so complex? the village project is an experimental Docu- fictional thriller drama that indulges into all these questions.

Hindi Language.name: Saraswati - EK Khoj

After which the adventurous roller coaster of her life starts. In this first episode, the story showcases the ups and downs, which Roshani faces in her life, after consuming the 'AZT'.
