Hindi Language.description: After failing at multiple attempts to lose his virginity, Rajveer eventually finds solace in peeking into the spicy lives of his neighbors. Here he encounters Bobita, the two-faced wife of his professor, and a beautiful married woman Aara.

Hindi Language.name: Not Dating
Hindi Language.description: Not Dating is the story of two best friends Rachit and Hardik who fall in love and their romantic journey begins or you can say fun begins.

Hindi Language.name: Hungama 2
Hindi Language.description: A sequel of the 2003 film Hungama.

Hindi Language.name: Pareeksha
Hindi Language.description: The film revolves around the story of an ordinary rickshaw driver in Bihar who aspires and dreams of providing a maximum possible quality education to his son by making arrangements for him to study at a private English medium school.

Hindi Language.name: Moh
Hindi Language.description: A village landlord, unable to conceive for years, blames his wife and seeks another marriage. His wife roams the village at night, seeking strangers to impregnate her, leading to an illicit affair.

Hindi Language.name: Games of Karma
Hindi Language.description: Leprosy-afflicted undertaker Farook fulfills desires with corpses. Caught by an outsider, he falsely accuses him, leading to the innocent's stoning. Will Farook face karmic justice for his sins?

Hindi Language.name: You Me and My Padosan
Hindi Language.description: A commitment-phobic guy's life turns chaotic when one girlfriend gets pregnant and another moves in as his housemate, leading to hilarious situations.

Hindi Language.name: Paro
Hindi Language.description: Paro lives In a village where women are considered sex objects .In order to escape physical abuse her mothers marries her soon.But Paro lands in a bride trafficking racket.

Hindi Language.name: The Rapist
Hindi Language.description: A psychology professor survives a sexual assault in a slum, leading to legal proceedings. As she copes with trauma and pregnancy, her experience highlights social issues.

Hindi Language.name: Relationship Counsellor
Hindi Language.description: Sejal, tired of her partner Kartik's relentless sexual demands, moves in with her friend Megha and husband Rajiv, who attempt to counsel the couple, inadvertently straining their own relationship in the process.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Sorry Teacher
Hindi Language.description: Where there is no limit to the limit, if anything, it is a fuzzy world filled with lust, greed and ever-changing feelings. Watch this story to know the story of guru and disciple's relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Anjaan Rishtey Ka Guilt
Hindi Language.description: Saru is married to a police officer named Pratap. But Pratap's impotency creates a rift between Saru and him, owing to which Saru finds solace in the company of Pratap's childhood friend Sunil and a love affair commences between them.

Hindi Language.name: : The War in the Hills
Hindi Language.description: In the Sino-Indian War, 126 Indians defended a strategic pass against 3,000 enemy soldiers. This was a battle of dauntless courage, fought to the last bullet.

Hindi Language.name: Blood Money
Hindi Language.description: A murder investigation leads an officer to fall for the prime suspect, a woman whose innocence becomes increasingly uncertain as the case takes dangerous turns.

Hindi Language.name: Prabha Ki Diary
Hindi Language.description: A wife's unfulfilled longing for her husband's love leads her to a passionate encounter with a stranger, challenging her to embrace her desires or suppress them, with a shut door symbolizing the journey of self-discovery.

Hindi Language.name: The Empire
Hindi Language.description: The series focuses on the rise and fall of Mughal Empire through generations from Babur to Aurangzeb.

Hindi Language.name: Balakot: The True Story
Hindi Language.description: Film on Balakot air strikes 2019.

Hindi Language.name: Durgamati: The Myth
Hindi Language.description: A bureaucrat is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

Hindi Language.name: Parivartan
Hindi Language.description: Set in pre-partition India, it follows the Indian business class and their rise, highlighting the contrasting ethics between traditional and new Baniyas.

Hindi Language.name: Milan.com- Nuefliks
Hindi Language.description: The life of two young girls. One of them decides to get a life partner and upload her photo on a website. A guy falls for her thinking she is the actual person. Things take a shocking turn as the truth comes out.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Myself Lilly
Hindi Language.description: Lilly struggles to sell her beauty products until her fiance suggests using a seductive tone. Experimenting together, they crack the code, leading to Lilly's first sale.

Hindi Language.name: Chaman Bahaar
Hindi Language.description: A small town panwalla falls for a schoolgirl who lives opposite his shop. He experiences love, jealousy and betrayal without meeting her even once.

Hindi Language.name: Choked
Hindi Language.description: A bank employee weighed down by her jobless husband's debts - and her own broken dreams - finds a secret source of seemingly unlimited cash in her home.

Hindi Language.name: Barrister Babu
Hindi Language.description: In a bid to save an 8-year-old girl from becoming the victim of Sati, Anirudh marries a curious and tyrant girl Bondita. Anirudh educates Bondita and makes her the first "Barrister Babu" of their region.

Hindi Language.name: Devil Girl
Hindi Language.description: Rekha Mona Sarkar debut as a director in series DEVIL GIRL, her first project is Indian adaptation of famous Japanese Comedy- The Succulent succubus .DEVIL GIRL ,Episode 1, A fun-filled parody of the film Bedazzled. Suhana Khan , shakexpearking, Ayesha Pathan, Sana Sundi.

Hindi Language.name: Shakuntala Devi
Hindi Language.description: Mathematician Shakuntala Devi's journey to become "The Human Computer" and her relationship with her daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Gulabo Sitabo
Hindi Language.description: Two scheming men get caught up in a game of one upmanship, each one attracting other members to their clan and each one with an agenda of his own.

Hindi Language.name: Hero Gayab Mode On
Hindi Language.description: Aeons ago, in a great war between the good and evil, the powerful ring was forged by the dark side. It could make the wearer invisible. After the war, the ring is lost and only a true hero can wear it.

Hindi Language.name: Hotspot
Hindi Language.description: After receiving an alluring phone call, a man becomes entangled with a mysterious couple who draw him into their seductive world, leading to unexpected complications.

Hindi Language.name: Dial 100
Hindi Language.description: One night, while working at the Mumbai Police Emergency Call Centre, police officer Nikhil Sood gets a call from a hysterical woman who wants to commit suicide. Even as he tries to save her, Nikhil has no idea that it will lead to him endangering his own family as dark truths that he has been hiding threaten to destroy all that he loves and stands for.

Hindi Language.name: My Darling
Hindi Language.description: A neglected wife's affair sparks her transformation. Her husband's passion finally awakens when he suspects infidelity - but his renewed interest may come too late.

Hindi Language.name: Pandya Store
Hindi Language.description: In the era of nuclear families, Dhara uses her entrepreneurial foresight to revive her ancestral business. But can she keep her family united against all odds?

Hindi Language.name: Monika
Hindi Language.description: "On the eve of his wedding, a groom faces temptation when a dress delivery leads to an unexpected encounter that threatens his upcoming marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Feels Like Ishq
Hindi Language.description: Short films follow young adults as they navigate the gamut of emotions that come with finding romantic connection in unexpected places.

Hindi Language.name: Bhagya Lakshmi
Hindi Language.description: Hailing from a middle-class family, Lakshmi's life is upended when she realises that her marriage to Rishi Oberoi, an industrialist's son, is a sham to keep his death at bay.

Hindi Language.name: London Confidential
Hindi Language.description: Amid a series of brutal killings of Indian agents in London, a RAW officer and India's Ambassador to Great Britain race against time to find the traitor within their own ranks.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Mein Marjawan 2
Hindi Language.description: Riddhima and Vansh are back but this time, their relationship is not what it appears to be. Which new (or old?) enemy will they have to fight?

Hindi Language.name: Virgin Boys
Hindi Language.description: Three friends pursue losing their virginity, facing obstacles but finding success for one. They secretly compete to become the "King of Romance" in this entertaining portrayal of their quest for sexual fulfillment.

Hindi Language.name: A Simple Murder
Hindi Language.description: A failed entrepreneur has a lot going on in life when he finds himself involved in a case of mistaken identity and ends up getting a contract to kill a young girl. The target is the daughter of an influential politician.

Hindi Language.name: Kuch Toh Hai: Naagin Ek Naye Rang Mein
Hindi Language.description: Rehan, a local heart-throb, hides his dark powers beneath a cool demeanour. An encounter with Priya,an angel, turns his life upside down, leading to conflict and passion.

Hindi Language.name: Indoo Ki Jawani
Hindi Language.description: A coming-of-age story of a girl who experience life through misadventures & dating apps.

Hindi Language.name: Meet
Hindi Language.description: Despite her efforts to provide for her family, Meets disregard for societal gender norms and her nonconformist job as a delivery agent make her an unsuitable girl in the eyes of her family.

Hindi Language.name: Ram Singh Charlie
Hindi Language.description: A Lovely Little Film About A Family Of Circus Artistes.

Hindi Language.name: Devadasi
Hindi Language.description: The life of people in a village. Few situations in life change the whole dreams of two girls. They have to face some shocking things in life taking away their love. Can the girls relieve their happy life.

Hindi Language.name: Bombay Begums
Hindi Language.description: Set in contemporary urban India, five women across generations wrestle with desire, ethics, personal crises, and vulnerabilities to own their ambition.

Hindi Language.name: The Whistleblower
Hindi Language.description: Education is one of the top businesses in India and PMT scam is one of those serial scams in Education that gives wings to the scammers who use Proxy and contacts for paper leaks and planned cheating. The series is based on PMT Scam 2013.

Hindi Language.name: BehruPriya
Hindi Language.description: Priya is a widow and Anil is a Guest in the House. Now this is a Story where Anil Finds out Many things about Priya which others don't know and how He takes advantages of that. What will Happen in the End?

Hindi Language.name: Rashmi Rocket
Hindi Language.description: A small-town girl overcomes all societal barriers to become a national-level athlete, but her glory is hindered when she is asked to undergo a gender test.

Hindi Language.name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 2
Hindi Language.description: The show is a reboot version of the 2011 series of the same name Bade Achhe Lagte Hain and once again deals with how two unlikely people get married and find love over time.

Hindi Language.name: The Raikar Case
Hindi Language.description: An edge-of-the-seat thriller about family, love, deceit, and the secrets that wrench us apart. It grapples with the dilemma of 'Will You Choose Truth Over Family?', and if trust can ever really be absolute.

Hindi Language.name: Shakeela
Hindi Language.description: A biopic based on the life of adult star Shakeela, who ruled the South Indian film industry for over two decades. The film features Richa Chadha in the lead role.

Hindi Language.name: Kaali Kaya
Hindi Language.description: A WOMEN WHO FACES OBSTACLES AFTER THE DEATHS OF HER IN-LAWS. STORY TAKES A TURN WHEN SHE GETS A LETTER ADDRESSED TO A OLD FRIEND ASKING FOR A HELP TO SAVE THE FAMILY. THE WOMEN'S INVESTIGATION LEADS HER DOWN TO A BIG SECRET OF HER IN-LAWS

Hindi Language.name: Bye2
Hindi Language.description: Story of boy and girl, how relationships change over a period of life and how hard is to say Bye sometimes when you want to end the relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Maddam Sir - Kuch Baat Hai Kyunki Jaazbaat Hai
Hindi Language.description: Set in Lucknow, four quirky women run an all-female police station. They balance personal lives, solve cases through reconciliation, and bring sensitivity to policing. Their unusual solutions and interpersonal dynamics create humor.

Hindi Language.name: Panga
Hindi Language.description: Panga is inspired by the life of a National-level Kabbadi player from India. It follows her triumphs, struggle, and overcoming of stereotypes. It shows how important family love and support is for success.

Hindi Language.name: Chintu Ka Birthday
Hindi Language.description: During US invasion of Iraq some illegal migrants are waiting to get back home to India. As one such family prepares to celebrate the 6th birthday of their youngest member Chintu, their kind-hearted Iraqi landlord lends them a helping hand.

Hindi Language.name: Indian Matchmaking
Hindi Language.description: Matchmaker Sima Taparia guides clients in the U.S. and India in the arranged marriage process, offering an inside look at the custom in a modern era.

Hindi Language.name: Rasmalai
Hindi Language.description: The Story of office Politics with the flavor of Love and Romance. Girl falls in the Trap of Game play of Boss. But who is the Main conspirator behind all this.

Hindi Language.name: Shark Tank India
Hindi Language.description: Aspiring entrepreneurs from India pitch their business models to a panel of investors and persuade them to invest money in their idea.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Ballet
Hindi Language.description: Discovered by an eccentric ballet master, two gifted but underprivileged Mumbai teens face bigotry and disapproval as they pursue their dancing dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Bebaakee
Hindi Language.description: Sufiyaan and Imtiaz are like brothers, and together they run one of the biggest media houses in Manali. But what will happen when they both fall for the same woman- Kainaat? And whom will she choose - a good friend or a bebaak lover?

Hindi Language.name: Call My Agent Bollywood
Hindi Language.description: From pulling off casting coups to calming celebrity egos, the drama never stops for four Mumbai talent agents hustling to save their sinking company.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2
Hindi Language.description: Set against army backdrop, "Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2" will narrate the love story of Shravan(Mohit Kumar) and Suman(Kanikka Kapur).

Hindi Language.name: Ateet
Hindi Language.description: A soldier lost in war and pronounced dead returns after decade to his wife and daughter, only to realize that they have moved on. As he forces his way into their life, questions are asked whether he is dead or alive.

Hindi Language.name: Raat Baaki Hai
Hindi Language.description: It's a story of one night where estranged lovers Kartik and Vasuki end up meeting each other after 12 years under strange circumstances. Kartik is on a run for being a murder suspect. However, there is more than meets the eye.

Hindi Language.name: OK Computer
Hindi Language.description: In a New India - of towering smart holograms and drone superhighways - hard-boiled Cyber Crime detective Saajan Kundu is called out of retirement when a self-driving taxi is hacked and ordered to kill an anonymous human victim.

Hindi Language.name: Alif Laila
Hindi Language.description: This show story start on bagdad's king shahbaz after betrayed cheated with his first wife noor and his step brother shahzama after 6 months everyday sultan sleeping in bad dreams of noor so sultan's wazir are suggested to marriage and sultan decides to everyday he married girl and morning killed her so she not chance to cheat but wazir's daughter saher she are loved sultan in childhood he married sultan and every night he listen sultan stories from alif laila magical book.

Hindi Language.name: Mehndi Hai Rachne Waali
Hindi Language.description: Widowed Pallavi is all for family, while loner Raghav, a business magnate, is all for money. One day, these polar opposites clash.

Hindi Language.name: Shaurya Aur Anokhi Ki Kahaani
Hindi Language.description: Sparks fly when masked modern-day misogynist Shaurya comes across Anokhi, a headstrong girl. With their clashing ideologies on the line, will opposites attract?

Hindi Language.name: Kathmandu Connection
Hindi Language.description: An officer is murdered, a hotelier is kidnapped, and a reporter is stalked against the backdrop of the 1993 Mumbai Blast.

Hindi Language.name: Breast Tax
Hindi Language.description: The series tells the true story of Breast Tax which was a tax imposed by the Kingdom of Travancore (Kerala). If the lower caste Hindu women wanted to cover their breasts in public, they should pay tax.

Hindi Language.name: Gang Bang Balloons
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of three girls. They decide to take a fun trip and enjoy their best. They try to experiment a new thing in life. Can they still remain friends?

Hindi Language.name: Sakshi
Hindi Language.description: Virat and Prachi are engaged to be married. But Virat is asked to shift to a new city where he meets Sakshi and falls in love. When Prachi and Sakshi come face to face, things complicate.

Hindi Language.name: The Power
Hindi Language.description: It is a hair-raising journey into the world of two lovers as both their families are ripped apart for the sake of revenge and power, and an entertaining look at how they rise out of that pit of blood lust and despair, together.

Hindi Language.name: D Company
Hindi Language.description: The biggest saga of the year is about to unfold the dark side of India's underworld enterprise. The film will showcase the true story behind India's biggest underworld enterprise, D Company, a Mumbai based underworld gang headed by Dawood Ibrahim Kaskar.

Hindi Language.name: Koochie Koochie Hota Hai
Hindi Language.description: The film is an animated take on Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, and it marks the 20 year anniversary of its release.

Hindi Language.name: Sanak Ek Junoon
Hindi Language.description: Ajay and Ragini, an ambitious couple from a small town relocate to Mumbai in search of a better life. Mr. Shekhawat offers Ajay, a junior lawyer, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity in exchange for compromising his morals. Will Ajay compromise his values for this life-changing opportunity? Until when will he continue to be unhappy with his current lifestyle? What consequences await him on the other side of this deal? Gear up to witness his impending decisions and the events that follow.

Hindi Language.name: Ratri Ke Yatri
Hindi Language.description: A rigid enforcer, a devoted couple, a groom on the run, a vengeful visitor, and a thief converge at a brothel. Over one fateful night their lives intertwine as they each gain newfound perspectives

Hindi Language.name: : Halla Ho
Hindi Language.description: Loosely based on a real incident, 200: Halla Ho is the story of women, terrorised by a mobster whose gang raped, robbed, terrorised and murdered 300 families for 15 years until he met his nemesis in a young Dalit girl.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Jhand Hai
Hindi Language.description: Husband obsessively watches wife's infidelity. Despite abuse, she stays until abandoned. Humiliated, she finds love with gardener, leading to husband's murder and grave consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Torbaaz
Hindi Language.description: A man rises from personal tragedy to lead a group of children from a refugee camp to victory, transforming their lives through the game of cricket.

Hindi Language.name: Vasooli
Hindi Language.description: The Story where Vasooli become the Main thing in the Life. Everyone wants something from someone but here Everyone believes Vasooli is the only way to out and Twist in that Vasooli will make your Time worth.

Hindi Language.name: Pawan & Pooja
Hindi Language.description: Love, over the years has been defined as an emotion that brings out the best in people, the very thought of the person you love will bring a smile to your face, butterflies in your stomach and instant longing to be close to them. But is that all it is? A happy emotion? Instead of being unconditional, unbreakable and unquestionable - sometimes, love fails only to be reborn again, it breaks bonds to forge new ones and it destroys lives but still brings hope. This relationship drama explores the lives of 3 couples - all coincidentally named Pawan and Pooja who at different stages of their lives discover that their love is indeed conditional, breakable and questionable.

Hindi Language.name: Ziddi Dil Maane Na
Hindi Language.description: Special Agent Karan Shergil is stern with his trainees and prepares them for the tough life in the army. Soon, Monami, a kind-hearted doctor, joins his team.

Hindi Language.name: Mere Angane Main
Hindi Language.description: Husband falls in the Love Trap with a Girl who is a Friend of his Wife. He is not happy with his Love Life but Destiny take one by one Twists in his Life and Finally unwanted Guest changes All things that he planned in his Life.

Hindi Language.name: Mary and Marlow- Big Movie Zoo
Hindi Language.description: Mary becomes a sexpert helping grassroots people communicate about intimacy. Her assistant Marlow attempts to use formal Hindi, leading to unintentional double entendres.

Hindi Language.name: Shimla Mirchi
Hindi Language.description: While on holiday, Avi meets Naina and falls in love with her. Smitten, he decides to stay and work in her cafe. He confesses his love in a letter, however it's Naina's mother who mistakenly reads it.

Hindi Language.name: Black Widows
Hindi Language.description: Tired of their abusive husbands, three women plan and execute their murders. It is an almost-perfect plan until Pankaj Mishra, assigned to the case, realises there is more to it.

Hindi Language.name: Hai Taubba
Hindi Language.description: Hai Taubba is a compilation of 4 mature stories, representing emotions symbolized by a distinct colour of love.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Jaane Na
Hindi Language.description: A heartbroken writer struggling with writer's block goes to a quiet hill station where he finds love again but uncovers a copycat serial killer who has mysteriously come alive and is killing everyone around him.

Hindi Language.name: Shukranu
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around a married couple. The wife is unhappy and demands something exciting. Things take a turn as they involve a new person. Will it solve their problems forever?

Hindi Language.name: Tribhanga
Hindi Language.description: The lives of three women spanning the late 1980s to present day and underscores the value of family in everyday life.

Hindi Language.name: Jamun
Hindi Language.description: A dysfunctional family who overcomes their individual difficulties.

Hindi Language.name: A Night of Knowing Nothing
Hindi Language.description: L writes letters to her estranged lover. Through these letters, we get a glimpse into the drastic changes taking place around her. Merging reality with fiction, dreams, memories, fantasies and anxieties, an amorphous narrative unfolds.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Stop
Hindi Language.description: Crime Stop is an original show by ABZY cool . It is a show made to educate people about the crimes happening around them .

Hindi Language.name: Naxalbari
Hindi Language.description: STF agent Raghav goes on a secret mission to curtail the revival of a naxal uprising in Gadchiroli. But the war becomes too personal as he digs deeper and tries to uncover the larger plan of the uprising.

Hindi Language.name: Sardar Ka Grandson
Hindi Language.description: A devoted grandson embarks on a complicated and comic journey to fulfill his ailing grandmother's last wish.

Hindi Language.name: Masaba Masaba
Hindi Language.description: Real life mom-daughter duo Neena and Masaba Gupta play versions of themselves in this playful, fictional peek into their lives in fashion and film.

Hindi Language.name: Perversion
Hindi Language.description: Perversion is story of Family where every member has different perversions.

Hindi Language.name: Molkki
Hindi Language.description: A victim of bride buying, a social evil prevalent in India's heartland, Purvi is married off to Virender, who is double her age and a widower with children from his first wife.

Hindi Language.name: X Zone
Hindi Language.description: A group of friends plan a holiday at a lonely farmhouse but their vacation soon turns into a nightmare when they realise the bungalow is haunted. Will they escape?

Hindi Language.name: Chhota Bheem Aur Arazim Ka Raaz
Hindi Language.description: Chhota Bheem and his friends embark on an adventurous journey to defeat Arazim who has captured the people of Dholakpur.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Kills
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around a never-ending fight between two families and a love story. The romance will have to take on the fury and grudge of the families. Will they be able to survive and achieve their love?

Hindi Language.name: Virgin Bhanupriya
Hindi Language.description: Bhanupriya, a conservative girl decides to lose her virginity but fails in her every attempt. A soothsayer predicts that it is an impossible task and it will not happen to her. She decides to overcome this bad luck.

Hindi Language.name: Chhupee Rustom
Hindi Language.description: Family pressure mounts as a young man approaches his wedding day, knowing nothing about his bride except his sister-in-law's assurances.

Hindi Language.name: Potluck
Hindi Language.description: Potluck is a heartwarming and amusing depiction of the Shastri family trying to build a strong, lasting bond with each other. Each character adds a distinctive flavour by expressing a variety of perspectives and personal experiences.

Hindi Language.name: Shikara
Hindi Language.description: Shikara is the story of resilience in the face of insurmountable odds. It's also the story of a love that remains unextinguished through 30 years of exile. A timeless love story in the worst of times.

Hindi Language.name: Cash
Hindi Language.description: Amidst the chaos of demonetization, down-on-luck Armaan finds a business opportunity in money laundering. Where will this shortcut take him?

Hindi Language.name: Murder at Teesri Manzil 302
Hindi Language.description: A wealthy businessman's wife mysteriously disappears, and a team of investigating officers embark on a search for her. Will they be able to decipher what's going on?

Hindi Language.name: Angithee
Hindi Language.description: Firdous is married off in a conservative house with her husband Hameed. Her old friend Shahid comes back from Punjab and they fall in love, but things change when Hameed discovers Firdous is sleeping with his friend.

Hindi Language.name: Chutzpah
Hindi Language.description: Chutzpah is five stories intertwined with one another through the worldwide web, explore the complexities of real-life through the somewhat delusional online lives of the quirky net head characters.

Hindi Language.name: Homespun
Hindi Language.description: 'Homespun in Uttarakhand' aims to narrate personal stories of seven master artisans and their passion celebrating the unrecognized and dying craft practices, which need preservation and our support.

Hindi Language.name: The Great Indian Wedding
Hindi Language.description: Be it love or arrange, this wedding is not happening so easily. Here everyone is more excited about food or gossip than our beautiful bride and groom. But wait what is the bride's ex doing here?

Hindi Language.name: Jannat House
Hindi Language.description: This is drama story of three beautiful girls named Rangoli, Riya and Ishika living in 'Jannat House'. All three girls are desperately in search of love relationship. They bring their male partners in the house tom have fun with them.

Hindi Language.name: Fatherhood
Hindi Language.description: Pratap an arrogant and strict father has kept his adolescent son Kamal from exploring the physical side of the relationship. But Pratap has a change of mind, when his sister-in-law Nisha comes to stay with them and spices up an affair with both father and son, and furthermore insists on a threesome with them.

Hindi Language.name: Titoo
Hindi Language.description: Titoo is an animated kids' comedy show that follows the daily escapades of eight-year-old boy Titoo. Though, he is a good-hearted, intelligent kid who loves to help everyone, but inadvertently manages to brew even more trouble.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Mummy Di
Hindi Language.description: Jai Mummy Di is a light-hearted family comedy that portrays the trials and tribulations a couple has to undergo due to the dynamics between their respective mothers.

Hindi Language.name: Ratri
Hindi Language.description: Paakhi moves to Mumbai for work and rents a flat where unsettling occurrences begin. She uncovers a surprising resolution, believing herself safe, until an unforeseen twist.

Hindi Language.name: Saina
Hindi Language.description: The story of Saina Nehwal, a professional badminton player who ranked number 1 in the sport.

Hindi Language.name: Who's Your Daddy
Hindi Language.description: Soggy, the coolest dad of 'Dilli' has the 'hottest' tale to tell his son as they go down the comical memory lane laced with 'blue-films' and hilarious encounters to uncover who's the Daddy of Soggy's son.

Hindi Language.name: RK/RKAY
Hindi Language.description: RK is a filmmaker, making a new film, in which he also plays the lead character of Mahboob. Its a quaint film, like a tribute to the cinema of the sixties. People close to him are not really sure why RK wants to make this film.. Edit begins and RK has a sinking feeling that this film is not going to come together, that this time he has really screwed up. His nightmares warn him of an impending disaster. Sure enough, one afternoon RK gets a call from the edit room- something terrible has happened. Mahboob has run away, run out of the film. Nobody can really understand why would he leave, where would he go. But he is not there anymore in the rushes- missing from the film negative as well. The fact is Mahboob was running away from his killers, and somehow he left the film and arrived in our world. RK finds him, brings him home- but Mahboob has no idea where he is from, or that he is any different from people around him. Slowly, he is told. They must convince him to go back to the film, so that RK can finish his film.

Hindi Language.name: Velle
Hindi Language.description: Three criminals, a runaway girl, her three best friends, an aspiring director and a star cross paths due to an incident. Will they come off better for it or worse?

Hindi Language.name: Suraj Pe Mangal Bhari
Hindi Language.description: In the 1990s, a wedding detective has to perform background checks on prospective grooms. In the time before social media and mobile phones, everything has to be done in person.

Hindi Language.name: Saath Nibhaana Saathiya 2
Hindi Language.description: Gopi finds her younger self in Gehna while visiting the selfish and greedy Desais. But when their youngest son returns home, things take an unexpected turn..

Hindi Language.name: Jurm Aur Jazbaat
Hindi Language.description: Jurm Aur Jazbaat presents a series of spine-chilling crime stories and thrilling mysteries that bring forth the worst side of human emotions. It is sure to keep the viewers on the edge of their seats.

Hindi Language.name: Faasla
Hindi Language.description: Gunjan, a vivacious housewife, loves to spontaneously seduce her husband, Sameer. After Sameer's injury, Gunjan's attraction to the neighbor, Yogi, leads to an affair.

Hindi Language.name: Jassi King - The FAKR
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the musician Jassi King. Romance enters into his music-filled life and girls have been strong fans of his talents. Things take a twist when a new girl enters the life of Jassi King.

Hindi Language.name: Tinku Ki Suhaagraat
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around newly married urban village couple does not know what has to be done in a Suhaagraat, their curiosity turns into hilarious comedy moments.

Hindi Language.name: Pratiksha
Hindi Language.description: Pratiksha Singh a humble television star witnessed a downfall in her stardom post her controversial love affair with a flamboyant free-spirited hunk Chirag, before her eventual suicide that thrilled the entertainment world. A US-based journalist Abhay, seeks the truth behind her death and finds the hidden secrets of her relationship with her father and her possessive boyfriend.

Hindi Language.name: Milestone
Hindi Language.description: Recently marking 500,000 kilometers on the road, a newly bereaved trucker faces the threat of losing the job that has come to define him to a new intern.

Hindi Language.name: Suno Bhabhiji
Hindi Language.description: This story is about how the innocent looking Alka and Somya manipulate Jethalal, Pannalal and Chamanlal for their advantage and how they get all the property rights of the family. Let's see the mindset behind this master plan.

Hindi Language.name: Qubool Hai 2.0
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of Asad and Zoya -- two individuals who have surrendered to their ideals. One to the cause of his country, another to her duty towards her family.

Hindi Language.name: Halahal
Hindi Language.description: The Murder of a college girl morphed into a suicide takes Dr. Shiv on a journey to dig the truth out of his daughter's murder.

Hindi Language.name: Paper
Hindi Language.description: Story of the biggest counterfeiter, who shook the entire nation with a multi-crore scam. One who started with setting up a hoax printing setup and looted people for more than a decade. Unveiling the story of the most bizarre scam in history:

Hindi Language.name: Ankahi Kahaniya
Hindi Language.description: As big city life buzzes around them, lonely souls discover surprising sources of connection and companionship in three tales of love, loss and longing.

Hindi Language.name: Beautiful Maid
Hindi Language.description: This is a beautiful love story between a maid and her house owner and how they find pleasure and excitement by involving with each other.

Hindi Language.name: Fire in the Mountains
Hindi Language.description: A mother toils to save money to build a road in a Himalayan village to take her wheelchair-bound son for physiotherapy but her husband who believes that a shamanic ritual 'Jaagar' is the remedy, steals her savings.

Hindi Language.name: Robot
Hindi Language.description: Mr. Chadda, the cunning head of customs, confiscates a sex Robot imported from Bangkok and hides it at his junior Anand's home. Anxious and inquisitive Anand opens the box and finds the semi-nude sex robot "Rosy" and his life takes an unexpected turn.

Hindi Language.name: Shaadisthan
Hindi Language.description: Mumbai to Ajmer, a squabbling family, a band, and clashing values. Along the roads of friendship and life, this journey only gets crazier.

Hindi Language.name: Haathi Mere Saathi
Hindi Language.description: Watch the bond between humans and elephants with Bandevs story as he fights for the protection of his ele--friends. Witness the rage on 'Haathi Mere Saathi'.

Hindi Language.name: Rumjhum
Hindi Language.description: Son of a rich landlord have crush on a poor person's wife Rumjhum and her husband knows about the extra marital relationship, but she is in serious love and she has given her life for her love.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Jee
Hindi Language.description: The story of Womance goals, women having each others back, all of them changing and bending the rules and earning a quick buck while they enjoy themselves.

Hindi Language.name: Chitthi
Hindi Language.description: Ravi Asthana's life is upended when he receives a letter from his past after 25 years, forcing him to confront moral dilemmas and make a choice that could shatter everything he has built.

Hindi Language.name: Collar Bomb
Hindi Language.description: A glorified cop's life is thrown into chaos as he is forced to commit a series of crimes before a suicide bomber blows up a school. As he races against time, he's confronted by an evil that is hell-bent on striking raw, primal terror.

Hindi Language.name: Happily Ever After
Hindi Language.description: A slice of life story that captures the essence of a modern millennial relationship and brings to light the hitches and glitches the millennial couple, Roneet and Avani, face as they strive to achieve their dream wedding.

Hindi Language.name: Blind Date
Hindi Language.description: A lonely woman finds companionship through a dating app, leading to an unexpected yet passionate encounter after a blind date.

Hindi Language.name: Writing with Fire
Hindi Language.description: In a cluttered news landscape dominated by men, emerges India's only newspaper run by Dalit women. Chief Reporter Meera and her journalists break traditions, redefining what it means to be powerful.

Hindi Language.name: Sirf Tum
Hindi Language.description: A kind-hearted girl, Suhani dreams to be a doctor, Ranveer a strong-minded man, just has one obsession, Suhani. Destiny brings them together, but a dark secret looms over them. Will it keep them united or will it break their bond forever?

Hindi Language.name: Crime Next Door
Hindi Language.description: A twisted tale full of murder, mysteries and deceit. The truth is not what it seems to be.

Hindi Language.name: Khaali Peeli
Hindi Language.description: Follows a taxi driver who picks up a girl while he is on the run and ends up in a crazy roller-coaster of events.

Hindi Language.name: Sasural Simar Ka 2
Hindi Language.description: Gitanjali Devi entrusts Simar Bhardwaj with the task of finding an ideal bride for her grandson. Simar's quest ends when she meets her namesake, Simar Narayan, who dreams of making it big as a singer.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Charlie
Hindi Language.description: Charlie a young pizza delivery boy, who has been assigned the task to transport a gorilla from Mumbai to Diu. The adventures the unlikely duo get embroiled in along the way forms the crux of the plot.

Hindi Language.name: Namumkin Tere Bin Jeena
Hindi Language.description: NAMUMKIN Tere Bin Jeena is a intence love story about how the pride,the acceptances of the Differences play major part in separation even when love exists.

Hindi Language.name: Love Scandals & Doctors
Hindi Language.description: Love, Scandal and Doctors is a story of 5 medical interns who got embroiled in a scandal. They are the prime accused in a murder. The question lies - Are these students even capable of committing such a crime or are they just being framed?

Hindi Language.name: Kamathipura
Hindi Language.description: Police find the abandoned dead body of the prostitute in the Kamathipura area of Mumbai. Lady cop Aditi Acharya starts the investigation.

Hindi Language.name: Scorned
Hindi Language.description: Romantic weekend of Kajal and Akshay turns into horrific and sadistic when Kajal discovers her boyfriend akshya is having an affair with her best friend Yamini

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi inShort
Hindi Language.description: An anthology of 7 heart-warming stories, Zindagi inShort glimpses into various moments of ordinary lives. The circumstances that we live in, we ignore our loved ones, we madly focus on our careers, we stop thinking about them.

Hindi Language.name: Tuesdays and Fridays
Hindi Language.description: To avoid the burden of commitment, a young lawyer and a writer agree to be romantic partners only two days a week. That won't get complicated - right?

Hindi Language.name: Dil Bekaraar
Hindi Language.description: Set in 1980s' Delhi, Debjani, an easy-going English newsreader, meets Dylan, a fiery journalist. It's a clash of ideals with a strong dose of attraction.

Hindi Language.name: Balika Vadhu 2
Hindi Language.description: Anandi is a feisty, intelligent young girl in Gujarat who is trapped in the shackles of marriage at a tender age. How does Anandi take on the injustice meted out to her?

Hindi Language.name: Manglik
Hindi Language.description: This is Drama story of Gauri who is a beautiful girl of the village but still she is unmarried due to her Manglik dosh. Gauri want to become Dulhan and enjoy married life desperately. Will she marry or not? Will She enjoy honeymoon or not?

Hindi Language.name: Did It Happen?
Hindi Language.description: In a not-so-typical scenario, Ishan a young, charismatic boy is staying with his mom's friend, someone he's attracted to. while his imagination often does run wild, Ishan his Stuck in a conundrum - did it really happen?.

Hindi Language.name: The Incomplete Man
Hindi Language.description: A bride's bachelorette party at her village home turns dark when a supernatural force threatens her family line. A tantric seeks to control this spirit for power, leading to a battle for Nupur's survival.

Hindi Language.name: Operation Parindey
Hindi Language.description: The film is a fictional story based on true events which depicts a groundbreaking jail break.

Hindi Language.name: Time to Dance
Hindi Language.description: When a ballroom dancer's shot at a crucial tournament is jeopardized, a street dancer must face his own painful past and step up as her new partner.

Hindi Language.name: Queen of Sajjangarh
Hindi Language.description: Three couple decide to go to an old haveli during the lockdown. There they unknowingly free a spirit in the process of opening a door which was closed from several years. After which all the three couple are subjected to strange and spine chilling incidents.

Hindi Language.name: Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya 2
Hindi Language.description: Nine years later, Pratigya finds herself conflicted between her duty as a public prosecutor and her emotions as a mother. Which side will she choose?

Hindi Language.name: It Happened in Calcutta
Hindi Language.description: A story that managed to leave a mark during the times of war, epidemic and political unrest. Based in the era of 60s and 70s, Ronobir and Kusum's story not only created memories, but also impacted history.

Hindi Language.name: Break Point
Hindi Language.description: The series traces the incredible journey of Indian tennis legends Leander Paes and Mahesh Bhupathi. From their meteoric rise to their shocking split, watch their story of hard work, conflict, and hope.

Hindi Language.name: Tapa Tap
Hindi Language.description: An unsatisfied husband decides to spice up his sex life by inviting another married couple for dinner where things take an unexpected turn.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Bina Jiya Jaye Naa
Hindi Language.description: The show's story revolves around Krisha (Anjali Tatrari), a hospitality graduate, trying best to prove herself and help her family financially by working at her father's friends' royal hotel in Udaipur.

Hindi Language.name: Punyashlok Ahilyabai
Hindi Language.description: Ahilya decides to build her own temple after an argument with the pandit. On the other hand, Malhar Rao is concerned about his son Khande Rao's laid-back attitude.

Hindi Language.name: Landlord
Hindi Language.description: This story is about a house-mistress, who traps her own tenant in the trap of her love and begins with her, watch this story to know the emotional torture of lust and love.

Hindi Language.name: Bisaat
Hindi Language.description: A pawn, a target, or the culprit - what is Dr. Kiyana's ultimate truth?

Hindi Language.name: Amar Prem
Hindi Language.description: Widow marriage is still considered a sin in progressive society of india even today. Film Amar prem raise questions on mentality of indian society and cover issues like widow marriage and honor killings.

Hindi Language.name: Matto Ki Saikil
Hindi Language.description: A far remote rural village with green fields. As Matto is responsible for the livelihood of his wife and two young daughters, he daily takes a long distance journey to the city to work as a construction labor. The most important asset of him is a bicycle that is heavily worn out after riding for two decades. One day, an accident occurs in which the bicycle is damaged so badly that it can no longer be used. It could be a minor problem to someone, but it leaves an irreparable wound to his circumstances. Will he be able to return to the life of feeling the little happiness of everyday life again.

Hindi Language.name: The Story of My Wife
Hindi Language.description: To Spicy up the Relationship, Kaamya started an Activity, that her Husband Siddharth never ever imagined. Lets See How this New Activity open up the new Doors of their Married Life of Kaamya and Siddharth.

Hindi Language.name: Blind Kotha
Hindi Language.description: A devoted wife harbors a secret life as a prostitute at a blind brothel, where clients are blindfolded to conceal identities. Her favorite customer, unaware of her true identity, shockingly turns out to be her husband's boss.

Hindi Language.name: The Casino
Hindi Language.description: A "reluctant Heir" to a billion dollar Casino is emotionally trapped by his father's 'Keep', who is extremely manipulative and deceptive. He must overcome and claim his throne before she destroys him completely and takes the casino away.

Hindi Language.name: Anjaam- Feneo Movies
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around the life of two close friends. A special girl meets them together and that changes their lives forever.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Premium League
Hindi Language.description: With satirical sketches, cheeky debates and blistering roasts, 16 of India's wittiest entertainers compete in teams to be named the ultimate comedy champs.

Hindi Language.name: Court Martial
Hindi Language.description: This play comprises the proceedings of this Court in which the defense lawyer, the extremely sharp Bikash Ray, goes deep into the motive behind the assault and exposes the ugly and shocking truth.

Hindi Language.name: Hunger
Hindi Language.description: A neglected wife in a passionless marriage finds excitement with her young tailor after her husband's growing disinterest leaves her unfulfilled.

Hindi Language.name: Shaadi Mubarak
Hindi Language.description: Preeti when disrespected by both son & his wife tries to earn respect by doing a job as a wedding planner.

Hindi Language.name: Ghoomketu
Hindi Language.description: An aspiring writer from a small town in U.P. runs away to Mumbai. He gives himself 30 days to try and prove his worth.

Hindi Language.name: Photoshoot
Hindi Language.description: Nandini, a young widow with an attractive figure, catches Piyush's greedy eye. He hatches a plan to take advantage of her vulnerability, fueled by his own nefarious desires.

Hindi Language.name: Online
Hindi Language.description: Chetan's father owns a lingerie shop with declining business. Chetan plans to expand to Chinese market but must convince his stern father to let him go to China.

Hindi Language.name: Virkar
Hindi Language.description: When a college student gets murdered in a ghastly manner, Inspector Virkar from the Crime Branch gets called in.

Hindi Language.name: Khatta Meetha
Hindi Language.description: Two quarrelsome siblings studying for different entrance exams constantly fight at home and their coaching institute, causing trouble for their parents until their mentor steps in to resolve conflicts.

Hindi Language.name: Money Mafia
Hindi Language.description: The most shocking con stories in India are chronicled. Meet India's King Cons. No one is safe from cyber crimes in India. From CAs, and advocates, to villagers, 1 out of every 2 Indians has been a victim of identity theft. But who are the people behind this fraud, and how did they convert a place into India's Cyber crime Capital?

Hindi Language.name: Blue Whale
Hindi Language.description: Kriti a struggling air-Hostess after failing to get a job and loosing the love of her life gets introduced to Blue Whale game. This game of dares pushes her to do extreme tasks to eventually commit suicide. Will Kriti survive in this nasty game?

Hindi Language.name: Sandwiched Forever

Hindi Language.name: Aisa Waisa Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: An anthology of 4 short films, strung together by the theme of romance, comedy and characters at different ages and stages of their relationships that crisscross and give us a whole new take on pyaar.

Hindi Language.name: Peshawar
Hindi Language.description: Peshawar is based on a terrorist attack that took place at Peshawar's Army Public School on 16 December 2014, in which more than 148 people, most of them being children were killed.

Hindi Language.name: Tryst with Destiny
Hindi Language.description: A billionaire learns there is something money can't buy, a lower-caste couple attempts to build a new life, and a corrupt city cop finds himself far outside of the law in Nair's slyly biting triptych on class in contemporary India.

Hindi Language.name: Comedy Couple
Hindi Language.description: A story about two comedian couples and the up and downs between their parternship.

Hindi Language.name: Nachaniya
Hindi Language.description: In small-town Bihar, childhood friends hatch a plan for instant wealth. Meanwhile, local performer Rasili navigates romance and revenge, setting off a chain of events that will change their lives forever.

Hindi Language.name: Nakaab
Hindi Language.description: When Aditi Amre becomes involved in the high-profile death case of actress Vibha Dutta, she discovers the horrible secrets that Vibha has been keeping hidden underneath her public persona. Is it a Murder or a Suicide?

Hindi Language.name: Silsila Sidnaaz Ka
Hindi Language.description: Will have unseen footage from the Bigg Boss house that will be all about friendship, love and romance. It will narrate the good and bad times of Shehnaz and Sidharth as a couple.

Hindi Language.name: Raka
Hindi Language.description: Ramakant alias RAKA has built up his anti-social empire with the looted money from the poor people of West Bengal.

Hindi Language.name: Mysterious Lust
Hindi Language.description: Anupriya and Abhishek are married and lead a good lifestyle, however, due to work pressure, Abhishek gets less time for Anupriya due to which she is always upset, as she hardly gets a chance to make love with him.

Hindi Language.name: Marzi
Hindi Language.description: Anurag and Sameera go on a date - a night that will change their lives forever. The truth is tested and the lies are revealed when both have completely different versions of the night.

Hindi Language.name: LOL - Hasse Toh Phasse
Hindi Language.description: Hosted by Boman Irani and Arshad Warsi 10 of India's most entertaining and diverse comedians compete to keep a straight face while attempting to make their contenders laugh. In this 6-hour long comedy duel, the comedians who give in to the laughs get eliminated one by one, and the last one who manages to keep a straight face is crowned 'Last One Laughing'

Hindi Language.name: Glitter
Hindi Language.description: Three independent flatmates find themselves embroiled in a complicated murder case when Samarth, a lawyer, is killed by one of them. Things get darker when the CBI takes charge of the investigation.

Hindi Language.name: Do Minute
Hindi Language.description: One evening, a suburban couple plan to meet in a rented cottage. Waiting for his girlfriend he consumes a good amount of alcohol. She arrives in an auto rickshaw, and requests the driver to stay back for 2 minutes as it was late in the evening and the couple planned to go out. The couple cant wait to have sex so they decide to do it before to head out, the boyfriend falls asleep while doing it, the girl is disappointed and horny and soon seduces the auto driver to sleep with her.

Hindi Language.name: Aafat-e-Ishq
Hindi Language.description: This ZEE5 Original film revolves around Lallo, a 30-year-old recluse girl who yearns for love. She works as a caretaker, and her life changes when she inherits her employer's property.

Hindi Language.name: Shrikant Bashir
Hindi Language.description: Two ideologically and ethnically different individuals partner up to solve crimes of national and international threat.

Hindi Language.name: Beej
Hindi Language.description: Somewhere in a small village of Uttar Pradesh, a young girl named Ela gets possessed by a ghost. Gyanu, her father, brings an expert exorcist Omkar to expel it. In the process, they get to know that the ghost is not a random one, but someone who is related to daughter and father. Soon Omkar finds that Ela and Gyanu are in an incestuous relationship, and that ghost is also connected to that act of taboo. The ghost is impossible to be banished as it is bound to keep Ela and Gyanu in their forbidden bond to fulfil the journey of karma. On the other hand, Omkar has to find a solution to save Ela as she is on the edge of death.

Hindi Language.name: Searching for Sheela
Hindi Language.description: Journalists and fans await Ma Anand Sheela as the infamous former Rajneesh commune's spokesperson returns to India after decades for an interview tour.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Yaar Hoon Main
Hindi Language.description: Rajeev Bansal, a simpleton, leads a content life with his loving family. However, he wishes to build a rapport with and become a close confidant and friend to his young son.

Hindi Language.name: Pinjra Khoobsurti Ka
Hindi Language.description: Mayura, a young woman, leads an unhappy life because the people around her recognise her for her beauty and not for her skills and accomplishments.

Hindi Language.name: Kaanchli Life in a Slough
Hindi Language.description: The immensely beautiful Kajri gets her heart-broken when her husband leaves her to fight alone with the world so to test her husband's feelings towards her, she puts up an act to learn the truth.

Hindi Language.name: His Story
Hindi Language.description: A rollercoaster tale of a power couple, Kunal-Sakshi who lead a perfect married life since 15 years and are the epitome of perfection that makes their friends red with envy.

Hindi Language.name: Secrets of Sinauli
Hindi Language.description: The excavations of Sinauli have uncovered secrets that were buried for 4000 years.
It's 2024, and a mutated virus is turning Mumbai into a death zone. Meanwhile, four friends try to find each other and get to the last train to escape the city.

Hindi Language.name: Shukranu
Hindi Language.description: Set in Delhi/UP/Haryana, SHUKRANU is a comic take on the darkest phases of Indian democracy through the encounters of a would-be groom who is forcefully sterilized just days before his much-awaited marriage.

Hindi Language.name: The Interns
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to the lives of three young interns of Digital Diva. They come with their own set of drama. Come ride along and watch these girls power through their internship and their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Lips Don't Lie
Hindi Language.description: Lips Don't Lie is a high octane romantic thriller anthology of four standalone stories depicting twisted tales of love.

Hindi Language.name: Little Singham: Kaal Ka Badla
Hindi Language.description: Little Singham's biggest enemy, the demon Kaal, is back and badder than ever -- but this time, will he succeed in destroying the world's best kid cop.

Hindi Language.name: Diary - A Life of Indian Housewife
Hindi Language.description: DIARY is story of Lonely Indian Housewife Dominated by her husband and her choices in life shown no respect.

Hindi Language.name: Raat Ki Rani Begum Jaan- Big Movie Zoo
Hindi Language.description: In the market of jism, this story of emotions being sold everyday, will make you think that there are two faces in the rest of this society. Where people do not like to talk in the daylight, they cross the limits to make the nights colorful in the glare of the night.

Hindi Language.name: Atkan Chatkan
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of a gifted kid Guddu, who along with his street kid friends, forms a band to win a prestigious musical competition without using conventional instruments and unites his separated musician parents.

Hindi Language.name: Story 9 Months Ki
Hindi Language.description: Alia, an independent young woman, decides to become a single mother through IVF. While looking for a suitable donor, she meets Sarangdhar, an aspiring writer.

Hindi Language.name: Not Today
Hindi Language.description: A 24-year-old Muslim woman's secret job as a suicide prevention counselor in Mumbai. On her first day, she must open up to stop a suicidal man from jumping off a high-rise.

Hindi Language.name: Bang Baang
Hindi Language.description: Raghu faces the biggest test of his life when he is a prime suspect in a high-profile murder case. Meera, his ex girlfriend is closing onto him at the same time. Will the truth prevail or will the case get more murkier?

Hindi Language.name: Taish
Hindi Language.description: A story of friendship and loss of innocence when two worlds clash amid a wedding when a secret exposes a betrayal, and innocent friends converge with dangerous criminals and intense violence.

Hindi Language.name: Manasvi
Hindi Language.description: A CBI officer's quest to solve a case of serial child killings draws him inwards to seek the ultimate truth of existence.

Hindi Language.name: Vidhan
Hindi Language.description: Vidhan (Writ), a romantic drama, is a take on relationships. A casual conversation on the use of appropriate language sets off a whirlwind romance between Pranay and Akshar (Abhishek). They start meeting regularly and the romance blossoms. However, there is one issue - Akshar is a sex worker. The film takes us through the vicissitudes of their romantic journey.

Hindi Language.name: Possessed Love
Hindi Language.description: A bride disregards her grandmother's warning and leaves home on Haldi night. Upon return, an evil spirit attaches to her, making her desire her husband's friend.

Hindi Language.name: Rakshabandhan... Rasal Apne Bhai Ki Dhal
Hindi Language.description: In the aftermath of their mother's passing, Shivraj and Rasal's world is shaken when their father, Umed, weds both Phooli and the cunning Chakori, unaware of her malicious intentions.

Hindi Language.name: Bhangra Paa Le
Hindi Language.description: Determined to bring traditional bhangra to the world stage, a dancer preps for an international competition against a rival with dreams of her own.

Hindi Language.name: Innocent the Bhola
Hindi Language.description: A dramatic tale of infidelity, blackmail, and loss of innocence, "Innocent: The Bhola" follows a young Nepali boy's transformation from a simple-minded servant to a cruel blackmailer.

Hindi Language.name: MX TakaTak Fame House
Hindi Language.description: The battle of fame sees many an emotion - love, hate, drama, sensational fights and the fire to win - all of which you can expect in MX TakaTak Fame House Season 1. This unique reality series will see 18 top Internet creators put under one roof for 7 days and with all of them gunning for one thing - more fame.

Hindi Language.name: Humraaz
Hindi Language.description: Two couples meet by chance at a resort. As romance and passion intensify, their past and present lives intertwine. Rekha feels elated, but unexpected events await them all.

Hindi Language.name: Manjulika
Hindi Language.description: Tanu Weds Manu.But in the very first night, beautiful Tanu become Manjulika...a ghost and it disturb the life of entire family.

Hindi Language.name: Maid for Each Other
Hindi Language.description: A married man's affair with his housemaid spirals into obsession. As their intimacy deepens, she becomes dangerously infatuated, leading to a perilous entanglement.

Hindi Language.name: Badnaam
Hindi Language.description: Desperate to leave her parents' house and start a new life with her boyfriend Kabir, Sonia agrees to deliver a mysterious package for her friend. Will her decision help her fulfill her desires.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Meri Sonam Gupta Bewafa Hai
Hindi Language.description: In this ZEE5 Original film, Sintoo, a dejected lover, pens down his feelings on a currency note which goes viral and triggers a chain of hilarious events. Will he overcome the heartbreak and find closure?

Hindi Language.name: Akkad Bakkad Rafu Chakkar
Hindi Language.description: Bhargav and Siddhant, friends, set out to create India's first fake bank to steal 71,500 crores from Hoshiargarh, Madhya Pradesh, using tricks, godmen, and glamour to expose the dangers of scams.

Hindi Language.name: Aakhet
Hindi Language.description: Babu Nepal Singh of laadi village is a clannish, wealthy and a married person of the age about 40-42 years. He spends his holidays alone away from his urban life style every year, without fail. But he doesn't take his wife along with, nobody knows the reason and his other colleague's don't have much enthusiasm for outgoing to pass away their holidays with him. In his monotonous routine one of Babu Nepal sing's regrets in life is that he has never hunted a tiger whereas his royal ancestors had killed many tigers. His one friend suggested him to visit Betla Forest, Palamu, Jharkhand in coming Durga Puja vacation where he can shoot a tiger and gave him a tour guide address. His name is Murshed who lives in the village near Beta forest. Knowing this snoop Babu Nepal Singh turned out with thrill and he prepares his mind to go for tiger expedition in the forest of Betla without fail. Thus he rushed for nearby village along with his ancestral gun as his holiday begins - Finally what happens with Nepal Singh, did he shoot the tiger.

Hindi Language.name: Namak Issk Ka
Hindi Language.description: 15 years ago, Ravikant and Nishkant's cars meet with a terrible accident. Later, Chamcham disguises herself as Pandit's daughter and performs.

Hindi Language.name: Haathi Ghoda Pal Ki Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki
Hindi Language.description: To teach the world that good always prevails over evil, Lord Vishnu takes birth as Krishna. Watch the tales and miracles from his childhood.

Hindi Language.name: Bezubaan
Hindi Language.description: In the heart of New Delhi, at Bhargav Classes, young Chandan struggles with both academics and intimacy. His secret relationship with Ginny is plagued by his inability to perform, leading him on a bizarre journey involving love potions, shady babas, and an ill-fated visit to GB Road. When a rape case tied to his father's stolen car puts him under police scrutiny, Chandan's world spirals out of control.

Hindi Language.name: Metro Park 2
Hindi Language.description: Metro Park Season 2 is a Hindi web series about all the family drama that revolves around the Patel family. This season has 12 episodes; each 22 mins - 24 mins long.

Hindi Language.name: Akki Jaanbaaz
Hindi Language.description: Akki is a nine-year-old boy blessed with extraordinary karate skills. While he tries to lead a normal life, he ensures the optimum usage of his power for good deeds.

Hindi Language.name: Daasi
Hindi Language.description: Daasi is a concept, which puts light on superstition and how it affects people's lives. This illness has been rooted in society since hundreds of years.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Mera Saath Rahe
Hindi Language.description: Talented but timid Gopika fails to match up to her husband's expectations. When she finds a mentor in her mother-in-law, Meethila, things take a turn.

Hindi Language.name: Mentalhood
Hindi Language.description: The rules of parenting have changed. Every mother has her own strategy and some have their own game, with only one aim - to be the best of the best. Step into this #Mentalhood.

Hindi Language.name: Galti
Hindi Language.description: Galti is a 2019 Hindi erotic thriller film featuring Arun Kant Yadav, Mohan G Mahto and Anushka Shrivastava. The movie, directed by Bande Prasad and Produced by Mohan G Mahto and Santosh Vishwakrma under their banners Arts Productions and Om Art respectively. shoot in 35 days Nepal and Mumbai. It is based on the story of a girl living in a Ranchi, and two guys who fall in love with her.film released on 12 April 2019.

Hindi Language.name: Khunnas
Hindi Language.description: A house decked out like Diwali just for their daughter's birthday is thrilled by gunshots. The assassin is none other than their driver, whose rage was triggered by the birthday girl's past acts. Witness the twisted affair behind this revenge drama that leads to a massacre.

Hindi Language.name: Couples Guest House
Hindi Language.description: 2 romantic couples moves out for a trip and stay at Couples Guest House. The romance-filled story turns upside down and become a nightmare.

Hindi Language.name: Hundred
Hindi Language.description: An unapologetic and frustrated ACP teams up with an honest civil worker who teams up to accomplish their personal objectives.

Hindi Language.name: Guns of Banaras
Hindi Language.description: Guns of Banaras is Indian (Hindi ) language action film. Directed by Shekhar Suri and jointly produced by Ashok Munshi and Shaina Nath Taldar under the banner of Dashaka Cinema Co, and is presented by Dashaka Films and AJ media.

Hindi Language.name: Mittho Bhabhi
Hindi Language.description: This is Romantic Comedy of Story of a village called as 'Mittho Bhabhi'. She wants to grow her telephone booth business by attracting young boys and using them to boost her business along with other females.

Hindi Language.name: Bhootiyapa
Hindi Language.description: A Ghost trapped in the Haunted house for raping Married Women can only break the spell by committing the same crime. He goes on a Rampage and it almost looks like there is no stopping him.

Hindi Language.name: Shadyantra
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a woman. A conspiracy is planned to get something special. The team experiments something different bringing in the twist. Can the dangerous plan change their life forever?

Hindi Language.name: Evil Dead Is Back
Hindi Language.description: A mysterious soul wants to revenge for his past life, a newly married family wants to explore their past and find something horror. They are in trap trying to protect his wife

Hindi Language.name: Ladies vs Gentlemen
Hindi Language.description: Ladies vs Gentlemen is a unique opinion poll show, where India's biggest opinion-makers will wrestle out some of the most debated questions about MEN vs WOMEN. The show is hosted by the celebrity couple Riteish Deshmukh and Genelia Deshmukh and joined by the famous opinion makers/panelists. The show will also give a chance to India to answer the questions and win exciting prizes every day. This gender war will be led by our Panellists who will go head to head against each other and debate the every day topics that men and women face. They will answer 3 quirky, fun, and relevant questions in % that they think is right. Which will lead to them defending their answers in the form of fun banter and debate. They will get points each time they are closer to India's answer as compared to their opponent. As the name of the show suggests, this is a war that every human being can relate to and the ones fighting it are our Panellists. Through the course of this show, we get to know more insights about our panelists and how they are in real life. Hosts ask a question to the Panellists and the audience; they get 10 seconds to answer the question in percentage. Panelists' answers are revealed and the debate starts, hosts also give their point of view and take part in the debate. Hosts culminate the debate by revealing the answer of India in percentage and compare it with the panelists' answers. Hosts introduce a scoreboard that will show which panelist wins at the end of the day whose answers are close to India's answers. (10 points will be added after every question) The next morning at 9 am, the audience with the closest answers to the actual percentages will get to win amazing rewards on the Flipkart App.

Hindi Language.name: Chakori
Hindi Language.description: The first ray of the morning went out to sell milk and became the lover of the owner. Breaking the relationship by creating a web of beauty, Chakori became the wound of every heart.

Hindi Language.name: Doordarshan
Hindi Language.description: When the family's grandmother wakes up, the parents who have been bickering over their divorce are compelled to revive their marriage and keep the peace at home.

Hindi Language.name: Chalo Koi Baat Nahi
Hindi Language.description: A sketch comedy show that gives a satirical twist to a streak of issues and challenges faced by the common people, on an everyday basis. The show consists of 6 episodes, where each episode showcases different pillars of modern India such as sports, hospitals, media, education, Bollywood, environment, and marriage among others.

Hindi Language.name: Mission Frontline with Rana Daggubati
Hindi Language.description: Superstar Rana Daggubati spends time with India's finest of the Border Security Force at an outpost in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan in this discovery+ original.

Hindi Language.name: Rani Ka Raja
Hindi Language.description: Social and family pressure leads a man to hire a hooker to pretend as his wife. Everything was going well until the man's old rival an Inspector raids his house and finds the details of the hooker. The Inspector later hires that hooker to solve his conflict. But as its said every fortune comes with some bad blood that the hooker later realizes but there was no turning back.

Hindi Language.name: Sons of the Soil: Jaipur Pink Panthers
Hindi Language.description: A sports documentary series that follows the journey of Bollywood star Abhishek Bachchan owned Kabaddi team - Jaipur Pink Panthers in their attempt to reclaim the champion's trophy of India's Pro Kabaddi League 2018-19.

Hindi Language.name: Ankahi Ansuni
Hindi Language.description: Demoted for misconduct, Umesh, an eccentric genius and the youngest inspector in the history of UP police, is posted to a fictional sleepy town Jhaagi. The town is known for unsolved crimes and mysterious sightings.

Hindi Language.name: Bhavai
Hindi Language.description: The Film depicts us with path path for LOVE and LIFE as a SITA Character. But our mind lost power to choose between RAVANA and RAMA due to EVIL thoughts.

Hindi Language.name: Ramyug
Hindi Language.description: Movie is adaptation of the epic Ramayana.

Hindi Language.name: Chhinnar
Hindi Language.description: A story of a sex worker girl her name is Chameli, a village Pradhan did a fake marriage of this girl and his son for his personal use, but they fall in love in real life and can't be separated.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Mere Ghar Aana
Hindi Language.description: Despite losing their COVID warrior son to the pandemic, the Sakhujas are hopeful during tragic times. What happens when a grumpy loner enters their life?

Hindi Language.name: Raat Ka Khel Saara
Hindi Language.description: Annas womanising ways bring him closer to Shevanta, but when she gets betrayed, she decides to teach him a lesson. Will Indu, Annas wife, be able to get through all of it with her family intact?

Hindi Language.name: Girls in Big City
Hindi Language.description: It all about six girls Kamya, Payal, Misty, Dolly, Sweety, Parineeti who come to a big city from different places to fulfill their dreams to be an actress in the film industry and and how they get their luck on the wrong way and spoil their life is the story of the movie.

Hindi Language.name: Agar Tum Na Hote
Hindi Language.description: Niyati, a nurse, feels inexplicably drawn towards a mentally ill patient named Aditya and decides to nurse him back to health. She soon learns that there is more to Aditya's life than meets the eye.

Hindi Language.name: NCR: Chapter One
Hindi Language.description: NCR: Chapter One is an Indie Feature Film directed by Saif Baidya Under the production of Yaariyan House of Creativity in association with Shabros Films.

Hindi Language.name: Chattis Aur Maina
Hindi Language.description: Ambitious Maina, the lead of a dance troupe, meets neighborhood good boy Chattis. Poles apart in real life, what happens when they start vibing on a dating app?

Hindi Language.name: The Hidden Strike
Hindi Language.description: The Hidden Strike is a fictional movie about a ground mission where a team of thirteen Indian Army officers and soldiers went across POK and destroyed the terrorist camp with a planned sub tactical strike. The film is dedicated to India soldiers and their families. The film shows what price our freedom fighters pay for the safety of our country. The Hidden Strike also highlights issues that the Indian Army faces from certain groups of people from the valley.

Hindi Language.name: Jijaji Chhat Parr Koii Hai
Hindi Language.description: The show is sequel of previous successful show, Jijaji Chhat Par Hai., & is a comedy cum horror story where 2 families will be fighting to get a Haveli (a Mansion) but these both families are unaware of ghost existence in that mansion.

Hindi Language.name: Wakaalat from Home
Hindi Language.description: The story of a couple who hold their divorce hearings over video calls.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Nishedh
Hindi Language.description: A group of ambitious friends strive as they struggle to pursue their dreams. Meanwhile, they also make determined efforts to deal with taboo subjects in society.

Hindi Language.name: Pinaki & Happy - The Bhoot Bandhus
Hindi Language.description: In the beautiful town of Modern City somewhere in India, there is a mansion named "Vibhooti Mansion". A haunted Mansion. What's not known to the people is that there is an 11-year human kid live among the Bhoots (ghosts), Pinaki. As a baby, Pinaki was found on the doorstep of the mansion, along with a note that the boy must be protected by the people who live in. The family of Bhoots , "Col. Suri" being head of the family with his lovely wife "Mrs. Suri " who loves to cook odd-some dishes, "Happy" as a Big Brother and "Gappu" as a cute-little-talking-dog. Yes, All Bhoots . So here we are, this cracked family of misfit Bhoots adopt Pinaki and raise him as one of their own. Time flies, all these years Pinaki has been kept within the safe boundaries of the palace until one-day things take a turn when our protagonist decides to step out to see the outside world and pursue further education in Modern City's famous public school. The family has no choice but to come out of the haunted house for the first time in a decade. Thus begins the spooky adventures of Pinaki and his Bhoot family followed by a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world. Interestingly, Pinaki ends up resolving all their conflicts with the humans and strike a balance all the time keeping and his family's hidden identity intact.

Hindi Language.name: Nazarband
Hindi Language.description: A woman freed from prison finds her slum replaced by skyscrapers and her family disappeared. She joins forces with a scheming ex-convict to search through Kolkata's maze of criminals, police, and traffickers.

Hindi Language.name: Starting Troubles
Hindi Language.description: A Doctor is called many things from a healer to a saviour to even a God. But what happens when an ENT surgeon shares labels like "theatre actor", "entrepreneur" and "stand-up comedian?"

Hindi Language.name: Mai Hero Boll Raha Hu
Hindi Language.description: Nawab rises as an underworld don from a small town boy to Bombay's most powerful don. He falls in love with actress Laila who isn't aware of who he is. His erstwhile mentor Lala turns against him. Will Nawab and Laila survive?

Hindi Language.name: Pavitra Bhagya
Hindi Language.description: Jugnu lives a tough life in an orphanage and her mother Pranati doesn't even know about her existence. As for Jugnu's father Reyansh, life is one big party and love is a liability. Will this broken family ever come together?

Hindi Language.name: Mukesh Jasoos
Hindi Language.description: A quintessential loser and detective with questionable skills and laughable methods navigates through petty crimes. However, something sinister is brewing.

Hindi Language.name: The Hunt
Hindi Language.description: Major Rajveer is on a deadly rescue mission to find his younger brother, who has disappeared into thin air. Can he win this race against time?

Hindi Language.name: Gahara Asar Dil Tak
Hindi Language.description: Akash brother Vikash keeping a dark secret which he can't speak to any family members, His father has seen many doctors but to no avail as they thought Vikas is a became a hysteria patient.

Hindi Language.name: Bapu
Hindi Language.description: Bapu is an Indian animation show inspired by the revered Indian personality Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi. It is a fictional show about the adventures of Gandhi set in modern context featuring values, ethics and a whole lot of entertainment.

Hindi Language.name: Rishton Ka Manjha
Hindi Language.description: In a unique way, a young girl stops a boy from ending his life and inspires him to live.

Hindi Language.name: Ishk Par Zor Nahin
Hindi Language.description: When two people with contrasting ideologies about marriage cross paths with each other, it leads to chaos and misunderstandings.

Hindi Language.name: Kaun? Who Did it?
Hindi Language.description: Every episode will feature a thrilling murder case, allowing audiences the opportunity to get to the bottom of the mystery themselves and win exciting prizes as they deal with challenging twists, solve cryptic puzzles and identify suspects in real-time. Singh plays Adi Bhagat, a former police officer-turned-detective. He is brought back to the fold by a determined assistant police inspector Malini (Suwalka), who requires his expertise. Though reluctant at first, Bhagat aids Malini. The first look of this interactive crime fiction series was unveiled on December 23, 2021, with an intriguing poster featuring television star Sushant Singh who is known for his versatile performances, accompanied by film and theatre actress Samvedna Suwalka. The poster reveals a somber Sushant oozing with mystery along with a gorgeous but gritty assistant police inspector, Samvedna, as they solve complicated crime mysteries. Adding a twist to the traditional police tape, the poster invites the audience to actually cross over and become a part of the investigation. This show will provide the thrill of visceral entertainment and the rush of decoding a secret before the protagonist does.

Hindi Language.name: Karkat Rogue
Hindi Language.description: A first of its kind Bi-Lingual (Bengali and Hindi) web series in India, with an entire backdrop of the heinous world of Anti Cancer drug trial.

Hindi Language.name: Hamaari Bhabhi
Hindi Language.description: Elder brother decide to marry and bring a female in family to take care of his two younger brothers but When woman is greedy, she can destroy the entire family.

Hindi Language.name: Klpd
