Hindi Language.description: Two young men rent from a strict colonel who forbids female guests. Ignoring the rule, they secretly invite an attractive woman to stay for three days.

Hindi Language.name: Sargam Ki Sadhe Satii
Hindi Language.description: When a naive girl is married in an idiosyncratic household filled with men, she pulls out all stops to manage her life amidst conundrums.

Hindi Language.name: Mee Raqsam
Hindi Language.description: It revolves around a young girl's aspiration to become a dancer, but coming from a small village like Mijwan, everyone questions her dreams and choices. It's only her father who trusts, supports and helps her in this journey of achieving her dream.

Hindi Language.name: Vinash Kaal
Hindi Language.description: Nupur along with her fiancé Jai and friends planned a bachelorette party at her native house at village. But that house was possessed by a supernatural power who want to destroy her family's heir.In that village, a tantric was also chanting hyms to control that supernatural power with the help of whom he will become almighty and powerful.When that supernatural power interact with Nupur, Tantric came in between and then the war began.Will that soul be able to kill Nupur and take her revenge?Will Rajesh Vivek be able to control that soul?

Hindi Language.name: Teri Meri Ikk Jindri
Hindi Language.description: Amritsar's resident Mahi falls in love with Jogi and the duo gets married. However, Mahi refuses to bow down to the rules laid down by her brother-in-law Pappuji and struggles to win the much-deserved respect and recognition of her love.

Hindi Language.name: Taare Zameen Par
Hindi Language.description: Aspiring young singers from all over India showcase their talents under the mentorship of prominent artists to impress the judges.

Hindi Language.name: Faactory
Hindi Language.description: Yash falls in love with Natasha but is not able to profess his feelings to her. A few years later, he stalks and kidnaps her. Will they fall in love or will his obsession increase with time.

Hindi Language.name: Chronicle of Space
Hindi Language.description: After his father's disappearance, eight-year-old Dighu seeks refuge from loneliness in his imagination and diary entries.

Hindi Language.name: Chatkarey
Hindi Language.description: An infotainment series that delves into wide range of critical topics including health and nutrition during the first 1000 days of life of pregnant mother, newborn care, family planning and more told in an engaging and entertaining manner.

Hindi Language.name: Good Night
Hindi Language.description: On a night when thousands of weddings take place, three newlywed couples-each from a different social class-embark on their first-night journeys, filled with unexpected twists, humor, and chaos. Their stories, though worlds apart, share an uncanny resemblance-proving that love, desire, and fate don't discriminate by wealth or status.

Hindi Language.name: Rangili
Hindi Language.description: Rangili is a 2021 Indian erotic horror film which is a story about a painter and his girlfriend. Rangili features Rekha Mona Sarkar and Ajay Bafna in lead roles and will be released on Net Prime App.

Hindi Language.name: Modi
Hindi Language.description: Modi (Season 2) - CM to PM follows the journey of India's most celebrated leader who inspired a billion Indians and led us to a new age India. Watch Narendra Modi look back on his experiences and retrace his path to becoming India's Prime Minister. From being a three time CM to becoming the 14th Prime Minister of India, relive the story that has made him the man we know.

Hindi Language.name: Montu Ki Paltan
Hindi Language.description: The story begins with the irony in the life of five children Rohit, Mihika, Ananya, Nupur, and Om whose face problems at their home and they decide to resolve it.

Hindi Language.name: Nath Zewar Ya Zanjeer
Hindi Language.description: Unaware of the burden society has placed on her, a bright Mahua finds herself trapped in the clutches of a landlord due to a cruel custom.

Hindi Language.name: Kaamnaa
Hindi Language.description: 'Kamna' is bringing the story of the conflict between middle class husband and wife and their principles.

Hindi Language.name: Deewaanee
Hindi Language.description: Deewaanee a triangular love story is a romantic, musical, suspense thriller.

Hindi Language.name: Nima Denzongpa
Hindi Language.description: Nima Denzongpa, a young bride from Sikkim, shifts to Mumbai with her husband but their arrival results in racial discrimination against her.

Hindi Language.name: Kashibai Bajirao Ballal
Hindi Language.description: Protected and pampered as a child, Kashibai rises to the challenge and proves to be an able administrator when her husband Peshwa Bajirao sets out to expand the Maratha empire.

Hindi Language.name: Sumer Singh Case Files: Girlfriends
Hindi Language.description: An ACP with a sharp eye for the truth. 4 mis-fitting pieces in his puzzle. Each move reveals a new clue! Sumer Singh Case Files: Girlfriends, revolves around an honest and diligent police officer, ACP Sumer Singh who moves to Delhi with his sights set on finding and delivering justice, building on his impressive record of solving cases involving youngsters wrapped up in a world of crime. When his leap into romance takes a deadly wrong turn, the no nonsense cop finds himself enmeshed in the lives of four friends, who are all hiding dirty secrets. There is also a high-level inquiry on him since he was closely associated with one the girlfriends. What he hadn't expected was to be sitting before a senior officer, months later, explaining how he got involved with four criminals - in a case which had a disappearance, a suicide, an attempt to murder and blackmail. DCP Ratishankar (Played by Swanand Kirkire) questions Sumer about his dealings with these four young women and he reveals a plot filled with secrets, lies, twisted plots and heartbreak. With Rannvijay displaying his remarkable acting chops, the whodunnit keeps you hooked throughout as it deep dives into the mystery behind the unimaginable extent to which four supposed best friends can go for their own gain. Best friends, for never. The show consists of 8 episodes and features a talented cast that includes Karishma Sharma, Priyanka Purohit, Aditi Arya, Elisha Mayor, Ayaz Ahmed and Sidharth Bhardwaj along with Rannvijay Singh and Swanand Kirkire.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Not Blind
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a visually challenged guy, Vimal, struggling with life and his amazing journey of fulfilling an unusual dream of becoming IAS officer despite his low self confidence.

Hindi Language.name: Shaadi Vivah
Hindi Language.description: Two female con artists who marry wealthy men for their money face a challenge when two determined police officers devise a plan to catch them in their criminal scheme.

Hindi Language.name: School Wala Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Elvish Yadav Originals Presents a Story Of 3 Friends and their ups and downs in life and friendship.

Hindi Language.name: Uncommon Sense with Saloni
Hindi Language.description: A variety show which looks at most topics surrounding a middle-class family with a very uncommon and hilarious lens. Every episode has some commentary on the current affairs in our nation and has a different theme for every episode.

Hindi Language.name: Swap
Hindi Language.description: A couple is not happy with their marriage life relationship , things take thriller turn when they try to get rid of their marriage. Least cast yet more entertaining. This is 3 episodic based web series. The length of this web series is 1 hour.

Hindi Language.name: ZOO webseries
Hindi Language.description: This series pledges to spread positivity in this uncertain time of amid Covid 19. This series is an Infotainment Series where information and entertainment both are involved. It's an initiative to spread awareness, love and social messages through this unique webseries. This series is totally completed staying Indoors without breaching the Stay Home Policy. Dropout Media has dedicated this series to the Frontliners working for us.[3] This series mainly focuses on the real situation of the people at this time of uncertainty, involving the real shits happening around us.

Hindi Language.name: Me, Boss and Lockdown
Hindi Language.description: Introvert Ajey Nagar works in an ad agency. Rockstar, a character Ajey developed for the brand, comes alive to help him woo his crush and impress his rude boss.

Hindi Language.name: Aryan and Meera
Hindi Language.description: Say hi to Aryan and Meera. They're finally moving in together after a year of dating. Yes yes, it's a VERY big step. Curious to see how it'll go? Catch Aryan and Meera exclusively on Netflix India's YouTube Channel.

Hindi Language.name: Naati Pinky Ki Lambi Love Story
Hindi Language.description: Her unbreakable spirit and her wit are what help her stand out. Harboring dreams of becoming a stand-up comedian, she falls flat on her face when she faces her rigid and traditional father. Will Pinky find her courage and strength?

Hindi Language.name: The Cobweb
Hindi Language.description: Where a hero with his smartness creates a dark cobweb to earn crores of money illegally. Hero is been accompanied by a 19 years old girl named Nancy to carry this illegal activity. But there is a saying that "God has a plan for all evils"

Hindi Language.name: Code Name Abdul
Hindi Language.description: In New York, four Counter Intelligence agents from India's Research and Analysis Wing (RAW) are given a mission to find an elusive Terrorist.

Hindi Language.name: Nyay: The Justice
Hindi Language.description: Mahinder, a small-town talent, rises to fame but faces betrayal and a mysterious death. His family's fight for justice fades as media and public interest wane, revealing the dark side of the industry.

Hindi Language.name: Deja Vu
Hindi Language.description: When a man hears that a plane ostensibly carrying all his loved ones has crashed, he begins making frantic phone calls to assess the extent of the damage, and to figure out if something sinister is at play.

Hindi Language.name: The River of Love
Hindi Language.description: A man who has forgotten his past (Raahi) meets a woman (Swara) who'd rather forget hers. He combines a great power for self-destruction and penitence with a desperate need for dignity. She stoically faces all the odds life throws at her, guarding herself with her devotion to God, ready to unflinchingly brave anything that may come at her. They decide to become fellow travelers on a spiritual journey of discovery. But as one journey is about to end, a more epiphanic one is set to begin.

Hindi Language.name: Bulbule
Hindi Language.description: Harmeet and Irfan, friends from diverse minority communities in India, reconnect after five years, discussing politics, religion, justice, and discrimination in Bulbule, a poignant portrayal of modern India.

Hindi Language.name: Gul Makai
Hindi Language.description: Gul Makai' accounts the courageous journey and struggle of Nobel laureate Malala Yousufzai, from her humble upbringing in the Swat Valley to her becoming the champion for free education to all.

Hindi Language.name: Crashh
Hindi Language.description: A happy family was torn apart by a fateful accident. When fate brings them together will Kabir, Kajol, Alia and Rahim realise that they are family? Will these long lost siblings find their long lost love for each other?

Hindi Language.name: Bhasudi
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a group of youngsters. Things take a different turn as they deal in weapons. With back to back gangster fights and deadly attacks, things take a twist.

Hindi Language.name: Saat Kadam
Hindi Language.description: Saat Kadam revolves around the generation gap and the relationship between a father and his son. It is a a fictional sports based film.

Hindi Language.name: Filmi Raasleela
Hindi Language.description: METOO IN BOLLYWOOD . A realistic film based on the dark side of bollywood film industry , where newcomers are exploited after luring them of casting in film. The low budget filmmakers invest small amounts in films just to exploit girls and finally the girls land up becoming high paid call girls .

Hindi Language.name: Jhini Bini Chadariya
Hindi Language.description: A street dancer trying to save her daughter and a lonely weaver seeking connection are caught in the same crisis in Varanasi, a city where rising hatred turns everyday life into a fight for survival.

Hindi Language.name: Bamini and Boys
Hindi Language.description: Three boys rent a flat out of their budget from an attractive woman. Bitten by the love bug, they compete to woo her, only to land in hilarious situations.

Hindi Language.name: Risky Ishq
Hindi Language.description: Love is beautiful, but it never mixes well with deception, rejection and betrayal. In this set of short stories, find out how far a person can go for 'love'.

Hindi Language.name: Runaway Lugaai
Hindi Language.description: Rajnikant Sinha is a submissive man who has lived his entire life under his father's thumb as a pawn. His life took a turn for the better when Rajni met and married Bulbul. However, Bulbul made a bold decision to run away without a trace.

Hindi Language.name: Trishna Ek Chahat
Hindi Language.description: A story of a family who desires for money which brings family relations at stake.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Not a Player
Hindi Language.description: I AM NOT A PLAYER The story of our film is based on a young boy "Ankur"who wants to be a player of kickboxing.He hides practicing kickboxing for fear of his father. But one day when Ankur's father "Shivcharan"gets to know that Ankur is wasting his time in a game,he forbids Ankur to take interest in this game.But Ankur's mother being greedy supports Ankur to win the gold medal and give it to her so that she can make jewellery with that gold medal.Even after Shivcharan refuses, Ankur's mother persuades Shivcharan and Ankur is allowed to prepare for the boxing championship. A coach named"Jayveer" trains Ankur for kickboxing .While returning from training with his cousin, a goon type youngster Ashu's car and Ankur mopate(scooty)collide.In this case,both groups get Into a fight in which Ankur and his cousin beats Ashu and his friends Chimpo,Montu and Fattu. After that according to Preeti's plan Ankur is badly beaten by a kick boxing player named Harsh by bribing a coach "Ravi Sharma" in the championship to be held in Mathura City to avenge his boyfriend's beating. Due to which Ankur goes into coma. Ashu's heart falls on Harsh's girlfriend participating in the Mathura Championship and Ashu goes madly in love with Varsha "Harsh's girlfriend".When Preeti gets to know everything she realizes her mistake and meets Ankur in the hospital . She tells that no one else is responsible for his condition but she herself is and apologizes to Ankur. Ankur forgives her. Seeing this nature of Ankur, Preeti falls in love with Ankur. The parents, seeing Ankur's condition, ask him to quit kickboxing forever but Preeti convinces Ankur's parents and she herself prepares Ankur for the next championship . When Ashu comes to know that Preeti has now known his reality, Ashu meets Harsh and his girlfriend and warn them to defeat Ankur again but God is great and love has much power and the pan of love is always heavy. That is, in the final kick boxing championship, Ankur defeats Harsh very badly,which results Ankur recieving two trophies with a gold medal. All the villagers reach Ankur's house and celebrate the happiness. On this occasion, Ankur's parents announce Ankur and Preeti's wedding. ....THE END

Hindi Language.name: Lahore Confidential
Hindi Language.description: The Story revolves around a humble, divorced Indian woman named Ananya and amidst her mundane-routine life, she finds herself on a secret intelligence duty in Pakistan. But her love for Urdu literature will have her falling in love that will eventually put them in a tug of war with each other.

Hindi Language.name: Aur Bhai Kya Chal Raha Hai
Hindi Language.description: When two culturally and ideologically opposite families are forced to live under the same roof, it sparks conflict and daily bickering between them.

Hindi Language.name: Hidden
Hindi Language.description: What happens if you are not ready for something ? That something reveals darker plot with uncertainty and gray characters so it can take you on bad trip, that's what exactly happens with ACP. Raje &his Team.

Hindi Language.name: Qurbaan Hua
Hindi Language.description: A Hindu man seeks revenge for his sister's murder, believing the culprit is a Muslim woman's father. They fake a marriage to uncover the truth, their differing stances bringing them under one roof.

Hindi Language.name: Bhadkhau
Hindi Language.description: Everyone is baffled when mysterious situations arise after Santyas wedding. Especially when one of the wedding gift turns out to be a puzzling 500 note.

Hindi Language.name: Bamfaad
Hindi Language.description: A passionate love story set in Allahabad between Naate and Neelam who meet accidentally and fall in love. They make brave choices and go through a path of love and loss to be with each other.

Hindi Language.name: The Glitch
Hindi Language.description: Sometimes in order to understand someone's point of view you need to put yourself in their shoes...literally. This is what happens when a 17-year-old shy girl and her bubbly 70-year-old grandmother switch bodies and discover each other's lives and secrets, while they figure out how to reverse this 'Glitch'.

Hindi Language.name: Fauji Calling
Hindi Language.description: A soldier sacrifices his life during an attack. His family struggles following the attack which they've to face along with getting over their loss.

Hindi Language.name: Waah Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Waah Zindagi is a Hindi situational comedy which is a slice of life story about a fickle boy who is set to redeem his past. It is incidentally the first Hindi Film related to the Government of India's 'Make in India' initiative. The film is produced by Ashok Choudhary and directed by Dinesh Yadav. The script is said to have been written after a research of three years. The film revolves around the struggles and rise of the Ceramic Industry in India.

Hindi Language.name: Bhanwar
Hindi Language.description: A couple moves into a new apartment and discovers that the place is already occupied by their own ghosts. They soon realise they have time travelled and can see the person who killed them

Hindi Language.name: Pariwar
Hindi Language.description: A loving father who misses his wayward quarrelsome children will stop at nothing to make sure they come home, and Kashiram Narayan knows just the right tricks.

Hindi Language.name: Halfpace
Hindi Language.description: When a bed-ridden teen discovers his online crush has been murdered, he investigates her death, leading him on a hunt to stop her killer before he strikes again.

Hindi Language.name: Omprakash Zindabad
Hindi Language.description: The story is of a wage earner who thinks that if he was having a bike instead of bicycle his life would have changed... he would have become a contractor than a laborer. There is a compounder in a hospital of that village who has strived for years to come into politics but the villagers do not give him more importance. One day this compounder comes to know about a game of scam which is being done in the name of the government compensation, and he promises this wager a bike in return of his support in that game. He has an aim to represent himself as a guardian angel of the poor to fill his own political motive. Both of these common men pass through the funny and interesting events which makes you laugh and also expose the untouched and unseen issues of their society.

Hindi Language.name: Sabka Sai
Hindi Language.description: A saint worshipped across India - Sai Baba has touched and enriched the lives of many. Highly anticipated amongst his followers, 'Sabka Sai', gives a glimpse into the life of the great Sufi Saint. This is an effort at a biographical account of one of the most beloved and spiritual persons to ever walk this earth. His path from being an adopted child to distinguishing himself as the 'Saint from Shirdi'.

Hindi Language.name: Sasural Genda Phool 2
Hindi Language.description: After his wife's death, Ishaan does not want to remarry and begin a new life. However, things take a turn when he meets Titlee (Tanya)

Hindi Language.name: Aisa Bhi Hota Hai
Hindi Language.description: Two friends talk to each other about their sex life. One of them has a lot of girlfriends and the other a Looser, The Looser wants to compete with his friend Rohan. One day he sees an add on a newspaper for a Friendship club to become a Gigolo, for which he purchases a membership. Rohan finds out and warns him about it but he doesn't heed. They the next day he boasts about his experience as it was the most wonderful one, just like a fairy tale. Rohan does not buy the story and then soon finds out what actually happened.

Hindi Language.name: The Closed Door
Hindi Language.description: Two writers contradict with each other's story about a closed door which is there in the host writer's flat. Things take a turn when the guest writer breaks the lock to see what is hidden inside

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu in Double Trouble
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Chingam is being forced to marry, but his bride gets kidnapped by some local goons. While Motu Patlu are trying to save Chingam's bride 'Dharti'', their identical twins Motuji and Patluji are in another mission.

Hindi Language.name: The Third Hacker
Hindi Language.description: A guy who is a game addict, turns to an ethical hacker. The Engineer student comes to hacking world for some reasons. The Story is all about that guy.

Hindi Language.name: I Deal Friendship
Hindi Language.description: It's a murder mystery of Ankush Desai. His best friend Kush is accused for the killing. He is long time drug addict. Police interrogates him to find out the truth behind. Kush tries to Explain, how he is not guilty and Ankush was killed by a ghost. Now the question is how will Kush prove his innocence because law needs evidence and how can he prove the very existence of ghosts, when u cant see them.

Hindi Language.name: Ghar Pe Bataao
Hindi Language.description: After 5 years of their relationship, the girl struggles to convince the boy to apprise his parents about them. The boys seems to be dithering and stalling because he is aware the full weight of an inter faith marriage would do to his parents. But the girl has made up her mind. It's now or never and she will push through. The entire movie unfolds in real time over their morning walk on a weekend trip to Matheran. They relive old bittersweet memories reminding themselves of the shared love, fully aware of the uncertain future that holds for both of them. They confide in each other stories of hurt and disarming moments of deep affection. This peaceful moment of intimacy is marked with fear and worry. They have known each other for many years since the time they were neighbors in Mumbai. She always thought of him as a quitter but for her, he would go to any length. She brought the best out of him. What if life doesn't move in the direction you desire? She knows there won't be any life to live and love without him. There are real conversations, stolen looks, brief pauses and unbeknownst to her, startling revelations.

Hindi Language.name: Nagin
Hindi Language.description: In an epic adventure where knives will be thrown into shoulders after which one stumbles onto a wire connected to a trap covered by leaves and people will be hacked to gore, a princess must win.

Hindi Language.name: Iss Mod Se Jaate Hain
Hindi Language.description: Paragi dreams of becoming an IAS officer and receives all the support from her uncle, but will society and her family's expectations clip her wings?

Hindi Language.name: Sitapur: The City of Gangsters
Hindi Language.description: Dev Singh Rana gets into a fight with some bullies which later turns into a fierce enmity. Soon a series of murders start. Will the animosity ever end.

Hindi Language.name: The Weekend
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a couple. They decide to spend a happy weekend together. As they experiment new things they find something special. Can they stick on with their love and bond forever?

Hindi Language.name: Rajnigandha
Hindi Language.description: Rajnigandha is a heart-wrenching story of a father and daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Into the Wild with Bear Grylls & Ajay Devgn
Dhadkan Zindaggi Kii
Hindi Language.description: In a world where rules are set by men, Dr Deepika Sinha, a surgeon, enters FMS hospital. But for her to live her dream, she must struggle against gender bias, judgment, as well as her own past.

Hindi Language.name: Clutch
Hindi Language.description: Clutch is an Esports drama that follows the lives of Arun, Adil, Prachi, Raunak and Jeetu as they navigate the world of gaming in India. Will this squad of misfits succumb to the pressures gamers face or will they rise above all odds?

Hindi Language.name: Love Luck
Hindi Language.description: Love luck is story on Love triangle between three friends.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Hardy and Heer
Hindi Language.description: Happy and Heer grow up as best friends, with Happy falling for Heer over the years. When she moves to London, Happy goes with her on the pretext of getting a job. He hopes that she will fall for him too but she soon meets Hardy, who was born and brought up in the UK. Hardy is a self-made entrepreneur while Happy is light-hearted and carefree. Who will Heer choose?

Hindi Language.name: O Pushpa I Hate Tears
Hindi Language.description: You always fall in love with those whom you want to be the part of your life. This is the only truth and only condition. When Aditya fallen in love with Pushpa, she thought that he only loves her. But she gets traumatized when she came to know that Aditya was in love with her only to get her money. He only wants money not Pushpa. Aditya wants Pushpa out of his way, so he takes the help of Shyam. But Shyam smartly get Pushpa in love with him and also get a hold on her. Shyam is so clever that its impossible for Aditya to remove Shyam from Pushpa's life and her money. Now Aditya is helpless and feels like he lost Pushpa and her money as well. What Aditya will do now?

Hindi Language.name: I Am Here
Hindi Language.description: Paranormal Investigator Sandhya plans to visit a haunted house to research and communicate with the entity haunting that place along with her friend Rahul who is a spirit healer. After being warned by her friend not to go in alone as he was to meet her there but had trouble with his car on the way. Things go horribly wrong as she finds out the reality of the entity that possesses the House.

Hindi Language.name: Triangle Trap
Hindi Language.description: Ajju and Vijju kidnaps Khushi Tiwari but soon it turns against them. Ajju is betraying Vijju, Khushi is playing her own game. Who's is with whom and against whom is the game. Extortion money which is demanded for Khushi brings the danger along with it. A father, a suspended cop Every body is behind the money but who gets it, is the game.

Hindi Language.name: Yahan Sabhi Gyani Hain
Hindi Language.description: A satirical comedy film shot in Kanpur. The story revolves around a delusional and dysfunctional "Kanpuriya" family, are told of having hidden ancestral treasure. But in the process of finding the treasure, find the true lesson of life.

Hindi Language.name: Heartbeat
Hindi Language.description: Maha, who needs a heart transplant, and Sameer, who has a brain tumor. Despite their conditions, they find love. Maha lives with her adoptive aunt, while Sameer embraces life despite his diagnosis.

Hindi Language.name: Jurm Aur Ishq
Hindi Language.description: The show deals with real-life crimes stories of murder, kidnapping, domestic violence, fraud, robbery, forgery, rape, sexual assault and other crimes.

Hindi Language.name: Lock'd IN
Hindi Language.description: Lock'd IN is a light hearted mini series about a newly dating couple that get stuck living together because of the lockdown; their bitter sweet journey in discovering one another, and in-turn discovering a bit of themselves.

Hindi Language.name: Chikoo Aur Bunty
Hindi Language.description: A family of four - dad, who's an engineer, mummy, a homemaker, two brothers: Chikoo (11 years old) and Bunty (10 years old). A middle-class family where dad works hard to ensure the best for the family and mummy pushes the kids to make the best of what they, as parents, can offer to the kids - education. Unfortunately, both the boys have a different take on education: they detest it and believe that education is not the key to success but rather being smart is. Their attitude towards education reflects regularly in their quarterly, mid-terms, and final exams, year-on-year. They never score above 65%.

Hindi Language.name: Prem Bandhan
Hindi Language.description: An independent girl who has the responsibility of her family on her shoulders and how she meets a cross road and ends up marrying a businessman with a mysterious past.

Hindi Language.name: My Girlfriend's Love Story
Hindi Language.description: Two best friends navigate a strained relationship when one's macho boyfriend ignores her feelings. After failed interventions, one friend takes an unexpected action to resolve the situation.

Hindi Language.name: The Interview: Night of 26/11
Hindi Language.description: Official remake of the acclaimed Dutch film, THE INTERVIEW, remade in Hollywood by veteran actor Steve Buscemi starring himself and Sienna Miller

Hindi Language.name: Awkward Conversations with Girlfriend
Hindi Language.description: The chronicles of Ishaan's awkward conversations with his girlfriend Ananya.

Hindi Language.name: Come Inside
Hindi Language.description: A wealthy young woman feigns innocence, but her true nature emerges. A smitten cop still desires to shield her despite knowing the truth, but fate has other plans.

Hindi Language.name: Trishna
Hindi Language.description: After her husband's death, Trishna becomes very miserable and things become worse when her in-laws make it difficult for her to lead a normal life. Trishna is forced to take some drastic steps to get out of this situation.

Hindi Language.name: Indian Pro Music League
Hindi Language.description: Six teams comprising renowned playback singers and aspiring vocalists compete against each other to win the coveted title.

Hindi Language.name: Chhatrasal
Hindi Language.description: Chhatrasal is the first historical epic based on the life of the unsung warrior King Chhatrasal of Bundelkhand. Its story goes back to 16th century India when the Mughal empire was expanding under the leadership of tyrant Aurangzeb, who mounted towards Delhi and dethroned his father Shahjahan, declaring himself "Alamgir Aurangzeb", which means 'conqueror of the world'. Around the same time in Bundelkhand, it was predicted that a child will be born who would free his people and bring them back to their motherland. That child was Chhatrasal. He was a hero from medieval India who never lost any battle against the Mughals.

Hindi Language.name: Love Letter
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a youngster. He gets totally trapped when he cant differentiate between love and friendship. His feelings costs him very much as the girl takes on him. Can he clear the issues between them or will he have to pay heavy price for the misunderstanding?

Hindi Language.name: Sheru
Hindi Language.description: A young boy named Sheru who's fighting to find his place in the world. As his life unfolds, he learns that no village or city is without its faults, and the societal norms he's fighting against aren't just in one place.

Hindi Language.name: Lockdown Ki Love Story
Hindi Language.description: Mumbai's Sonam is about to get hitched to Dhruv from Prayagraj. When Sonam's family gets stuck at Dhruv's place due to the lockdown, all hell breaks loose.

Hindi Language.name: Aapki Kahani Aapki Zubani
Hindi Language.description: In Aapki Kahani Aapki Zubani we make films for couple who want to seize the precious moments of their lives on screen.

Hindi Language.name: Atrangi Office
Hindi Language.description: Have you ever thought that why there is not even a single "bewakoof khana" in this world? There are many "pagal khaane" (mental hospitals) but not even one "bewakoof khana"? A visit to our "Atrangi Office" headed by Mr. Brij Bhushan Sharma (BB Sharma) and his employees will clear the above question in no time. Set in current times, "Atrangi Office" is a comedy web series of a new business venture of Mr. BB Sharma and his loyal employees. A simpler way to say the above will be that, "Atrangi Office" is about a fool and his disciples. Inspite of knowing that his son is good for nothing, Shashi Bhushan Sharma is unable to put a stop to his son's senseless business misadventures because of his wife; Kanta's blind undying love for her son resulting in repeated financial losses. While everyone is aware of the incapabilities of BB Sharma, BB Sharma feels that he has been unable to succeed because there is not a single person in this world whose mental wavelength matches with his. After having failed in 10-12 businesses, BB Sharma has now started project "MAHALAND" to teach the world correct way of agriculture.

Hindi Language.name: Love Sorries
Hindi Language.description: The movie is an anthology film consisting of 4 love stories featuring overrated love.Exposing the magical love projected to us for years.

Hindi Language.name: Wrongleela
Hindi Language.description: Neil, a young aspiring actor, struggles to find an apartment and a job in Mumbai. He pays a casting agent to live with him in his house along with another crazed flatmate named Tiwari. Tiwari has installed CCTV cameras in the entire apartment. When money crunch threatens to make him go homeless, Neil hacks the CCTV footage, creates uncomfortable situations in the house, and uploads the reactions of his flatmates on a YouTube channel. As the videos go viral, Neil's life starts getting increasingly complicated.

Hindi Language.name: Murder Meri Jaan!
Hindi Language.description: One is a con artist, another a top cop - Sonal and Aditya are an unusual couple. Together they solve crimes while the mystery between them continues to puzzle.

Hindi Language.name: Brahmarakshas 2 - Phir Jaag Utha Shaitaan
Hindi Language.description: Tantric Jwala wishes to marry Kalindi to attain immortality, but when his attempt fails, he turns into Brahmarakshas. Years later, he comes across Kalindi, but will he be successful in his endeavor?

Hindi Language.name: The Other Room
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Akshat, a renowned psychiatrist embarks on a journey of finding secrets from the past and present life of delusional patient and piano teacher, Rishi Sharma, in turn paying the greatest price of his life.

Hindi Language.name: Basement Company
Hindi Language.description: The show is set in Gurgaon, where first jobbers Raj, Simran and Rahul are forced into the basement of the office 'PunjaBeats" as the small start-up undergoes a major transformation to attract more business. These three badnaseeb buddies are put in the wackiest situations as they try to regain their territory upstairs. While trying to achieve this, they are fighting their respective battles to achieve their dreams which lie beyond the four walls of this company as well as juggling friendships, relationships and their new lives at work.

Hindi Language.name: India's Most Sansanikhez Kahaniyan
Hindi Language.description: Murders that will leave you trembling - Crimes that will shame humanity - Treachery that will shatter your very core!India's Most Sansanikhez Kahaniyan brings sensational true crime stories that will keep you up at night.

Hindi Language.name: Lockdown with My Crush
Hindi Language.description: Shivam Sharma, a bachelor living with his roommate Dharam finally gets lockdown with his crush. The intimations with his crush gets things to chaos.

Hindi Language.name: Project 9191
Hindi Language.description: A special team led by DCP Amitabh Sinha, based in Mumbai, is working towards stopping crimes. Stopping crimes before they can happen.

Hindi Language.name: Bhopal to Vegas
Hindi Language.description: What happens in Vegas will also happen in Bhopal now. Three friends decide to venture into a risky new business.

Hindi Language.name: Excuse Me Madam
Hindi Language.description: A 'woofy' narrator presents the quintessential misadventures of a middle-aged married man caught between his suspicious wife and his drop-dead gorgeous boss.

Hindi Language.name: Googly Gumm Hai
Hindi Language.description: The call for some fun and adventure brings a couple to Dharamshala, a small hill-station nestled in the Himalayas. However, an ominous twist of fate puts everything at stake when they decide to go trekking to a deserted mountain peak.

Hindi Language.name: Amar Kahani Ravidas Ji Ki
Hindi Language.description: 'Amar Kahani Ravidas ji ki' depicts the struggles of the great saint Ravidas who believed in the unity of mankind, his opposition towards discrimination, and his immense devotion to Ganga Ji.

Hindi Language.name: Wishlist
Hindi Language.description: A couple lived 7 years of their married lives planning for their future but one incident brings their world upside down. That's the moment they decide to live their lives and embark on a long wishlist trip to live each moment of live and fulfill their bucket list before one of them die.

Hindi Language.name: Rudrakaal
Hindi Language.description: Suspended IPS officer Ranjan, aka Cheetah, is on a mission to find his mentor's killer. Juggling his personal and professional demons, he is in for a surprise.

Hindi Language.name: Aapkey Kamrey Mein Koi Rehta Hai
Hindi Language.description: Four bachelor friends - Nikhil (Sumeet Vyas), Subbu (Naveen Kasturia), Kavi (Amol Parashar) and Sanki (Ashish Verma) are ecstatic when they find a 4 B.H.K at a measly rent in a city like Mumbai. But, little did they know that they would be sharing their amazing new flat with a newly acquired roommate who happens to be a ghost. Life gets further complicated when the beautiful Mausam (Swara Bhasker) comes for their housewarming party, after-which begins the comedy of horrors.

Hindi Language.name: Taxi
Hindi Language.description: A girl meets a guy in a bar, which turns into an unexpected event. After this rendezvous, the girl takes a cab for her next destination. But it seems like fate has something else in store for her.

Hindi Language.name: Andaman
Hindi Language.description: Andaman is an inspirational social drama about a quarantine centre in an unprivileged village.

Hindi Language.name: Bunker
Hindi Language.description: Lt. Vikram Singh is a lone survivor in a Bunker, at Poonch (Kashmir), after being hit by a mortar shell during a ceasefire violation.

Hindi Language.name: Babloo Bachelor
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film is based on UP, where a well to do family had always dreamt of their son's wedding with great pomp and show. Babloo "Sharman Joshi" met few girls for his wedding but didn't get the right one.Then he met Pooja Chopra who was already engaged in other relationship and is not virgin.After listening to this, he rejects the proposal.In one wedding he got to meet Tejasri Pradhan, with whom he falls in love and both agrees for the marriage.But the twist comes when on the wedding day Tejasri ran way from the wedding and left a letter for him.She had always wanted to be an actor and now she had got a chance of a lead actor in a reality show in Mumbai.Sharman tries everything to reach his would be wife.He even goes to Mumbai.There, by chance, he again bumped into Puja Chopra who was the creative head of that channel.He told her everything.She agrees to help him and when finally Tejasri comes back, Sharman falls in love with Puja Chopra after looking at her intitiave and efforts to bring Tejasri back.

Hindi Language.name: Lights! Camera! Murder!
Hindi Language.description: Even after being warned about the danger, a top fashion team plans a murder mystery film shoot at a secluded spooky castle. Alas, nobody in the crew likes or trusts each other. Is it just a coincidence that real murders are taking place just as in the script or was it all planned?? Only the script writer could tell but. - unfortunately he too commits suicide on this cursed night!!.

Hindi Language.name: Mission Frontline with Sara Ali Khan
Hindi Language.description: Sara trains with India's first female commando unit for Mission Frontline.

Hindi Language.name: Thoda Sa Baadal Thoda Sa Paani
Hindi Language.description: When Kajol's father passes away on the day of her wedding to Arjun, she must learn to balance her family's responsibilities with her romantic relationship.

Hindi Language.name: School Romance: Pure Love Web Series
Pati Patni and Joe
Hindi Language.description: A black comedy that tests the facade of modernity that a man wears, when he stumbles upon a secret manuscript - a work in progress erotica being written by his domesticated wife, which may be more autobiographical than he initially thinks.

Hindi Language.name: Trapped
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a businessman. He travels all around the world and his relationship with his wife is getting ruined day by day. The wife discovers about the secret affair of her husband. The girl is set on a journey to find love and enjoyment.

Hindi Language.name: Thoda Adjust Please
Hindi Language.description: A comic web-series about the gags of four youngsters, struggling to make sense of love, life, career and relationships.

Hindi Language.name: The Reunion - Chal Chalein Apne Ghar
Hindi Language.description: Set in Odisha, Leela and Madhav, are left alone because both their sons have relocated to bigger cities to pursue their professional goals. However, a family crisis forces them to come together and the story takes various turns from there.

Hindi Language.name: Kyun Utthe Dil Chhod Aaye
Hindi Language.description: Amrit, Vashma and Radha are three women who live in Lahore at a time when India is on the cusp of gaining independence. They hope to achieve their dreams and find success in their love lives.

Hindi Language.name: WingMan (The Universal Irony of Love)
Hindi Language.description: The bittersweet story of Omi's life is an oxymoron. Meeting a new woman will turn his life upside down.

Hindi Language.name: Love J Action
Hindi Language.description: Love is not just blind, it chooses to be blind. Jackson gets the girl of his dreams against all odds, but when she betrays him, his obsession takes on a form so Machiavellian, even he can not predict how far he'll go.

Hindi Language.name: The Return
Hindi Language.description: The line between truth and lies becomes murkier when 6 years past the tragic death of Geetanjali's husband, a child claims to be his reincarnation.

Hindi Language.name: The Killer
Hindi Language.description: A lonely hotel by a lonely road. Sarah is lost, looking for somewhere to sleep. She's come to the wrong place. A lonely hotel by a lonely road. Sarah is lost, Jenny is looking for her. She's come to the right place. The Bridgeburn Hotel.

Hindi Language.name: Suno Sahebji
Hindi Language.description: Story of Kunal, goes to his village to take care of his Dadaji and meet Aaya, the caretaker of Dadaji. But Kunal is surprised to find the extreme closeness that Aaya and Dadaji share, and realized, that the Aaya have many things to offer. Kunal gets what he wants from her, but it is going to be a very interesting turn of events in the End.

Hindi Language.name: Rum Pum Posshh
Hindi Language.description: Rum Pum Posshh is a thriller, which shows the story of 6 friends and their antics spanning over 3 days, it begins with fun and craziness and later how things turn upside down.

Hindi Language.name: Rubi Star
Hindi Language.description: Ruby Star is a nagina who knew very well what her price is. So beyond the looks of the world, dazzling and lustful, she achieves her place with simplicity, see what the Ruby Star story is.

Hindi Language.name: Jaunpur
Hindi Language.description: The story is of a dreaded gangster Babu Bhaiya who terrorized Jaunpur. Later, he spread his wings to Mumbai and worldwide. The film captures the ups and downs of Babus audacious crime journey.

Hindi Language.name: Agni Vayu
Hindi Language.description: A dynamic young Dr. Agni meets an ambitious investment banker Vayu. In the most serendipitous of encounters, they become close and develop feelings for each other. But as life progresses, they find themselves at the crossroads due to unfortunate turns of events both personally and professionally. From then on, at every turn, they deal with conspiracy, misunderstanding, swindling, and all sorts of paradoxes. Can their romance withstand all the trials and tribulations that the world throws at them?

Hindi Language.name: Durga - Mata Ki Chhaya
Hindi Language.description: Durga feels a divine connection with the mentally unstable Dev, but the two have never met. With Mata Rani on her side, can she pull him out of his trauma?

Hindi Language.name: Yug the law of karma
Hindi Language.description: Yug film showcases the pious love relationship between father and daughter. When the law does't provide justice to the father, he is compelled to choose his own path to seek justice for his daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Asli Cricket
Hindi Language.description: Chintu (28) lives in a village in Gujarat as a construction worker. His owner earns insufficient income to support him. Chintu and his family fast a lot when they have no money left. Chintu has a blind adopted son, Kush. Vivek Joshi, the captain of the Indian cricket team, attends the opening ceremony of the tournament in the same village. Vivek Joshi asked the invitees to keep his presence as private as possible to protect his reputation. A villager learns that Vivek Joshi has come to the Puja Ceremony as Vivek Joshi attends it - the villager immediately informs players who are playing cricket very close to the Puja Ceremony. Villagers throng to Vivek Joshi to have their pictures taken. Vivek Joshi slaps Chintu to maintain social distance in this process. Vivek Joshi connects back with Chintu in the TV interview. When Vivek Joshi asks Chintu to name his wish, Chintu requests that he bowl one over if given the chance. The team India and the rest of India will play one game against each other in the finals. The plot centers around Vivek Joshi's team up with Chintu in the end.

Hindi Language.name: Paapnaashini Ganga
Hindi Language.description: Ganga flowed down from heaven to wash away all the sins of humanity. She further created different streams on Earth.

Hindi Language.name: Sunny Winter
Hindi Language.description: His only big dream is to be a successful porn star internationally and he plans to explore the local porn industry first. Sunny's father, who is a cop wants him to pursue his studies first. When police decides to uproot the on-going salacious racket, sunny's father also pledges to unite. Will this lead sunny to prison? Will sunny fulfill his dreams?

Hindi Language.name: Cookiees
Hindi Language.description: Cookiees is the story of three low JEE ranking students dealing with life in an engineering college in Mathura, while trying to understand themselves, their dreams and aspirations.

Hindi Language.name: Vilom
Hindi Language.description: Vilom, a lonely, isolated young man from India, is obsessed with becoming internet-famous and deeply confused about his sexuality. When he moves in with Amay, a dynamic, openly gay hairdresser, and simultaneously meeting Nivi for social experiment video project, who is a beautiful struggling actress, he finds that they both are slowly falling in love with him. This sudden love triangle leads to even more confusion, forcing Vilom to examine his sexual and romantic wants and needs on an even deeper level. Meanwhile, societal pressures and prejudices are beginning to build just outside the walls of their home. Vilom is an unflinching sociopolitical drama. The film tells a provocative story of risk-taking, creativity, rebellion and survival.

Hindi Language.name: Bawri Chhori
Hindi Language.description: A young woman who has arrives in London from India to find and kill her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Nyaya
Hindi Language.description: A victim confronts a powerful spiritual leader in court after his misconduct. Her story drives an intense legal battle against injustice, emphasizing courage and the fight for women's rights.

Hindi Language.name: Uljhan: The Topper Blues
Hindi Language.description: A young girl dreams to be topper in the university by foul means, goon threats and political pressure

Hindi Language.name: One Stop for Love
Hindi Language.description: Sanjana virgin girl under peer pressure, instigated by her friends ends up booking a Gigolo, she sees some more guys till she meets the right match.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Stories: Khoj Apradhi Ki
Hindi Language.description: Crime Stories is an interactive crime thriller show starring Vikrant Singh and Samar Pratap. It is an original series of Flipkart Video and is available under the video section of Flipkart app. Season 2 was released on 27 July 2021.

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu Kung Fu Kings Returns
Hindi Language.description: When renowned martial artist Tiger Chang comes to Furfuri Nagar and challenges everyone, Motu starts training to defeat him. Soon, Patlu and Motu find themselves facing an unexpected situation.

Hindi Language.name: Taarak Mehta Kka Chhota Chashmah
Hindi Language.description: The residents of Gokuldham Society encounter several adventures and misadventures as they navigate the ups and downs of life and overcome their struggles together.

Hindi Language.name: Ameena
Hindi Language.description: Story of 2 girls and a boy getting into a mutually beneficial relationship without any rules and boundaries.

Hindi Language.name: Slip
Hindi Language.description: Mostly, we seek to follow the right course in life and undertake right measure, to be the best version of ourselves. What if destiny doesn't let you follow your heart? When three different souls choose to go with their erroneous alternatives: "SLIP"

Hindi Language.name: Mighty Little Bheem: Festival of Colors
Hindi Language.description: From surprising stage performances to spraying colors with friends, join baby Bheem for all his Holi hijinks during the special spring festival.

Hindi Language.name: Rip Real Horror Story
Hindi Language.description: Presenting South (Sauth) Indian Movies Dubbed In Hindi Full Movie (Hindi Movies, South Movie) "RIP REAL HORROR STORY" starring Vijay Chendur, Hanumanthe Gowda and Aarti Kulkarni, Raj Nitish Kumar. Exclusively on South Hotstar Heroines

Hindi Language.name: Kartik Purnima
Hindi Language.description: Purnima's story is a lot like Cinderella's with an added woe of fighting the beauty stereotypes. Enter Kartik who loves her dearly, but will his love ensure them a fairy-tale ending?

Hindi Language.name: Main Bhi NRI
Hindi Language.description: An Indian student goes to Australia for further study to fulfill his dreams. As he was pampered by parents, finds himself in a difficult situation to handle study and fees. The habit of staying in a comfort zone puts the student in many difficult situations. During his stay he finds a job and friend too. However he is not able to continue his friendship and job too.

Hindi Language.name: Gadget Guru Ganesha
Hindi Language.description: Guru, an eight-year-old boy, is best friends with his soft toy, Ganesha. Together they create various gadgets to help them in everyday situations but land themselves in trouble constantly.

Hindi Language.name: Bhootiyapa the Conclusion
Hindi Language.description: The Film Shoot starts in the Bhootiyapa House and Characters of the Story start seeing some unusual Activities in the Bhootiyapa House. What happen next !!.

Hindi Language.name: Tathagat
Hindi Language.description: The hills, especially in our country, are associated with austerity - saints, renouncement and embracingthe vagabond path. I began to wonder where does man end and monk begin? Is renouncing life as we know it, a sacrifice or an escape?

Hindi Language.name: Shubh Raatri
Hindi Language.description: It is a story about the finding of the truth of a witch which is only heard in tales by people living near village. Some friends find this tale interesting and try to enter the village but are stopped by the villagers. Are they able to enter the village? Are they able to find the truth? Is the tale of the witch true? Shubh Raatri is all about finding the truth. Director - Pankaz Singh Tanwar

Hindi Language.name: Lines
Hindi Language.description: It is a tale of love divided by borders, an innocent yet gritty story of a young girl Nazia representing the pains of people of Kashmir who have been the suffers of hatred between two countries

Hindi Language.name: Kaatelal & Sons
Hindi Language.description: Dharampal Thakur lives with his twin daughters Garima and Susheela and owns a haircutting salon. However, things change when the daughters decide to run their father's business.

Hindi Language.name: Miles
Hindi Language.description: A Goan car mechanic's adventurous journey with a stranger from India to the UK. Uncertainties, desert, snow, cultures, and faith shape their journey.

Hindi Language.name: Kamini
Hindi Language.description: Three Boys and Three Girls are in Love. They get Married and leave for Honeymoon. But One Girl gets Possessed with the Ghost of Kamini. Who is Kamini? Why Kamini Possessed that girl? Why Kamini has come back? All will be revealed in the Climax.

Hindi Language.name: My Friend Ganesha 4
Hindi Language.description: When a corrupt man is intent on razing a prestigious museum, a young boy finds an ally in Ganesh and manages to turn the tables.

Hindi Language.name: Law of Attraction
Hindi Language.description: Rich mad girl Maithili. To defy the standard norm of the game, she trains a blind painter to turn in to her lover and convinces everyone about his perfection. But what she is not aware is about her own desires which has no limit.

Hindi Language.name: Lava Ka Dhaava
Hindi Language.description: Actor Jaaved Jaafferi brings his signature humor to this Hindi dubbing of the show where teams creatively navigate rooms flooded with make-believe lava.

Hindi Language.name: Tuition Teacher Ki Beti Se Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Elvish Yadav Originals Presents a quirky Love Triangle story.

Hindi Language.name: Sakha
Hindi Language.description: Two ordinary odds set the mark of unbelievable miracles

Hindi Language.name: Dil Jaise Dhadke... Dhadakne Do
Hindi Language.description: Iti and Yug's innocent friendship has survived emotional trauma and class divide. But will they break free from the shackles of Devguru, who believes little Iti to be a goddess?.

Hindi Language.name: Pavitra: Bharose Ka Safar
Hindi Language.description: A young girl from an underprivileged family pursues education while fighting gender discrimination and social barriers. Her taxi driver father's daughter strives for self-reliance despite obstacles.

Hindi Language.name: Lockdown to Unlock
Hindi Language.description: Lockdown to Unlock movie which based on corona kaal...very relative story for everyone because everyone has face this pandemic situation. His our light style with 5 songs

Hindi Language.name: Mandbuddhi
Hindi Language.description: Mandbuddhi is the story of Pagli and her daughter Mandakini who was born because of Pagli's rape. To take revenge she gives her womb to the childless couples of the village. Watch the movie to seek the truth behind Mandakini's origin.

Hindi Language.name: Astounding Courage in Distress
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of a girl Ruhana, who doesn't lose hope in adverse conditions; she fights bravely for her right. Her future depends only on her strong determination. Will the double standard hypocrites of society survive her sheer willpower and strong determination.

Hindi Language.name: Shit, Yaar!
Hindi Language.description: Under the influence of adrenaline and alcohol, two loser friends set out on a hilarious yet tumultuous adventure. Can they survive the weekend?

Hindi Language.name: Main Khudiram Bose Hun
Hindi Language.description: Biopic on patriotic leader Khudiram Bose. This period drama will showcase the never heard facets about the life of Khudiram Bose who was one of the youngest revolutionaries from Bengal.

Hindi Language.name: Sumeru
Hindi Language.description: Bhavar Paratp Singh has left everything is search of his father and he meets Savi accidentally who came for her destination wedding in Harsil. The story further continues in their struggle of finding Bhavar's father and they eventually fall in love in the journey.

Hindi Language.name: The Grey
Hindi Language.description: A painter who has grown up overseas and lives in a metropolitan city now has returned back to Chhattisgarh to sell off his property after his father's death. Terror is like a slow poison in the air here which is graying life with every breath. Something incredible happens with him at his ancestral land which has been the nucleus of the biggest insurgency of independent India.

Hindi Language.name: Official Bhootiyagiri
Hindi Language.description: How will Dilawar Rana manage a haunted hotel?

Hindi Language.name: Kabaad- The Coin
Hindi Language.description: The story of Kabaad the Coin begins with a boy named Bandhan living in a slum area of Mumbai. One day, working at the junk Bandhan gets five hundred years old Ram Siya precious gold coins from the era of Emperor Akbar. He is filled with self-confidence. Meanwhile, Bandhan falls in love with Roma, a high society girl, and Bandhan expresses his love by giving a gold coin to Roma. Roma realizes that these are the precious gold coins, so on instigating by her boyfriend Sam, she pretends to love him to get coins from the Bandhan. But Roma falls in love with Bandhan. The story of money, love and deception becomes interesting. Does Bandhan fall prey to this deception of Roma? Or Roma changes her plan in the love of Bandhan. What will Sam do, who is using his girlfriend for the greed of money, you will have to watch the movie Kabaad the coin.

Hindi Language.name: Haunted Hills
Hindi Language.description: The film 'Haunted Hills' revolves around a honeymoon couple. The wife dies accidentally, and her soul remains in a painting that she leaves incomplete.

Hindi Language.name: Family Dinner
Hindi Language.description: Family Dinner is where all the difficult conversations happen.

Hindi Language.name: Aap Ki Nazron Ne Samjha
Hindi Language.description: Darsh, a blind photographer, crosses path with selfless Nandini. Sparks fly, hearts flutter and a beautiful tale of love begins.

Hindi Language.name: Nymph
Hindi Language.description: Dismal, yet sensual story of Hezal, who is a nymphomaniac. Irrespective of her good intentions, she is not able to control her kinky feelings, and it is the hot and steamy time for all, who are near her. It would be interesting to see how Hazel come on top of all her trouble with her sickness, that made her a NYMPH.

Hindi Language.name: Zee Comedy Show
Hindi Language.description: Get ready for a laugh riot with renowned celebrities as they perform hilarious acts and skits to tickle your funny bone.

Hindi Language.name: Lockdown
Hindi Language.description: Lockdown is story about life of husband and wife in lockdown.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Comedy Base Camp
Hindi Language.description: A comedy talent hunt where the funniest entries will get to perform in front of renowned comedians on the show that will telecast on MTV India.

Hindi Language.name: Shaheed Chandrashekhar Azaad
Hindi Language.description: This story is of Azaad , Chandrasekhar Azaad , his passion to free India from shackles of British govt . since childhood he was very furious against Britishers . This story is of conversion of a small splash of fire into volcano known as Shaheed Chandrasekhar Azaad .

Hindi Language.name: D
Hindi Language.description: In a series of heinous events one dark night, in the by lanes of Delhi; two brothers come face-to-face with a nightmare they never imagined. Their entire life turns upside down. Soon they discover there's no law to serve them justice. Their courageous battle for justice forms the rest of the story.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Battey Do
Hindi Language.description: The film is based on a tribal family of Jharkhand rural area where a mother and a father lives their life as farmers and are very poor and they don't have any child incidentally one forest officer who was appointed in their area with his wife were killed by the local smugglers with that any how their daughter who was sleeping in the back seat of the vehicle survived as smugglers didn't know about her and this tribal couple found the girl who is not like them in appearance as she is fair and with good cloths so finally this family adapted the girl and aim for her the better education in English medium school of Ranchi city. This was very difficult but they succeeded to achieve the goal with many hurdles on their way and in last the adapted girl when grows up she also achieved a biggest platform to become a IAS officer and further she changed the livings of these tribal. This film has got 2 Awards for woman empowerment in JIFFA awards and Darbhanga state award.

Hindi Language.name: Babuji Aur Humsab
Hindi Language.description: A Family Comedy Drama for Respect of Father where a Father gives only one month time to his three sons to behave nicely and stay together to get the share of his Huge Property and then three selfish sons starts competition to get property.

Hindi Language.name: Shubh Laabh Aapkey Ghar Mein
Hindi Language.description: Savita, a 45-year-old ardent Lakshmi worshipper, struggling to save her shop believes that Lakshmi ji will help but is betrayed. Lakshmi ji decides to turn up on earth in Human form.

Hindi Language.name: The Missing Stone
Hindi Language.description: This 5-episodic series is a story of a happily married couple, Dhwani (Bidita Bag) and Sahir (Barun Sobti). With Dhwani's birthday just around the corner, she is expecting the usual surprise from her younger sister Payal (Rashi Mal) who plans something elaborate each year. This year, Payal has organized a weekend getaway at a resort but this surprise soon turns into a shock when Payal does not arrive at the resort. The world stops for Dhwani, when she realizes that her sister is missing, or worse - she may be dead. The romantic birthday getaway soon becomes a trap for Dhwani, where she's left putting together the clues of the puzzles that will help her find the truth about Payal.

Hindi Language.name: Apna Time Bhi Aayega
Hindi Language.description: Rani is a girl who loves her father the most, but she wanted to achieve her dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Gupta Brothers
Hindi Language.description: The four self-reliant brothers can do it all, from homely chores to managing work. But how long can they defy the law of nature that everything exists in pairs?

Hindi Language.name: A Game Called Relationship
Hindi Language.description: A celebrity power couple who is in a live-in relationship fake their breakup to see how far their pursuers will go to win them over.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Ki Suno Stories
Hindi Language.description: There are many questions that run inside our mind as we are unable to find the answers to them, but we forget that the answer sometimes lies in our heart. Inspired by true stories, we present to you 5 women who are stuck between their heart and mind.

Hindi Language.name: Home Stories
Hindi Language.description: An online wedding, a one-night stand turned three-week standoff, difficult choices and hope pushing through in a smile--a lot can happen when everyone stays at home. Home Stories is an anthology of short films starring Arjun Mathur, Apoorva Arora, Veer Rajwant Singh, Imaad Shah, Saba Azad, and Tanmay Dhanania.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Aapke Fan Hai
Hindi Language.description: For Rahul, meeting the His Favorite movie Star Roxy, is a dream. One Lucky day, this dream turns to Reality. But fate has decided a new path for Rahul.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbaiyya: The Daring Mumbaikar!
Hindi Language.description: Mumbaiyya is an Narrative Action Drama flim The story revolves around the dark side of Mumbai underworld and Bollywood glamour industry. Arhaan a young,dynamic personality who lives in Mumbai, is a dare devil, lives a lavish life , unquestioned due to his standard and impressions,a Knight Hawk partying Rowdy.He earns this exotic living by unlawful means.He is generous at heart and a thorough man of his words and promises,he lives all by himself and everytime escapes from the hands of the policemen using his skills.One day on his way he meets Amaaya, a girl from a village in Bihaar who has come to Mumbai in search of her fiancee, who promised her that one day he will call her to Mumbai after pursuing his passion to be an actor in Bollywood,Arhaan helps this girl out by finding her fiancee disclosing a shocking suspense.

Hindi Language.name: Love You Pappu
Hindi Language.description: A lady fan and a young television journalist madly in love with a bachelor politician of Delhi and both wish to see him succeed. The love triangle is a revelation for everyone.

Hindi Language.name: Urf Ghanta
Hindi Language.description: A warm, fuzzy and endearing story of naive Ghanteshwar, a middle-aged unmarried guy, who dreams of getting married one day to the girl of his dreams, but his world is turned upside down when he learns a startling truth about himself.

Hindi Language.name: Atithi Kab Aoge Shhamshan
Hindi Language.description: In the Year 2020 when the entire world was reeling under the effect of corona virus, the deadly virus had created havoc all around. People were dying in thousands and lacks. Slowly after months of suffering, doctors and scientists invented the vaccination for it. Now, though the people were saved but people were still facing the dangers posed by floods, earthquakes, cyclones and asteroids. It seemed as if God was enjoying the suffering that had surrounded Earth. In this scenario, a strange story begins. Yamraj, the God of death decides to come to earth to find out the solution to his problem. Scientists had already found a vaccine for China's deadly virus but it seemed they were planning something more advanced so that people could live for eternity and should not die. But when Yamraj sees that people are not dying, he decides to visit the earth and explain how the inventions of scientists can destroy the ecological balance of nature.

Hindi Language.name: Parlok
Hindi Language.description: Jhoting is a very rare kind of cunning ghost seen and experienced in the various parts of India who takes the shape of the boyfriend/husband of lonely women. In this episode 1, a young girl Swati faces a similar kind of ghost.

Hindi Language.name: Chote Nawab
Hindi Language.description: 13-year-old Junaid visits ancestral home in Lucknow, India for family wedding. Experiencing Indian culture for first time, he goes through teen rites of passage: first love, heartbreak, rebellion against patriarchal family values.

Hindi Language.name: Yeshu
Hindi Language.description: which depicts the childhood of Yeshu Masih (Jesus Christ). This series showcases Yeshu's miracles and how he helped people with his healing powers in a world afflicted by sins and evil. The show also focusses on Yeshu's special bond with his mother.

Hindi Language.name: Khwabon Ke Parindey
Hindi Language.description: Wild child Bindiya has convinced her besties to accompany her on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip across Australia. What makes Bindiya, Megha and Dixit's caravan-cruising Australian adventure all the more exciting? The quick-witted and quirky hitchhiker Aakash, who join them as they make their way from Melbourne to Perth. Watch as they traverse through the breath-taking landscapes, and the fun trip turns into an opportunity to heal wounds, fall in love with life and combat their worst fears.

Hindi Language.name: The Dark Jungle
Hindi Language.description: This story Revolves around our main lead Akash and Priyanka. Who have came into a jungle for a reality show Contest.

Hindi Language.name: It Happens only in India
Hindi Language.description: Sonu Sood brings an array of jaw dropping, pride inducing, visually stunning stories from around the country.

Hindi Language.name: Switchh
Hindi Language.description: SWITCHH as an action movie about friendship, love and betrayal, the plot revolves around three con artists who use their charm to dupe wealthy victims out of cash.

Hindi Language.name: Red Bull Spotlight
Hindi Language.description: Red Bull Spotlight is a nationwide hunt to discover and support India's best-emerging rappers. In early 2020, qualifiers were held across the country, where many young rappers went up against each other and then again in a virtual qualifier; until they found their final eight. These eight rappers from across the country - will go head-to-head in this six-part series. They will spend a week under the mentorship of some of the finest in Indian hip-hop, attending workshops and sessions, doing challenges, and more. In the finale, judged by Divine, Naezy, Emiway Bantai and Dee MC, only one young rapper will walk away with the title of, 'India's Next Rap Superstar'.

Hindi Language.name: Samvaran
Hindi Language.description: A Supernatural Thriller, Samvaran is a story of a couple trapped in the past.While they want to live in the present, they still get up in the past.For them to break out of it, they need to find answers that will unveil secrets of the past.

Hindi Language.name: Mannphodganj Ki Binny
Hindi Language.description: Binny Bajpai is a 21-year old, dreamy-eyed girl, from the suburb of Mannphodganj in erstwhile Allahabad, now Prayagraj. Her conventional middle-class parents Brajesh and Kumud are on the lookout for the perfect virtuous boy for her. However, fiery and rebellious Binny is on her own hunt. Her dream boy is a politician's son, Rahul Pandey - her ticket out of Mannphodganj. But all is not rosy for Binny. Blinded by her desire for him, she fails to see through Rahul's pretence. While failure of her first love collides with the many option her parents present, looking from distance is a tongue-tied shy Raja who is unconditionally in love with Binny. Will Binny Bajpai make the right choice?

Hindi Language.name: Ashant
Hindi Language.description: A down-on-his-luck alcoholic, an ambitious girl stuck in a dead-end job, and a heartbroken bar owner unexpectedly team up, leading to a wild, life-altering adventure.

Hindi Language.name: Tape Recorder
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of Mili and Deepak who love each other but have never expressed their love. Mili is Deepak's first love. One day, all of a sudden Deepak leaves her and Mili waits for him. This silence love story is about love and sacrifice. Tape Recorder revolves around Mili's emotions of how she waits for Deepak without expressing her love for him.

Hindi Language.name: Assi Nabbe Poore Sau
Hindi Language.description: The wilted life of a widow blossomed when a handsome gentleman gave his name to her fatherless son. But his strong arms were never meant to protect the apple of her eye.

Hindi Language.name: Maali
Hindi Language.description: A poor, backward caste gardener unwittingly provokes a middle-class homemaker to question her long-standing marriage, leading to friction with her husband.

Hindi Language.name: The Hidden War
Hindi Language.description: The Hidden War is a film about love in the time of war. Set against the backdrop of one of the world's longest running armed insurgency - India's Maoist rebellion - this film is an intimate character study of the emotional, psychological and personal impact of war in the lives of ordinary people. Shot in vérité style, it follows the intersecting journeys of one displaced couple and one former rebel, as they search for home, justice, and sometimes for revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Pepper Chicken
Hindi Language.description: The plot of the movie revolves around a female Radio Jockey, who gets in a cab at night to go home, but halfway through the journey, the cab suddenly breaks down. In search of help, the cab driver and the RJ enter an old house. As they enter, they realise the house has been abandoned for many years. Is there any connection between the house and the cab driver? Will the RJ be able to escape the house? What unravels over the course of the night is a tale of mysteries, unexpected twists, and shocking revelations from the past, that dare to scar the present.

Hindi Language.name: Most Common Budbak
Hindi Language.description: Most Common Budbak is a memoire to two hearts nestled in a mid size town with passion of their own and of course the challenges these two throbing hearts had to face.The movie acts as a time machine and takes you back in your era of romance.

Hindi Language.name: Old Monkey
Hindi Language.description: An Old man accidentally pops a viagra tablet, his excitement turns into a dramatic comedy situation.

Hindi Language.name: Crazy Uncles
Hindi Language.description: Three middle aged, rich uncles who are unsatified with wives decides to enjoy their life without them and ends up getting in a big trap

Hindi Language.name: Brawl - The Battle Within
Hindi Language.description: Brawl is a web series that follows the journey of Harsh who wakes up one day in a strange club with no memories of the previous night and finds that all money from his bank account is gone.

Hindi Language.name: Godaam
Hindi Language.description: GODAAM - a story nested inside a small village in India dwelling day to day lives of the farmers and their struggles told in satire way from the point of view of the Government Officer 'Vikas Babu'.

Hindi Language.name: Hamari Wali Good News
Hindi Language.description: A Hindi drama serial that depicts the sweet and sour relationship between Navya, daughter-in-law of the Tiwari family based in Agra, and her mother-in-law, Renuka. The beauty of their relationship further develops when Navya learns that she cannot become a mother, and Renuka decides to bring the much-awaited Good News to the family herself with her husband.

Hindi Language.name: The Mortuary
Hindi Language.description: In the hospital, three doctors rape a patient girl and kill her, her corpse is kept in the mortuary, and her corpse is tortured there too. In life and even after dying, she was tortured.

Hindi Language.name: Bebas
Hindi Language.description: This is a political crime thriller and story of a honest police officer Ranvijay Singh. How Ranvijay is helpless because of this corrupts system and suspended again and again.

Hindi Language.name: Colours of Night
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the unexpected entry of a girl into the life of a youngster. The girl seeks the help of the youngster as her car is in repair and wants to spend the night safely. After some time, shocking things happen in the house. The story takes a different turn as the truth comes in front and everything seems to be connected.

Hindi Language.name: Bawara Dil
Hindi Language.description: A rebellious Shiva and a righteous Siddhi are as different as fire and ice - but, what happens when they get married with a common goal in mind? To destroy one another. Will they find love? Will their relationship survive the test of time?

Hindi Language.name: Ranju Ki Betiyaan
Hindi Language.description: Journey of a single mother's struggles and challenges while raising her four daughters.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Banam Khap Panchayat
Hindi Language.description: Pyaar Banam Khap Panchayat is a Hindi movie released on 3 Jan, 2020. The movie is directed by Shambhu Purohit and featured Manoj Bakshi, Manoj Pandit and Varun Suri, Sangeeta Kapoor as lead characters.

Hindi Language.name: Suitboy
Hindi Language.description: A boy get a suit with extra ordinary powers.

Hindi Language.name: Lakshmi Ghar Aayi
Hindi Language.description: Jwala is unhappy when her daughter-in-law Maithli brings no dowry but only love into the family. In this battle of love versus greed, who will come out on top?

Hindi Language.name: High Vibe
Hindi Language.description: In the well-to-do suburbs, a group of teenagers, try their stint with Love, Lust, Parties and Drugs which leads the ordinary adolescents who take a singular path.

Hindi Language.name: Teri Laadli Main
Hindi Language.description: Born as a mute girl into a family that desperately wanted a boy, Bitti struggles for love and acceptance. Will fate reunite her with her guardian angel Akshat?

Hindi Language.name: Kosa
Hindi Language.description: Kosa, a young tribal boy who lives with his family in the dense forested heartlands of India, is picked up by the local police one day.

Hindi Language.name: Mauka-E-Vardaat
Hindi Language.description: Things get brutal when Nibha, a young woman, is murdered on her wedding day. Later, when the police investigate, a startling truth surfaces.

Hindi Language.name: Soch Ek fullstop
Hindi Language.description: A journey of a girl from being a high class family when falls in love and decide to settle with a lower class. One misjudge of boy leads to separation of both. with enough internal and family challenges Girl decide to rediscover her strength and fight against the world , their view and their thinking by becoming a writer. Soch is a series about what would a world will be with different type of thinking.

Hindi Language.name: Kahat Hanuman Jai Shri Ram
Hindi Language.description: With fascinating, interesting and adventurous tales from the life of Lord Hanuman (the divine devotee of Lord Ram and 11th avatar of Lord Shiva), this show teaches us many moral values of life

Hindi Language.name: Regards & Peace
Hindi Language.description: In the present-day mountains of Bhaderwah (J&K), a photographer has a one-night stand with a sensuous lady who is found dead the next day. When he confesses to his murder, his statement doesn't validate the evidence found on the scene of crime, and an eventual investigation brings forth an unusual spiritual ideology behind the crime.

Hindi Language.name: Kaise
Hindi Language.description: The story revolve around a boy who finishes his studies from USA and comes to India, he finds out that his house is sold out and father goes missing.

Hindi Language.name: Gharelu Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the life of a girl. Her family catches her relationship with her lover. They force them to get married as its a problem in the village. After the marriage, a huge twist happens with the secrets revealed.

Hindi Language.name: The Pushkar Lodge
Hindi Language.description: Its a story of a lost child who want to go home back but he forgot everything , a girl tourist comes from mumbai and try to get reach him home but not succeed.
