Hindi Language.name: Rohingya - People from nowhere
Hindi Language.description: A true story, interwoven with a fictional poignant love story between a Rohingya girl and an Indian Special Forces Officer. It focuses on the peril, uncertainty, betrayal and misery of life in the Rohingya refugee camp.

Hindi Language.name: Abki Bari Bipin Bihari
Hindi Language.description: A middle class highly ambitious man with a banking job struggling to pursue his dream of being a Bollywood actor.

Hindi Language.name: Kidnapper
Hindi Language.description: While on her journey to Delhi, Nisha becomes aware of two local men tailing her. As they seize her child, Nisha unveils her hidden agenda of revenge, causing a dramatic shift in the dynamics for everyone involved.

Hindi Language.name: Hawayein
Hindi Language.description: Aditya, a youngster, decides to start a new life by travelling solo across India. During his journey,he encounters thought-provoking people and situations which change him as a person.Somewhere along the way, he even begins to explore himself.

Hindi Language.name: Power Play with Champions
Hindi Language.description: An interactive predictive trivia-based quiz show for all cricket fanatics. Each episode will have the hosts, Virender Sehwag and Samir Kochhar discuss various possibilities of the upcoming T20 tournament match.

Hindi Language.name: Mera Ramrajya Nai Kranti
Hindi Language.description: A common man in his 50s is oppressed with the corruption in the country and the horrible news headlines he reads every morning. After lot of research and analysis, he finds out that, only a PM can change this system. He decides to be the PM. Establishes a political party, launches a revolutionary manifesto, on the basis of which got exceptional majority in the next elections. His revolutionary manifesto will change the constitution of the country for the good. What are the points of his manifesto ? Will the opposition let him change the constitution of the country at such a large extent ? How will he deal with the dirty tactics played by the opposition to bring him down ? At the end, will he survive ?

Hindi Language.name: Aparajitha Ayodhya
Hindi Language.description: Follows the Babri Masjid-Ram Mandir dispute case, in a story of love, faith, unity and divinity.

Hindi Language.name: Indiawaali Maa
Hindi Language.description: A mother is distraught when her son, who stays far away from her, gets married without informing her. However, she decides to guide him through his life's journey.

Hindi Language.name: Nimmi's PG
Hindi Language.description: Three single girls live in a paying guest accommodation run by Nimmi aunty in Dilli. From late night parties to idiotic boyfriends, hilarious misunderstandings to hiding secrets, the girls' life in the PG accommodation is total siyappa.

Hindi Language.name: Sayonee
Hindi Language.description: When his fiancée vanishes in Russia, champion shooter Rajdeep must battle gypsies, corrupt police, assassins, smugglers, and the mafia to uncover her fate - but is he ready for what he'll discover?

Hindi Language.name: Metro Park: Quarantine Edition
Hindi Language.description: Snippets of daily life from the metro park gang the patels and others during the covid-19 outbreak.

Hindi Language.name: Dihadi
Hindi Language.description: A migrant worker gets lost in internal area amid lock-down.

Hindi Language.name: Ladies Only
Hindi Language.description: Trains in Mumbai, are like trains from hell. As if they're the last trains on earth, people jump in through closing doors, while those unable to get in hang onto the doors. Thankfully, one of the cars is for women only.

Hindi Language.name: Khwahishen
Hindi Language.description: Khwahishen is the story of a young couple, Vicky and Riddhi who are in love with each other and dream of a beautiful future together. Riddhi, a kind young woman, believes she has found her soulmate in Vicky, a charming and caring man who seems perfect in every way. However, unknown to Riddhi, Vicky is hiding his true identity is not what she believes it to be. Vicky struggles with the weight of his deception, fearing that revealing the truth will shatter their love. But fate has other plans. Vicky's true identity is revealed through a past acquaintance. The truth comes crashing down on Riddhi. She's devastated, feeling betrayed by the man she trusted the most. Enter Raj - a confident and charismatic man who steps into Riddhi's life unexpectedly. Unlike Vicky, Raj is transparent about his emotions and intentions, making Riddhi question the foundation of her love with Vicky. Vicky, now forced to confront his past, must prove to Riddhi that his love for her was always real, even if his identity was not. Riddhi finds herself torn between two men-Vicky, the love of her life who deceived her, and Raj, the man who has always been honest with her. As emotions run high, she must decide whether love can survive betrayal or if truth and trust are more important than feelings of the heart. Will Vicky be able to redeem himself? Will Riddhi forgive him, or will she walk away forever? And what role does Raj truly play in their destiny? Khwahishen is a heartfelt journey of love, deception, and redemption, where desires clash with reality, and choices determine the fate of hearts.

Hindi Language.name: Parallel
Hindi Language.description: A girl troubled by the problems in her life mistakenly gets into the "parallel dimension world" and sees that her counterpart in that dimension has a perfect life there. She wants to achieve it at all costs.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Draupadi
Hindi Language.description: I Am Draupadi is a journey of a girl and her encounters with love in different stages of life. Along these encounters she realises that the reasons of her heartbreak always revolve around her body and Patriarchy. She's an artist and wants to come out of her body. While narrating her story to an American tourist in Banaras, she discloses her refuge which she finds in acting like a nude model for art students. It's a story and discourse about love which explores various mindsets of society across Indian geography.

Hindi Language.name: Bomdila
Hindi Language.description: The Bomdila documentary film by Swami Anand Fakira is a wonderful journey from Bomdila Height to Sela Pass Height. The scene shown by a bike rider on the dangerous twists and turns between the beautiful hilly paths and forests.

Hindi Language.name: Vidrohi
Hindi Language.description: Set in Odisha 1817, in the backdrop of Paika Rebellion, a common enmity with East India Company brings together Senapati Buxi Jagabandhu and Kalyani, a warrior princess.

Hindi Language.name: Ayodhya Ki Ramleela
Hindi Language.description: It is a live show of Ramayana.

Hindi Language.name: Ting Tong
Hindi Language.description: The series is a spin-off created around a character named Ting Tong from the popular Nickelodeon series called Gattu Battu (2017). The series revolves around the daily adventures of a fun and lovable character named Ting Tong who has a temporary memory loss issue and transforms into whatever character he sees before him when he loses his memory which turns him into an accidental hero of the town comically catching bad guys.

Hindi Language.name: Ammaa Ki Boli
Hindi Language.description: Interesting story about the series of events that transpire when one member of a large family purchases a scooter and a couple of his friends take it for a ride.

Hindi Language.name: Mrs. and Mr. Kohli
Hindi Language.description: Changing the norms of love, romance and marriage in today's world, the latest romantic Punjabi show Mr and Mrs Kohli, an MX Exclusive and Mirchi Play Original, brings about a change in the set gender roles in a marriage. Directed by Dheeraj Padiyar, the star cast of the latest Punjabi web series includes Sara Gurpal and Sahil Vedoliya in the roles of Sara and Sapan. The married couple lives a normal life like anybody else, one person earns for the family and the other runs the household, but the gender roles have been reversed. Sara - Mrs Kohli goes to work while Sapan - Mr Kohli is the house maker, who remains at home and performs the household chores. Exploring the new ways of love and breaking the gender norms, this show will open new horizons for a modern way of living.

Hindi Language.name: Joda Thath Ka
Hindi Language.description: The tip of the husband wife and the way of loving them is based on each other's quarrels and daily actions and the living conditions of the people of the village.

Hindi Language.name: Dilli Kaand
Hindi Language.description: When Alishka travels with his friend on public transport, she gets assaulted by six men, leaving her injured and naked. As this horrific case sparks nationwide outrage, Inspector Pandey and Journalist Riya Batra must work together to find the culprits and bring justice to Alishka.

Hindi Language.name: The Darling Wife
Hindi Language.description: THE DARLING Wife is a suspense horror thriller story. The story revolves around three characters AMAN(AMITABH ACHARYA)PARI(ANKITA CHAKRABORTY) and Pinki(Ushasie Chakraborty). Aman and Pari are husband and wife. Is Pari sick or really seeing a ghost? Or is it connected to her past life? Aman does his best to make his wife happy and Pinky(Governess)tries also her best to make her happy. In spite of all this does Pari becomes normal and is it a happy ending?

Hindi Language.name: Psycho
Hindi Language.description: This Story is about a man named KABIR who's journey to find a love and life partner who agrees to support his unusual fetish is never ending, as he ends up killing all of them without a trace. Friend I Am Not A Psycho reveals the vicious and dangerous motives of Kabir and the ordeals his partners have to go through in the course of time. Let's find out whether Kabir successfully meets the love of his life.... or .....continues the hunt.

Hindi Language.name: Disney Imagine That
Hindi Language.description: Talented artists demonstrate the techniques used to make fun artistic items and DIYs with easily accessible and affordable materials.

Hindi Language.name: Green
Hindi Language.description: Today's world is strife with various sociological issues stemming from an upswing of mental health problems to which the society has turned a blind eye for long by stigmatizing them. t is these kind of modern day issues of depression, suicidal tendencies, sexual abuse and cannabis addiction that the film GREEN talks about through the intertwined characters of Arvind and Megha. Arvind a young man from a middle class family, is emotionally exhausted as he deals with a broken marriage with a scheming wife who leaves him for vested interests. His unstable state of mind gets reflected in his job too, where his performance drops and he is on the verge of losing his job. These rejections, one after another, in every area of his life force him to contemplate suicide. A young girl Megha who is a victim of sexual abuse at a very tender age eventually gets addicted to cannabis as an escape route from the realities of life. A disturbed soul and weed addict Megha, comes into Arvind's life in a stroke of destiny and is surprised with herself for developing feelings of attachment even though she has grown up hating men. This starts the journey of two wretched souls plunged in the darkness of their own lives, searching for answers in their equation of togetherness and love. Dr. Nandini Kumar who is a celebrated doctor of neuroscience, who Arvind consults, unravels the mystery of such young minds, which opens up very interesting dimensions in the story from the mental health point of view. Will Arvind be able to fight his innermost conflicts through Megha's presence or succumb to his deep seated insecurities of rejection? Will Megha continue to live her carefree life of virtual reality, or will she realize that she will lose Arvind because she is truly a prisoner of her own addiction? Will these hearts find solace in each other or will they drift apart ? The Questions are many and but the answer will be found in your emotional interpretation of this film.

Hindi Language.name: Budhape Ka Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a businessman who is drunk with money and suffering from loneliness, whose love for life comes from a storm, and his happy life goes on to devastate.

Hindi Language.name: Bekhudi
Hindi Language.description: A boy who is born rich, has never seen the darker side of life until he falls in love with a girl of darker past . A thriller lover Story which revolves around the protagonist Abhishek and his love life Sanya who he love like mad. It starts with abhishek's feeling of uneasiness in love, when he is feeling betrayed in love, while discovering the reason for betrayal he gets to know many perspective of her sanya's life by meeting different people of her past relationships, every point of view is narrated by different person has different meaning , things starts taking a grip of Abhishek and at one point he reaches a stage of confusion and lost in darkness. Story reaches peak when Abhishek decides to kill Sanya with her ex boyfriend and then he gets a brief of the same story from sanya's perspective . Every character has their version to the same story which brings entertainment and excitement together , every single dialogue has its unique meaning. A new generation love story, presents the contemporary and relatable love angles which connects with today's youth, a multi-layered narration makes the film( interactive) with melodious songs makes a film "A prefect romantic thriller". Bekhudi "Love meets reality"

Hindi Language.name: Smaashhing Simmba
Hindi Language.description: Simba, a fearless teenager, experiences various adventures with his friends while trying to keep the town safe from evil forces.

Hindi Language.name: Admitted
Hindi Language.description: Admitted is a a striking, uplifting journey of five decades to become the first Transgender student of Panjab University.

Hindi Language.name: Nikki Aur Jadui Bubble
Hindi Language.description: Nikki's quest for her missing parents along with her fun-loving magician friend 'Bubble' while she is orphaned.

Hindi Language.name: Raag
Hindi Language.description: Raag is a 2021 Indian Hindi-language social drama film, written by Nazir Qureshi and directed by Arvind Tripathi. The film is releasing on 26th March 2021

Hindi Language.name: I Know You
Hindi Language.description: It's just not a story of gost it's the story of ghost who can never die. The tagline of the film itself explains that gost does not live in different world they live in our world only but they meet only to whom they want to meet & they want to meet you.

Hindi Language.name: Titoo in Ocean Kingdom
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Dive an evil scientist is turning the world into a water land. With the help scientist Rama Shankar and Titoo's intelligence, Titoo and his friends take the responsibility to save everyone.

Hindi Language.name: The Lineup
Hindi Language.description: 'The Lineup' is a story of poems and poets. It is a story that explores the words behind a poem and the world behind its poets.

Hindi Language.name: Kyun Rishton Mein Katti Batti
Hindi Language.description: Kyun Rishton Mein Katti Batti is a Hindi family drama series focussing on the lives of Shubhra, Kuldeep and their kids Roli and Rishi. After 10 years of their marriage, cracks start developing in Shubhra and Kuldeep's relationship. Will Rishi and Roli succeed in erasing the differences between their parents?

Hindi Language.name: Sanghaar the Massacre
Hindi Language.description: SANGHAAR THE MASSACRE- Is a Vendetta based film, in which the story unfolds in a reverse chronological order - In a backwards format (With the last scene of the film appearing first and a chapter wise sequence of events leading to the start of the story). The scenes are storyboarded in rewind, across a timeline of 12 hours and they eventually unravel the real reason why a certain heinous 'SANGHAAR' , a blood bath like 'MASSACRE' was committed by the protagonist. Then end of the film unravels the real reason behind the 'Act Of Vengeance'.

Hindi Language.name: Laila
Hindi Language.description: LAILA STORY OF A WIFE WHO WAS BLISSFUL WITH HER HASBAN..

Hindi Language.name: Super Fan
Hindi Language.description: A celebrity game show hosted by Anupama Chopra, Super Fan is a Flipkart Video original, where viewers are asked questions about celebrities. The winners get prizes every episode from Flipkart.

Hindi Language.name: Five as Same
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of five common girls and their five best friends who are living their individual lives, facing real and humane problems what girls face in Indian Society. They bravely face those problems and challenge the patriarchy in our society.

Hindi Language.name: Love Crisis
Hindi Language.description: The peaceful relation between Nina and Armaan gets in serious trouble when Nimisha enters their life. Nina gets quite upset when see learns about Armaan and Nimisha. She feels betrayed and plans to avenge her broken trust in a violent manner.

Hindi Language.name: Secret Pocketmaar
Hindi Language.description: Secret Pocketmaar is Crime based movie in hindi language Starcast - Ayush Kumar Upadhyay ,Deepak Verma,mushtak khan Ayush Kumar Upadhyay is as Secret Pocketmaar ( Ayush ) in this movie

Hindi Language.name: Bhuj: The Day India Shook
Hindi Language.description: This special documents the massive earthquake that struck Bhuj, India.

Hindi Language.name: Cutting Chai
Hindi Language.description: CUTTING CHAI is a web series also for Coffee lovers. As the cup of CUTTING CHAI is filled with Suspense, Comedy, some Drama. The Super Entertaining characters will serve you every sip of the episodes in the BEST POSSIBLE WAY. If you haven't tasted it yet then you are missing some Sooper exciting taste in your roller coaster life .

Hindi Language.name: Noise of Silence
Hindi Language.description: A story about love and lost; Something that was never told. Something that needs to be shown. An agony and betrayal in a journey of a young woman's life who is out to search for her mother.

Hindi Language.name: Meher
Hindi Language.description: An ailing, retired Army colonel finds a new lease on life when his paths cross with Meher.

Hindi Language.name: It's My Pleasure
Hindi Language.description: Raman's wants to want to quit his job to pursue his dream of opening a sexual happiness startup. He is hesitant to share the same with his family, girlfriend. His only hope is his best friend Somu. How will things work out for Raman?

Hindi Language.name: Chhakda
Hindi Language.description: A girl runs away from her home to meet her lover for fear of marriage and meets a driver on a dark road and the two get into a bitter fight and the two fall in love with each other and return home together.

Hindi Language.name: Different
Hindi Language.description: A Young Man Fights For Poor And Down Troddent People And He Unearths Culprits Behind The Mob Lynching.

Hindi Language.name: Bioscope Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: The film's original story is about the continuous creation and disintegration of the dreams of a folk dancer. Lead character Sona is a popular folk dancer from a small town of Gorakhpur.

Hindi Language.name: The Bonker
Hindi Language.description: Tarun, a man who has it all. Business, success and a wonderful wife, Trisha. But he lacks the element of thrill, a trigger that will turn him on. He has been visiting a psychiatrist for help but nothing works till one day their conversation leads to a solution. What no one knows about Tarun is that he harbors an animal instinct in him. Tarun himself didn't know about it till he found a good enough reason to hunt. Opportunity comes knocking on his door as he suspects his only love of life, his wife, bonking with bonkers. Trisha becomes the reason for his thrill and so does the game begin. The game of endless possibilities which will reinvent their relation to another level of love, their sick minds had planned for as EVERYTHING IS FAIR IN LOVE and WAR.

Hindi Language.name: Cookie
Hindi Language.description: The film is an exercise in relentless mind numbing horror.

Hindi Language.name: Gaurav Gupta: Market Down Hai
Hindi Language.description: 'Market Down Hai', Gaurav Gupta's one hour is a spot on culmination of years of observation and personal anecdotes on the Baniya Way of Life. Having experienced that since childhood, he draws his humour and relatablity from his own personal experiences which not only make it engaging but also allow us insights on hacks to survive the word of Business Conquering Baniyas, as he likes to call it. Gupta in his own effortless style and approach to call out and make the best of his own personal experiences, humours us all in this one hour, it's everything but mundane.

Hindi Language.name: Shaandaar Ravivar
Hindi Language.description: To mark the festive season, popular celebrities from Indian television and music industry entertain and enthral the viewers with their energetic performances.

Hindi Language.name: Soulsathi
Hindi Language.description: Preeti is looking for her soulmate. But all the men she meets can only see her body. No one can see her soul.

Hindi Language.name: Bansuri: The Flute
Hindi Language.description: The Story of a young boy who discovers what is in his blood after learning to play the violin. He is inspired and strives to achieve the same level of success as his father.

Hindi Language.name: Aavartan
Hindi Language.description: The film features the cycle of GURU-SHISHYA relationship, How it begin, evolves, end and again a new cycle begins covering the four generation.

Hindi Language.name: Lost Mind
Hindi Language.description: Its story about Three sisters a And a creepy man who wanna kill them.

Hindi Language.name: Tribute of Love
Hindi Language.description: Today many new directors in the film industry are worried about making full life film, these films are dedicated to the new film director.

Hindi Language.name: Janani
Hindi Language.description: Savita nurtures and provides her children with everything, often at the cost of her own requirements. And when she needed them the most, her children didn't have the time to look after her. Savita decides not to settle out and embarks on a journey to reinvent her life. Will she rise like a phoenix against all odds and make herself an independent successful woman? Watch Janani - An emotional saga of a mother's journey.

Hindi Language.name: The Successful Loosers
Hindi Language.description: A Slice of life drama film revolves around MBA graduates who started facing the Recession in their golden career. They fight their demons and come out as winners and life achievers.

Hindi Language.name: The Hundred Bucks
Hindi Language.description: The Hundred Bucks is a 2020 Indian film directed by Dushyant Pratap Singh. The film stars Kavita Tripathi and Dinesh Bawra in lead.

Hindi Language.name: Teri Diwali Meri Christmas
Hindi Language.description: A young girl with seasonal amnesia encounters a man claiming to be God, together both of them try to recover her memories leading to big events.

Hindi Language.name: My Goal football
Hindi Language.description: "You can either be a Football and get kicked around by others all your life Or kick the ball yourself...choice is yours " says Rekha to Goli in the feature film Football. This dialogue neatly sums up the beautiful message of the film written and directed by Shoib Nikash Shah. Goli (Gulshan) is a poor boy in a Jammu village who dreams of becoming a Football player. Circumstances however lead him to take up his father's profession of painting statues. Now in his late 20s he bumps into Rekha, another passionate football player who has been married off at a young age. She however continues to play street Football with village children, coaching and encouraging them to "play the sport". Goli joins her team and starts living his dreams again. The film weaves around complex relationships that develop between Goli and Rekha and his and her family. The common passion and love for the sport keeps them going. Will Goli be able to play with the pressures of life that develop around him forms the climax of the film.

Hindi Language.name: Hissa
Hindi Language.description: A failed and disabled cricketer struggles to financially secure his family and encounters obstacles but continues to pursue his goals, but a brutal incident occurs which makes him an opportunist and challenges his sanity.

Hindi Language.name: To Be or Not to Be
Five Point Three
Hindi Language.description: Lets traverse through this musical ride. A bicycle journey. A kid- the inner voice. And find out the meaning of Five Point Three.

Hindi Language.name: Three Sisters and a Dream
Hindi Language.description: Three Sisters And A Dream is a subject based feature film,which portrays the journey of a mother and her three daughters in a panaromic way by unfolding all the shades and colours of human life underling the basic values and ethos of society..the mother is in lead role,who sacrifices her career but never lets them know that ...the story revolves around her and picks up almost all beautiful emotion s that a woman is made off..it is about her courage,vision and conviction...the story is virgin and original and the plot is untold...it is written by Sanjay R Singh,IPS,who is also a serious theater activist and playwright The character of mother spans between 16and45yrs.. i. e. 1963 and 1992-93. She is in love with a neighbouring boy,and they,together, live through all the trauma and hiccups..but,their chemistry is such that they always cross the bridge when it comes..so,the story is about their youthfulness, joy and beauty ..which finally convets into utmost sacrifice.....the role of mother is charismatic ,which portrays the emotions of thousands and thousands of girls of this subcontinent The another beautiful aspect of this film is it's music

Hindi Language.name: Breed
Hindi Language.description: The story of a person who is neither a man nor a woman, the world calls him the name of the Hijra. In this story it has been told that what is the emptiness in this person's personal life and how it is from society Fighting protecting the lives of others by fighting than. This story based on humanity of Hegira and shows problems in her lives.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny & The Super Race Car
Hindi Language.description: Honey Bunny and team buy an abandoned racing car named Maganlal. They are astonished to discover that the car has the mind of its own. In the race they will face an enemy who has evil plans to stop Honey Bunny from winning.

Hindi Language.name: Soch
Hindi Language.description: Soch is a crime series about the Secret Agency Bureau of India .. A series of crimes occur in town which leads to the hunting down of the murderer which in turn leads to more danger.

Hindi Language.name: Shoprite Cooking Star
Hindi Language.description: 9 contestants bring their passion and dedication as home cooks to the camera nationwide. The contestants will race to win the first-ever ShopRite Cooking Star title and award.

Hindi Language.name: The Final Night
Hindi Language.description: A vengeful spirit from a husband's hidden past threatens his family's peace. His wife battles supernatural forces to protect their home, leading to a dark confrontation where only one will prevail.

Hindi Language.name: Leo
Hindi Language.description: 'LEO' is about a guy who's the son of an Indian spy in South America. He was born with a Brazilian mother and brought up in Brazil . After his father has disappeared. The Indian government finds out about this and summons him to complete the mission, where he has the mission of killing world mafia leaders from all over the world. But somehow something goes wrong, and the whole world thinks that he wants to become the new Big Boss for the new world order. .Watch how he defeats his adversaries and disproves everyone by using the darkness.

Hindi Language.name: Bhasad
Hindi Language.description: Two odd roommates decides to spin their social life via online booty call party at the heart of the nation 'Delhi'. They find themselves becoming a mockery for the internet after someone leaks the footage of the party. What follows is their adventure about being a young adult trying to figure out the norms of the society simultaneously clearing up the chaos they created for themselves and the people they lost and found after the party. Just like in comics, "KAPOW!" Is a reflection of life which is a bit large, a little bizarre with lots of captions.

Hindi Language.name: Living Together
Hindi Language.description: Living Together a romantic story of today's Fulmu Ranjhu a couple in live-in relationship, in which they fight and take cute decisions to save the relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Footloose: A Story of Belonging
Hindi Language.description: Minorities from Pakistan and Myanmar came to India to save their lives. They had heard that Indian is a secular country where there is no religious discrimination. But, in the last few years, religious discrimination has increased leading to communal riots which ultimately ended up being the sole agenda for contesting elections. The situation has changed so drastically that Indian minorities are being asked to prove their claim over being an Indian. What does the future of these refugees look like in the time of NRC and CAA? We started filming this story in 2017 and in these past three years, things have changed rapidly in India, and Footloose tells the story of this changing India.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny and the Dacoits of the Valley
Captain Vidyut
Hindi Language.description: A regular Joe becomes the superhero Captain Vidyut.

Hindi Language.name: Contact Killer
Hindi Language.description: A business tycoon dreams of coming up with the lowest fare flights so that any common man can afford to fly.

Hindi Language.name: Peepal Tree
Hindi Language.description: When the police kill sacred trees, where do you go?

Hindi Language.name: Taanashah
Hindi Language.description: the life journey of the dreaded dacoit Shiv Kumar Patel who ruled the lands of Bundelkhand for twenty-eight years and had the entire police, administration and the politicians being obedient to him.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Kaisa Sukun
Hindi Language.description: When Asha does not get real love from her husband, then she decided to leave the house, then what does her father-in-law do that Asha changes their decision.

Hindi Language.name: Rocky
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a boy and a girl who are going to get married to each other, both do similar work but hide it from each other. Because both are sex workers.

Hindi Language.name: September
Hindi Language.description: The story is about life, love, and nirvana.

Hindi Language.name: Tank Cleaner
Hindi Language.description: A young orphan boy working as tank cleaner is trapped in water tank by someone. He struggles for his life for four days in this tank full of water.

Hindi Language.name: Badalte Rishte
Hindi Language.description: Badalte Rishte is a story of changing fortunes. How dramatically and with what consequences the changes are brought about in the human psyche, personality, behaviour and relationships. Badalte Rishte strongly underscores the point that people can change their destiny, if they have the will. It portrays people's convictions, beliefs and faiths on the one hand and on the other, the inherent contradictions in human situations which make or mar a man's world. This drama series begins with Anand Narayan Verma, a retired bank official and a man known for his honesty, integrity and adherence to Gandhian principles, about to board a night train to his native village where he intends spending his life in retirement. But destiny wills it otherwise and the CBI sleuths make a sudden appearance to detain him to inquire about a dubious bank transaction in which Verma's estranged son, Ajay is involved. From here, the story takes intriguing twists and turns. Badalte Rishte is a search, a quest at different levels, for different values of life: for wealth, power, dignity and peace. And the passion with which men and women work towards their destiny.

Hindi Language.name: Transparency: Pardarshita
Hindi Language.description: Transparency: Pardarshita, chronicles chase of a common man from offshore to India. It explores India Against Corruption movement or Anna Andolan along with backstage scenarios that led to subsequent birth to the Aam Aadmi Party.

Hindi Language.name: Machaan
Hindi Language.description: All villagers started driving off Bhola with fire, lathis, lanterns, etc. To throw him out of village. Bhola pleaded that he would never enter the village, but villagers started pelting stones over him, and soon Bhola stopped breathing.

Hindi Language.name: Target
Hindi Language.description: An industrialist, a star mountaineer, a distraught daughter - are all set to summit Mount Everest, but each one has their eyes set on a different prize

Hindi Language.name: Say Yes to the Dress India
Hindi Language.description: 16 brides-to-be hunt for their perfect dress with family and top talent.

Hindi Language.name: Om Shri Satya Sai Baba
Hindi Language.description: Satya Sai Baba was a renowned religious guru and Producer Balkrishn Shrivastav and director Vicky Ranawat have come together to make a biopic on him. The film will release on January 22 all over the world in Cinemas. It is said that Satya Sai Baba was the incarnation of Sai Baba of Shirdi. Millions of people who believed in Sai have the same belief. Sathya Narayan, who was born from the womb of Ishwar Amma in 1926, later became Sathya Sai Baba. At the age of five, he declared himself to be God. And these things were also proved by the people when he performed miracles. From former President of the country Late Abdul Kalam Azad to superstar Rajnikanth ,Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and God of Indian cricket Sachin Tendulkar many people believed in him. The small village Putapurti, which did not have roads and infrastructure, today has world-renowned hospitals, music and education centres and many other facilities for the common man. Despite taking Samadhi, even today, millions of people who believe in him, believe that he will again incarnate as Prem Sai. The film will have Anup Jalota, Sadhika Randhawa, Jackie Shroff, Govind Namdev , Murli Sharma, Arun Bakshi ,Mushtaq Khan , Babanrao Gholap in important roles. Sudhakar sharma has written the lyrics which are composed by Bappi Lahiri ,Sumeet Tappu . Babban Rao Ghulap of Atman Films presents the film produced by Balkrishn Shrivastav of A One Creation . The film is co-produced by Subhash Sehgal,Ankita and Nikita Shrivastav . Sachindra Sharma has written the story of the film.

Hindi Language.name: Dre7ms
Hindi Language.description: After experiencing a traumatic loss of a colleague, Saanjh starts seeing a mysterious girl in his dreams who takes him through the seven stages of grief.

Hindi Language.name: Dheet Patangey
Hindi Language.description: Four cricket-crazy friends set out to find answer and write their destinies, between the two big wins in 1983 and 2011.

Hindi Language.name: Spring Thunder
Hindi Language.description: Storytelling the tussle between 'Sustainability' & 'Development' in context of rural India, film 'Spring Thunder' narrates the story of a Uranium mining tender at the highest plateau of India, enriched with thick forests and populated by various native communities. Starting from conflict of policy-makers, to crime, money, politics, and rage at the local level concerning land acquisition to universal environmental concerns. The selfish political inadequacy leads the local tribes to unite and retaliate for the survival of their existence, and the existence of forests there. In a time frame where scientific communities across the globe are continuously raising alarm about the environment and the health of the Planet Earth, 'Spring Thunder' reinforces this global concern through the drama and the plot of the story. The film showcases the exotic natural beauty of the Chotanagpur plateau in India and the culture, emotions, values and concerns of the local communities. The film aspires to bring the crude reality of the situation to the world as a way of awareness, sensitisation and rebel.

Hindi Language.name: The Cage of Life
Hindi Language.description: The Cage of Life has a number of shades of life Here in this movie the cage of life we are focusing on the multi-colour shades of Bollywood film Industry beginning from the struggler to the superstars who are the heart beats of the fans all over the world.

Hindi Language.name: Love Ka Panga
Hindi Language.description: Love ka Panga, Hungama Play's latest original show is a romantic comedy about a modern city girl who wants to enjoy a peaceful holiday, a desi munda who thinks he's the coolest dude on earth.

Hindi Language.name: Dabangg: The Animated Series
Hindi Language.description: The series chronicles the day to day life of police officer Chulbul Pandey, who stands in the face of evil to keep the city safe.

Hindi Language.name: Wanton
Hindi Language.description: On a fateful night, the lives of three friends descend into chaos after one of them commits a gruesome crime in a nightclub.

Hindi Language.name: Ardhsatya - Jeevan Ke Rahasya
Hindi Language.description: Brought back together after 17 years of separation, sisters Aaina and Myra Bisht discover they have supernatural powers and start a brand-new journey with Ardhsatya - World's First Detective Agency for the dead.

Hindi Language.name: Horror Love Story
Hindi Language.description: This is fictional a story of two souls who gets together after a terrible disaster and founds vengeance in a comic way.

Hindi Language.name: Modi: Season 2
Hindi Language.description: Modi (Season 2) - CM to PM follows the journey of India's most celebrated leader who inspired a billion Indians and led us to a new age India. Watch Narendra Modi look back on his experiences and retrace his path to becoming India's Prime Minister. From being a three time CM to becoming the 14th Prime Minister of India, relive the story that has made him the man we know.

Hindi Language.name: Ghar Ek Mandir
Hindi Language.description: Genda teaches everyone not to consider anyone small and to have the same attitude towards each other.

Hindi Language.name: Choices
Hindi Language.description: What if the "settled" life you are living is suddenly challenged under a Lockdown? Will you be able to survive reality?

Hindi Language.name: The Honey Bunny Show with Kapil Sharma
Hindi Language.description: This a Brand New Show of Honey Bunny Ka Jholmaal. In this show, Honey, Bunny, Zordaar and Popat do funny things with Kapil Sharma.

Hindi Language.name: Wild Villa
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to Wild Villa where there's love, connections and a lot of naughty action. What more you ask? Well, the Wild Villa winner will the golden chance to change the game of Splitsvilla.

Hindi Language.name: Sabne Bana Di Jodi
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a wedding happening between two delhi based punjabi familes where the girl is super excited to marry the boy, her childhood love interest who however is not willing to marry her. she leaves no stone unturned to impress him but he already has a girlfriend. Both the families are constantly making efforts to somehow convince the boy. Even his childhood friend who is the wedding planner wants this marriage to happen so that he can improve his relations with his girlfriend cum partner in wedding planning. To add more twists and turns to this chaos, the ancestral wedding house is haunted with the ghosts resembling exactly the family members. Now, it will be interesting to see how the families deal with the ghosts and make the wedding happen

Hindi Language.name: Safaibaaz - The Scavenger
Hindi Language.description: Safaibaaz: The Scavenger is a Hindi movie released on 2 Oct, 2021. The movie is directed by Avneesh Singh and featured Rajpal Yadav, Johnny Lever, Upasna Singh and Omkar Das Manikpuri, Anupam Shyam, Manoj Pandit as lead characters.

Hindi Language.name: Someone
Hindi Language.description: Sebastian and Akanksha are a happy go lucky couple, awaiting the arrival of a baby into their lives. Everything goes well until destiny hits them like a cyclone in the form of a miscarriage that Akanksha goes through in the 12th week of her pregnancy. From here on, things go downhill between Sebastian and Akanksha as Silence takes over their relationship and there's a mysterious fracture their bond meets with. things some unexpected unravel post this event.

Hindi Language.name: Kajri
Hindi Language.description: In a remote village, a widow fights to protect her community from exploitation while seeking safer livelihoods. Her journey reveals both struggle and hope as she works to build a better future.

Hindi Language.name: Ghost Leela
Hindi Language.description: It's a horror love story where a girl is in love with a guy who actually don't exists and her friend likes her, there is another mysterious character Margaret who does black magic and now he wants to kill the girl Sunane and Arjun wants to secure her from Margaret and Leon (the soul she is in love with).

Hindi Language.name: Awasaan
Hindi Language.description: This film tells the story of a 27 year old boy named Satyawan Shukla who hails from Prayagraj and from a lower middle class family. His father is a poor priest and mother house wife, his father falls pray to a social change which urges him to make his son engineer for which he has to sell 50% of his farm l and. After not finding a satisfactory job Satyawan leaves for Lucknow and there he prepares for a government job and at the same time searching for a private job. He struggles to find a s mall pay scale job, which could not support his family economics as a result Satyawan is forced t o do small and odd jobs even though he has to sell newspapers and repair mobile phones, but suddenly a Government job vacancy comes on his way he happily goes to apply for it but on finding that there is only 2 vacancies for general category. He decided not to apply for it and at the same time he finds that if he can manage a government officer he may get a government job, he does it and becomes a car driver of a government officer after spending some time he persuades the officer for one job in exchange of Rs. 15 Lakh. Satyawan father sells his every piece o f land and gives 15 lakh to that officer. Now the question is will Satyawan get one job in a government department or will something else happen to Satyawan?

Hindi Language.name: A Rifle and a Bag
Hindi Language.description: Somi and her husband met and fell in love while fighting alongside the Naxalites, a communist guerrilla group that has been fighting since the '60s for the rights of the tribal communities of India. After a decade of armed struggle, the couple deserted the movement and surrendered to the police. Ever since, they have been striving to forge a new identity, educate their two children, and eventually reconcile their violent past with the fervent desire to integrate into the hostile Indian society.

Hindi Language.name: Yamuna Paar
Hindi Language.description: This story is about a part of an area in Delhi city where life is as a bullet. The whole administration fails to maintain peace in the city just because of the fight of supremacy between two gangsters.

Hindi Language.name: Rizwan
Hindi Language.description: The movie Rizwan revolves around a boy from Gujarat, India, who moved to Africa in search of an opportunity, his journey started empty handed but he had a vision to make those dreams come true. Facing each of the obstacles in life and surviving, he steadily grew to become one of the most successful businessmen in Southern Africa. Presently he has businesses in 11 countries of Africa. In order to improve the life of poor people in Africa and Asia, he initiated the Rizwan Adatia Foundation. The foundation runs more than 80 humanitarian projects in seven countries of Africa and Asia. The foundation has offices in India, Mozambique and Congo. RIZWAN is a story that will keep the audience spellbound and will inspire them to face all struggles with courage and dedication.

Hindi Language.name: Champoo Ki Suhagraat
Hindi Language.description: Champoo is a very simple man. He gets married. He fantasizes about his honeymoon. But his whole dream falls apart. His wife is a very open minded and modern woman. She does not come in a veil in honeymoon nor does he have milk in his hands. Champoo gets surprised and thinks how to spend further life with his wife?

Hindi Language.name: AI 1.0
Hindi Language.description: Synopsis - Aman, an app developer broke up with his wife Heena. To fill his empty life he met with an AI friend JESSICA. She helps him to understand the value of love by a series of criminal events, and finally to get his wife back.

Hindi Language.name: Barber of Baadarpur
Hindi Language.description: The film shows life of a village barber in the role of a matchmaker in the rural north India of 1980s. Viewers get to see and experience authentic village life in its richness with folk and classical music (all original recordings), customs, costumes, colours and philosophy.

Hindi Language.name: Games of Thirst
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to the Games of Thirst. A masterpiece of politics, love and substances that you should not mess with. Get Ready to enjoy a class struggle with lots of action and mystery.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Mard Bechara
Hindi Language.description: What defines a man? What are the societal norms that men face every day? Ye Mard Bechara reflects the stereotypes attached to manhood and gives a refreshing take on defining a man.

Hindi Language.name: Bulbule
Hindi Language.description: A sequel to very successful comedy Bulbule; which had released in 2013. This time featuring 12 brainy people fighting over how to fix a basic flaw in the Indian education system.

Hindi Language.name: Santoshi Maa - Sunayein Vrat Kathayein
Hindi Language.description: Swati, an ardent devotee of Goddess Santoshi, delves into the importance of fasting and proper ways of worshipping her even as Goddess Poulomi tries to wreak havoc in Swati's life.

Hindi Language.name: Koi Sath Hai
Hindi Language.description: Koi Sath Hai is the story of four friends played by Neet Mahal, Rajesh Dubeay, Priya Tiwari and Asma Sayad who visit an isolated bungalow and plan to call spirits. Things change when their plan becomes dangerous and a police officer comes to their rescue.

Hindi Language.name: Star vs. Food
Hindi Language.description: Bollywood celebs and chefs rustle up a special meal for close friends and family.

Hindi Language.name: Titli current marti hai
Hindi Language.description: Set in Bihar's Gardani Bagh, 'Titli Current Maarti Hai' is the story of a girl named Titli who runs a dance school. Titli is the symbol of a small town girl's aspirations and dreams. They all wish to fly away one day; they want to breathe in fresh air. Their misfortune is that the air around them is unclean and dusty. The two political groups of Gardani Bagh are very volatile and violent. If mornings name aspirations by sunset gory violence dominates. Titli though has delicate wings. She is colorful. And these violent men want to tame her. They want to crush her wings. They want to own her. Will they be able to cage her or she will find her way and emerge as the butterfly who shocks them like electric current.

Hindi Language.name: Supadu Dada: The Great
Hindi Language.description: True Historical Story

Hindi Language.name: Kosha
Hindi Language.description: After the death of her father, a runaway comes back home to take care of her younger brother, but he seems to be at the center of something sinister.

Hindi Language.name: Three Auspicious Hours
Hindi Language.description: Three women in three auspicious hours take an important decision of their life. A confused bride leaping into the social bonding, a personal secretary struggling to keep her self-respect at the workplace and a dreamer trying to break all the norms to start an exciting journey.

Hindi Language.name: A Method in Multishade
Hindi Language.description: Mithun, A struggling actor uses Method acting in his day to day life activities in order escape his own mental reality and depression.

Hindi Language.name: In the Month of July
Hindi Language.description: The film has been approached with a light and breezy treatment which includes eye-pleasing visuals as it is primarily shot on Red Epic format, in scenic locales of Himachal Pradesh, melodious music, appealing faces and subtle performances.

Hindi Language.name: The Big Picture
Hindi Language.description: The Big Picture is a 12-stage trivia-based game show in which participants answer multiple-choice questions related to images that appear in front of them on a large screen. They get chance to win upto Rs. 5 Crores.

Hindi Language.name: Khunnas
Hindi Language.description: Khunnas is the story of two young college students, Deva and Somya. Deva is a well-known son of a politician who harasses the college's girls. Somya, angered by his behaviour, tries to save the girls from his attack. The movie follows the brave youngster's fight against injustice.

Hindi Language.name: Rashi Mein Sunny
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around Rashi, who wants to become the Best Horror Movie Actress across the bollywood. Sunny, a corpse, observes the same and as he too was an actor before his death, he sticks around Rashi and helps her out. Witness the comic journey of Rashi and Sunny as the story unfolds.

Hindi Language.name: Narayana
Hindi Language.description: "Narayan" a freelance Mathematician whole life struggled to prove his theory and at the end lost everything, found abandoned. This is his struggle till the end. Film is an independent film made by Dustbin Ideas.

Hindi Language.name: Veera
Hindi Language.description: a young girl forced to marry an old man but falls in love with a young boy

Hindi Language.name: The Bid & Win Show
Hindi Language.description: An interactive game show hosted by Samir Kochhar, Bid and Win is an original series on Flipkart Video that aired on 6th August 2020 on Flipkart App. The winners of the show get to win products as well as prizes every day from Flipkart.

Hindi Language.name: Social Mandiya
Hindi Language.description: Three friends with different objectives want to become popular through Social Media .They start with fake show-offs and silly posts and somehow gain attention of the followers ,but it doesn't last long.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome on Board
Hindi Language.description: Welcome on Board is a story of 4 cabin crew who come from different walks of life and societies. The movie deals with the daily struggles and dilemmas in the life of Cabin crew when they are off air.

Hindi Language.name: Never Kiss Your Best Friend Lockdown Special
Hindi Language.description: The best-selling author and her first BFF (first kiss) land in the world of virtual dating amidst the global corona crisis, only to end up dealing with millennial complications of love and life.

Hindi Language.name: Lakshya 1971- Vayu Sena Ke Veer Yoddha
Hindi Language.description: The year 1971. The Liberation War of Bangladesh. The violent skies above India's borders. The bloodied battlegrounds on land. Deadly. Gory. Lethal. As India locks horns with an aggressive Pakistan, the fate of the suppressed East Pakistan hangs in uncertainty. Its freedom, its liberty on the verge of being lost forever. On 3rd of November at midnight, after being attacked by Pakistan, India declares war. The Indian Air Force moves in. Multiple battles are fought over land, sea and skies. Over 12,000 combat sorties are conducted. Over 600 combat aircraft's deployed. Fiery dogfights dominate the skies. The film 'Lakshya 1971: Vayu Sena ke Veer Yoddha', brings out this exclusive story of the 1971 aerial war for the first time ever, majorly through the decisive Air battles that changed the course of this iconic war. Travelling back 50 years to retrieve the breath-taking battle stories, the anchor- Harman Singha will uncover some of the Indian Air Force's closely guarded tales of men, machines and missions. For the first time ever, we hear the first-hand account of the game-changing stories and inspiring heroics by the IAF war legends themselves. Combining archival footage with graphics and recreated scenes, the film will bring into life some of the greatest stories of courage, patriotism and independence which the world has long forgotten.

Hindi Language.name: Jhatka Jaroori Hai
Hindi Language.description: Two youngsters who denies to do their caste occupation and are used to hang out with girls and bother their parents.

Hindi Language.name: Aata
Hindi Language.description: Struggle story of two lovers bhaira and foolan. They love each other beyond the limit and caste. This movie shows the consequences of Inter-cast marriage in Indian rural areas. And also shows the condition of women in society. this movie describes the strength of a woman , a woman is not weak and can fight for her love and respect.

Hindi Language.name: Iskool Bag
Hindi Language.description: An emotional journey of a little boy and his mother, from the lower strata, over education and a school bag.

Hindi Language.name: Icarus
Hindi Language.description: A disenchanted undercover agent is forced to take up a final mission to solve a minister's murder if he wishes to retire to a normal life with his newly wed wife.

Hindi Language.name: Veer Gomtesha
Hindi Language.description: Veer who is a Reporter and Atheist by birth who hates his Religion and Rituals. While covering one of his stories He gets Enlightenment , Knowledge and Purpose to save his Community.

Hindi Language.name: Phone-a-Friend
Hindi Language.description: Phone-a-Friend is a sci-fi romantic comedy series starring Akhlaque Khan, Mantra and Swati Kapoor. It's a humorous tale of romance and friendship between a guy, a girl and a cellphone.

Hindi Language.name: The Green Force Mission 14th March
Hindi Language.description: Ex-army chief created a secret Force to save the nation from Terror attacks. GREEN FORCE is an unofficial team of Patriots which fight against every terrorist activities. Full POWERPACK movie with Action, Suspense, Comedy, Fight.

Hindi Language.name: Hamara Bar Happy Hour
Hindi Language.description: Failed actors and friends Pari, Gulshan, Shivam and Fuddu inherit a bar. But can this self-centered and whacky gang run it successfully? Chaos guaranteed.

Hindi Language.name: Baabul Ki Dua
Hindi Language.description: A father wants his daughter to elope just a day before his wedding. His plans go to toss when his wife gets to know about this stupidity.

Hindi Language.name: Premaatur
Hindi Language.description: Premaatur is a horror love story in which Soniya is possessed by some super natural power. Rahul and Soniya tries to be friend with Pooja and Arjun but Arjun shouts at them in very nasty and ghostly manner. While conservation with the balloon vendor, they got to know about a ghost who cuts the plait of ladies and kills them. Next day Soniya was alone in her room, she heard someone's anklet sound approaching towards her and banging her door. She calls Rahul for help with trembling voice but before Rahul comes to rescue her she was possessed and started walking barefoot on the road. She even tries to kill herself. When asked she didn't know about the incident and was fearful and exhausted. Other day she was found at the basement near mirror. At the first Rahul didn't believe her but later he takes her to the baba to get rid of the supernatural power. Baba comes and finds a mirror and asks Rahul to break it. They saw a ghost or soul flying by on breaking the mirror. They keep looking for Soniya and found out about a cave in haweli where Soniya was possessed. Arjun was trying to give her sacrifice to the goddess.Baba comes and asks Arjun the purpose of his doings and then Arjun and Pooja's tragic love story starts. At the end after a high voltage drama good wins over evil.

Hindi Language.name: Osho Rajneesh Aur Unki Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Based on Osho Rajneesh Life.

Hindi Language.name: Zindagi Unlimited
Hindi Language.description: This film revolves around three main characters, THEY ALL HAVE A COMMON DREAM-they all dream of going to London and have their respective careers and lifestyle sorted with a good source of income in their respective professions. But one incident changes their visions, priorities and focus of their fairy tale and turns them into human beings with substance and inculcates' a never say die attitude' in their soul, finally making them decisive and matured in life letting them know the worth of India as a nation. The genre of movie is humor with a message to the youth about the worth of India as a nation.

Hindi Language.name: Amangal
Hindi Language.description: The film starts from a dangerous situation. COVID -19 pandemic has taken over the country and sudden lockdown is causing an all round panic. Ashok the protagonist along with 8 staff members of the hotel has no choice but stay stranded within the four walls of the hotel due to job exigencies. An old incident is recalled. The hotel was once sealed due to the murder of a family in room number 307. The room was now locked and regarded as haunted. One night one of the workers unlocks the room accidentally and lo and behold paranormal activities begin to happen one after the other causing a petrifying environment and making it difficult for everyone to live normally. Things come to a head when one of the members is murdered.

Hindi Language.name: Teen Do Paanch
Hindi Language.description: Vishal and Priyanka's lives turn upside down when they end up adopting three kids. With another surprise on the way, can they survive all the madness?

Hindi Language.name: Oye Mamu!
Hindi Language.description: Rohit Mamu (Ruslaan Mumtaz) is a man who dreams of being rich one day. These dreams and his investments in them have taken him from being reasonably well off to flat broke. Akhil Bhanja (Tanay Chheda) is a 10-year-old mischievous school boy with a rather crazy streak. There is very little love lost between Mamu (maternal uncle) and Bhanja (nephew) as Rohit has been at the receiving end of many of Akhil's pranks. A crazy turn of events brings the two under one roof for two weeks. Life under Mamu's supervision is now a constant strife for Bhanja. There are a series of clashes between the two as Rohit tries to discipline Akhil but this master-of-manipulation Bhanja more often than not, gets the better of Mamu. Akhil's secret ambition to become a VJ collide with a museum trip, a diamond robbery, the Runaway Bhanja, the police and crooks on Mamu's tail - to converge in an action-packed, rib-tickling climax before the various plots resolve themselves.

Hindi Language.name: Kismat Karma Cash
Hindi Language.description: When a wealthy Indian American businessman's teenage daughter is missing, a young tourist couple finds themselves involved in the suspected kidnapping.

Hindi Language.name: Hindmata
Hindi Language.description: Hindmata Women's Prison follows the life of fashion designer Samaira Jal, who finds herself among criminals in a women's jail

Hindi Language.name: Balcony Buddies
Hindi Language.description: In this interactive short film, two strangers across balconies, Prateek and Sunanda, find a way to become friends during the lockdown with papercup telephones, Ludo and conversations.

Hindi Language.name: Naagmani 2: Naya Rahasya, Anokha Safar
Hindi Language.description: Shivali, a young and true devotee of Lord Shiva, had no idea that her life would change on her 20th birthday after discovering her origin of being a shape-shifting serpent.

Hindi Language.name: Shoot to Saltara
Hindi Language.description: Shoot to Saltara is an Action revenge drama. Its a story of two powerful families. they fight for a mansion.

Hindi Language.name: Saumya Ganesh
Hindi Language.description: Bollywood first ever romantic comedy film which has major aspects of diabetes (a metabolic disease that cause high blood sugar). Such disease sometimes either break a relationship or strengthen it. Sanskriti Bhatt and Avinash Dhyani are in the leads. Under the banner of Padma Siddhi Films, the film Saumya Ganesh is produced, directed and written by Avinash Dhyani, who has also been the Actor-Director of 72 hours:Martyr who never died. The film revolves around a guy who is type 2 diabetic which decreases male fertility as it lowers the testosterone level. The film shows the unconditional love of Saumya and Ganesh.

Hindi Language.name: Mariya the journey of love
Hindi Language.description: The story follows Rahul and Maria, college friends in a relationship. The narrative takes a turn when Maria is married to a businessman who later introduces her former lover, Rahul, as his new business partner.

Hindi Language.name: Wo Meri Student Hai
Hindi Language.description: Wo Meri Student Hai is a Hindi Feature Film starring Anup Jalota, Jasleen Matharu, Vinay Dungarpur and more. The movie is directed by Kesar Matharu, and produced by Kanwaljeet Matharu, Kukku Films.

Hindi Language.name: Jeene Ki Umeed Tumse Hi
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around various social and political issues of rural and urban India like unemployment poverty and corruption, where Vijay (Brajesh Rai) fights the bad elements of society and tries to improve life of poor and needy.

Hindi Language.name: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaaniya S3
Hindi Language.description: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it's viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

Hindi Language.name: Humkadam
Hindi Language.description: Tara and Shanti are two diametrically opposite personalities weaved into the complicated dynamics of a SAAS-BAHU relationship. In the wake of tragedy, these two ordinary identifiable women find themselves stuck in unprecedented situations. Will they put aside their differences and become each other's Humkadam to face all the adversities together?

Hindi Language.name: Myopia
Hindi Language.description: A broke private detective takes up a small parrot-hunting case but unintentionally gets embroiled in murder mystery that later turns out to be a part of an extremely huge and elaborate crime.

Hindi Language.name: Sir Sir Sarla
Hindi Language.description: The play explores the bond between the students and their professor, which faces many ebbs and flows. Secrets are revealed, accusations are thrown, and the three lives remain interwoven for many years to come.

Hindi Language.name: Offbeats
Hindi Language.description: Offbeats is an unusual anthology of 6 short films with 6 uncommon characters and their extremely unconventional stories.

Hindi Language.name: Kaale Chitte Rang
Hindi Language.description: The story is based on the two sisters, one dark and one fair. Where the color racism creates the jealousy between them and its turn out as a dark crime.

Hindi Language.name: Pasha
Hindi Language.description: The sole survivor of a multiple murder must prove his innocence by recounting the previous night's bizarre series of events.

Hindi Language.name: Balli 1984
Hindi Language.description: Balli 1984 is a story of a boy named Balli who loses his innocence at the early age of 9 due to the hatred spread across Punjab. Balli represents the emotional journey of the major section of Sikh youth during the 1980s.

Hindi Language.name: Consequence Karma
Hindi Language.description: KUSUM, a true believer of God who wishes to reconcile with her husband, is determined to conduct the Pooja (prayer service ritual) on the occasion of Ram-Navami on 2nd April 2020. Things get strained when Kusum, desperate to find a priest during Lockdown, agrees to bring a strange and peculiar PANDIT home to conduct the pooja. The Pooja gathering is joined by four other characters URVASHI, a lecherous lady indulged in gratification; JYOTI, a non-believer of any supreme power; KARAN, a kid with no sense of higher power and SAAHIL, a drug addict who can cross any boundaries to meet his needs. Gradually, as the Pooja proceeds the true nature of each and every one is revealed and turn out to be various shades of grey. Being at the centre of the turmoil of chaos, emotion and action; the Pandit provides the direction to all this mayhem and all receive the offerings according to their Karma. Then Pandit, who is actually a mythological character from Ramayana, unveils his true identity to Kusum who embraces it with serenity. What happens next - What does the Pandit do? Does Kusum get her husband back? The answer to these questions is the twisty conclusion of the film Consequence KARMA.

Hindi Language.name: Delhi Riots... A tale of burn & blame
Hindi Language.description: "Riots erupted in the northeast district of Delhi in February 2020. There were claims and counterclaims as to what triggered these riots and who all were to be blamed for it," he said. "But in this din the pain, suffering and loss of those who lost their kith and kin in these riots got ignored. This film is an attempt to capture this pain and suffering as well as an attempt to probe the root cause of these riots."

Hindi Language.name: The Last Letter
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a mad man, who is very upset with his life, Because wherever he goes people run away or run to beat him. Because of which he decides to die. And as he moves, He gets a letter lying on the ground, Seeing no one around, He wakes up the letter, And he sits in one place and reads the letter. A girl has written a letter to her father, She tells her father to come home, her mother is ill and can leave this world at any moment. Hearing this, He becomes crazy emotional and tells himself that I was going to die, But why did I get this letter? Whatever it is now, this man will definitely meet his family, I will find him. to know all this, See The Last Letter.

Hindi Language.name: Secret Attack
Hindi Language.description: A story of a secret Acid attack and the revenge that happens later .

Hindi Language.name: Ijaad
Hindi Language.description: Ijaad is One Character hindi film, about the journey of a girl, to discover herself. who had an impactful past which is disturbing her present. But she finally decides to face it and go through, which leads her to a peaceful life.

Hindi Language.name: Pagleaazam
Hindi Language.description: Pagle Aazam is a quirky comedy that revolves around three men who are dumped by a girl. But soon after Rahul meets Ishita, their lives change and everything gets turned upside down when they get trapped in their own chaos.

Hindi Language.name: Dadi Amma.. Dadi Amma Maan Jaao!
Hindi Language.description: Shraddha and Anjali are millennial sisters with dreams to fulfill and their 75-year-old kids, the grandparents to care for. Can they strike a balance?

Hindi Language.name: Faraar Kab Tak
Hindi Language.description: The horrifying fact that millions of unidentified criminals are absconding across the nations, is enough to frighten anyone. These criminals didn't just vanish - they are living amongst us, in the form of friends, relatives, employees, or even worse - husband/wife. The show is a clutter breaking factual drama series that appeals to the inherent security concern of a family. Engaging police procedure on true crime cases is brought to life with an edge of seat narrative. Constant plot intrigue and threat to the victim's life keeps a high engagement with the viewers.

Hindi Language.name: Kal Hamara Hai
Hindi Language.description: "Kal Hamara Hain" depicts the story of India, particularly how India has been divided in 3 classes - High class, Middle class and lower class. The story reveals how all these classes are deeply affected by today's corrupt system. The 3 protagonists represent these 3 classes and decide to take a stand against corruption. Little do they know what holds in the future and slowly they all start becoming a part of this magnanimous system.

Hindi Language.name: Meera Mathur
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of woman named as Meera Mathur, who is suffering from domestic violence, how do these woman fight to save their love and self-esteem.

Hindi Language.name: Bhootaha
Hindi Language.description: ANNU got trapped in her own office while working late night and in the mid night super natural power awakes. - what she will do to survive from evil power? A super natural film has only one character not even a single photograph has been used in the film and the best part movie has only one location too.

Hindi Language.name: Go Fun Yourself
Hindi Language.description: Loaded with wackiness and a slew of madcap challenges, the 10 episode series will feature the best funny videos uploaded by people hosted by Kusha Kapila

Hindi Language.name: Crime Patrol: Khooni Kaun Hai?
Hindi Language.description: Funny spoof by 2 in 1 Vinese on popular crime series Crime Patrol.

Hindi Language.name: Savdhaan India - Aapka Sangharsh, Aapki Zubaani
Pishachini the beginning
Hindi Language.description: A man traps in a loop of a mysterious woman. She is connected to his past present and future.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Aai
Hindi Language.description: The story is based in the slums of Mumbai where this little Girl Diya and her Mother is residing. Diya and her mother are garbage pickers and are dependent on that only source of income for a living. Divya is fond of dancing and hence is dreaming about she making a successful career in that field and buying each and every luxury which she wanted to offer to her mother. The story is all about dance and the affection and crave for her mother love and respect. This story is a complete blend of emotions, romance, fight and entertainment. A complete package of family Entertainment.

Hindi Language.name: Dancing Daughters
Hindi Language.description: The documentary travels in the state of Rajasthan to explore the lives of the dancing communities there. And these women beautiful, richly dressed, and alluring and immensely fascinating as well, going by how many paintings or photographs of dancing girls one finds dating back to this period. These Nat tribe dancers who makes a living by entertaining men, women and children of all social classes, regions, castes and religions on various occasions including parties, weddings, christenings, religious ceremonies, and other social events. But with no jobs on offer, even for educated members of the community, the girls have been forced to join dance bars in Mumbai.The community of the Kalbaliyas..the snake dancers are limited to giving cultural performances. These communities live on the periphery of the Indian society.

Hindi Language.name: All in a Night
Hindi Language.description: A young woman succeeds to ward off the threat to his married life posed by his criminal ex-boyfriend.

Hindi Language.name: Ding Dong Bell
Hindi Language.description: Ding, Dong, and Bell are chased by a hungry Fox named Bhukkad. The Hungry Fox is forever on the prowl for these chicks who are always ready to foil his plan.

Hindi Language.name: Mrs & Mr Khurana
Hindi Language.description: The story of Mr and Mrs Khurana.... their Dreams.... Aspirations..... Greed.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny in Arabian Adventure
Hindi Language.description: Honey Bunny and team are on a vacation where Honey unknowingly stumbles upon a mysterious magical lamp which contains a genie. Honey Bunny and team soon realises that the genie is actually a prince of Pandan who was trapped in the magic lamp while hiding from commander Kamaal.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Nasha
Hindi Language.description: A story of a Fashion Designer who is madly in love with Atul who is A Super Model. She has a fatal attraction towards Atul that she is always thinking about him. The problem with her attraction is not knowing if it will be returned.

Hindi Language.name: Dev-Ansh: Son of God
Hindi Language.description: A man with no name and a page-less past need to discover who he is, out of a separated wilderness that he winds up caught in. With the assistance of two different campers, he goes to each degree to look for reality. Will his long for reality make him insane?

Hindi Language.name: Mad'ouk - Toughened by Life
Hindi Language.description: Story of an ultra-runner as he attempts one of the world's toughest races, 333 kilometers in 72 hours at the high altitude Himalayan terrain.

Hindi Language.name: Anu-Priya
Hindi Language.description: Anu-Priya is a heart touching love story of gangster and a rich girl. How a gangster fall in love and what happen when the girl know that he is the person who killed his parents.

Hindi Language.name: Doctor I Love You
Hindi Language.description: 9000 feet above the sea level, snow caped mountains, colorful jungles of autumn, snakelike small roads, deadly valleys, surprising fog and untimely snowfall. Mysterious nature and equally mysterious unfathomable story of doctor Madan, the only neurosurgeon working in the local hospital.

Hindi Language.name: Man Maiden Mercenary
Hindi Language.description: Amidst a life filled with problems, noise and complaints, an introverted artist finds a muse in his chance encounter with a mysterious woman. His life starts to unravel, however, when the woman moves into his neighboring apartment.

Hindi Language.name: Shouting Silence
Hindi Language.description: Shouting Silence is a multi language Crime/Thriller/Drama film written and directed by Jaimin Bal And produced by Jaimin Bal and Neha Desai under the banner of Hiranyagarbha Motion Pictures. The film is going to release by the end of 2021.

Hindi Language.name: Gangs of Filmistan
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to Bhindi Bhai's house of comedy. As his tenants try to impress him with the funniest Bollywood spoofs, a heavy dose of entertainment is guaranteed.

Hindi Language.name: No Man's Truth
Hindi Language.description: The peace of a middle-class family is shattered by the suicide of the elder daughter just a month after she is admitted to college. Coral, her younger sister, replaces her in the college to find out the circumstances her sister's death.

Hindi Language.name: Aahvaan
Hindi Language.description: A group of boys and girls go to a forest for a fun picnic. They enjoy a lot but humans have very bad qualities like jealousy and greed which make them demons but they don't know that this is a forest.

Hindi Language.name: Out of the Blue
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a girl who has been kidnapped and tries to play with the kidnapper's mind and convinces him to fall for her, so that he can let her go.

Hindi Language.name: Amma Ke Babu Ki Baby
Hindi Language.description: Baal-brahmachari wrestler Babu's life turns upside down when he meets Baby, a spoilt city girl. What happens when their destinies collide?

Hindi Language.name: Gamingtronium
Hindi Language.description: Gamingtronium is a video series on YouTube where Gamingtronium (Mohammad Owais Khan) shares gaming videos and live streams.

Hindi Language.name: Murdaahi
Hindi Language.description: Murdaahi, a name which evokes fear in cthe hearts of people, a place where death is easy & cheap and life too hard to live. It's a one-way road where you can see back but you can't go back, whoever comes here, never returns.

Hindi Language.name: Popcity
Hindi Language.description: A coming of age story of a hitman in Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Durjanpur
Hindi Language.description: Durjanpur is the story of a mentality that destroys humanity .

Hindi Language.name: Gutter Boy
Hindi Language.description: Sandeep belongs to a poor, lower caste family. Struggling to earn a living, he moves to the big city in the hopes of a better life. Instead he is merely reminded of his place in society when the only job he's offered is of a sewage cleaner.

Hindi Language.name: Gud Boy
Hindi Language.description: Working as a dance instructor, 27 year old Pranav Kulkarni (Rishi Saxena) follows the "Gud Boy Formula" that allows him to get close to girls without the added baggage of a relationship.

Hindi Language.name: The Purple Night
Hindi Language.description: A deadly rare magical mushroom makes its way into the life of an NRI family man, amid conflict situations with his wife on returning back to India.

Hindi Language.name: Beat the Genius
Hindi Language.description: A game show where the host asks five questions to the viewers sitting at home and gives four options for each question. Winners of this game show get big prizes every episode from Flipkart. This 28-episode show is hosted by Manish Paul.

Hindi Language.name: Black Coffee
Hindi Language.description: BLACK COFFEE is a film based upon two characters who meet in an unusual interesting way. Mrs. Malik lives alone in a small town battling with the vacuum created by the absence of family. She has an encounter with Krishna. Who is jugging his way to meet the needs and desires of his family. The film slowly unravels the complex emotional human need of companionship and is an attempt to draw attention towards this slowly progressing depressive illness seen in nuclear families.

Hindi Language.name: Three Course Meal
Hindi Language.description: Three different kind of meals. Three renowned directors. Three Bollywood stars. If that is already not thrilling enough, then wait for "Three Course Meal".

Hindi Language.name: Where Is My Home
Hindi Language.description: A 23yrs nightmare continues with Bru/ Reang community as refugees in their own country. An ethnic clash changed the life of Bru Community, forever, but they hope, one day they will get their Home, which left in Mizoram, India in 1997.

Hindi Language.name: Roop Calling...
Hindi Language.description: An aspiring writer stressed with relationship problems, family complications, writer's block & his own insecurities gets a call out of nowhere from a girl named Roop. She's the typical Jab We Met's Geet. After the call the things around the boy get's messy- parents get stuck in another city, old relationship crawling up on his head again, & the more he's pushing himself against these all, the more it's coming near him.

Hindi Language.name: Bhanwar Jindagi
Hindi Language.description: An unfolding mystery when Aarav kidnaps a girl and brings her to a house that is under surveillance.

Hindi Language.name: G Mehraru
Hindi Language.description: This is a story of a newly married girl who run away with his boyfriend who mate her on facebook. He sold her in a red light area. His husband struggles for find out her.

Hindi Language.name: Gangs of Malgudi
Hindi Language.description: Plot unknown.

Hindi Language.name: Murders by Masses
