Hindi Language.description: In two parallel stories, a man and a woman, have to show their best survival instincts to fight the mindset of people around them else death is looming at the very next step.

Hindi Language.name: Cheer Haran
Hindi Language.description: Cheer Haran is an attempt to peep into the psyche of Haryana in the aftermath of Jaat Reservation Agitation 2016. It's an attempt to decipher the two words Jaat and Reservation and understand why the agitation, all of a sudden, turned horribly violent. Whether the brutality that occurred could have been averted?

Hindi Language.name: Shehri Gabru
Hindi Language.description: Three unemployed bachelors and two local goons leading their life separately, get a deadline of seven days to pay a large amount of money..

Hindi Language.name: Fukrey Boyzzz: Space Mein Fukrapanti
Hindi Language.description: After a foreboding dream about aliens comes true, three fun-loving friends must prevent human intelligence from being stolen from Earth.

Hindi Language.name: Majjma
Hindi Language.description: Majma is the story of an indigenous magician, Bishnu, who travels from town to town with his wife and son, performing street magic. Soon as they arrive at a new slum dwelling, a local thug frames them for theft, alerting the cops. Cops bash up Bishnu and rape his beautiful wife. What follows is a tale of survival as Bishnu battles not just the dogma that all indigenous magicians are thieves amidst abject poverty but also the odds that threaten the very existence of the ancestral craft.

Hindi Language.name: A Bride
Hindi Language.description: A Bride is a dark comedy short film. The story is about a helpless bride who took asylum in a bachelor's house. The boys are now in fear of a rumour about a killer bride. This is a perfect blend of fear, comedy and sarcasm.

Hindi Language.name: Singapore Vignettes
Hindi Language.description: The Singapore Vignettes tells distinct stories of the new Indian expats in Singapore, along with the story of a corporate fraud that delivers befitting justice to a group of disgruntled older workers in a factory.

Hindi Language.name: Undertaker
Hindi Language.description: Lakhpat, an undertaker for unclaimed bodies, is followed by a dead woman's young son of 6-7 years old to the cremation ground. The boy turns up at his door again at night, demanding bread to eat. Lakhpat yields and even entreats him to stay the night. Though no emotions are overtly exchanged between the two, a bond is formed.

Hindi Language.name: Vande Bharat Flight IX 1344: Hope to Survival
Hindi Language.description: A devastating air crash, that turned hope into tragedy for 190 people.

Hindi Language.name: Now Memeing
Hindi Language.description: Now Memeing is a 100% original, authentic, innovative, Asia #1 memelord Netflix meme review show hosted by Slayy Point.

Hindi Language.name: The Motorcycle Man
Hindi Language.description: It starts with Ashna, Ramji, Amit, they come to farewell party of Sir. Ashna Loves Sir a lot, but Sir is not getting convinced by Ashna. They reached at Sir's home; they started to talk about here and there. Ashna many times tries to convince Sir to be with her and marry her, once Ashna proposed him in-front of everyone, He refused very rudely, so Ashna started to cry and goes inside the bedroom, so everyone around forced Sir to come up with the truth. Sir slowly and somewhat reluctantly, that he is Ashwatthama who has lived for more than 5 thousand years. Sir begins his tale under the guise of a possible science-fiction film story, but eventually stops speaking in hypothetical and begins answering questions from a first-person perspective. Sir continues his tale, relating how is it possible that he means Ashwatthama can take part at the era of World War 1 and 2. Ashwatthama also took part in freedom fight of India. In the course of the conversation, each of Sir's colleagues questions his story based on knowledge from his or her own academic specialty. Sir says that one scientist in 1837 helped him to recover the curse (not completely but partially). The discussion turns to the topic of religion. After this revelation, emotions in the room run high. Ramji begins crying, he is having Blood pressure condition so he became unconscious, Sir treats him, now Amit demands that Sir end his tale and gives the group a sense of closure by admitting it was all a hoax. Sir says it was just a lie and he was making a film's script, all people goes and leaves the place.... Again Ashna proposes him, but he again rejects her proposal and leaves for infinity.... To be continued...

Hindi Language.name: Damru-story behind a small change
Hindi Language.description: Damru is the story of a small village. Which is still plagued by superstition. There lives a 10-year-old boy, Damru, who tries to change the condition of the village with the help of his friends Sher Singh and Vedika.

Hindi Language.name: Cyclotron
Hindi Language.description: Cyclotron is a film about the world's oldest functional particle accelerator and the people who keep it running today.

Hindi Language.name: Double Trouble with Smriti & Jemi
Hindi Language.description: One's an elegant left hander who can mercilessly cut and pull any opposition bowler, the other is a supremely fit teenager whose classic drives can leave you speechless. Together, they're a formidable 'JODI' both on and off the cricket field. Presenting Baseline Ventures's first web series Double Trouble hosted by Smriti Mandhana and Jemimah Rodrigues.

Hindi Language.name: Priti: The Dark Shadow of Society
Wheres Vibhuti
Hindi Language.description: Where's Vibhuti is a film is about a regular college going girl whose life turns upside down when she gets kidnapped and assaulted.Seeking revenge she finds an ally in a teenager who witnessed her kidnapping and also shot it on his camera.

Hindi Language.name: Koki Poochega
Hindi Language.description: Koki Poochega (translated as 'Koki Will Ask') is a highly popular digital talk show hosted by Indian actor Kartik Aaryan. He launched this series on his official YouTube channel in April 2020, during the initial nationwide COVID-19 lockdown in India. Instead of interviewing big celebrities, Kartik used his platform to interview real-life COVID-19 fighters, including doctors, police officers, health experts, and virus survivors. His main goal was to spread awareness, bust myths, dispel widespread rumors and misinformation surrounding the pandemic, bring hope to people during the lockdown, and to highlight the efforts of frontline workers. Kartik hosted the show virtually from his home, interviewing guests via video calls. He combined his signature humor with serious, informative questions to keep the audience educated without causing panic.

Hindi Language.name: Silence of Sleep
Hindi Language.description: This Film is the story of a woman who has suffered a serious accident while she was hypnotized by her mysterious and psychopath lover. Since she is in coma all she can do is think of different ways to take revenge on this person who has trapped her against her will. But the effects of hypnotism seem to be so strong that things don't go as per plan even in her own imagination. The lover is like a hunter. He first lures the prey towards him by letting her feel safe and in control and then he unexpectedly turns things around and traps her again and again. This happens to such an extent that even the people who are close to her in real life are unable to help her out in her imagination. She realizes that she is alone in this struggle and has only two options, to keep fighting or to give up.

Hindi Language.name: X6
Hindi Language.description: What is a ghost? Does it have a shape or size? or a gender? or is it an evil force? there are no perfect answers for such queries. There are stories saying that few people have seen a ghost. But there are no apparent evidences..

Hindi Language.name: Maa Ke Sath Kuch Pal
Hindi Language.description: An old mother mistreated in a family by daughter in law. The daughter in law sends the old mother in Old age Home and there the Mother dies. The Son repents his mistake of leaving his mother in Old age home.

Hindi Language.name: Dhyey
Hindi Language.description: It's a pure and simple village oriented love story . Amresh is from a respectable family , his father owns a garage , Amresh friend Vibhu is the ultimate monkey of the entire village going by his antics . His father often beats him up but he neither realize his mistakes nor does he change . Amresh and Vibhu's friendship is much talked about and their comradely is evergreen . Amresh falls for Pragya who is the niece of Jageshwar Banvariya , the so called Robinhood of the village . Pawan one of Jageshwar pupil / protege likes Pragya and has a very awkward / jealous relationship with Amresh . When things don't go according to plan , their love story turns upside down . Jageshwar who is deeply influenced by rules and regulations , culture and orthodoxy threatens to destroy their love but relents later but Pawan comes out as the main villain who not only become against them but also kills them in a fit a rage . Even after they are dead , Amresh and Pragya are still together in afterlife .

Hindi Language.name: Make Me Up
Hindi Language.description: India's first digital Make Up contest. 16 contestants battle it out for the title of The Make Up Artist of the Year. Streaming Now On Hungama Play.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Sainik - The Tale of a warrior
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a medieval kingdom named Subhangarh and its soldier named Ayaan who fought against the odds to save his kingdom from an unknown threat.

Hindi Language.name: San 84 Justice
Hindi Language.description: This is Hindi-Punjabi Feature Film. It is a story of a family, who sell Rice for their living. The family tries to cope up in several ways to fulfil their living requirements. Gurfateh Singh, the father of 3 sons along with his brother and wife belong to a lower middle class family where they all work together and live with good and strong bonding. Since Gurfateh Singh is not able to get sufficient income through his rice selling business, he and his family tries several other work to fulfil the basic needs of the family. Although one of his friends suggests to mix tiny pebbles in the Rice and wheat grains. But the man is honest and dedicated to his work. He refuses to do so. Somehow the family is leading their way peacefully even after all issues. Meanwhile the news is heard that Smt. Indira Gandhi is assassinated by Sikh security force. This news creates lots of threat to Sikh families. The Communal people in the town create chaos by taking the advantage of this incident. They bribe few unemployed men to create chaos and acquire the Sikh familys' belongings and properties. This creates lots of violence in the town and several Sikh families including small children were killed and women were left widow. The incident of war-like which took place in Golden Temple, Amritsar took several Sikh lives in Amritsar to New Delhi and many women and children suffered due to this. Thousands of them lost their life and many families destroyed.

Hindi Language.name: Chai - a bond undefined
Hindi Language.description: Chotu's world comes crashing down when he gets to know about Nishant's Job situation. life.Will Nishant let go of his life long dream or will Chotu be left behind amidst Nishant's chaotic work

Hindi Language.name: Sanam Hotline
Hindi Language.description: Recently fired from their mundane jobs at a call centre, Ishaan (Pushkar Jog) and his friend Abhijeet (Uday Nene), decide to do something exciting with their lives and start an adult hotline

Hindi Language.name: The Right Click
Hindi Language.description: In this cool new interactive short film, you get to make decisions for Ajay, a college fresher whose hopes of finding a girlfriend were dashed by the pandemic. But what could have been boring days of online classes turned interesting when he finds his quirky classmate, Dia. How will Ajay and Dia click in the days of social distancing? Well, that depends on the choices you make. Watch the story and be part of it.

Hindi Language.name: Nobel Peace
Hindi Language.description: 'Nobel Peace' is a feature film exploring the dangerous social tensions arisen from religious differences and simple differences of opinion which lead to cruel, senseless violence and oppression which in turn leads to further injustices and creates a never-ending cycle of exploitation from both legal authorities as well as illegal groups. Set in a small touristic village in India, we follow the story of Hayan Mir and his friend Aasif Alam long with professor Shlok Manhas. Hayan is a young man desiring to make videos to attract tourists to his village and promote peace. His actions are being misinterpreted as he visits a terrorist camp. Although he eventually gets released after relentless efforts of the professor and his lawyer uncle pleading for his release, the damages caused to everyone involved are priceless and hefty.

Hindi Language.name: Dhar
Hindi Language.description: Bhukkad King went Dhar and here he tasted some best street foods of Dhar. This Season-1 covers all the Episodes made in Dhar.

Hindi Language.name: Friction
Hindi Language.description: Rahul and Roskija are married and have a kid but things are not smooth in their relationship. Will the friction between them lead to a bigger disaster?

Hindi Language.name: Shaheen Baghi
Hindi Language.description: Raju Lohar, the voice of voiceless, fighting for his village's identity gets influenced by the Shaheen Bagh movement and becomes a rebel with a cause.

Hindi Language.name: Boxed
Hindi Language.description: Surviving in the Box and facing the drastic epidemic cos of a small misunderstanding from a brother after her sisters death. Will He Die from Corona or ??

Hindi Language.name: Entertainer No.1
Hindi Language.description: Entertainer No. 1 is a UGC based competition which will be aired on Flipkart Video. It is a first of its kind competition where users can perform dance, mimicry and create dubsmash on a digital platform, which also gives an opportunity to win 1 crore from home. The show will go on for 8 weeks, which will be divided into 8 weekly themes. Each user will have to follow the theme and create a video using the songs/dialogues available in the show library. Every video uploaded is open to 'audience hearts' which is the primary form of scoring, the higher the hearts the more the chances of winning There are three judges on the judge, Varun Dhawan, Bharti Singh, and Raghav Juyal who will be watching the performances of the users and giving them 'Super Hearts. A user can only participate once in a weekly challenge Every week, the top 110 winners with maximum 'hearts' will be declared as winners, of these the top 10 winners will be receiving Rs. 1 Lakh as prize money and the remaining 100 will be receiving Flipkart Gift Cards worth Rs. 1000. At the end of Every week, Flipkart will declare the winners of that weekly challenge. At the end of 8 weeks, the user who has received maximum cumulative 'Hearts' across all 8 weekly challenges will be declared as the Grand Winner. He will be eligible to receive a cash Prize of Rs. 1 Crore.

Hindi Language.name: Sector 12 Ka Kitty Club
Hindi Language.description: The series is a hilarious joy-ride into the world of women. An observational comedy talking about stereotypes, taboos and everyday fights.

Hindi Language.name: Beti: The Angel of God on the Earth
Hindi Language.description: A mother struggles to save her girl child.

Hindi Language.name: Mughalsarai Junction
Hindi Language.description: Life and Journey of Deendayal Upadhyay.

Hindi Language.name: Mumbai Special Pav Bhaji
Hindi Language.description: Amidst dark and gritty reality of drug smuggling and human trafficking in Mumbai we see Prem, our protagnist. Prem is an orphan and does odd jobs. He is all alone until he falls for innocent Bubbly who sell toys at a traffic signal. They both falls in love when Bubbly's step father tries to sell her off to the mafia king of human trafficking in Mumbai, Bobby Khan Prem soon sets out on a journey to save Bubbly from this nexus. Simultaneously we are introduced to Samar, the young, dynamic yet ambitious man who thrives for power and runs the drug cartel for Bobby Khan. Samar runs this whole nexus along with Kamat and Pawar, two corrupt cops always looking out to rip people. Imran and Golu two pawns stuck in this web whose strings are pulled by Bobby Khan only. Mumbai indeed is a plate of Pav(Law) Bhaji(Crime) and everyone sure wants a piece of it.

Hindi Language.name: Sunderkand Let love find you
Hindi Language.description: A travel journalist embarks on an ambitious quest to reach a letter to its intended owner, written three decades ago by a forlorn lover.

Hindi Language.name: Boomerang
Hindi Language.description: A horrifying tale of a man's past which cursed his life and family forever, a past which comes back to haunt them every night and a tale which has no beginning and no end.

Hindi Language.name: Locked in Love
Hindi Language.description: Mini series about the Highs and Lows of LOVE, depicted in 5 different stories enacted by two performers. The series highlights how Love can transcend time, how it can hurt you, heal you and also give another chance. The world as it is , seen through the lens of Love.

Hindi Language.name: Badtameez Love
Hindi Language.description: A family had to leave the city because of job transfer.They distribute all their plants to their friends but one plant brings turmoil in a friend's life.

Hindi Language.name: Antervyathaa
Hindi Language.description: An investigative officer partners with another person who uses his experiences with fear to handle a case and break a criminal who feels right after committing a crime.

Hindi Language.name: To Caterpillar, from Butterfly
Hindi Language.description: A poor girl is lured into the world of crime and is haunted by ghosts of her guilt and conscience, eventually runs out of her dimension to discover that she was a part of a film.

Hindi Language.name: Innocent Criminals
Hindi Language.description: Three bachelors living a normal life when an opportunity comes knocking to earn quick money by blackmailing their landlady. Without thinking about the consequences, they accept the offer and begins a crazy hilarious roller coaster ride.

Hindi Language.name: Blind Date: dark face of love
Impossible Amarnath Yatra
Hindi Language.description: The film Impossible Amarnath Yatra was made during the Corona lock down. It depicts the time of Amarnath when there were no devotees here. This film has become very popular and has received about 1.6 million views.

Hindi Language.name: Persona Mrs. India
Hindi Language.description: Persona Mrs India challengers are successful Indian married woman who endeavour to act naturally certain agile exquisite magnetic and respectable within the representation of India reception and round the globe.

Hindi Language.name: Aage Kya
Hindi Language.description: Aage Kya is an original Quiz show of Flipkart Video releasing on 28th March 2021. It will be available in the video section of the Flipkart app and features 4 social media influencers who ask viewers 3 questions. The winners get prizes.

Hindi Language.name: Reporter Robinhood Reporting
Hindi Language.description: In 2016 India's demonetization shocks both corrupt officials and ordinary citizens. Two small-time reporters seek a breakthrough story that could transform their careers.

Hindi Language.name: Days in Heaven
Hindi Language.description: 100 Days in heaven is a reality show first of its kind which is inspired by the mountaineers. The show not only has incredible people but also their incredible stories that will break your heart and make one believe in courage and strength. As a special appearance and Amelia Rose Hillary will be seen. The show will be an aspiration for the mountain lovers. The viewer will definitely witness the alluring locations of Uttarakhand.

Hindi Language.name: Jagjivan Ki Patni Ka Teesra Pyar
A Cold Plan
Hindi Language.description: A late night hostage situation, in a deserted warehouse, unfolds in a very unpredictable manner.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Dopahar (An Afternoon)
Hindi Language.description: Radha lives in a box like apartment in Old Delhi. As her husband leaves for work, she runs to the room,opens an old trunk to take out her dress, make up, mobile phone and a painting of Mona Lisa. She goes into her fantasy and dream world.

Hindi Language.name: Short Films: Emerging Leaders
Hindi Language.description: Through several quirky characters and a narrator, we see a series of 100 short films based on the fun, misery and drama of the new age corporate world. We see how these 4 characters become Emerging Leaders of the corporate world.

Hindi Language.name: Anomaly
Hindi Language.description: Thrilling story of Abhishek, who is trapped in the labyrinth of his Karma and re-living the GUILT of a heinous Crime committed by him, again and again, a punishment given by the BOSS.

Hindi Language.name: Bahuli
Hindi Language.description: BAHULI as the name suggests is a metaphor for Meenu and Guddu's life individually. Fate brings them together under one roof on one destined night and while talking, their emotions unravel till the sun rises. Will the morning bring new hope in their lives or once they will shelve their lives into the darkness of reality of Life.

Hindi Language.name: Lambuji Tinguji
Hindi Language.description: Lambuji and Tinguji are best friends who are inseparable. While trying to help everyone, they end up being part of various misadventures and trouble because of Tinguji's big talk while Lambuji has to save the day.

Hindi Language.name: The Making of Kingfisher Calendar 2020
Hindi Language.description: One captivating location, four jaw-dropping models, and one ace photographer, India's most irresistible calendar is back again, this time in stunning Cape Town. Stylish swimwear, scenic landscapes and the hottest models, the calendar this year is steamier, saucier, and sizzling hot like never before. We take you behind the scenes with Atul Kasbekar and his muses - Aishwarya Sushmita, Zoya Afroz, Pooja Chopra, and Aditi Arya.

Hindi Language.name: Bolti Nadi - Into the Sakri River Basin
Hindi Language.description: Filming in the Sakri River Basin by walking approx. 90 k.m. by Amir Hashmi, 4 continues day and nights from the River's origin point the Michal Hill's first village Kariyama to the end point of it merged at Darhi village.

Hindi Language.name: Surrogacy
Hindi Language.description: Ganga is another name for sacrifice, courage and purity. The holy Gangas, which can bear many sorrows within itself, is probably born to remove the sufferings of the world. The word Ganga itself is inspiring. Which includes their sense of power, energy, guidance. GANGA TU HAI MAHAN is the story of sacrifice of one such girl. One who spends his life in the fire of sorrows to give life to his father. For the treatment of her father, she gives her womb on rent to her royal family. Shivji Patil that is, in medical science called surrogate mother. This decision saves Ganga's father life but his life becomes completely hell. When Ganga's father comes to know about the truth. Instead of supporting him, he leaves her out from his home, after many difficulties. The Ganga moves forward without stopping. Does Ganga get her destination Does Ganga get his love Does her father forgive Ganga Does society accept Ganga Does the stain of desecration on the Ganga's disappear.. The word Ganga itself is inspiring. Which includes their sense of power, energy, guidance. GANGA TU HAI MAHAN is the story of sacrifice of one such girl. As a young man, he is able to accomplish what no other man has ever done: he lifts and strings the bow of Siva, and by so doing her earns the right to marry the beautiful Sita. Just when he is about to ascend the throne of Ayodhya, his father Dasaratha is forced to exile him for fourteen years to the forest due to a vow made long ago. Unruffled, Rama accepts his exile; his wife Sita and his loyal brother Lakshmana accompany him. In the forest, the princely brothers kill many demons and visit many wise men and women. The evil demon Ravana hears of Sita's beauty, and kidnaps her. He has fallen in love with her and tries to seduce her, but she rebuffs his advances for nearly ten months. Desperate to win her back, Rama and Lakshmana form an alliance with the monkey king Sugriva, and invade Lanka with an army of monkeys. After many violent battles, Rama defeats Ravana and wins back Sita. He is concerned that she has been unfaithful during her long captivity, and so Sita undergoes a trial by fire to prove her chastity. Rama takes her back, and they return to rule Ayodhya for many wonderful years. In another version of the tale, Rama hears his people gossiping about Sita's imagined indiscretions, and he banishes her to the forest, where she gives birth to Rama's twin sons. Sita and the children confront him years later; he tries to explain his harsh actions to Sita, but she vanishes into the earth to escape him.

The walk started from Ganga Sagar, West Bengal in June 2016, and completed on reaching Gangotri, Uttarakhand in April 2017. The film is an attempt in bringing out first person narratives as well as large scale data archives on the river's history, its condition and life of the people of the basin. The film follows the journey of Siddharth, an engineer by profession, who undertakes a 3000km walk along the Ganga to better understand the river and the people who live next to it. It follows his experiences of navigating the myriad dimensions of a river, its ecosystems and ecology, as well as his own personal journey of realisation and change as he navigates the 6 month long walk.

Hindi Language.name: Hacking for the Commons
Hindi Language.description: « Hacking for the Commons » (aka « La bataille du Libre » in French) is a 87 minute documentary film written and directed by Philippe Borrel, produced by Jeremy Zelnik and Tancrède Ramonet for ARTE TV in 2019. Computing has infiltrated almost all human activities of today's world. Has it contributed to making us more self-reliant ? Or has it turned us into the passive consumers of what has become a total market ? Without our being aware of it, two logics are confronting each other at the very heart of technology, since the emancipating principles of free software have shaken the exclusive proprietary rights of so called « intellectual property » since the 1980s. For decades, Big Data multinationals, generally referred to as GAFAM (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Apple, Microsoft) have sought to simplify, even infantilise our relationship with the digital world and ultimately with the world around us. Their designers assume that the less we know, the more we will behave as captive and passive clients and the more we will be kept under control, without our knowledge. Yet this is not necessarily an inevitable fate, and many initiatives around the world show us that it is still possible to regain control of our tools, whether digital or not. It would have seemed totally unimaginable just 20 years ago that non-industrial or non- state protagonists might succeed in collectively creating a system of exploitation or an encyclopedia. Several challenges that appear insurmountable today - climate, energy or social - might well be tackled tomorrow by all of humanity, across borders, thanks to models being tried out by the "Free" activists. Free software, free seeds, open source hardware, generic medicine or alternative treatments and free access to knowledge - Objects, devices, machines, concepts, reproducible to infinity by all who wish, thanks to the free distribution of their blueprints. The founding legal principles of free software serve as an example with the battle won against the dominant model of intellectual property. Since then, collective and contributing practices of "Free" are flourishing in many other domains. Their principle attraction is designing alternatives to the system of marketing and control, whether in relation to technology, ecology, the defence of public services or culture. By stressing the importance of freedom, cooperation and sharing, at the same time they revive users' autonomy and power. They can as such contribute to the emergence of a world that might be liberated of copyright and patents for the benefit of the Common. Which is perhaps the challenge of these utopias; every large-scale social and political revolution is above all a cultural revolution. Featuring : Kenneth Roelofsen, Karen Sandler, Richard Stallman, James Boyle, Hervé Le Crosnier, Shamnad Basheer, Pierre-Yves Gosset, Thomas Bernardi, Kwame Yamgnane, Lucile Vareine, Asa Dotzler, Denelle Dixon, Abhiram Ravikumar, Pascal Chevrel, Lionel Maurel, Martine Cailbault, Nicolas Huchet, David Gouailler, Xavier Niel, Giorgio Regni, David Bollier, Marc Oshima, Vandana Shiva, Guy Standing, Joseph Stiglitz, Pierre Dardot, James Love, Francis Gurry, Anthony Di Franco, Steve Berman, Yann Huon de Kermadec, Olivier Maguet, Vidyashankar R., Marc Bouché, Mick Minchow, Kevin Kenney, Lydia Brasch, Vinod Kumar, Bhavani, Mani Kantan, Grégoire Wattinne, Marie-Laure Marcadé, Nicolas Sinoir, Vladimir Ritz, Benjamin Coriat, Marcel Thébault, Michel Dartois.

Hindi Language.name: Thank You for Coming
Hindi Language.description: Kanika Kapoor (Bhumi Pednekar) is on a quest for love and sexual pleasure. Kanika, a 32 years old single woman, lives with her mother, Dr. Bina Kapoor (Natasha Rastogi), and her grandmother, Kishori Kapoor (Dolly Ahluwalia). Bina is a single mother and a gynecologist. Bina has always been very transparent with Kanika about sex education. Bina was unashamed about her single life, even when the landlords objected to her bringing her boyfriends home, late at night. At school, Kanika was made to apologize by Kishori for talking about sex during a school play. Bina maintained that Kanika should not have to say sorry to tell the truth. Kanika himself grew up to become a sexually active teenager. Kanika has affairs with a college friend Bunny, a Professor Shekhar Sinha and later with Rahul (Sushant Divgikar). Rahul never even wanted to have sex with Kanika. Despite trying hard, she has never had an orgasm. After every breakup and at her birthdays, when she is very depressed for being alone, she is warmed up by her best friends Pallavi Khanna (Dolly Singh) and Tina Das (Shibani Bedi). At her 32nd birthday Kanika was looking to hook up with Arjun (Karan Kundrra), but he brings his own date Rushi Kalra (Shehnaaz Gill) to the party. When Pallavi and Tina confront Arjun, he retorts that Kanika is over 30 years old, and he respects her like an aunt. Rushi and Kanika get super drunk at the party and Kanika confesses to her that she has never had an orgasm. Rushi tells Kanika to have sex with a person who loves her and not with the person whom she loves. Kanika has an epiphany and decides to get married to Jeevan Anand (Pradhuman Singh), a businessman, who has been courting her for long time however they have never been physical. Kanika goes over to Jeevan's house in her sexy red dress, with an intention to have sex with him. But while Jeevan is very passionate, his heat and passion does not include sex, which frustrates Kanika. Her mother and friends warn her about the shy and simple Jeevan Anand. But given her mother did not get married to her father and raised her as single mother, Kanika is terrified of the idea of being alone and facing the society. Neha (Kusha Kapila) is one of the mean girls who taunts Kanika about being single. Kanika retorts that she is engaged and invites Neha to the engagement. Bina lashes out at Kanika and says that her father never loved her and he was offering to marry her out of pity as she was pregnant with Kanika. Aman's wife, Meera who has an autobiographical bestseller to her credit is trying to cope with their financial burdens and Aman's lack of responsibility. One fine day, as in all stories, Meera is summoned by a big businessman Siddharth Jaiwardhan, to Uttarakhand where he expects her to stay and write his biography. Meera knowing the money situation at home says yes to this much lucrative task at hand. This makes Aman furious as it is their son's death anniversary in a day. The couple get into a bitter fight at the end of which Aman resolves to somehow bring money home but stops Meera from leaving for Uttarakhand. Aman in rage and fury steps out of the house and meets with a fatal accident. The doctor tells Meera that Aman has gone into a coma for an undefined time. Meera is devastated but patiently waits for Aman. Then one day Aman wakes up. Meera who is overjoyed to get Aman back, resolves to bring Aman home and start their lives all over again. But while Meera borrows money to take care of the hospital bills she realizes Aman has hit the bottle within the confines of the hospital. At this point Meera stops chasing hope. She leaves aman to himself and leaves for the ghost writing job in Uttarakhand. Meera reaches Binsar station, a remotely populated town in Uttarakhand. The town is quiet and eerie. Matthew, Siddharth's butler, receives Meera and takes her to Siddharth's palace. While this happens, Aman is visited by a strange blind man in his dream, Purohit. He warns him that his wife's life is in danger. Aman wakes up but soon realizes that this was not just another bad dream, it was a strange prophecy. Meera meets Siddharth Jaiwardhan, a young and handsome loner, who lives in this huge palace all by himself. But Meera doesn't know that she has stepped into the den of the devil himself. Siddharth is a soul sucking demon, who slowly seduces Meera, puts a spell on her and makes her a slave to the demon. When Aman reaches Binsar to bring back Meera he finds her almost unwilling to acknowledge him. This breaks Aman further. Siddharth is a powerful man in Binsar uses his clout and gets aman arrested to be thrown out of the town. But all is not lost in aman's heart yet. He refuses to believe that Meera could actually forget him. He puts his might together for the love which is still alive and throbbing in his heart. He takes a leap of faith and comes back to Binsar to find a way to get to Meera. The blind Purohit and his accomplice Roohi, soon gets hold of Aman and tells him that Siddharth Jaiwardhan is a demon, who feeds on the souls of bastard children. He has been doing it for thousands of years and now Meera is his next prey to devour on. Aman now has his back against the wall as he is battling the devil. The devil, who is an ancient evil king who has been sucking on souls and never died. Will Aman be able to save Meera, will he be able to be a husband that she always wanted. In this war of Love and Evil, will Aman be able to become a knight of Love.

Hindi Language.name: Tera Kya Hoga Lovely
Hindi Language.description: A comedy of errors that traverses through the hinterlands of Haryana unfolding crazy dynamics, relationships and eccentricities that occur between family, friends, lovers, and even cops!.

Hindi Language.name: Hindutva
Hindi Language.description: The depths of Hinduism is seen through its principal characters.Friendship, love and student politics are put in place.

Hindi Language.name: Angoori
Hindi Language.description: Angoori, a blind but innocent girl, stumbles upon the love of her life, Ajay who is also a blind. Together they attempt to see the love that life has snatched from them.

Hindi Language.name: Navel of Love
Hindi Language.description: Obsessed with women's navels, Debo gets married but never even sees his wife Mouni's face. Ranjit, Debo's elder brother suggests that she should attract Debo using her Navel. But she ends up falling for Ranjeet. This accidental mistake changes everything and Mouni meets a brutal end.

Hindi Language.name: Crime Patrol: 48 Hours
Hindi Language.description: Police race against time in crucial first 48 hours of investigations, when solving chances are highest. Officers use swift thinking and teamwork to catch criminals before this window closes.

Hindi Language.name: Aitraaz
Hindi Language.description: A newlywed husband grows suspicious of neighbors and colleagues being attracted to his beautiful wife, questioning if his suspicions are founded.

Hindi Language.name: Mimamsa
Hindi Language.description: The backdrop of the mystical city of Bhopal, the capital of Madhya Pradesh- but also a city that conceals many shadows in its ancient walls.

Hindi Language.name: Sherdil
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by the real events that took place in the Pilibhit Tiger Reserve where people used to leave their elderly family members for tigers to prey on, and then claim compensation from the administration.

Hindi Language.name: Mintoo
Hindi Language.description: Mintoo is the tale of an fearless girl but fear becomes her best friend in her journey of life where she will face the mental and physical challenges. Will she be a winner ? or fear will takeover ?

Hindi Language.name: Maid for Each Other
Hindi Language.description: Grew up with the words " Made for each other " only to realize your soulmate is your "maid" ? Shivam a 25 years old falls in love with his maid while dating his current boss (charu). Mess and chaos happens in the family when his father also somehow gets involved with this maid and his mother gets to know all of this. Come watch to unveil this unusual, quirky , funny and borderline dramatic story.

Hindi Language.name: Dancing on the Grave
Hindi Language.description: Deep dive into the spine-chilling murder of Shakereh Khaleeli, which took place in the early 90s in Bangalore.

Hindi Language.name: Middle Class Love
Hindi Language.description: A young college boy is frustrated being in middle-class family setup and finds love the ideal way to get out of it.

Hindi Language.name: ShortCut
Hindi Language.description: This is Romantic Comedy Story about a lady named "Roma" who uses tricks and tactics with the help of her beauty and attractive appeal take control of the property of her husband and also to befriend with her son in law and daughter in law.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Rosy Ki Dastan: Bijli
Hindi Language.description: Ajay postpones wedding, hooks up out of frustration. His grandma gifts a lucky ring he gives to Raga when framed for murder. Ajay sees victim alive with Raga, realizing he was used. Cornered, Ajay fights to get the ring back

Hindi Language.name: Kangan
Hindi Language.description: A wealthy older man's young wife becomes enamored with his mysterious, handsome gardener, setting the stage for a tangled web of desire and deception.

Hindi Language.name: Manmaniyan
Hindi Language.description: Dev Kumar's midlife crisis intensifies when he becomes infatuated with his daughter's teenage friend Soni, forcing him to confront his life choices as he navigates relationships and searches for meaning.

Hindi Language.name: Parshuram
Hindi Language.description: Parasuraman who believed to be the sixth incarnation of lord Vishnu. Created and Produced by Dilip Sonkar and Kumar Ranjit Under the Banner of Kamalashree Films Private Limited. And Directed by Gautam Nagrath.

Hindi Language.name: Tu Zakhm Hai
Hindi Language.description: Viraj, a hawala king, runs illegal operations. Kavya becomes his hostage, seeing his dark world. Gradually, they develop feelings for each other. The second season depicts Viraj's transformation due to his love for Kavya.

Hindi Language.name: Bloody Brothers
Hindi Language.description: Driving home late one night, two brothers, Jaggi and Daljeet run over an old man. They put the body back in his house, but when people suspect, the brothers' lives fall apart. They realise they can trust no one. Not even each other.

Hindi Language.name: Mister Mummy
Hindi Language.description: A couple with opposing choices when it comes to children but destiny has something else planned for the childhood sweethearts.

Hindi Language.name: Barsatein - Mausam Pyaar Ka
Hindi Language.description: A sensible and ambitious journalist joins a media company run by a maverick. While united in their passion for honest journalism, their contrasting characters immediately puts them at loggerheads.

Hindi Language.name: The Talent Manager
Hindi Language.description: Get ready to dive into the world of showbiz.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Idhar Udhar
Hindi Language.description: 'Pyaar Idhar Udhar' is story about two friends who get into relationship with each others wives without knowing anything.

Hindi Language.name: Nikamma
Hindi Language.description: A lazy slacker struggles to get along with his diligent sister-in-law - until they must step up and fight together against a common enemy.

Hindi Language.name: Karm Yuddh
Hindi Language.description: A deadly fire accident at the Roy Group of Industries brings Bhisham Roy under the scanner, inciting a power grab where it's blood versus blood.

Hindi Language.name: Woh Din Desi Kisse
Hindi Language.description: A girl finds herself in a strange family ritual where she is being kept alone in isolation when she starts menstruating. She finds a way by inviting her lover and satisfying all her desires that had been refrained by the family.

Hindi Language.name: My First Time
Hindi Language.description: A young woman hopes to take her relationship to the next level during a planned trip with her boyfriend. As they prepare for this important step, challenges arise, testing their connection and expectations about love and physical intimacy.

Hindi Language.name: Goa Trip
Hindi Language.description: Best friends Ankit, Rakesh and Neeraj plan a trip to Goa after Ankit's breakup. However, when Rakesh and Neeraj spend a night with two girls in Goa, a stranger shoots obscene videos of them and blackmails them which turns their trip miserable.

Hindi Language.name: Friday Night Plan
Hindi Language.description: When their mother takes off on a business trip, two bickering brothers unite to secretly attend the hottest party of the year before she returns.

Hindi Language.name: Farzi Mushaira
Hindi Language.description: After receiving the love and affection of all the "dil toote aashiq" around the world, Zakir Khan is back with Farzi Mushaira Season 2. The guests, the Shayaris and above all, the farziness is touching new heights.

Hindi Language.name: Tadap
Hindi Language.description: The series revolves around the story of a girl who falls in love with a guy and faces several obstacles in their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: The Receptionist
Hindi Language.description: A hotel receptionist and a flamboyant married businessman start having an illicit affair which ends abruptly. Things take an unexpected turn when she decides to re-enter his life hell bent on marrying him

Hindi Language.name: Masoom
Hindi Language.description: In the pursuit of justice for her deceased mother, a fierce Sana Kapoor fights her father and uncovers secrets that can impair her relationship with her family.

Hindi Language.name: Kaisa Yeh Fitoor
Hindi Language.description: In a whirlwind of passionate romance, a simple college girl finds herself entangled with her charismatic next-door neighbour whose possessive and obsessive behaviour turns her fairy-tale romance into a nightmare she must escape.

Hindi Language.name: Salt City
Hindi Language.description: Salt City delves into the complexities of relationships within the Bajpai family. The show explores their journey of exploring the past, dealing with a bitter present, and unfolding a promising future.

Hindi Language.name: Berang Tum Bin
Hindi Language.description: A woman one day she come across a book which includes all innovative tricks and techniques of Berang. She fantasizes getting in romantic relation with the author of the book and she also guides her friends for their personal issues.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Next Door
Hindi Language.description: A simple young guy leads a responsible, boring, and colorless life until he bumps into the 'girl next door'. Now his life is colorful but complicated.

Hindi Language.name: Ranjish Hi Sahi
Hindi Language.description: A maverick film director gets drawn into an extra-marital affair with a superstar changing his life; his marriage with his first love spirals as he's torn between two worlds. Set in 70s Bollywood this is the story of Shankar, Amna and Anju

Hindi Language.name: Meri Seal Todo
Hindi Language.description: Nimmi, a sheltered 26-year-old woman, raised by her late father's overprotective friend, struggles with her romantic life due to strict restrictions and there is some complication in her Kundali which his uncle solves finally.

Hindi Language.name: Ratri Kawach
Hindi Language.description: She has everything in life, but her desire for intercourse is unlimited and she end up being in a bad relationship and later she understood the consequences of this.

Hindi Language.name: Shastry Viruddh Shastry
Hindi Language.description: 7-year-old Yaman Shastry who binds the family together lives in his grandparent care and his parents visit him on weekends. Things get twisted when Yaman's father gets a chance to settle in the US but Guruji is unwilling to let Yaman go.

Hindi Language.name: UT69
Hindi Language.description: Based on the true story of Businessman Raj Kundra's 63 days inside India's most over crowded jail, Arthur Road jail.

Hindi Language.name: Jehanabad - Of Love & War
Hindi Language.description: A small town in Bihar, where innocent love and anarchy of the land are brewing parallelly and bound to collide.

Hindi Language.name: Kismat Ki Lakeeron Se
Hindi Language.description: Shraddha and Kirti, two sisters with contrasting personalities, face various ups and downs in their lives as fate plays a major role in their destinies.

Hindi Language.name: On Either Sides of the Pond
Hindi Language.description: Amidst the 2020 Coronavirus Pandemic, Sumit and Priyanka, an eloped couple, return to the security of their hometown. While Priyanka feels uneasy in the suffocating familiarity of her town, Sumit immerses himself in his tribe of friends.

Hindi Language.name: While We Watched
Hindi Language.description: How independent news reporting in India and beyond is increasingly under threat by budgetary cuts and especially, extremists leveraging alternative platforms to spread misinformation.

Hindi Language.name: Big Band Theory
Hindi Language.description: Akriti Kakar brings together the bunch of musical genius to create magic with their voices. Every musical episode has its own essence and touch that defines the emotions of India and its people. This 5 episode musical series features names like Shankar Mahadevan, Shaan, Sukriti Kakar, Prakriti Kakar, Nikhita Gandhi, Shashwat Singh and Romy.

Hindi Language.name: Lakhan Leela Bhargava
Hindi Language.description: An empathetic advocate in his fight for justice. We follow Lakhan on his journey to become a respected lawyer while facing prejudice for being the illegitimate child of the biggest lawyer in the city.

Hindi Language.name: Mayajaal
Hindi Language.description: This story is all about a struggling Story Writer her name is Lalita. His friend help for find out about publisher who published Erotic Stories. After Meeting Publisher agree for Published her story but own Term and Conditions.

Hindi Language.name: Alibaba: Dastaan-E-Kabul
Hindi Language.description: A lovable rogue cares for 5 orphans while confronting 40 thieves, suppressed by his late father, seeking revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Chatrapathi
Hindi Language.description: Shivaji and his family are uprooted from their community in Sri Lanka and wind up as bonded labourers in Visakhapatnam. The situation worsens when his jealous stepbrother enters his life.

Hindi Language.name: Vash
Hindi Language.description: Rakshit and Aanchal are having a perfect love story, until a third person appears wanting Aanchal to be part of his world at all costs. Who is he and what are his intentions? Some mysteries are better left unsolved.

Hindi Language.name: Hurdang
Hindi Language.description: Back in the 1990s, an aspiring IAS starts a rebellion against the caste-based reservation.

Hindi Language.name: Capsule
Hindi Language.description: Ramprasad, an old man filled thoroughly with the dreams of having a great sex life but his wife doesn't support. He gets a Magical Capsule from an unknown Baba and his life changes completely from there.

Hindi Language.name: Black Justice
Hindi Language.description: Pandey aka J.P. is practicing lawyer in sessions court and supreme court of India. JP is very honest whose only aim is to speak for the justice. J.P. decides to file a PIL for the reforms in current judicial system.

Hindi Language.name: Chal Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Strangers Sana ,Sahil, Sada and Rana go on a bike trip to Leh, Ladakh with different objectives. Through their journey, their perceptions of life change and leave a deep impact on them

Hindi Language.name: Gud Se Meetha Ishq
Hindi Language.description: Due to unforeseen circumstances, Kaju gets married to Neel. And thus, begins their journey of love and companionship, while they also carve a path of their own..

Hindi Language.name: Dono
Hindi Language.description: Dev travels to Thailand to attend his best friend and childhood crush's wedding. He meets Meghna and seems to have an instant connection with her. What does fate have in store for them?

Hindi Language.name: Baalveer 3
Hindi Language.description: Baalveer is the son of Adishi and is a boy from Udaka-Lok, a sister planet of Shashvan-Lok, the capital of righteousness. Baalveer is given some powers by Uttan, the ruler of Shashvan-Lok. On the other hand, a evil power Aagil, the empress of Himbash-Lok turns out to be successful in generating an ultra-weapon, named Mahajadoo, to kill the Baalveer. Uttan arranges Kasam Kaal for Baalveer to give all Baalveer's powers to him, so that Baalveer will be able to defeat Aagil. Baalveer calls Uttan, Adishi, and Shashmaad (Uttan's assistant) to come to Shatr-Ghar (weapon house; a place where Uttan keeps weapons of evil forces after defeating them) and deceptivates the weapon of Aagil that she used to kill previous Baalveer by touching him the weapon and turns him into ashes. Baalveer told them that he is ready to fight the evil forces.

Hindi Language.name: Kafas
Hindi Language.description: A middle-class family sees a brighter tomorrow when their son meets with a life-changing career opportunity. But this transition only unravels a web of trauma, raising poignant questions about wealth, power, and morality.

Hindi Language.name: Dildo
Hindi Language.description: One blogger is going to village to write a blog about lady pleasure, she found that they never have an experience about pleasure, so she is trying to explain them about the pleasure. Is she able to do?

Hindi Language.name: Dhappa
Hindi Language.description: Five intertwined stories explore romance's challenges amidst prying eyes: a couple's contraceptive struggle, a professor-student friendship, an untimely pregnancy, friends forced to marry, and newlyweds' night disrupted.

Hindi Language.name: Dada Lakhmi
Hindi Language.description: Based on the musical journey of Pandit Lakhmichand, a folk artist who hailed from Haryana.

Hindi Language.name: Epilogue
Hindi Language.description: Personal longings haunt an author who must finish his book's epilogue, leading him down unexpected paths as fiction and truth collide.

Hindi Language.name: Amar Colony
Hindi Language.description: A crippled widow demands respect for her beloved pigeon. Caught in a maze of loneliness, a pregnant woman finds escape in a tomato. When paranoia strikes, a religious devotee of Lord Hanuman battles it with a mace.

Hindi Language.name: Kakori: Robbery
Hindi Language.description: A story of four mid 20s people named Robin, Neha, Monty and Aashiq Ali. They are roadside thieves in their own way, but things take a turn for the worse, when they plan to heist a train. Aashiq Ali's younger brother Imran also join them to help.This series revolves around India's biggest train heist which leads to a shocking end.

Hindi Language.name: Pratha
Hindi Language.description: A village's disturbing tradition deters young men from marriage, impacting lives. The powerful headman perpetuates it. The complex tale unfolds gradually, challenging rational thought.

Hindi Language.name: Ajooni
Hindi Language.description: Consumed by one-sided love, Rajveer is hell-bent on marrying Ajooni, a naive educated girl. Circumstances bring them together, but with an uncertain future..

Hindi Language.name: Pine Cone
Hindi Language.description: Semi-autobiographical film that narrates the story of an proud filmmaker Sid Mehra falling in love for the first time and over two decades becoming cynical about love and the changing landscape of queer rights in India in the year 1999.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq-e-nadaan
Hindi Language.description: Ashutosh's life changes when he meets Ramona at the hotel, which is his work place. On the other hand, Charulata grows friends with Subhash Kapoor, a filmmaker, and shares a secret with him. What is the secret?

Hindi Language.name: Ittu Si Baat
Hindi Language.description: In Chunar near Varanasi, aspiring cricketer Bittu falls for his childhood friend Sapna. He discovers her dreams and strives to make them reality in this innocent small-town romance.

Hindi Language.name: Jaggu Ki Lalten
Hindi Language.description: "Jaggu ki Lalten" is a comedy-drama musical film that explores the life of a scrap dealer cum businessman, Hari lal bhoot. A man with shrewd business tactics yet elated with generous and compassionate nature. This unique quality has gained him excellent fame in the vicinity. He's indeed astood businessman that takes complete pride in cherishing his morals and ethics more than anything else. This certainly sets him a class apart, in the fast-moving world of distrust and defamatory. Hari Lal's life is an open declaration of the fact that leading a life with generosity and compassion is certainly the best way to live. The film explores the life of a middle-class man who made his fortune creating successful deals as a scrap dealer. The sacrifices he made in his early age gave him the strength and will to fight and bring the difference in the lives of the people surrounding him. On one of his occasional business trips he had a coincidental encounter with Jaggu, a middle-class man deft with life's pain and suffering. Perplexed by his story, Hari Lal vows to help Jaggu bring his life back on track. It's interesting to see how Hari Lal's dedication made him strive across all odds and fulfill his commitment in giving Jaggu the life he deserves. Although it's a fictitious story, it very well highlights the quality of Humanhood, one that's hard to find in this fast-moving world of status and stature.

Hindi Language.name: Khoon Bhari Maang
Hindi Language.description: As Amit and Jacqueline's bond devolves into mutual greed and delusion, their manipulations and betrayals spark deadly violence, blurring the boundaries between right and wrong.

Hindi Language.name: Do Gubbare
Hindi Language.description: Rohit moves from the city of Indore to the metropolis of Pune where he becomes a paying guest at Ajobaas Place.

Hindi Language.name: Titu Ambani
Hindi Language.description: Titu.. His aspirations and dreams are far from his actions, he dreams with open eyes, and finds the shortest way to achieve his dreams. Despite despite his debt-ridden life, if you ask him, he is no less a dreamer than Ambani. Mosmi is the girl of today, living life on her own terms. She cannot compromise with her principles. Mosmi feels that Titu and she are made for each other but troubles arise when Titu's decisions endanger their love affair. This is a slice of life film, this simple love story of middle-class family conveys the big message of life in a very entertaining way.

Hindi Language.name: Hero of Nation Chandra Shekhar Azad
Hindi Language.description: Chandrashekhar Azad has been a leader in the freedom revolutionary movement of India, along with Bhagat Singh he created a revolutionary organization and gave a tough challenge to the British. After the capture of Bhagat Singh and due to some traitor revolutionaries, his organization got disintegrated and till his last breath, he continued to contribute to the freedom of the country. Azad's life was full of mysteries, very little information is available about his personal life through his fellow revolutionaries. The film Chandrashekhar Azad will introduce us to the noteworthy person from Azad's life like his mother and revolutionary Durga Bhabhi, Vishwanath, as well as the personalities of Azad's father Sitaram Tiwari and mother Jagrani Devi.

Hindi Language.name: Krish, Trish & Baltiboy Bharat Hain Hum
Hindi Language.description: The beloved trio of animals storytellers relates the stirring history of The Freedom Struggle of India through real-life tales of courage and sacrifice.

Hindi Language.name: Ab Dilli Dur Nahin
Hindi Language.description: Abhay Shukla, a boy from a small town in Bihar reaches Delhi in the desire of success. Abhay comes from a family that is struggling with difficulties. Abhay aims to appear in the IAS exam and achieve success.

Hindi Language.name: Non Stop Dhamaal
Hindi Language.description: Satinder, a film director, teams with friend Amar, a writer, to find financing for a new film. A businessman named Khattri, companion to Jassu Bhai, offers support for a special reason.

Hindi Language.name: Pinky Darling
Hindi Language.description: This story is about four friends who want to have a relationship with a prostitute, among them a friend starts seeing that prostitute through the eyes of his sister and then the boy tries to get that girl out of there.

Hindi Language.name: Constable Girpade
Hindi Language.description: Newbie Constable Mandaar Ghorpade, nicknamed GIRPADE, follows in his father's footsteps and joins the police force as a lowly constable presiding over a rich Mumbai neighborhood. Girpade's father, Senior Constable Amol Ghorpade, died on the job while chasing the notorious criminal PHENYL MOHAN, who prides himself on being a master of disguise. Between his desire to apprehend Phenyl, his candid mother seeking purpose, his first love, and his quirky relationship with his Sub Inspector boss, Girpade finds himself dealing with bizarre rich people problems - one hilarious case at a time.

Hindi Language.name: Dharm Yoddha Garud
Hindi Language.description: The untold saga of a great warrior - 'Dharm Yoddha Garud'

Hindi Language.name: Sherdil Shergill
Hindi Language.description: The show narrates the coming-of-age story of an unusual yet tenacious woman, Manmeet Shergill, who takes some unusual decisions that change her life forever. Despite being young, she is ambitious and wants to make a name for herself in the male-dominated field of architecture. Manmeet has a chance encounter with a carefree young man named Rajkumar Yadav that paves way for a beautiful love story.

Hindi Language.name: Who Am I
Hindi Language.description: Based on the critically acclaimed novel KO aham By AshokJamnani, The story is set in a small town based on the banks of the river Narmada. Bhavitavya, a philosophy student who is currently living as a tenant at Jyoti's house, is also his girlfriend Aditi's mother. Though the two love each other, their way of life has always differed. While Bhavitva is a curious fellow filled with philosophical questions, Aditi is a cheerful girl who finds joy in even the little things in life. The story takes a turn when Bhavitavya's favourite philosophy professor, Vibhu Laxmi Narayan passes away. The turbulent mind of Bhavitavya starts questioning the existential questions of life. The questions like "Who am I?" or "Ko Aham?" heighten and soon his interaction with an old monk on Narmada Ghat compelled him to embark on a journey of self-discovery Narmada parikrama in the hope to find the answers to his many questions.

Hindi Language.name: Chaalbaaz in London
Hindi Language.description: Chaalbaaz In London is a Bollywood comedy movie, directed by Pankaj Parashar. The cast of Chaalbaaz In London includes Shraddha Kapoor

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Pehla Naam: Radha Mohan
Hindi Language.description: Radha, a cheerful girl, is head over heels for Mohan, a cynical businessman, despite being aware of the fact that he has a daughter. However, she believes that she can turn him into a good man.

Hindi Language.name: Bravehearts
Hindi Language.description: Bravehearts is India's first Army anthology series dedicated to the humans behind the heroes in our Army. The series explores 5 unique stories of hope, courage, sacrifice, and pride for our nation.

Hindi Language.name: M A PASS (Sarkari Naukri)
Hindi Language.description: Divya, a MA PASS graduate, decides to leave her home to marry her boyfriend, Param. However, their life takes a turn when his family, motivated by greed, discovers that she is unemployed and involved in a love affair.

Hindi Language.name: The Conversion
Hindi Language.description: A Movie that explores the sensitive topic of religious conversion, this movie is a captivating drama depicting girl's dilemma of what happens in an inter-faith marriage that results in religious conversion.

Hindi Language.name: Farmhouse
Hindi Language.description: In this ZEE5 original film, a father and son duo enter a farmhouse with ulterior motives. However, they soon learn of a bigger plot brewing within the farmhouse orchestrated by their rich masters.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Jaisa Yaar Kaha
Hindi Language.description: Bungled heist lands a thief in jail. He tasks cellmate to retrieve home codes for stolen diamonds. A tangled web of mishaps, motives and betrayals unfolds as all covet the diamonds.

Hindi Language.name: Shadow Assassins
Hindi Language.description: Nirbhay Kalita, a young ambitious boy who got sucked into vengeance after his dear ones are assassinated.

Hindi Language.name: Prem Game
Hindi Language.description: There is one married couple, the husband is in a relationship with another beautiful lady, he is not care about his wife, she felt he does not love her anymore, so she is trying to know what the problem is?

Hindi Language.name: The Clown
Hindi Language.description: 13 yr old girl Anna finds a doll of a clown in a park and starts behaving very strangely with everybody. In the same town there are mysterious murders happening and strangely, all murder victims have clown makeup on their faces.

Hindi Language.name: Operation Fryday
Hindi Language.description: A Muslim unwittingly gets involved in a terrorist bombing in Mumbai and decides to avenge the act.

Hindi Language.name: Holy Cow
Hindi Language.description: It tells the story of how Salim's cow, Ruksar, goes missing and he starts searching for it at night.

Hindi Language.name: Badmaash Babes
Hindi Language.description: When the stripper from Alisha's bachelor party is found dead the next morning, the high society lives of best friends Alisha, Maya and Zee go through a roller coaster ride.

Hindi Language.name: Teri Khata
Hindi Language.description: A story of a husband cheating his wife, capturing her property and killing her father. The wife then hires a killer to carry out the killing and manage the situation.

Hindi Language.name: One Friday Night
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around one stormy night, in an isolated villa a top a secluded hill.

Hindi Language.name: Ferrous
Hindi Language.description: A hitman, disguised as a cab driver, gets an assignment to dispose off a body. In between the task, he is robbed by a couple on the run. While the girl is in love, the boy has other plans.

Hindi Language.name: Love-All
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of a father, a son, and a sport connecting their destinies. Talent lifts a man towards fame yet destiny had other ideas and challenges to chase passion against all odds.

Hindi Language.name: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
Hindi Language.description: There is a boy named 'Rahul' He planed a drama with his father for Enjoy a own fantasy life but Rahul girlfriend's wants something else for own family. So guys if you want to know what she wants then watch this series for know everything.

Hindi Language.name: Laachi
Hindi Language.description: Shunned for his appearance, a village man's life changes when the enchanting Laachi enters his world, challenging social prejudices and matters of the heart.

Hindi Language.name: Kabhi Kabhie Ittefaq Sey
Hindi Language.description: Gungun lives with her father and Aunt Only , so she does not know the joy of living in a big family like Anubhav. They have somewhat opposite personalities but still fate wants them to complete the love they are lacking in their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Rangili Ragini
Hindi Language.description: Two young friends take interest in a neighborhood woman. Peering through her window, they see her sleeping and bathing. She seems dissatisfied with her spouse, as evidenced by the couple's regular fights.

Hindi Language.name: Woh Toh Hai Albela
Hindi Language.description: Krishna, a fun-loving man, always has his two brothers back, especially the elder one, Cheeru, who leaves no stone unturned to keep him safe. Circumstances make him get married to Cheeru's lover.

Hindi Language.name: Sapna Tiffin Center
Hindi Language.description: A middle-class wife starts a tiffin service to help with expenses. Her beauty attracts customers, leading her into temptation and compromising choices that strain her marriage.

Hindi Language.name: UnWoman
Hindi Language.description: Bhanwar, a simple man, is burdened by the overpowering shadow of his dominant uncle Bhairo who makes decisions on Bhanwar's behalf. To improve their living conditions, his uncle coaxes him to buy a bride.

Hindi Language.name: Haiwaan
Hindi Language.description: Psychotic killer targets family in remote village bungalow. Brutal killings ensue. A lone survivor remains, but the killer's identity is unknown.

Hindi Language.name: Takeshi's Castle
Hindi Language.description: Bhuvan Bam lends his distinctive voice and unique humor as commentator in the brand-new season of Takeshi's Castle. Classic games are making a comeback with new and terrifying obstacles emerging one after another.

Hindi Language.name: Doors
Hindi Language.description: A strange encounter with his lover leads a man on a mind bending journey.

Hindi Language.name: Good Bad Girl
Hindi Language.description: This is the tale of a middle-class girl turned accomplished lawyer, Maya Ahuja, who finds inventive ways to escape sticky situations. She cleverly pulls off a big deception to make things work her way.

Hindi Language.name: Jugaadistan
Hindi Language.description: A college life drama focusing on the gritty side of campus life, Politics, Love and Emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Ki Dastaan - Naagmani
Hindi Language.description: A shapeshifting serpent couple takes rebirth in order to complete their love story, unaware of a threat that has followed them.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Diyaan Gallaan
Hindi Language.description: Generation and communication gaps lead to a rift between a couple and their children. It is now up to the grandchildren to ensure that the members express what's in their hearts and the family doesn't break apart.

Hindi Language.name: Bahu Ki Aashiqui
Hindi Language.description: Bahu Ki Aashiqui is a high note family drama which shows how the crave for lust overpowers your senses and destroys everything. Superstar Jeet Kapoor gets into a physical relationship with his daughter-in-law Sahira which becomes his life's worst mistake. Also the game changes when Sahira's dark past encounters her in the most unexpected way.

Hindi Language.name: Final Draft
Hindi Language.description: The web series is about Aditya and Vani. Two young writers, met by destiny who eventually fell in love with each other in an old-school romantic manner.

Hindi Language.name: Kaun Banegi Shikharwati
Hindi Language.description: A former king, who has a dysfunctional family, devises an outlandish plan to unite his estranged daughters. Meanwhile, an income tax investigation looms over the palace's hidden treasure.

Hindi Language.name: Majbooriyan
Hindi Language.description: When Sonali's 'wild past' resurfaces in the form of raunchy videos and photographs, her happy family life runs the risk of complete devastation. Will this blackmail seal her fate?

Hindi Language.name: Wajah
Hindi Language.description: A young girl named Gauri goes missing after entering the orbit of the powerful Mehra family and fashion house. The search for her ensnares the Mehras and their associates as secrets emerge

Hindi Language.name: Chidiakhana
Hindi Language.description: It is a coming-of-age story of a Bihari boy who is embraced by residents of a Marathi Chawl due to his grit, imagination and especially his footballing skills.

Hindi Language.name: NRI Wives
Hindi Language.description: Four real life-inspired stories dive into the taboo side of human relationships, emotions, desires, curiosity and how people show their "grey shades" in life's unusual circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Mithyabhaas
Hindi Language.description: Akshat and Mayra are good friends. Though Akshat is deeply in love with Mayra , she never exhibits the same for him. Akshat believes taking Mayra on a vacation to his friend's native place shall help him better their relationship. Mayra knows that Akshat is her support system and she likes his company. But Mayra encounters something horrifying at this new place. Though after some investigation she continues to have more terrifying experiences. Mayra wants to solve this mystery and thus talks to Akshat. But things don't go as expected. Mithyabhaas talks about their relationship, love, complexities, suspicion, their life amid chaos.

Hindi Language.name: Harphool Mohini
Hindi Language.description: Love story between a Haryanvi guy and a South-Indian girl and show cultural differences as the sparks that will fly when the two opposite cultures meet.

Hindi Language.name: Murder
Hindi Language.description: Neha's journey took an unexpected turn when she embarked on a short stay at her elder sister's abode. Little did she know that fate had woven a complex tale of emotions that would entwine her heart with forbidden desires. Amidst the familiar walls of her sister's home, Neha found herself entangled in an affair that transcended the boundaries of reason. Love's allure led her astray, weaving a web of connections with both her brother-in-law and his younger sibling. But as the saying goes, love's fervor can birth a tempest of consequences, a truth Neha was soon to confront.

Hindi Language.name: Rosh
Hindi Language.description: Rajat Ronika and Alina hits a delivery boy on road and he dies on the spot. After some time door bell rings and an injured delivery boy enters in house stating he is late because someone hit him on road by a car and thrill starts.

Hindi Language.name: Shanaya: An Unsolved Mystery
Hindi Language.description: Shanaya is found dead while on holiday with her elder sister Pragya, her husband and a few friends. The police investigates her death and unravels motives of lust, lies, revenge and deceit making everyone a suspect, but who is the killer?

Hindi Language.name: Country Mafia
Hindi Language.description: Two siblings have a dream of becoming IAS officers. But life has other plans. Watch their tale of revenge as they confront Babban, the biggest liquor baron of Bihar, for murdering their father.

Hindi Language.name: Bindiya
Hindi Language.description: A dysfunctional gangster family's members from Bihar vie for leadership amid betrayals and power struggles, featuring dark humor and focusing on internal conflicts rather than external enemies.

Hindi Language.name: Banni Chow Home Delivery
Hindi Language.description: Banni, an independent and brave woman who runs a food delivery business, crosses paths with Yuvan, an oppressed young man with special needs, and their lives change.

Hindi Language.name: Khidki
Hindi Language.description: Ambika comes across a house, she happens to hear weird noises from the window. It is Chhavi who is screaming out of the window crying for help. Will she be able to rescue Chhavi and escape from the place is a big question.

Hindi Language.name: Anamika
Hindi Language.description: Chase of an intelligent agent..., Sunny(Anamika) who forgot her own past, and no one knows the ultimate truth about her. Will Anamika be able to save herself from these powerful forces? It's time for Anamika to fight her past and solve it.

Hindi Language.name: Aye Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: The journey of a 28-year-old liver cirrhosis patient Vinay Chawla who bond with a hospital grief counsellor Revathi, rekindles his hope and faith in life and makes him believe in the power of humanity.

Hindi Language.name: Maarrich
Hindi Language.description: A police official starts a wild goose chase to find a murderer. The journey unfolds deep dark secrets from the past which leads to a spine chilling face off in the finale

Hindi Language.name: Faltu
Hindi Language.description: Amid the arid landscape of Rajasthan, a dreamy-eyed young woman battles to prove her mettle whilst navigating through cultural stereotypes.

Hindi Language.name: Dhai Aakhar
Hindi Language.description: Dhai Aakhar is a story of a woman who rebuilds herself after years of being in an abusive marriage when she starts talking to an empathetic writer through letters. The film brings out the conflict surrounding such relationships.

Hindi Language.name: Iftikhar
Hindi Language.description: Based on the life of real life hero Major Mohit Sharma who eliminates terrorists during a counter insurgency operation in Kupwara. He sacrificed his life and was awarded the Ashoka Chakra for gallantry.

Hindi Language.name: Baatein Kuch Ankahee Si
Hindi Language.description: In the heady world of music, Vandana wishes to resurrect her father's legacy. But for Kunal, music equals business.

Hindi Language.name: Kadaknath
Hindi Language.description: A father's matrimonial plans collide with his brother-in-law's poultry sale when mixed-up schedules cause them to mistake common buyers for nobility and vice versa.

Hindi Language.name: Ishqyapa
Hindi Language.description: Cupid arranges for Vikram from Punjab and Puii from Mizoram to fall in love. Despite differences, the couple must fight for their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Atithi Bhooto Bhava
Hindi Language.description: Srikant's life turns upside down when he bumps into a middle-aged ghost who claims to be his grandson from his previous birth. Things take an even more comical turn when the ghost seeks Srikant's help to meet his long-lost love.

Hindi Language.name: Khalli Balli
Hindi Language.description: A model and wannabe Bollywood actress, Sanjana, experiences bizarre supernatural events that make her boyfriend, Rohit, mistrust her. To get things back on track, they go to Lucknow on holiday, where things turn more dangerous.

Hindi Language.name: BhootMate
Hindi Language.description: Step into the hilarious yet spine-chilling world of 'Bhoot Mate'. Prepare to be scared and amused in equal measure as we unveil a unique blend of comedy, horror, and thrills.

Hindi Language.name: Junooniyatt
Hindi Language.description: Set in Punjab, Junooniyatt captures the journey of three aspiring singers, who navigate through the ups and downs of their lives.

Hindi Language.name: Chakki
Hindi Language.description: An extremely inflated electricity bill leads a small town flour mill owner to the darkest corners of the government office infested with corruption, inefficient officials and apathy of the worst kind.

Hindi Language.name: The Face of the Faceless
Hindi Language.description: Based on Sr. Rani Maria, this tale depicts the trials and tribulations of a woman who rose above the boundaries of her religion, realized the universal oneness, and committed her life to women's empowerment.

Hindi Language.name: The Joker: A Strange Kidnapper
Hindi Language.description: A story about a kidnapper who calls himself Joker. He kidnapped Pratap's son and starts giving him different tasks.

Hindi Language.name: Jadui Ittar
Hindi Language.description: Mamta and Chetan buy a house to start a happy life together. However, things take an unexpected turn that is beyond their expectations. What was a simple perfume for another woman turns into trouble for Mamta.

Hindi Language.name: The Y
Hindi Language.description: The Female Protagonist is a Mute. After her marriage the couple enters a new chapter of their life but face another dilemma which they least expect. They experience paranormal incidents and their daily life turns into a mysterious tale.

Hindi Language.name: Bohot Pyaar Karte Hai
Hindi Language.description: Indu is thrust into the spotlight after she locks horns with a Bollywood star Ritesh. Chaos ensues when fate forces the duo into a marriage of convenience..

Hindi Language.name: Channa Mereya
Hindi Language.description: Adityaraj Singh, an NRI aspires to be a sought-after hotelier but is weighed down by his family. Things take an interesting turn when he meets Ginni Garewal, a countryside chef..

Hindi Language.name: Once Upon Two Times
Hindi Language.description: On a family trip gone wrong, betrothed sweethearts Ahaan and Ruhi find out that their parents were once embittered lovers and attempt to mend their past, only to confront the problems of their own present.

Hindi Language.name: Rabb Se Hai Dua
Hindi Language.description: Dua and her husband are a perfect married couple in the eyes of their family. However, Dua's life turns upside down when her husband seeks her permission to marry another woman.

Hindi Language.name: Udan Patolas
Hindi Language.description: 4 small town girls try to hilariously fit in the big city. They maybe unlucky in love but their sisterhood is unbreakable.

Hindi Language.name: Kavya - Ek Jazbaa, Ek Junoon
Hindi Language.description: This TV show is a compelling narrative that follows the life of Kavya, an IAS officer who, being a woman, faces challenges of balancing work and personal life while showcasing the huge responsibility of handling the country's affairs.

Hindi Language.name: Main Hoon Aparajita
Hindi Language.description: Deserted by her man and left alone to fend for her daughters, Aparajita rises to meet every challenge so that her family can stand tall.

Hindi Language.name: Love Buddy
Hindi Language.description: Kanika tells her husband Kunal that she is in love with her school friend, Nirvana and wants to marry him. She's jolted when Kunal agrees but Nirvana refuses her proposal.

Hindi Language.name: Sanaa
Hindi Language.description: It follows an ambitious girl who is raging against an internal battle that is rooted in unhealed trauma.

Hindi Language.name: Virodh
Hindi Language.description: In the treacherous world of illegal sand mining, family politics, and crime, a perilous chain of events is unleashed. As the story unfolds, the hidden truths and layers of the criminal world surface, revealing a web of deceit and danger.

Hindi Language.name: Match Of Life
