Hindi Language.description: Match of Life" is based on a cricketer's life who looks like Virat Kohli and what circumstances he faces in day-to-day life being a normal person with a celebrity face.

Hindi Language.name: Ardh
Hindi Language.description: Shiva struggles to become a mainstream actor in Mumbai despite being a theatre actor. With the help of his wife Madhu, he disguises himself as a transgender and begs for money to survive.

Hindi Language.name: Muskuraane Ki Wajah Tum Ho
Hindi Language.description: Katha, who sets on a journey to answer an important question: Is a child required to always take on his father's surname? Or can a mother's name be enough? Join Katha in her quest to find happiness while navigating through life.

Hindi Language.name: Chalawa
Hindi Language.description: Chalawa is a series of a married couple Samar and Shilpa who plan to visit their village to spend time with their family. They soon experience some unnatural things happening around them and they are connected to Samar's his past.

Hindi Language.name: Walk
Hindi Language.description: When the nation is shut down by a devastating Pandemic, one man must deliver his dead friend's son back to his mother, across 1000 miles of unforgiving lockdown territory.

Hindi Language.name: Dadugiri
Hindi Language.description: The chronicles of a grandfather, his grandson and their misadventures.

Hindi Language.name: Cinema Marte Dum Tak
Hindi Language.description: J Neelam, Vinod Talwar, Dilip Gulati and Kishan Shah directors of the golden age of 'B-movies' take you for a behind-the-scenes look at the making of their films.

Hindi Language.name: Antaryatri Mahapurush (The Walking God)
Hindi Language.description: The film "Antaryatri Mahapurush (The Walking God)" is the life journey of Digambar Sant Acharya Vidya Sagar Ji Maharaj,.The film covers the story of his childhood till attaining the position of Acharya, his education, his sports, his love for siblings. His devotion towards his parents, the ups and downs in his life and his devotion towards religion will be seen in this film.

Hindi Language.name: Pagalpan Next Level
Hindi Language.description: Pagalpan Next Level is the biopic of fitness expert Guru Mann, starring himself. Guru Mann was a man on a mission to transform the fitness landscape of India with his 'Mission India Fit' campaign. From being a spirited trouble-maker in Amritsar to becoming a global fitness icon. The film underlines his journey from Yamaha to Lamborghini.

Hindi Language.name: Murder in Agonda
Hindi Language.description: Sub Inspector Sanket Salelkar investigates his first murder case involving Mala Coutinho, found dead in her 200-year-old Portuguese villa. Seeming straightforward, his sister Sarla brings unexpected news.

Hindi Language.name: Gauraiya
Hindi Language.description: This offbeat film Gauraiya is based on true incidents with imaginary story portrait of north India situated desert area of Patha. Which is a place of downtrodden and poor people who are victimized by bandits and other criminals. The reason behind is only unemployment and illiteracy A sensitive girl Shefali who comes from a small city,is doing PhD in Criminology. She has thought of writing a book entitled END OF CRIME because she is worried about crime and its victims

Hindi Language.name: Lohardaga
Hindi Language.description: A twenty year old boy Manu, who dreams of joining the Indian Army, ends up joining Maoists because of a dubious job agent, who manipulates Manu that the government is awarding jobs to the Maoists who surrender.

Hindi Language.name: Azamgarh
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around Aamir who gets trapped in the terrorising world of Islamic fundamentalists.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Dia
Hindi Language.description: The movie Dear Dia is a Hindi remake of the super-hit Kannada film "Dia". The movie revolves around a love story between Mihika Kushwaha, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Ujjwal Sharma who are playing the lead actors. The film is directed by KS Ashoka, produced by Kamlesh Singh Kushwaha and will be released under the Netrix Entertainment Pvt Ltd banner. This musical youthful love story is driven through the music of Jubin Nautiyal, Shankar Mahadevan, Palak Muchhal and Jyotica Tangri.

Hindi Language.name: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
Hindi Language.description: A poignant father- son story set in Ujjain. Inspired by true life, it deals with the sensitivity of unemployment, the selfless love of a father, and the behaviour of a selfish son, with quirk and humour.

Hindi Language.name: Shadyantra
Hindi Language.description: It's a story about greed, ambition, self-preservation, and revenge, and it stars Chandan Roy Sanyal and Kunaal Roy Kapur in key roles.

Hindi Language.name: Exit
Hindi Language.description: Ravi, a failed Cricketer uses his Cricket expertise for betting on Cricket Matches. He loses a bet and has to pay a huge amount to a betting goon. Ravi plans to fake his death for the Insurance Money and EXIT his old life. His wife, Shailey is blackmailed by a mysterious Man who claims to know about their Insurance Scam. That's when Ravi decides to bring on his "A" game.

Hindi Language.name: Nasha Chaahat Ka
Hindi Language.description: For some people nothing matters in life in front of their ambition and greed and they can go to any extent to achieve that.

Hindi Language.name: Wah Bhai Wah
Hindi Language.description: Shailesh Lodha invites three poets in every episode, who recite hindi poems of various genres.

Hindi Language.name: Kooki
Hindi Language.description: A 16-year-old girl Kooki's beautiful present life and dreamy future are destroyed by a gang rape, and after the incident, the court's verdict against the culprits makes her feel betrayed and not served justice as a victim.

Hindi Language.name: Chanda Aur Chandni
Hindi Language.description: This is story of Chanda and Chandini, two cousin sisters who are desperate for love and romance. They always find innovative ways with their male partners to have highest level of pleasure and charamsukh.

Hindi Language.name: Prayag
Hindi Language.description: In the hustle-bustle of Lucknow, a young, seven-month pregnant poetess is killed in broad daylight in her own apartment, by a powerful state politician who is involved in an illicit affair with her. When the state and system fail to provide justice, her college friend who becomes a big name in the college political circle rises to the occasion to avenge her death, by killing,

Hindi Language.name: PlanB
Hindi Language.description: The story of two sisters, of which one sister plans to murder her sister for her dad's property.

Hindi Language.name: The Purvanchal Files
Hindi Language.description: A cop story of revenge and how he tries to purify the police system in Purvanchal .

Hindi Language.name: InCar
Hindi Language.description: A kidnapped girl's terrifying journey of survival.

Hindi Language.name: Durga Aur Charu
Hindi Language.description: Two sisters get separated in their childhood when their parents pass away and develop into distinct personalities, living in different classes of society.

Hindi Language.name: Jaanbaaz Hindustan Ke
Hindi Language.description: A single mother and celebrated IPS officer, Kavya Iyer's bravery and psychological strength are tested when she becomes the lead investigator in an ISIS-K bomb attack case.

Hindi Language.name: Savdhaan India: Criminal Decoded
Hindi Language.description: Delving into the warped minds of killers and criminals, the series aims to study and expose the criminals and why they commit crimes

Hindi Language.name: Privacy
Hindi Language.description: Roopali works at the Mumbai surveillance command and control center as an operator. Things start to get complicated when she ignores protocol and begins to investigate a robbery and murder that takes place on her watch.

Hindi Language.name: Fireflies: Parth Aur Jugnu
Hindi Language.description: A 14-year-old boy named Parth, who meets Jugnu, a mystical kid from the haunted forest of Bheem Mukteshwar.

Hindi Language.name: La Vaste
Hindi Language.description: A man who has done B.Tech, gets the job of lifting unclaimed dead bodies in the name of job.A unique tale depicting the untold tragedy of unclaimed dead bodies in our society.

Hindi Language.name: Entertainment Ki Raat Housefull
Hindi Language.description: Entertainment Ki Raat: Housefull takes celebrity guests on a wild ride. In this show, two brothers, played by Punit J. Pathak and Haarsh Limbachiyaa are assigned a task by their grandmother. Their challenge involves giving the guests a hard time with games, pranks and punishments. Popular actors like Sumbul Touqeer, Fahmaan Khan, Arjun Bijlani, Shiv Thakare, Archana Gautam, Rashmi Desai among others participated in the show. With its unique format that combines fiction and non-fiction, the show offers an array of components. From musical games to dance-offs to antakshari, the show has a lot to offer. The cook-offs brings in some delicious moments, while the hidden camera pranks on celebrities are part of this show as well. And if that's not enough, the funny tete-a-tete ensured that the audience stays engaged throughout.

Hindi Language.name: Kora Kagazz
Hindi Language.description: Kora Kagazz (Tabula Rasa) is the story of three lost souls who find a home away from home. Divya, a juvenile home warden, and Vivek, an actor struggling to create art, meet Sandhya, a 14-year old girl with a mysterious dark past. Together they rise above the hardship, grief, trauma, and complexities of family bonds.

Hindi Language.name: Lakeerein
Hindi Language.description: A courtroom drama based on the theme of marital rape, where a married woman is seeking justice against her husband, it often remains underreported and stigmatized due to societal misconceptions about consent within marriage

Hindi Language.name: Sab Satrangi
Hindi Language.description: Mannu idealistic approach puts him in tricky situations. A ruthless world that tries to bring him down. Mannu still chooses to see the silver lining in and keep a positive attitude towards life.

Hindi Language.name: Parvatinagar
Hindi Language.description: Police arrest former lover 'Arvind' of a prostitute 'Shweta' for her murder . The police are suspicious of Arvind but have no evidence to support it. After getting beaten up by the police, Arvind reveals shocking details about her friend 'Mahesh' and Shweta's husband 'Sandesh' which leads the police down a rabbit hole and a carefully constructed dead ends by someone too diabolical for the justice system. The movie delves deep into layers of deception and shows how people are not always what they seem. The atrocious mystery behind Shweta's murder and its connection with Arwind is divulged in the latter half of the movie.

Hindi Language.name: Karma Strikes
Hindi Language.description: Every Love Story faces its Karma; so did theirs.

Hindi Language.name: Damaged 3
Hindi Language.description: A story of 2 strikingly different personalities who admire each other's persona and develop friendship but it turns against them when the friendship is taken for granted.

Hindi Language.name: Purnima
Hindi Language.description: Purnima is a Dangal TV new serial. In this TV show Sudesh Berry, Chhavi Pandey and Siddharth Shivpuri played lead role . Purnima was released on 21 August 2023. The producers of the show are Dhawal Gada and Gurudev Bhalla who have also produced serials like "Na Aana Is Des Laado". Sudesh Berry is playing role of Garjan Singh father of Siddharth Shivpuri and father in law of Chhavi Pandey.

Hindi Language.name: Love in Goa
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around the a couple of beautiful girl who visited the Goa and her her friendship turn into the relationship(lesbian). After spending some time together their family members know the truth of the relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Bikroo Kanpur Gangster
Hindi Language.description: Bikroo Kanpur Gangster movie is a real story based on kanpur Gangster Vikas Dubey. It is shot on the real location of kanpur & other places in uttar pradesh. It shows the hidden truth behind the system.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ka Pehla Adhyaya Shiv Shakti
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around Shiv, a successful doctor with a crumbling personal life. Shakti, an orphan, has a nurturing nature. Will Shakti heal Shiv's broken self?

Hindi Language.name: Kyunki... Saas Maa Bahu Beti Hoti Hai
Hindi Language.description: Ambika challenges tradition as Hetal seeks separation from the Rajgaur family. She vows to raise Kesar as her own, aiming to demonstrate that daughters-in-law can be like daughters.

Hindi Language.name: I Am Unused
Hindi Language.description: Young woman contracts HIV after being betrayed, embarking on a vengeful quest against those responsible, determined to make them suffer the same fate.

Hindi Language.name: Deceptive Diva
Hindi Language.description: A head-strong girl, raised by a lady-don, aspires to make it big in the world of glamour; only to discover secrets about her gruesome past.

Hindi Language.name: Jagannath Aur Purvi Ki Dosti Anokhi
Hindi Language.description: Jagannath Mishra, an elderly gentleman, saves a young woman from drowning and takes her home. Soon, they become good friends as he finds his lost sense of life's purpose.

Hindi Language.name: Trahimam
Hindi Language.description: Champa is a labourer in Dholpur village, where her employers and policemen gangrape her. As the culprits are directly related to the local MLA, they go scot free until a brave female SP steps in to bring the rape survivor justice.

Hindi Language.name: Mithai
Hindi Language.description: Mithai, a gifted sweet maker, is on a quest to establish her professional identity. What happens when Mithai's world collides with Siddharth, a software engineer and heir to a traditional sweet making business.

Hindi Language.name: Machaand
Hindi Language.description: A STRANGE MEN PUT A GIRLS BODY IN A DRUM AND BURN THE BODY INTO ASHSES -STORY GOES IN FLASH BACK. RAAJ, WHO LIVES IN NEXT DOOR HOUSE KEEPS HIS EYES ON SAHIL'S SISTER. Will Sahil be able to save her family from this man Raaj.

Hindi Language.name: Kos
Hindi Language.description: 48 Kos Kurukshetra bhoomi is located between the two rivers Saraswati and Drishadvati. This 48 Kos bhoomi is guarded by four gatekeepers who keep this 48 Kos bhoomi safe from evil. Can they protect it forever?

Hindi Language.name: Moha
Hindi Language.description: The deliberately slender storyline involves a spiritual male hermit, a female nymph who tempts him into secular ways of the flesh, and a rival lover.

Hindi Language.name: Golgappe
Hindi Language.description: Two women, one who is dissatisfied with her husband. the other one who only gets cheated in the name of marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Dil Maange More
Hindi Language.description: Yeh Dil Mannge More is an Indian Hindi-language romance drama television series produced by Ekta Kapoor and Shobha Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms. The series stars Akshay Mhatre and Twinkle Patel as protagonists. The series revolves around an Army officer and a doctor. The series explores how tied under their profession they fight each other, ultimately falling in love.

Hindi Language.name: SSC
Hindi Language.description: Shiv Shankar Chaudhary navigates the high-stakes world of the SSC exam, first as a student driven by his father's expectations, and then as an insider in the business that thrives on the hopes of millions.

Hindi Language.name: Nehlee Par Dehla
Hindi Language.description: A group of two males and two females who are trying to overcome each other with sweet and sour tactics for their own benefits and revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Rahasya
Hindi Language.description: Rahasya is a Hindi-language web series starring Shilpa Shinde and Kaushal Agnihotri in prominent roles. It is a horror web series directed by Anil Kona Devsoth. This web series is produced by Agnihotri Production and Entertainments.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Ishq
Hindi Language.description: Famous author Abhimanyu gets swept up in a cutthroat challenge with Asmita, for whom life is beyond paperback fiction. In the face of rivalry, will love bloom?

Hindi Language.name: Jai Bharati
Hindi Language.description: Jai, a young guy torn between his father's pride of military tradition and his own desire to become an actor, gets entangled with Bharti. Now, during societal pressure, Jai and Bharti must confront their own desires and the town's gossip.

Hindi Language.name: Unsafe
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a sex worker and a news reporter who get entangled in helping each other in such a way that their whole world gets shaken. See how they got out of the political trap and how they settles themselves.

Hindi Language.name: Chill Bro
Hindi Language.description: After a brother gets accidentally killed by her sister, the emotionally broken down sister keeps moving between past and present, recalling the good old memories and attending the unannounced visitors, until the police arrives.

Hindi Language.name: Country of Blind
Hindi Language.description: After falling 1,000 feet from a cliff, a mountaineer winds up in a strange valley that's inhabited by blind people.

Hindi Language.name: Stardom
Hindi Language.description: Showcases the widely discussed struggles and behind-the-scenes moments of the Indian film industry.

Hindi Language.name: X or Y
Hindi Language.description: Is it a boy,is it a girl?Story of an ordinary Indian family discovering what's always known but never understood

Hindi Language.name: A Place of Our Own
Hindi Language.description: Laila and Roshni are looking for a house after they are evicted from the place they rented. It soon becomes evident that their search for a home is also their ongoing search for a place in this society.

Hindi Language.name: Nukkad
Hindi Language.description: Desires, dreams, and destiny form eddies in the quiet flow of life in a sleepy little town, weaving together the lives of some local folk in a tangled tale with beautiful imagery, delicate nuances, and sensitive portrayal.

Hindi Language.name: Pehla Chakravyuh - Chalava
Hindi Language.description: A mysterious serial killer is being transferred from one prison to another; Ashish Dutta, a new police officer, is assigned to lead the journey, which leads to shocking events, deaths, and unimaginable crimes."

Hindi Language.name: Dhoop chhaon
Hindi Language.description: Dhoop Chhaon is a saga of two brothers who love each other and the difficulties faced by them while figuring out how to get their respective families under one roof.Dhoop Chhaon tag line is Where Life Begins and Love Never Ends

Hindi Language.name: Slum Golf
Hindi Language.description: The journey of one young boy from the Mumbai slums to the annals of golfing glory.

Hindi Language.name: Swaraj: Bharat ke Swatantrata Sangram Ki Samagra Gatha
Hindi Language.description: Historical drama spanning 450 years, portraying unsung heroes' sacrifices in India's freedom struggle against colonizing forces, exploring national themes of self-governance, culture, and identity through their stories over 75 episodes.

Hindi Language.name: Zende
Hindi Language.description: Zende follows the 82-year-old retired assistant commissioner of police in Mumbai, Madhukar Zende. The man who nabbed the infamous serial killer, Charles Sobhraj - twice.

Hindi Language.name: Daayre
Hindi Language.description: A tale of sisterly love between Dimple and Pari where they both are willing to go to great lengths for each other in their own way; not realizing that their fates are intertwined and that some lines should never be crossed

Hindi Language.name: Bachcha Aur Shaitan Horror Movie
Hindi Language.description: Pooja and Rahul join their ten year old son Bunny in a boarding school Bunny is kicked out of the school for his weird behaviour A deeply upset Pooja takes him to a psychiatrist for treatment the doctor suggests a unique therapy

Hindi Language.name: Bed Stories
Hindi Language.description: For years, a hotel room has witnessed different stories, from pleasant to horrific ones. Now, its worn-out bed narrates these tales interwoven with emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Hajamat
Hindi Language.description: Parimal's salon faces threats due to a loan. Dabbu, the star stylist, and Cutting Kumar devise ways like viral videos and Saloni's beauty products to repay it. Dabbu's love for Saloni complicates matters as they strive to save the salon.

Hindi Language.name: Minus 31: The Nagpur Files
Hindi Language.description: While investigating an important murder amidst the second wave of the pandemic, an impulsive cop uncovers the dark realities of the system and reconciles with her true self.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Hai Toh Hai
Hindi Language.description: What happens when a stranger enters the lives of two childhood friends who fall in love with each other?

Hindi Language.name: Saroj Ka Rishta
Hindi Language.description: A Carefree and Confident Girl (Sanah Kapur) of her area who finds Love in Vikram(Randeep Rai).

Hindi Language.name: Nautanki
Hindi Language.description: Joshi's parents expect him to move back to his hometown once he graduates high-school. This leaves him little time to fix things with his best-friend Priti.

Hindi Language.name: Love You Loktantra
Hindi Language.description: Political satire narrated in a tongue-in-cheek manner, commenting on current Indian politics with a touch of humor.

Hindi Language.name: Totka
Hindi Language.description: This is exciting story of a Dhongi baba in village who uses his powers to get attract and get closer with all ladies. There's another lady who have spent her childhood in this village comes after a long time and she recollects about the baba that how he has ruined her whole family life and now she wants to take revenge from baba.

Hindi Language.name: Good Night India
Hindi Language.description: Good Night India is an Indian comedy show made especially for the audience to release stress at the end of the day. The show is designed to make people laugh out loud with the hilarious jokes performed by their favorite stand-up comedians. It is a late-night family show where Amit Tandon and Jiya Shankar invite various stand-up artists to perform laughter sets for the audience.

Hindi Language.name: Palkon Ki Chhaon Mein 2
Hindi Language.description: A heart- warming tale of an orphan girl Suman, whose dreams of finding family love come true when she is accepted by a very lovable and traditional joint family.

Hindi Language.name: Gaalib
Hindi Language.description: 'Gaalib' will shed light on Afzal Guru's son Gaalib Guru . Afzal Guru was convicted for his role in the 2001 Indian Parliament attack and sentenced to death. It was upheld by the Supreme Court and he was hanged to death on Feb 9, 2013.

Hindi Language.name: Naar Ka Sur
Hindi Language.description: A story of 12 women who fights for their rights and dignity but to achieve the same they has to face many obstacles and evil forces who tries to stop them and threaten them.

Hindi Language.name: IRL: In Real Love
Hindi Language.description: Four singles seeking love navigate its ups and downs through real and online connections but will they choose virtual romance, or go offline?

Hindi Language.name: Swaran Ghar
Hindi Language.description: Kanwaljeet and Swaran live the perfect life, have the perfect house and are a perfect couple. However, what will happen when their perfect life gets marred by their children?

Hindi Language.name: Birthday Gift
Hindi Language.description: The present throws a web of questions and mysteries that can only be untangled by visiting the past, which has a deep, dark secret in store. The story follows a man, Abhimanyu, who is roped into a web of dark, mysterious secrets from the past, and now he has to deal with them to ensure his present and the future are certain and safe. The story of a day, which starts with a birthday celebration, ends in a night of fury and vengeance.

Hindi Language.name: Coat
Hindi Language.description: Madho and his father are pig farmers, of a low caste are not respected by the other villagers. One day he sees a foreigner being respected and because of his expensive coat. Determined Madho tries to acquire a coat that he cannot afford.

Hindi Language.name: Modi Ji Ki Beti
Hindi Language.description: When two stupid terrorist, trying to prove their capability, believing on the fake news of a presence of Prime Minister daughter, kidnaps her, they are faced with a series of comical challenges to send her back to the country.

Hindi Language.name: Sapnon Ki Chhalaang
Hindi Language.description: Radhika, a small-town girl, moves to Mumbai to chase her dreams. However, the culture gap and professional challenges may prove to be more than she bargained for.

Hindi Language.name: Marriage.com
Hindi Language.description: Film Marriage.com is scheduled to release on 3rd November 2023. This is an Action, Romantic Thriller full entertainment film. The story of the film revolves around a family.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Rahe Na Rahe Hum
Hindi Language.description: Free-spirited Surilii lives a modest life while Shivendra is brought up in the strict traditions of Ranakgarh's royal family. Their worlds collide when the two fall madly in love with each other.

Hindi Language.name: Rangili Baatein
Hindi Language.description: Vaishali, who lives with her uncle goes through a lot of suffering and molestation when her uncle finds out that she works on an online dating website. Vaishali takes revenge on Ashok, as not just him, but he invites his friends as well to take part in such activities, causing Vaishali to brutally avenge herself.

Hindi Language.name: Karmadhikari Shanidev
Hindi Language.description: Karmadhikari Shanidev showcasing the kind nature, discipline, justice, karma and service of Suryaputra Shanidev through attractive stories.

Hindi Language.name: Chalaak
Hindi Language.description: An abduction, an extra marital affair and bold revelations. Mansi's life takes an unexpected turn when she is mysteriously kidnapped. This ordeal forces her to confront her past and hidden intentions are revealed.

Hindi Language.name: Kacchey Limbu
Hindi Language.description: A wilful young girl who is in the race of fulfilling dreams imposed on her by everyone and being at the receiving end each time.

Hindi Language.name: Kazi
Hindi Language.description: A mind reader scrambles to protect his dreams and secrets from a dream watcher hell-bent on destroying him and his family.

Hindi Language.name: Ajmer Kand
Hindi Language.description: Ajmer rape case involved the serial gang rape and blackmailing of over one hundred school and college girls in Ajmer , Rajasthan . During 1992, a group of youths led by criminals Farooq and Nafees Chishti used to lure victims to remote areas or farmhouses and gang-rape them there. Apart from this, they used to blackmail those girls by taking nude photographs so that they could keep their mouth shut. [1] The story of this scandal came to light with an article published by a local newspaper, Daily Navjyoti , which detailed the incidents of the crimes and showed some pictures taken by the rapists. At the same time the police started investigating this incident. In which it has been told that the local authorities were aware of these incidents till a year ago, but they refrained from taking legal action. [2] Eighteen serial offenders were charged in court in September 1992, and the first eight to stand trial were sentenced to life imprisonment. However, four of them were later acquitted by the Rajasthan High Court in 2001. [3] In 2007, a fast track court in Ajmer convicted Farooq Chishti, but in 2013 the High Court released him on time.

Hindi Language.name: Samosa & Sons
Hindi Language.description: A submissive small-town man married to an ultra-modern cosmopolitan is brainwashed into producing a son by his dead father's ghost. In time, he is hit by a startling realisation.

Hindi Language.name: Trap
Hindi Language.description: Story of honey trapping by a girl and her boy friend, honey trapped another guy for money.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Pashmina
Hindi Language.description: Forced by their own condition amidst the beauty and silence of Mashowra, Karan and Omisha come closer to each other. One has never seen the other, only felt it. Soon the two complement each other, but perhaps something else is written in their fate. Amidst heavy snowfall, a very sensitive story is born. Which shakes and leaves its effect very deep in the heart.

Hindi Language.name: Appnapan... Badalte Rishton Ka Bandhan
Hindi Language.description: After their separation, Pallavi and Nikhil have raised their kids by themselves, alone. But despite their best efforts, they haven't managed to overcome the lack of the other parent in the kids' life.

Hindi Language.name: Aangan Aapno Kaa
Hindi Language.description: Jaidev Sharma, a dedicated single father, and his unbreakable bond with his three daughters.

Hindi Language.name: Mast Mauli
Hindi Language.description: Mauli, a young woman, vies for the love of her father, who blames her for her mother's death. As a result, she does everything in her power to win Fathers heart but faces many challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Mystery of the Tattoo
Hindi Language.description: An art student/therapist befriends her new neighbor. Soon after which she starts experiencing deadly psychological and hallucinating events, only to realize later that they were all a set-up by her neighbor to apprehend an old killer.

Hindi Language.name: Shatranj
Hindi Language.description: A men whose wife not ready to accept him has a husband despite of the fact that everyone else was telling that he is her husband.

Hindi Language.name: Murder at Koh E Fiza
Hindi Language.description: Film based in Bhopal, it's murder mystery in today's time .

Hindi Language.name: Main Monica
Hindi Language.description: Nobody knows what makes Monica the most desired bar dancer in the city. Only Monica knows the secret of her wild success. When Monica goes missing her many lovers come out crawling and what ensues is chaos.

Hindi Language.name: Kaisa Hai Yeh Ristha Anjana
Hindi Language.description: A Girl Anmol, who doesn't have anything to call her own, it's her journey of finding herself and through that finding her own world, her own family whom she can finally call her own.

Hindi Language.name: Dance Deewane Juniors
Hindi Language.description: A platform to the Junior DEEWANA dancing talent. The talented kids will face challenges to prove their mettle and hone their skills.

Hindi Language.name: Bhasadbaaz
Hindi Language.description: This comedy short film is story is based in Ballia in Eastern UP. It humorously depicts the unbalanced nature of our society and the deep rooted old stereotypes which we fit as per our convenience in Today world. Humourous take on the status divide between Bihar vs UP and how it affects the common life of a mafiosi family. The role that media plays in today's world and how it affects the smallest in the most rural places. In Amma's world, nobody is averse to play games and politics specially inside the family. It's a satire showcasing the on the life of a women in small time Mafiosi family and how under that roof all these situations exist. It also attempts to show that our standards are different for different people and relationships and we convincingly believe it.

Hindi Language.name: Decent Boy
Hindi Language.description: When his father Uday Pratap Singh, ABC Inter colleges trustee, decides to shift from Hindi medium to English medium, Dhruv finds himself opposing his father. Who will win the battle?

Hindi Language.name: Haunted Evil Dead
Hindi Language.description: Horror story of the couples

Hindi Language.name: Chuhiya
Hindi Language.description: A look at the Education System, Caste System and Gender Inequality in India. Where no amount of governmental encouragement has been able to stem the tragic custom that separates human beings according to their Caste and Gender.

Hindi Language.name: Satta
Hindi Language.description: This series is about how teenager are being exploited by tricks of business, A teenager after watching his friends betting on cricket matches and making a lot of money in a very short span and he is tempted to follow suit.

Hindi Language.name: Honey Bunny Reloaded
Hindi Language.description: As OG Jholers are back with 'Honey Bunny Reloaded' on Sony YAY!, let's take a stroll down memory lane and relive those childhood moments that mirror the iconic duo's antics.

Hindi Language.name: Hey Kameeni
Hindi Language.description: A new job opportunity arises for Kamini when she meets Gauri, a resolute woman unfazed by Kamini's shadowy history. Gauri develops feelings for Kamini but wonders if a romance between them has a chance.

Hindi Language.name: Woh 3 Din
Hindi Language.description: an uncomplicated man with few uncomplicated dreams - Sanjay Mishra as Rikshaw Driver.

Hindi Language.name: Alpha Beta Gamma
Hindi Language.description: As the deadly COVIC 90 virus spreads across the globe, a woman, her almost ex-husband, and her about-to-be husband are locked down under one roof for 14 days and they realize that it is very difficult to move on and even tougher to let go.

Hindi Language.name: Spy Bahu
Hindi Language.description: Love blooms between Sejal, a clumsy girl, and Yohan, a handsome young man who is always around to rescue her. However, their real lives pose as barricades between their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: I Killed Bapu
Hindi Language.description: The assassination of Mahatma Gandhi made Nathuram Godse one of the most hated assassins in the history of India. The film depicts Godse's reason behind the extreme step.

Hindi Language.name: Shubh Nikah
Hindi Language.description: Families of two different cultures join hands and come together for love, humanity, and peace with a strong message of national integrity

Hindi Language.name: Lag Ja Gale
Hindi Language.description: Shiv and Ishani tie the knot to ease the path for their siblings' marriage. Will their marriage, which has taken place under compelling circumstances, stand the test of time?

Hindi Language.name: Sir Madam Sarpanch
Hindi Language.description: Ana, Indian-born but US-raised, faces local politics when starting a library in her ancestral Indian village. Her mission reveals how books threaten the system. She runs for Village Council, confronting more bureaucratic chaos.

Hindi Language.name: Balat
Hindi Language.description: Through the film ,want to tell that whether it is a woman or a man, to forcefully against someone's soul is a kind of rape.

Hindi Language.name: Manto Remix
Hindi Language.description: These four stories of 'Manto Remix' anthology are independent in their original sensibility and the threads of the ancient relationship of Adam and Eve.

Hindi Language.name: Token the Treasure
Hindi Language.description: A family decides to sell their ancestral house and with much effort, they finally made it happen. In a sudden twist, they come to know that Haweli has some ancestral treasure inside. Now the journey starts to get Haweli back.

Hindi Language.name: Keh Doon Tumhein
Hindi Language.description: Embracing life after divorce, Kirti moves to a hill station with her son. Soon she meets a mysterious admirer Vikrant, whose secrets may ignite destruction.

Hindi Language.name: A Winter Tale at Shimla
Hindi Language.description: A Mature Sensible Love Story Where A Man Meets His Long Lost Love After Two Decades .The rekindled affair could be ruinous, for the jealous husband who is a DIG Police Officer, a brute with a unenviable reputation.

Hindi Language.name: Rajnandini
Hindi Language.description: A treasure hunter, Retd. Prof. of Archaeology , Fernandez seizes the opportunity to lead two groups of college student in an excursion to "Neel Haveli" a fully haunted century old kings mansion in Kishangunj, where the walls whisper a very sad, sordid and gory history of betrayal, lust, greed, hate and death. The professor searches for a gem studded shrine of "Radha Madhab " believed to be hidden somewhere in the Haveli. History reveals its bloodied fangs of mysticism and paranormal phenomenon - Rahul, reborn into the present era, a student leader, vanishes away with the spirit of his previous births ladylove, the kings daughter, Rajnandini - but not before the professor and nearly all students meet unnatural and ghastly deaths at the hands of the fiery spirits of the haunted mansion. Only Raj and Payel, two students, somehow, luckily escape to lament and tell the world.

Hindi Language.name: I Love Us 3 - Tu Meri Aashiqui Hai
Hindi Language.description: Love Story of two girls chasing affection and fighting to live life on their terms. Witness an incredible journey of love as they discover themself an their love emerges victorious in the face of all doubts and changes life throws at them.

Hindi Language.name: Udti Ka Naam Rajjo
Hindi Language.description: Rajjo, an athletically-gifted girl from a village, encounters Arjun, a rich but angry man, who saves her life during a calamity. However, they have to deal with the societal boundaries to be together.

Hindi Language.name: Pyar Mein Thoda Twist
Hindi Language.description: Pyar me thoda twist is a Romcom and action drama film. It's a story of a town near Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh). Hero of the film Dheeraj Thakur (Mukesh J. Bharti) and Heroine Maya (Richa Mukherjee) loves each other even after knowing the old rivalry between their families. A twist comes with the entry of Jwala Singh aka Mr. Wanted. Everyone in the town and police is looking for Mr. Wanted. How the life of everyone changes with Jwala Singh's aka Mr. Wanted entry? Does Dheeraj and Maya able to convince their rival families for their marriage? Does this twisted love story resolves?

Hindi Language.name: Favvara Chowk
Hindi Language.description: Fawara Chowk is a Comedy Show Where Fight begins Between Two Shops.The Day to Day fight Between them Attract the People of Fawara Chowk.

Hindi Language.name: Badhai Ho Beti Huee Hai
Hindi Language.description: This story is about journey of a girl who was rejected by society and her family since birth and later how she turned out to be a boon for society and her family.

Hindi Language.name: Hari Singh Nalwa - Champion of the Khalsa Ji
Molkki Rishton Ki Agnipariksha
Hindi Language.description: Bhoomi ends up into a Molkki marriage with Suraj a regressive ritual Molki - The bought wives.

Hindi Language.name: Maali
Hindi Language.description: Tulsi lives in the mountains, treating nature as her companion. Sakshi who suffers from anxiety and depression asks Tulsi to accompany her to the city where Tulsi faces challenges that are alien to her otherwise harmonious life.

Hindi Language.name: Ek Tha Hero
Hindi Language.description: A 11 year old village boy fondly called as HERO who has a passion for CYCLE and dreams of having his own CYCLE someday. He has to go through a roller coaster ride to make his DREAM COME TRUE. He does not succumb to his failures and sets a strong example of NEVER GIVE UP and emerges out to be a real HERO.

Hindi Language.name: Wedding.con
Hindi Language.description: Five women seeking marriage get exploited by conmen posing as grooms online, losing money and getting emotionally manipulated.

Hindi Language.name: Rocket Gang
Hindi Language.description: A roller-coaster ride of friendship, camaraderie, love and dance as the team of 5 children step into the biggest dance competition to accomplish their dream.

Hindi Language.name: Gotakhor
Hindi Language.description: Meera is a greedy woman who plans to get her husband killed in order to get the insurance claim of 10 CRORE. But, her husband knows that his wife is a cunning cheat so he turns the tables and makes a plan to expose his wife. He deliberately takes out an insurance policy after telling his wife about it. Does the wife fall in his Trap? Watch GOTAKHOR to find out what happens IN THIS THRILLER.

Hindi Language.name: Meow Meow
Hindi Language.description: Two street hoodlums try to rise up in Mumbai's crime world.

Hindi Language.name: Roached
Hindi Language.description: Stuck at home amidst the COVID pandemic, a timid housewife finds her world unraveling due to the constant presence of her overbearing husband and a six legged intruder.

Hindi Language.name: Accelerator
Hindi Language.description: A man runs over a kid on his way home from a failed business deal and flees the spot. While trying to escape the arrest, his bad day starts turning into worst day of his life.

Hindi Language.name: Rainbow Rishta
Hindi Language.description: Enter the worlds of six heartwarming, real and fabulous stories of love where our protagonists across the queer spectrum make mountains move to make their seemingly impossible dreams come true.

Hindi Language.name: Khela Hobe
Hindi Language.description: This story revolves around a woman who decides to contest election to take revenge against the oppression faced by her and her family. She fights election with a new agenda, other contenders fight election on the basis of secularism and progress in town, whether the major contenders using the ancient agenda of secularism or progress would win, or there will be some surprise in the result The contender's of the election is portrayed by Mugdha Godse, Manoj Joshi and Sanjay Batra.

Hindi Language.name: Swayamvar: Mika Di Vohti
Hindi Language.description: Renowned singer Mika Singh sets out to pick his perfect bride from a group of beautiful women who attempt to steal his heart.

Hindi Language.name: Am I Next
Hindi Language.description: A sudden shock grabs the family of 14-year old Honey, when they get to know that their teenage daughter is pregnant. She was raped and now there is a long court battle to seek her right to terminate the pregnancy.

Hindi Language.name: Jholachhap
Hindi Language.description: Story of a newly posted doctor in a rural villages and the challenges she faces specially from the quacks,who plans to throughout her by any means.

Hindi Language.name: Bunty Billa Aur Babban
Hindi Language.description: Bunty, Billa and Babban are three friends who engage in mischievous behaviour and create trouble for each other which leads to various adventures for the trio.

Hindi Language.name: Bhabhi Ji Gadbad Hai
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of Savita Bhabhi. Though she is a maid by profession, she doesn't look like a maid from any angle. She is so hot that all the boys hits on her. To get her, they can put everything at stake. Will anyone get her or not? If yes, then who? But there is something else going on in Savita's mind, what is that?

Hindi Language.name: Sonu Beauty Parlour
Hindi Language.description: Welcome to Sonu Beauty Parlour. From Cocktail's Deepika to DDLJ's Kajol, this place offers all kinds of makeovers. From love to lipstick and merriment to mascara, this story has plenty of twists and turns.

Hindi Language.name: The Dead End
Hindi Language.description: An abduction by a Naxal group and time spent by DK Chaudhary amongst them, was an experience, worth telling. An experience worth pondering. The Film, The Dead End traces the metamorphosis and consciousness of unbroken emotions.

Hindi Language.name: The Thugesh Show
Hindi Language.description: The Thugesh Show is a chat/fun show where Thugesh interviews guests from across YouTube from genres such as vlogging, gaming, entertainment, roasting and much more.

Hindi Language.name: Quota - The Reservation
Hindi Language.description: Quota The Reservation, Story of a Dalit medical student who faces discrimination and bias only due to his lower caste, and one day he decides to break the system and do something like the whole nation will shake up

Hindi Language.name: Special Task Team
Hindi Language.description: S.T.T. (Special Task Team) "Sabko Nyay Milega" The "Special Task Team" is a fictional department created for the series which will be shown as a unique and covert unit of law enforcement operatives.

Hindi Language.name: Aarop
Hindi Language.description: Two young police inspectors ANURAAG and SHANTNU successfully catch hold of a local goon JETHIYA but mounting political pressures lead to a fight among both with Anuraag refusing to let go of the criminal. The next day, Anuraag is arrested by the police for having killed Shantnu to which he rebuses and says he visited him to patch up for the last verbal fight. Raashi, Anuraag's wife tries hard to seek help from MLA Kiran and the SP but is shocked to know that her ex-boyfriend Arjun will be investigating the case. This creates doubts in Anuraag's mind and he blames Raashi of a conspiracy against him. But a dutiful officer Arjun tries his best to free Anuraag of charges while On the other hand, MLA Kiran tries hard to send Anuraag to jail. In the process, Mahendra, who is in love with Shantnu's wife Mansi accepts he killed the inspector with a rope but the whole investigation rewinds with the new post-mortem report which says Shantnu died of poison and not by suffocation.

Hindi Language.name: Mahima Mata Vaishno Devi
Hindi Language.description: Based on a lesser-known epic, within the Ramayan. Throws light on an Unrequited Love Story, between Prabhu Shri Ram and Maa Vaishno Devi. Where the latter fell in one-sided love with Prabhu Shri Ram, who had already taken martial vows with Mata Sita. The beautiful love story transcends 4 yugas. Starts in the Satt Yuga and is deemed to climax at the end of Kalyuga.

Hindi Language.name: Red Forest Khooni Jungle
Hindi Language.description: Red Forest...Khooni Jungle This story is quite frightening and related to horror elements.In this story the viewers are provided with entertainment and the audience get immersed in the plot of the story. In this story, Red Forest is a forest where people come from far off places.In this forest young girls and boys take bath in the love waterfall. In the film s opening scene a girl named Shaila and a boy called Sandy come for a visit to this forest and are suddenly murdered by a mysterious evil spirit.The other main characters in this film Vishal,Raj,Shiva,Jhangvi,Nidhi also come to this jungle to enjoy their vacation.Inspite of the warnings given by the hotel owner Shyamu,they venture out into this jungle with their adamant guide Mangal and each one of the boys and girls are killed in a mysterious ways.It is not found who is the murderer and how the boys and girls are getting killed.In this manner,in this dense forest anyone who enters is killed in a mysterious manner.The suspense of the story is contained in the climax.

Hindi Language.name: Sutliyan
Hindi Language.description: A heart-warming tale of an estranged family struggling to deal with their troubled past and unresolved conflicts. What will happen when the siblings gather under one roof for Diwali?

Hindi Language.name: Sama
Hindi Language.description: This is a coming-of-age film about young blooming college girls. As they step into a heartless demanding world, the boundaries of their friendship are tested transforming from pupae and blossoming into butterflies.

Hindi Language.name: Aaina (Truth Lies Within)
Hindi Language.description: It's a story about twisted love with a full of Drama.

Hindi Language.name: Police Secrets
Hindi Language.description: A Mumbai based gangster and an upright Customs officer unwittingly set of a chain of events leading to a deadly game of deceit, corruption and betrayal

Hindi Language.name: Tamso
Hindi Language.description: Prodigal daughter returns home for a family wedding only to discover they are hiding the fact that one of their member is possessed by a demon.

Hindi Language.name: Hotel Murder Case
Hindi Language.description: Two people end up dead in a restaurant. police are able to narrow the suspects down quickly but which of the suspects actually did the murder?

Hindi Language.name: Mose Chhal Kiye Jaaye
Hindi Language.description: Serial showcases a story of girl named Saumya(Vidhi Pandya) and India's best TV serial producer Armaan Oberoi (Vijayendra Kumeria). Saumya's aim is to become a popular and a successful writer.

Hindi Language.name: Surveillance
Hindi Language.description: Surveillance revolves around a renowned bio medical researcher Dr. Purushottam Dixit who has cracked the formula to finding an Ayurveda serum against cancer at his bungalow in Kanha Village which is protected by The Safe House Surveillance (SHS) unit since both Dr. Dixit and his Ayurveda serum, which he has agreed to share with the government is an asset to the country. Dr. Dixit dies off heart attack at the announcement event of the serum on World Cancer Day. His daughter Riya , partner Mohini , assistant Mishty and the village head Meghnath are shocked to see this sight. The entire SHS is shaken by this incidence and decides to send their best agent BHARAT at the Safe House to find the formula and make a report on his death. When Bharat reaches the Safe House , strange things start happening in the village and around the house which leads Bharat to uncover a bigger conspiracy. What Is This Conspiracy ? Can Bharat Find The Formula? What Happens To Dr. Dixit's Family ? Is Dr. Dixit's Death Natural Or A Murder?

Hindi Language.name: Aaj Mere Pyaar Ki Shadi Hai
Kaisi Ye Dor
Hindi Language.description: A small town film which is set in the backdrop of the spiritual capital of India, Banaras. The film brings forth the essence of relationships which seems to be missing in the present times

Hindi Language.name: Raashifal
Hindi Language.description: An unemployed young boy goes to horoscope reader and that pandit tells him to avoid some things and persons starting with a particular word. But after that he finds that he is so much involved with that particular word.

Hindi Language.name: Remote Control
Hindi Language.description: It's about a guy Bunty who is very innocent and weak then suddenly he finds a REMOTE and his life changes drastically. He is in love with a girl named Misty(Shweta Ghosh) but Misty is in a relationship with someone else(Virat). So the story has a lot of twists and turns.. Misty is sweet, nice, intelligent and kind at the same time.. but she is a little naive too and she loves her parents alot.

Hindi Language.name: Doosri Maa
Hindi Language.description: Life as she knew it comes to an end for Yashoda on learning about her husband's illegitimate son.

Hindi Language.name: Oh My Lallan
Hindi Language.description: Lallan, an adventurous stray dog, embarks on a mission to secure life's fundamental necessities, such as food, water, and shelter.

Hindi Language.name: Before Life After Death
Hindi Language.description: When a young woman, Gauri faces a tough choice, her only hope lies in an unlikely bond with Radhika, a doctor who is battling with a tragic past.

Hindi Language.name: Main Raj Kapoor Ho Gaya
Hindi Language.description: A man who despite being born in a world full of hoggish beliefs, chooses to live a life of truth and honesty. He believes the fact that God created everyone as equals. Can he fight the system with his beliefs?

Hindi Language.name: Pratikaar Chauri Chaura
Hindi Language.description: Uncover the concealed truth of the Chauri Chaura incident, which remained obscured throughout British rule while acknowledging the bravery of the unsung freedom fighters.

Hindi Language.name: Meru Gaun
Hindi Language.description: पहाड़ के एक मरते हुए गांव की कहानी, जिसको हर साल कोई न कोई परिवार छोड़ रहा है, मगर एक शख्स कसम खाकर बैठा है कि वो इस गांव को कभी नहीं छोड़ेगा, पर एक दिन उसकी इस कसम का ऐसा इम्तहान होता है कि उसकी कसम टूटने पर आ जाती है, कभी धन धान्य, परस्पर स्नेह व खुशहाली से भरपूर गांव के उजाड़ होने की मार्मिक कहानी.

Hindi Language.name: Haryana
Hindi Language.description: Haryana is a story of 3 brothers. Mahender is the eldest one who takes care of everything, be it farming fields, transport business or the well-being of all his family members. Jaibeer, the second brother who studies in Hisar university, near their village. Jugnu, the youngest, is tough to handle as he is spoilt with love, comforts and desires of a regular 20 year old boy. All 3 brothers in the movie fall in love through which the story unfolds Naive but pure, witness this hysterical tale from Haryana .

Hindi Language.name: The Astronaut and His Parrot
Hindi Language.description: An accident causes a spaceship to explode and an astronaut tumbles out of it. He starts floating and falling in space and frantically tries to connect to someone.

Hindi Language.name: Deendayal Ek Yug Purush
Hindi Language.description: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya was the co-founder of Bhartiya Jana Sangh, fore-runner of Bhartiya Janata Party. He was involved in social work and also participated in the Indian freedom struggle. Not just this but when after freedom, Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) was blamed for Mahatma Gandhi's death, he worked day and night to clean its image. He believed that after freedom the country needed a strong opposition to keep the government in check and he continued towards achieving this. Just a few days after being appointed as RSS chief, he was found dead under mysterious circumstances on the railway track. A lot of people thought it to be a political murder so the government was forced to start an investigation, which was stopped midway. After years, his death is still a mystery.

Hindi Language.name: Sorry Day
Hindi Language.description: Akash is a egoistic self centered man who can't say Sorry to anyone. His life changes upside down when he meets an 8 year old girl Sohana on his way to Shimla.

Hindi Language.name: L.A.C.
Hindi Language.description: When their commanding officer is killed by the Invading forces in a border standoff, two Indian soldiers must cross the Line of Actual Control unarmed, in order to save their battalion.

Hindi Language.name: Mini Bomb
Hindi Language.description: Mini fibs a lot and lies to save herself from life's little complications, one such lie ends up with her mother believing that she is a lesbian. Confronted by her mother she agrees to the lie whereas she is in love with a guy. Not realizing this time her lie is going to turn her life upside down.

Hindi Language.name: Konman
Hindi Language.description: Story of a man who gets conned by a sinister scam organization and decides to turn back against them and con them by becoming part of them and destroying them forever.

Hindi Language.name: Saubhagyavati Bhava: Niyam Aur Shartein Laagu
Hindi Language.description: Consumed by obsession, tech billionaire Raghav Jindal falls in love with Siya. Though romance ignites, will it endure Raghav's absurd terms and conditions?

Hindi Language.name: Unlock Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: During the pandemic, for the first time, we had our backs against the wall, compelled to question our ways of life which resulted into an Un-Lockdown of ideas, thoughts and values.

Hindi Language.name: Social Currency
Hindi Language.description: Social media influencers are put to test in the real world without their superpower, who will be the most liked on and off the phone screens?

Hindi Language.name: Ditch Witch
Hindi Language.description: Ditch Witch (DW) Explores The Unsaid Wanting And Wishes Of Metro City's Young People's Relationships, And When They Lack, They Try A Different Route To Make Themselves Happy. In The Process, What All Challenges They Face Is What Ditch Witch Scouts. Metro City Life Is A Whole Different Lifestyle, Way Apart From Cultures. The Nuclear Families, Living Independently, Relishing Single-hood-ness Are All Derived From A-towns, But, Not Limited To These. Unsatisfaction, Depression, Unfaithfulness, DITCHES And Much More Are Packaged With All Those Few Good Things.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti
Hindi Language.description: Lovers Priya and Lakshman who can't get married till Priya's elder sister Pallavi does. Lakshman devises an elaborate plan where they hire an NRI groom to woo Pallavi.

Hindi Language.name: Wrong Way
Hindi Language.description: Shiva and his 4 friends are driving to Lonavala to have some good time but little did they know what awaits them

Hindi Language.name: Ho Ja Mukt
Hindi Language.description: 21-year old Vicky is diagnosed with mental health issues and starts having illusory images which he needs to break out of while his parents constantly fail to understand his situation.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar
Hindi Language.description: Dark-skinned Diya faced a lot of rejections because of her appearance. She crosses paths with Armaan, a charming divorcee. Will he appreciate her real beauty?

Hindi Language.name: Hello Daddu
Hindi Language.description: Hellodaddu This is the story of Janardan who lives in Mumbai with his friend Rahul. Janardan is a simple boy who does pupa and his friend Rahul is exactly opposite to him. Rahul also has a girlfriend. Their romance plan fails because of Janardan. Because he is not ready to leave both of them alone in the room, hence Rahul and his girlfriend make a plan to make Janardan's friendship with Heena and convince Janardan to be in a live-in relationship with Heena. Next day after Heena comes with Janardan, Janardan's Daddu comes to his place to check his eyes. Now even Heena cannot be called, so that Daddu does not know that both of them live together, his struggle and excuses are shown. Meanwhile, while trying to scare Daddu, Daddu's foot slips and the doctor asks them to stay for more days. Seeing Daddu's condition, both of them repent for their actions and serve Daddu wholeheartedly. In this story, at the end, when Daddu is leaving, both of them apologize to him for their mistakes, then Daddu tells that he knew from the very first day that both of you live together and he has no problem with that. The girl is a Muslim because she is good at heart and it is she who will convince Janardan's father for marriage. #hellodaddu this movie release soon on November 2023 on Jio Cinema. Cast for this movie is Abhansh Kumar, Ruhana Barg, Ali Shah Shorya Pratap Singh, Jinal Joshi. This Movie Directed By Shahroj Khan. Anil Shrivastav is Producer of this movie. Present by Raj TV And Film Makers. Writer & Creative Director is Shubhamm Vishwakarma. DOP Amit Podia. Associate Director is Hasan Pathan. Asst Director is Resham Warsi.

Hindi Language.name: Kaala Barbarian Chapter 1
Hindi Language.description: A surgeon who single-handedly tries to save his patient's life against all odds. Will he be able to protect an innocent family from the twisted plans of an organ trafficking mafia? What hidden truths will he unfold in the process?

Hindi Language.name: Sirf Ek
Hindi Language.description: Sirf Ek is a 2 hour Crime Drama on the prevailing issue of sexting among teenagers and related crimes

Hindi Language.name: Chhe: Six
Hindi Language.description: Those six didn't believe in the legends.. The legends which were there from centuries... and for a reason.

Hindi Language.name: Donkey
Hindi Language.description: Based on novel "Hole in My Soul".

Hindi Language.name: Juliet
Hindi Language.description: Amidst dark comedy and unexpected plot twists, the trio finds themselves caught in a web of deception, secrets, and unrequited love, culminating in a suspenseful climax. they become catalysts for a series of chaotic events.

Hindi Language.name: Tantra
Hindi Language.description: Tantra is a Bollywood movie produced by Omkar Jaitly and directed by Ram Raja Dwivedi. Royal Munda OJ, Shargun Mehta, Daizel Carol Cutinho and Kiara Jaitly will be seen in the lead roles of the film.

Hindi Language.name: Raazz Mahal: Dakini Ka Rahasya
Hindi Language.description: A king and a queen's happy life is disturbed when the wicked Dakini casts an evil shadow on the kingdom in her quest to become immortal. Soon, they must fight her to restore peace.

Hindi Language.name: Desh Ka Dhoni
Hindi Language.description: Cycling 2500 kms from Delhi to Chennai proves the admiration towards his idol Cricketer Dhoni in the mid summers by Gaurav and his companion-wife Ritu. This title is apt and motivates to "Achieve the Arjuna-in-you".

Hindi Language.name: Dvand: The Internal Conflict
Hindi Language.description: Dvand: The Internal Conflict is a Hindi movie released on 29 Sep, 2023. The movie is directed by Ishtiyak Khan and featured Ishtiyak Khan, Vikram Kochhar, Sanjay Mishra and Tina Bhatia, Ipsita Chakraborty as lead characters.

Hindi Language.name: Mauka Ya Dhokha
Hindi Language.description: Beware what you wish for. As some wishes do come true that will topple your life, forever. 'Mauka ya Dhokha' is an edge-on-the-seat murder mystery thriller, set in scenic Goa, driven by love, greed and betrayal.

Hindi Language.name: Aaina - Roop Nahin, Haqeeqat Bhi Dikhaye
Kartoot
Hindi Language.description: This story is about husband and wife. Nigar is a beautiful young girl and belongs to very poor family. One day she married young guy Samir, who is a rich person and businessman in Mumbai. They love each other. Nigar gets all happiness and she considers her husband as god. She is a dignified girl with a great ideology. She respects her relationship emotionally ,and they live happily in their life. One day a series of deceit and intrigue starts in the life of nigar and samir, which has many shocking twists and in the end, this conspiracy will be punished or the one who has been cheated will get justice, you must watch the movie Kartoot.

Hindi Language.name: Bhumi
Hindi Language.description: Bhumi is a story of an orphan girl who has lost her mother in domestic violence in her early childhood father was a drunkard. from childhood bhumi loved one thing and that was painting which later in her life became the source to communicate with death, after her father's death she started having premonitions about death being around someone, and she would start sketching it on paper as she was a mute child from birth, the only way to communicate and save people was to make them aware through the paintings and sketches, which people took very lightly or just ignored her, some misunderstood her as a girl doing witch craft. Her life was in danger as many people had lost thier loved ones and they pinned the blame on this girl. Bhumi was on the run for life with the only help the protagonists of the series who believed in her and saves her from the wrath of angry villagers. During her run through forest and ruins how she comes across an unexpected entity which is too good to be true, how she is confused between the good and evil soul, how she overcomes her fear, and anxiety forms the crux of the story. some misunderstood her as a girl doing witch craft. Her life was in danger as many people had lost thier loved ones and they pinned the blame on this girl. Bhumi was on the run for life with the only help the protagonists of the series who believed in her and saves her from the wrath of angry villagers. During her run through forest and ruins how she comes across an unexpected entity which is too good to be true, how she is confused between the good and evil soul, how she overcomes her fear, and anxiety forms the crux of the story.

Hindi Language.name: The Lost Prime Minister
Hindi Language.description: Revelation of an Investigation into the mysterious death of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose

Hindi Language.name: Pyar Ki Policy
Hindi Language.description: Sundarlal, a decent, humble young man, goes on to become the unopposed head of the village assembly in the election. But only then, when Lula Singh was released from jail, he would have lost the election.

Hindi Language.name: Abhimanyu Ki Alien Family
Hindi Language.description: The series is a sci-fi comedy, which presents Abhimanyu, both in the form of a 12-year-old Human Boy as well as an Alien. It showcases his journey of fitting in with the humans, making friends with them, hiding his true identity and overcoming adverse situations or threats. The secondary plot is of his "Family" struggles of fitting-in with the humans. All these characters will be seen in two avatars - both 'Human' as well as 'Alien'.

Hindi Language.name: MTV Ex or Next
Hindi Language.description: Three ex-couples come face-to-face with each other, and their toxic past. Beach parties, bonfires and a tempting choice to move on awaits them. A hot new date or clinging to their past? Find out if they give love a second chance or move on to the next?

Hindi Language.name: The Rise of Sudarshan Chakra
Hindi Language.description: Film The Rise Of Sudarshan Chakra Is Based On Sant Sudarshan Muni Lifes Journey

Hindi Language.name: Delhi Khabbar
Hindi Language.description: A comedy horror between a group of friends.

Hindi Language.name: Orange Lilly
Hindi Language.description: A lawyer must find his missing mistress from his farmhouse while dealing with corrupt police, abnormal sculptors neighbour, his mentally ill helper and pilferer maid before his wife reaches there to spend time with him.

Hindi Language.name: Avani
Hindi Language.description: A 24-year-old girl, has gone on a work trip to Bangladesh. The ship gets blown up, and Avani finds herself alive. She builds a bond with a tortoise and tries to escape from a tiger. It took almost 267 days to rescue her.

Hindi Language.name: Years
Hindi Language.description: After their families oppose marriage due to caste differences, Rohit and Priya spend the next couple of days in despair wondering about the uncertain future of their relationship.

Hindi Language.name: T
Hindi Language.description: Bishnu was often beaten up by father for his girlish behavior. His unusual behavior was the subject of fun for his classmates. Will he ever get employed and have equal rights?

Hindi Language.name: The Golden Thread
Hindi Language.description: Outside Kolkata a few jute mills crank on, virtually unchanged since the industrial revolution. Powered by steam and sweat, work is a dance to the dictate of profit and century-old machines. The Golden Thread follows the weft and warp of jute work alongside the creative labour of the film's own making. In this near dystopian industrial town can there be a potential for a collective re-imagination?

Hindi Language.name: Corporate Sarpanch
Hindi Language.description: A woman reaches the heights of her career but decides to give it up and take up the duties of a village head and lead her people to a better future.

Hindi Language.name: Unfinished Story
Hindi Language.description: It's a story of a disconcerted writer and his evolving relationship with his newly-hired assistant. It's a journey of discovery and remembrance for the duo as they go about completing the unfinished stories, both fictional and their own.

Hindi Language.name: Highway to Hell
Hindi Language.description: Highway To Hell is a new-age cinematic documentary exploring the life story, philosophy and motivations of a group of nomad mechanics from north India, who travel around the year to perform death-defying stunts in 'the well of death'.

Hindi Language.name: Vahem
Hindi Language.description: Vahem is the story about Raghav and Suman, after they meet an unfortunate accident they take shelter in an empty house. Suman tries to help stranger outside of the gate but Raghav hesitates and calls this a Vahem.

Hindi Language.name: Shyaane
Hindi Language.description: 3 youths who want instant success in life and to achieve this they start walking on wrong path. Later they realize their wrongdoings and want to take u turn from wrong path.

Hindi Language.name: Shakkar Masala
Hindi Language.description: A fight between two families started over an egg of a hen, becomes a bigtime enmity between them and this drags them to a level where at a point of time, they have lost almost everything to keep their enmity alive.

Hindi Language.name: Who Killed Gaurav?
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by the world-famous ghost hunter, Gaurav Tiwari's life and mysterious death, this movie is the story of Gaurav's unquenching thirst for proof of ghosts that kicks off a series of mind-bending events

Hindi Language.name: Legends of the Ramayana with Amish
Hindi Language.description: A story that has lived in the hearts of countless individuals for generations. But is it really just a story for them? It's their truth, the one which their beloved Lord Ram lived.

Hindi Language.name: Anaari Is Back
Hindi Language.description: Rajveer who comes to Lucknow from Afghanistan for his better living searching a job for himself there he gets to meet a filthy rich girl Jaspreet(Mishikka Chaurasia). Jaspreet falls in love with Rajveer for his sincerity and purity.

Hindi Language.name: Dalchini
Hindi Language.description: Falak, an uneducated village girl, who forges her unique identity through a relatively overlooked talent: cooking and revolves around Dalcheeni and her mother-in-law Rajrani.

Hindi Language.name: Do Chutki Sindoor
Hindi Language.description: Story of 2 sister they share everything from each other can they share their husband also.

Hindi Language.name: Yaara Vey
Hindi Language.description: Triangles are always messy and the one between the disciplined Sania, the gentle Armaan and the maverick Samir was more than she bargained for.

Hindi Language.name: Before Everest
Hindi Language.description: We all once in our lifetime have dreamt of reaching top of the world, haven't we? Mount Everest the highest point on earth the most fearful mountain in the world, Kovid Mittal will have to battle this last 7000 meter mountain before he can attempt and be fully prepared for the monster Everest. A journey of young boy battling his own emotions and demons in hope one day he shall conquer Mount Everest. A motivational journey of human spirit of not giving up.

Hindi Language.name: Dhartiputra Nandini
Hindi Language.description: Follows a passionate agriculturist, Nandini, as she's thrust into an urban family's power struggle. Her connection to the land becomes a catalyst for change, testing her resolve and Aakash's preconceptions.

Hindi Language.name: Hunarbaaz: Desh Ki Shaan
Hindi Language.description: The quest for India's finest talent.

Hindi Language.name: Tedhi Medhi Kahaniyaan
Hindi Language.description: Two woke millennials, pressured by their family, agree to give them a chance to arrange marriage which becomes a casual date, and things start moving fast but a twist reveals the hypocrisy of the woke millennials.

Hindi Language.name: Paksh
Hindi Language.description: An innocent couple stranded on a highway in the middle of the night take lift from a truck. The men in the truck have bad intentions toward the couple, unaware of how everything is about to take a U-Turn.

Hindi Language.name: Laal Banarasi
Hindi Language.description: The skill of Gauri's hands is the pride of the weavers, Gauri is going to paint her dreams with colorful threads.

Hindi Language.name: Hum Nikamma Banate Hain
Hindi Language.description: Labeled worthless by their community, coaching center students in Kanpur squander opportunities until one girl's refusal to accept mediocrity awakens dormant ambitions in the most unlikely candidates.

Hindi Language.name: Backwaters
Hindi Language.description: Based on a series of missing children from Kerala - the film looks at how even God is not aware of what has happened to the missing children from his own country- especially the missing case of Rahul Raju

Hindi Language.name: Fatima
Hindi Language.description: Fatima has become an activist to challenge sex trade in her community. Married off to a pimp as a child-bride and expected to become a sex-worker by her in-laws, she has a genuine knowledge of and access to the women in her community. Fatima tries desperately hard to prevent her children going into the sex trade. She divorces her husband and as we follow her personal ups and downs: falling in love again, trying to start a new family, we find out more about why she chose to fight against the abuse and exploitation that has become systemic in her community. Despite the forces of police corruption and community ties hampering her efforts, Fatima appears to be rewarded both as an activist and in her personal life. But there is growing resentment and Fatima's hopes appear to be constantly overwhelmed by the challenges facing her and her new family.

Hindi Language.name: Anandibaa Aur Emily
Hindi Language.description: Anandi's worst nightmare comes true when her son, Aarav marries Emily, a foreigner. Fun-filled chaos ensues as Emily tries to live up to the notion of perfect Daughter In Law..

Hindi Language.name: Desert Tears
Hindi Language.description: A young woman who attempts to free herself from being used as a trad-able sex commodity to find economic freedom, falls in love with a man of a higher caste who promises her the much coveted freedom but when she is betrayed by the same man to eventual sexual exploitation, she finds herself at a cross road of giving up the battle all together and watch the same happening to her daughter, or rise up from the ashes of her scorched hopes.

Hindi Language.name: Beech Mein Mat Bol
Hindi Language.description: Married life of 60 years old husband and 20 years old wife.

Hindi Language.name: Anth the End
Hindi Language.description: Simran gets Ranjeet arrested for crimes. Ranjeet escapes, but returns in disguise to visit Simran. Unaware of the identify of his visitor, Simran informs Sumeet, who organizes a party. However the event results in a fight between Sumeet and Ranjeet, whose identity is exposed. He kidnaps Sumeet and demands ransom, but winds up killing him by accident. What happens next forms the crux of the story.

Hindi Language.name: Bera: Ek Aghori
Hindi Language.description: There used to be an Aghori in a village 500 years ago, who had mastered black magic, he used to perform his art by going to different states of the country, he had such a knowledge, with which he could take the form of anyone.

Hindi Language.name: Anya The Other
Hindi Language.description: The film is about human trafficking. An attempt has been made to explore a realistic hard core issue in society today and expose the sordid truth behind it.

Hindi Language.name: Ikk Kudi Punjab Di
Hindi Language.description: A kind-hearted Heer faces difficulties when her rich family marries her into the Atwal family, but Ranjeet enters her life and empowers her to overcome all obstacles.

Hindi Language.name: Chapter
Hindi Language.description: Siddharth lives in mumbai with his girlfriend vaani and wants to become an actor and vaani's friend Riya also live with them and wants to become an actor . Riya compro with a fake producer in order to become a star soon but she does not get the work . One day siddharth is found in a movie lead so riya plans to implicate siddharth.

Hindi Language.name: Shame
Hindi Language.description: Freud's essay on anxiety, guilt, and shame, perfectly fits on this middle class Indian housewife, who's guilt when turns into shame, creates a monster which is uncontrollable .

Hindi Language.name: Acting Ka Bhoot
Hindi Language.description: Two Con Artists with shattered lives and dreams who end up falling in love, while trying to scam each other.

Hindi Language.name: Naam Tha Kanhaiyalal
Hindi Language.description: Hypnotizing story of awesome ancient artist Kanhaiyalal. It also hammers the insensibility instrument portraying how on-screen characters of bygone days, who gave their sweat and soul to cinema, were dispatched to obscurity.

Hindi Language.name: Pret Boys
Hindi Language.description: Prem, Tatsat, and Rajat, launch a unique start-up focused on smashing ghosts. They get a ghostly one when they encounter Eisha, As the crew battles various Ghosts, they find themselves on a collision course with the dark world.

Hindi Language.name: Come on Yaar
Hindi Language.description: Today's time, young people make their lives complicated by themselves, they do not know in the shortcuts that they are getting trapped in a huge trap. Nowadays parents are very confused about raising their children. The story moves forward by psychological analysis of all these subjects. how girls take advantage of feminism, that aspect is also the main theme of the film. The big thing is that behind this all, how big division works and they also have political patronage. How much is going on behind a layer, which is a very shocking scenes. The film connects 4 different stories through a big wire and gives a very deep social message with a happy ending.

Hindi Language.name: Salesman of the Year
Hindi Language.description: A 26-year-old Kartik uproots his life and moves to New Delhi from Hyderabad to start his new job as a salesman. Will Karthik be able to make his place in the new territory? Will he be able to earn the much-wanted respect from his parents?

Hindi Language.name: Lomad
Hindi Language.description: This SINGLE SHOT film describes that there is a stranger within all of us that comes out at an unknown place and in an unusual time.

Hindi Language.name: Bade Chote Jasoos
Hindi Language.description: Get ready for a gripping tale of thriller, suspense, drama, laughter and lots of Jasoosi only with BC Jasoos.

Hindi Language.name: Mahapaap
Hindi Language.description: Inmates at a Bihar shelter endure sexual abuse. Medical exams confirm 34 victims out of 42 at the Muzaffarpur facility run by the NGO Sewa Sankalp Evam Vikas Samiti.

Hindi Language.name: Anupama: Namaste America
Hindi Language.description: Seventeen years ago, Anupama gets an opportunity of a lifetime to live her dreams. Now she has to make a tough choice between her career and her family.

Hindi Language.name: First Act
Hindi Language.description: A searing look at the dark, twisted and painful world of child actors

Hindi Language.name: Shashank
Hindi Language.description: This movie is based upon the life and journey of a superstar who is facing downfall in his career and is fighting for survival and existence in bollywood. This also covers the situation of some strugglers who come to the film industry.

Hindi Language.name: Lucknow Junction
Hindi Language.description: Lucknow Junction is a 2022 Hindi Bollywood drama movie. It is about an honest police officer who cleanses Uttar Pradesh, a state where rapes, gang wars, and extortions have been taking a toll on innocent people.

Hindi Language.name: Aarambh
Hindi Language.description: A son returns from US for last rites of his father. Little did he know that he will become a part of insatiable greed of men uncovering one of the darkest secret of the state.

Hindi Language.name: Mahalakshmi Path: The Evolution
Hindi Language.description: The film revolves around Sheetal and Samaira, sisters blessed with prosperous lives. Their personal evolution mirrors the Mahalakshmi Path, a journey towards joy, consciousness, and the true wealth of life.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaari - Tarawali the True Story
Hindi Language.description: An intense and captivating love story drama of Pyaari, an enigma of womanhood, desiring love with freedom and of a common dreamy tea-seller Laxman Chai wallah.

Hindi Language.name: Tankesh Diaries
Hindi Language.description: Both Tanya and Mikesh have started planning Mikesh's birthday party but they soon realize that they don't agree on anything and this leads to more s between them..

Hindi Language.name: Shinigami's Box: Origins
