Hindi Language.description: In a race against time, Inspector Kabir of Special Crimes Unit must unravel the connection between a masked criminal captured during a critical operation and a mystifying box that materializes in a secluded village on the city's outskirts.

Hindi Language.name: Yaatris
Hindi Language.description: Sharmas from Banaras are your next door, dysfunctional middle-class family who take on a journey of a lifetime as they navigate love, laughter and life lessons in a heartwarming tale of togetherness.

Hindi Language.name: The Fantasy Element
Hindi Language.description: An Anthology series that tell tales spanning various genres, set in a reality like our own where magic, Super-advanced science, and Mythical Entities exist too.

Hindi Language.name: Roro aur Hero Bhoot Mast Zabardast
Hindi Language.description: When Roro meets Hero his life is sent into a tailspin. They are the craziest combination there can be. Roro is street smart and mischievous whereas Hero is dramatic and chaotic. They are best of friends. Hero tries to make sure that everything works out in the favor of his friend Roro. In trying to do so, Hero generally goes overboard and instead of solving an issue creates a few more. Roro on the other hand is more measured with his plans. This is the reason why they are the right combination as a team. Hero is the Yin to Roro's Yang. Together they face all the problems and obstacles as a well-oiled machine and manage to come out of it unscathed more often than not.

Hindi Language.name: Screwed Up
Hindi Language.description: Eshan, A young fashion photographer, is a compulsive Gambler. His addiction to gambling has led him to owe a large sum of money. The failure to pay it back would mean losing his life.

Hindi Language.name: Famous Pandey
Hindi Language.description: A small town boy comes to the big bad city of Mumbai, with hope, excitement and just a friend to spare. Soon the friendship turns into love and the 2 get hooked. But staying in the city comes with its own set of hardships. Dev needed to survive and quick. He takes up the odd job of managing a local public toilet. He soon befriends a regular gangster, a crack head and even a vendor next door. Dev is unique as his roots haven't left him yet. He is sweet to everyone and sometimes goes out of his way to just be a friend. His different attitude usually makes him stand out and a local journalist does a small video piece on him. Much to everyone's surprise, the video goes viral, but unfortunately for all the wrong reasons. But Dev, enjoys all the attention. One by one the truth begins to unfold, even about his own friends. Each one has a role to play and survive in this monstrous city. How far will Dev go and will he let this off to get back to his normal life, is something that you may have to wait and watch Why Famous Pandey (FP)? Any movie goer is always looking for something new and gripping. FP talks about an issue which every individual would relate to. GETTING FAMOUS, but 'Are you willing to go that extra mile', is something that for them to decide on. With 5 across-genre songs, a good mix of film and theatre actors, a look-n-feel that speaks of its production value, and a tight duration of less than 2 hours, Famous Pandey will definitely finds its audience

Hindi Language.name: A Week to Time Travel
Hindi Language.description: In the near future, Ankit a common man living in the city is shortlisted for a Time Travel program by the Intellectual Society. He has one week left in hand to take part in the program. In the course of that time he meets some people and certain incidents in his life influence him to think about whether he should really be part of this program or not.

Hindi Language.name: Love in Dehradun
Hindi Language.description: Love in Dehradun is an upcoming Bollywood film produced by Shafeeq Ur Rahman under the banner "Star Life Hyderabad" while Sagar Joshi is Director of this film. Love in Dehradun will be released on 16 April 2023.

Hindi Language.name: Fatal: Chapter 1
Hindi Language.description: When an unidentified fingerprint is discovered on a crime scene Insp. Kadam finds himself in a spiral of deceiving clues facing a powerful foe.

Hindi Language.name: The Check Post
Hindi Language.description: "The Check Post" is based on the story of a young journalist who a meets with a little girl selling peanuts on a Check Post. The movie is directed by British-Iranian Director Mr. Hassan Nazer ( Winners ) Fame.

Hindi Language.name: Paramahans Lakshminath Gosain
Hindi Language.description: This Biography Docudrama is about the Legendary Saint of Mythila Paramhans Lakshminath Gosain , Also known as as Bbajee in bihar and mythila region . Laxminath Gosain (Babajee) and Sant shiromani laxminath gosai he was born approximately in the year 1787-1872 . he was an Indian yogi and poet from the Mithila region was lived in Bangaon Bihar . (A Documentary Feature on the great saint of Mithila - Paramhans Lakshminath Gosai) Paramhans Lakshminath Gosai born in the 18th century in the village Parsarma under Supaul district in the state of Bihar. His devotees use to honour him with the name Babaji. A large number of believers in him are living across the globe. They regard him as God. His devotees believe that to have faith in 'Babaji' benefits his devotee is certainly in different forms. It is well-known that Goswami Lakshminath or saint Lakshminath or 'Babaji' was a wonderful saint of Mithila. He was well-versed astrologer, a famous practitioner of cult (tantrik) and an Ashtanga Siddha Yogi as well as a social reformer too. On the one hand he is regarded as a Grihastha for having wife, son and family on the other he is recognized as an ascetic (Vairagi) saint because he left his native place in the very early period of his youth and sacrificed his family life too in the young age. He was such a saint who passed his whole life free from all worldly desires. Goswami Lakshminath who engrossed himself in the adoration and devotion of God, his biography and literally works in the form of poems and devotional songs are valuable inheritance of Hindi as well as Maithili literature. Many research scholars and academicians have been awarded Ph.D. degrees for their works on different aspects of Babaji and his literary contributions etc. He was warp and woof with equal and intimate sentiment for all religions. His whole life was multidimensional astonishing personality. The Ugraadya Research and Development Centre has tried its best to present the inspiring works and personality of such a great saint, before the society so that it may easily visualize the important activities of his life for making lives better. It has been observed in the last few decades that the serial, cinema or documentary prepared on the basis of the life of great men have positive impact on the people in general. Therefore, this development centre has prepared such a documentary feature to coordinate everyone with the valuable life of the great saint 'Babaji'. It is hoped that this documentary will globally effect people with positive impact on religion, culture, education and society etc. too. This documentary feature is based on the real life of Baba ji in which the clear glimpse of the culture, rural life and public behaviour of Mithila region is visualized. The knowledge of teacher-pupil tradition as well as the enriched knowledge tradition has also been acquainted. This documentary can also be important in the sense that it makes easy acquaintance to the general people with life of the great man like 'Babaji'. It will simplify the spiritual thought process of the people and there will be clarity in the religious and cultural thinking. It is expected that this documentary will promote inclusive thinking and activities of the society and will be a strong chain to promote culture, religion, education and social harmony.

It chronicles the events that led to the police investigation and capture of Wahid. Produced by Tikatbari and AB Films entertainment in association with Adiman Films, and ND9 Studio as a Co-producer. Saurabh More is the Executive producer. The film stars Riyaz Anwar and others. One day in the newspaper Film writer-director Sudarshan Gamare first read the horrific experience of Wahid Sheikh during the police custody and in the prison. But int the start there was a lot of scepticism also, but with the rigorous research, and several interviews, writer-director Sudarshan was convinced and motivated to make a film. The film's soundtrack has various theme music according to the characters and was composed by Mujtaba Aziz Naza, and lyrics were written by Nasir Faraaz, Mumtaz Aziz Naza, DOP (Director Of Photography) was Rohan Mapuskar, Sound design by Avinash sonawane. Hindi Language.name: Kalrav (Sound of running water)

'Rakesh', with no experience of filmmaking, decided on a whim to make a documentary on the theme of the River Ganga and the Kumbh Mela. He got hold of an amateur cameraman, 'Siddartha', and started to shoot, without a story line, a written script, or a plot. The theme of the musical film is: how a story is born, frame by frame, and characters come into being, and how the making of the documentary spiritually transforms the makers as well as the various characters, each in their own way.

Through their experiences, Sankshay and Arnold demonstrate that sometimes, the greatest stories are found not in the projects we undertake, but in the journey we share with those we love. The road trip changes their lives forever, igniting a new sense of purpose and creativity as they embrace the beauty of their surroundings and the joy of living in the moment.

Hindi Language.name: Sheher Mein Dhindora
Hindi Language.description: A girl, JASMINE, is riding her scooter on the streets of Dehradun. Suddenly, she lost her balance and fell off from which leads to waking her up. In reality she is on bed and dreaming about owning an scooter one day with her own money. JASMINE gets ready and leaves for job search. . Her friend, Saloni picks her from her home to help her. On a traffic signal, we see, ARJUN SINGH, who is standing beside SAloni's vehicle but JASMINE has not seen him. ARJUN SINGH is going to the police station in which he is posted as Sub-inspector. ARJUN SINGH is a corrupt officer who takes bribes from local thugs and thieves. JASMINE worked very hard on her work to save money. After few months of hard work, she saved enough money to buy an scooter on EMI. She purchased it. Her whole family is proud of her. She celebrates that with family. On very next day, when she is going office , she jumps a red signal. ARJUN and one home guard are doing duty there. The home guard stopped JASMINE and ask her to pay a fine for violating the red light. When JASMINE argues with him, the home guard tells JASMINE to pay a bribe for dodging the fine and charges. Hearing this JASMINE gets angry. Hearing all this, ARJUN came there to clear the rift between JASMINE and home guard. JASMINE scold them for asking for bribe. ARJUN fell in love with her on first sight. Whole society is angry due to her riding skills and they complain this to her parents .The next day, when JASMINE gets out of her home, she finds her scooter missing. JASMINE calls police officer ARJUN. She told him that her scooter get stolen last night. ARJUN personally went with her to check the area but found nothing. Then ARJUN and JASMINE together search for the scooter for a couple of days but didn't find it. ARJUN is interested to spend time with JASMINE instead of actually searching for scooter . JASMINE got frustrated and yells at ARJUN for being irresponsible. From the next morning, ARJUN seriously search for it. He went to couple of thief whom he know personally. He even bribe some thugs to get information for any stolen scooter but found nothing. The next morning, when JASMINE comes out of her house, found her scooter standing outside of her house. JASMINE got happy seeing this. Then ARJUN came in there who informs her that he finds the scooter . JASMINE's family thanks ARJUN. On the other hand, when she notices that the colour of speedometer is different from her actual scooter . Then she understands that ARJUN didn't actually finds the scooter but gave her another scooter to make her happy.She yells and ask ARJUN where is the real scooter.

Hindi Language.name: Mistake
Hindi Language.description: Two thieves plan to rob a house, Their greed made circumstances even worst. They handle the situation by themselves when they have visitors at the door. escapism leads to another troubles which situations make them more confusing.

Hindi Language.name: Timir
Hindi Language.description: A rich businessman is dead under mysterious and horrific circumstances. Her father is accused of sneaking in an occult expert inside the hospital and performing rituals on her which apparently resulted in her death. Nisha's friend, Ritika, an investigative journalist sets out to find what really happened with her.

Hindi Language.name: The Lost Vagabonds
Hindi Language.description: A group of four young friend addicted to drugs and aimless in life , embarks on an endless journey where they fight for their survival learning the lesson of real life.

Hindi Language.name: Harkatein
Hindi Language.description: A television actress whose career is dooming suddenly finds herself in deep trouble when she is kidnapped but Ransome is much more than money. Will she be rescued or her life will also end like her career or is this just tip of a trap?

Hindi Language.name: Mrigja
Hindi Language.description: The film is about many unheard struggles of people who come to Mumbai to be a part of the film industry,In different departments with their beautiful dreams and how they go through in their journey. It's a dark comedy film, made in a realistic way when it comes to the setup and lifestyle of these people.

Hindi Language.name: Guhaar
Hindi Language.description: A poor farmer fight against a rich landlord and the corrupt administrates for a small piece of land. Ends with a painful decision to save his farms for his family.

Hindi Language.name: Jeena Isi Ka Naam Hai
Hindi Language.description: Akshay who lied to his family that he has a stable job and doing well in his life is actually a struggling actor and working in call center part-time. He loses that job too when lock-down happens and attempts suicide but survives because the rope breaks down. He meets Apoorva who works in a marketing firm and is a neighbor of Akshay. She comes up with the idea of starting of something of his own till Akshay doesn't find a job and Jeena Isi Ka Naam Hai is born where anyone can share their problem, loneliness and pretty much anything what they want.

Hindi Language.name: Tasal
Hindi Language.description: This story is about a brother who kills someone for the honor of his sister and the situation becomes such that he becomes the bahubali of the city and everyone becomes his enemy.

Hindi Language.name: Duniya Gayi Bhaad Me
Hindi Language.description: An intense action-suspense web series where chaos rules and survival is the only law. Betrayal, crime, and shocking twists force characters to navigate a world where trust is rare and every choice is deadly.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Missed Call
Hindi Language.description: A missed call can change your life

Hindi Language.name: Noise(Shor) 2022
Hindi Language.description: Mayra is married to Aditya. Aditya is a businessman for which he has to travel a lot. Mayra is a house wife and most of the time she stays alone at home. She is 3 months pregnant but she has a serious problem, which is noise phobia. One night when Aditya is out of town, there is a party going on at Mayra's house. Mayra's friends are enjoying loud music, wine and food. Suddenly a man enters the house and kills everyone. A team of police officers headed by Shivani Bose reaches the crime scene and finds out that all have been killed except Mayra. Mayra in her statement says that she hasn't seen the face of the killer. Police investigation goes on and in the end they find out who is the killer.

Hindi Language.name: Shiddat: A Tale of Love
Hindi Language.description: Shiddat is an undying tale of timeless love and romance that will grip you till the end and will make you fall in love all over again.

Hindi Language.name: Alingan
Hindi Language.description: Kabir wants to test every new thing in life for which he travels and wants to use his experience to live life but he never wants to return from this journey.

Hindi Language.name: Adhoori
Hindi Language.description: An old painter falls in love with a young Model, who betrays him for a younger aged boyfriend.

Hindi Language.name: Subway
Hindi Language.description: Subaway is the best movie.

Hindi Language.name: Aashaon Ka Savera... Dheere Dheere Se
Hindi Language.description: Tragedy follows a grieving widow, Bhawana, as she navigates through the hardships of life. In pursuit of a better future, she must brave against the odds.

Hindi Language.name: No Water Land
Hindi Language.description: "No Water Land" is a poignant documentary detailing the struggles of two young girls, Jyoti Bhore and Rani Madhavan, in rural India as they grapple with the harsh realities of survival due to their water collection duties. This narrative is set in remote villages of Maharashtra where girls, from an extremely young age, have to bear the laborious task of fetching water for their households. The ordeal involves traveling long distances, often under scorching heat and sometimes barefoot, balancing heavy pots of water on their heads. This day-to-day hardship deprives the girls of their innocent childhood and obstructs their educational pursuits. Jyoti and Rani, who aspire to become a policewoman and a nurse respectively, find their dreams fading away amidst the toil of water collection. The documentary is produced by Shaz Memon, the founder of Wells on Wheels, a water charity aimed at improving the lives and education of young girls in Maharashtra. The film is directed by award-winning Saumitra Singh, who was deeply moved by the heart-rending stories of these young girls and decided to spotlight their predicament to the world. Sanjay Kapoor, a prominent Indian film actor, and an ambassador for Wells on Wheels, lends his voice and support to the cause, hoping to illuminate a path to a promising future for these girls.

Hindi Language.name: Mouse in the Dark
Hindi Language.description: Series is talking about the dwarf humans and how they are thrown aside by the society with 5 murders and a cliff hanger rich plot. There are no to less people known who risk their everything to fulfill their dream.

Hindi Language.name: The Smoker
Hindi Language.description: A smoker boy "Veer" meet the unknown passenger "Pancham" in the dark Night at a Highway, and Pancham tells him a haunted story of this highway, which deals with Veer's past.

Hindi Language.name: A for Aditya
Hindi Language.description: What if a serious person hosted a comedy show? Would he make us laugh? Is he trying to be funny?

Hindi Language.name: Mrit
Hindi Language.description: Roma and her boyfriend, Chiraag visit Roma's mother in her village farmhouse. Chiraag who has a hidden criminal past soon finds out that people in the farmhouse are behaving weird. He uncovers the mystery but at a very huge cost.

Hindi Language.name: Cottage No. 1303
Hindi Language.description: Justice can be delayed to a human but not to a wandering spirit seeking the vengeance against its perpetrators. Witness how the suspense unfold in Cottage No 1303 where revenge will be taken with no more delay.

Hindi Language.name: Hanuman Singh - The Dreamscape Conversation
Hindi Language.description: Description - In "Dreamscape Conversations," we delve into the surreal realm of dreams where the boundaries of reality blur, and the wisdom of generations transcends time.

Hindi Language.name: Sanjog
Hindi Language.description: Amrita and Gauri, who hail from different backgrounds, become intertwined after their daughters get swapped accidentally during the time of their birth.

Hindi Language.name: Saarch
Hindi Language.description: The story starts with an unusual incident that happened in the life of an investigative journalist who finds one abnormal photo taken while she is driving a car. That journalist visits the place and finds a dead woman and a dead man. Journalist calls the ACP to find out the matter further. A psychopath believes in the remains of life after death and tries to find those ghosts and people at the last stage and thinks that he can relieve them with brutal murder. Extremely intelligent ACP tries to search for this psychopath with evidence and intuition. And there is always a fourth point of view present who recaptures and recapitulates everything.

Hindi Language.name: Luck Shots
Hindi Language.description: LUCK SHOTS!!. is a series of original stories full of ups and downs in one's life. With every episode there will be a new story that will show the uncertainties and complexities of one's life, throughout the episode protagonist will go through different phases which one considers as good luck or bad luck. Through these stories of common people, we want to depict that Bad Luck and good Luck are two different sides of the same coin. Whether the situation will work in your favor or against you, Nobody knows.

Hindi Language.name: Kalankit: The first revenge
Hindi Language.description: Story of a physco businessman

Hindi Language.name: Basantpur Diary
Hindi Language.description: Basantpur Is A Village where two brother Satish babu And Nitish babu Living Nearby . Sons of Satish Babu and Nitish babu always Trying To Compete With Each Other . They always Fight with Each Other but Living Together .

Hindi Language.name: Dum LagaKe India
Hindi Language.description: Biriyani by Kilo and Rusk Studios present Dum Laga ke India, where Ranveer Brar sets a journey across India to uncover their dumdar flavours and culture of different Indian regions, While meeting some of India's most dumdar celebrities.

Hindi Language.name: Ticket ek Sangharsh
Hindi Language.description: In Rudranagar, the ticket is not just integral but also has multiple and divergent connotations. Although meanings would not be consensually agreed upon, but the desire to get one ticket at all costs unifies them all.

Hindi Language.name: Last Bullet
Hindi Language.description: Trisha was captivated and gang-raped every day by a new man, Vikram left one last bullet on the table for her. With that only one LAST BULLET, either kill yourself or wait for the revenge. Both ways it will end all the humiliation.

Hindi Language.name: The Redemption (Feature Film)
Hindi Language.description: In "The Redemption" a friendship between Oyi and Api blossoms amidst life's challenges. Unexpectedly, Oyi betrays Api, unveiling a shocking scheme devised with the help of Bompi, a figure deeply connected to nightlife and drug trade scene.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Teri Fitrat
Hindi Language.description: Yeh Hai Teri Fitrat ek erotic thriller film (2022) hai jo mohabbat (love), hawas (lust) aur dhoka (betrayal) ke gird ghumti hai.

Hindi Language.name: Pustak
Hindi Language.description: Set in the fiction town PUSTAK, an integral part of Bundelkhand, Madhya Pradesh, a place having its rich cultural heritage ranging from marvelous monuments of Afghani architecture to its breathtaking scenic beauty, this series follows an intertwined tale of four friends - Shiv, Rishi, Pushkar and Azhar, influenced by its politics and mafia which form an important constituent of Pustak's underbelly; and their choices in regards to carve a way in this landscape backed by a strong influence of a woman trying to help a small child achieve a better way of living while uncovering a deep dark secret of an authoritative demagogue rupturing his family's reputation; risking their own lives in the process.

Hindi Language.name: Chitrakut
Hindi Language.description: Set against a lush Western Indian landscape during the monsoon season, CHITRAKUT delicately sets the tone, interweaving the lives of Saloni, Shaan, Debu, Alisha and Kim - all converging at different intersections of life, discovering the meaning of love, encapsulating fractured feelings, consumption of romantic longing and fleeting moments.

Hindi Language.name: Fouja
Hindi Language.description: Story of An average Indian Family with tradition of serving Mother India by joining Indian Army from generations and dedicates his life for the Security of the Nation. Dedicated to all the Martyred Soldiers of the Indian Army

Hindi Language.name: Oh My Wife
Hindi Language.description: A forensic officer goes into personal turmoil when he has to fight his own demons to solve one of the most high profile cases in the city.

Hindi Language.name: One Way
Hindi Language.description: The Story throw's light on Prarabdh Karma(The Arrow has left the bow) the evil deeds done two decades back is haunting Ranadheer and the love triangle of Pranit which can have Unfortunate consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Cantt Road: The Beginning
Hindi Language.description: A peculiar place located somewhere in the outskirts where mysterious and ghostly incidents occur. It is a place having a dark history in it's past, the wails of which still continues to haunt the place and the people who pass through it.

Hindi Language.name: The Era of 1990
Hindi Language.description: Shiv and Shanky who have been film pirates from a young age. All is well until shiv finds out that his uncle has murdered his father.

Hindi Language.name: Naach Baiju Naach
Hindi Language.description: A man encouraged with claps and whistles whenever he plays Launda Naach "Natua" (a man who entertains audience in the guise of a woman). However when he comes back to his original appearance, he is jeered and rebuked by the same society.

Hindi Language.name: Hukus Bukus
Hindi Language.description: Contradiction in faiths of Father and Son in a Kashmiri Pandit House. Story of Krishna, Kashmir and Cricket from the valley of kashmir.

Hindi Language.name: Dahini - The Witch
Hindi Language.description: Women become victims of witch-hunting in property disputes or in cases where they are hated for not conforming to societal gender norms.

Hindi Language.name: Akul Nakul the Asuras
Hindi Language.description: Akul and Nakul are two naughty asuras who are sent on earth with a mission to change the perception about Asuras being evil. They do so by putting their special magical powers to use to help people solve their problems. They face challenges from Kaantasur, the king of bad asuras who wants to show that auras are evil, but he is always defeated when going against Akul and Nakul.

Hindi Language.name: Jaane Do
Hindi Language.description: A blind couple embark on a road trip only to break up from a relationship that they never entered.

Hindi Language.name: Disconnect
Hindi Language.description: In a world of fake social media connections, Jatinder navigates real relationships with his best friend Babban and love interest Dolly, as they transition from 1990s telephone-era communication to the smartphone age.

Hindi Language.name: The Next Morning
Hindi Language.description: Children are similar to gods, so how do they become devils?

Hindi Language.name: Sangi-Gai
Hindi Language.description: Tamar, a native of Sangi-Gai village, finds an exotic chest while searching for his lost brother Tamey, which expatriates him to the land of strangers in the obscured future, disrupting his current time of the year 1914.

Hindi Language.name: Wapsi Ya Prawasi
Hindi Language.description: Gamphu, a migrant laborer from Uttarakhand, works in Delhi. During the Covid pandemic he, along with his wife and daughter, goes back to his ancestral village. He considers the possibility of staying back in the village, but would that really be an easy shift? Through the video calls with his cousin, the backstory of Gamphu slowly unfurls. The story reveals that his initial departure from the village was driven not solely by economic necessity, but by false impressions on the young mind, and a quest for social validation. These motivators and concerns still haunt him. The question of staying or leaving the village, therefore, is not an easy one.

Hindi Language.name: Second Chance
Hindi Language.description: Prerna works rigorously to chase her dreams. Despite all the bold and bitter facts of Bollywood she never gives up on her dignity. But her innocence and the unpredictability of her life takes her to a whole new world of emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Bonkers
Hindi Language.description: "Bonkers" is a gripping Indian web series available on MX Player. It follows the story of Vedant and his two best friends as they navigate the world of business and crime in their quest for success.

Hindi Language.name: Twinkle Sharma #0007
Hindi Language.description: When a wicked magician threatens her village, 7-year-old Twinkle Sharma teams up with her seven mischievous ghost friends to outsmart dark magic and save the day--with courage, cleverness, and a touch of the supernatural!"

Hindi Language.name: Masoom Sawaal
Hindi Language.description: The story of the film revolves around the superstitions and regulations imposed on women during their menstrual cycle.

Hindi Language.name: B R Ambedkar Now and Then
Hindi Language.description: Through the discerning lens of a Bahujan feminist filmmaker, the film delves deep into critical themes of liberty, equality, fraternity, social justice, exclusion, and marginalized representation.

Hindi Language.name: Muqaam
Hindi Language.description: Muqaam is inspired by the daily news stories of love and betrayal which we come across in the society. The society has almost become insensitive towards these issues because of the sheer frequency and the feeling of a false sense of security that it is not going to happen to them or their dear ones. The story revolves around the key characters- Disha, Tahir, Chandu, Zoya and Salim, etc. Disha is a small town, next-door girl. She is an orphan raised by her grandfather. Her grandfather wants to see her happily married to a good guy before he retires but Disha has plans of her own. She is in love with Tahir and is ready to take any measure for getting married to him. She is convinced that Tahir is the key to her happiness and her dreams. Tahir is an auto driver and a small-time criminal which Disha is unaware of. He along with his friend Chandu commits petty crimes to make some quick bucks on the side. During her quest of getting married to Tahir against the wishes of her grandfather, Disha along with Tahir and Chandu crosses paths with a local strongman Salim. Disha, an innocent girl whose dreams get shattered gets entangled in the mess because of her blind faith. She is caught up in a dangerous situation for no wrongdoing of her own. Will she be able to come out of this whirlpool or will she bear the brunt of her single mistake, her blind faith? Will she get a second chance, or will she be the collateral damage? The movie will soon be out to answer these questions.

Hindi Language.name: Damned Graveyard
Hindi Language.description: This story is based on an incident in which a Priest is shown who is the care taker of a cemetery and a builder is to illegally grab the land of that cemetery but Priest stops him from doing so and that builder kills him and builds a beautiful bungalow for his daughter in place of that cemetery After that the bungalow is cursed forever.

Hindi Language.name: Before You Die
Hindi Language.description: 'Before You Die...', a film based on how a cancer patient and her family handle the crisis and trauma superbly well in an exemplary way.

Hindi Language.name: Mandali
Hindi Language.description: It mirrors the journey of a man and his struggle to uphold righteousness in times of diminishing social conscience and downfall of cultural and traditional values.

Hindi Language.name: Sivudu
Hindi Language.description: The plot revolves around the crimes in a locality. A jolly youngster gets affected by the activities. His family and life get into danger. Things take a new turn as he decides to fight back.

Hindi Language.name: Chhipkali
Hindi Language.description: Our limited understanding of the world, our misconceptions about life, derived only from what we directly witness. It highlights our incapability to look beyond the stereotyped realism.

Hindi Language.name: Joothan
Hindi Language.description: When getting transferred in a remote village, government School teacher Santosh fight against caste discrimination. However, he encounters with unexpected hurdles and his own identity gets questioned.

Hindi Language.name: Aamantran
Hindi Language.description: While on a photography assignment in the valley of Bhadherwah (Jammu Kashmir), a middle-aged celebrated photographer finds himself involved in a romantic affair with the teenage daughter of the Resort manager. Meantime, the other woman (a novelist and heartbroken in a relationship in her past) staying in the same resort, develops the soft corner for him but the photographer's emotional dilemma pushes him to a pang of guilt that leads to something which he has never expected in his life.

Hindi Language.name: Beti Hamari Anmol
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around Anmol, a young woman from a small town. She faces challenges posed by societal norms that hinder girls from such backgrounds in education, career, and marriage. Adding to her plight, her short stature leads to social bias, earning her the label of a "Dwarf." Despite unfavorable circumstances, Anmol's determination empowers her to confront hostility from in-laws and society. She becomes a doctor in the hospital where her father works as a custodian. Her journey restores honor and pride in her family. Anmol's saga resonates deeply, portraying how one's resolute spirit can triumph over any obstruction in life.

Hindi Language.name: -A Akash Ganga
Hindi Language.description: A journey through the life of "Surbahar" legend Annapurna Devi, by her disciple Nityanand Haldipur, the bansuri master.

Hindi Language.name: Wings of Freedom
Hindi Language.description: Arefa a 23-year-old girl, belongs to an Orthodox lower-middle-class family dealing with her inner and outer conflicts during her young age as she is getting pressed to get married.

Hindi Language.name: The Ghost Thesis
Hindi Language.description: The Ghost Thesis is a paranormal science thriller based on a thesis by a professor who is an expert paranormal activist and his protege Aditya.

Hindi Language.name: Hotspot
Hindi Language.description: A show about cyber-crime in India. It narrates both sides of the coin - the story of the victims as well as the villains. It shows how the perpetrators snare the victims through various methods and how cyber-crime destroys the lives of ordinary people.

Hindi Language.name: Phas Gaye Yaaro
Hindi Language.description: based on the fictional horror story about a witch who roams around a jungle resort and abducts every men at night when they are alone outside the resort and only leaves their underwear behind causing many disappearances over the months.

Hindi Language.name: Badmashi
Hindi Language.description: Badmashi or A Gangster ki Love Story - A Fictional Action-Romance-Comedy Story of a Gangster and Four Boys Who Want Quick Money.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome to Kashmir
Hindi Language.description: The girl visits Kashmir and one of her psycho,drug addicted social media follower 'Zulfi' kidnaps her. Zulfi is under influence of a fake baba who provokes him. She proves her stand about women and fight back.

Hindi Language.name: Agnisakshi... Ek Samjhauta
Hindi Language.description: Satvik Bhosle and Jeevika Rane are happiest on their big fat wedding day. So what causes him to divorce her soon after?

Hindi Language.name: Rabb Di Awaaz
Hindi Language.description: As ratings drop, and the radio station struggles hard to stay afloat in the post-pandemic world, a contestant on the show offers a fresh perspective at life.

Hindi Language.name: Aisa Q
Hindi Language.description: A chief minister of the state is assassinated at a public location one evening. And the murder appears mysterious. The murder mystery seems to have many suspects. Who is the culprit?

Hindi Language.name: Guest Unwanted
Hindi Language.description: An angry father seeks deadly revenge on his daughter's rapists and murderer

Hindi Language.name: Triple Cross
Hindi Language.description: Three strangers, A Hitman - Haider Pasha, A Gangster - Amjad Daniyal and a Sidekick - Abeer Gul gets trapped in a Carnivorous environment. Things are not what they seems. Outcast, Betrayed, all three suspecting each other are fighting for their life. Trust is the name of the game.

Hindi Language.name: Nobody Wants Half aka Pura Glass Pani
Second Mother
Hindi Language.description: A middle class family is struggling for its daily life survival and an upper class family is willing for their son recovery. Can both family get resolutions by helping each other? Let us see in Movie Second Mother.

Hindi Language.name: Wajid
Hindi Language.description: Wajid, a young carefree boy has aspirations to start his career in social media to achieve fame. His elder brother, Mehtab is a cab driver and is of traditional thinking and opposes his stance of it, stating his dream is useless and it will take him nowhere in life, instead persuades him(Wajid) to take up simple jobs for a living, which is also supported by their father, however Wajid remains unmoved and wants to stick to his aim, and he enjoys the sole support of his sister Heena from his family regarding his views. Mehtab has a customer(Kritika) for his cab, who works in a call center to whom he regularly picks and drops. One fine day, Kritika spots some of her friends who are involved in shooting from the cab while commuting to work, she suddenly asks Mehtab to stop the car, after which she goes out and meets them and comes back to the cab to go for work, which catches the attention of Mehtab. Exited, he instantly asks her about the work of her friends they are involved in. Kritika tells him, that her friends work for a social media platform, and they are getting great response for their videos, they shoot and post in the social media. Upon which Mehtab tells her, that his younger brother Wajid is also very active in social media and is looking for a relevant job. He(Mehtab) requests her if she can recommend his younger brother for a job there, to which she responds, she will ask her friends and will let him know. Eventually, Mehtab forwards a contact to Wajid and asks him to get in touch with them for job. Wajid goes and meets Mr. Ketan(Boss) for a job, who interviews him and eventually hires him. Wajid starts working for Ketan and they are involved in shooting prank videos with random citizens and make money out of it. Soon Wajid's work is appreciated by Ketan and he becomes the team lead of all the employees and also achieves good support from everyone. Ketan enjoys good success and revenue from the prank videos that his employees shoot, but he scarcely rewards them back for their hard work as he is a very greedy and selfish man. This earns him the displeasure of Wajid and all other employees. As a result, he promises them, he will give the credit to everyone, by adopting an independent way of working outside Ketan's knowledge. Meanwhile, Wajid's father and Mehtab watch the prank videos shot by Wajid and his team, and are not happy from his work, stating it to be immoral, to which Wajid responds by trying to clear the misconception to Mehtab. Whereas Sonal(Mehtab's girlfriend) is supportive of Wajid's initiatives and persuades Mehtab to support Wajid in his cause, but he disagrees with her in it. Also, Mehtab's father upon learning that Mehtab loves Sonal, fixes the marriage of Sonal and Mehtab. One night, while Sonal and Mehtab are discussing about their future wedding, walking on a deserted road, a Car hits mehtab from back and disappears, leaving mehtab seriously wounded. A distressed Sonal after witnessing the horrific scene desperately cries for help, to which a passer by responds, they have witnessed some prank videos on this street before and this might well be a prank attempt to fool them, refuse to help her and leave. On the other side, Wajid is informed of Mehtab's accident over call and rushes to hospital to see Mehtab, where his entire family is present. After seeing him for a while, Wajid comes out of hospital room, where Sonal follows him and confronts Wajid furiously for his prank job, and blames him completely for the current situation of Mehtab, stating Mehtab was indeed right about him and she herself was wrong in supporting him earlier. As Wajid is broken from her fiery arrows of words, they both hear the call of heena, that Mehtab cant breath anymore. they both rush back to hospital and discover Mehtab is dead, leaving everyone grieving over it. Later, Wajid gets criticized by his father as well, which leaves him enraged and he furiously arrives at Ketan's office, and confronts him to stop the prank work forever, on which Ketan disagrees with him and orders him to leave, as a result it turns into a major fight between the two, leaving Ketan wounded. Wajid is handed over to police as an aftermath of it. Upon interrogation, initially he refuses to speak , but after being forced and threatened by officers, and he finally reveals the entire story to police. Upon learning about his story, police officers release him, after warning him. Meanwhile, the prank angle leading to Mehtab's death and Wajid's strong revolt against it, is now being cooked up by media in the city to make profit out of it.

Hindi Language.name: Ayassh Dil
Hindi Language.description: Based on a novel, Ayassh Dil depicts the rise and fall of a man hailing from a humble background achieving the pinnacle of success in the field of investigative journalism.

Hindi Language.name: India's Sons
Hindi Language.description: India's Sons is a feature length documentary film throwing light on lives that have been destroyed because of false accusations of rape.

Hindi Language.name: Bicycle Days
Hindi Language.description: A boy and his mentor share memories through cycling, as bikes let anyone revisit childhood moments before time machines exist.

Hindi Language.name: Ayena
Hindi Language.description: In the aftermath of an acid attack that changed their life forever, 'Ayena' explores moments of friendship, resilience and the daily negotiations of two extraordinary young Indian women.

Hindi Language.name: Dear Latika
Hindi Language.description: A girl who was destroyed by the people who loved her. Latika is a nave, cheerful, regular girl, one of billions of girls who have absolutely no exposure to love, to have sex, to keep a male friend before marriage because they are raised to be a 'good girl'. But the same girl is expected to miraculously become a sex goddess overnight when she gets married. People keep making decision for Latika. There is a husband who doesn't want her but would not let her go because it might stain the family's reputation. There is a mother who would not keep her because it will stain her family's reputation. Then there is Mayank, who perhaps loved her but didn't care whether she feels the same. And there is Latika, who is fighting it all in her own way. But would that be enough?

Hindi Language.name: Kalpataru (The Tree)
Hindi Language.description: THIS FILM EXPOSES HOW POLLUTION AFFECTING YOUR WATER/AIR/HEALTH.

Hindi Language.name: Explosive
Hindi Language.description: Kiran takes a cab to go from Navi Mumbai to Thane but faces a grave situation when she finds that the cab driver is part of a terror attack. On the other hand the Inspector Tejas is given the reponsibility to save the city.

Hindi Language.name: Mid Day Meeal
Hindi Language.description: The struggle of chef from 5 star hotel while contributing in the rural class gone lot more difficult when it starts affecting his personal life. Will he able to counter these difficulties and stand for his dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Divit
Hindi Language.description: This films is about a middle class boy named Shobhit who's a college student. His mother is no more since long back and hence there's no one who understands him. His father is an irritating character. Somehow he's attracted towards Aryan's life. Shobhit's friend Rohan tips him off as to what can happen while being connected to Aryan. But Shobhit doesn't seem to listen to him and gets involved in drug peddling business with Aryan. Shobhit thinks Aryan is a friend but he's actually not a friend. Aryan uses Shobhit to do his experiments with his new drugs. Shobhit becomes a drug addict. Aryan stops the drug supplies to Shobhit and the consequences are not so good. Shobhit kills Aryan in the end. When Shobhit's father gets to know all about this, he locks Shobhit up inside a room. Shobhit faces withdrawals and hallucinations. His condition gets critical. Gradually, he loses his control over himself. When his friend Rohan opens the door and enters inside the room, Shobhit sees Aryan who's already been killed by him. But because of his bad condition, he attacks Rohan thinking that he's Aryan. Rohan dies.

Hindi Language.name: Jafar
Hindi Language.description: A young boy comes to Mumbai to earn money and support his family, but ends up in a deadly trap - becoming a sharpshooter for underworld don, Mamu. Will Ayesha help the police catch Jafar, or will she lie to protect him?

Hindi Language.name: Lafzon Mein Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Raj interrupts his studies, disappointing everyone but his kind sister-in-law, Geeta Bhabhi, who encourages him to pursue new interests in music. Raj's life is given fresh excitement when Priya comes into it.

Hindi Language.name: Mom @ Work
Hindi Language.description: It's where the chaos of motherhood collides with the challenges of the corporate world.

Hindi Language.name: The Last Coffee
Hindi Language.description: On the verge of a divorce, Rehaan and Iram meet for one last time over coffee. But they get stuck in a snowstorm and are left with no choice except to confront their pent-up feelings.

Hindi Language.name: Dark Rose: The Name of Fear
Hindi Language.description: Choices between right or wrong, sanjana had two choice either to let her Ex reveals her secret or to do whatever he telling. But she don't know that it will change her life forever, Let's see what will sanjana choose.

Hindi Language.name: Cinemaa Zindabad
Hindi Language.description: A group of artists and a film director struggle through their journey in the film industry, showing their personal life too, from their happy, lighter moments to their serious, sad, heart-touching experiences.

Hindi Language.name: Abey Yaar Lagg Gayi
Hindi Language.description: Human desires have no end nor end of life's needs. In the race of these desires and needs, five human beings meet at a crossroads through the streets of life. These five take the path of theft to fulfill their desires and needs. For this, what could have been better for them than a leader's house. After all, if the money of the public comes to the public then what is wrong. The plan of the five was successful and they managed to steal. But luck had something else approved.It seems that the number 8 is not a fate of his fate. The Prime Minister's announcement of demonetisation on November 8 at 8:00 pm changed all the fortunes. The money for which they were running back till today is trying to go far away from the same money today. It did not take so much effort to loot it, as it now took to hide it. It is so strange that if there is no money, there is trouble and if there is trouble. Where would the stolen money go after all this money was scrapped in demonetisation. One side leader fell behind them, and the other side luck did not take the name of ending the problems of theft on them, so the five together started saving lives. They began to start putting the stolen money at the right place. In the midst of bad luck, the five managed to get the money right, but the money does not reach the five. One of the friends who was orphan, would have deposited these money in orphanage house and some money reaches everyone but this part of the race behind the money has taught everyone a lesson that the money is necessary for life but not so much that one loses ones happiness behind it. The real purpose of life is a happier life.

Hindi Language.name: Hara Sindoor
Hindi Language.description: Haroli is one such village that is not yet on the map of India. Here reigns Amma Ji, a dictator who is wielding all the power in the name of tradition. Rani, an ordinary girl and a devotee of Amma Ji, has to stand against her own hymn to liberate the people of the village from Amma Ji.

Hindi Language.name: Lost and Found in Singapore
Hindi Language.description: A journey through the vibrant streets of Singapore as Dhruv and Sitara delve into their personal journeys of love and friendship.

Hindi Language.name: AB LLB
Hindi Language.description: A Struggling Actor becomes a lawyer to fulfil his father's last wish. Based on his acting skills in Court Room, he starts winning Cases and gets a chance in Movies. But he promised to win one last case where a father killed his son and his girlfriend, whose elder brother is a town's successful lawyer and a goon.

Hindi Language.name: GillHarry
Hindi Language.description: Harry hails from Naasik, comes to Mumbai to find work. He meets a sensitive girl Gill, who is a consultant and Gill helps Harry to find work in Mumbai. Eventually, GillHarry fall in love and plan to spend their life together, but life had already planned a curriculum for them. They do live together but without letting each other know.

Hindi Language.name: Panch Kriti Five Elements
Hindi Language.description: Depicts overcoming challenges while focusing on important social movements - Environment, saving and educating the girl child, Gender Parity/Empowerment, Spirituality and a deeply ingrained Indian value system that Love Lives Forever.

Hindi Language.name: Marne Ke Dar Se Mere Dil
Hindi Language.description: One fateful night , Samadhan reluctantly goes to the police station to report a dead body he saw on his society pavement, But silly inspector is suspecting him as a murderer instead, more complications waiting to push him to the brink

Hindi Language.name: The Scavenger of Dreams
Hindi Language.description: Follows the story of a family in Calcutta who collect waste from one of the city's wealthiest localities.

Hindi Language.name: Love Kills
Hindi Language.description: Murder, passion, politics -- the Madhumita Shukla case is underway.

Hindi Language.name: Brij Ke Gopal
Hindi Language.description: Lord Krishna incarnates as a human on Earth to end the agony of his devotees and battle against evil, restoring the faith of people in good.

Hindi Language.name: Jaal
Hindi Language.description: Ved girlfriend Khanak gives a book to Ved & asked him to read and do as written in it, Ved gets trapped in a ghostly situation. Strange things start happening to him.

Hindi Language.name: Indian Case File - Masoomiyat Ki Taskari
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Veerta and Ahmed together capture Madam Ji, but Pari was still away from them. Then they force Madam Ji to speak the truth and get reached the same place where Pari was getting a deal and expose the real boss of this racket. After all, who will be it? To know more, Watch the full episode of "Masoomiyat Ki Taskari" Only on Dangal Tv Channel.

Hindi Language.name: Writers Block
Hindi Language.description: An eminent writer finds a chance to go out of the city's cacophony to write his new horror film script, along with his wife. The journey was amazing until they met with an accident. Post-accident, the writer and his wife start experiencing unexplainable things. The writer, who had come there to write his book, witnesses the unusual, as the house seems haunted. The question arises: are they the victims, or are they the ones haunting others?

Hindi Language.name: Alex Bond
Hindi Language.description: This story is about a man named Alex, who follows the rules of the society but does not back down from his principles. He likes to live at a secluded place far away in the forest where he can spend time with nature, but one day a guest comes, named Bond to his house and stays with him the whole night, many normal things happen in which the guest also talks. But in the end something is revealed which starts a new story.

Hindi Language.name: GE Week - Ghost Encounters
Hindi Language.description: The team of Ghost Encounters, investigate some of the most haunted locations of India, in this Halloween Special. The team comes across entities haunting abandoned hospital to the infamous D'Mello House to places where insane Doctor used to experiment on his patients. Nothing gets crazier, insane and spookier than this.

Hindi Language.name: Labour Pain - an unending saga
Hindi Language.description: Shankar and Manju, daily wage migrant workers, living miles away from home for work that to them is worship. Our journey with them brings us to the apocalyptic days of an un-foreseen pandemic that upends the lives of millions like them.

Hindi Language.name: Raebareli
Hindi Language.description: Karan Singh, who has completely done the city of Rae Bareli in his fist has completely destroyed the whole of U. P. I was slowly spreading my black empire. Shankar Mishra used to help him in spreading this empire.

Hindi Language.name: Madhur Model
Hindi Language.description: Madhur Model is a stand-up comedy series where emerging comedians take the mic for short sets while host Madhur Virli and a live panel place bets, banter, and react - blending performance with playful stakes.

Hindi Language.name: The Anglistanis
Hindi Language.description: A regular student house in London. A regular bunch of students and ex-students. This is their home from home - only home is India! Meet the Anglistanis, a bunch of "Desis" trying to make their way in the big city. Arpit; tall, handsome, studying... or is he? Sameer; funny, greedy, lazy - he's here to study... what was that subject? Kalpana; she's a model student... and a nag! Rehan; he's a student of IT... and love! Jignesh; he's a student of life... and trying to earn a crust. Arjun; he's the master of the house... or is he? The house is bursting at the seams and landlord-cum-father figure Kuldeep is trying to keep order. But when the beautiful Nisha, Arpit's old flame from India, asks for a place to stay, their world is turned upside down with love triangles, gangsters and even cross dressing Mujra dancers!

Hindi Language.name: Ramrajya
Hindi Language.description: Ram Rajya is a film shows how Lord Rama's principles can be used in order to solve new age problems like corruption, caste discrimination, religious conflicts etc.

Hindi Language.name: Deep in the Woods Death Warrant
Hindi Language.description: The story is about an unknown virus that will infect the whole town and a team of 10 forest officers will go deep in the woods to cut the roots of this virus.

Hindi Language.name: Pledge to Protect
Hindi Language.description: The reality-based Pledge To Protect movie construct chronicles harsh realities of women, children enslaved for driving profits for human trafficking industry.

Hindi Language.name: Khel Kood Aur Bhoot
Hindi Language.description: This is a story inspired by true events of six friends who embark on a documentary-film-making adventure to figure out whether ghosts exists or not. Their interviews with the common people lead them to a supposedly-haunted house in the suburb of Panvel near Mumbai, where they come face-to-face with the frightening truth.

Hindi Language.name: Mystery of Journey
Hindi Language.description: After forsaking his family and religion, a husband finds his wife is demoniacally possessed.

Hindi Language.name: Joy-The Feathers of Life
Hindi Language.description: Joy is the story of an artist who is chained by his past and trapped inside his emotional bubble. On this journey of self-discovery will Joy be able to triumph over his fears?

Hindi Language.name: Les soeurs Pathan
Hindi Language.description: Sofia and Suzain, two survivors of the 2002 anti-Muslim massacres, are coming of age in Gujarat, India.

Hindi Language.name: Dare and Lovely
Hindi Language.description: Dare and Lovely is a first Urdu-Hindi comedy film produced under Pakistani and Indian film industry. The film was announced to be released in June 2022 but due to some internal issues between both countries.

Hindi Language.name: Criminals
Hindi Language.description: Hitman Haider accepts a contract to eliminate Amjad for Baba Khan, but a meeting with Abeer leads them to a mysterious trap. To survive, they must trust each other, and battle an unknown foe, testing their loyalties along the way.

Hindi Language.name: Achievers
Hindi Language.description: Achievers follows the emotional, often harsh reality of youth attempting government exam and career preparations. It explores themes of personal sacrifice, growing apart from friends.

Hindi Language.name: Tasveer Ishq Ki
Hindi Language.description: A romantic musical love story and their journey to understand the essence of true love

Hindi Language.name: Romeo ke Funday Laajawaab
Hindi Language.description: 'Romeo ke funday laajawaab' is a fantastic family entertainment romantic- comedy hindi feature film, about the smart, educated Romie who in pursuit of his love for Julie.

Hindi Language.name: Waster
Hindi Language.description: Vijay Malhotra is a 75 year old single brat, a hard nut, a deadpan and an alcoholic, after spending 30 years in prison he comes out in the dystopian society to rediscover his city where he is completely alone with the longings of his memories but in all the grief he still has a reason to relive by finding his longtime girlfriend Vinni. Out of surprise he is wandering in the dense streets of Mumbai, travelling in the modern transport system, spending time in city malls to find the address of Vinni. Meanwhile he meet one of his old time chap who never came to see him after he got arrested. He takes the address of Vinni from him but later finds that she had relocated to Mudh Island. Finally when Vijay meets Vinni at her high rise apartment he discovers that she is totally changed and have no sympathy left for him. He feels tormented and decides to end his life because neither his beloved city nor his past darling have accepted him. Lonely Vijay one day coincidentally met another woman Sujata from his past life and he get another ray of hope to live. Sujata invites Vijay for dinner but before he could reach her house he get arrested for a past offense.

Hindi Language.name: Chattan
Hindi Language.description: In the bustling city where the shadows of crime lurk in every alley, a cop stood as a beacon of unwavering commitment to law and duty.

Hindi Language.name: Desi Vibes with Shehnaaz Gill
Hindi Language.description: Presenting the first ever quirkiest show, which is made of only and only pure and best quality "DIL".

Hindi Language.name: Juni the Last Prayer
Hindi Language.description: Juni is based on the Misuse of 498A, myths around God, religion, and spirituality. A young entrepreneur is facing domestic and business issues at the same time. Will he overcome them all?

Hindi Language.name: Bharateeyans
Hindi Language.description: Six strangers meet at an unknown place and start their journey without knowing what dangers await them.

Hindi Language.name: Sachin: The Ultimate Winner
Hindi Language.description: A school boy named Sachin wants to be a successful cricketer like Sachin Tendulkar. Unfortunately Sachin meets with an accident and gets paralyzed. Will he make a full recovery and become a cricketer?

Hindi Language.name: Coding - Future software developer
Hindi Language.description: Story revolves around a college student who is pursuing a degree in business administration decides to learn how to code in order to grow his career, but he encounters numerous difficulties along the way.

Hindi Language.name: Sevak - The Confessions
Hindi Language.description: Nothing is what it seems as the race is on to seek the truth from a dark web woven of terror and deceit.

Hindi Language.name: Khudbudi
Hindi Language.description: A 26 year old girl life changes by the sudden death of her entire family. During which she started hallucinating about a 10 year old girl, But once what was only hallucinations ,came to be a much bigger part of her life.

Hindi Language.name: Dhaage
Hindi Language.description: What happens when the threads of destiny bring you face to face with your lost love, once again? Soban, a middle-aged man is in search of solace for his battered heart. And there is someone who is about to knock at the closed doors of his heart.

Hindi Language.name: Bailadila
Hindi Language.description: After his mom's death, 10-year-old Rinku lives with artist-brother Jiten in Bailadila. Jiten's frustrations strain their relationship. Rinku bonds with Dharmendra, explores and entangled in the life of the town.

Hindi Language.name: Tanishka
Hindi Language.description: Dedicated to the most important time period of an artist's life - childhood, the eponymous film 'Tanishka' explores the journey of rhythm in an 8-year-old soul. The film tries to capture the formative years of her learning Bharatanatyam. The narrative of the film, constructed in non-linear form, shows her practice, day-to-day life, surroundings, traveling, and performance. Knowingly and unknowingly her life is practicing and living the art form. Even though only a child, performing Slokas, Rasas, Shastra, and other exercises are integral to her daily life - many times in the presence of the audience. At the same time, her childhood innocence is intact, taking her on the path of becoming a devoted artiste of an old and traditional dance form of Indian culture.

Hindi Language.name: Balli Vs Birju
Hindi Language.description: Balli (Kiran Kumar) plays the main Antagonist. His illegal government operates in Jaipur district of Rajasthan; the police are his happy pony. He's the mastermind of many illegal and criminal ventures with access to the top who is targeted by Birju. Birju is the son of Mangal Singh (Raju Kher) Birju's sister is married to Balli's nephew. But Balli brutally murders Birju's sister, because she brought fewer dowries in her marriage. Due to this, Birju kills Balli's sister (Nilima Singh) and nephew. After it he goes to Jaipur where he stays at Master Atar Singh (Raza Murad)'s home. Birju's only aim is to eliminate Balli. Master ji's granddaughter Ritu (Gunjan Pant) falls in love with Birju but Birju does not even see her because her destination was different. Birju starts killing all the goons of Balli one by one. A common man killed King Balli's goons in his area; this news brings a lot of disrepute to Balli. Now the only goal of Balli's life is to avenge the death of his sister, nephew and his goons, so that the fear of Balli remains in the mind of the people. For which he starts searching for Birju so that he can avenge blood with blood.

Hindi Language.name: A Day Turns Daark
Hindi Language.description: A Day Turns Daark is a story of a tenacious young man's quest to overcome his obsession with guilt. He blames himself for an incident that changes his life. He finds himself racked with repulsion for what he has done.

Hindi Language.name: Meeraa
Hindi Language.description: Young and adrift, Meeraa yearns for a relationship as she navigates through life. Love blossoms when she meets Naina, but the latter might be harbouring a secret of her own.

Hindi Language.name: Sadhu Kishan Singh
Hindi Language.description: The film "Sadhu Kishan Singh" is based on the book about Sadhu Kishan Singh. It tells the true story of Sadhu Kishan Singh. Sadhu Kishan Singh returned to Punjab in September 1958, after years of spreading the gospel in the Himalayas. Seventeen years earlier, he had been expelled from his home for following Jesus. Upon his return, he learned that his parents had died earlier that year and that he had a younger sister, Shanta, who was born in 1953. The movie was released in 2023 in Punjab.

Hindi Language.name: Age 29
Hindi Language.description: This is a comedy drama movie. Story is all about a boy who is a drunker , makes all the efforts (jugaad) to get some wine / whiskey / rum / vodka whatever possible after being forbidden by his mother. Once he makes his things bring to his home with the help of a pizza delivery boy. He doesn't know the consequences of doing so and a painful day comes when he gets so so much that he doesn't even know where he is buried alive leaving his parents crying behind.

Hindi Language.name: Masoom Kaatil
Hindi Language.description: Raised in a family devoted to animal protection, a 17-year-old turns to violence against butchers. Meeting Vedika changes his mission's direction.

Hindi Language.name: Ballia Kaand
Hindi Language.description: Ye Kahani Hai Bala ki, jo apne dushmano ko jab thokta hai to goli seedhe G***d pe lagti - Bala Ko nafrat hai dhokhe se - Par kya hoga jab uska pyaar aur uska Dost Raghav Bala ke sath Gaddari karenge - Dekhiya Ballia Kaand.

Hindi Language.name: Mujhe school nahi janna
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around an adolescent school going girl from an affluent family belonging to a family of four consisting of her parents both in high flying jobs and an elder brother. The girl goes into deep emotional turmoil cutting her herself completely away from the real world.

Hindi Language.name: The Cannabis Diary
Hindi Language.description: Traumatized from his past killings, Arjun Singh looks for clues related to his nightmares. During his investigation, Arjun Singh discovers the real importance of Medical Marijuana for the mankind.

Hindi Language.name: The Butterflies
Hindi Language.description: The childhood trauma turns two girls into killers who seek revenge from their molester but they soon realize, there are more girls out there who seek avenging.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Mere Wo Hain
Hindi Language.description: Manu adores Bollywood and dreams of a dramatic life. When Ram Vikas saves her from an accident, she falls in love with him instantly and brings him home to marry him. Although Manu's parents are initially surprised, they eventually support her, setting some conditions. Together, they face various challenges, but their love story thrives with the enchanting touch of Bollywood romance.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Hello Whats-Up
Hindi Language.description: After the patriarch of the Sharma family passes away, many extended family members gather. Amidst the mourning, Suman begins to receive messages from his late father. What is the mystery behind this paranormal phenomenon?

Hindi Language.name: Hallution
Hindi Language.description: Fueled by vengeance and betrayal, this gripping drama follows Avinash Kumar as he navigates the complexities of love and family, leading to a shocking finale that will leave you breathless.

Hindi Language.name: The Legal Battle - Intazar Insaf Ka
Hindi Language.description: This documentary shows the problems of Indian Judiciary system. More than 4 CR cases are pending in different courts of India.

Hindi Language.name: Scrap
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of Police officer Romil Rana, he wants to end the crime in the society at any cost. Chinu Pandit wanted to make himself a big gangster but is killed by Rana in an encounter. While Rana's wife investigates this encounter, an assistant officer named Gaayakwad has malicious plans to destroy Rana's career for good. Will Rana be able to escape the conspiracy, and reveal the truth of crime in the society?

Hindi Language.name: The Raid
Hindi Language.description: While specific plot details are sparse, it is generally categorized as part of his "power-packed" dramatic and thriller performances on digital platforms. Abhansh Kumar is an Indian actor who has appeared in a web series titled The Raid.

Hindi Language.name: The House
Hindi Language.description: The story is about a couple who moves to Mumbai but the wife is upset because has just lost her child the husband tries a lot to keep her happy but all in vain. When all of a sudden the wife starts feeling a presence of someone in the house. He feels that she is still upset about her child and she must be imagining things but finally calls a lady who tells them that there is a ghost in the house. When the police inquiries about the same they realize that two couples who had rented the house in the past had done planchet and called a gosht and left. Will the lady be able to take the gost out or will the couple have to deal with the consequences thats the story of " The House"

Hindi Language.name: Istikhara, New York
Hindi Language.description: Reza, a 20-year-old aspiring Broadway actor, hustles as a food delivery courier to make ends meet.

Hindi Language.name: Surviva
Hindi Language.description: A man is being trapped in a confined space, bound and locked inside a car. All he have is a half-filled water bottle, a cell phone, and a gun - your only lifelines to the outside world. The situation intensifies as he receive calls from three individuals, each one recognizing him with distinct personalities and names. The clock is ticking; every second counts as he engage in this adrenaline-fueled battle to outsmart fate and break free from this suffocating or deal.

Hindi Language.name: Aa Bhi Ja O Piya
Hindi Language.description: Kaushal owns his own nursery in Jharkhand village meets Kalpana, a city girl belonging to an army family is on a research tour. Feelings develop between them but circumstances force them to rethink if they are actually made for each other.

Hindi Language.name: Dilon Mein Uphaan
Hindi Language.description: A retired courtesan Sanno and her dance troupe members live a simple yet harmonious life in a small town, where their familial bonding tides them over several hardships. Their peaceful rhythm is disrupted by the shocking rape of Simmi, Sanno's specially abled adolescent daughter. Outraged by this brutal crime, the townspeople take to the streets to demand immediate legal action. The police finally launches an investigation into the matter as a result of protests and public pressure. However, it is clear that the efficacy of the criminal justice system is marred by corruption, bureaucratic delays and red tapism. The legal set up is put to test in this small town, when the people begin to demand accountability and question whether women can rely on the current legal mechanism to ensure their bodily safety. Is justice delayed, justice denied? Will the legal system protect Simmi's human rights? Or will frustrated civilians be compelled to take it upon themselves to serve justice?

Hindi Language.name: Srinagar
Hindi Language.description: Based on today's time Kashmiri Pandit issue, The Hindus of the Kashmir Valley, a large majority of whom were Kashmiri Pandits, were forced to flee the Kashmir valley as a result of terrorism, on or after 20 January 1990.

Hindi Language.name: Banaras ke Rasiya
Hindi Language.description: *Banaras ke rasiya* is the story of a banarasi middle class family. The story revolves around Sada shiv's family , and Rashi love Story.

Hindi Language.name: Pyara Kulhad
Hindi Language.description: There is a boy named Vidhan who lives with his mother, he is very smart in studies, his mother makes handicraft items and Vidhan also helps his mother in her work... A very beautiful girl studies in Vidhan's college, named Vidhi, she is the only daughter of Prem Kumar, the city's biggest businessman, Vidhi gets impressed by Vidhan's good nature and starts loving him, slowly Vidhan He also starts loving Vidhi but Vidhan's mother understands that relationship should always be with equals. Prem Kumar shows photos of many rich boys to Vidhi for Vidhi's marriage, but Vidhi rejects everyone, then Vidhi tells about Vidhan that there is a boy in my college named Vidhan, I love him very much and he Prem Kumar gets angry on hearing this and says that I will not marry you to any poor boy.... Will Prem Kumar give his only daughter's hand to a poor boy Vidhan? Will Vidhi be able to convince Prem Kumar to marry Vidhan? To know the answers to all these questions, you will have to come to the theater and watch the film.

Hindi Language.name: Smile Hearts
Hindi Language.description: Healthy and successful life make with smile Heart

Hindi Language.name: Bed No 17
Hindi Language.description: BedNo17 is a Film based on the true IncidenT. Story tell about the love shared by a father and a Son. Father didn't tell his son how to live, he lived it so that his son can see and learn.

Hindi Language.name: Ghaznavi
Hindi Language.description: Follows a man who finds it hard to identify himself as he has lost his memory and the world seems new to him.

Hindi Language.name: Ananth Anaadih Vadnagar
Hindi Language.description: Archaeologists and historians reveal the buried history of Vadnagar-one of India's oldest living towns across seven dynasties. The documentary delves deep into the archaeological explorations conducted by the ASI and studies scriptural evidence to narrate the story of Vadnagar.

Hindi Language.name: Akhri Khat
Hindi Language.description: Inspired by True Events. The true story of an actress, Nazish Jahangir, her ordeal, and her journey of depression. Society labels her as a bad person, trolls harass her on social media, and her family wants her to earn for them but will not provide her any support. The one she loves and wants to lean on has his own troubles that she is burdened with. Written and Performed by Nazish Janagir herself.

Hindi Language.name: Powai
Hindi Language.description: Powai is a triptych of stories about three women from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds living in the titular developing suburb of Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: Alert Code Red
Hindi Language.description: Raghav comes home and finds his wife Chaya's dead body. On the other hand, the real scandal begins once Jerry joins the group. One by one everyone starts parting their ways.

Hindi Language.name: Star Vs Food Survival
Hindi Language.description: See the thrilling escapades, delicious discoveries and unforgettable dining experiences in the Indian wilderness. Celebrities venture out of their comfort zones and embark on an epic survival adventure to forage unique ingredients to create tasty dishes.

Hindi Language.name: Point Blank: A Look Into the Heart of India's Gun Culture
Hindi Language.description: India has some of the world's strictest gun laws. Yet, guns are extremely prevalent in our country, both legally and illegally - second only to the US in the number of privately owned fire-arms. Why so?

Hindi Language.name: Andhvishwas
Hindi Language.description: Sachin and Rishi navigate the ups and downs of living together, Sachin's superstitious beliefs like horoscope predictions, boiling milk mishaps to encounters with crossing cats.

Hindi Language.name: Article 25
Hindi Language.description: Article 25 is an article of the Indian constitution where laws about Indian religion. this movie is based on that where some characters are planning for the conversion of Hindu People.

Hindi Language.name: Vanshree
Hindi Language.description: A brave forest officer is working hard to stop the smuggling of forest wood and inculcate social awareness among people. Will her efforts yield a favourable outcome?

Hindi Language.name: Love Jaisa Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Love Jaisa Pyaar is a Fictional Love Story of Vidya and Rajan. In This Story Filmmaker showcase How Porn Addiction effect the physical and Mental Health Of Film Hero Rajan ..And How Rajan has Destroyed his Own Life along with his True Love Vidya.. The Story Of Love Jaisa Pyaar Shows How in today's world the increasing porn addiction effects the physical, mental, personal and social life. And the Most Important it also Destroyed the decision Making Capacity of today's Generation. In this story Filmmaker had also given the Solution with the help of psychiatric Doctors And His intense Research of 3yrs Along With Real Case Studies .

Hindi Language.name: Antim Sukh
Hindi Language.description: A couple shifts to a new house and observes unusual activities which turns out to be a horrifying fact later on

Hindi Language.name: Saaya the Mystry
Hindi Language.description: A boy who leaves his entire family for his girlfriend and they both get married then he goes with his wife to her house. It is realized that apart from the two of them, there is a third person in the house who is watching over them.

Hindi Language.name: Tallika
Hindi Language.description: 21 Years old Sweety returns to her native village in Gujarat all the way from America to meet her childhood buddy. Sweety's reunion with her school friends gives her joy but she has to find her childhood Friend.

Hindi Language.name: Kurukshetra
Hindi Language.description: From an Indian epic scripture "Mahabharat" said by Ved Vyas and Written by Lord Ganesh. The great war between Pandavas and Kauravas known as the Mahabharata War in Kurukshetra.

Hindi Language.name: Merit Animal
Hindi Language.description: A cycle racing competition is being held on a hillside on the outskirts of the city. As the race is about to begin, one of the participants named Varun, whose age is 16 years goes missing. People start looking for him. On the other side, Varun finds himself in a remote village where there is no sign of any modern technology. Varun was spotted by a poor couple Meera (age 30) and Mohandas (age 38) in the village named Gunapur. As Varun gains consciousness he tells them that he doesn't remember anything about himself. The leader of the village suggests Varun stay in the village for a few days and send a person to the nearby city. Mohandas and Meera have a boy named Muniya who is very naughty. Muniya takes Varun along and involves him in all his plays and mischiefs. All this was quite new for Varun. Whenever Varun is asked to participate in a play, he takes it as a competition. Due to this approach, all other children begin to maintain distance from him. One day Varun was talking to a statue in the village. He mentioned that he is from a big city called Mumbai. His parents would regularly push him to get into merit. Last year one of his friends committed suicide under the pressure to perform. Varun's parent wants him to score highest in all the areas. He meets with an accident trying to meet their expectations. And he realizes, that in this mad race of numbers he is actually getting away from his childhood joys. In a few days the village festivals get started. During these festivals, people from the village would teach their children to learn the old traditional work style. There's a Bull's race being organized in the village. Looking at that race, Varun identifies himself as the Bull who is facing the hard realities of life. Varun's parent has been looking for him and they find him there in the village. Varun is happy to meet his parents. His parents inform him that the race in which he had fallen is happening again and he needs to participate in it. Varun starts to ponder. The bull owned by his friend Muniya finally wins the race. As the bull is being taken back, Varun offers a unique gift to the Bull from the field of education

Hindi Language.name: Anurag Kashyap
