Hindi Language.description: A scientist brings together a struggling actor, a writer and a movie director for his unique experiment on the human brain. Set against the serene landscape of Benaras, the film delves into what would happen if a dream takes over your life and it just keeps going, no matter how hard you rebel.

Hindi Language.name: Topaz
Hindi Language.description: Biopic on controversial bar dancer Sweety who ruled in 80s and 90s Mumbai.

Hindi Language.name: The Cavalry goes to Jodhpur
Hindi Language.description: The cavalry goes to Jodhpur The show is about the journey of the host who raises his cavalry of horses & camels and travels through a region of Rajasthan living an adventure, the way one would before cars were invented. While completing this journey on camels and horseback from Pushkar to Jodhpur it showcases the chronicles of the land and it's people.

Hindi Language.name: Aanchhi
Hindi Language.description: A Pandemic Comedy of a contract-rat killer who gets a new job but mistakes it for something else which changes the course of his life.

Hindi Language.name: Tere Liye
Hindi Language.description: Prem, Raj, Priya, and Deepak were inseparable friends,bound by years of laughter and memories. However, beneath their friendship,unspoken feelings lingered. Raj was deeply in love with Priya and hoped to confess his feelings, believing

Hindi Language.name: Live in Relation
Hindi Language.description: The story is a bit filmy. There is no age limit, no birth restriction. Something similar is the case of 60-year-old Phoolmati living in Jind district in Haryana (India), who fell in love with 25-year-old Golu. Both love each other and want to live together but do not want to get married so they have chosen a live-in relationship. Both have reached Jind court. It also highlights what is there Act under the law. What happened next? How are they ridiculed? How Phoolmati responds to the words of all the people, all of them have been shown through a media reporter.

Hindi Language.name: MAATI 2 Kahani kisaan ki
Hindi Language.description: This film is about the child of a farmer laborer wants to study, In todays era, technology is most important for farmer so that they can do farming and the farmer can become self-sufficient by producing good crops.

Hindi Language.name: Bhaiyyaji Balwan
Hindi Language.description: A Slice of life animated comedy about an 8 years old kid, fondly known as Bhaiyyaji Balwan and his adventures in the the village of Gomatipur.

Hindi Language.name: Pyaar Ki Roshni
Hindi Language.description: Shankar a good and honest middle-class boy, on his way to office, finds an infant girl child discarded near a dustbin. He takes the infant to the police station. Later he and his wife Janaki decide to adapt the child even though they have a son of their own. After completing the paperwork, they finally manage to bring the little girl home. They name her Roshni as she has brightened their lives. The film is a wake-up call that life has no short cuts. It is wrong to think that you can improve someone by getting him married to someone sensible. More often you end up destroying two lives and two families.

Hindi Language.name: Viram
Hindi Language.description: The show is about an acid attack which is showing the image of the people's mentality. As now days the crime is more easy due to people mentality ahs change and hence this is the web series based on the message that is based on the acid attack and the for the people of criminal mentality. The episode starts with a man kidnapped where he is asked questions by the accuser. Then a man finds a body half died In a forest behind the factory and he calls the cops and informed them that its an acid attack case, then the body is taken to hospital and the doctor says that the patient is in a critical situation. Later, the doctor also lights on the truth that the body is not of a girl but of a boy, which makes the scenario more confusing for everyone. The cop is investigating deeply the case. and they find out that the victim was a boy, then made a girl and then threw acid on the face and was beaten worst. News media take advantage of this situation and make it crisper and show it live to the nation. The office of Mahadev Sharma reaches out to a victim of an acid attack who he thinks is the main culprit of his case. a dead body is being found in the dump yard, the inspector reaches the crime spot and Mahadev orders to seal the hospital. inspector Sanjay gets kidnapped and tortured meanwhile the police team interrogates Sweety Khetan about the majid murder case. The inspector is ordered not to integrate Tanya, and then the team finds shocking information about Tanya's reality. inspector Vinod Gupta is kidnapped and tortured by Nikhil. sweety and Gang put 'viral' on each person who committed the crime.

Hindi Language.name: Teesri Talash
Hindi Language.description: Teesri Talash is a Indian movie directed by M Lohith Raj starring Nitish Nirmal ,Mamatha Rahuth, Sudarshan, Achyuth Kumar and Narayan Swami. The feature film is produced by Sanjeev Gavandi and the music composed by Arjun Ramu

Hindi Language.name: Waa Nauni
Hindi Language.description: A junior scientist is on his way to reach Harshil for his research work. However, his destiny makes him stumble upon a milestone which he finds a very strange connection.

Hindi Language.name: Khud Teri
Hindi Language.description: When a school teacher gets transferred to a village, there he meets a girl who used to study with him. Soak into this soulful and heart-warming love story...

Hindi Language.name: I Killed My Son
Hindi Language.description: When his son is abused by drugs, ultimately ruining his family and life. He decides to find and avenge everyone involved in the drug business. And when he finds himself defeated, he joins and works for the drug lord.

Hindi Language.name: Hello Daddu
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of Janardan who lives in Mumbai with his friend Rahul. Janardan is a simple boy who does puja and his friend Rahul is exactly opposite to him. Rahul also has a girlfriend. Their romance plan fails because of Janardan. Because he is not ready to leave both of them alone in the room, hence Rahul and his girlfriend make a plan to make Janardan's friendship with Heena and convince Janardan to be in a live-in relationship with Heena. Next day after Heena comes with Janardan, Janardan's Daddu comes to his place to check his eyes. Now even Heena cannot be called, so that Daddu does not know that both of them live together, his struggle and excuses are shown. Meanwhile, while trying to scare Daddu, Daddu's foot slips and the doctor asks them to stay for more days. Seeing Daddu's condition, both of them repent for their actions and serve Daddu wholeheartedly. In this story, at the end, when Daddu is leaving, both of them apologize to him for their mistakes, then Daddu tells that he knew from the very first day that both of you live together and he has no problem with that. The girl is a Muslim because she is good at heart and it is she who will convince Janardan's father for marriage.

Hindi Language.name: Documenting Love
Hindi Language.description: Daring Ones Films presents Documenting Love - a mockumentary series about love. In this season we bring stories about Red flags and Green Flags.

Hindi Language.name: The Invisible Visible
Hindi Language.description: THE INVISIBLE VISIBLE is a poignant 'Impact' documentary-feature on the estimated 70 million homeless people in India. It draws attention towards these 'invisibles' and seeks to 'visibilize' them. The sordid stories of the homeless people humanizes them and depicts how poverty has been criminalised under an archaic, draconian law in India. The stories unfold through the lens of India's leading crusaders - TARIQUE MOHAMMED, and his organisation members who have dedicated their lives for the homeless and destitute. The fight against injustice and violence is an ongoing one and THE INVISIBLE VISIBLE has some call to actions.

Hindi Language.name: High Tide
Hindi Language.description: High Tide is a suspense thriller, about the struggle of a man who is stuck in a dark situation. Where his life becomes unpredictable. He is unable to understand, who is the tormenter. A Psychopath, a Devil, or a conspiracy. Police have their own theory, which is entirely different and saying a different story. The wife has her own theory. Mother wants something else. All moving in different directions. It's not clear Who is deceiving who. A situation that is beyond the wildest nightmares of a person's life. A situation of life and death. Every passing minute is taking him near death. Before it's too late.

Hindi Language.name: Starting Troubles 2 - Bheja Unfry
Hindi Language.description: Magic - Is nothing but science. There is a neurosurgeon who always believes that when you add some methods to your madness, MAGIC happens. He does wonders in the realm of neuroscience using his magic. Of course, conjuring such magic in other people's lives is not so simple. However, he made it possible. His remarkable journey in the world of neuroscience is the centerpiece of this series.

Hindi Language.name: Manvee
Hindi Language.description: MANVEE is a story of the struggle of an educated third gender who is a successful clinical psychologist by profession.

Hindi Language.name: Dusht Aatma - Deadman Spirit

She constantly had a nightmare how her husband endured suffering in hell. Ai Ling saw a newspaper post about a very skillful master resided in Thailand who could coax the spirit upon..

Hindi Language.name: Tulsi Dham Ke Laddu Gopal
Hindi Language.description: Tulsi, an ardent follower of Laddu Gopal, finds guidance in her unshakable faith while navigating life's complexities and relationships, leading her on a path of devotion and self-discovery.

Hindi Language.name: Angry Anna
Hindi Language.description: Anna is an honest police inspector, whose posting is in the city of Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Anna never forgives the guilty, he has only one principle, the honest should not suffer any harm and the guilty should not survive. Verdict on the spot. Anna's elder brother Satish is a doctor. Some goons kidnap Satish. Satish's daughters Kittu and Mithu inform Anna about Satish's kidnapping. People give the status of God to doctors, but nowadays there are some doctors who play with the lives of patients to earn more money. Similarly, some corrupt doctors used to illegally remove the kidneys of patients. When Anna searches for Satish, one by one the case begins to open that a huge kidney racket is going on in the city of Noida, who take out the kidneys of patients and sell them illegally at high prices. Malik runs this racket. It was Malik who kidnapped Satish, as Satish had refused to work for him and was about to expose his racket. Now Anna's grip reaches to Malik's neck and Anna annihilates his kidney racket gang operating in the city.

Hindi Language.name: Eternite
Hindi Language.description: A boy who makes an AI for his homework but that AI gets out of his control and copies itself in every smart electronic device in the world.

Hindi Language.name: LBW: Love Before Wedding
Hindi Language.description: Two quirky families try arranging their kids' marriage, despite them having other partners. As plans move ahead, relationships spiral into chaos with mix-ups, conflicts, and secrets making love more complex than imagined.

Hindi Language.name: Puppet Master
Hindi Language.description: Ritesh is given the power to control his life through a TV ad. He chooses Rehana, the fiancé of his flatmate, fall in love with him. The unnatural control pushes the universe to react in the brutal way. She becomes a puppet.

Hindi Language.name: Baaton Baaton Mein with Sapna Vyas
Hindi Language.description: An intimate and captivating show hosted by Sapna Vyas, revealing the hidden lives of audiences favourite stars through intriguing discussions and genuine connections. Join the conversation for entertainment and storytelling at its best.

Hindi Language.name: Suspect
Hindi Language.description: Three bachelors used to stay in a row house. They are fond of illegal activities One of the bachelor takes revenge to other flatmates for Her family past. Her neighbour and family members end up saving her for her innocent revenge.

Hindi Language.name: Namastey Ji, May I come in
Hindi Language.description: A housewife, home alone on a drenched rainy afternoon, is in for a surprise from a stranger.

Hindi Language.description: Vishu who has lost half of his memory because he was attacked by someone but now he has come to know what was done to him

Hindi Language.name: Leech
Hindi Language.description: A man who pretends to be a writer , a woman who pretends to be normal and a devastating game of cannibalism !who ,why how all questions never rest into peace as chaotic leech syndrome affects them All the man , woman , child , investigator and many more who is the leech in real the journey to explore the truth behind leech.

Hindi Language.name: Jarasandh
Hindi Language.description: This story is of a young man named Samrat, who oppresses the people of Assandh.

Hindi Language.name: Ragad Bhassad
Hindi Language.description: In the dangerous world of political violence, a ruthless family's reign of terror meets its match when two enigmatic strangers emerge with a deadly agenda of their own.

Hindi Language.name: Nimmo Lucknow Wali
Hindi Language.description: Excessive usage of mobile devices among children in particular. The film pushes the forward among parents that dependency on mobile and excessive usage could be dangerous and must be prevented.

Hindi Language.name: Seven Battle star
Hindi Language.description: "SEVEN BATTLE STAR" SEVEN BATTLE STAR is an youth based reality show. Will telecast on Bpflixtv ott in India. In this show, a group of contestants travel to different destinations and participate in various tasks that challenge their physical, social and mental strength. During the course of the journey there are vote outs, vote ins, eliminations and game changing twists. Eventually the contestant who manages to survive vote outs and succeed in the finale is chosen as the winner. The show has enjoyed relative success among the youth. When asked about the show, the mohd talib said, "Seven battle star through provide new commerce give batter platform & to excited task for prove youngester. Why do you want to be a Battle Star ?" and "What is the greatest regret of your life?" etc. Moderators watch the performance of all the applicants in this GD(group discussion) and then they shortlist some people who are called on the next day for the Personal Interview round. This personal interview takes place with some of the above-mentioned . And These interviews are known to be intense and try to bring out the true nature of the participant. These interviews often have abusive language and the interviewers don't like applicants who have lied on the application form. The interviewers always stress on not lying in the application form and showing who they really are, instead of portraying a false personality in front of them. & Total winner 7 in this show that's why they call seven battle star .

Hindi Language.name: Dictatorship bulletin (The democratic truth)
Hindi Language.description: Aditya's film features the first picture-less film in human history. A solo-film based on dictatorship, democracy, and Indian politics.

Hindi Language.name: Case No. 009
Hindi Language.description: Police fail to solve Minister Raval's daughter Navya's murder. Commissioner assigns CBI team to Case 009, who solve both her case and other city murders.

Hindi Language.name: Salvation at Sunrise
Hindi Language.description: Two emotionally burdened man meets and discovers a surprising connection between them. So, they embark on a journey over a night to ease their sufferings through contemplating their grief and loss.

Hindi Language.name: Pehchaan: The Unscripted Show with Mahesh Bhatt
Hindi Language.description: In the captivating talk show series, "Sikh Spirit: A Heart-to-Heart Journey with Mahesh Bhatt," viewers are invited on an inspiring and enlightening odyssey alongside legendary filmmaker and host, Mahesh Bhatt. This unique series brings forth distinguished Sikh guests from various walks of life, each with a remarkable story to tell. The series delves deep into the lives of these unsung heroes, offering audiences an intimate and revealing glimpse into the experiences, challenges, and triumphs that have defined their journeys. From trailblazing entrepreneurs to extraordinary athletes, from dedicated social activists to accomplished artists, each guest's narrative is a testament to the indomitable Sikh spirit. Hosted by the iconic Mahesh Bhatt, whose wisdom and insight act as the inner conscious of the show, "Sikh Spirit" goes beyond the surface. It explores the profound philosophies, faith, and cultural values that have shaped the lives of these remarkable individuals. With his signature style, Mahesh Bhatt connects with both guests and viewers on a deeply emotional and philosophical level. Through engaging conversations and heart-to-heart dialogues, Mahesh Bhatt unravels the hidden gems within the stories of these Sikh luminaries. He artfully weaves their experiences into the fabric of human existence, transcending boundaries of religion and culture. The series seeks to inspire and motivate, leaving the audience with profound life lessons and a renewed sense of purpose. With "Sikh Spirit," Mahesh Bhatt takes viewers on an unforgettable journey, celebrating the unsung heroes whose stories illuminate the human spirit's capacity for resilience, compassion, and greatness. Drawing from different philosophies, faiths, and cultures, the series is a powerful reminder of the boundless potential that resides within each of us, waiting to be unlocked. Prepare to be inspired, enlightened, and moved as "Sikh Spirit" unfolds the heroic journeys of these exceptional individuals, guided by the wisdom and warmth of the legendary Mahesh Bhatt. This is more than just a talk show; it's a transformations experience that transcends the screen and touches the heart.

Hindi Language.name: Mixtape
Hindi Language.description: "Don't grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form" - Rumi This is a tale of 3 individuals that runs in parallel and gets entwined due to some coincidences. Protagonists being Raj, Madhav and Moin, their life takes twists and turns as they try and reach for their life goals. In the process they end up loosing sight of these goals as life itself presents new avenues and adventures.

Hindi Language.name: Elham
Hindi Language.description: The symbiosis of a boy and goat, set around the festival Bakrid.The kid befriends the goat and develops a very special bond though he knows that the goat is brought for a ceremonial sacrifice.

Hindi Language.name: Dhoort
Hindi Language.description: A fake wants his progeny to be real in a world full of crooks.

Hindi Language.name: Mohan Bhargav and the Hologram Girl
Hindi Language.description: A psycho detective Mohan Bhargav with his dual split personality friend hippo, is trying to stop Ramakant who do crime with the help of a hologram girl.

Hindi Language.name: Meri Awaaz Suno
Hindi Language.description: A famous RJ loses his voice unexpectedly and the film is all about ,how he regained confidence and voice with the help of a speech therapist

Hindi Language.name: Death in the City
Hindi Language.description: With funeral pyres burning non-stop for more than three millennia, the sacred city of Varanasi on the holy Ganga, India's river of life is, for Hindus, the dream destination for death and the most pressured crematorium in the world: its relationship with death at once auspicious, spiritual, and industrial.

Hindi Language.name: Paap
Hindi Language.description: Surabhi's world is about to change as her husband, Aniket, lands a job opportunity in Canada. Excitement fills the air, but Surabhi sees this as an opportunity to ease some of her responsibilities. She decides it's time for her mother-in-law to reside in an old age ashram. However, as Surabhi approaches her mother-in-law with this idea, she is met with unexpected revelations. The conversation takes an unexpected turn, unraveling truths that force Surabhi to confront her own perceptions and reconsider the dynamics of her relationships. As the layers of family dynamics are peeled away, Surabhi's journey becomes a poignant exploration of understanding, empathy, and the complexities of familial bonds.

Hindi Language.name: Krishna Sangani Yamuna
Hindi Language.description: This film is the story of Shri Yamuna Maiya, the fourth wife of Shri Krishna, appearing on the earth and liberating her devotees. The miraculous stories of Yamuna Maiya being pleased with the devotion of her devotees and removing their sorrows. The stories of Gusai ji Maharaj and the devotees who were blessed by Yamuna Maiya in Gusai ji Maharaj's period. How in the life of Kishori Bai, Mohandas, Madhavdas, and pervaded happiness in life of other devotees by the grace of Yamuna Maiya.

Hindi Language.name: Dream & Death
Hindi Language.description: The film Dream and Death is based on the educational city of Kota. Filmmaker Fakira has revealed the mystery of the increasing suicides of students in Kota. According to the film, parents overwhelm their children with the burden of dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Jeevan Kee Nadee - The River of Life
Hindi Language.description: On the outskirts of Varanasi, on the banks of the Ganges River, there is a small school, surrounded by the villages from which the children come. It was established some eighty years ago and is inspired by J. Krishnamurti's educational vision of compassion and harmonious human development. Overcoming numerous difficulties throughout its existence, the school has remained steadfast in its intent to be a place of joy for young children. The documentary explores the children's lives at home and at school. The story is intertwined with the interviews of the other protagonists: the Principal, the teachers and the founder of the group of donors "The River of Life".

Hindi Language.name: Janam Janam Ka Bandhan
Hindi Language.description: Vimal is an educated, talented boy from the village who saves the villagers from the atrocities of the village headman and hence he becomes the enemy of the chief. Vimal falls in love with a girl named Prabha who belongs to the royal family. But Prabha's family becomes against of their love. On the other hand Mukhiya and his son make many plans to take revenge on Vimal but Vimal make all the plans failed and in the end love wins.

Hindi Language.name: Chambli
Hindi Language.description: Fateh Singh, affectionately known as Fattu, is a humble and peace-loving man living in a quiet village. He leads a simple life, working as a gunsmith and serving a notorious and dangerous man named Dharam Singh.

Hindi Language.name: Ta
Hindi Language.description: Five college students along along with a cab driver (Who is Husband of one of a student) finds themselves in the surrounding of three newly made and amateur ghosts who desperately wants to come back to life.

Hindi Language.name: Cyberrun
Hindi Language.description: Acharya, a jovial wannabe artist accidentally encounters a theft attempt and sets on a quest to find the man behind the mystery.

Hindi Language.name: Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Li'l Champs 2022
Hindi Language.description: Get ready for wholesome entertainment as the little champs from across India take you on an enthralling musical journey with their impeccable singing prowess.

Hindi Language.description: This is the story of struggling female aspiring Actors who enter the glamour world to convert their dream into a reality.

Hindi Language.name: Bose DK
Hindi Language.description: Hiiiii on adventure journey!!!!!!

Hindi Language.name: Letters
Hindi Language.description: The "Letters" documentary series tells stories through "open letters" that protagonists write, pouring out their hearts and passionately sharing their suffering and concerns. They not only read out these letters in the episodes, but also intimately share their lives with the audience. While addressing the letters to individuals or groups, they desire for their audience to at least recognize their pain or celebrate their successes with them.

Hindi Language.name: Ye Tune Kya Kiya
Hindi Language.description: "Ye tune kya kiya" is a question asked by Tanu to her husband. What was the reason behind transformation of innocent village girl Tanu to prostitute Tamanna? Who was the one who made her life a living hell.

Hindi Language.description: The Devil comes to Earth when he falls in love with a beautiful girl and takes her soul with him and a Supernatural fight takes place between a spiritual healer and the Devil.

Hindi Language.description: Devanand Dheere Dheere is a Rom-Com based on slices of life. The story of the film revolves around a 45 years old bachelor Devanand who falls in love with a girl almost 20 years younger to him.

Hindi Language.name: GJ12 Saga
Hindi Language.description: Journey of a man who has lost his love and family. And a psycho gangster who has come to take back everything he has lost at any cost.

Hindi Language.name: Sher Gujjar
Hindi Language.description: Narayan Gurjar (Gajendra Chauhan) is a very cultured self respecting rural youth, Due to crop failure in the village he has to work as a security supervisor in a factory. Narayan Gurjar has to go to get his 5 year old son Ravi (Master Naitik) admitted in the school, on the same day after getting admission he takes his son along with him and reaches the factory's office to get his salary. The manager (Amit Rana) of that factory Narayan Gurjar accuses of stealing goods worth 5 Lakhs which is false, the owner of the factory Mr. Ranveer (Mushtaq Khan) also get into the manager's talk and in front of his son, the manager and owner insult Narayan Gurjar very much. Because Narayan is a very cultured person he respect his master very much so he takes to heart what was sent by the factory owner Mr. Ranveer and dose nothing to the owner. But in anger he punches to the manager in the mouth and breaks one of his teeth. Seeing so much anger of Narayan Gurjar the factory owner Ranveer insult him even more and 5 year old son Ravi sees all these things with his eyes and his blood boiled. On coming home Narayan Gurjar remains in depression carrying the stain of humiliation in his heart, two days later he dies of a heart attack, Before dying he takes an oath from Ravi that he will erase the stain of his humiliation and poverty by reading a lot and becoming a big man by following the path of honesty. After this Ravi reads a lot. He becomes a big man reaches great heights. On the other hand Ranveer the owner of the factory gets drowned in the debt of the banks. He has a very bad time. in the end he has to come to Ravinder Gurjar for help, though he dose not know that he is the son of the same Narayan Gurjar whom he had fired on charges of theft. The good values given by Narayan were codified inside Ravinder Gurjar his father had taught him that the owner should be respected a lot. That's why Ravinder definitely takes out his anger when Ranveer comes, But in the end Ravinder gives him a cheque of 20 crores to his father's owner so that his house and factory can be saved from being auctioned off by the banks.

Hindi Language.description: Set in a bustling auto parts warehouse in Delhi's Kashmere Gate motor market, the play unfolds against the backdrop of the mundane yet meaningful routines of the characters. As the narrative opens, it is the start of another ordinary Monday morning, a day that signifies the beginning of the workweek for the employees. The protagonist, a young man engaged in the physically demanding tasks of loading axles and sweeping floors, aspires for a brighter future through a college education. His dreams stand in stark contrast to the disillusionment that permeates the atmosphere, enveloping his more seasoned co-workers. The play masterfully captures the essence of the characters' lives, highlighting the monotony and despair that accompany their daily grind. Each member of the ensemble cast grapples with their own coping mechanisms in the face of the seemingly unending cycle of work and monotony. Some find solace in poetry, seeking refuge in the beauty of language and expression, while others succumb to the numbing effects of alcohol, a desperate attempt to escape the harsh realities of their existence. What unfolds is a poignant exploration of the human condition, punctuated by moments of humor that serve as a respite from the pervasive gloom. The action of the play unfolds over the course of two consecutive Mondays, providing a nuanced portrayal of the characters' lives and the incremental changes that occur in their collective journey. Directed by Sanjiv Agarwal, this Hindi adaptation draws inspiration from Arthur Miller's lesser-known masterpiece, "A Memory of Two Mondays." The original play, set in a Brooklyn warehouse during America's Great Depression in the 1930s, reflects Miller's own experiences of that era and explores the pervasive sense of insecurity in modern existence. Initially staged in 1955, the play was later adapted by Miller for an ITV broadcast in 1959 and a 1971 television movie. The Hindi adaptation of the play is a testament to the creative prowess of the ensemble cast, with the first draft crafted by Umesh Vyas. This staging marks the play's debut in Delhi, offering audiences a unique lens through which to witness the universal themes of hope, disillusionment, and the pursuit of a better life. In Miller's own words, this play is a creation infused with "greater love" than anything else he has written-a sentiment that resonates in the adaptation's exploration of the human spirit amidst the challenges of modern existence.

It is also a reminder that the people are the true masters of democracy, and that no one is above the law. The MLA's rise to power was fueled by his own ambition and the corruption of the system. He was able to get away with his misdeeds for many years, but he eventually met his downfall. The MLA's story is also a reminder of the importance of public vigilance. The people must hold their elected representatives accountable and speak out against corruption and abuse of power. Only then can we ensure that our democracy remains strong and healthy.

Hindi Language.name: Indian Gurjar
Hindi Language.description: There was a girl when she was about to be born her grandparents and relatives of the house were preparing for the celebration because they thought there would be a boy but it was not so, the girl happened. When people saw her and called her by the name - "Sophia".It sounds strange to hear the name Apashguni, but the girl was smiling after hearing her new name, thinking that I had come to some paradise. But people are not even touching me, it feels like I have a disease. Those who came to celebrate also left. People wanted to kill me, thinking, 'I am a girl and what can I give except defamation?'The only person who was fully supporting me was my mother. I was dead in the eyes of the world, but I was in an orphanage. I had a full family, but still I was in an orphanage.There was not a single day when my mother didn't come to meet me and feed me milk. She used to take full care of me and lie to my mother and family that I was going to meet my friend. Every day my mother made new excuses.One day I had a high fever and that day my mother stayed with me all day and went back home after putting me to sleep. Dad asked how it was so late and she said that my friend was unwell and I was helping her. Dad also beat up mom that day in anger. My mother was in pain, but still hiding me, she thought I was a child, what would I understand, but it was not so, I understood everything.I also thought I'd be knowledgeable. I went to madam and on requesting a lot, she told me everything. Hearing all this, I got very angry, I thought that I have to do something different.When something grew up, I joined the boxing club. When I turned 18, I got the title of state champion. Two months later, I had a national match with a Pakistani girl. When the media came to interview me, I got a call from my mother and she said, 'Daughter, please don't harm your family.' I was laughing that my mother was still saving her family. I gave an interview and the whole public heard that interview on TV. In the evening, mom told that while watching TV, papa was saying that wow what a girl, how much name she is bringing to her parents and family.They had left me saying That I am Kulakshmi. Today they wanted to meet me and take photos with me but even today they were unaware of who I am.Exactly two months later, there was a National Championship match and they all came to see me. A lot of people had come to watch the match and everyone was saying - "You can do it" but my eyes were looking for my family in that crowd. When I saw my family in the distant crowd, I was angry and I vented all the anger on my opponent and won the national title.Then what, everyone became interested in me, people started asking me about my family. Very compelled, I told him that I was the girl who was killed 20 years ago who was first given the name "sofia". My whole family's eyes were moist.Just then someone came running from the distant crowd and called me a daughter, it was as if it was like a dream for me, the childhood love I had lost, I suddenly got it and she hugged me and said to everyone - "This is my daughter" who gave me the right to be a father. Everyone was apologizing to me.

Hindi Language.name: Kinaare
Hindi Language.description: True love is like parallels of a river, can flow together but can never meet. This narrative is a cycle of vicissitudes which pirouettes around fondness between Rohaan (Male lead) and Maira (Female lead).The story starts with the appearance of Mr. Verma, Maira's father waiting for the doctor in his cabin as Maira is admitted in heart hospital. As soon as doctor arrives, he discusses Maira's condition with the doctor. Doctor informs him about Maira not recovering and heart transplant would be impossible in this state. Mr. Verma breaks down after hearing this because he is unprepared to bear the pain of losing his loved ones after the sudden demise of his wife, sister and brother in law. Since, he has to take care of Reet (his niece) too. Leaving the cabin, he calls Reet who lives in London to share everything. Reet gets upset after hearing everything and oddly starts blaming herself. She then comes to India and goes to the club to see Rohaan, a rock star in his concert. She gets shocked as soon as Rohaan comes on stage because seeing him it is evident that he is in a state of depression (long dirty hair, reddish eyes with dark circles). During the concert, he sees Reet and hugs her warmly. They sit and talk and Reet asks him to come to the hospital but he refuses. (Rohaan and Maira were in a relationship during college days but the two parted ways due to misunderstandings.) Reet convinces him and they visit hospital to see Maira. Seeing her in such condition, Rohaan faints. Now, both Rohaan and Maira are admitted in the hospital. A friend of Rohaan blames Maira for Rohaan's condition. After hearing this, Reet tells him that she is responsible for everything instead of Maira. She starts narrating everything and there comes a flashback. Flashback shows their college life and the love triangle between Reet, Rohaan and Maira. Rohaan loves Maira and Reet loves Rohaan. With the help of a boy named Parth (who loves Reet), Reet creates misunderstanding between Rohaan and Maira wrongly which parted them away. But unfortunately, Rohaan hears all this. He gets angry at first but forgives Reet because now the biggest motive of his life is to save the life of Maira. Rohaan apologizes to Maira and promises to be with her forever. Maira starts recovering and her body is now ready for heart transplant but the doctors can't find a match for the transplant. Her health starts deteriorating and Rohaan tries to commit suicide so that he could give his heart but Reet stops him. Next day, Reet tells him that the operation was successful. But in reality, it was Rohaan's hallucination as doctors tell him that Reet met with an accident and gave her heart for operation so that Rohaan and Maira can live happily ever after. Rohaan and Maira, the two parallels of a river meet but the river itself stops.

Now how things would turn out once we make a choice, is totally unpredictable. We can't even guess, only the person who opts for the option, knows might know the outcome. Hindi Language.name: Sankraman
Hindi Language.description: Jealousy is a very much human emotion and astonishingly a highly contagious one too. A jealous mind can go to any length to scheme against those who are doing better. Dhananjay is a young unmarried IT professional. Sankraman or Infection is the story of Dhananjay who feels that destiny is cruel to him. He is convinced that every undeserving person around is on a mission to belittle him. While thinking about punishing those undeserving people he has created a dark room in his mind for himself. It is a world where he is the predator and those who mock him directly or indirectly are his prey. This day begins like any other day for Dhananjay, full of frustration and anguish. Because of his pessimistic thinking, Dhananjay sees everything as a chip on his shoulder. This frustration has led him to believe that nothing good will ever happen in his life. He imagines torturing his neighbour because he has a well settled family. Dhananjay lacks empathy and love in his life. Adding to the frustration and jealousy, a good looking female colleague tells Dhananjay about her wedding. Dhananjay looks at the photo of her fiance and jealousy again kicks in. But today is the day when the company is going to announce, "Employee of the year". This day is not at all going well for him. He's worried that he is going to lose yet again. Dhananjay believes he deserved to win the award last year and is the best candidate to win the award this year as well. Karan, who according to Dhananjay is a quintessential undeserving fellow, won this award last year. Dhananjay sees an archrival in Karan. Hindi Language.name: Siasat 75
Hindi Language.description: Siasat Daily: A Newspaper Founded in the Midst of Trouble Siasat Daily, a popular Urdu-language newspaper in India, was founded in 1949 by Abid Ali Khan and Mahboob Hussain Jigar. The newspaper was born in the midst of trouble, as the country was still reeling from the effects of Partition. The founders of Siasat Daily were determined to create a newspaper that would give a voice to the Muslim community in India. One of the most memorable stories published by Siasat Daily was about a police scene happening in the YouTube video made by the newspaper. The video showed police officers beating up a Muslim man, and it sparked widespread outrage. The newspaper's editor and team faced trouble while trying to write the news, as they were threatened by the police. However, they refused to back down, and the story was eventually published. The story of Siasat Daily is a testament to the importance of press freedom. The newspaper has played a vital role in holding the powerful accountable and giving a voice to the marginalized. It is a reminder that even in the midst of trouble, there are always those who are willing to fight for truth and justice. How the Editor and Team Faced Trouble While Trying to Write the News The editor and team of Siasat Daily faced a number of challenges while trying to write the news about the police scene happening in the YouTube video. First, they were threatened by the police, who warned them not to publish the story. Second, they were under pressure from the Muslim community to publish the story, but they also had to be careful not to incite violence. This Independent film depicts the impact of Siasat daily.

Hindi Language.name: Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh
Hindi Language.description: After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.

Hindi Language.name: Personal Trainer
Hindi Language.description: At an upscale gym, fitness and ambition mix with murder, secrets, and betrayal. As lives overlap, hidden motives emerge. In this web of love, greed, and deception, trust is scarce and survival paramount.

Hindi Language.name: Jolly LLB 3
Hindi Language.description: Smart-alec Jolly Mishra and jugadu Jolly Tyagi clash in Judge Tripathi's court with witty banter, wild twists, and heartfelt chaos in this ultimate courtroom comedy.

Hindi Language.name: Bhakshak
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around the journey of an unwavering woman's quest to seek justice and her perseverance in getting a heinous crime to light.

Hindi Language.name: Heeramandi: The Diamond Bazaar
Hindi Language.description: Sanjay Leela Bhansali brings his majestic signature flair to stories of love and betrayal in the lives of courtesans in pre-independence India.

Hindi Language.name: Nishaanchi
Hindi Language.description: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

Hindi Language.name: Munjya
Hindi Language.description: A young man's visit to his native village unveils a family secret and a vengeful spirit, the Munjya, who wants to get married. Now the young man must fight to protect himself and his love from Munjya's clutches.

Hindi Language.name: Utha Patak
Hindi Language.description: "Utha Patak: A book that brings your story to life. Immerse yourself in its pages and live out your deepest desires, as reality and fantasy merge. But pleasure is confined to the book's world-dare to read?"

Hindi Language.name: Stree 2
Hindi Language.description: After the events of Stree, the town of Chanderi is being haunted again. This time, women are mysteriously abducted by a terrifying headless entity. Once again, it's up to Vicky and his friends to save their town and loved ones.

Hindi Language.name: Metro in Dino
Hindi Language.description: Follows stories of bittersweet relationships in a contemporary setting, exploring various aspects, hues, and moods of love.

Hindi Language.name: Rangbaaz: The Bihar Chapter

Hindi Language.name: The Fable
Hindi Language.description: After discovering burned trees in his orchards, a wealthy landowner grows suspicious of his workers and nomads passing through his vast estate.

Hindi Language.name: Singham Again
Hindi Language.description: Bajirao Singham and a team of super cops must rescue his wife, Avni, who is producing a stage play based on the Ramayana, from a villainous kidnapper.

Hindi Language.name: Sikandar

Hindi Language.name: Rangeen

Hindi Language.description: In 1989 Rajasthan, IPS officer Patnaik raids a palace but fails. After requesting a bribe, he's transferred to Bhoj, where he investigates Dada Bhai, a respected local figure. Suspended after a failed raid, he uncovers hidden truths.

Hindi Language.name: Chandu Champion
Hindi Language.description: A man who faced one adversary after another with an undying spirit. His unwavering zeal and never give up attitude led to India's first individual gold medal in any form of the Olympics.

Hindi Language.name: Baby John

Hindi Language.name: Dhoom Dhaam
Hindi Language.description: Veer Poddar and Koyal Chadda are a mismatched couple, who get into an arranged marriage. A case of mistaken identity forces this newly married couple to go on the run on their wedding night and search for the mysterious "Charlie".

Hindi Language.name: Article 370

Hindi Language.name: Gustaakh Ishq

Hindi Language.description: Love faces its toughest test yet as Ashish visits Ayesha's family home. Will the age-gap romance win hearts or stir things up? This Pyaar vs Parivaar clash promises a relatable, riotous ride for every kind of audience.

Hindi Language.name: Swatantrya Veer Savarkar

Hindi Language.name: Veer Hanuman - Bolo Bajrang Bali Ki Jai

Hindi Language.name: Judwaa Jaal

Hindi Language.name: SSS (Silent Shackled Sold)

Hindi Language.name: Dange
Hindi Language.description: Journey that delves deep into the complexities of friends. Set against the backdrop of a vibrant college festival, the movie explores the intricate dynamics between two friends whose paths diverge and ignite a fierce competition.

Hindi Language.name: The Great Indian Cricket Fan
Hindi Language.description: The Great Indian Cricket Fan is a fun and emotional series about how much Indians love cricket. It follows the lives of everyday people during a big cricket season.

Hindi Language.name: Tipppsy

Hindi Language.name: Greater Kalesh
Hindi Language.description: Twinkle returns home for a surprise Diwali trip, but secrets and disagreements test her family's bonds in ways she never imagined.

Hindi Language.name: Mangal Lakshmi
Hindi Language.description: Mangal journeys to find an ideal husband for beloved Lakshmi. Despite obstacles, Mangal persists, revealing the power of sisterhood and predestined connections.

Hindi Language.name: Zyada Mat Udd

Hindi Language.description: Sandeep, 28, is asked by his father to visit home, which leads him to reluctantly take a road trip with his friend Vikram. During the journey, he encounters Bablu, his childhood rival, triggering latent memories and fears.

Hindi Language.name: Unbroken: The Unmukt Chand Story

Hindi Language.name: Sharmajee Ki Beti

Hindi Language.name: Moonwalk
Hindi Language.description: Two thieves go head to head to steal the heart of a local heart-throb. Their rivalry and competition lead to dangerous yet hilarious consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 4
Hindi Language.description: Bhagyashree struggles as a single independent woman who is afraid of love as she nurses her broken heart after a painful betrayal. She meets a free-spirited Rishabh who enters her life as a new hope of love.

Hindi Language.name: Sabse Bada Rupaiya

Chama Obo, or Obocchama-kun, is heir to the Obo Group, a multi-million-dollar financial group; and the haughty rich kid has recently been accepted into the school. With a doting father that is always treating him like a prince, you'll laugh out loud and scratch your head at all the strange interactions Obocchama-kun has with his friends.

Meera & Raj as they sit hand in hand under the starlit sky, their love has weathered the storm of doubt and emerged stronger than ever. Their journey continues, filled with newfound dreams of a family and the enduring power of their love, a love that is as boundless as the universe itself.

Chaudhary (Om Puri) is the head of the mob waiting outside police station. There is an Inspector in charge Chaube (Manoj Joshi) who is waiting for his promotion and a corrupt Havaldar Sales D'souza (Asrani). Negotiations are going on. But all hell break loose when someone lodges a complaint about a missing truck with loads of cash and gold.

Together, Neha and Vijay start a jewelry business but face sabotage from Arnav, Neha's family, and her jealous friend Mona. Through love, trust, and determination, they overcome every obstacle. The turning point comes when Neha's design sells for 10 million at an auction, proving her talent and their bond stronger than money or status.

Hindi Language.name: Imaan Dol Jayega

Hindi Language.name: #Bluetick (Verified)
