Hindi Language.description: In Bhurangarh, people worship the satanic force Malik. Soon, a city-based Nikki arrives to marry her prince charming and ends up challenging the evil entity.

Hindi Language.name: The Confession
Hindi Language.description: In 1966 Kerala, the murder of Marie shakes a small community. Father Benedict holds the key to the truth in confession, but revealing it would break his holy obligations.

Hindi Language.name: Kahani Pehle Pyaar Ki
Hindi Language.description: Neha, a second-born daughter, loves her childhood friend Sanju. However, she senses there are important life goals she needs to accomplish before settling down.

Hindi Language.name: Sandeh
Hindi Language.description: A group of students from an engineering college on an excursion tour filled with suspense,thrills,romance,music and action goes through series of events and deaths leaving them all stunned and thereby grows a strong plot called SANDEH

Hindi Language.name: Gambler: One Table, One Mission, No Mercy
Hindi Language.description: A humble casino waiter with a hidden talent for gambling embarks on a years-long quest to unmask his father's killer, forging unlikely alliances and risking it all as he seeks justice in the shadows of Goa's dazzling underworld.

Hindi Language.name: Khajoors
Hindi Language.description: Dive into the ultimate conversation starter as we explore the world of desi drinks and delightful banter. Join us for hilarious stories, insightful opinions, and unexpected challenges, all tied together with our beloved beverages.

Hindi Language.name: Mard Ko Dard?
Hindi Language.description: Two friends get in touch with a woman who gets them hooked up, but later they face the consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Sanduk
Hindi Language.description: WWI twin soldier brothers desert and find refuge in an abandoned mansion. They discover a Sanduk said to grant deepest desires. A tense tale of greed, morality, and destiny unfolds as the chest's secret pulls them in.

Hindi Language.name: Naam Namak Nishan
Hindi Language.description: Follows the journey of young cadets at the prestigious Officers Training Academy in Chennai, exploring themes of brotherhood, love for the nation, and the essence of genuine bonds

Hindi Language.name: Love Adhura
Hindi Language.description: A simple guy meets a charming damsel who cons him out of his car, leading to unexpected twists and dramatic consequences involving his overbearing father and a staged romance at their resort.

Hindi Language.name: Oye Bhootni Ke
Hindi Language.description: Rivalry between Broker and the Owner of Haunted Hermitage in outskirt of city traps, fun loving fake Ghost Exorcist Trio to put their life on stake against Ghost mob Inside and Goon Horde outside the Hermitage.

Hindi Language.name: Engaged
Hindi Language.description: In "Engaged," singles face flirty tasks, wild card twists, and partner swaps to prove they've got the 3Cs-compatibility, communication, and commitment.

Hindi Language.name: Gili Gili Raat
Hindi Language.description: Professor Vikrant and his wife Tanya, who enjoy role-playing for excitement, head to Lonavala for a getaway. While Tanya is away, two girls, Kajal and Naina, appear at their doorstep seeking shelter from a stalker.

Hindi Language.name: Qaatil Haseena
Hindi Language.description: Shanaya and Rohit become entangled in a web of lies, deceit, and murder. As they each pursue their own agenda, the line between truth and deception blurs, leading to a gripping tale of suspense and betrayal.

Hindi Language.name: Batashey Gungun
Hindi Language.description: A disturbed student's brilliant mind spirals into obsession over her professor, transforming love into something sinister.

Hindi Language.name: Bal Naren
Hindi Language.description: Idea of cleanliness and how a 14-year-old boy, with his determination and efforts, prevented his village from getting any case of Coronavirus.

Hindi Language.name: Apradh
Hindi Language.description: A man who was trying to cross the river of life in 2 boats, would his boat cross?

Hindi Language.name: Kartam Bhugtam
Hindi Language.description: Dev returns to Bhopal after his father's death to claim property. A paperwork issue leads him to meet Anna, a guru who helps resolve it. His fiancée Jia finds him living poorly, doubting Anna's existence.

Hindi Language.name: Olive Green +ve
Hindi Language.description: A retired Colonel confronts the son of a terrorist he killed, leading to a tense encounter driven by vengeance, remorse, and the prospect of redemption.

Hindi Language.name: Moti Sethani
Hindi Language.description: In Rajasthan, Narayani, believed to be the reincarnation of Mahabharata's Uttara, embarks on a spiritual journey. Her devotion and sacrifice lead her to become the revered Rani Sati Dadi.

Hindi Language.name: Sant Tukaram
Hindi Language.description: The story of the 17th-century poet and well-known religious figure, Sant Tukaram.

Hindi Language.name: Legends of Shiva with Amish
Hindi Language.description: Amish travels India to uncover the true essence of Lord Shiva, exploring why his Tandav dance shakes the cosmos and discovering his deep meaning in Sanatana Dharma, beyond myths and legends.

Hindi Language.name: Rehna Nahi Bin Tere
Hindi Language.description: The film "Rehna Nahi Bin Tere" intimately explores his life, his experiences with love, and his evolution into the responsible man his industrialist father always envisioned, as he rises to lead the family business.

Hindi Language.name: Ajab Gajab Dhamal
Hindi Language.description: Two prisoners, Jarnail Singh and Tarsem Lal, escape from prison on the day of Baisakhi. However, their troubles increase when they learn that they were to be pardoned by the jail minister.

Hindi Language.name: Badmash
Hindi Language.description: A man who was trying to cross the river of life in 2 boats, would his boat cross?

Hindi Language.name: Body
Hindi Language.description: After being stripped and bullied during a village trip, a traumatized actor in post-covid Mumbai starts public stripping. While struggling mentally, he befriends a boy facing paternal abuse, leading to an unpredictable path.

Hindi Language.name: Shat-Shat Atal
Hindi Language.description: On the 100th birth anniversary of Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee, Shat-Shat Atal looks back at the life of the leader who became the first Indian Prime Minister in 50 years to be directly elected by the people in his first term. The film shows how his love for poetry, his deep devotion to the nation and his honest, gentle leadership earned him lasting respect. It reveals the true Atal, simple, warm and inspiring to generations.

Hindi Language.name: Barah by Barah
Hindi Language.description: A photographer who clicks the last photographs' of the dead at Varanasi's Manikarnika ghat goes on a journey through the periphery of the circle of life and death.

Hindi Language.name: rd October
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around two lawyers with contrasting perspectives, each justified in their own right. The film sheds light on the role of the justice system and the media within our society.

Hindi Language.name: The Diary of West Bengal
Hindi Language.description: Centred around the illegal influx of Rohingya Muslims and Bangladeshis extremist communities in the state and how the settlement of the Rohingyas and Bangladeshi infiltrators is being facilitated by the state government.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Sanak
Hindi Language.description: Two brothers find themselves entangled in a love triangle after one's fiancée becomes drawn to the other. Their family harmony shatters when buried history surfaces unexpectedly.

Hindi Language.name: Suman Indori
Hindi Language.description: Suman runs food truck in Indor. Her brother Rishi, involved with aspiring MLA Teerth Mittal, dies during a protest. To preserve his image, Teerth marries Suman. Suman strives to heal the Mittal family and uncover Teerth's true intentions.

Hindi Language.name: Pyramid - Scheme Ya Scam
Hindi Language.description: After Arjun Banerjee, founder of India's first crypto exchange, is murdered, millions find their Pyramid accounts frozen. As police suspect his partner Niharika, journalist Vrinda exposes a multi-billion-dollar scam of betrayal.

Hindi Language.name: Qayaamat Se Qayaamat Tak
Hindi Language.description: Two lovers who promised each other that they would never be separated find their story together seemingly ended by a fatal car accident, but one of them reincarnates to fulfil their vows.

Hindi Language.name: In Transit
Hindi Language.description: Explores the lives of trans and non-binary individuals navigating love, identity, and the boundaries of gender in a uniquely Indian way.

Hindi Language.name: Gaming Insaan
Hindi Language.description: YouTuber Nischay Malhan, aka Triggered Insaan leaves his comfort zone to chase an impossible dream: becoming a pro-gamer in just three months. As tensions rise, will he conquer the e-sports world or crack under the weight of expectations?

Hindi Language.name: IRaH
Hindi Language.description: Everybody wants a piece of Hari Singh and his revolutionary new app: the IRAH 5.10. Sadly, this extends to kidnappers, Police, Cyber Security Agencies and international hackers.

Hindi Language.name: Dilwali Dulha Le Jayegi
Hindi Language.description: A young Sukoon wants to marry Aayush, but learns that he has shifted to Mumbai with his parents. Twenty years later, she comes to the city to reunite with her childhood sweetheart.

Hindi Language.name: Suswagatam Khushamadeed
Hindi Language.description: "Suswagatam Khushamadeed" intends to spread a message of love, friendship and compassion elements that glue a society together. The film will fulfil the much required love , support and humour in this dark times.

Hindi Language.name: Pad Gaye Pange
Hindi Language.description: Shastri Ji, a retired math teacher, shares his home with his son Nilesh and daughter-in-law Madhu. Madhu desires a new apartment, away from Shastri Ji's quirks. Ayush leads a monotonous life, brightened by his girlfriend Parul.

Hindi Language.name: Ghaprol: Garhwali Movie
Hindi Language.description: One day, bored with bustling city life, two friends Vicky and Kunal residing in New Delhi decide to take a break and go on a getaway holiday to a peaceful place.

Hindi Language.name: Amma
Hindi Language.description: Jaya Malini, a famous actress from Bangalore, one day her 9 year old daughter is raped and murdered. The blame is put on an ex-income tax officer. When the officer is caught by the police, he declares himself as Radhe Maa to escape from the police. When Jaya comes to know about this, she takes her out of the police station and keeps her in a closed factory and then tortures her and takes revenge for her daughter.

Hindi Language.name: Lost Queen
Hindi Language.description: Lost Queen is a poignant documentary centered on Sultana Begum, the great-granddaughter-in-law of the last Mughal emperor, Bahadur Shah Zafar. Living in poverty in a Howrah slum, she wages a solitary legal battle to reclaim her ancestral right to the Red Fort - once the heart of imperial India, now a distant memory. Through her powerful story, the film explores the forgotten legacy of India's last royal bloodline and the quiet strength of a woman confronting historical silence.

Hindi Language.name: Naag Bhoomi
Hindi Language.description: Madan, an archaeologist, uncovers a connection between a series of mysterious events and a myth about a shape-shifting serpent.

Hindi Language.name: Binddii
Hindi Language.description: Born in prison, young Binddii is the shining light of her mother's life. Time flies, and now, she has to step out in the real world all alone. What awaits her?

Hindi Language.name: Pati Patni Aur Robot
Hindi Language.description: Kiara, a renowned scientist, gifts her husband, Sam, an AI robot named Meera. Kiara is very busy with her work, and Sam, feeling lonely, finds love in Meera. Now Sam wishes to be with Meera, which displeases Kiara. Consequently, Sam and Meera devise a plan to kill Kiara. Will they succeed? This is a story of pure emotion, love, and betrayal.

Hindi Language.name: Ishani
Hindi Language.description: A tragedy shattered Ishani's dreams, changing her fate forever. In a life where hope remains elusive, she journeys to reinvent herself whilst finding love.

Hindi Language.name: Second Chance
Hindi Language.description: After experiencing the first major trauma of her young life, Nia retreats to her family summer home in the Himalayas where time, nature and unlikely friendships help her heal.

Hindi Language.name: The Networker
Hindi Language.description: After his MLM company fails, Aditya partners with networker Lallan and friend Raghav to launch new ventures backed by Pradhan. They hire a motivational speaker and fake MD before absconding to Dubai with investors' money.

Hindi Language.name: Bandit Shakuntala
Hindi Language.description: Shakuntala grows up in poverty, part of the lowest cast in Indian society. At a young age she decides to improve her position and make a better life for herself through studying hard. But at the age of 12 she is brutally raped by the Chief of her village, humiliated and dishonored she is unable to get justice. Forced into an arranged marriage with a drunkard, the marriage doesn't last. But tragedy strikes again as she is gang raped again by the Chief together with a mob of villagers. When rescued by Nadeem, an outlaw bandit, she is taught the skills on how to avenge herself. Gun in hand she seeks revenge for everything she and other women like her, have had to endure. Her name instills dread and fear, but this is just the start of her journey for justice and retribution.

Hindi Language.name: Loktantra: Power of the People
Hindi Language.description: Dhruv Mehra, who wants revenge on Vidhayak's nephew for some personal reasons, is the protagonist. It is a fight between a politician and the common people. This video is the 2nd part of NETAGIRI : Power of the Politician where all this revenge story begins.

Hindi Language.name: One Last Time
Hindi Language.description: Mukti, a 24-year-old woman, ends a relationship. Her obsessive ex Janardan waits outside her building with acid, intent on defacing her for rejecting him. As he waits in a taxi, fate intervenes. Will he succeed or will a miracle occur?

Hindi Language.name: Soch - A perception
Hindi Language.description: In serene Arkee, Officer Priyanka Negi's investigation into social activist Shaila Awasthi's disappearance sparks a national uproar, but as communal tensions rise, one question lingers: is the true enemy within or beyond the village walls?

Hindi Language.name: Della Bella Badlegi Kahaani
Hindi Language.description: A 'pre-love story' of a changing India. Changes that are taking place across society and psyche, where a small-town girl, Dollu, popular as DELLA BELLA becomes a beacon of women's self-exploration through a journey of her own.

Hindi Language.name: Missing Face
Hindi Language.description: Aryan suffers from face blindness. He receives an SOS from his younger brother, who went missing. With friends turning on him, police disbelieving him and his inability to recognise faces, how will Aryan uncover the truth and save him?

Hindi Language.name: Follow Kar Lo Yaar
Hindi Language.description: An infamous girl's bizarre outfits gain attention. Seeking to reshape her image, she joins a talent agency while struggling to keep her dysfunctional family afloat. Can she make it?

Hindi Language.name: Pride
Hindi Language.description: Story of A Girl Nandini who dreamed of becoming a doctor since childhood.She left no stone unturned to fulfill this dream. Always topper in school..Nandini got very good rank in medical entrance.But she could not get admission in any government college. Nandini is depressed and now she does not feel like anywhere.Her Friend Aditya gets admission in Law College and they both get separated. One day Nandini meets M.L.A Veer Partap and shouts at him in the midst of the crowd that so much effort, so much reading and writing is useless. Even after getting a good rank, she could not get admission and now he will have to get her admission done anywhere. Veer Partap's ego is hurt. Nandini gets admission in a Pvt Medical College by the influence of Veerpartap ,For this help Veerpartap wants to make physical relations with Nandini. When he tries to forcefully with Nandini, She spits on his face and runs away.In the night Four masked men enter her house kill her parents and took her at Veerpartap House.VeerPartap again tries Forcefully with her but she runs away. the goons of Veerpartap try to kill her but Williams saves her and took her to his house. Williams runs a NGO which helps the destitute girls to be established. William takes great care of her. Goons of Veerpartap tell Veerpartap that nandini has died. By the help of Williams Nandini goes to Germany for medical studies.. She has become a very famous doctor.After 15 years, on the request of Dr. Gupta, she comes to India again to perform the surgery of Health Minister Veer Partap.But during the surgery, she faints. Veer Partap dies. Investigation starts.The police get a call that Veer Partap must have died in the midst of surgery but it was a preplanned murder.Police investigates and Dr. Gupta, Nandini and the team of other doctors are accused of Veerpartap's murder.JudgeAditya is shocked to see Nandini alive in the court. The case goes on.The night before the surgery, a man named Anant gives Gupta a bag full of money, the video of which is caught by the police.But Gupta says that he has taken a bribe for some admissions in Medical colleges. and this money has no link with the case.The police could not prove anything else, Gupta is sentenced to 10 years in the bribery case and everyone else is proved innocent.Case gets closed. The police again get a call from the same man, saying that the murderer is very clever. The police are shocked.The combination of present and past plays in the story. Doctor Nandini, Dr gupta , PA ramnath ,Veer Partap's young wife and her mysterious boy friend, Maskman who calls the police, and Williams are under suspicion. The Suspense opens in the end

Hindi Language.name: Paro Sang Dev
Hindi Language.description: "Paro Sang Dev" is an Indian TV series on Dangal TV about a girl named Paro from a humble background who enters into a fateful marriage with an affluent man, Dev, where her hidden truth threatens their relationship

Hindi Language.name: Jaan Abhi Baaki Hai
Hindi Language.description: A young man falls deeply in love with a tourist, and their romance becomes a path to personal growth and social consciousness.

Hindi Language.name: Kya Masti Kya Dhoom
Hindi Language.description: In a bid to become successful by any means necessary, two friends get embroiled with a mafia boss, leading to hilarious misunderstandings and complex predicaments.

Hindi Language.name: Hind Di Chadar - Guru Ladho Re
Hindi Language.description: The Ninth Sikh Guru, Tegh Bahadur, stood up for humanity when fear gripped a nation. His ultimate sacrifice 350 years ago still inspires courage today.

Hindi Language.name: Chalti Rahe Zindagi
Hindi Language.description: Krishna explores Arjun's wife's infidelity with Aru's husband, Sushma's financial strain on Krishna, and generational clashes between Leela, Naina, and Siya during lockdown. Characters face adversities, testing their perseverance.

Hindi Language.name: Namriti
Hindi Language.description: Namriti has been mysteriously found dead and ruin starts occurring in Sarpgrah. Namriti's soul unravels the mystery of her death and the cause of Sarpgrah's chaos. Season 02 Comes with a Different Plot and Twist.

Hindi Language.name: Dead Dead Full Dead
Hindi Language.description: This is a Surreal Whodunit Murder Mystery

Hindi Language.name: The Mirror Room
Hindi Language.description: Trapped in a time loop trying to solve a murder, detective Aarav's mind fractures. Torn between his partners' advice, he must solve the case while confronting a terrifying possibility: he is the most unreliable witness.

Hindi Language.name: Family Aaj Kal
Hindi Language.description: The Kashyaps' like to believe that they are an open-minded lot that respects everybody's work, but their own daughter's choices make them question- is no work really too small?

Hindi Language.name: PCMB
Hindi Language.description: In the shadowed hostels and coaching lanes of Kota, four NEET aspirants chase medical dreams-until one of them uncovers a dangerous shortcut buried beneath the system, threatening to tear their futures-and friendships-apart.

Hindi Language.name: Dhaaak
Hindi Language.description: A brilliant student aspires to achieve something extraordinary for his nation and society, aiming to make his parents proud. He falls for his classmate, but her father opposes their relationship, leading to a clash of ideals and emotions.

Hindi Language.name: Appu - The Yogic Elephant
Hindi Language.description: This beloved children's series revolves around Appu, a young elephant endowed with extraordinary abilities, as he sets out on a quest to uncover his powers and explore the wonders of the world. Throughout his journey, he encounters thrilling adventures and triumphs over various challenges that come his way.

Hindi Language.name: Farming the Revolution
Hindi Language.description: In 2020 Gurbaz Sangha, a young Punjabi farmer led thousands to Delhi protesting new Farm Laws. Joined by over half a million from diverse backgrounds they remained at borders despite COVID lockdown vowing to stay until laws were repealed.

Hindi Language.name: Fatima
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around Fatima, a woman with an unwavering resolution. Despite her own limited education, Fatima is determined to provide her daughter with a brighter future. Challenged by financial difficulties and her husband's debilitating illness, Fatima operates a humble tea stall to support her family. However, their lives take a tragic turn when a horrific incident involving her daughter leads to a devastating outcome. Overwhelmed by grief and societal shame, Fatima decides to take matters into her own hands. She orchestrates a complex plan to deliver her own form of justice, meticulously framing a crime in a way that implicates the wife of the inspector investigating the case. Assisted by the influential politician, Bhaiya Ji, whose sons are connected to the crime, Fatima navigates the intricate web of deceit and manipulation. Her actions not only challenge the boundaries of the law but also set off a high-stakes game of intrigue and deception in the pursuit of her own version of justice.

Hindi Language.name: Bengal 1947
Hindi Language.description: Explores the partition of India in 1947, focusing specifically on the impact on Bengal.

Hindi Language.name: Welcome Wedding
Hindi Language.description: It is a light hear-ted surreal comedy target to attract masses and is a hilarious family entertainer featuring Komal Jha and Sahil Kohli as main leads.

Hindi Language.name: In the Belly of a Tiger
Hindi Language.description: An elderly farmer decides sacrificing himself to a tiger will free his family from poverty. He shares a final surreal night with his wife before his planned death.

Hindi Language.name: Nafratein
Hindi Language.description: Torn between destructive rage and healing love, Karan struggles to find his place in a world that pushes him to the edge.

Hindi Language.name: Gharwali Pedwali
Hindi Language.description: Gharwali Pedwali is the story of Jeetu Pandey, a man cursed with a life of doubles: 2 mothers, 2 ideologies, and 2 wives. Set against the vibrant, mystical backdrop of Benaras.

Hindi Language.name: Loop
Hindi Language.description: When premonitions of her husband cheating on her with another woman she saw in her dreams torment, a young woman, Shravanya, confides in her best friend, leading to fatalistic consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Iss Ishq Ka Rabb Rakha
Hindi Language.description: Ranbir, a proud Sardar, falls in love with Bengali beauty Meghla. But, sparks fly when their culturally different families come face-to-face. Is love enough?

Hindi Language.name: I, Poppy
Hindi Language.description: A son fights corrupt officials while his mother tends their poppy farm in India. As authorities strike back at their lower-caste family, they must choose between keeping food on the table and standing up for what's right.

Hindi Language.name: Yes Papa
Hindi Language.description: The film delves into the life of a daughter who becomes a victim of abuse, perpetrated by her own father. The film portrays the haunting presence of a father looming over his daughter, who eventually finds herself on trial for his murder.

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu & The Race to the Diamond Valley
Hindi Language.description: Motu and Patlu decide to participate in the race to help their village's development. Soon after, they land in France, where they face off against talented racers from various parts of the world. Will they emerge victorious?

Hindi Language.name: Kaakbhushundi Ramayan
Hindi Language.description: Kakbhushundi, the wise and immortal crow narrates the Ramayan to Garuda revealing deep truths about devotion dharma and the eternal battle between good and evil Through his bird's-eye view offers timeless wisdom on faith and righteousness.

Hindi Language.name: Gamerlog
Hindi Language.description: A teen gaming prodigy joins an underdog Mumbai esports team challenging the champion Wolfclan. As they pursue glory, Raghu seeks Joanna's love while hiding secrets from his past.

Hindi Language.name: Avantika
Hindi Language.description: Macky Is A Flop Film maker Who Wants to make A New Movie With A super Star Farukh Khan. But Unfortunately This Time To Make Movie Unique, He Takes The Entire Unit To A Palace Where They Shouldn't be. With Full Of Turns and Twists At Last He Completes The Movie Named Avantika. But At What Cost???

Hindi Language.name: Let's Meet
Hindi Language.description: TV actor Nikhil connects with finance professional Priya on social media. Their online friendship blossoms until his overeager action pushes her away. He hopes for a chance to restore their connection.

Hindi Language.name: Bas Itna Sa Khwaab
Hindi Language.description: Avani, a dedicated housewife from Kanpur, works as a beautician to support her family amidst financial crises. Balancing home and work, she overcomes personal challenges to prove her potential.

Hindi Language.name: The Black Essence
Hindi Language.description: What does it mean to truly live? A father, son, caretaker, and lover-each trapped in their own way. As guilt, duty, and longing collide, a disabled son's dark temptation forces his father to face the unthinkable.

Hindi Language.name: Benaam Rishta
Hindi Language.description: In the City of Dreams, Hema, a housemaid, dared to dream of love-unexpectedly, with her employer Shikha's husband, Rohan. Will this forbidden affair satisfy her yearning for love, or will their relationship remain undefined?

Hindi Language.name: Saira Khan Case
Hindi Language.description: After a cruel talaq abroad, a resilient mother defies oppressive laws and fights back through India's secular courts-battling for her children, her rights, and her dignity in a powerful journey of justice and courage.

Hindi Language.name: Flames
Hindi Language.description: Mahesh, a mute farm worker, is forced to go on a run to protect his son who gets accused of a murder.

Hindi Language.name: GoodBye
Hindi Language.description: Rahul, torn between the memories of his past love Kanika and his present with Nisha, struggles to move on. When Kanika suddenly reappears, unresolved emotions force him to confront love, loss, and the true meaning of goodbye.

Hindi Language.name: Namacool
Hindi Language.description: Mayank and Piyush, inseparable best friends, embark on their journey to uncover the true essence of manhood. However, yearning for popularity and romance, a chain of hilarious misfortunes thrusts them into the midst of a murder accusation.

Hindi Language.name: Ambat Shoukin
Hindi Language.description: The film portrays a humorous journey of three friends trapped in the world of social media.

Hindi Language.name: Deewani
Hindi Language.description: Story revolves around a girl named Meera who has a strong belief in love Despite witnessing a heartbreaking incident where a girl is murdered by her own lover named Parth Meera firmly maintains her belief in Parth's innocence in the crime.

Hindi Language.name: Game Over
Hindi Language.description: It is the notorious 90's when crime was at it's all time high. Raja Vasooli, a dreaded gangster is embroiled in a cat and mouse chase with an encounter specialist cop, Deshmukh. Who will survive this deadly game?

Hindi Language.name: Qaatil Ki Talaash
Hindi Language.description: A daughter cries for justice. Long after her last breath. Too Late to Hold You is a chilling supernatural thriller where family neglect, betrayal, and murder collide

Hindi Language.name: Saako 363
Hindi Language.description: Saako 363 is the 300-year-old tale of the sacrifice of 363 Bishnois to save trees. King Abhay Singh needed wood to build his Flower Palace, but it was difficult to find in the desert-like Rajasthan. The only greenery was in the Bishnoi villages. Bishnois are followers of Jambheshwar Maharaj's 29 principles, which emphasize the protection of nature and living beings. They believe that sacrificing one's life to save trees is a noble act, as their guru has said, "If you have to cut your head to save a tree, it's a cheap deal." Girdharlal Bhandari, the king's minister, who harbored a grudge against the Bishnois, led a group of soldiers to the Bishnoi village to cut down trees. However, they faced resistance from the Bishnois. Amrita Devi, a simple and truthful Bishnoi woman, led the resistance, inspiring neighboring villages to join the fight. This incident is an example of extraordinary courage. The axes and swords clashed, and the number of beheaded Bishnois grew. The killers grew tired, but the Bishnois remained steadfast, refusing to let a single tree be cut. This is a unique and unparalleled incident in the history of not only Bharat but the whole of world, inspiring us to protect nature, wildlife, and the environment.

Hindi Language.name: Sarkari Baccha
Hindi Language.description: This is biggest issue in India Jobs

Hindi Language.name: Chitta Ve
Hindi Language.description: A childless woman facing social stigma falls prey to manipulation when a stranger promises her a better life, leading her into the perilous world of drug trafficking.

Hindi Language.name: Hanak
Hindi Language.description: Hanak is a Crime Thriller based on the book " Main Kanpur Waala" inspired by Real -Life incidents of the Biggest Crime Boss " Vikas Dubey " The notorious Vikas Dubey epitomizes the immorality of the humanity.

Hindi Language.name: Emerald Green: The Unsolved Mystery
Hindi Language.description: Based on the novel Emerald Green, Mac, a passionate artist whose life takes a dark turn when he encounters a dying man on a deserted road. The man's final words-"Emerald Green"-become the key to a chilling mystery. As Mac dives deeper into the investigation, secrets unravel, and danger closes in. Will he uncover the truth behind the murder, or will the secret of Emerald Green remain buried forever?

Hindi Language.name: Apna Amitabh
Hindi Language.description: A ninth-grader from a village idolizes Amitabh Bachchan but feels shame over his father's work as a toilet cleaner. As a lower-caste boy facing ridicule, Vijay struggles against discrimination while pursuing his dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Ghotala
Hindi Language.description: Priya, an ambitious working-class girl, gets entangled in an MLM scheme through Sahil's false promises of stardom. As she discovers its criminal links, she must fight to expose the truth and escape danger.

Hindi Language.name: Sipahi
Hindi Language.description: Agent Korkut Ali Türkoglu, trained by the National Intelligence Organization, uncovers crucial information about plans concerning Turkey.

Hindi Language.name: Bhanumati
Hindi Language.description: Watch a gripping historical drama unfold as a ruthless monarch schemes to preserve his royal lineage at any cost. But will his plan succeed, or does destiny have other plans? Bhanumati is a tale of treachery, love, betrayal, and legacy - a powerful story of one woman's tryst with fate.

Hindi Language.name: Pyar Ke Do Naam
Hindi Language.description: Two strangers, Kaira and Aryan, cross paths and bond over their differing ideologies about life and love, leading to an unconventional relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Durga - Atoot Prem Kahani
Hindi Language.description: A young Indian girl's journey of self-discovery, navigating societal prejudices, domestic abuse, and her pursuit of education amidst unfulfilled love, cultural complexities, and aspirations.

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu vs the Ghost House
Hindi Language.description: In Motu Patlu vs. the Ghost House, a builder plans to demolish Furfuri Nagar for an amusement park, so he hires John the Don to scare the residents away with a ghost plot. John and his goons dress as ghosts to steal from and frighten the townspeople, but the friends discover the ruse after seeing a fake ghost and realizing the builder's involvement. To combat the fake ghosts, Dr. Jhatka creates a special "invisibility powder" to turn the tables on John and the builder.

Hindi Language.name: Naisha
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around Naisha Bose, a free-spirited woman with a Bengali-Mizo heritage, and Zain Kapoor, a stand-up comedian, rapper, and swimmer. Their paths cross unexpectedly, leading to a deep yet complicated relationship.

Hindi Language.name: Tomchi
Hindi Language.description: Six troublemaking kids change their ways after befriending a dog named Tomchi. Upon learning he belongs to someone else, they plan to return him - but Tomchi gets stolen, sparking their search to find and return him.

Hindi Language.name: Smart Killer
Hindi Language.description: A business tycoon family's two brothers Vijay & Arjun Ranawat, who have enemity with a Criminal Don Kabir Chopra. Kabir forcefully wants the partnership in Vijay & Arjun's construction company "Sharda group of companies" but Vijay and Arjun don't bow to his demand because after many long-long hardships they have established the company. Both the brothers take the Kabir's challenge and warn him of any foolish attempt. But Kabir underestimates them and he wages a war against them. In the course of this war Vijay's brother Arjun is killed by Kabir's orders being in the Jail. Now Vijay challenges Kabir that before coming out of Jail he should order the wood and Ghee for his pyre because the same day he will have to go to the Shamshaan(cremation ground). Vijay is furious on his brother's death and plans everything so precisely that he successfully completes his challenge and takes his brother's revenge by killing Kabir on the very same day when he comes out of the jail. In front of Kabir's burning pyre Kabir's 14 year old son Raj Chopra takes the vow of finishing Vijay Ranawat's whole family. After about 9-10 years Vijay's sons Suraj & Veer and Arjun's son Akash become young and takes over the business. One day Vijay dies in plane crash and all three brothers run the company successfully. Raj along with a girl Ayesha plans to ruin Vijay Ranawat's family, on the other side Akash also wants to grab Suraj and Veer's property and makes a plan along with his girlfriend Tina to kill his brothers. Ayesha is the daughter of Mukesh, ex-manager of Sharda group of companies who was thrown out of the company on theft charges. According to their plan Ayesha becomes the girlfriend of Suraj to take her revenge, as well as to make Raj Chopra's plan successful. One day Akash plans to kill Suraj and Veer in a club. When Akash is just about to shoot Suraj and Veer some body else kills them. Akash gets the shock of his life. Now somebody starts Black mailing Akash by showing him the video clipping of his aiming to kill Suraj and Veer. Now the real mind game starts Between the blackmailer and Akash. What happens to Akash.... Who is the blackmailer of Akash.... what happens to Raj and Ayesha's planning to ruin Ranawat's family and does Akash succeed in grabbing his brother's property, all these answers we will be getting in the climax of "Smart Killer" .

Hindi Language.name: Aakhir Palaayan Kab Tak..?

Hindi Language.name: Srishti
Hindi Language.description: Lured to the forbidden forests of the Himalayas, a photojournalist unearths secrets that unravel his mind and challenge the very nature of reality.

Hindi Language.name: Badi Heroine Banti Hai
Hindi Language.description: Advait and Kajal meet at his fashion house. Attraction and hate lead to drama as intern and boss become fake fiances to save his empire.

Hindi Language.name: Mamta Child Factory

Hindi Language.name: Haseeno Ka Inteqaam
Hindi Language.description: Moosa, a smuggler who searches for an idol's missing part is contacted by two people who claim to have it. Mysterious things start to happen when they arrive at the meeting point while someone keeps a watch on all their activities.

Hindi Language.name: My Groom a Billionaire
Hindi Language.description: Jay, a rich businessman, ends up marrying Megha after running from his arranged wedding. She mistakes him for a waiter and proposes when her groom leaves her. As they fall in love, he keeps his real identity secret.

Hindi Language.name: Kunwarapur
Hindi Language.description: It is the story of a strange and cursed village where the entire young generation is unmarried, Bagheli Superstar Avinash Tiwari plays the lead role in this film as Prem Prakash Parauha (Pappu) and Annapurna Dwivedi as Lalita (Lalli).

Hindi Language.name: Me and You
Hindi Language.description: Tom, a corporate worker and gifted painter, copes with routine through art. After a crushing breakup leaves him devastated, his creative passion fades - until Kavya enters the picture.

Hindi Language.name: Chhoriyan Chali Gaon
Hindi Language.description: Eleven urban female celebrities swap city life for rural challenges, testing their grit and adaptability as they navigate a world vastly different from their own.

Hindi Language.name: Malhar
Hindi Language.description: In a remote Kutch village, three interconnected stories unfold. Two friends battle to repair a hearing aid. Jasmine and Jatin, from different faiths, face obstacles in their love. Newly-wed Kesar endures pressure to conceive from her law.

Hindi Language.name: Sir Syed Ahmad Khan the Messiah

Hindi Language.name: Lie Hard

Hindi Language.description: Shivangi saves her sister from a dowry-driven marriage only to be forced into marrying Ranbir, a man bound by family pressure and debt. Rejected by the Pandey's, she finds strength in truth and compassion. As she slowly steadies the troubled home, Shivangi begins to see Ranbir's true nature and love quietly takes root between them.

Hindi Language.name: Hours Survival: Gauraiya Live
Hindi Language.description: A girl and her family in crisis. The family's request for rescue from politicians goes in vain when they create a political agenda around Gauraiya's life.

Hindi Language.name: Safar Mein Sheher
Hindi Language.description: Six journeys. One day. Infinite hope. Experience Mumbai's relentless spirit as the lives of a designer, a house-help, two best friends, a female taxi driver, a small-town boy, and a call-center exec intersect in the city of dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Tauba Tera Jalwa
Hindi Language.description: The self-loving real estate tycoon of Uttar Pradesh, Romi Tyagi, faces life changes when he meets Rinku, who dreams of a prince charming, and Laila enters their lives, hiding twists around each corner.

Hindi Language.name: Shukrdosh
Hindi Language.description: Sundar Asopa wanted opulence and contentment in his life but for that his Shukranus must reach the destination so his Shukrdosh can come to an end, but this journey turns out to be a domino effect of disasters for him.

Hindi Language.description: In 1390 Himalayan kingdom Lahora, warrior princess Rajnandini leads defenses against Afghan invaders and faces internal threats. She must protect her realm while confronting Bhimavati, a former ally seeking revenge.

Hindi Language.description: Movie(End of the World) dubbed from Hollywood Movie : End of the World Starcast :Greg Grunberg, Neil Grayston, Caroline Cave and Others Director: Steven R. Monroe Banner: CineTel Films Hindi Dub Banner: Wide Angle Media Pvt. Ltd.

Hindi Language.description: A Couple goes to a hill station to spend some time at a friend's farmhouse, but a mysterious person disturbs them, teases them, and wants to kill them

Hindi Language.description: A Mute Dalit rickshaw puller named Jugal sacrifices everything to educate his son ''Tarengan'' but after becoming educate, Tarengan starts to hate his father and commit suicide.

Hindi Language.name: Motu Patlu & The Rise of Zombies
Hindi Language.description: As the zombie leader seeks to turn all humans into zombies, Motu and Patlu are determined to find a way to save the world from this trouble. Will they succeed in their mission?

Hindi Language.name: Siharan
Hindi Language.description: Siharan is a horror film which has a very old tradition.discriminates between black and white women The Sarpanch exploits those women.Among them, a woman named Mohini fights with the Sarpanch and eradicates that Sarpanch and his tradition.

Hindi Language.name: Money Hai to Honey Hai
Hindi Language.description: Kabir, an aspiring entrepreneur who launches his own marketing firm. Mona, a successful model with whom Kabir has a past relationship, wants to be part of his campaign. However, Kabir is now married to Sushmita. The conflict arises when Mona manipulates Kabir's image in the media by leveling molestation charges against him. Can a wife save her husband in such a situation?

Hindi Language.name: Sad Letters of an Imaginary Woman
Hindi Language.description: Nidhi, mid-aged, and Meera, elderly mother, confront emotional scars, shattered dreams. Journey unveils generational wounds, unresolved conflicts.

Hindi Language.name: Main Nida
Hindi Language.description: Main Nida is an audio-visual biographical documentation drawing the attention of the audience in general and the artistic world in particular, towards the legendary journey of one of the greatest modern Indian poet, scholar and philosopher. The documentary is a sensitive assemblage of rare video footage, audio bytes and still photographs, interspersed with authentic tributes recorded over the years with illustrious film industry and literature fraternity colleagues, and decorated with few of Nida Fazli's splendid poetry. The film includes testaments by some of the most admired Poets, Authors, Award winning Film Writers, National Award-winning Film Makers, Family, Wife, Daughter and Young Age Friends etc. The film is shot on location in Madhya Pradesh, Mumbai, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh etc.

Hindi Language.name: God Must Die
Hindi Language.description: * (God Must Die" is inspired by Dostoyevsky's "Notes from Underground" and Nietzsche's "God is Dead," This one-day odyssey follows Abram, a nomadic gypsy. Abram's path begins with a stark declaration: dragging a coffin through the streets, he proclaims, "I have killed God!" This attracts Fitna. His alarm brings media hounds and police, transforming a quiet day into a whirlwind. As chaos unfolds, Abram's past unfolds too. College students hack into his laptop, projecting his private discussions onto a live news channel. This unexpected audience witnesses philosophical debates about existentialism, nihilism, and the very origins of the concept of God. Beyond intellectual discourse, the film delves into humanity's darker side. The conversation shifts to the manipulative use of God's name to justify violence and discrimination based on color, creed, caste, and gender. Abram's act ignites a firestorm. He becomes a symbol, interpreted differently by various factions. Some see him as a Bad Guy, others as a liberator challenging oppressive doctrines. The narrative deftly weaves Abram's philosophical debates with the escalating external conflict. The film builds suspense, leaving the audience to wonder - what is Abram's true motive? Has he truly killed God, or is he a man desperate to awaken the world? "God Must Die" is more than just philosophical musings. It's a social commentary, urging viewers to confront the complex realities of faith, prejudice, and the search for meaning in a seemingly godless world. By the time the police raid Abram's home, he has vanished. His absence becomes a powerful statement, leaving the audience with lingering questions and no easy answers. Did he escape? Was he captured? )

The hitman grants him seven days before carrying out the act. During this week, Rahul unexpectedly falls in love with Taniya. Now, he no longer wishes to die, but the agreement with the hitman cannot be undone. The central question is: Can Taniya and her love save him from his predetermined fate?

Aman ,with the help of his only best friend Subhangshi carries on the search process where he'll be facing his biggest challenge as a human.

Hindi Language.description: Two strangers discover they have little time left to live. Defying fate, they spend their final hours exploring if their newfound connection transcends mortality.

Hindi Language.description: The duo of Motu and Patlu journey to the land of Gagnathoros, inhabited by giants. They encounter the Magnathor, who aims to shrink planets for his crown. Motu and Patlu must battle beasts and protect the Moon and Sun.

Hindi Language.name: Maya Ka Jaal
Hindi Language.description: Mayank's moment with his wife takes a shocking turn when he accidentally reveals an explicit video, uncovering startling secrets about his brother. Confronting her, Mayank triggers events that leave him rattled.

Hindi Language.description: Five friends exploring an abandoned mansion are haunted by two ghosts - one friend, one foe. As they begin to disappear one by one, they realize these ghosts are playing a very specific game, and it may be too late for them to escape.

A prophecy suggested that a reincarnation would happen in Kalyuga who would find the treasure. Well, the dog and dogfather are presumed to be the reincarnation by a popular group of Goons who will stop at nothing till they find the treasure of Mahabharata. The story revolves around the decades-old rivalry of 2 competing wrestling families in Haryana, India. The rich and powerful wrestling family of Hanuman Akhada, and their gritty rivals Bajrang Akhada. Things explode when Sonam, married to Bajrang Akhada's owner Prithvi, runs away with Randeep, the son of the head of Hanuman Akhada. This event becomes a trigger for a dozen people who are either seeking to fulfil their hidden desires or execute their secret vendetta's. Themes of pride, love and vengeance dominate the narrative. So he is now spruced up to take revenge against the savages who are now white color biggies of nation. And they remain assured that having no traces of a crime of yore can never stop them. But Here from onwards a blood shedding crusade incepts versus the feudal system to tear Kunal and his family apart because Kunal and family's reluctance draws them towards their win and which trembles the biggies. Finally, crime never pays even occurred aeon back and love heals even the stale lesion.

Hindi Language.name: Kashi Vishwanath

Hindi Language.name: Kuch Reet Jagat Ki Aisi Hai

Hindi Language.name: Cholay

Hindi Language.name: Main Mulayam Singh Yadav
Hindi Language.description: "ZINDA KAUMEIN PAANCH SAAL TAK INTEZAAR NAHIN KARTI" This quote by one of his guru Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia became his Mantra as he flourished and became one of the most successful Political Leaders in the country MULAYAM SINGH YADAV. A farmer's son in a small village called Safai in Etwas district of Uttar Pradesh fought in most adverse conditions to become the supreme leader of his state. Coming from a very humble background his father wanted him to become a Wrestler, but he was destined to become something bigger. In one of the wrestling contest a local Political leader Nathuram saw this young boy when he slammed wrestlers who were double the size of him, Nathuram saw this strong-willed boy and gave him his first opportunity to enter Politics. It was his destiny that Nathuram also introduced him to one of the most influential leaders of the country of that era Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia. Nathuram also helped him with a job as an English teacher in Karhal but his main focus remained Politics. Lohia's convictions towards the equality of people and other social justice issues strongly influenced Yadav's own ideas about standing up for the rights of minorities and his actions based on those principles marked his subsequent political career. After Lohia came in his life Former Prime Minister of India Chaudhary Charan Singh, from whom he learned the nitty-gritty of politics and it was then Mulayam Singh Yadav became a big name in UP politics, he was also the political heir of Chaudhary Charan Singh. Nathuram, Ram Manohar Lohia and Chaudhary Charan Singh were the 3 pillars who groomed and shaped the political wisdom of Mulayam Singh Yadav. From an English teacher in a Primary school to Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, this is the journey of a man who was in jail for 19 months at the time of Emergency. This is the story of a man who was shot on the day he won his very first election. This is the Story of a man who wrestled and found his way among the giants. When capitalism and bureaucracy were the main pillars of politics, he came and changed the scenario, he changed the game of bigger political parties and big names. This is an inspiring tale of a farmer's son who became the supreme leader of the state.

Hindi Language.name: Heartbeats: Recording Live
