Hindi Language.name: Mafia - Game for Life
Hindi Language.description: Five years after college, six estranged friends gather for a bachelorette party in Madhupur. Soon, a game of Mafia reveals buried secrets that put their bond and lives in danger. Will they survive?

Hindi Language.name: Gaia
Hindi Language.description: Arindam Sehgal, leader of the Labor Party, visits ally Vivek Shukla on a stormy night to negotiate ministerial positions in their fragile coalition. At Vivek's house, he meets Jenna, a mysterious young woman. As the night unfolds and the truth of Jenna unravels, Arindam realizes he's trapped in a web of political betrayal forcing him to question everything he stands for.

Hindi Language.name: A Life Inside Me
Hindi Language.description: A story of a 60-year-old father who wishes to live his final days as his true self - a woman. The film was officially selected at the 2025 KASHISH Pride and won Best Indian Narrative Feature and Best of Festival at the PIQFF Pune.

Hindi Language.name: Sir, Aapke Office Mein Bomb Hai
Shrimati Shukla
Hindi Language.description: A devoted homemaker, Shrimati Shukla, constantly sacrifices for her family but finds her own needs and self-respect ignored, leading to her journey of fighting for her identity and dreams amidst family challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Online Pyaar
Hindi Language.description: Caught between love and temptation, a married man finds himself emotionally entangled with an anonymous woman. One decision leads him to a moment that will test his marriage and his truth.

Hindi Language.name: Prachand
Hindi Language.description: We are just a medium to carry-out God's wish, two brothers Viru and Niru think even their dark deeds are justified, as they are just following God's order.

Hindi Language.name: Gear-Up Click to Login
Hindi Language.description: Tech-savvy graduates face a rapidly changing employment landscape where human behavior parallels computer operations in an AI-dominated corporate world.

Hindi Language.name: Muhnochwa
Hindi Language.description: The infamous case of Muhnochwa that took place in 2002 in Kanpur is back now, Muhnochwa is back to haunt more people and this time its not just rumors or scars but a lot more than that. From the minds of Award Winning director Sankshay Babber.

Hindi Language.name: Andaz Tera Mera
Hindi Language.description: Andaaz Tera Mera is a lighthearted and entertaining comedy film that revolves around two inseparable friends, Amar and Prem. Both share the same dream and a common goal: to marry a beautiful and wealthy girl Raveena.

Hindi Language.name: Case 19: Vichchhiya
Hindi Language.description: One of the rarest explored genres in Indian Cinema, a Found Footage Horror Film. It follows the journey of Inspector Jaydev Sinh Solanki, trying to solve one of the most mysterious cases of our time, Case 19: Vichchhiya, which involves a few people missing in the jungle under mysterious circumstances in the town. Watch The Tale of Greed, Curiosity, and Danger.

Hindi Language.name: Slow Local
Hindi Language.description: Four friends, two of them are a couple, come to Mumbai to pursue their acting career but things turn out opposite to what they had imagined.

Hindi Language.name: Lights, Camera, Achhan
Hindi Language.description: Sundar is on a quest to solve the puzzle of his father's life. His search leads him to his father's filmmaking dreams and a secret half-sister whose mother was the lead actress in B-grade films.

Hindi Language.name: Loop 11:47
Hindi Language.description: Three friends escape mundane routines when they discover a mysterious lake trapping them in a time loop, facing new challenges that test their resilience.

Hindi Language.name: Avani
Hindi Language.description: Meeting an old friend, a woman finds a temporary escape from her chaotic present, and a moment to introspect.

Hindi Language.name: Vicheyam
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of deep investigation of actual murder happened in India . story is about ego, grief , revenge of a common security guard, who murdered famous fashion designer celebrity Neha Shirodkar.

Hindi Language.name: Bittu Bahanebaaz
Hindi Language.description: The series is about Bittu - a smart and quick-witted 10-year-old boy who always finds funny excuses to get out of trouble. No matter the situation, he comes up with a clever escape - fast, funny, and full of surprises.

Hindi Language.name: Maqam
Hindi Language.description: Maqam promises an adrenaline pumping deeply emotional portrayal of a fighters journey. The film stands as an ode to the fighting spirit and a heartfelt farewell to Tom Alter, ensuring his legacy continues to inspire generations to come.

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Saazishein Hain Pyaar ki
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around a teenage girl puja - who falls in love with her servant unknowingly - her mother and father loves her a lot - but what she think nobody knows

Hindi Language.name: Mona Ki Manohar Kahaniyan
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Pawan Singh engages in a psychological battle with the mysterious Mona. Their perilous relationship evolves into a tense struggle for dominance, filled with deception and obsession, as they vie for ultimate control.

Hindi Language.name: Dahej Daasi
Hindi Language.description: Chunari, trapped at an age-old social practice of becoming a Dahej Dasi of rich Rajawat Family. Everything seemed normal until Chunari became an orphan and her life took an unexpected turn. She stand up against the old practice Dahej Dasi

Hindi Language.name: Uberman
Hindi Language.description: Explore the thrilling story of a cab driver whose everyday routine becomes perilous when he encounters an unexpected danger. Discover how he uses his perspective and experiences to save himself and his passengers from dire consequences

Hindi Language.name: Battle of Varchasva
Hindi Language.description: Dhanbad means coal, mafia and battle of supremacy. Before independence, Dhanbad has been a bloody battle of supremacy. Amresh Singh, who ruled for the last 20 years, also knows how to earn power along with money. He is the MLA of Dhanbad. Ajay, an honest and hard working worker, raises his voice against atrocities against workers and women by mafia gangster. In view of Ajay's increasing supremacy among the workers, Amresh Singh makes him head of his coal mine. Ajay's increasing domination and Amresh Singh are sure to clash. Young Ajay is a hero of poor and needy people, so in the media he has given images of a domineering don. Ajay's son is against his father's values. In this battle of supremacy, Amresh Singh and Ajay are face to face and the relationship of father and son is also at stake.

Hindi Language.name: Chingam
Hindi Language.description: In a quiet Himachal village, teenage sweethearts Ajay and Radhika part ways chasing dreams. Years later, Ajay returns a failed singer to find Radhika married, their reunion sparking love, regret, and the weight of second chances.

Hindi Language.name: Jhanjhaarpur
Hindi Language.description: Amidst personal challenges, child married couple, Arun and Reshma reunite in Mumbai, She pursues a career in Bollywood after a traumatic incident. Arun learns about Reshma's sexual orientation, they return to village, seeking justice.

Hindi Language.name: Chote Tara Ka Bada Gadar
Hindi Language.description: Chote Tara ka Bada Gadar is an Indian animated children's action fantasy series set in the Punjabi village of Himmatpur.

Hindi Language.name: Zehan
Hindi Language.description: Aakash, a man suffering from a personality disorder and childhood trauma, falls in love with Mona. However, he struggles to maintain his relationship with her as he constantly fears abandonment.

Hindi Language.name: Unmatched
Hindi Language.description: When a jilted stalker attempts to destroy the life of a spirited young woman going through a breakup, she takes it upon herself to find evidence against him and put him behind bars for good.

Hindi Language.name: Rangde
Hindi Language.description: Rangde Story Of Combiend Coulture Of Rajasthan & Gujarat.

Hindi Language.name: Aasma
Hindi Language.description: At the pinnacle of the splendor of the Himalayas sits the Kashmir valley, one of the most stunningly picturesque places on earth. But today, its grandeur has also become ubiquitous with the ravages of terrorism and counter terrorism operations. Under these circumstances, anyone roaming these hills would tell you the shocking truth: that combat soldiers are statistically safer than women. The calm melody of the idyllic villages is disrupted by the abrasive sputter of semi-automatic gunfire. In one such neighborhood, we see Aasma, a delicate young girl. For Aasma, heaven and hell are about to collide. The leader of the local village conceals four armed militants from across the border, in his house. In due course they notice the young girl. Mesmerized by her delicate beauty and overcome by lust, they kidnap Aasma. Their leader reasons that on their way to a suicidal terrorist attack, this is probably their last opportunity to be with a woman before martyrdom. As Aasmaa's night of torment unfolds, one of the militants, Intekhaab, shows signs of regret; he knows that Islam does not permit cruelty on woman. But in the presence of armed hostility he must find clever ways to delay the inevitable. In the tight, cramped quarters, the odds are stacked against Intekhaab: can he find a way to save Assma - and himself? Can a different face of so-called Islamic terrorism emerge from this desperate plight, so that Aasma is not yet another faceless victim of this endless conflict?

Hindi Language.name: Imamdasta
Hindi Language.description: Two unknown people, Mehmood and Jaanisaar visit two unemployed roommates Manoj and Firoz with no intentions of leaving. A series of madness and confusion leads to a comedy of errors.

Hindi Language.name: Bombay
Hindi Language.description: Ulas Mhatre, an underworld don operates activities with his trusted members Nana, Tatya, and Sherry. Things changes when Tatya goes missing with no evidence.

Hindi Language.name: Love karu Yaa Shaadi
Hindi Language.description: A 27-year-old MBA graduate from Kanpur named Rahul, from an affluent middle-class family, struggles between societal values and personal desires.

Hindi Language.name: Gudiya Rani
Hindi Language.description: Six-year-old Rani sacrifices her freedom for Pari, daughter of rich family, to save her starving family. As years pass, she endures cruelty, but when Pari's marriage crumbles and her life is threatened, Rani fights to reclaim her identity.

Hindi Language.name: Rakshas
Hindi Language.description: "Rakshas" is the story of a young man named Tejas, who struggles to live in a world of fake smiles and tears. The film delves into his chaotic life and the extreme measures he takes to survive and protect himself from starvation, ultimately living the life of a Rakshas.

Hindi Language.name: Desi Fiction
Hindi Language.description: Four seemingly unrelated lives-a soon-to-be-bride, a skeptical daughter, a debt-ridden man, and an aspiring performer-collide in a darkly tangled web of ambition, memory, and dangerous secrets.

Hindi Language.name: The Missing 54
Hindi Language.description: The missing 54 are 54 Indian soldiers and officers of the Indian Armed Forces who went missing in action during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 and whom the Indian government believes to be secretly held by Pakistan.

Hindi Language.name: Bawla
Hindi Language.description: A young military cadet hunts down her sister's killer as corpses pile around her in rapid and relentless succession.

Hindi Language.name: Rare
Hindi Language.description: Tina works as a relationship manager at ShubhShaadi Dot com, a matrimonial company. One day, she receives the groom profile of Mr. Divaker Sharma, an elderly man with health conditions such as high blood pressure and short-term amnesia. Tina thinks it will be very difficult to find a bride for him. However, when she meets Mr. Divaker, she realizes that he is a wealthy man with a lot of ancestral wealth and lives in a big old villa. Mr. Divaker tells Tina that he has been searching for a loving, honest, and dedicated wife for many years so that after his death, his wife and children can take care of his ancestral wealth. He had first married at a young age, but his first wife died after only one year of marriage. Mr. Divaker believes that it was his one-sided love that caused his first wife's early death. Since then, he has met many women, but he has not found anyone who can give him love and dedication. That's why he applied to ShubhShaadi Dot Com. Tina thinks that if she marries him, her life will change. But how will Tina gain Mr. Divaker's trust and love?

Hindi Language.name: In Bed with My Dead Wife
Love Swipe aur Mauka
Hindi Language.description: Paras, a simple man, is married to Sheetal, who is very modern, beautiful, and bold. Abhi, a handsome man, is married to Rajni, a simple housewife. Sheetal and Abhi are having an affair. Separately, Paras develops feelings for Rajni. After Rajni and Paras discover Sheetal and Abhi's affair, they initially plan to teach them a lesson. However, they unexpectedly fall in love with each other. What do you think would be the end of this complicated love story?

Hindi Language.name: Ek Raat Baki
Hindi Language.description: A newlywed couple embarks on their honeymoon trip to Goa, filled with dreams of love and adventure. However, their joyous journey takes a dark turn when they commit an act of disrespect toward a sacred idol along the way.

Hindi Language.name: Ziindaagi in Two Shades
Hindi Language.description: Ziindaagi in Two Shades tells the inspiring story of Iftekhar Shareef - India's first Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holder - a man who built a life between India and America while quietly working to bring people and communities closer with kindness and unity.

Hindi Language.name: Balaayen
Hindi Language.description: Young couple is walking home from office late one night. It becomes a pleasant walk, as they enjoy each others' company. Some strange events unfold that night. The couple are back into their normal lives. The girl feels some changes and starts falling into fear and depression She feels that someone is attacking her in her dreams. Doctors are unable to diagnose her problem. Her work and family life start getting affected. Her mother takes her to a spiritual guru, who immediately catches her problem The guru mentally takes her back to the same journey through that night She reveals that something had transpired on the way. That she had met some-one, who was now trying to control her life.

Hindi Language.name: Kaamdhenu Gaumata
Hindi Language.description: The series tells the eternal tales of Kamdhenu Gaumata, born from the Samudra Manthan, whose blessings and compassion guided sages, gods, kings, and all of humanity - narrated in the divine voice of Lord Krishna, alongside Radharani.

Hindi Language.name: Bhediya Dhasaan
Hindi Language.description: A labourer visits his ancestral village in the Himalayan foothills to take his aged father with him to the city. But his father's refuses to leave, and the village soon becomes gripped by the terror and drama of a lurking man-eater.

Hindi Language.name: Mannu Aur Munni Ki Shaadi
Hindi Language.description: Mannu a small town boy is facing hurdles in his marriage, found a witty solution by a baba which leads him to some other difficulties.

Hindi Language.name: Jhumri Talayian
Hindi Language.description: Dhruv battles addiction and scandal in Delhi while Prem, a rural musician, faces urban violence. Their paths cross as personal demons and mistaken identity lead to life-changing consequences.

Hindi Language.name: Luv You Shankar
Hindi Language.description: Revolves around the bond between an eight-year-old boy and Lord Shiva.

Hindi Language.name: Ishq Jabaria
Hindi Language.description: Gulki's arranged marriage to Aditya derails her dream of becoming an air hostess. As they navigate the challenges, their union faces threats from sinister forces determined to drive them apart.

Hindi Language.name: The Lipstick Boy
Hindi Language.description: The Lipstick Boy is a upcoming Hindi Movie which is a biopic of "Kumar Uday Singh"

Hindi Language.name: Parakh Ek Dharohar
Hindi Language.description: A hidden identity, a family legacy, and a sacred test intertwine as Dev lives as Rumaal in Rishikesh, finding love with Rashmi while Bhoomika searches for him, unaware of the emotional storm and destiny awaiting them.

Hindi Language.name: Colourrs of Love
Hindi Language.description: A terrible breakup and depression bring Avee, a young doctor, to Rajat, a renowned psychologist. Will Avee ever find his way back to love and happiness?

Hindi Language.name: Dream Lock
Hindi Language.description: Over the course of three dreams a man foresee events about to occur not realizing his ability to influence a physical activity without physical interaction.

Hindi Language.name: Jagan
Hindi Language.description: Jagan knows no money or time, but develops an inseparable love for music and nature. He faces daily adversities with a blissful smile. When life gives him deeper challenges, his smile disappears, but not for long.

Hindi Language.name: Nonstop Nonsense
Hindi Language.description: Nitish had recently closed down his gym when his mischievous best friend persuaded him to attend a New Year's Year's party. He enticed Nitish with the promise of a lucrative opportunity, suggesting that all Nitish had to do was stick by his side.

Hindi Language.name: Rest in Manhole
Hindi Language.description: Bezwada Wilson is a Roman Magsaysay Award winner activist who runs the organization Safai Karmachari Andolan. The documentary follows Bezwada Wilson's journey of trying to eradicate the inhumane act of Manual Scavenging in India.

Hindi Language.name: Widow's Shadow
Hindi Language.description: Kajal, a Dom-caste woman escaping an abusive marriage, and Aankhi, a newly widowed Brahmin woman, who meet in a widows' shelter and slowly form an unexpected bond. Drawn together by loneliness, trauma, and their shared struggle against rigid social structures, the two women discover a deep emotional connection that gradually blossoms into love. Their relationship becomes an act of defiance against entrenched caste hierarchies, widowhood restrictions, and prejudice toward queer relationships. As they fight for dignity and the right to exist on their own terms, their journey exposes the harshness of societal judgment while illuminating their quiet resilience and hope.

Hindi Language.name: Cactus
Hindi Language.description: A Truck-Driver and a Prostitute are in love but the events unfolding at grass-root politics of region forces them to run and fight for their survival.

Hindi Language.name: Tatkshan
Hindi Language.description: Tatkshan is a brutal story of grit and indomitable spirit of Sub Inspector Harshvardhan Dubey,UP Police,who comes across mutilated unidentified human body in Lucknow.Investigating the case layer by layer leads to many shocking revelations.

Hindi Language.name: Early Days
Hindi Language.description: Preeti and Samrat, an aspirational couple in their mid-twenties navigate their romance both on and off screens soon after they become professional influencers.

Hindi Language.name: The Super Husband
Hindi Language.description: A dad who thinks he's a superhero with time-travel powers can't manage to keep his family happy, particularly his overwhelmed wife who feels ignored.

Hindi Language.name: Main Dil Tum Dhadkan
Hindi Language.description: Vrinda, a single mom, learns to let go of her overprotective ways with son Krish and share parenting responsibilities with Keshav.

Hindi Language.name: Savdhaan India: Apni Khaki
Hindi Language.description: Inspector Pragati Deshmukh, while fighting personal demons, has to step up to handle the crime of the city. Will she reel under her own story or emerge victorious? Is she her own Savior?

Hindi Language.name: Gin Ke Dus
Hindi Language.description: On India's 1991 election day, a killer hunts down ten meddlesome people threatening to untangle a web of deceitful secrets about twin sisters.

Hindi Language.name: Amavas
Hindi Language.description: On the evil night of amavasya, moonless night, when the evil rises, two medical students find themselves trapped in a relentless ride into dark. Staying as a paying guest with an old couple in Delhi, two girls when find themselves threatened for life by a man, they kill him in self-defence and hide his body. But soon the line between reality and fantasy gets blurred as both do not understand if the man they killed is dead or alive.

Hindi Language.name: Problem Toh Hai
Hindi Language.description: A regular guy, overwhelmed by life's challenges, pleads for divine intervention. Unexpectedly granted the ability to hear people's thoughts, he's caught in a moral dilemma. Can this newfound power bring solace or turmoil?

Hindi Language.name: Fridayy the 13th
Hindi Language.description: Nisha plans to elope with Aryan but gets entangled in a crime and is abandoned by him and Sakshi. She turns to her brother Vishal, realizing the true value of his unwavering love and family.

Hindi Language.name: Kaise Banta Hai
Hindi Language.description: Kaise Banta Hai is a one-of-a-kind television series that invites companies to showcase the behind the scenes of the making of some of its most popular products. We invite you to take part in this educational yet informative television web series and build your brand's credibility amongst millions of viewers around the world. Presenting the ideal stage for you to showcase the nitty- gritty, effort, and dedication that makes your brand stand out from everyone else.

Hindi Language.name: Successful Failure
Hindi Language.description: Story of a divorce lawyer, whose love life is getting tougher because of her profession, this story shown how she will get the love of her life.

Hindi Language.name: Khel Passport ka
Hindi Language.description: When a person arrives in a new country, his life takes a terrifying turn after he suddenly loses his passport and all other documents. As he struggles to navigate his predicament, he finds himself trapped by people involved in terrorist activities. This high-stakes thriller follows his desperate fight for survival.

Hindi Language.name: For Bindiya Call Jugnu
Hindi Language.description: A small-time pimp, going through mid-career crisis meets an "English - speaking" escort girl.

Hindi Language.name: Langha Phobia
Hindi Language.description: After a blissful beginning to Gopi and Shanti's married life in Fiji, things take a big turn when Gopi starts showing his chauvinistic ways. Having no other option, Shanti comes up with a cunning plan to get some sanity back in her life.

Hindi Language.name: Kitty Kelly Ki Diwali
Hindi Language.description: Good Indian Girl KITTY decides to kill grumpy old landlady KANJI to save her love KELLY from deportation. White American Kelly, Bollywood backup dancer, has a murky past. But even for her committing two murders in one night, is a new low.

Hindi Language.name: Raaghav
Hindi Language.description: A young man struggling with Paranoid Personality Disorder takes up a job at a cashew factory to support his family after his pregnant wife resigns. But when cartons mysteriously go missing from the warehouse, his growing suspicion of those around him begins to spiral out of control.

Hindi Language.name: Chiranjeevi
Hindi Language.description: In the heart of Delhi, a police constable hunting a child molester becomes fixated on a quiet cab driver, triggering a tense cat-and-mouse pursuit that slowly unravels the truth about guilt, identity, and the man known as Chiranjeevi.

Hindi Language.name: Kashi to Kashmir
Hindi Language.description: The most awaited Film based on Article 370 and Kashmiri Pandits forced flee from Kashmir valley in 1990 . Its not a love story, this tells what happened then in Kashmir Valley and thereafter.

Hindi Language.name: Saar the Conclusion
Hindi Language.description: Saar: The Conclusion -is the story of a father and son's bonding. A family drama, it talks about how the experiences in the growing-up years of a child can affect his thoughts and behavior pattern for life.

Hindi Language.name: Family Table
Hindi Language.description: Laughter and entertainment glue viewers to their seats. This binge-worthy experience promises nonstop fun.

Hindi Language.name: Cycle Mahesh
Hindi Language.description: A young worker's epic bicycle journey home and cinema's cold gaze

Hindi Language.name: Bade Ghar Ki Bahu
Hindi Language.description: Radha Son Ravi left him after getting married with Neha Radha give complaint to Man Durga then lots of surprise came for Radha family

Hindi Language.name: Yeh Hai Mera Watan
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of two men whose lives are torn apart by the false promises of terrorism - one blinded by ideology, the other trapped by desperation.

Hindi Language.name: Lonely 2Gether
Hindi Language.description: Mann, a straight-laced banker, and KK, a charming gym owner, have been best friends since school-brothers in everything but blood. On a tipsy walk home from a party, Mann proposes a pact: if neither of them finds love in three months, they'll let their mothers arrange their marriages. KK reluctantly agrees, setting off a roller coaster of comedy, heartbreak, and self-discovery in the city that never sleeps. As Mann tries to move on from his past love Shalini, fate brings her back-divorced, vulnerable, and hiding more than she reveals. Meanwhile, KK meets Mehek, a sharp, witty designer who calls out his macho charm and stirs something real in him. When both women pull away-one haunted by her baggage, the other hurt by overheard truths-the friends are left questioning what commitment really means. Amid comic chaos from their meddling house help, wild friends, and their mothers' sudden arrival, Mann and KK realize that growing up isn't about settling down-it's about learning to stand up for love, life, and oneself.

Hindi Language.name: Shiva Ragini
Hindi Language.description: Shiva living in Varanasi Ragini living in London both are shivbhakt they have dream to make video album song on Lord Shiva they taking loan and make the album and real struggle start Lord Shiva

Hindi Language.name: Aayaam
Hindi Language.description: A man's solitary journey through the dark depths of his mind even when the society forces him into a corner.

Hindi Language.name: Jai Mahalakshmi
Hindi Language.description: Story of Mata Mahalaxmi the goddess of wealth and prosperity.From the advent of universe creation to the final 4th stage of Kalyug we have vast story of romance, devotion, glory and 8 different forms of the Godess and their importance.

Hindi Language.name: Thugs of Goa
Hindi Language.description: In Goa, con artist Amar and his team Saloni, Neha, and Vicky run scams until Officer Vijay forces Neha to spy on a minister's corrupt son. As Amar tries to protect his crew, he faces off against Vijay's pursuit of justice.

Hindi Language.name: A Long Walk to Happiness
Hindi Language.description: ALWTH (A Long Walk to Happiness) follows the journey of Ajay, a solitary man who has spent his life longing for a sense of belonging and familial connection. Growing up as an orphan, Ajay never experienced the warmth of a family's embrace or the security of a stable home. One day, fate intervenes when Ajay meets Maha.

Hindi Language.name: The Last Wish
Hindi Language.description: The sacrifices made by the parents for their children. Every parent wants the best for their children with love and affection. But sadly when it's their time to get the care when they are old, some children send them to old age homes

Hindi Language.name: Rivalry
Hindi Language.description: A Rivalry Between Two Freind Who became Enemies For many reasons.....The story is Full of Action And Thriller

Hindi Language.name: The Silent Prayer
Hindi Language.description: In the tumultuous aftermath of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi's assassination 1984, a 4-year-old Sikh girl's birthday joy transforms into a harrowing tale of survival. Stranded without their parents, her 9-year-old brother becomes her brave shield, navigating a world of chaos and hatred to protect the flicker of innocence in his sister's eyes and brother's love becomes their unyielding fortress against the backdrop of a society torn by violence.

Hindi Language.name: Mitthu Singh Da Vyaah
Hindi Language.description: A shy farmer's son who has been scared of laughter since childhood due to Gelotophobia (the fear of being laughed at), a result of being teased. On his wedding night, a small prank goes wrong, creating big trouble and putting his marriage in danger. This film shows, in a light and entertaining way, how even small jokes can cause deep fears but also how family and friends can help overcome them. Full of comedy, drama, and emotions, it's a story about facing fears and the strength of love and support.

Hindi Language.name: Daket of Dholpur
Hindi Language.description: The film Daket of Dholpur has been made under the banner of Baba Cine Entertainment Film Production. The story of the film revolves around the common people and farmers of a village named Dholpur

Hindi Language.name: Rockers
Hindi Language.description: A band gains Instagram fame and gets funding from a drug lord using their tours for smuggling. While recording in Goa, tensions rise until their drummer's mysterious death makes suspects of his bandmates.

Hindi Language.name: Marriage Cops
Hindi Language.description: In a small city in northern India, unhappy couples seek relationship advice in the most unlikely of places-the local police station.

Hindi Language.name: Manpasand Ki Shaadi
Hindi Language.description: Aarohi has one month to find her dream Dulha. And she sees her Mr. Perfect in our hero Abhishek, but will her 'Manpasand' marriage story be successful?

Hindi Language.name: Mangal Dev
Hindi Language.description: In Vedic astrology, Mangal Dev, the second planet, symbolizes courage and protection. Born from Lord Vishnu and Mahadev, he is the son of Bhudevi. Mangal Dev ended chaos in the universe, evolving from Bhoom to Lohitang and ultimately becoming Mangal Graha after facing many challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Meroon: Ek Rishta Pyaar Ka
Hindi Language.description: Seema loses her husband at a young age, faces discrimination, and finds a new life partner.

Hindi Language.name: Woh Raat
Hindi Language.description: "Woh Raat " is a poignant short film script based on the true story of Dr. Moumita Debnath. It portrays the struggles of a talented doctor's life and her fight for justice after a heinous crime. Through Moumita's voice, the short movie emphasizes the need for women's safety and justice in society. *Key Points:* 1. Dr. Moumita's struggle and dreams. 2. The crime and its aftermath. 3. The demand for justice and societal awareness.

Hindi Language.name: Inky Pinky Ponky
Hindi Language.description: In Brampton's chaotic "Little India," Karan, a naive newcomer searching for love and a place to stay, crosses paths with the eccentric Douglas, who has just returned from India to surprise his landlord Satish Bhai and fellow tenant Aadesh. Meanwhile, Aadesh, the lustful tenant, fools Satish Bhai to plan a romantic night, which goes wildly out of control when Douglas unexpectedly shows up at the door, leading to a night of hilarious chaos and surprise revelations.

Hindi Language.name: Until I Fly
Hindi Language.description: A charismatic Indian-Nepali boy, lives a bohemian life in a remote Himalayan village. As he transitions from childhood to teenagehood, his poetic journey of perseverance echoes issues that span across ages and communities.

Hindi Language.name: Kusum Ka Biyaah
Hindi Language.description: Sunil's marriage is finalised after many problems, all of the family members are overjoyed. However, on the day of the wedding, the entire country slips into complete lockdown owing to Corona.

Hindi Language.name: Khancha Bhai
Hindi Language.description: Khancha Bhai movie is based on those people who don't pay tax to the government but earn lakhs of rupees from their roadside business. By making this an issue, an educated man starts extorting money from them by scaring them.

Hindi Language.name: Lakudiya Veer
Hindi Language.description: Lakudiya Veer is a testament to the resilience and spirit of a forgotten hero who emerges to rekindle the lost legacy of a sacred art form.

Hindi Language.name: Game Khatam
Hindi Language.description: Three childhood survivors of a brutal crime reunite years later to bring down the feared smuggler who destroyed their lives - but revenge comes at a cost.

Hindi Language.name: Chikoo Bunty in the Ultimate Dream Chase
Hindi Language.description: The film centers on Chikoo's desire to watch the World Cup final and Bunty's wish to celebrate his birthday, with the events intertwining to create chaos and ultimately, a quest to fulfill both their dreams.

Hindi Language.name: Nevvla
Hindi Language.description: This is the story of a retired officer Rudra Pratap Singh and his lifelong friend Tyagi. Rudra Pratap's daughter Shikha calls both of them Papa. But one day Shikha accuses Tyagi for raping her for which Tyagi has to pay the price with his own friend's life.

Hindi Language.name: Leer
Hindi Language.description: Leer, set in Bombay's slums, follows Mitul, an 18-year-old gang member, as they use a technological device to disrupt the internet, facing an ethical hacker who foils the gang's scheme.

Hindi Language.name: Gaon Ki Beti Desh Ki Topper
A Real Encounter
Hindi Language.description: In 2002, Gujarat faced threats from numerous gangs and terrorist groups. The Central Intelligence Agency alerted the state government about potential attacks targeting the Chief Minister and other officials. The government, led by efficient officer's like ADG Rathore ( Ehsaan khan), Arjun Ranade (Shahbaaz Khan), Varun Barot (Rishikesh Tiwari) etc. launched operations to hunt down terrorists with the help of informants. During one such encounter, four terrorists planning an attack on the CM were killed. Among them was Muskan (Bratuti Ganguly), a girl from a middle-class family in Mumbai. Muskan, a college student who gave tuition to children, dreamt of starting her own coaching classes. She befriended Mahi and Waseem (Akhilesh Verma), with Waseem promising to help her achieve her dream. Unknowingly, Muskan got entangled in Waseem's terrorist activities. When she tried to resist, they blackmailed her by threatening her family. Trapped and helpless, Muskan became part of the gang and was ultimately killed in the encounter. What happens next.

Hindi Language.name: House of lies
Hindi Language.description: Exchanged Dulhan is a gripping drama-romance series that follows Yuvika, a poor orphan forced to live as a servant, whose life takes a dark turn when she is manipulated into secretly replacing another woman at a wedding. Betrayed, brutally attacked, and left for dead by powerful conspirators, Yuvika miraculously survives. A year later, she returns with a new identity-as a wealthy, confident businesswoman and a powerful investor-entering the very household that destroyed her life. As secrets unravel, relationships are tested, and hidden crimes resurface, Yuvika begins a calculated game of revenge, exposing lies, reclaiming her dignity, and confronting the woman who stole her marriage and tried to erase her existence. Blending revenge, romance, betrayal, and emotional drama, Exchanged Dulhan is a story of a woman's rise from victim to victor in a world ruled by power, greed, and deception.

Hindi Language.name: Dil Kya Kahe
Hindi Language.description: Shalini marries Dhairya and discovers he has a phobia of women, straining their relationship. Determined to help, she delves into his dark past to find a solution.

Hindi Language.name: Chaar Phool Hain Aur Duniya Hai
Hindi Language.description: A meandering brook of moments from two afternoons spent with Vinod Kumar Shukla, his wife and son at their home in Raipur, saunters between the mingling geographies of past, present and future, drifting in and out of pauses - to ponder, to reflect, to reminisce, and to share.

Hindi Language.name: In Retreat
Hindi Language.description: The feature follows a man in his 50s, missing his brother's funeral, who returns home to a small mountain town in the late fall. He lingers at the threshold, delaying his arrival one more night.

Hindi Language.name: Dana Majhi the Tragic Incident
Hindi Language.description: A tribal man named Dana Majhi walked 10 kilometers carrying the dead body of his wife on his shoulders after her death in the hospital, which became a one of the huge tragic incident in the world.

Hindi Language.name: The Bandhua
Hindi Language.description: In Chambal, Radha and her son Deepu are trapped in bonded labor. Amid hardship, Deepu's hope for freedom grows, as love, courage, and dignity guide them to fight against oppression and reclaim their life.

Hindi Language.name: Dhulundhi
Hindi Language.description: A beautiful small village named Dhulundi, surrounded by forests, rivers, and hills. For the last 15 years, neither has anyone gone out of this village, nor has anyone come inside.

Hindi Language.name: Love Mashallah
Hindi Language.description: Love has no boundaries,no limitations and no religion. Love is the purest form of humanity.

Hindi Language.name: Sampoorna
Hindi Language.description: Mitti's 'perfect' life shatters when her husband, a respected doctor, is accused of sexual harassment.

Hindi Language.name: Need
Hindi Language.description: A widow's descent into dangerous affairs and obsession follows her husband's murder, while questions emerge about his death and her possible involvement.

Hindi Language.name: Murder in the Valley
Hindi Language.description: A man devastated by the death of his brother tries to rebuild a quiet life in Kashmir, but his fragile peace collapses when he and his friend Ali are accidentally pulled into a murder that forces them to face fear, guilt, and fate.

Hindi Language.name: Red Letter
Hindi Language.description: When past horrors return to threaten today and tomorrow, confronting society's lingering evil becomes the only path forward. One person, seeking justice and redemption, faces the darkness to stop a monster who escaped punishment.

Hindi Language.name: Troy the Bharat Putra
Hindi Language.description: An abandoned dog in the border area of Poonch, Kashmir was found by the childless couple Major Bharat Kumar Reddy of Indian Army and his wife Nandini Srinivasan Reddy. They named him Troy. This is a story about the love bond between them.

Hindi Language.name: Ittarr
Hindi Language.description: A middle-aged couple who find strange love and comfort in each other's company.

Hindi Language.name: BacXtage
Hindi Language.description: BacXtage, created by young music director duo Rameez Sohail, is a music platform that brings emerging talent together with established artists, giving new voices the opportunity to be heard and recognised. Blending the soul and depth of classic Bollywood with modern Indian and international sounds, BacXtage creates original music across genres, built on powerful melodies, meaningful storytelling and distinctive collaborations.

Hindi Language.name: Roohrangi
Hindi Language.description: A queer voyage, Roohrangi traverses filmmaker's encounters in a gay-cruising forest-reserve as he retraces memories of his grandfather's leucoderma-marked face. A face on whose white-and-brown patches, he saw a forest of miraculous trees.

Hindi Language.name: India's 1st Best Trans Model Agency
Hindi Language.description: Over 7 years, activist Rudrani Chettri creates a company to champion India's hijra people, considering the culture's schisms and complex roots while moving them away from traditional hardships.

Hindi Language.name: The Shoes I Wore
Hindi Language.description: "A lone survivor of surreal tragedies navigates a world that resets time and again, raising the question: is he a victim of fate or the architect of his own delusions?"

Hindi Language.name: Mata Saraswati
Hindi Language.description: The goddess of knowledge and art, Saraswati, embarks on a journey through 14 worlds to uncover the secret of how to reattach the severed head of Lord Narayan.

Hindi Language.name: Rajwant
Hindi Language.description: Jagdeep, a soldier, meets mysterious Rajwant at a desolate station amid a wave of murders targeting newlywed men. Offering her shelter, secrets unravel, blurring love and danger in this gripping, suspenseful tale.

Hindi Language.name: Amaarg- The Wrong Path
Hindi Language.description: 'AMAARG - the wrong path' is though a work of fiction, it reflects many a harsh reality pertaining to the modern human societies across the world. The vices of new lifestyle are especially targeting the youth.

Hindi Language.name: Mata Ki Mahima
Hindi Language.description: Indrayani's cunning marriage to Vijender Rawat unfolds as a saga of power seeking, where she ruthlessly eliminates threats like his wife, Asha, and even targets Vijender's son's pregnant wife Suman. Amidst the darkness, Suman's survival with Maytarani's grace brings forth Mahima, a beacon of hope. Unfamiliar to Indrayani, Mahima's birth signals a divine intervention, setting the stage for a transformative battle. Guided by Maa Sherawaali, Mahima emerges not as a weapon of destruction, but as a force for change, Challenging Indrayani's reign with the power of compassion and righteousness.

Hindi Language.name: Maaya Ka Moh
Hindi Language.description: Maaya and Mohit chose each other for love but life chose something else entirely different for them. Soulmates at heart but destined to stay apart, will they come together or is love just an illusion.

Hindi Language.name: Paati
Hindi Language.description: Sudha, Manu, and daughter Veena lead a quiet life, but a gap has grown between the parents. When Veena finds an old love letter, she and Sudha seek Manu's first love, sparking a reunion that bridges past and present.

Hindi Language.name: Raibaar
Hindi Language.description: Set in Uttarakhand; Pushkar, a postman in mid 30s finds an undelivered letter written 7 years ago. With the objective of delivering the letter to its intended recipient, he gets on his personal quest in pursuit of answers.

Hindi Language.name: Lailaa Manju
Hindi Language.description: Manju sets out to apologise to Lailaa, during the first COVID-19 lockdown in India. She has to re-affirm their love and avoid a conversation with her formidable mother, who's learned the truth about the two young women, at all costs.

Hindi Language.name: Abhimanyu - A Revenge Story
Hindi Language.description: This is the movie Abhimanyu, it is a action and romantic movie. The Main character of movie are two best friends,Abhimanyu and Sahil, abhimanyu is a daring and cool boy on the other hand sahil is very polite and mature. Sahil get into the trouble every time due to his silly nature. one day a big gangster whose name is Vikrant came into their as Abhimanyu is in love with her sister named Bhumi. so there is action comedy and romance it self in movie.

Hindi Language.name: Moh Maya: Illusion of Desire
Hindi Language.description: Maya, a bride from a small village in Rajasthan marries Moh, an Indian NRI whose real interest in her virginity. Before he flies her off to London with him, Maya has to flee from his grasp but not without dismantling his obsession.

Hindi Language.name: Happy Second Honeymoon
Hindi Language.description: A son plans a second honeymoon for his parents to save their crumbling marriage.

Hindi Language.name: META - The Dazzling Girl
Hindi Language.description: Meta, an archaeologist. In her excavation she comes across an old ruin and unknowingly falls trap to a curse. This curse later leads her head to get stuck in a mystical pot.

Hindi Language.name: Husna
Hindi Language.description: "In the shadowy world of journalism, Investigating Officer Shinde must navigate the tangled web of Sudhir's demise, where obsession leads to deadly consequences in 'Husna'."

Hindi Language.name: Hayat - Anth Ki Shuruvaat
Hindi Language.description: Haunted by his past, Hayat joins a risky vigilante mission that spirals into betrayals and moral conflict, testing loyalties and redemption.

Hindi Language.name: Rhythm of a Flower
Hindi Language.description: This animation film takes the single moment of Kumar Gandharva lying on his sick bed and expands it, where his life in music and contemplation moves like a dream. He teaches, writes and sings again, giving voice to the years of silence.

Hindi Language.name: Pratyaksha
Hindi Language.description: The film is set in a single room and follows a struggle between life and death, with Pratyaksha trying to end her life while Vivasvan, a psychiatrist, prevents her.

Hindi Language.name: Prayog
Hindi Language.description: The film Prayog, which determines the present condition and direction of the country, is a film that gives the message that we want Swarajya and not Surajya. Father of the Nation Mahatma Gandhi wanted that the constitution of our country.

Hindi Language.name: Kabir's Path
Hindi Language.description: In "KABIR'S PATH", we delve into the world of humanist Kabir, a 15th-century Indian saint, poet, philosopher and also rebellious whose teachings and writings had a significant influence on the society .This film, directed by Indubhushan Mandal, associate professor of Calcutta University takes us on a journey through Kabir's life, work, philosophy and flagship of humanity; exploring his role as a mystic, thinker, rebel and humanist.

Hindi Language.name: Lorii
Hindi Language.description: The affection between mother and daughter with strong social messages like government development programs like literacy and awareness towards certain social issues..

Hindi Language.name: Behan Darr Gayi Na
Hindi Language.description: Comedy queens Kusha Kapila and Srishti Dixit face their biggest fears in hilarious, unexpected ways. A wild ride of emotions and friendship as these internet stars tackle challenges together.

Hindi Language.name: Sugar Free Girls
Hindi Language.description: Three girls escape addiction and rise to take down a deadly drug mafia in a bold fight for justice.

Hindi Language.name: Apavitra
Hindi Language.description: A desperate wife becomes a cunning sex worker-turned-informant, navigating brothels and criminal networks to reinvent herself as Charu from Pavitra, teaming up with a CID officer to take down the system that once exploited her.

Hindi Language.name: Maxx Ki Gunn
Hindi Language.description: This is action Thriller Movie.

Hindi Language.name: Sundarnagar Ki Sundari
Hindi Language.description: Two neighboring families unite for a wedding, but chaos erupts when the groom's sister-an aspiring Bollywood superstar-steals the spotlight, sparking hilarious drama in this roller-coaster, light-hearted family comedy.

Hindi Language.name: Bless You
Hindi Language.description: Sadanand Murkute, a government clerk and his family is struggling to cope with today's new normal. On one weekend, the Murkute family goes out for shopping and treat themselves with ice candies at a roadside vendor. While slurping the ice candy, Sadanand suddenly sneezes. And the whole world comes to a grinding halt for him and a new drama begins. This hilarious story of real people in real times, demands a peculiar treatment. No makeup, no glamour and real locations. Our team has beautifully captured the suburbs of Mumbai to create a unique texture of storytelling. Anyone can relate to this realistic approach.

Hindi Language.name: Gumshuda Billionaire
Hindi Language.description: A long lost son reunites with his mom, who is a billionaire by now and takes on the world who has looked down upon him since the beginning.

Hindi Language.name: Toofan Ek Nasha
Hindi Language.description: "Toofan Ek Nasha" is the powerful story of six individuals whose lives spiral into drug addiction. Each of them falls into this dark world for different reasons-some due to personal circumstances, some out of helplessness, and others seeking temporary happiness. But their choices don't just destroy their own lives; they tear apart the hearts of their families. For the loved ones watching them fade away, the pain is unbearable. Missing a meal is something they can live with, but seeing someone they care about surrender to drugs is a wound too deep to heal. These families try everything-love, anger, support, even desperate interventions-to save them, but nothing seems to work. Amid this chaos emerges one young man, someone who has lived through this nightmare himself. Having experienced the torment of addiction up close, he decides to fight back. With fierce determination and emotional strength, he sets out to rid the city of drug dealers and bring the addicts back from the brink. His journey is filled with intense struggles, heart-wrenching moments, and powerful confrontations. "Toofan Ek Nasha" is not just a story of addiction-it's a storm of emotions, redemption, and the fight to reclaim lost lives from the clutches of darkness.

Hindi Language.name: Kiss Ka Call
Hindi Language.description: When mysterious calls disrupt Rocky's ordinary life, he's drawn into a cat-and-mouse game with a sinister force. As the calls escalate, Rocky's grip on reality falters and his darkest secrets begin to surface.

Hindi Language.name: DFO Diary: Fire Warriors
Hindi Language.description: World's First Film inspired by the Diary of a Forest Officer.

Hindi Language.name: Town Glitch
Hindi Language.description: Four friends on a road trip find themselves stranded in a deserted town that doesn't appear on any map, where each begins to see a different version of reality and must uncover the truth before the town consumes them.

Hindi Language.name: Days of Autumn
Hindi Language.description: An ambitious young woman on a month-long government assignment in rural Bengal grapples with loneliness while forming a complex bond with her teenage house help.

Hindi Language.name: Unheard Cries at GB Road
Hindi Language.description: Inside Delhi's red-light lanes, women reveal stories of pain and courage.

Hindi Language.name: Babla ka Laughing Buddha
Hindi Language.description: Synopsis "Laughing Buddha" unfolds the touching story of Babla and his sister in a destitute village. Their bond weathers life's storms, but when Babla stumbles upon a 25 lakh rupees golden Buddha, his innocent dreams transform into a pursuit of wealth. This obsession alienates him from teachers, eroding trust. The film delves into the struggle between dreams and the alluring trap of greed, emphasizing the profound lesson that genuine happiness transcends material possessions. It's a poignant reminder of the importance of integrity, family, and self-discovery in life's toughest moments.

Hindi Language.name: Dhaakad Beera
Hindi Language.description: Strong-willed Samrat and his sister Kishmish defy the cruel norms of their village. As atrocities against women rise, the siblings-in-action wage a rebellion.

Hindi Language.name: Chhota StartUp
Hindi Language.description: Meet Gyaani, Rosy, and Tej, the dynamic trio on a mission to revolutionize the start-up scenes. In this exciting new show, they embark on a journey to help budding entrepreneurs turn their big dreams into reality.

Hindi Language.name: Dulhan bani drama queen
Hindi Language.description: A CEO's engagement day turns tragic when his fiancée mistakes his pregnant sister for his lover, sparking violence and revenge as he fights to protect his only family, shattering relationships before the wedding.

Hindi Language.name: Revenge - The Badla
Hindi Language.description: This is the singular tale of Ajay and Maya, a love story that darkens into a quest for revenge. Initially, Ajay is driven solely by his career, but when Maya enters his life, she becomes his sole focus. Even when presented with a coveted voice-over role in a prominent film, Ajay remains deeply engrossed in his love for Maya, dismissing his friends' warnings that he is sabotaging his career. However, as their love begins to sour, the story twists into one of retribution, with fissures forming in Maya and Ajay's once-seemingly perfect bond.

Hindi Language.name: Love Angles
Hindi Language.description: Love angle is an institute based love story and it's purely a youth based content revolves around the life of young generation relating to their love, career, friends and family.

Hindi Language.name: Rudra & Return of King Makoonga
Hindi Language.description: Rudra and his friends arrive at Monkey Island for the lively Banana Harvest Festival. The festivities are disrupted when Rudra unveils a banana statue that vanishes, revealing the wrathful Makoonga. Can Rudra save festival from disaster?

Hindi Language.name: Tum Aaye Ho Toh
Hindi Language.description: Beats of a love story across timelines, giving it a feel of a timeless romance with memorable music.

Hindi Language.name: The Killer
Hindi Language.description: The Killer Film portrays the Story of A Serial Killer who is targeting his Victims and killing them and henceforth the entire Crime Branch Department of Kolkata Police is on a Chase to catch this Serial Killer.

Hindi Language.name: The Vanishing Act
Hindi Language.description: The Untold Story of the Missing Malaysian Plane is an upcoming English language feature film inspired by the events surrounding the disappearance of Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370.

Hindi Language.name: Madam Driver
Hindi Language.description: Madam Driver is a coming-of-age drama about Devika Dixit, a middle-aged woman who wants to learn to drive. Battling doubt and social norms, she enlists Hassan, a reluctant instructor. Madam Driver is a story of loss and starting over.

Hindi Language.name: The Legend of Sudarshan Chakra
Hindi Language.description: A biographical film chronicling the life of spiritual leader Gurudev Shri Sudarshan Lal Maharaj from his early advocacy for social reform to his final days, cementing his legacy of national unity and human Upliftment.

Hindi Language.name: Entertainers Cricket League
Hindi Language.description: India's first cricket tournament featuring content creators and influencers.

Hindi Language.name: Mangta Jogi
Hindi Language.description: Ghasita 28 returns to his village near Varanasi after 10 years to find his family struggling financially. His brother, Shambhu, cant meet their needs. Ghasita refuses to do menial village jobs but is intrigued when he meets his childhood friend Pawaru, now wealthy. Pawaru reveals he runs a begging business and offers Ghasita a chance to join, which he accepts to support his family.

Hindi Language.name: Ramsay House - The Fantasy World
Hindi Language.description: Ramsay House is a fantasy drama about Chandrabhan Ramsay, a man obsessed with collecting haunted antiques. One night, he mysteriously vanishes from his basement, leaving behind a lifelike puppet. Despite searches by family, police, and a guru, he remains "neither alive nor dead," trapped by cursed objects. The only hope is Hari Prasad, an IT professional with a divine power to communicate with the dead. Known for using his gift to help others, Hari is approached by Chitralekha to break the curse and bring back her husband. This show blends fantasy, horror, and mystery for all age groups, without promoting black magic or superstition.

Hindi Language.name: Deewaar Ke Us Paar (beyond the Wall)
Chhappan Chhori
Hindi Language.description: A contemporary social drama that reflects today's youth and society's conflicting mindset about love, freedom, and virginity. Through candid conversations, friends discuss enjoying life before marriage, while also confronting the harsh reality of societal pressure and outdated expectations. The narrative sheds light on how women are unfairly judged, and the stigma of virginity becomes a burden that exposes society's double standards.

Hindi Language.name: Talaq Mubarak
Hindi Language.description: Humaira's journey focuses on her transformation from a docile girl, oblivious of the harsh reality she lives in to a rebel taking charge and control of her life as she could no longer cower under the threat of an instant triple talaq.

Hindi Language.name: The Unknown Mind
Hindi Language.description: Director Vinod Tewari's Film "THE UNKNOWN MIND" is a gripping tale inspired by true events and the biography of a person who faced a rare, life-altering mental disorder. This groundbreaking film sheds light on a prominent mental disorder that affects people worldwide but remains largely unknown in India. The disorder impacts 3 out of 1,000 people in India, while the figure rises to 5.1 out of 1,000 in the United States. Disturbingly, 72% of patients in rural India and 83.3% in urban non-metro areas remain untreated, mainly due to a lack of awareness, even among medical professionals. The film aims to bring much-needed attention to this mental health issue, which has been largely overlooked in Indian cinema and society. "THE UNKNOWN MIND" promises to be a revelation in terms of storytelling and will help raise awareness among the Indian population, including the diaspora. The plot of the movie is both breathtaking and unprecedented in Hindi cinema, making it a potential masterpiece. It explores the devastating effects of this disorder on individuals, families, and society, offering audiences a window into the struggles of those living with mental health challenges.

Hindi Language.name: Hocus Focus
Hindi Language.description: In a shocking discovery, video footage from multiple hidden cameras unveils a chilling conspiracy surrounding a bank robbery. As the pieces come together, the footage paints a gruesome picture of the heist. "Are You Being Watched!"

Hindi Language.name: Chhattisgarh ke Bheem Chintaram
Hindi Language.description: A documentary on Chintaram Tikariha, a strongman and community figure from Chhattisgarh, India.

Hindi Language.name: Lootere Chapter 1
Hindi Language.description: Lootere is inspired by real highway robberies in India. Raghu and Birju, two cunning robbers, prey on travelers and vanish without a trace. Their crime spree takes a turn when they kidnap 3 friends en route to Nainital,but one escapes, vow

Hindi Language.name: Rocky the Slave
Hindi Language.description: A Catholic man's past catches up when his former lover's grown son, introduced to crime as a child, crosses paths with him unknowingly. Their lives entwine as the son seeks redemption, unaware of their connection.

Hindi Language.name: Atma Nirbhar Bharat
Hindi Language.description: This is an incredible story. The hero of this story is Yuvraj - a physically challenged guy. He has passed his life through tremendous hardships; his childhood struggles;he has deformities in his legs. Overcoming all these anomalies he regularly attended the school but there also he faced ill behavior from his teachers and class mates. He was able to make his name despite all these troubles. He has built his career as an artist which is an example in itself. It is a true story and an inspiration for each and every common Indians.

Hindi Language.name: Pankh
Hindi Language.description: "Pankh" is a heartwarming story about a little girl named Aashi, who was unable to speak. To overcome this challenge, she learned sign language with the help of her grandfather. From here, she spread her wings of determination and took flight towards her dreams.

Hindi Language.name: India Post
Hindi Language.description: The most visible and relatable aspect of a postal system is the postman. Behind this individual, however, there is a massive, intricate organisation that makes it possible for him to bring us joy, hope, news and so much more.

Hindi Language.name: Bajrang Aur Ali
Hindi Language.description: Is Religion bigger than Humanity?

Hindi Language.name: Uparwala & Sons
Hindi Language.description: Set in the backdrop of small town India, the movie is a societal satire through a common man's journey of self-discovery.

Hindi Language.name: Phooli
Hindi Language.description: A young girl Phooli wants to study and pursue her dreams despite her circumstances. Later a 'Jaadugar' enters her life and helps her overcome her situations and becomes an IPS officer.

Hindi Language.name: Mann Behka
Hindi Language.description: A character study of Manav Aggarwal, a good natured and naïve 19-year-old, as he navigates through his personal life filled with trials and tribulations over the course of a memorable summer.

Hindi Language.name: Quizzer of the Year
Hindi Language.description: Curated by Siddhartha Basu, 'Quizzer of the Year' on Sony LIV is a pan-India quiz for students of Classes IX-XII. Answer MCQs daily, score points, unlock levels, and compete for daily, weekly, and monthly prizes, plus a 1cr scholarship.

Hindi Language.name: Dhushor
Hindi Language.description: A melancholic contemplation of a traveller....about life, its origin and finality.

Hindi Language.name: Hot Shots
Hindi Language.description: Featuring IPL icon Shikhar Dhawan, and MLB All-Star Adam Jones, the search is on to find India's best amateur cricket and baseball batters to prove their talent in a Major League Baseball hitting competition with a 15 lakh prize at stake.

Hindi Language.name: The Night Sale
Hindi Language.description: Torn between survival and self-respect, The poor Immigrant begins losing control over his choices.

Hindi Language.name: Irani Chai
Hindi Language.description: An Iranian woman is visited by men each night, each confiding a story in her. She links these stories to reach a treasure.

Hindi Language.name: Charlie in Wonderland
Hindi Language.description: When Charlie a twelve years old orphan boy escapes from orphanage, his life path moves towards an uncertain future. He encounters some wonderful people on his journey. They shape his life path which intertwined with their lives also.

Hindi Language.name: Sach Ki Jeet
Hindi Language.description: Sach Ki Jeet depicts the importance of truth and law and the movie revolves around the dispute over land and conflict among people.

Hindi Language.name: Canteen Honors
Hindi Language.description: At a lively college campus, a group of friends spend much of their time in the canteen, where everyday conversations often turn into moments of conflict and connection. As they navigate friendships, misunderstandings, and personal ambitions, their shared experiences reflect the humor and emotional complexity of student life. Through small but meaningful events, they begin to understand the value of trust, growth, and lasting bonds.

Hindi Language.name: Lethal Trip
Hindi Language.description: Lethal Trip is a Bollywood movie starring Rishabh Jain, Sareh Far in lead roles. The film is produced under the banner of Renaissance Motion Pictures while the director of the film is Vikrant Dev.

Hindi Language.name: Kripya Dhyaan Dein
Hindi Language.description: Jagan who is a young boy of Mathura is caught masterbating by his family on his birthday, incident brings him lot of unexpected problems and creates confusion about his sexuality and sexual preference. He struggles to justify his acts.

Hindi Language.name: Darr Ki Aahat
Hindi Language.description: In "Bhootiya Aina" the story unfolds with Aman and Kritika, a couple in love, who come across a seemingly enchanting antique mirror sold by a blind man at a suspiciously low price. As they bring the mirror into their home, eerie events begin to unravel. Kritika experiences unsettling visions and voices linked to the mirror, while Aman's dismissive attitude and secretive behavior create tension.

Hindi Language.name: Rog 2
Hindi Language.description: A lonely and insomniac detective falls in love with a dead woman whose murder he is investigating

Hindi Language.name: Pisara - Mystery Within Mystery
Hindi Language.description: In a remote area of Maharashtra, two courageous kids, Drishti and Aditya, defy the ominous rumors surrounding a mysterious house on a hill. The house is said to steal the childhood of any child who enters, yet the children venture inside, and emerge as adults. However, their newfound maturity is short-lived when they are attacked by a supposed ghost, revealing itself as a traumatized girl named Naina. The duo is unexpectedly tied to chairs, plunged into darkness, and introduced to Scienjo, a peculiar scientist and joker. Naina, haunted by childhood bullying, initially fears the grown-up Drishti and Aditya. But after the assurance of Scienjo that they have grown-up, she still remain hesitant but calms down. As Aditya and Drishti share their motive for entering the forbidden house, Scienjo scolds them for ignoring warnings. He explains the consequences of their actions and urges them to leave. Unbeknownst to them, Scienjo and Naina share a deep connection, with Scienjo acting as Naina's guardian since her parents' demise. Aditya and Drishti return with their own struggles, disclosing their lack of knowledge about the outer world. However, the revelation of a peculiar meteor effect that turns children into adults, leaving their mental state unchanged, sheds light on their predicament. Scienjo, adamant about protecting Naina, insists they leave. Yet, Naina's compassion prevails, and she allows them to stay temporarily. The revelation that Aditya and Drishti were adults all along complicates their plan to steal a rumored rock from under the house. However, the biggest twist surfaces when it's revealed that there is no mystical rock. Scienjo, masquerading as a caretaker, orchestrates a sinister plot involving the disappearance of children and their transformation into adults to facilitate a child trafficking ring. Naina, discovering Scienjo's true nature, confronts him in a battle of wits, ultimately exposing the dark operation and liberating the captive children. As Naina breaks free from her childhood trauma and exposes Scienjo's heinous activities, there is another mystery which is yet to be unfold as Naina gets to know about Scienjo's past and his true self.

Hindi Language.name: Dr. Hedgewar
Hindi Language.description: Dr. Keshav Baliram Hedgewar, driven by patriotism, founded the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) to unify India and work toward its independence and global progress. a monumental organization devoted to national unity and development.

Hindi Language.name: Zeenat

The girl asks him why he always collects milk from her house first. Dudhiya treats the girl as a normal human being and also secretly has feelings for her. He never discriminated her and understands his concerns for the girl's condition. Further in the story, We see the girl is not happy at all with the types of Guys that are coming for the marriage. Hindi Language.name: Global Iconic Entertainment and Business Awards
Celebration
Hindi Language.description: In a dimly lit apartment, three friends unite for a Celebration, a night of laughter, memories, and expensive whisky. Dushyant, a quiet filmmaker with a poetic soul, begins the evening with verses that echo with longing. He is joined by Shivam, a charismatic actor carrying charm and silence in equal measure, and Vikas, the heart of the group-sharp- tongued, quirky, and always a step behind in life, yet somehow miles ahead in spirit. As the night unfolds, playful banter gives way to nostalgia. Monologues are performed, stories are shared, old wounds are teased with humour and new ones are quietly born. There's warmth in their mockery, tenderness in their silences. Every word, every laugh feels just a bit louder, as if trying to drown out something unspoken. They drink, they reminisce, they tease each other like boys who never fully grew up. Stories are shared-of missed chances, fading careers and dreams that slipped just out of reach. Laughter echoes through the night, but behind every joke is a bruise. Beneath every toast, a tremor. But beneath the surface of celebration, there's a lingering stillness. A question the film refuses to answer outright.
