Hindi Language.name: Main Bhi Arjun: Parv
Hindi Language.description: The film explores the life of the Guinness World Record Holder Youngest Singer Clubfoot Warrior child prodigy Parv Thacker, delving into the challenges he faced as a child born with clubfoot and his eventual transformation into a global ambassador for hope and inspiration being the Global Ambassador of "Global Clubfoot Awareness Parv", the youngest singer, youngest entrepreneur and Bhagavad Gita Bharat Ambassador. Through the lens of his journey, the film highlights the power of Indian cultural teachings, particularly the profound wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita, the epic tales of the Ramayana, and the lessons from historical heroes of Bharat. Parv's story is not just about battling a physical condition but also about embracing life's struggles with a smile, proving that every challenge can be turned into an opportunity for growth. The narrative emphasizes the importance of community, spirituality, and perseverance, making it a beacon of inspiration for people of all ages. At its heart, "Main Bhi Arjun: Parv" is a story of hope during the most challenging times. It presents a deep and meaningful exploration of Indian cultural values and traditions, drawing wisdom from sacred texts like the Shrimad Bhagavad Gita and Ramayan as well as the lives of great historical characters of Bharat. These teachings are interwoven into the narrative, offering a philosophical and spiritual perspective on perseverance and self-belief. "Main Bhi Arjun: Parv" is the first installment in the "Main Bhi Arjun Universe" movie series and aims to expand the reach of the "Global Clubfoot Awareness Parv" initiative led by Parv Thacker under the aegis of the Give Vacha Foundation. The film aspires to motivate individuals worldwide to find hope and strength in their own battles, inspired by Parv's journey.

Hindi Language.name: Oishi's Honeyymoon
Hindi Language.description: Newlyweds Oishi and Artav had to postpone their honeymoon, due to the lock down. Now, in 2024, they have finally planned a honeymoon. However, on the eve of Oishi's honeymoon, an unexpected incident puts the entire honeymoon in jeopardy.

Hindi Language.name: Hum, Tum aur Love
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around the writer Aditya, as he remembers his college days and how he first met Garima, a street-smart girl he eventually falls in love with.

Hindi Language.name: A Lovely Résumé
Hindi Language.description: A Lovely Résumé is a tale of love which starts through a piece of paper... Résumé. A bashful boy, Krishna and his journey begins with a hunt to earn a living... a job. In the path of hope he meets Rashmi and fall in love at first sight in a local cyber café. In the journey, Krishna visits cyber café over and over again to print his Résumé because of his job rejection due to Casteism. Krishna faces caste system of society and nepotism several times as well as he builds an attraction with Rashmi, a flirtatious girl. Krishna's path is fill with love, struggle, courage, pain and at last hope which embraces with Rashmi's compassion.

Hindi Language.name: Shashikosha
Hindi Language.description: Shashi = The Moon; Kosha = A Treasury. The journey of a man who travelled from a small village of Uttarakhand to Mumbai, sharing his wisdom and spreading his knowledge of Hindi literature, culture and the art of living to every being.

Hindi Language.name: Dewalo
Hindi Language.description: The Film has strong lesson for those business class people, who take loan for their business and misuse it in pomp and show or in speculative property business.

Hindi Language.name: The Indian Memoir
Hindi Language.description: Ten diverse stories from across India interweave to reveal universal truths about love, loss, and triumph. From bustling Mumbai to serene Kerala, these tales showcase ordinary people facing extraordinary circumstances.

Hindi Language.name: Krishna Ki Kahani
Hindi Language.description: "Krishna Ki Kahani" is a YouTube TV series hosted by Krishna Singh Rao, showcasing the most important moments of his life in a raw and inspiring way.

Hindi Language.name: Montage
Hindi Language.description: Two young friends meet in their hometown after a few years. Without any specific plan, they roam around their City all day. And simultaneously, they also travel through their broken childhoods, with its frozen moments, through the sensitive boundaries of friendship and love; and through those answers which do not require questions. Re-living the old and creating new Montages, the day itself ends as a beautiful Montage. Emotions peek from the corner of his eye. The quiet perfectness of her simplicity. But, something blooms among the withered leaves of previous autumns, only to fall again.. Unlocked emotions in the City Of Gates..

Hindi Language.name: AIIMS: The Last Hope
Hindi Language.description: This documentary film highlights the immense trust and reliance placed on AIIMS by patients from across India, especially those from underprivileged backgrounds who view the institution as their final resort for quality medical care.

Hindi Language.name: Kamakshi
Hindi Language.description: In Rajasthan's haunted village of Bhartwa, whispers of a centuries-old curse echo through the night. A witch named Kamakshi rises in darkness, preying on men to fulfill her vengeance. When a tantric's protective shield collapses due to Rudra and Shilu's mistake, chaos engulfs the village. The guardian Kullu reveals a terrifying truth-Rudra is the reborn Som, eternally bound to Kamakshi's curse. Trapped between forgotten love and supernatural wrath, Rudra must confront his past and face Kamakshi in a battle that could either redeem Bhartwa or doom him to the very fate he was born to end.

Hindi Language.name: Psycho Holibaaz
Hindi Language.description: Bhaskar, A Boy Who Killed His Own Father And His Whole Family And Surrendered Himself To the Police. Bhaskar A 19 Year Old Boy Who Killed His Won Family Members As He was very much Tortured By them. During Investigation It Was Also Found That He Has Some Family Enemy Who Are trying To Kill Him Because Of His Grandfather's Property. But To Save His Life He Had kill His Own Family. Why..??? Is He A Murderer Or A Psycho.....Watch Till End To Know About Him.

Hindi Language.name: Poorval
Hindi Language.description: The unwanted fight between two brothers due to their wives

Hindi Language.name: Solved
Hindi Language.description: Between lectures and sleepless nights, freshman Shubham gets pulled into a mysterious case that uncovers secrets, lies, and unexpected love. As the truth draws closer, he must solve it before it destroys everything he cares about.

Hindi Language.name: Tujhe Chahoon Main
Hindi Language.description: In the bustling heart of Delhi, AARAV OBEROI'S life runs like a well-oiled machine, precision-engineered by none other than his father, Mr. Oberoi. Their relationship is a complex tapestry of respect, expectation, and unspoken emotion-a dance of duty and desire that has shaped Aarav's very being. Aarav, the obedient protégé, has become a successful businessman, sharing the reins of the family's construction empire. He's also the perfect fiancé to the fiery NEHA DESHMUKH, daughter of a powerful politician. Their impending marriage is a fusion of friendship and familial expectations, lacking only that elusive spark of passion But fate has other plans. A business trip to the breathtaking valleys of Bhaderwah, Kashmir brings Aarav face-to-face with Khushbu Kaul. She's a whirlwind of contradictions-a free spirit with an old soul, whose laughter echoes through the mountains and whose wisdom seem as ancient as the surrounding peaks. In just three days, Khushbu awakens something in Aarav he never knew existed, challenging the very foundation of his carefully constructed world. For the first time, the man who always followed his head is compelled to listen to his heart, a language he's long forgotten. As Aarav returns to Delhi, he's torn between the life he's always known-the path meticulously laid out by his father-and the possibility of a love he never expected. The countdown to his wedding with Neha begins, but Aarav is a changed man, haunted by memories of Kashmir and a pair of eyes that seem to hold the secrets of the universe. Neha, perceptive and proud, senses the shift in her fiancé. Will she fight for the love she's always believed in, or step aside for a connection that seems written in the stars. Meanwhile, in Jammu, Khushbu grapples with her own dilemma, caught between pursuing this unexpected love and respecting the boundaries of society. As the wedding day approaches, tensions rise. Aarav must navigate the treacherous waters between his father's expectations, his duty to Neha, and the passionate pull of his heart towards Khushbu. Will he bow to the life planned for him, or risk everything for a chance at true love? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hindi Language.name: Sobo Ki Nakchadi
Hindi Language.description: In the upscale area of SoBo (South Bombay), Roma stands out as a spirited young woman with a strong-willed attitude. Her disdain for those from the suburbs sheds light on the societal divisions in India rooted in language and education. As the daughter of Alaak, Roma challenges her father's quest to find her a suitable husband, despite his dual role as both mother and father since his wife's passing. Seeking guidance from his late wife's portrait, Alaak arranges Roma's marriage to Rajiv, a promising match from the suburban area of Andheri, considered a 'Vern' in societal terms. The complexities of Roma's past and her ties to a Colaba resident test the strength of her union with Rajiv. Through patience, understanding, and love, Rajiv embarks on the journey of taming Roma's fiery spirit, leading to transformative growth and unity. This film delves into themes of transformation and acceptance, aiming to bridge the societal gaps prevalent in the country.

Hindi Language.name: Perfect Valentine Gift
Hindi Language.description: A rich youth Kabir kidnaps love of his life Alia this Valentine to his farm house to make her accept his love and to evade Police and his best friend Karan whom Alia loves.

Hindi Language.name: Shubh Lagn Muhurat Again
Hindi Language.description: A fully entertaining comedy super dose movie.

Hindi Language.name: Mera naam ullhas hai part 2 (bachelor)
Hindi Language.description: The story line is about the protagonist who just wants to be bachelor forever, how is he able to do so is the plot of the film.

Hindi Language.name: Sangharsh Anandi Ka
Hindi Language.description: Anandhi leaves her humble and troubled home to fearlessly pursue a better life for her family, facing numerous challenges with unwavering courage.

Hindi Language.name: Bhediya: The Hunter
Hindi Language.description: A Scientist has a Theory that Man was an Animal in the early times and it took many Centuries for him to Become a Human from an Animal. It is not known how Correct this Theory was.

Hindi Language.name: Ekangi antaratma
Hindi Language.description: A stuborn soul love story.

Hindi Language.name: Swarth Se Pare - Illimitable Self
Hindi Language.description: A documentary film on an autism friendly campus in India, and the journey of its founder.

Hindi Language.name: Lilly Chacha
Hindi Language.description: Set in the heart of rural India, Lilly Chacha follows a man whose struggles against poverty, identity, and social injustice reveal a raw and emotional journey of survival and dignity.

Hindi Language.name: L'Oréal Professionnel Paris Indian Hairdressing Awards
Hindi Language.description: India's first and only hairstyling reality series, L'Oréal Professionnel Indian Hairdressing Awards showcases the craft and talent of the country's top 12 hair professionals. Critiqued by acclaimed filmmaker Karan Johar and global brand ambassador Min Kim along with an exciting line-up of guest judges, the five-episode series chronicles the journey of these Hair Pros as they create transformative looks with each challenge to win the trophy at the grand finale.

Hindi Language.name: Bangkok Returns
Hindi Language.description: Mikki is serving as an Indian spy. He gets a call from his lover, Mayra, who is clueless about her kidnapping in Bangkok. Upon reaching Indian embassies, Mikki sees that Indian government officials and Interpol are not taking the case seriously. Mikki then starts his own investigation and finds that there is no truth in Mayra's story, as such a thing never happened. Mikki got stuck in a trap, and Mikki goes on a rampage of destruction to see his country safe, even if it means that he independently has to take on an entire world mafia.

Hindi Language.name: Shriman Bade Sahab
Hindi Language.description: SHRIMAN BADE SAHEB, Mumbai's most respected figure refuses to stay silent as crime seeps into everyday life. He watches helplessly as criminals, shielded by corrupt police, twist justice and ruin innocent lives. Knowing trials can be bought with money and influence, Bade Saheb makes a dangerous choice. Using his own power, he pressures the system from within, pushing for encounters that bypass broken courts. Every step brings him closer to danger, even death. Yet he stands firm-haunted but resolute-believing that saving the helpless is worth risking everything, even if history may never judge him kindly.

Hindi Language.name: Error Trapped with No Way Out
Reel ki Reality
Hindi Language.description: Reel Ki Reality was a landmark live event held on 21st November 2021, designed to captivate audiences and redefine influencer engagement. Featuring 12 macro influencers with massive social media followings, the show brought these digital icons into a common house for 12 hours with a unique concept: complete 12 challenges and reveal their authentic selves to their fans. The event streamed live on Moon OTT and partnered link servers, achieving a phenomenal milestone of 50 million+ viewers. This unprecedented response underscored the power of blending influencer culture with immersive live entertainment. Now, as it streams exclusively on Moon OTT, Reel Ki Reality continues to be a testament to the evolving dynamics of digital storytelling and audience connection.

Hindi Language.name: Maaya Prapanch
Hindi Language.description: Vishakha and Mark live happily until Mark, who fears lizards, starts hearing strange sounds. His mental health declines, affecting their life. A doctor's visit reveals shocking truths, leading to a thrilling journey of mystery and fear.

Hindi Language.name: Dukhad patr
Hindi Language.description: Moments of life of a person who is nobody.

Hindi Language.name: Poisonous
Hindi Language.description: The story revolves around three close friends-Sid, Prince, and Anushka-whose lives are deeply intertwined by friendship, love, sacrifice, and fate. Prince is charming, intelligent, wealthy, and carefree, living life on his own terms. Confident and charismatic, he is a natural flirt and a classic playboy. In contrast, Sid is a simple, ordinary young man with no financial stability or social confidence. Lacking money and self-esteem, Sid depends heavily on Prince for survival and direction in life. He handles Prince's daily responsibilities and errands, slowly losing his own identity in the process. This constant comparison gives rise to an inferiority complex that makes Sid appear dull and invisible, even to those closest to him. Anushka enters their lives as a calm, intelligent, and emotionally grounded woman. One day, Prince realizes that his casual lifestyle no longer satisfies him-he has truly fallen in love with Anushka. He confides in Sid and asks for his help in proposing marriage. Despite his inner struggles, Sid agrees, putting his friend's happiness above his own emotions. The day arrives when Prince, Anushka, and Sid go to the registrar's office to formalize the marriage. However, fate takes a tragic turn when Prince suddenly collapses and is rushed to the hospital. There, doctors reveal a devastating truth-Prince is suffering from a severe, incurable illness. Shortly after, he passes away, leaving behind heartbreak, unanswered questions, and shattered dreams. In the aftermath of Prince's death, Sid stands by Anushka as her strongest support system. Their shared grief slowly turns into understanding, companionship, and emotional healing. With time, Sid and Anushka decide to marry, honoring Prince's memory and moving forward together. Their life seems peaceful and stable, built on trust and emotional maturity. Just when everything appears settled, a mysterious woman enters their lives, triggering unexpected events. Her arrival uncovers buried secrets, unresolved emotions, and dark truths that threaten to destroy everything Sid and Anushka have built. What begins as suspicion soon escalates into betrayal, and eventually, a shocking crime takes place. As the story unfolds, the narrative dives into suspense and psychological drama-revealing motives, hidden pasts, and the real nature of relationships. Who committed the crime? What secrets were concealed behind friendship and love? And how far can guilt, obsession, and insecurity push a person? The answers unravel in this gripping tale of love, loss, and crime, available to watch on the Tangent OTT platform.

Hindi Language.name: Justice I'm the Law
Hindi Language.description: An intelligent law student goes on a secret crusade to eliminate criminals from the world after discovering a pen capable of killing anyone whose name is written with it. A law student, Abhay Rajput who remains restless due to the sight of crimes in society and no hope of crime ending, receives supernatural power that led him on a path to make society crime- free. Abhay uses this power to erase criminals in order to make this world a better place to live in. The real owner of the supernatural power is always associated with the tool and can only be seen by Abhay. The police department tries to catch Abhay. In this practice the police department appoints the best detective named as K. This is the story of mind wars among Abhay, K, Police Department and others.

Hindi Language.name: Nandini Ka Pratishodh
Hindi Language.description: Shapeshifting snake Nandini seeks revenge for Ratnavel's misdeeds and to reclaim the three Kalachakras. Watch the serpent's tale of vengeance against an ardent devotee of the Goddess of snakes Ganga and the family's guardian spirit Janaki.

Hindi Language.name: Har Ghar Jal Har Gaanv Swacchta
Hindi Language.description: A 52 episode travelogue series to explore the works of Jal Jeevan Mission and SBM-G in the villages of pan India.

Hindi Language.name: Mother Yamuna
Hindi Language.description: Behind the Taj Mahal, one of the symbols of India, flows the sacred river Yamuna. Its waters are among the most polluted in the world. Photographs of people immersed in toxic foam have made international media headlines, arousing disbelief and concern. The Yamuna is a severely compromised ecological system. Despite this, we are there immersed, like boiled frogs....

Hindi Language.name: Aatish
Hindi Language.description: Trapped in a loveless marriage, Ketki is drawn into a dangerous affair with her obsessive childhood friend Vedika, risking her family, sanity, and life as love turns deadly.

Hindi Language.name: Mangalsutra (Vertical Drama)
Hindi Language.description: Young bride trapped in a loveless marriage discovers betrayal,forbidden love, and dangerous family secrets,but just when she finds happiness with the man she truly loves, a chilling message from the shadows threatens to unravel everything.

Hindi Language.name: Mehta vs Mehta
Hindi Language.description: Two brothers-bound by blood, divided by intent. The elder, an NRI, returns with a dream to build hospitals and schools through his NGO carrying hope for his homeland. The younger, rooted in power, weaves a web of forged papers, political pressure, and silent threats to seize everything. Tension escalates-family turns courtroom, love turns suspicion. In a climactic moment, truth pierces through deceit: a hidden document, a loyal witness, and the brother's own conscience unravel the conspiracy. As the gavel strikes, justice prevails. The elder stands vindicated, the younger shattered. In the end, one truth echoes-Satyamev Jayate.

Hindi Language.name: Saaye Ka Safar
Hindi Language.description: After a tragic misunderstanding, a grieving businessman discovers his wife is alive and raising their daughter, forcing him to confront her past and win back his family.

Hindi Language.name: The Good, the Bad, the Hungry
AnBan - Soulmates Mein
Hindi Language.description: AnBan - Soulmates Mein" is a captivating short film that explores the contrasting souls in a passionate love story. The film delves into the lives of a married couple, who, like two sides of a coin, possess opposing perspectives on life. The wife, a fiercely ambitious and empowered woman, embraces her liberal values, while the husband, deeply protective, holds a more cautious and traditional mindset. As the story unfolds, doubts arise within the husband's heart, questioning his wife's love and accusing her of being too materialistic. However, through a series of compelling events, the wife's unwavering affection and genuine love for her husband are revealed, shattering his misconceptions. "AnBan - Soulmates Mein" beautifully portrays the complexities of love and the power of understanding, as the couple discovers that their differences in worldly perspectives do not diminish their deep connection. Through their journey, they learn to appreciate and respect each other's unique qualities, ultimately strengthening their bond as soulmates. This short film serves as a reminder that love transcends societal norms and expectations, and that true understanding and acceptance can bridge any divide. "AnBan - Soulmates Mein" is a heartfelt exploration of love, trust, and the transformative power of genuine connection.

Hindi Language.name: Swipe Swipe
Hindi Language.description: Current day and age when everything is available on our fingertips i.e mobile still the struggles with the dating and relationship continues irrespective of the age.

Hindi Language.name: Zakhm Ki Khamoshi
Hindi Language.description: Yash, a young secret detective, is on the trail of a ruthless serial killer who has begun a string of brutal murders. But when the hunter becomes the hunted, and the killer starts targeting Yash's closest ones.

Hindi Language.name: MTV D2R Mr & Miss India Runway Model
School-Viskul
Hindi Language.description: "School-Wiskul" is not just the story of a school, but the story of a generation whose fate is decided-what they must see, what they must study, and what they must become-even before they get a chance to fill their own eyes with the colours of their dreams. This is the story of those innocent children whose dreams are written on a blackboard, only to be erased by the numbers on a report card. This is the story of those hallways where children's laughter echoes, yet behind every laugh lies the shadow of an unspoken pressure. "School-Wiskul" holds the delicate threads of relationships-the joyous sounds of friendships, the innocent spark of mischief, and the lessons of strict discipline wrapped in a teacher's affection... But along with this, it also exposes the irony where, amidst high fees and sparkling uniforms, some parents mistakenly see themselves as the masters and the teachers as mere servants. This story is an account of a world where education doesn't reside in buildings, but is nurtured in hearts. Where the real curriculum is not written in books, but in feelings. "School-Wiskul" is, in fact, the search for that invisible lesson-which tells us that knowledge is not just a score, but an experience; and that every child is an unread poem, who should not be judged before being understood.

Hindi Language.name: Blind Date Destiny
Hindi Language.description: When free-spirited Naina Kapoor meets charming but guarded Rohan Malhotra on a blind date, a twist of fate turns one evening into a life-changing journey of love, secrets, and second chances.

Hindi Language.name: Lakshmi Mere Aangan Ki
Hindi Language.description: Abandoned by her father and coping with an alcoholic brother, Brinda becomes her family's sole breadwinner. She finds happiness in her sacrifice to meet the needs of her brothers &sisters. Watch Brinda stand tall in her selfless journey.

Hindi Language.name: Badgumaan
Hindi Language.description: "Badgumaan" is about Muliya torn between her husband and his brother, ultimately choosing loyalty.

Hindi Language.name: Akbar Ka bal Birbal Ka hal
Kittu
Hindi Language.description: A fearless small-town girl's college dreams turn into a battle between love, betrayal, and a dangerous past that could destroy her forever.

Hindi Language.name: Afterlife: Ek Prem Kahani
Hindi Language.description: Lucky and Gebi are bound by love, but fate separates them before Lucky confesses. After his death, destiny gives a second chance. Reunited in the afterlife, they must face the past and complete the love story that was left unfinished.

Hindi Language.name: Kashmir and National Education Policy 2020
Hindi Language.description: This Documentary, "Kashmir and National Education Policy 2020" has been certified as an "Educational FIlm" by CBFC. The ISBN of this Documentary is 978-81-986872-1-0. The CBFC, i.e. Censor Board has issued a Certificate: VIS/1/63/2025-DEL.

Hindi Language.name: Panne
Hindi Language.description: A woman's pursuit in achieving social identity after the dawn of her step grandfather's empire.

Hindi Language.name: Samarthan
Hindi Language.description: This film's story is connected to society, where people often perform prayers and rituals, yet still complain that they gain no benefit from them. They say that despite praying, they do not receive good results. They remain worried and unhappy-sometimes they meet with accidents, sometimes they get injured, sometimes problems arise at the office, and sometimes they get into fights with others. Such people question the value of prayer and ask, "What is the use of worship? Where is God?" The story revolves around two friends. One of them regularly prays and follows religious practices, while the other is involved in drinking alcohol, womanizing, and indulging in vices like opium, Charas, and marijuana-doing all kinds of immoral activities. In contrast, the friend who performs good deeds and prays meets with an accident, while the other friend, who does bad deeds, suddenly finds a bag full of money on his way. Through this film, it is shown what kind of results both of them receive for their actions. The film aims to depict the consequences of one's deeds-**the fruits of karma**-through this story.

Hindi Language.name: Middle Finger
Hindi Language.description: Abhijit Sawant gets entangled with the wrong people in his quest to get rich quickly. He has to complete a risky assignment in a day, will he be able to complete the job?

Hindi Language.name: Diljala Raanjha
Hindi Language.description: Left heartbroken, he battles memories that refuse to die and becomes the man the pain creates.
